tei:div.tei:p: ༷// ༷hūṃ rgirdoṭwāṃ: hūṃ/ //rgi byeX/rdzu /ṭwāṃ~X 5 51 dī ཿ dro7shā| shā 2༷༵ chi 30 mi3sdulta 7
༄7/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/ /(ca)gung thang bstan pa'i sgon mes brtsams/mirigasadaposkrunakhang /

༅tsozalo za/01ba/mazatshocho zawa4khyezomaza zo5ཿ7tshojo nga /bzomazo thutho zalomaloni1 2khru4 5/32ma7—105—06217—71 po smo ma khya bocho mayo1 za maza za slom 29466—53khyezolorṣazagoyo01bamatshoṣṭharo(2khru4)za0mo509byuzamamalornye lomabo(shā6zopotsho zashādi tsho 14snyokhrokhyeza1khu13)5 977mkhan cha60 ba 4zalomaloni1 ma skakhri ma khrumangagrublo//thomolnga lozam2྾ca5zazo1lo 2྾ro5thagrothuzozo1mapoblo /za 850ba bam11477 1 2 yim 18 5grum khya1—1ཿma zayi 35 zaspra zhu poyo sgro2 7shā tshosmozlosmyostsostsozlasmogoshā 19)

༄༅/ /dpe sgrun ga47bshad/dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'am mtshan yongs gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me dbang phyug sder 'bod pa'i dam pa de nyid rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu pho rta lo ste spyi lo 1762lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge'i smadakyi yul du yab ze bo lcags po byams pa dang / yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ khong dgung lo bdun par phebs dus kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin mdzad de bla brang bkra shis 'khril du gdan drangs/ khong gis kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang rab byung dge tshul bcas dkyus gcig tu zhus shing mtshan la dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me zhes gsol/ de nas rdo rams pa blo bzang rin chen slob dpon du bsten nas yi ge'i sbyor klog dang blo 'dzin sogs legs par sbyangs pa ma zad/rim gyis rgya dang sog po'i skad yig sbyangs pas thugs su chud/ dgung lo bcu bdun par dbus su phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang /mdzod/ 'dul ba/ tshad ma/ phar phyin bcas gzhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par sbyangs/ dgung lo nyer gcig par rgyal ba blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos/1

༄/ /gung ca bam pa'i sgronama'i gsang ཿma/dgung lo nyer gnyis par dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/dbus su lo brgyad tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gzhung kun la mkhyen pa thogs med du gyur cing / dbus gtsang gi mkhas mang dkyil na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar kun gyis gtsug tu bkur ba'i gnas su gyur/dgung lo nyer lnga bar yul mdo smad bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/dgung lo sum cu bar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen du 'khod pas gdan rabs nyer gcig pa yin/ de nas bzung yul mdo smad lho byang gi chos grwa chen po rnams su 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba'i yo lang kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i chu mo lug lo ste spyi lo 1823lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thim/ dbal mang paṇḍi ta dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs slob ma mkhas chen mang du byung ngo / /khong gi gsung rtsom ni phar phyin sdom dang / mdzod sdom/ 'dul ba sdom/ sgra dang snyan ngag sman dang rtsis/ lha ris thig tshad sogs sgyu rtsal skor gyi bstan bcos rnams gcig tu bsdus te po ti bcu gcig byas nas shing par du brkos yod pa de dag kun kyang tshad mar 'dzin pa'i legs bshad sha stagayin pas nged cag dpe skrun khang gis bla brang gi shing par gzhir bzung nas dpar du btab pa'i dge ba 'di yis thams cad bkra shis bde legs su gyur cig /mi rigs dpe skrun khang /2

༄/ /dkar chagadakar chagarje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (1)bstan pa'i rtsa lag yil gog san er ti ni mer gen paṇḍi ta hu thog thu blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas kyi rnam thar nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (179)nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen chen po mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa legs tshogs sgo 'byed ces bya ba /pa/(//ཿsa//sa (sdus (18)5)rje bla ma mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul dang 'brel bar bstod pa rnam dag gangs ri ma'i 'grel pa rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (271)dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam grub pa'i bden tshig gi 'grel pa bzhugs so/ (304)yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi zhing gi bsngags pa brjod pa dang ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (311)phul byung legs bshad ma'i 'grel pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bsdonagathag (〈/ (317)gnyan rtse dpon slob rin po che'i bstod 'grel nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (336)1

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i sgonaryā khrung 4/bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar dang 'brel pa'i kun bzang 'khor lo sogs kun 'khor sna tshogs kyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legs bshad ces bya ba bzhugs so/ (344)bden gtam de nyid gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (361)kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rje rin po che'i bstod pa dbyed kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (366)bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsungs thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang phyag mchod skor ba'i phan yon bstan pa rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (379)lung ston byams pa'i dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi gatrī zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (442)bde ba can gye zhing gi yon tan sems pa dang sbrags te smon lam 'debs ༅ byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so (462)rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i gsang ba'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ (468)dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar ba gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (475)mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid sgo mang mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos dar pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so (508)2

༄za/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ro༅/ / rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jig rten kun tu bde skyid 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ / spang rtogs sgo mtho'i lhun po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / ma rig mun sel nyi ma dam pa'i chos/ / rig grol rin chen 'byung gnas dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum byādhriX byeX byang tt+waṃ~X ༵ ra ldardo sdidis 'a/ du/na ༵du ༷ ṭwāṃ di nghrudhi rdo ༵rdo /la mahūṃX ṭwāṃ ༵༵ bstanayo rdo'i tardod sgoX ṭwā didhridīdī dhri /sa bo/ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃ'im rla ṭwāṃ dhri ༵ dī ṭwāṃhāX las/ / rin chen sems kyi sdong bu dar drag tshogs gnyis yal ga'i khyon yangs shing / / phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i me tog rnam bkra bde chen sku bzhi'i 'bras bu smin/ / lhun grub 'phrin las grib bsil snum pos 'gro la phan bde ci yang stsol/ / zla shel gcig las yangs pa'i 'jig rten du/ / rang 'dra rgya mtsho'i rdul snying 'char ba bzhin/ / mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gsang gsum kyi/ / rol pa yid kyi ra ba las 'das kyang / / dus mthar thun mong gdul bya'i mos ngo dang / / 'tsham par bstan pa skye ba'i zlos gar la/ / tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i rim pa yis/ / don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i 1

༄/ /gung ca bayo yosgonasa'i khrung 'bum/ṭwāṃ sdi ༷bye/ /hūṃbye/ / ༷༷/ ༷༷shaṃ shaṃshaṃshaṃ byeshaṃ byebhe sdiṭwāṃ rte bherte ༷rte ṭwāṃ shaṃshaṃshaṃ rtebye spro ba'i 'jug ngogs yin/ / mkha' dang 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor dbyar gyi lang tshos bsten pa na/ / yid 'ong mdongs mtha'i rgyal mo 'jo sgeg nyams kyis rol pa bzhin/ / rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i yon tan lhun gyis dzogs mthong tshe/ / mdzangs shing des pa rnams ni bstod bkur bsngags la spro ba 'dzin/ / lce rkan gtsub shing brdar ba'i mong nyid la/ / chags sdang du ba 'thul ba'i gshis min par/ / dam pa'i yon tan zla shel dang 'grogs pas/ / legs byas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs chu shel dngos/ / mkhas bheṭwāṃbhe bhebhe bheshe rte tt+waṃ bhe byebhehūṃ tt+waṃ ༷/ ////// ༷/ shaṃ bhebhe bhe ṭwāṃbhe/ ༷bhebhe rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsis thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ rtag sbyor gus sbyor gyi brtson pa dang skyes thob sbyangs thob kyi shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i gru gzings kyis mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i smra ba'i khyu mchog / bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i go cha bgos te tshul khrims gsum gyis bsdus pa'i spyod pa bya dka' ba mtha' dag la zhum pa med par slob pa'i rgyal sras dpa' bo/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i bsnyen sgrub mthar son cing 2

༄༅/ /tshul khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mtshan bcas mtshan med dang rim gnyis zab mo'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa che long tsam zhig bsnyad par bya ba ni/ sku tshe snga mar grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po spyod 'chang dbang po'am nag po ba zhes mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud las gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul dang mdzad pa/ bu chen bzang po'i zhabs dang dge tshul tshems bu pa sogs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa'i slob ma drug dang bcas pa lung bstan cing /dus 'khor gyi rgyud phyi ma 'gyur rnying las kyang mtshan sgra gsal bar lung bstan pa de nyid dang / rje bla ma'i thugs sras 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa bdun gyi nang tshan 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa zhes gzhung chen brgya dang sum cu thugs la bzung ste bshad pa gnang zhing /dpal ldan 'bras srung gi chos sde chen po phyag btab pas dge ldan ring lugs micub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug par mdzad pa de nyid sogs rgya bod gnyi gar mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skye 'phreng nam mkha'i nyi zla lta bu du ma rim par brgyud pa'i tshul/ rje bla ma'i snyan brgyud man ngag gi bdag po ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi skye mtha' rta tshag rje drung ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon pos mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs su gsal ba dang / gzhan yang 'khrul bral ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i lha bla ma du ma'i lung gis zin pa ltar ro/ / 'o na tā ra nā tha yan gyi sku 'phreng gong ma rnams rje btsun dam pa'i 'khrungs rabs su'ang bzhugs pas 'di dang mi 'brel snyam pa ni blo gros dman zhing mthong rgya chungaba'i skyon te/ mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa dang zhwa lu ba legs pa rgyal mtshan lta bu dam pa so so'i 'khrungs rabs na yod pa shin tu mang zhing 'khrungs rabs che ba phal cher gyi phugs rigs gsum mgon po gang rung la 3

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/thug cing / rigs gsum mgon po ngo bo gcig par bka' gdams glegs bam las 'byung ba dang / khyad par du theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan las/ ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ / 'od zer dpag tu med 'dres shing / / rtag tu bya ba gcig la 'jug / 'jig rten la yang snang ba byed/ / de bzhin zag med dbyings na yang / / sangs rgyas dpag tu med 'dres shing / /mdzad pa gcig ni mdzad pa la/ / ye shes snang bar mdzad par 'dod/ /ces nyi ma'i cha shas kun gyi 'od zer 'dres nas 'jig rten snang bar byed pa dang / yang / klung dag sa yi 'og tu ma song ba/ zhes pa nas/ rgya mtshor song bar gyur na thams cad kyang / / gnas rnams gcig cing chu yang che la gcig / bya ba gcig cing chu la gnas pa yi/ / srog chags mang po'i rtag tu nyer spyad che/ / sangs rgyas nyid du ma zhugs brtan pa rnams/ / rten kyang tha dad blo gros tha dad cing / / rtogs chung rang gi bya ba tha dad la/ /sems can nyung don rtag tu nyer spyad 'gyur/ / sangs rgyas nyid du zhugs na de dag kun/ / rten kyang gcig cing rtogs pa che la gcig / mdzad pa gcig tu 'dres shing rtag par yang / / sems can tshogs che'i nye bar spyad pa che/ / zhes chu klung mtha' dag rgya mtshor 'dres na ro gcig tu 'gyur ba bzhin/sangs rgyas pa na nga'o snyam pas phye bas rgyud tha dad kyi rnam gzhag med la/gdul bya'i sngon gyi 'brel ba'i dbang gis tha dad snang rgyu'ang yod pa mi 'gal bas/ de nyid las/ zag med dbyings na sangs rgyas rnams/ / mkha' ltar lus ni med phyir dang / / sngon gyi lus rjes 'brang ba'i phyir/ / gcig min mang po nyid ma yin/ / zhes dang / rigs tha dad phyir don yod phyir/ / rdzogs phyir thog ma med pa'i phyir/ / sangs rgyas gcig min dri med gnas/ / tha dad med phyir mang po'ang min/ / zhes gsungs so/ / 'di ni 4

༄/ /4 khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mngon pa kun btus las bsam mi khyab bzhir gsungs pa'i nang nas kyang /mi mnyam pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi mthar thug tu gsungs pas blor shong dka'ang / dam pa'i gsungs la yid ches kyi dad pa skyed na phan yon shin tu che ba ni/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs las/ bsam mi khyab la dad byas na/ / rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / der ma zad sa dang por sprul pa brgya 'gyed pa nas bzung gong ma gong mar stong gsum 'bum phrag du ma'i rdul snyed kyi sprul pa ston par gsungs pa rang gis khas len cing / de'i sgo nas bsngags pa brjod bzhin du phyogs gnyis nas sprul pa gnyis byung na 'gal bar rtsi ba ni rang tshig dngos su 'gal ba yin pas/ don med pa'i gnas la rtog ge'i rigs pa 'tshang ste log rtog gi 'phreng ba mi sbel bar/ rang rang la gang 'tsham du bstan cing gdams pa'i ngo skal de nyid bdag gir byas te mos gus sbyangs na sman yon du 'gyur ro/ / tshon brgya'i mdangs dang 'grogs pa'i dwangs shel bzhin/ / mtha' yas gdul bya'i skal ba'i rjes 'gro ba/ / gcig min gzhan min ye shes 'byung lnga'i mdangs/ / gzugs sku'i 'ja' tshon ri mo cir yang snang / / lha bu nyi ma dngos sam gzhal yas su/ / rtsod par mi ltos grags pa'i gdung sel bzhin/ / rtog ge'i 'khrul bar mi 'phyan gang 'dul gyi/ / bkod par mos pas smin cing grol pa 'thob/ / de'ang sku 'phreng gong ma de dag las 'ga' zhig la rnam thar lo rgyus rgyas kyang cha tshang ba zhig ma rnyed pas re zhig btang stoms su bzhag / gdan sa 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i sku gong ma rje mi nyag blo gros dar rgyas dpal bzang po nas brtsams te gleng ba la/ rje gong ma de nyid gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ rje tsong kha pa chen po sku bltams pa'i gnas khyad par can dang mi ring ba'i sa'i cha bum par 5

༄/ /yo thang bayo rsāsgonas gsung ཿma/rte'u chung zhes par rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ de nas ring po ma lon pa na sngon gye bag chags yongs su sad pas khyim gyi gnas ni dug sgrul gyi tshang lta bur gzigs te/sku 'bum du byon nas rgyud pa bla ma snye kyu dge legs dpal ldan las yongs dzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang rab byung gi tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas klog pa dang thos bsam sogs la brtson par mdzad/ ring por ma lon par dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du phebs nas dpal ldan 'bras srung bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs te rgyal dbang yab sras sogs skyes chen dam pa du ma'i zhabs la bsten/ khyad par mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la gtugs nas mdo sngags kyi gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan/ bka' pod chen po rnams la sbyang ba mthil phyin pa mdzad/ gsang phur phebs nas bka' bcu'i ming btags gnang / gsang chen gdams pa'i gter mdzod brag dkar sngags ram pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas dbang rjes gnang khrid man ngag sogs zab chos mang du gsan pa dang / jo shāka sogs la mchod 'bul phyag skor/ dbus gtsang kun tu gnas mjal sogs dbus phebs kyi dgos don mtha' dag lhun gyis grub nas slar mdo smad du phebs/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i snyan grags che zhing sngon gyi las 'brel gyes bskul nas kun gyis bla marabakur te/ mtsho sngon phyogs kyi wang pe li ja sag sogs bla dpon phal cher sbyin bdag tu gyur pas de dag la 'dod mos bzhin chos kyi char phab/nyidakyi sku gong ma'i 'khrungs yul khri ga gser mo ljongs su bstan 'gro'i phan bder dmigs bod kha/ ske ba zhes grags pa'i sar dgon pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling dang / khri ga'i mkhar gyi thag nyer sngon rje btsun sgol ba'i 6

༄/ /spyo khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mgon po'i sku tshe rjes mar sngags chen 'phrin las 'bum du skye ba bzhes skabs sgrub pa byed pa'i gnas der gsang sngags bde chen chos 'phel gling dang bkra shis chos gling zhes pa'i ri khrod gnyis btab/ hor kyā'i grwa tshang bsam gtan rab rgyas gling zhes pa'ang 'debs par mdzad de bshad sgrub rnam par dag pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde mang du btsugs/ gsang sngags bde chen chos 'phel gling der yun ring po'i bar du sgrub pa nan tan gnang / rgya bod hor sog gis mtshon phyogs mtha' dag nas yong ba'i dad ldan ser skya drag zhan mang po la rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis yid tshim par mdzad/ de nas sku 'bum chos sde chen por phebs skabs las sne thun mong nas bstan pa spyi dang / lhag par dgon pa 'di'i bshad sgrub kyi bya ba 'phel ba la bar du gcod pa'i gegs sel ba'i ched du zhabs brten rim gro zhig sgrub dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin rgyud grwa'i 'du khang gi khyams rar rje nyid sgrub grogs dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang bcas pas 'jigs byed kye bsnyen pa rgyun ring gnang ste mjug tu zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang mjal ba ser skya mtha' dag la ngo mtshar ba'i mthong snang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung / de dag la brten nas skye bo kun lhag par dad de 'di ni nges par mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig go zhes phyogs kun tu grags/ de nas rgyud pa'i seng khrir bzhugs nas sngags kyi 'chad nyan la thugs khur che bzhes mdzad/ grwa pa chos 'grim pa rnams la sgo du ma nas chos la sbyor ba'i rting bskul gang drag gnang / lhag par rgyud grwa 'dir sngar paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtor chog mtshon cha 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor ltar gyi lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa ma gtogs lcags mkhar zur dgu pa'i phyag len ma dar bas/ rje 'dis lcags mkhar zur 7

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/dgu pa'i phyag len btsugs/ snga ma 'ga' zhig bu ston gyi gsung zin sogs labarten nas drug cu pa brtsegs pa'i sngo tshul mi 'thad par smra ba byung yang /'dini rtog bdun gyi rtog pa gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud rtog gsum gyi rtog pa dang po dang gsum pa sogs 'khrul 'khor gyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i gshed skor kun gyi dgongs pa gtor ma la brten pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin zhing / lhag parazur dgu pa 'di ni rwa lo'i gtor chog las/ drug cu rtsa bzhi rtseg tshul ni/ /phyi yi zur dgu nyis rtseg dang / / zhes sogs kyis 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang las gshin sbrags sgrub la brten pa'i lcags mkhar zur dgu pa'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos gtor chog srid gsum rnam rgyal du gsal bar mdzad pa yin pas/ sngags 'chang rnams kyis bstan pa srung ba'i lag cha rmad du byung bar gzigs nas bstan pa'i lcags ri lta bur btsugs pa yin la/ grwa pa rnams sngar rgyus med pa'i thig dang rtseg tshul sogs sbyor dngos rjes kyi phyag len cha tshang ba nyid nas zhib khrid mdzad/ de'i ngag 'don dang kun spyod sogs kyi rim pa yi ger bkod nas mkhar thabs gnyis po lo re bzhin res mos kyis sgrub pa'i srol btsugs nas thugs bskyed kyi dbang gis da lta'i bar gong 'phel du gnas/ de nas rgyud khri'i dgongs pa zhus te slar yang khri gar phebs nas thugs dam la gzhol bar mdzad/ skabs shig tu sbyin bdag gcig gis gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs pa dang lam du chibs pa 'drog ste chibs gong nas bskyur bas/ zhabs gras parnams la 'dir kha la phog ste ras gur phub ces gsungs/ de nas nyid ras gur du bzhugs te khyod tsho thag ring la song / ngas brda ma byas bar du sdod cig ces gsungs/ yun ring tsam song ba dang zhabs gras pa rnams la bosanas mdun du song bas/ sems can la gnod pa byed mkhan gye mi ma 8

༄/ /spyo khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/yin ma rung ba gsum 'dug pas bzung ba yin kyang gnyis shor song /gcig 'di'o zhes the'u rang rkang gcig gi gzugs shig mdun na 'dug pa bstan pas zhabs gras pa rnams kyang ya mtshan bar gyur/ rje nyid la da 'dis ci byed zhus pas/ byed rgyu gzhan med srung ma'i spyan gzigs la phul gsungs te/ deng sang yang kun gyis mngon sum du reg rgyu dang mthong rgyu yod do/ / rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa sbrul lor rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdan sa sku 'bum chos sde chen po'i khri la bzhugs te dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi char phab/ lo der skyabs mgon dam pa lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje rgya nag nas mdo smad du byon skabs rje'i gser gdung sogs mjal bzhed kyis gdan sa sku 'bum chos sde 'dir phebs/ gdan sa pa dam pa 'di nyid rje rol ba'i rdo rje'i drung du phyag dbang zhu bar phebs skabs/rje lcang skya rin po che thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i sgo nas mdo sngags kyi dri ba mang du gnang zhing / khyad par zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba'i skor nas dka' gnas kyi dri ba mang du mdzad pas/ zhu lan lung rigs kyis mtha' chod pa thogs med du phul bas/ lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa thugs gting nas tshim pas phyag thal mo sbyar te bsngags brjod mdzad/ rje 'di la phyag chen gyi khrid cig gnang rgyu'i snyan gsan phul yang / lcang skya rin po che'i zhabs phyi la rgya mi'i dpon po che drag mang po yong nas sku la bcar sdod byas yod pas gdan sa 'dir gnang stabs ma 'grig par brten/ rje lcang skya rin po che dang rje 'di pa gnyis zhabs gras nyung ngur byas nas chos sde chen po bya khyung du phebs te der dga' ldan phyag rgya chen po'i khrid lung rigs kyi lam nas drangs pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i gsung bshad shin tu rgyas par phul cing / lhag par lta ba'i skor la bod kyi lta sgom mi 'dra 9

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/ba so so dang / de las rje bla ma'i rang lugs 'di khyad par 'phags tshul sogs ma 'dres par phye ste zhib tu bkrol bas rje lcang skya rin po che'i thugs shin tu 'phrog ste rje 'di la gus pa cher mdzad cing bsngags brjod yang yang gnang ba'i stobs kyis mkhas pa'i grags pa mtha' dbus kyi phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur/ de'i skabs su gdan sa 'dir bzhugs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sum cu lhag gis kyang bka' chos mang du zhus shing mdo sngags kyi dka' gnas las brtsams te dri ba mang du zhus par bka' lan thogs med du gnang /rje lcang skya rin po che 'di gnas phebs khar nyid la rje tsong kha pa'i 'khrungs gnas khyad par can 'dir rje nyid dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa 'di rnams dang lhan rgyas su 'dug 'dod che'ang / 7gong ma'i bka' bzhin 'phral du bskyod dgos par/ slar mjal nas chos kyi dga' ston myong ba'i 'dun pa byed ces thugs 'phrad pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ lcags rta'i lo rgya yag mkhan po er ti ni cha gan hu thog thus rje rin po che'i gser sku che ba zhig gdan drangs te tshogs chen gyi 'du khang chen mor bzhugs su bcug nas rje 'di bas rab gnas mdzad pas legs tshogs rten 'brel che ba byung / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang don gnyer ba rnams la bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ spyan ras gzigs/ tshe dpag med sogs kyi dbang dang / snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lam rim dang sngags rim chen mo/ paṇa chen gsung 'bum/ lcang skya rin po che'i gsung 'bum sogs kyi lung bcas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i mdo sngags kyi chos mang du stsal nas kun gyi yid tshim par byas/ de'i skabs su gzur gnas bu slob rnams kyis mi nyag rdo rje 'chang zhes bsngags brjod kyi rol mo 'khrol ba la brten nas phyogs kun tu'ang rje 'di'i mtshan la mi nyag rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa byung / skyes rabs so bzhi 10

༄/ /༅ khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/pa'i stod cha la 'grel pa zhig mdzad pa'ang tshig don gyi cha mtha' dag nas mkhas pa kun gyi yid 'phrog pas bsngags brjod kyi gnas su gyur/ sa sbrul nas bzung chu sprel gyi lo'i bar du smon lam gsung chos skabs snga dro'i cha la sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs dang lam rim gnyis res mos kyis 'chad pa dang /phyi dro'i char smon lam la chag med du phebs te bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ smon lam dus der phyogs kun nas 'dus pa'i dad ldan ser skya che phra rnams la'ang so so'i 'dod pa bzhin phyag dbang dang dbang lung rjes gnang sogs lhug par stsal/ rgyun du gdan sa 'di ga'i 'chad nyan la gzigs rtog star chags su mdzad de/ chos thog skabs brtsi bzhag rgyun parasnal cing / tshig rgyugs dang don rgyugs res mos kyis bzhes/ grwa pa chos 'grim pa rnams la gzengs bstod gsol ras sogs bdag rkyen gnang ba dang / gzhan rnams la'ang chags zhen du ma song ba'i 'di dang phyi ma'i dgos don gtsor 'don gyi rting bskul gnang bas mkhas blun kun yi rang bar gyur te nyin mtshan khor yug tu thos bsam tshig dril du mdzad cing /lhag par chos grwa pa rnams kyis rje 'di pa'i gsung dang du blangs te/ rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung sogs yig cha khungs thub rnams tshad mar bzung nas rtsod pa'i dus su tshig 'khri tsam min par/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa rang gi rgyud steng du go rgyu zhig byung na snyam pazhi (bsam pa 'ba' zhig gis slob gnyer la brtson pa dang / nga rgyal dang phrag dog sogs ye mi byed par gzhan yon tan can la shin tu gus pas ya rabs kyi ngang tshul la gnas pa sha stag byung / rgyun ring bsten nas zhal slob tu gyur par ma zad rje 'di'i zhal mthong nas chos tshigs su bcad pa bzhi tsam nyan pas kyang shes rgyud je 'jam du 'gro zhing gzhan la gus pa dang / rtag tu bag yod la gnas pa byung tshul 11

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i sgroname'i gatshi lam/ kun la mthun par grags/ sprel lor khri'i dgongs pa zhus nas rje chu bzang rin po che ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug gdan sa 'di'i khrir brko bzhag mdzad/ de nas sku bsnyun bzhes pa'i tshul gnang skabs/ phyag gnyer sogs kyis zhabs brtan phon cher bsgrubs/ gdan sa 'di'i rgyud sman bla ma gnyis dang tshogs chen zhal ngos gtsos pa'i las sne'i rigs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gzhi bzung dge 'dun 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhabs brtan phul bar/ bka' lan du da res skyon cher mi 'dug mod/'on kyang lo ha cang rgan pas nges pa ci mchis/ de bas bdag gi chos ldan gyi bgyi ba rnams bsam pa bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug dge 'dun 'dus tshogs yongs nas thugs brtse bas gzigs pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu ba mdzad/ 'phral du sku'i khams dwangs shing khri ga'i phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang / phebs kha'i tshe rje nyid kyi thugs sras 'ga' zhig dang rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i parnyi ta chen po che shos lha bzo bas gtsos dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang por chos srid kyi bslab ston bstsal cing / khyad par khyod tshos rang rang gi blo nus dang mthun par rgyal bstan yongs dzogs la bag chags ci thebs kyi dge spyor la rem rem gyis/ da phyis su nged rang rnams yang bskyar thug mi thub pa 'dra zhes gsungs/ de ltar mdo smad dang mtsho sngon phyogs kyi dpon 'bangs che phra phal cher dang / rma chu'i 'gram gyi rgya bod ma lus pa sbyin bdag tu gyur cing / de dag la thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel ba thogs par mdzad nas sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa na khri ga'i mchod rten bla brang du dgung lo bdun cu rtsa dgu pa chu bya lo'i hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/thugs dam la rgyun ring tsam bzhugs shing thugs dam grol rtags su shangs 12

༄༅/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bug g.yas g.yon nas byang sems gnyis kyi rgyun babs pa sogs rgyud sde nas bshad pa ltar gyi ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung / zhabs gras pa rnams kyis gdan sa 'dis mtshon phyogs so so'i dge 'dun gyi sde mchod 'bul dang /nyid kyi bla brang du'ang mchod tshogs rgya chen po bstar te sde snod 'dzin pa du masagatsos dge 'dun brgya phrag gnyis lhag gis bde gsang 'jigs gsum sogs rgyud sde gong 'og gi bdag 'jug bzhes pa rnams la mang 'gyed gya nom pa dang / dbul phongs la sbyin pa sogs rnam dkar gyi phung po gang rgyas sgrub bhebhe rdo shebhe/ // / / de // /// de ༷ ༷ // //bye tt+waṃ bhe bhe bcad pa'o/ /dam pa de nyid slar yang ljongs 'dir gdul bya rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te yang srid gsar pa'i zlos gar mngon par bsgyur ba ni/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i srog shing mtshungs zla ma mchis pa dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po 'di nyid yin la/ mgon po 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po sku bltams pa'i gnas khyad par can mkhas grub bye ba'i rol mtsho chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi nubaphyogs ha cang mi ring ba'i yul mtsho sngon gyi sa'i char/ dge mtshan du mas mngon par spras shing phyogs kun nas ri dang brag sogs gus pa'i tshul 13

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/gyis mngon par 'dud pa'i rnam pa can gyi dbus ri chen po um tsos o bo zhes 'bod pa/ gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha mthu rtsal can gnas shing / g.yas g.yon nas mu tu zer ba'i lung pa gnyis kyi gshar chu ri de'i mdun du 'dres nas yon chab kyi tshul du 'khyil ba sogs dpal 'byor 'du ba'i sa dpyad can gyi gnas khyad par can zhig yin par snang / gdung brgyud ni/ badzra pā ṇi'i sprul pa'i rgyal po zhig/ ces sogs gter gzhung du ma dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge ha ming slar log nas/ / kla klo'i rgyal pos rab tu mchod/ / yi ge ha bya dge dang ldan/ / zhes gsungs te/ os lod rnams ke ken han zhes zer la/ yongs grags ko shi han zhes zer ba'i mtshan sgra dang ri bo dga' ldan pa'i sbyin bdag gi rtsa bar 'gyur bar lung bstan la/ rgyal brgyud rnams kyang chab srid yar ldan gyi rten 'brel ma 'chug pa'i ring la zhwa ser gyi sbyin bdag thun mong ma yin par gyur pa'i gdung brgyud kyi dpon khag du ma mchis pa las/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa skyong mi dbang dam pa wang dkon mchog bkra shis kyi chab 'og tu gtogs pa ta le'i hung ze ji zer ba'i skye rgyud yin zhing / gso rig rgyud bzhi'isrol 'byed chen po g.yu thog yon tan mgon po gnyis pa dar mo sman ram pa'ang gdung brgyud 'di nyid yin par grags so/ / rigs phun sum tshogs pa ni rnam smin gyi yon tan brgyad kyi gtso bo zhig yin pas/ mdo las/ya rabs rigs ldan gus shing bag yod spyod/ ngang tshul bzang la gtsang zhing des par 'gyur/ / zhes yon tan du ma gsungs shing / rgyan las kyang /rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / / zhes sa'i yongs sbyong gi skabs su gsungs so/ / sman mdo brgyad brgya par/ rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i khyim dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ bram ze shing snga la chen po lta bu'i khyim dag 14

༄/ /༅ khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/tu skye bar 'gyur/ khyim bdag shing sā la chen po lta bu'i khyim dag dang /nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang ba mang po 'byor pa'i khyim du skye bar 'gyur/ zhes rigs bzang ba'i steng du 'byor pa che ba la bsngags pa ni sbyin pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bang nas skyes dang nye rgyal gyi byung ba'i thad kyi 'dul ba lung las/ ha cang phyug po'i khyim dang ni/ / dbul po'i khyim du mi skye bar/ / bar ma'i khyim du skye 'gyur zhing / /rtag tu rab byung mang bar shog / ces bsngags pa rab tu 'byung sla ba dang tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas pa yin zhing / 'di ni gnyis po gang gi dbang du byas kyang chog pa zhig go / yab bsod nams dar rgyas zer ba rang bzhin bzang ba/ bla ma mchog gsum la dad gus che zhing tha na lhan pa ser po yan chad la skyabs kyi 'du shes 'dzin pa/ snying rje che zhing sbyin gtong la dga' ba/kha ton dge sbyor dang phyag skor sogs dam pa'i lha chos sgrub pa la gzhol ba/'dod chung chog shes bsten cing dus rtag tu bag dang ldan pa zhig go zhes kun la grags/ yum ni sgrol ma skyid bya ba bud med kyi rten la g.yo sgyu med cing dad pa dang gtsang spra che ba/ sgrol dkar ljang ma ṇi sogs kha ton la rgyun du 'bad cing / nye ring med par kun la phan ci thog byed pa zhig go zhes gleng /yab yum de gnyis la sras sras mo gsum yod pa'i dang po ni co ne chos rje blo bzang nyi ma'i sprul sku dang / gnyis pa ni rje 'di nyid yin la/ de'ang dam pa 'di nyid lhums su zhugs pa nas ji srid sku ma bltams kyi bar du yum gyi lus lhag par bde zhing / shes rgyud sngar las je 'jam je gsal du 'gro ba dang / rmi lam dang nyams snang ci rigs bar 'ja' tshon shar ba sogs ngo mtshar ba mang du byung / lhag par yab kyi rmi lam du rje tsong kha pa'i gser sku che ba zhig la rang nyid kyis mchod pa phul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / gzhan 15

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonace'i gsung 'bum/dge tshul slong mang po gral bsgrigs nas dung 'bud cing mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs kyis mchod pa byed pa sogs dri ltas ya mtshan pa sna tshogs byung / rab byung bcu gsum pa'i bgrang bya dgu pa bde mchog stong 'grel ltar na na tshod ldan dang / ma hā tsi na'i yul du yi ha'i zhes grags shing / spor thang dang bstun pa shing mo phag gi lor rgyal phur 'dzoms zhing 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin zhig nyin phyed dbang po shar ri'i rtser mngon par 'phags pa dang dus mtshungs bar gzhon nu mdangs gsal zhing / yan lag dang nying lag rnam par 'byes pa/ skye bo kun gyi min gi bdud rtsi lta bu zhig yum la gnod pa med par mngon du bltams so/ / de'ang sku 'khrungs ma thag nas sngon gyi bag chags bzang po'i mthu nye bar sad de ngu ba dang 'tsheg pa sogs byis pa'i rgud pa ring du spangs te/ su mthong yang dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis 'dzum pa mdzad pas yul mi rnams bu chung mthong na dga' ba ang zhes gleng ba byung / yab yum gnyis kyis kyang bab la brtags te gzhon nu 'di phal pa zhig min nges snyam nas dus rgyun gtsang sbra dang / rnam 'joms bya bas khrus sogs byed du bcug ste bskyed bsrings/ gsung phye ma thag mi mi zhes zlos pa zhig byung ba skabs der dpyad ma shes kyang / rjes nas dpyod lngan rnams de mi nyag pa yin gsung 'dod par 'dug ces zer ba don la gnas par mngon/ skabs der sku gong ma'i phyag gnyer mi rtsa sogs dang /mtsho sngon shog gi sa skyong dam pa wang dkon mchog bkra shis/ bai zi tshe ring rnam rgyal/ ja sag sogs dpon khag mang po bcas nas dam pa de'i yang srid la phyogs kun tu ang nyan byas shing phal cher 'di pa e yin snyam pa'i dogs pa yod thog 7gong sa rgyal ba yab sras dang 'bras spung gnas chung sogs la brtag zhus phul ba'i bka' lan phyir 'byor te gung bsgrigs nas 16

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bltas pas thams cad las dgongs pa gcig gis 'di par babs/ rnam 'joms bya ba khrus dang sgrol ma rgyun 'don sogs rim gro mang du babs pa'ang gnad smin bsgrubs te/ dgung lo gsum pa'i skabs su phyag gnyer dang mi rtsa 'brug rtse sogs zhabs gras pa rnams kyis sku gong ma'i phyag tu rgyun par bsnams pa'i phreng ba dang de dang rigs 'dra'i phreng ba kha shas/ phyag ḍar dang yang de mtshungs kyi ḍa ma ru kha shas khyer nas ngos 'dzin zhus pas tsham tshom med par sku gong ma'i phyag phreng ngo ma de phyag gis zen nas blangs/ phyag ḍar yang ngo thog gi lung bu zen nas tab tob ces ḍa ma ru'i skad kyi rnam pa dang 'don pa mang po 'don tshul mdzad pa sogs ngos 'dzin yang 'khrul med byung bas grwa slob sbyin bdag thams cad yid ches lhag par skyes nas rje gong ma bhe bhede shaṃbhe : ༷༷ ༷/ de rdo/ rte / bhe ༷/ / ༷ ༵ dzee //༷ / rdobhe sbrang rtsi re ba'i bhra ma ra / / rab dga'i mu cor dri za'i dbyangs su sgogs/ / de tshe dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyang / / nor 'dzin dpal mo'i bcud kyis bltams so zhes/ / dga' ba'i 'phrin yig springs pa 'og min na/ / sras bcas rgyal ba mchod pa'i rol mor gyur/ / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal las sku bltams pa'i tshul gyi dra ba phyed pa ste dang po'o/ /dgung lo drug pa rnam gnon zhes pa lcags 'brug lo'i ston ga gza' 17

༄/ /yo ca b.lo yosgronasa'i khrung 4ma/skar legs pa'i nyin mtsho sngon wang dkon mchog bkra shis/ bai zi rnam rgyal tshe ring / ja sag thus lagyi sogs dpon khag mang po dang / gzhan ho sho'u so so'i sbyin bdag rnams dang / sbu 'bum byams pa gling nas bla ma las sne'i rigs/ tsho drug gi rgan pa/ gzhan grwa rgan rnams dang bcas pas bsu skyel gyi bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te sku 'bum chos sde chen po'i rang sgar du 'jigs bral gdong lngas bteg pa'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs pad mngon par bkod nas bde dga'i dga' ston gser 'dzum gyi mgo tshugs par mdzad/ phe kyu shog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po blo gros mchog ldan dge rgan du bsten te ka kha dang klog rnams thog mar slob tu bcug pas ring por ma thogs par klog rab tu byang ba byung / de'i zhar la rgyun gyi spyod lam/na bza' mnab tshul/ bzhes pa bzhes lugs/ phebs tshul bzhugs tshul sogs chos dang mthun pa'i dang ba 'dren pa dgos tshul yang yang bslab ste ma mdzangs kyis bu skyong ba bzhin byas pas bshes gnyen pa de bka' drin shin tu che zhes rje nyid kyis yang dang yang du gsungs tshul sku 'khor rnams gleng ba ni/deng dus sku skyes kyi ming re btags te/ gces phrug gos dar gyis btum zhing chung dus nas lang shor la btang bas bstan pa'i mig ltos bslad pa rnams 'gog ched kyi dgongs gzhi zab par snang / dgung lo bdun pa khyu mchog ces pa lcags sbrul lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar ngo'i dus chen gsum 'dzom gyi nyin brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rje btsun bla ma bum par tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab byung dang tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pas mtshan la tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes 'dogs par mdzad/ sku tshe yun ring brtan pa'i rten 'brel du dgongs te bka' chos kyi thog mar ma cig grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe 18

༄༅/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dbang dang sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang sogs bka' drin du stsal/ de nas brtsams te gzhi bcus bsdus pa'i bslab bya'i bsrung mtshams rnams legs par rtsad bcad de mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung bhe ༷/ //bhe bhe rdo/ bhesde/༵ ༷ sde/༷ tt+waṃ bhe ༷ tt+waṃ bhebhe tt+waṃ/ ༷/bheshe bye bhe ma sogs dang / mngon rtogs rgyan/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ spyod 'jugagator ma brgya rtsa/ kun rig gi cho ga 'jigs byed mngon rtogs bskang gso sogs thugs 'dzin gnang ste/ dpe 'dzin sogs kyi zhabs bskul gang zhus dang du bzhes pas dge rgan thugs mnyes/ rgyun gyi zhal 'don gnang lugs kyang thog mar phyag mchod kyi rim pa dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ rgyan 'jug bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ bla mchod/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/gser zhun ma/ brgya rtsa sogs 'chag med kyi bkod pa mdzad pa bzhin nyams su bzhes/ dgung lo dgu pa nyi ma zhes pa lcags lug lor 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gdan sa sku 'bum chos kyi sde chen por mang bskol sogs kyi dga' ston dang bcas pa'i sgo nas chos grwar zhugs/ bsdus grwa'i rtsibazhag thugs la bzung ste dge rgan gyi drung nas dpe khrid kyang tshul bzhin gnang nas bslab sbyang la brtson pas chos thog gcig gnyis tsam gyi ring la bsdus grwa'i rtags gsal legs par chags/ grwa tshang dge bskos nas bsdus grwa'i tshogs gleng phul ba bzhin tshogs chen gyi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 19

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 4ma/dbus su bgro gleng mdzad pas/ thal skad dang rnam 'gyur/ rtsod pa'i spobs pa/ lung rigs kyi ngar sogs gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig byung bas/ dge bshes rgan gzhon du ma nas sprul sku 'di pa rdo rje 'chang gong ma de nyid kyi sku yon ma brjed par 'dug ces gleng ba byung / lo kha shas kyi ring bsdus gzhung rnams la tshul bzhin du sbyang ba mthar phyin par mdzad/ de nas 'dzin grwa gzhung du phebs pa na nya kyā shog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po rgyal mtshan dpal 'byor yang bskyar dge rgan du bsten te/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i blo rtags dang / rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ de'i dgongs 'grel rgyal tshab rjes mdzad pa'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed rnams thugs la bzung zhing /zhar byung du de'i skor gyi gzhung 'grel sogs la dpe gzigs dang mdzub khrid kyi sgo nas dka' gnas rnams la ring du 'dris par byas/ mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus su rtsod pa'i brdar sha bcad nas mtha' chod par sbyangs shing / gzhung de rnams kyi tshogs rgyug kyang 'bul bar mdzad/ phar phyin gyi skabs chos 'byung gi phar phyin skabs dang po zur bkol bcas dang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i phar phyin skabs dang po nas brgyad pa'i bar zur bkol gsum dang bcas cha tshang / legs bshad gser 'phreng / dbu ma'i skabs se ra rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu ma dang rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal/ mdzod la rgyal dbang rin po che'i mdzod sogs thugs la bzung ste gshar sbyang thang lhod med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin gnang / dbyar dang ston dus skabs 'gar gshar sbyang gis mtshan phud pa'ang lan mang po mdzad/ po ti so so'i rtsa ba dang phyogs gtogs rgya bod kyi gzhung mtha' dag dngagung bsgrig nas gzigs rtog mdzad de rtsod pa'i thog tu blo skyed thon pa 20

༄/ /spyo khrimayobastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/byas/ dgung lo nyi shu pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lor thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag rje ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang pos mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad/ kha skong gi chos rnams tshang ba'i dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bstan pa'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos po yang dag par bzhes te/ tshul khrims kyi phung po ma tshang ba med pa'i yid bzhin nor bus thugs kyi bang mdzod phyur bur gtams/ltung ba sde lnga so so'i bsrung mtshams zin par byas te 'dul ba'i phyag len gyi cha phra mo rnams kyang nyams bzhes su zebs par gnang / brgya la rkyen dbang gis nyes pa phra mo re'i dogs pa byung tshe 'phral du phyir bcos sogs kyis sbyong bar mdzad/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad/ lhag pa'i yo byad/ mkho ba'i yo byad rnams so sor byin gyes rlobs pa dang rnam brtag byas te 'chang lugs zas la byin len bya tshul/ rung chu 'deb lugs tshun chod kyi bcas mtshams phra zhing zhib par bsrung ba nyid sgrub pa nyams len gyi gtso bor gnang ba ni lung gzhi las/ gang na las kyang yod/ nan tan byed pa'ang yod pa de ni dam pa'i chos gnas pa zhes bya'o/ / gang na las kyang med/ nan tan byed pa'ang med pa de ni dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o/ / zhes bstan pa gnas mi gnas chos 'dul ba yod med kyi rjes su 'gro bar gsungs pa sogs bstan pa'i gnad mkhyen pa'i rnam par thar pa ste rje bla mas kyang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar ba la/ / sgrub pa snying por byed par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ / de nas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po rje chu bzang rin po che'i zhal snga nas gtsug tor gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang byad grol dang bcas pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa bdud las rnam rgyal gyi dbang bzhi yongs 21

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'isgonas khrung 'bum/rdzogs dang bcas pa gsan te/ gsang sngags rdo rje zeg pa'i sgor smin par mdzad/ dbang bka' sogs thob pa tsam gyis chog shes mi mdzad par dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa gal che bar dgongs te rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig mtha' dag tshul bzhin du srung bar mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i 'dul ba gzhi stod smad cha tshang bar thugs la bzung ste rtsod pas sgo 'dogs bcad cing / gtso bor lag len gyi dbang du mdzad de dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi gnad mtha' dag ji lta ba bzhin du gtan la phab/ yig cha thugs 'dzin gyi skabs nyin re bzhin shog bu mda' tshad ma bdun re tsam ma chad par thugs la 'dzin thub ces nye gnas rnams dang grwa thog mnyam pa'i grwa rgan phal cher gyis rgyun par gleng / skabs shig mkhas mang 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su sgrub pa'i mchod sprinadam par dmigs te tshogs rgyugs lo phyed dang gnyis kyi ring la bar ma chad par phul bas mtshon snga phyir gzhung chen mo thugs la bzung ba de thams cad sgra dag gsal gsum gye sgo nas tshogs rgyugs 'bul bar mdzad pa ni/sku'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan tu/ / bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang / /tha mar phyin par 'gyur ma lags/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / bu mo dbal phreng gis zhus pa bzhin dam chos 'dzin pa'i phan yon gyis thugs phrogs te/byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu gzhon nu nor bzang ltar chos tshol ba la ngoms pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa thar 'dod kun gyi smon pa'i gnas shig yin pas snyigs dus kyi skye sprul mthod man kun kyang rnam thar 'di dag gi rjes su spyan mig yar gzigs na/ gzhung chen 'di snyed 'dzin sbyor mdzad pa yang / / yang dag don gyi rnam thar zla med de/ / de ni 'jam dbyangs 22

༄༅/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ṭwāṃ~X //༷/ /shaṃ /༷shi/ ṭwāṃ /༷ ༷/ṭwāṃXskre diX sdibhe cu/ ༷ ༷/ byeshaṃshaṃ ༷/༷ shaṃ/ bhesde byebhe thu'u bkan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal nas/ deng dus dam pa'i skyes sprul 'di dag ni/ / sngon sbyangs yon tan snyigs dus bzung dka' bar/ / dgongs nas dag zhing bcol te sku rkyang gis/ / phyin pa sha stag phyir na thugs las chung / / khyod ni da lta'i ngang tshul 'dir dpag na/ / lung rtogs nor la ha cangasreng drag pas/ / snga ma'i dus kyi gsang mdzod gong med du/ / bsnams rnas byon pa'i ngo mtshar can du nges/ / zhes gsungs te 'phral nyams 'char lta bu la phugs go rgyu chen po zhig 'dug go / dgung lo nyer gnyis pa gdong ngan zhes pa me sprel lor gdan sa'i mkhan rin po che dang grwa tshang thun mong nas smon lam grwa skor gyi mtshan btags phul ba bzhin dgun chos chen mor grwa tshang rang gi dam bca' dang / dgung lo nyer gsum pa gser 'phyang zhes pa me bya'i lo'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dam bca' mdzad de legs bshad gtam gyi dga' ston spel bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtha' dag shin tu mgu nas bsngags pa'i ske tog gis mngon par mchod par gyur to/ / de nas skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po zhabs drung nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ 'jigs byed dang bde mchog sngag4btu'i rjes gnang / bla mchod dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid sogs gsan/ skyabs mgon de nyid nas/ khyed kyis mdo phyogs gsan sbyong legs po byung 'dug 'tshang rgya ba la mdo sngags ya ma bral ba dgos pas/ da ni sngags la sbyang ba 23

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/hur thag cig cis kyang mdzod/ ces bka' nan cher pheb par brten gsangasngags rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde rgyud pa grwa tshang du phebs/ lo kha shas kyi ring la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs dang / legs par bshad pa'i rgyal po 'grel pa bzhin sbrags/ rim lnga gsal sgron sogs la sbyangs pas gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gnad la nges pa bde blag tu rnyed/rgyud pa'i chos thog shog la phebs skabs su grwa rkyang gi lugs bzhin dman cha bzung ste 'dus sde'i 'grig lam dang mthun par rang gi bla gos rnam sbyar/sho ka li/ lhung bzed/ zhwa zlag sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams rang nyid kyis khur nas phebs pas thams cad ngo mtshar zhing dpyod ldan rnams rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ rgyud grwa'i rgan gzhon mtha' dag nas kyang sprul sku rin po che'i na bza' ngas 'khur ngas 'khur zhes hab thob kyis rtsod pa byas pas de mi dgos gsungs kyang nan gyes 'khyer ba sogs dad gus rmad du byung bas bkur ste je cher 'gro ba zhig yod ces ngag rgyun da lta'ang 'dug pa ni rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu ste/ bud bsnyegs thob gsum mam/ dman sa bzung bas rgyal sa thob pa'i dpe dam pa rnams kyi ngang tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃṭwāṃdī ༷ṭwāṃ ༷ bheX ༷/༷ byeX nyi khri~Xni hūm̐ ṭwāṃ/ bhe/ra~X ༵ rte ṭwāṃX ༵/sdi nghruṭwāṃ pa sa phag lor paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dpal bzang po gser gyi rgyal khab tu chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i lam zhor du sku 'bum chos sde chen po 'dir phyag phebs nas dgun gyi ring bzhugs pa'i skabs lam rim bde lam gyi khrid shin tu zab cing rgyas pa/mjug tu sems skyed kyi cho ga dang bcas pa/ rgyan 'jug gnyis/ spyod 24

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/'jug sogs kyi lung du ma dang bcas bka' chos mang du gsan/ gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngag dbang nyi ma'i spyan sngar 'phags bod kyi skad rigs sgyur tshul/ sgra dang snyan ngag ming gi mngon brjod/ rtsis dkar nag sogs la sbyangs pas dka' tsheg med par mkhyen/gzur gnas blo dang ldan pa rnams rje mi nyag rin po che'i sprul sku 'di pa mdo sngags kyi yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs 'dug pas/ rje rin po che'i bstan pa la phan nges shig 'ong bar 'dug ces dga' ba'i ca co sgogs pa byung / dam pa nyid nas kyang gong smos ltar gyi theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de rnams rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes te yon tan rnams thugs su chud pas dga' dang spro gsum gyi sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa mgur du bzhes pa ni/ rje bla ma rnams la gus btud te/ / dus da res thob ba'i dal 'byor la/ /don chen po sgrub pa'i gtam snyan gyi/ / dril chung de cung zad dkrol bar bya/ / sngon bsags pa'i rnam dkar las kyi dbang / / deng dal 'byor tshang ba'i rten bzang thob/ / mchog rgyal ba'i bstan gyi sgor zhugs nas/ / sdom tshul khrims yang dag rab tu blangs/ / 'di bsam na kho bo skal ldan yin/ /mtshan ldan gyi bshes gnyen legs bsten nas/ / bshad sgrub kyi bya bar blo gzhol te/ / chung 'bring dang chen po'i rigs lam la/ / gang thub tshod sbyangs pa'i skal ldan yin/ / gzhung phar phyin dbu ma la sogs pa/ / nang bltas kyi blo yis gang nus skyor/ / de rnams kyi dam bca'i khur yang bzung / / chos gtan tshigs rig pa'i bag chags bzhag / de bsam na kho bo skal ldan yin/ / mchog gsang sngags rig 'dzin 'dus pa yi/ / grwar zhugs te sngags lam la brten nas/ / 'tshang rgya bar sla ba'i smon lam btab/ / de tshul bzhin bsam na bdag skal ldan/ / mchog dam pa'i don 25

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronama'i gsung 'bum/detogs pa'i phyir/ / tha snyad pa'i rig gnas kun la yang / / blos gzhal tshul tsam gyes sbyang ba'i tshul/ / 'di bsam na nyam chung bdag skal ldan/ /dad gus dang spro pa rnam gsum gyis/ / dus nam yang bdag yid rab 'gengs shing / / nyam chung zhing zhi dul chog shes pa/ / 'di mtshan ldan gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs yin/ / 'di bsam na kho bo skal ldan yin/ / mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung nas/ / mchog dam pa'i mtshan gyis byin brlobs shing / / mchog thar pa'i lam bzang ston mdzad pa/ / 'di bsam na kho bo mchog skal ldan/ / skyes sbyangs pa'i rnam dpyod rab dman kyang / /mgon dge ba'i bshes kyi drin las ni/ / 'chad rtsod dang rtsom pa'i khur lce bo/ / 'degs nus pa 'di yang skal ba ldan/ / deng 'khor ba'i gnas su rab lhung yang / / mchog dge ba'i snying stobs cher bskyed do/ / blo'i gtad so chos la bgyis pa 'di/ / dus kun tu bsam na skal ba ldan/ / tshe 'di yid la 'byor don ldan gyur/ / tshe phyi mar dge ba'i skal ldan gyur/ / mchog dge ba'i bshes dang 'bral med gyur/ / mchog rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces rang bstod skal ldan bcu'i glu snyan dbyangs can phang 'gro'i sring mo'i rna ba'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di'ang bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten pa'i shāka btsun mi nyag sku skyes shī la shā sa na sukhyos dang gdung spro gsum gyi sgo nas sku 'bum du rang lo nyer lnga'i thog sbyar ba dza yachu/ / zhes gsungs te legs par brtags na don zab la go bde zhing 'dus che bar snang ngo / / de nas mtsho sngon shog nas dang stobs kyi dbang phyug wang dkon mchog bkra shis kyis mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsun rgyan rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas gdan drangs te bka' chos zhus skabs/ wang de nyid kyis rje 'di ba'ang gdan 26

༄/ /tshulakhrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnayopar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/drangs nas dbang la bzhugs su bcug pas/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i drung nas ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bco brgyad dam nyi shu dang ldan pa grub chen mi tra dzo ki la 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtshos dngos su gnang ba'i mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang / slob dpon a sto kā ra la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dngos su stsal ba rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gong ma gong chen dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang / gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi rjes gnang / chos rgyal phyi nang gsang gsum dang seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang / man ngag lhan thabs kyi lung / thang sag pa'i 'jigs byed bskyed dzogs dang dwags po'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi lung /'pho khrid/ tshe dpag grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang sogs mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi gdams pa zad mi shes pa'i bka' drin nod par mdzad/ de nas snga phyir gsan pa'i bka' chos thams cad la yang bskyar gzigs rtogs mdzad de dbang rjes gnang sogs kyi sgrub dkyil mngon togs/ rjes gnang gi chings mi 'dra ba sogs gang gi steng nas gnang ba dang gnang tshul rgyas bsdus kyi phyag len/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i tsa ka li thig gdan sogs kyis mtshon gang dgos pa'i yo byad sla chos su ma song ba'i tshad ldan yang gra sgrig mdzad/ chu rgyu kha pa rje btsun bstan pa dar rgyas kyi drung nas mgon po bka' bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang / rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yi dam sgrub skor gyi rjes gnang /lho brag bka' 'bum gyi lung / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ g.yu thog snying thig gi chos skor dbang chog bde chen klong yangs kyi steng nas thob pa sogs bka' chos kyi rim pa mtha' yas pa gsan/skabs skabs su zla re tsam la bcad rgya dam po gnang nas yi dam lha'i ljags 27

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i masa'i khrung 4ma/bsnyen kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa la 'grus par mdzad/ rgyun du'ang yan lag bdun pa sogs dang thun drug gi rnal 'byor 'jigs byed bcas la zhal 'don gtso bo mdzad/ de'ang rje nyid dang a kyā rin po che rnam gnyis sku 'phrengasnga ma rnams nas bzung da lta'i bar chos dam tshig gi 'brel zab cing gtsang bar brten/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa a kyā rin po che 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i bka' bzhin pho brang du nye bar 'byon dgos pas rje nyid la nyer mkho'i rjes gnang lung khrid mang po zhus pa rnams thugs kyi bzhed pa bzhin gnang / mdo sngags kyi dka' gnas rnams la dri ba mang du zhubar yang dogs lan nor 'khrul med par rje yab sras kyi gsung la khungs gtugs te zhib rgyas su phul nas bzhed pa'i yol go phyur bur bkang / ā kyu rin po che sku 'bum nas pho brang du phebs nyin nyid dang mjal phrad gnang ste skyabs 'jug zhus skabs kyang zhal nas/ khyed kyi sku gong ma de nyid byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs shing sku yon yang shin tu zab la bstan 'gror phan pa tshad las 'das pa zhig yin/ khyad par nged rang la bka' drin shin tu che/ da lam khyed nyid kyang mkhyen rgya yangs shing rgyal ba'i gsung rab la thos bsam sogs kyis sgro 'dogs chod pa 'di gzhir byas nas/ da dung smad phyogs su phebs na'ang lugs gnyis kyi sku don rgya chen po 'ong yang gtso bor gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang gar phebs kyi sar 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi ring lugs spel ba'i thabs mkhas gang cher gnang ba dang / dad ldan skye bo mchog dman mtha' dag la/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi 'phral phugs su phan pa'i mdzad pa rlabs chen pos dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gir bzhes pa gal che/ nged kyis kyang nyid kyi thugs bzhed ji bzhin 'grub ched du mchog gsum gyi thugs rje bskul te gsol 28

༄/ /4 khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/'debs dang chos srung la 'phrin bcol sogs byed/ ces sogs kyis mtshon zhal ta mang du gnang / skabs shig mtsho sngon ching wang bsod nams rdo rje dang / bee zi mi 'gyur sogs dpon khag du mas gdan drangs pa bzhin de phyogs su phebs/ wang gis zhus ngor sgol dkar ljang sogs kyi rjes gnang /sgol dkar gyi tshe sgrub sogs gnang zhing phyogs 'dus kyi dad ldan mchog dman mtha' dag la khrus dbang bka' bsgo sogs 'dod mos bzhin stsal/de nas bai zi mi 'gyur gyi u rgor phebs te dpon po'i mos 'dun bzhin sman bla'i lung / dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid 'pho khrid sogs dang / sde 'bangs nas kyang so so'i 'dod mos kyi bka' chos mang po zhus pa rnams bstsal te dad ldan kun gyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon khyad par can bskrun par mdzad/ slar sku 'bum du phebs te skyabs mgon dam pa chu bzang rin po che'i drung nas lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyi gsung 'bum/ chos chung brgya rtsa sogs kyi lung mang po dang / snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /gdugs dkar gyi dbang legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang / thugs rje chen po dang bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang / 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i bka' chos kyi rim pa zla ba gnyis kyi ring la legs par gsan/ chos yon du bdog pa'i mchod sprin gzab rgyas zhus/de nas khri ka gser mo ljongs kyi ser skya kun nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin/de ga'i chos sde thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi khrir bzhugs/ dgon pa'i 'grig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa gong mas ji ltar tshugs pa bzhin cung zad kyang grwa ma nyams par bskyangs/ dgon pa rang gi grwa pa rnams dang phyogs nas kyang ser skya mchog dman du ma lhags pa rnams la dbang lung rjes gnang 29

༄/ /gung thang bayo yotshaname'i khrung ཿma/sogs lhug par bstsal te zhu mkhan thams cad kyi re ba skong bar mdzad/spyir rgyal bstan rin po cher gus 'dud bkur ste sogs la brtson pa dang /lhag par rang rang thad ga'i dge sbyor la 'grus shing dge bcu ci lcog sgrub pa/yig drug dang smyung gnas sogs la 'bad na yul phyogs su dge mtshan 'byung zhing / rang rang so so'i 'di phyi'i dgos don 'grub pas de dag la 'bad pa gal che tshul sogs so so'i khams dang 'tsham pa'i zhal ta mdzad nas skye bo mchog dman thams cad phan bde'i lam la sbyar/ nyid kyi thugs rje dang 'phrin las kyi lcags kyus lus can kun gyi yid rang dbang med par phrogs pas dgon de nyid la mang 'gyed sogs sngar las ches lhag pa byung bas/dge 'dun rnams bshad sgrub yar ldan du song ba'i zhar la chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yang 'dod dgur 'byor 'phral dang yun gyi legs tshogs lhun gyisagrub ste/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ / don grub pa dang bde skyid 'thob/ / nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ / yul phyogs dge zhes mkhas rnams sgrogs/ / zhes pa'i ngang tshul mngon du gyur to/ / re zhig nas de'i khri khur bzhag ste mchod rten mi nyag grwa tshang bkra shis chos 'phel gling gi bla brang du lo phyed tsam gyi ring zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu gzhol te yi dam gyi lha du ma'i ljags bsnyen/mjug tu sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor sogs gang rgyas gnang / de nas sgo ma'i shog gi mchod rten skes zhes grags pa'i dgon gyi khrir bzhugs te chos 'grim pa rnams la rtsi bzhag rgyun par thugs nas gnang zhing tshig don gnyis kyi rgyugs zhib mor bzhes/ 'chad nyan gyi rting bskul dang 'grig lam kun spyod sogs bla ma gong mas btsugs pa'i phyag srol bzhin bskyang par mdzad/thams cad spro ba skyes te grwa pa rgan garo/ na gang sa nas bslab sbyang sogs la 30

༄/ /tshulakhrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/brtson mkhan kha mig yar lta ba mang du byung bas bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la shin tu phan pa byung / der bzhugs ring dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams dang mchod gzhi'i ser skya bcas la mdo sngags kyi lung khrid/ dbang rjes gnang sogs 'dod mos bzhin bstsal te rgyud smin par mdzad/ khri mthar phyin nas sku 'bum du phebs/ kun mkhyen chen po rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi spyan sngar/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje ni nges pa'i don du gsang ba'i bdag po dang ngo bo dbyer med kyang / rgyud brtag pa gnyis par/ 'chang pa po nga tshos kyang nga / / rang gi tshogs ldan nyan po nga / / zhes pa ltar thun mong gdul bya'i ngo bor de nyid yi dam gyi lhar brten nas rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pas zhal dngos su bstan te bstsal pa'i snyan brgyud kyi man ngag don dam sems bskyed kyi rjes gnang ngam ston pa nye sras dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / tshe dpag med dang rnam 'joms kyi dbang / phyag rdor sku lnga'i rjes gnang / phyag rdor sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / phyag rdor bdud rtsi thigs pa/ phyag rdor gtum po me 'bar drag po/ drag po sum dril sogs snyan brgyud kyi dbang dang rjes gnang cha tshang ba/ phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang dang mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dbang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang rigs gtad sgom lung sogs bsgoms pa sum brgya dang gcig de'i gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa/ mkhas grub rin po che'i gsung thor bu'i lung / dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs kyi lung / rgyan 'jug gnyis kyi lung / sgol dkar ljang bla med rdor sems/ seng gdong ma gtso 'khor gsum/ 'jam dpal nā ga rakka/ 'jam dkar/ rnam sras/ mgon dkar/ phyag rdor gos sngon can sogs kyi rjes gnang / nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang sogs dang /31

༄/ /yo thang bam pa'i sgonasa'i g.yo 'bum/gzhan yang lung khrid man ngag zhal shes kyi rigs mtha' yas pa gsan te/ded dpon nor bu'i gling du son pa bzhin thugs rgyud zab rgyas kyi gdams pas phyug par mdzad/ de nas yang phal cher bcad rgya mdzad nas yi dam gyi lha de rnams kyi bsnyen pa dang / kha skong sbyin sreg sogs kyang rgyas par gnang ste gsan pa'i dgos don phyag len du thebs par mdzad/ de'i bar mtshams rnams su phyogs so so nas yong ba'i mchog dman don gnyer can rnams 'dod chos kyis tshim par byas shing / las kyi cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bsgrub bya nyis brgya lhag la dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa sogs bstsal te thar pa'i sa bon grung po 'debs par mdzad/ wang bsod nams rdo rjes/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po cher dus 'khor gyi dbang zhus skabs der phebs te dus 'khor gyi dbang dang / lha me shra ma ṇa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar/ khro bo sme brtsegs/ lha mo/ klu dbang rgyal po/ phyag rdor gtum chung / sor 'brang / gtsug gtor rnam rgyal lha dgu/ lo ma gyon ma sogs lhag lha mang po'i rjes gnang / rdo rje phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / mgon po'i bskang bshags kyi lung / gso dpyad rgyud bzhi'i lung / 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi lung dang de las gsungs pa'i rjes gnang gi rim pa phal cher/ bsnyung gnas cho ga'i lung / 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po/ dge slong gi bslab bya/ sngags byang sems kyi bslab bya/ sgrol dkar mngon rtogs dang de'i sbyin sreg mkha' spyod ma'i mngon rtogs/ dam can mngon rtogs/ bde gsang gnyis kyi rgyud/ dwags po bskyed rim/ 'jam dkar sbyin sreg 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gye mngon rtogs/ bcu gcig zhal gyi mngon rtogs sogs kyi lung dang gzhan 32

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bka' chos kyi rim pa thor bu'ang mtha' yas gsan/ de nas sku 'bum du phebs te slar yang rje de nyid kyi zhabs drung nas nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi skor dang / gzhan 'pho khrid sogs khrid 'ga' zhig lam rim gyi khrid sogs bka' chos kyi rim pa spyi sger la gang gnang ba thams cad la ma lus par phebs te gsan/ res 'ga' gzhan gyis zhus pa ma gsan par lus pa'i tshe/rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches gzigs pa che bzhes kyis 'di ba bos nas bzhugs su bcug pas bka' drin shin tu che ba byung tshul dam pa nyid nas kyang yang yang gsung tshul rgyus yod rnams gleng / rje btsun bla ma dam pa sku zhabs thu'u bkwan rin po che'i spyan sngar rje de nyid kyi gsung 'bum skor po ti bdun lhag dang / gzhan chos tshan mang po'i lung gsan/ rgyar rtsang sgom chen rin po che blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas kyang lam rim gyi khrid dang lung kha shas gsan/ sgom chen rin po che dang rje 'di ba gnyis zhabs thang la mar tshang bla chen du mjal bar phebs/ rten la mchod pa gang rgyas phul te nyin kha shas kyi ring bzhugs nas skyabs sems/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor yan lag bdun pa/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon sogs nan tan gnad du smin pa mdzad/ phyag skor yang grangs tshad long nges byas/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / khyad par rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che/ rje chu bzang rin po che/ chu rgyu kha pa rin po che sogs rigs kyi cod paṇa du bzhes te mdo sngags kyi gsan sbyong rgya cher mdzad pas mdo sngags rig gnas/ dbang lung khrid man ngag sogs gdams pa zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur cing 'phrin las kyi sgo brgya phye nas phan tshun gyi dgon sde du mar 'dzin skyong dang chos kyi mchod sbyin 'dod dgur stsal ba'i grags snyan gyi rnga sgras phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur to/ / bshes 33

༄khya/ /gung thang bamin mi'i sgonas gsung lam/gnyen gangs kyi ri bo'i 'phreng ba las/ / dal 'bab chos kyi klung brgya chabs gcig tu/ / 'khyil ba'i gdams pa mi zad chu bo'i gter/ / thar 'dod ༵ṭwāṃ rdott+waṃ ༵/ ༵nas /dig ṭwāṃni tt+waṃ~Xl/ bya/ṭwāṃ ༷ ṭwāṃsdo di ༵༷ ༵/ ṭwāṃ ldarnyi hūṃdī nas/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i 'od zer 'bum 'gyed pa/ / bshes gnyen ༵stan /༷ ṭwāṃ~X ༵dī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃng/ ba/'i dīdī/ ṭwāṃ rdo tt+waṃr lo/ sdi ༵ngad ṭwāṃ' ṭwāṃ~X bhūshā sde padma'i mtshor/ / 'phrin las gser zhun khu ba bcud du 'khyil/ / zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal las bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing mang du thos pa rgya cher btsal ba'i tshul gyi dra ba ste gnyis pa'o/ /dgung lo so gnyis pa zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lor sku 'bum sman pa grwa tshang gi khrir bzhugs/ grwa tshang rang gi 'chad nyan la rting bskul/ lam rim sogs bka' chos kyi rim pa/ chos thog skabs kyi brtsi bzhag rnams chag med du bstsal/ dus bzang so sor yang chag med phebs shing 'don pa'i la brel dbyangs rta sogs 'grig lam gye rim pa mtha' dag la zhi drag gang 'os kyi do dam gang drag dang tshogs gtam bslab bya dang 'brel ba legs nyes skyon yon gyi shan phyed pa'i rgyu mtshan yid la 'bab nges bcas skyo ngal med par yang yang gnang / grwa pa chos 'grim pa rnams la thad ka thad ga'i yig cha'i rgyugs blangs te 'chad nyan la 'grus par mdzad pas kun gyis gsung dngablang gis thos bsam sogs la 'bad pa lhur blangs pas chos thog re re las re rer skyed thon te 'chad nyan yar tshes kyi zla ba ltar 'phel/ grwa tshang ma

༄/ /tshul khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/'disayo re bzhin dbyar chos kyi skabs kun rig gi sgrub mchod ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor steng nas gnang gin yod pas de la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs rgyu zhig tshugs na snyam pa'i thugs bzhed yod pa'i thog rje 'jam dbyangasabazhad pa rin po che nas skabs la bab par gzigs te rje 'di bar khyed kyis khri khur 'dzin bzhin pa'i thog rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs rgyu'i rgyun 'dzug thub na bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs la shin tu phan nges pas myur du btsugs na legs gsungs pa'i bka' bstsal me tog gi 'phreng ba spyi bor bcings te rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor phyag len rnams rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang mthun par cha lag tshang ma btsugs te sgrub mchod mdzad pas dge 'dun gyi chos kyi 'phrin las rgyas pa'i rten 'brel ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma mang du byung / de'ang grub chen dril bu pas/ ri mor bris pa'i las dang ni/ /thig las tshon dgye'i rim pa dang / / 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyi/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ / bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang / /de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod/ / ces ma bcos pa lus dkyil sogs la sngon du bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor dgos pa dang / de'ang ri mor bris pa zhes ras bris dang / thig las tshon dgye zhes rdul tshon gnyis su phye ba gdul bya'i dbang gis yin par gsungs la/ de yin tshul ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/dkyil 'khor la sogs las gang ni/ / bcos ma'i sems kyis gang byed pa/ / phyi rol las rnams gsal byed pas/ / dang po'i las can rnams la bsngags/ / zhes gsungs te rang gis bsgom pa la dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid shes dgos shing / rdo rje slob dpon byed pa la de nyid bcu'i nang du/dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ / zhes nan tan du gsungs pa dang /rdul tshon gye phye ma'i grangs snyed kyi bsod nams tshad med thob pas slob ma'i 35

༄/ /gung thang bstan yo sgroname'i g.yo las/tshogs rdzogs tshab che ba sogs rdul tshon gyi srol btsugs pa 'di la dgongs gzhi dang / dgos pa bsam las 'das pa zhig yod snang ste/ dbang don de nyid rab gsal las/ / a byu kā ra la sogs pas ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'ang bshad pas thog ma'i dbang la de'ang rung mod kyang slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid du dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas pa mang du gsungs shing / slob ma'i ngos nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su zang zing gtong ba'i sgo mang la des kyang rgyud snod rung du sgrub pa la khyad par shin tu che bas/ rgyud dang grub chen gye gzhung rnams nas rdul tshon gyi cho ga bsngags pas 'di ni gtso bo'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyedasgon lam grub pa'i dbang gis dus de nas bzung da lta'i bar la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i phyag len mtha' dag ma nyams par dar rgyas su bzhugs so/ / dam pa nyid nas tshad ldan skyes chen du ma'i zhabs bsten te gsan rgya che ba chos kyi mdzod lta bur bzhugs pa'i dbang gis phyogs mtha' dag nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dpon po che chung ser skya drag gzhan mtha' yas pa padma'i tshal la bung ba bzhin du 'dus nas bka' chos gang dgos zhus pa rnams la so so'i 'dod mos bzhin chos kyi char phab/dgung lo so lnga pa sa byi'i lor skyabs mgon thams cad gzigs pa chen po rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i spyan sngar khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rje thu'u bkwan rin po che nas zhus te khong dang 'di ba rnam gnyis kyis gtsos grwa slob thun mong nas gsan skabs der/ ston pa dang 'khor dang gnas dus sogs phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du gyur pas spro dga' dang skyo shas spel ma'i nyams kyis thugs g.yos te/ skyabs mgon thu'u bkwan rin po che dang rje 'di ba gnyis kyis 36

༄/ /tso khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/slob dpon dpa' bo dang phyogs glang gi spel mar bstod pa'i lugs bzhin gsung sbrags nas smon tshig nyams mgur du bzhes pa rje 'dis phyag bres su mdzad pa ni/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i nga padma kho dri bsung che dang gcig / bung ba rnams mngar dad che dang gnyis/ / dus tshod de dbyar la sleb dang gsum/ / de gsum po 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod na/ / rkang drug kun tshogs pa chos nyid yin/ / sbrang rtsi yi dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / bla ma rje byin rlabs che dang gcig slob ma rnams dad pa bzang dang gnyis/ /lasaspon gyi dus la sleb dang gsum/ / de gsum po 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod na/ / skal ldan kun tshogs pa chos nyid yin/ / dam chos kyi dga' ston rgyas gyur cig / slob bu mi nyag zhabs drung sa ra rgyal ba'i bstan la mjal dang gcig / sgos nang bltas shes rgyud drang dang gnyis/ / mgon dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten dang gsum/ / de gsum po 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod na/ / legs lam kun grub pa chos nyid yin/ / skye kun tu chos la spyod gyur cig / mchog mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam par thar/ / sgos bstan pa'i gnad du legs rtogs te/ / yid dma' ba'i mal du bag phebs pa'i/ / skal bzang po rtag tu 'dzoms gyur na/ / las gang smon grub pa chos nyid yin/ / dgra gnyen gyis bslu ba med gyur cig / rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i nga nga sngon gyi nam mkha' dwangs dang gcig / khri gdugs kyi nyi ma shar dang gnyis/ / 'od zer gyis phyogs kun gsal dang gsum/ / de gsum po 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod na/ / mun pa la mi sangs rang dbang med/ / snang ba la phyogs kun spyod gyur cig / bla ma dang dkon mchog mthu dang gcig / rang cag gi lhag bsam stobs dang gnyis/ /'gyur med kyi chos dbyings bden pa gsum/ / de gsum po gcig tu tshogs 37

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'ithonam gsung ཿmgyur na/ / gang smon la mi 'grub rang dbang med/ / bkra shis kye dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig / slob bu mi nyag zhabs drung sa tshal de lta'i smon tshig 'od stong can/ / bdag dga' dad spro ba'i rta bdun gyis/ / las mkha' dbyings dag par nyer drangs te/ / lam bzang po'i nyin mo rtsom pa yis/ / mchog dge legs dpal dang ldan gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni sa bya lor skyabs mgon dam pa 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i drung nas/ rje rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi lung grwa slob thun mong nas gsan dus phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du gyur tshul gyes yid drangs te/ mtshungs bral thu'u bkwan rin po che nas mgo brtsams/ nyam chung mi nyag sku skyes kyis mtshams sbyar te dge legs kyi bya ba 'dis thog drangs nas bskal pa'i bar du bla slob chos dang 'brel ba'i rgyun lha chu'i tshul ltar gnas pa'i rten 'byung gi smon tshig tu bgyis pa'o/ / zhes gsungs/ de skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad par nye ba'i dbang gis dus rgyun dang mi 'dra bar bu slob rnams la bstan pa'i khur bzhes dgos tshul yang yang gsungs shing /lhag par nyin gcig rje 'di nyid gcig pur mdun du byon pa'i tshe/ 'o/deng sang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di shin tu nyams dmas 'dug chos rgyun thams cad kyang nyag je phrar 'gro gyin 'dug kyang sus nyams mi 'jog par snang / khyed kyis thugs stobs bskyed nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi spyan sngar dbang lung khrid rjes gnang sogs gang thob pa thams cad dang / ngos kyi rtsar nas kyang mdo sngags kyi chos mang du thob yod pas spel gang thub kyis ngas bshad pa don ldan du 'gyur ba zhig mdzad dgos/ lhag par da lan brel ba che bzhag chung bzhag gis brtson pa bskyed nas rje bla ma'i bka' 'bum gyi lung phul ba 'di brgyud pa khungs dag cing btsun pa yin/38

༄/ /spyo khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/chos bdag por 'phrod pa yin pas thugs la bcings te phyogs mtha' dag nas don gnyer ba mang po byung na khyed nyid nas dka' tsheg med par spel ci thub gyis/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa sprin bar gye nyi ma lta bu 'di thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas dar rgyas su 'gro ba'i thugs stobs cher bskyed dgos zhes sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i gsung gi lung bstan mang du gnang / lung gsan mkhan gyi khrod de nas rgyun mang du spel mkhan nyid lta bu ma byung ba 'og tu gsal bas gsung de'ang 'byung 'gyur mngon sum du gzigs pa'i 'bras —rtags su snang ngo / / de'i skabs su rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po ches 'di bar khyed lo kha shas kyi ring la nga'i dgon pa bkra shis 'khyil du phebs nas bzhugs dgos tshul mang du gsungs te dgongs gzhi khyad par can zhig yod par snang / yang khyed kyi sku gong mas mdzad pa'i skyes rabs kyi 'grel pa rtsom 'phro ma de ha cang 'gang che bas/ 'phro 'di khyed la skal bar bzhag pa lta bu yin pas mjug rdzogs pa zhig byung na legs gsungs/ gzhan sprul sku che phra du ma dang / dbang phyogs kyi tā ra'i gang ga'i mer gen paṇḍi ta bla ma sogs mang pos kyang rtsom 'phro skul ma mdzad 'dug kyang dus la ma sleb pa lta bus gnang rgyur ma song snang / sman pa bla ma mdzad mkhan phal cher mdo sngags kyi sku yon bzang yang sman la 'dris chung bas lam rim sogs chos bka'aspyi 'gro tsam las mi 'ong la/ rje nyid gso rig la'ang mkhyen pa rgyas pas grwa khrod nas sman gyi lag len gsha' ma slob 'dod pa rnams la so so'i blo dang 'tsham par tshe'i rig byed kyi gnad mtha' dag gnas drug tu bsdus te ston pa dpa' bo'i yan lag brgyad pa dang / dpal ldan rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel gsum sogs sman gyi gzhung che ba rnams dang / cha lag bco brgyad/nyams yig bye ba ring bsrel/ lag len bdud rtsi'i bum pa che chung sogs 39

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'isgronama'i ga4 'am/gzhung mang po gung bsgrigs te dogs slong dang dmar khrid lag len du 'debs tshul gyi blo skyed mang du gnang bas phan thogs bla na med pa byung /de ltar chos srid zung 'brel gyi 'dzin skyong gzhan 'gran med pa'i ngang nas lo drug gi rim par gso rig grwa tshang gi bya ba gang rgyas mdzad de/ dgung lo so bdun pa 'gal byed ces pa lcags phag lor khri'i dgongs pa zhus nas zur bzhugs mdzad/ cha har shog gi dar han rab 'byams pa ngag dbang chos dar gyis gtsos ser skya nyi shu lhag gis/ 'jam dkar/ rdza bha la/thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang zhus pa bzhin bstsal/ rab 'byams pa de'i mos 'dun ltar bstan srung 'ga' zhig la mchod gtor 'bul tshul dngos grub gter mdzod ces bya ba'ang lngags rtsom gnang /grong ba'i skye bo 'ga' zhig la bsnyen gnas dang / bsgrub bya du mar dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ la kyā zhabs drung ngo g.yog nas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab ste rje rin po che'i gsung 'bum gyi lung zhus pa ltar khong dpon g.yog dang gdan sa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po gzhan ser skya sum brgya lhag tsamadang bcas la ljags lung cha tshang bar bstsal/ de nas chos kyi rje don grub rin po che'i gdan sa bya khyung dgon par phebs/ bla grwa thun mong nas tshogs chen gyi chos khrir gdan drangs nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'dus tshogs yongs la/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung gi khungs dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas pa zhig bstsal/ chos sder mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur zhus shing / nang rten sogs la mchod 'bul gya nom pa dang bcas skyabs sems thun drug gi rnal 'byor sogs dang spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs spyan dmigs nan tan gyi sgo nas gang rgyas mdzad/ der yun ring por bcad rgya gang dam gnang nas 40

༄/ /4 khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnayopar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/yi dam lha'i ljags bsnyen dang gtso bor bsag sbyang la 'grus par mdzad/dgung lo so dgu pa bla mā dī zhes pa chu glang gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin sku 'bum chos sde chen por dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi seng khrir bzhugs/ de skabs mtsho sngon gyi ching wang bsod nams rdo rje dang bai zi mi 'gyur sogs che drags mang po/ smad phyogs kyi sbyin bdag che phra du ma/ khri ga'i phyogs nas ser skya brgya phrag lhag bcas kyis spos 'dren khri dang dngos 'bul sogs btegs nas khri khar gdan drangs te rten 'brel gang legs bsgrigs/ rgyud grwa'i 'dus tshogs su bka' chos bstsal cing mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur dang / tshogs chen gyi dge 'dun sum stong brgya phrag drug lhag la'ang mang 'gyed sogs rgya cher phul/ de nas lo re bzhin grwa tshang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'grig lam bzhin bla ma rgyud mchod sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs don mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas btab pa'i gnad rnams bshad rgyud chen po drug gi sgo nas legs par bshad pa'i lam srol chen po dpal ldan zla ba'i 'grel ba sgon gsal dang bcas pa/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i bsdus don/ zur mchan/ dkyus mchan/ mtha' dpyod rnams sbrags nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i bshad rgyun dri ma med pa 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po nas rim par brgyud pa dpal ldan smad rgyud pa'i srol ji lta ba bzhin la/rje'i gsung rab gzhan rnams dang rgya bod kyi mkhas pa du ma'i gzhung khungs thub mang po gung bsgrigs pa'i bshad pa dang / dka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag la dgag gzhag brkyangs te dogs pa'i mtha' chod nges su mdzad pas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i yang snying gsang ba bla na med pa'i bdud rtsis ngoms par gyur te/ rgyud don lam gyi rim par bsgrig tshul 41

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gas las/gye gnad la nges pa gting tshugs pa byung / mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas bye shaṃbhe ༷ ba shaṃ / re la ༷ shaṃgraṭwāṃsde~X llī /༷༷//shaṃ/ byesde /tram̐ṭwāṃ gzhan la'ang phyin ci ma log par 'chad thub pa'i dge bshes mang du thon pas bstod bsngags kyi rol mo skal bzang sna ba'i rgyan du gyur/ so nyid phyogs nas 'ongs pa mkhyen dpyod yangs pa zhabs drung skal bzang bstan pa'i sgron mes zhus ngor 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang thugs rje chen po'i dbang sta gon bcas tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang / sgrol ma'i rjes gnang /gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi lung / lam rim gyi khrid/ sman chog rgyas bsdus kyi lung sogs bka' chos du ma bstsal/ kho rang gi 'dod mos bzhin lam rim gyi dmigs rnam ma tshang bar skyong tshul dang 'brel ba'i gsol 'debs mgur dbyangs su byas pa zhig ljags rtsom mdzad/ dge bsnyen gye sdom pa zhu ba 'ga' zhig byung ba'i 'dun pa bskangs/ tshogs chen gyi smon lam gsung chos sogs la chag med du phebs te bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon gang legs mdzad cing bdag gzhan gnyis char gyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba gnang /dgon pa'i nang dang phyogs gzhan nas 'ong ba'i bsgrub bya brgya dang lnga bcu lhag la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa phog ste lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i bdud rtsis yid kyi bum bzang gang bar mdzad/ chos mtshams phal cher bcad rgya la bzhugs nas yi dam lha du ma'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/ rgyud pa grwa tshang nas lo re bzhin zla zad skabs bstan pa spyi'i rim gror dmigs nas chos rgyal lcags mkhar zur dgu pa dang bcu drug pa gnyis res mos kyis sgrub srol 42

༄za/ /tshul khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/nyid kyi sku gong ma'i dus btsugs pa ma nyams par gnas pas lo snga phyir gnyi ga'i tshogs dbur bzhugs te sgrub pa tshad ldan byas nas mjug tu gtor rgyag skabs rgyud pa'i gtor rgyag dang sbrags te grwa tshang phan tshun gyi gtor ma'ang sdeb pa'i srol bzhin/ rje 'di bas grwa tshang so so'i gtor ma dang sgos kyi rgyud pa'i zor dang lcags mkhar rim par brdab pa'i tshe rlung kha phar ldog cing me lce dum bu dum bur chad nas 'gro ba sogs zil che ba tsham rngam dkyus dang mi 'dra bar shin tu 'jigs pa byung / gnam lo gsar tshes kyi nyin rgyud pa'i bla brang gi srol bzhin dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang mo'i gtor skyong mnga' gsol sogs phyag len ltar gnang / smad rgyud grwa tshang gi bla ma dbu mdzad ske rgya zhabs drung / dge bskos bka' bcu blo bzang dar rgyas/ bying 'dren shes rab rig 'dzin/ spyi gnyer rab 'byams pa bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/dge slong blo gros mchog ldan/ dge rgan bka' bcu blo bzang bkra shis/sngags ram pa 'jigs byed rnam rgyal/ sngags ram pa tshul khrims bzang po sogs grwa tshang rang gi las sne'i rigs dang / tshogs chen zhal ngo rab 'byams pa yon tan dar rgyas sogs las sne thun mong nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor chen lcags mkhar zur bcu drug par nye bar mkho ba'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa 'ga' zhig dang / las rim rnams dgos zhes bskul ba bzhin/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog 'khrul 'khor gyi lugs su byas pa lcags mkhar zur bcu drug pa la nye bar mkho pa'i las rim drag po pho nya bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa dang / yang zur dgu pa'i skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i las rim zhal 'don gyi rim pa 'ga' zhig dang / kun spyod kyi go rim lag tu blang bde ba yi ger bkod pa dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'grig lam kun 43

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/spyod kyi rim pa 'ga' zhig cung zad bag yangs su song yod pa je dam du btang ste/ chos 'dul ba'i dgongs pa bzhin bca' yig gi steng nas cung zad kyang ma 'das pa dang / lhag par 'chad nyan gyi rting bskul nan tan mdzad pa la brten nas grwa pa rgan gzhon mtha' dag 'dun pa je cher song ste/bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa blo la bzung zhing rje nyid la rgyugs phul nas khrid sogs zhu mkhan dang / 'grel ba bzhi sbrags kyi skor nas dogs gcod zhu mkhan ches mang po byung bas/ so so'i dogs lan zhib mor bkrol bas blo gsal rnamasasngon med legs bshad kyis tshim par gyur te dad pa'i snyim pa spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod cing bsngags pa'i me tog gis mchod pa lhur len pa byung bas 'grig lam 'chad nyan gnyi ga 'gran pa bzhin gong 'phel du gyur to/ / rgyun bherdo/ /bheX / ༵ // ༷/tt+waṃ/ bhe/shaṃ sdi ༷ / ༷ tt+waṃ/ / / bhe bheni bhebhe ༷/ ༵/ chos gling gi grwa pa dge slong ngag dbang snyan grags kyis phyogs de'i gzhi bdag la gsol mchod cig zhus pa'ang rtsom pa mdzad/ cha har phyogs kyi chos spyan yangs pa'i bka' 'gyur pa chos rje blo bzang bkra shis/ dad ldan blo bzang nyi ma ngo g.yog bcas la 'jigs byed kyi dbang / sgol dkar dang rta mgrin gye rjes gnang sogs stsal/ chos rje blo bzang bkra shis kyis bskul ngor skyes bu chen po dam can rdo rje legs pa dang sku lnga'i gsol mchod bya tshul legs tshogs 'phrin las dpal 'bar zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ grwa tshang dang 44
