༄/ /྾ khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/lhan du dbyar zhal bzhes gnang ste dbyar grol rjes bstan pa'i gsal byed a kyā rin po che blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dbus gtsang nas phyir phebs pas/ rje 'di par bka' chos mang po'i snyan gsan phul ba bzhin pa ri brgya rtsa dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs kyi rjes gnang dang / gzhan lung khrid mang po bcas bstsal te bzhed pa yongs su bskangs/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa zhu mkhan brgya lhag tsam byung ba rnams so sor bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod/dgung lo zhe gcig pa srin po zhes pa shing yos lor dbyar kha than chen byung nas bla sngags mang pos char 'bebs lan mang po byas kyang gtan ma bab pas mi phyugs lo tog sogs la gnod tshab che bar brten tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs las sne thun mong nas chos skyong la lung bstan zhus pas rgyud pa dpon slob kyis gtsos dge 'dun pa nyi shu rtsa gcig gis chu mig spal kha'i chu mgor phebs te char 'bebs byed dgos tshul babs pa bzhin nyin bdun gyi ring la dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs nang gi char 'bebs tshul de bzhin bsgrubs pa na char rgyun 'jam po nyin zhag drug tu ma chad par babs te lo tog rnams legs par gsos shing mi phyugs kun dbugs phyung ste bde dga'i dpal la bkod/ rgya bod mtha' dag nas da res spyir dkon mchog gi bka' drin dang / lhag par rje 'di ba'i thugs rje kho na yin par ze tshom med/ de min na mi phyugs kun la nyam nyes chen po zhig yong thag chod du 'dug ces bka' drin rjes su dran pa byung / sher gal dag tho yon nas rje rin po che'i gsung 'bum gyi lung zhus pa bzhin dge 'dun brgya lhag tsam la ljags lung tshang bar stsal te dge ldan rang lugs rgyas pa'i rgyur bsngo ba'i mtshams sbyar shugs drag mdzad/dam pa 'di nyid nas grwa tshang gi 'dzin skyong gnang tshul sa bcad ma stongs tsam gyis khrir bzhugs pa'i ming len thabs ma yin par rgyal bstan rin po che'i 45

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i me'i rsāng 'a4/yang snying rje tsong kha pa'i bstan pa dri ma med pa 'di nyid thugs la dgongs te chos srid gang gi thad nas kyang thugs khur tshad med pa bzhes te thabs mkhas kyi sgo du ma nas bskyangs pas chos 'byor rdzogs ldan gye dpal la reg par gyur/dgung lo zhe gnyis pa me 'brug lor dpyid ka rgyud pa'i khri'i las khur gye dgongs pa zhus te/ re zhig bcad rgya dam pos lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gye nyams len dang lhag lha du ma'i bsnyen pa la brtson par mdzad/ skabs shig mtsho sngon gyi ching wang bsod nams rdo rje/ bee zi mi 'gyur sogs kyes gdan drangs pa bzhin de phyogs su phebs/ wang la tshe dpag grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang bstsal cing zhag shas tshe sgrub gnang / 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa rgyun ring sngon du btang ste zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad/ phyogs kun nas lhags pa'i mjal ba mang por khrus dbang / ljags bsngo/ bka' bsgo sogs chos sbyin bstsal/ rab byung dang dge tshul slong gi dngos po don du gnyer mkhan bzhi bcu lhag la sdom pa bstsal/ de nas bee zi'i ur ger phebs te dpon po'i mos 'dun bzhin sgrol dkar gye tshe sgrub dang yi dam chos srung la gsol mchod zhus shing / kun rig tshe dpag med/ thugs rje chen po rnams kyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa bstsal/ bsgrub bya sum cu tsam la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang / de nas sku 'bum du phebs/ smad sog pa dge slong ngag dbang brtson 'grus ngo g.yog nas zhus pa bzhin 'jigs byed kyi dbang / seng gdong ma'i rjes gnang / mgon po bar chad kun sel gyi rjes gnang /gzhan lung thor bu sna tshogs bcas bstsal/ des bskul ngor rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub kun 'byung zhes pa ljags rtsom mdzad/de nas khri ga'i phyogs su phebs te mchod rten gyi bla brang rang du yun ring po'i bar sku mtshams la bzhug nas zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor skyong bar mdzad/46

༄/ /4 khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag 'jug lan mang du bzhes shing bsag sbyangala'ang shin tu 'grus par mdzad/ khri ga'i rten gyi gtso bo gren bru'i lha khang zhes grags par dkar chag cig dgos zhes rong po dge slong don grub rgyal mtshan gyes gtsos dpyod ldan 'ga' zhig gis zhus ngor ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas grwa tshang thos bsam dar rgyas gling du phebs nas grwa pa lnga brgya lhag la kun rig dang gsang 'dus gnyis kyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/sman chog rgyas pa dang bla mchod kyi lung sogs bstsal/ slar sku 'bum du phebs/ che shos rin po che'i yab bsngags chen gyis zhus nas rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang yang gsang gi dbang sogs gnang / che shos ngag dbang bstan pa'i sprul sku rin po che'i gtsug phud bzhes te rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bstsal nas mtshan ngag dbang bshad sgrub nyi ma zhes 'dogs par mdzad/ su nyid g.yas ru'i mkhan po bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis kyis rje'i gsung 'bum gyi lung zhus par/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog la sgrub pa'i mchod par dgongs te skyo ngal med par dgyes bzhin pa'i sgo nas lung cha tshang ba dge 'dun pa sum brgya lhag la bstsal/ cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dus su phyogs kun nas yong ba'i dad ldan rgya bod hor sogs la thugs rje chen po'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang bya bas srung bcas dang / ma ṇi dang dmigs brtse ma'i bzlas lung sogs gnang ste yid tshim par mdzad/bsgrub bya nyis brgya dang drug cu lhag la dge tshul dang dge slong gi sdom pa bstsal te thar pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs/ de rjes zla ba kha shas kyi ring sku mtshams la bzhugs nas bsnyen pa dang bsag sbyang lhur bzhes/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug kyang lan mang du bzhes te rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i lam gyi nyams len bskyangs/ de nas mtsho sngon bai li ye 47

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'isgroname'i gsung 'a4/shes 'jigs med kyis gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ dpon pos bstan pa dang yang sgos nged ltos bcas la phyi nang gegs 'tshub che stabs/ de dag sel phyir du cis kyang chos rgyal gyi gtor sgrub cig mdzad dgos zhes nan tan gsol ba bzhin sgrub grogs dge 'dun dang bcas pas gnad smin bsgrub te gtor rgyag byas pas/ gegs 'tshub sogs zhi ba'i ltas mig mthong lag bzung lta bu byung / slar sku 'bum du phebs te zla lhag tsam la 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan kha skong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ mkhas grub chen po rje btsun bla ma a rig dge bshes rgyal mtshan 'od zer gyi zhabs drung du phebs te lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid rgyas par gsan/ dgung lo zhe brgyad la phebs pa stod 'grel lugs kyi rnga chen te legs par sbyar ba saṃ skro ta'i skad du du rdzu bhi mahā tsi na'i skad kyis zhing zu'i zhes 'bod pa/spor thang dang bstun pa chu pho khyi lo hor zla gnyis pa chu shel dbang po don thams cad 'bras bur byed pas phalgu nī ste rgyu skar gyi lha mo dbos nya ba'i tshes gsum rgyal ba dang po'i nyin/ sku 'bum chos sde chen po'i dpal ldan smad rgyud dpon slob lha ram pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin dang sman pa dpon slob gnyis kyis gtsos tshogs chen zhal ngo / bla brang phyag mdzod/ spyi gnyer/sku rten chos rje/ tsho ba drug gi rgan pa/ sgar ba khag dang bcas nas gdan sa chen po'i chos khrir phebs dgos kyi gsol ba btab par/ rje rin po che'i 'khrungs gnas khyad par can 'dir 'chad nyan byed rgyu byung na shin tu skal ba bzang tshul dang bcas zhal bzhes mdzad pas/ dpon slob rnam gnyis dang las sne thun mong nas dga' dar bkra shis lha rdzas maṇḍal bcas phul/ seng khrir bzhugs rgyu'i sngar nyin rgya mi'i dpon po zi lang shān dgon par 'ongs nas rje 'di par thug skabs/ khyed dgon pa 'di'i khri la gsar du bzhugs 48

༄za/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/rgyu yin zer ba bden nam zhus par/ yin tshul gsungs pas/ shin tu dga' ba'i rnam pas khyed bla ma yag po red/ khyed kyis dgon pa 'di la do dam yag po gyis/ khyod kye gsung mi nyan mkhan de 'dra yod tshe dpon po nga la sprod/ khyed bla ma chos byed mkhan yin/ nged dpon po tshos chos dang mi mthun pa'i bya ba byed mkhan tshar gcod pa po yin/ dper na bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong lta bu yin zhes zhus te srung mas rgyud bskul ba'i rten 'brel can gyi gtam du snang / de nas hor zla gsum pa tse tri ga ste nag pa can gyi zla ba zhes ston pas bya rgod phung po'i rir sher mdo dang dpal ldan 'bras srungs su dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs pa'i dus chen khyad par can gye yar tshes gsum pa gza' skar 'phrod sbyor thams cad phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ nyi ma shar ri'i rtser mngon par 'phags pa dang dus mtshungs su tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs las sne thun mong nas chen por 'os pa'i yo byad mchod rdzas kyi bye brag du ma bsgrengs pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas chos kyi khri 'phangs mthon por mnga' gsol bar mdzad pas dge legs kyi 'od snang 'jig rten kun tu khyab par gyur to/ / snod bcud dpal 'byor bde skyid lha byebye ṭwāṃ ༷shaṃ ṭwāṃX ༷ ṭwāṃbye ṭwāṃbye ṭwāṃbye ṭwāṃX ༷༷ /༷da// rgyaX/ hūm̐~Xṭwāṃ bye ༷ṭwāṃ ༷shlau ༷ bherdo ༷ rjiṭwāṃ dī ༵ lha ༷༵ṭwāṃ ༵ṭwāṃ ༷༈༵ ༵ ༷ phyag/ ṭwāṃdī ༷ rdoX tshoga~X dīji snro chen mo'i mgo nas chos thun gcig gnang ste mjug tu bstan 'bar ma gsungs nas rgyal bstan rin po che rgyas pa'i thugs smon dang phan bde'i legs tshogs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yang dag bsgrigs/ gdan sa rang gi 49

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/bla spyi thun mong dang / dgon lung nas skyabs mgon thu'u bkwan rin po ches ched mngags kye mi sna sogs phyogs gzhan gyi dgon pa dang sbyin bdag du mas khri 'bul rgya che ba rim par bteg smad rgyud dpon slob ser byes lha ram pa bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis skyes rabs dang 'brel ba'i che brjod/bstan pa rgyas shing 'gro ba la dge mtshan 'byung ba dang / zab gsang chos 'khor bskor nas brtan par bzhugs dgos tshul sogs zhu 'bul rgyas shing snyan 'jebs 'brel chags pa zhus/ khri ston du tshogs chen la mang 'gyed dang tshwa sbra sogs kyi bsnyen bkur rgyas pa zhus/ zi lang shān sku mdun du yong nas legs dar dang / rin chen gnyis pa srang 'ga' phul te gus pa cher byas/ gza' skar legs pa'i nyin nas brtsams chos grwar brtsi bzhag 'chag med thugs thog nas gnang bas blo gsal don gnyer ba rnams ngang ba'i khyu tshogs yid bzhin gyi mtsho la glebs pa bzhin dga' dad spro gsum gyis mgrin pa'i rdza rnga brdung ba la brtson par gyur to/ / de nas sa ga zla ba'i smon lam skabasasnga dro gsung chos la rgyud 'khul nges pa'i gsung bshad rgyas pa dang phyi dro'i char smon lam la chag med du phebs nas thugs smon rgya chen po mdzad/lo sngon ma rnams su mtsho sngon dang nang logs rnams la dgra jag gi gnod pa cher byung bar brten rgya'i dmag chen bud de rma chu pha rir 'gro ba'i skabs yin pas/ lan ju'i tsun tu/ chin tshe'i tā zhin/ zi lang am bhan/ to 'u ye/ shān sogs rgya'i dpon po ches dregs pa mang po lam zhor la sku 'bum du phebs par/ dgon pa'i nye 'dabs su rje'i gdan sa pa 'di pas gtsos dge 'dun mang mas bsu ba byed skabs rje'i 'dis rgyang ring po nas chibs bshol te rgya'i lugs srol gyis bkur gzos byed rtsis gnang bar/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i zhing sa gcig gi bdag po chen po lan ju'u tsun tus 'di ba 50

༄༅/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mthong ma thag 'gyog byang nas babs te kha dar phul nas mjal phrad gnang /khyed rta chibs nas gzim gshag tu phebs zhes bkur gzos chen po zhus/am bhan chin tshe'i tā zhin yang dgon par phebs 'phral kho bo khri ba bla ma la thug rgyu yin gsungs te gzim chung du phebs/ zhabs phyi rnams la khyod tsho khang pa logs shig tu yud tsam sdod/ nged gnyis po 'gol po byas nas gtam gleng rgyu yod ces bshad de/ dpon pos skyes bu gsum gyi lam spyi khog dang / lhag par zhi lhag gi thad nas dka' gnas mang po dris par/ rje 'di pas byang chub lam rim chen mo khungs su mdzad nas dogs lan mtha' chod cing go bde ba'i yid tshim nges pa thogs med du bstsal/ dpon po de sngon gyi bag chags kyis chos la mkhas nges shig yin 'dug pas lhag par dad de bsngags brjod cher mdzad cing / khong rang bzhugs sar phebs 'phral dpon chung zhig btang ste/ mdzod gos dmar po yug rin chen gnyis pa thur srang bzhi bcu/ ja sbag bzhi bcas chos kyi bka' drin zhus pa'i yon du phul/ de skabs sku 'bum gyi sa thog tu hos zi'am ho hu'u mang pos lha khang gsar pa phub pa'i steng nas dgon pa dang ma 'grigs par rtsod gleng byed 'phro yin pas ho hu'u rnams lkog gros kyis kha 'cham byas te/ da res rgyu ci shor yang lam bcos te tsun tu la zhus nas rgyal kha e lon blta dgos zhes thag bcad yod kyang tsun tu dang am bhan sogs nas bkur gzos chen po byas pa mthong bas dpa' zhum zhing / re ba stong par song bas kho thag chad de log pa'i bsam sbyor mtha' dag phye ma'i mching bu'am sbrul gyi mdud pa ltar rang nghrubyeṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ byeX /bsta/༷ hūm̐ ṭwāṃhūm̐ ༵bhebye byebye hūṃrsha hūṃṭwāṃng/ ga/ci/༷/ bye ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ bheni ṭwāṃ ni ṭwāṃ 51

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonama'i gsung 'bum/che 'di sku bsod chen po ya mtshan red/ gzhan dpon po chen po de dag gis bkur ste 'di 'dra byed pa dka' zhes gleng ba byung / rgya cher rol bar/bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ / ces gsungs pas de'ang yin mod kyang / gtso bo ni ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ rang gi don ni med pa la/ / 'di ltar gzhan rnams dga' 'gyur zhing / / mthong ba'i chos la bsngags pa dang / / pha rol tu yang bde 'gror 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kye sems rin po che'i mthu yin no/ / de nas dbyar chos tshugs par gung zhog gnyis kyi chos grwar res mos kyis brtsi bzhag lhug par bstsal pas rtsod grwa me ltar 'bar ba byung / drug pa'i smon lam skabs phyogs gzhan gye dad 'dus pa rnams dang / dgon pa rang nyid kyi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor snga dro'i char skyes rabs dang lam rim res mos kyis gsung bshad 'byams klas shing lung rigs kyis brgyan pa don gyi snying po rgyud thog tu 'dril nges pa dang / smom lam la phebs te rgyal bstan rin po che'i yang snying dge ldan lugs bzang rgyas pa'i thugs smon yang dag gnang / mjal ba sum stong tsam la phyag dbang / bka' bsgo/bzlas lung sogs 'dod mos bzhin gnang ste yid tshim par byas/ dbyar gnas tshugs te gzhi gsum lag len phra zhib dag ther gnang ste chos 'dul ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/ brtsi bzhag chag med gnang ste 'phros pa mdzad cing blo skyed kyi skyes stsol pa dang / zhi drag gi sgo sna tshogs pas 'chad nyan rting bskul ches cher mdzad/ skabs der skyabs mgon dam pa thu'u bkwan rin po che gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu tshul bstan pa gsan ma thag gces pa'i ma dang bral ba'i bu sdug bzhin thugs ngal tshad med pa gnang zhing / kye ma kye hud 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyi ma ni nub ste/52

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/snyigs dus kyi skye bo rnams mgon skyabs dang bral tshul 'di ci 'dra rang zhes sogs thugs skyo ba'i gsung mang du mdzad cing / dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pas mchod pa dang / khrus gsol smon lam sogs rje de nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs te yang srid myur 'byon gyi smon pa mdzad/ myur 'byon gsol 'debs rtsom 'dun yod thog tshogs chen zhal ngo dge bshes blo gros yar 'phel dang / grwa tshang dge bskos bka' bcu mkhas mchog gnyis dang / phyogs gzhan nas kyang zhu mkhan mang po byung bzhin ljags rtsom mdzad de mang 'gyed sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang bcas tshogs chen du 'dzugs par mdzad/ de nas ston chos kyi 'chad nyan/ dgu pa'i smon lam gyi gsung chos smon lam sogs sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad/ smon lam skabs stod smad kyi mjal ba mang po 'dus pa'ang 'dod chos kyis tshim par byas/dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mor tshogs chen du ja thug tsha sbra sogs snga ma'i srol gang yod yar rgyas kyi tshul du phul nas dge 'dun rnams mnyes par bsgrubs/de'i nyin nyid kyis gtsos dge ba'i bshes gnyen sum brgya tsam gyes gser gdung chen mo'i drung du dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod sprin spros te khrus gsol rgyas pa/ rnam dag gangs ri ma sogs sku bstod kyi rim pa/ bstan 'bar ma sogs gsungs te spyi bye brag gi bsngo bas rgyas btab/ dgun chos chen mor brtsi bzhag 'chag med du bstsal cing 'chad nyan la gzigs rtog zhib mor gnang / so kyā chos rje ngag dbang phun tshogs dang sman ram pa blo bzang yon tan bcas kyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin don gnyer can du ma la 'jigs byed kyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ mgon po bka' bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang / dpal ldan sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum gye rjes gnang sogs chos kyi mchod sbyin bstar/ sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig gis lan du mar 53

༄khya/ /gung bang bstan pa'isgronas gas lam/dga' ldan ril sgrub tshogs chen du sgrub pa'i tshogs dbur gdan drangs nas 'bul nod gzab rgyas zhus/ lo mjug tu grwa tshang gi zhabs brtan nyin bdun gyi bsnyen bkur gang legs bstabs/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa chu phag lo'i lo gsar dga' ston dang 'dod khams dbang mo'i dus gtor sogs sngar 'khyud bzhin bsgrubs/ cho 'phrul smon lam skabs gsung chos smon lam sngar bzhin dang / tshes bco lnga'i nyin rje'i mchod rten drung du brgya mchod gang rgyas/ khrus gsol dang sku bstod kyi rim pa bstan 'bar ma bcas gsungs te/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ dgon pa'i grwa pa dge tshul bsgrub bya nyis brgya dang lnga bcu lhag dge slong gi dngos po don du gnyer ba sum brgya nyi shu skor bstan pa'i gzhi ma so thar gyi sdom pa'i dpal la dīṭwāṃdī ni padī bde'ikhri ༵ ༵ tt+waṃ/ dī ༵ dī ma~Xbhe ṭwāṃg/sa /la dī/ tt+waṃ/la slodī ༵dīrdo dī dhiṭwāṃ dī ༵ rdo ༷ ṭwāṃ dhi sna rdo/ dī /ldan/ dī ༵ bhe ṭwāṃ ༵ bye dī dīX ༵dī di bas sku/ gu/ dhri mer gen paṇḍi ta bsod nams bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phyag mdzod dge bshes chos rje sogs nas dbang lung rjes gsum/ khrid bcas mang du zhus pa rnams 'dun pa bzhin bstsal/ bla ma des bskul te bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs tshul dang / gzhi bdag spyi la bsang mchod bya tshul sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug lcang lung paṇḍi ta phebs nas bka' chos mang du zhus pa'i thugs 'dun bskangs/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i rtsa lag a kyā no min han rin po che rgya nag nas mdo smad rang yul du phyag phebs par bsu ba gnang zhing yab sras zhal 'dzoms pa'i dga' ston bstar/a kyā rin po ches zhus nas 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang dang lung khrid mang po 54

༄/ / khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bstsal/ dpyid chos chen mor brtsi bzhag sngar ltar bstsal cing tshig rgyugs sogs bzhes rtsis kyis tshul mthun spro ba bskyed cing dmu rgod dpa' bkong pa'i tshogs gtam btsan brjid brling zhing blo 'khul nges yang yang gnang bas 'chad nyan lhag par 'phel zhing / grwa 'tshogs kyang tshogs chen la dge 'dun sum stong dgu brgya lhag dang / grwa tshang bshad sgrub gling rang la'ang dge 'dun chig stong lnga brgyar nye ba byung ste 'dus tshogs shin tu rgyas pas phyogs mtha' dag nas 'ongs pa'i mchog dman thams cad yid khengs te gdan sa'i bsngags brjod phyogs kun tu sgogs pa byung / rgyud pa'i khri pa snga mas dgongs pa zhus te/ bum par tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i mchog sprul rgyud pa'i dpon slob tu bsko bzhag dang / sman pa'i dpon slob nas dgongs pa zhus par nya kyā dge bshes rgyal mtshan nor bu sman pa'i khrir bskos te/ de'i tshab tu rgya rtsang dge bshes rgyal mtshan nor bu bla ma gzhung las par bskos/rgya rtsang sgom chen rin po ches lam khrid sogs zhus pa ltar phul/ dpyid chos rjes ma nas bzung dbyar chos sogs chos thog gi rigs la brtsi bzhag dang rtsod grwa'i rting bskul sogs chu lam zhugs kyi tshul du gnang / de skabs sku 'bum chos skyong chen mo'i gtsang khang 'khyam ra gsar bzhengs grub zin pas/zhal ngo sogs las sne thun mong nas rab gnas kyi snyan gsan phul bas/yar tshes phun sum tshogs par nyid kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de rgyud smad kyi dpon slob rnam gnyis dang bcas bshes gnyen dam pa nyer gcig gi tshogs kyis rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs kyi sgo nas spyan dbye'i cho ga phyag len bzhin mdzad/ sku gsung thugs rten thog mar byung tshul/ rab gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i phan yon/ brtag gnyis kyi don rje btsun grags pas bkral ba bzhin bzang po drug gi sgo nas byed tshul sogs rab 55

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/gnasakyi bshad pa zab la rgyas pa/ rab gnas kyi rgyud sogs rgyud sde dang dgongs 'grel mang po'i lung gi rgyab brten bcas snyan zhing 'jebs pa bstsal pas/ mkhas pa legs bshad gtam gyis mgu/ gsungs pa bzhin gzur gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor/'khyam ra der dkar chag rgyas pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'ang ljags rtsom bka' drin bskyangs/ dgu pa'i smon lam dang lnga mchod chen mo sogs la chos srid kyi mdzad sgo gang yod yar ldan du gnang / rgya yag rin po che'i sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te/ mtshan blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes 'dogs par mdzad/ tā ri gaṅgā'i mer gan paṇḍi ta bla ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos dpon g.yog rnams la sgrol dkar rjes gnang sogs rjes gnang mang po dang / lung khrid sogs kyang 'dod mos bzhin bstsal/ bla ma des bskul ngor dam can gyi sgrub thabs bskang gso dang bcas pa ljags rtsom mdzad/ zla zad skabs nyin kha shas kyi ring tshogs dbur phebs te chos srung3mas la 'phrin bcol sogs gang drag gnang zhing / 'dus tshogs su nyin re bzhin ja thug dang / 'gyed tshwa spra sogs gang rgyas kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa mig dmar zhes pa shing byi'i lo gsar gyi nyin ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i gtor skyong sogs rgyas bar mdzad/tshogs dbur phebs nas phyag dbang bstsal cing / cho 'phrul smon lam skabs kyi gsung chos smon lam sogs sdur bzhin gnang / de skabs phyogs nas yong ba dang dgon pa'i dge 'dun bcas bsgrub bya brgya dang bcu gnyis dge tshul dang / nyis brgya zhe lngar dge slong gi sdom pa 'bog par mdzad/dang 'dus kyi ser skya mang por 'dod mos bzhin bka' chos kyi char phab/de ltar smon lam gsung chos kyi skabs dang chos thog gi skabs kun tu gtso cher 56

༄/ /spyo khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/'chad nyan la rting bskul cher mdzad pas rtsod pa yar zla bzhin 'phel zhing /de min rgan gzhon kun la lam rim blo spyong dang mthun pa'i dge sbyor gyi bskul ma gnang bar kun gyes gsung dang blang gi nyin mtshan khor yug tu bslab sbyang la brtson pas/ mtshan phud de brtsi bzhag skyor mkhan ches mang ba dang /rje nyid la rgyugs 'bul mkhan dang / dbu phar tshogs rgyugs 'bul mkhan mang po/ smon lam dang gling bsre'i dam bca' bzhag nas ming btags byed mkhan ches mang po byung ba sogs sgo gang thad nas nyin skyed zhag skyed thon pa byung / gser tog no min han rin po che'i sprul sku ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho la'ang rig gnas kyi skor 'ga' zhig 'khrid par mdzad/ chos sde chen po 'di'i nang rten gyi gtso bo gser gdung bzhugs pa'i lha khang chen mo rtsig pa sogs la skyon zhugs te cung zad nyams chag tu song yod pas gsar bzhengs byasan legs par dgongs te 'jam mgon bstan pa'i rtsa lag a kyu rin po cher/ nyid kyis gtsos tshogs chen gyi las sne'i rigs/ tsho ba drug gi rgan pa sogs thun mong nas rgyu mtshan zhus te gtad gnyer mdzad pas/ a kyā rin po ches/ kho bo la 'di 'dra'i kha stabs ma mchis rung bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las 'da' mi nyan pas/ gang yin kyang rten 'brel gyi khyad du khas len byed/ bla ma grwa tshang gi zhal g.yang bzhin 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug bla ma rdo rje 'chang nas mdzad dgos gsungs/ mgon po de nyid kyi 'phrin las nyinabyed snang bas bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i dge mtshan dang por 'dren byed kyang rje 'di'i thugs bskyed rta ljang shing rta kho na'i bka' drin yin no/ / de ltar legs byas sgo brgya lhun gyis grub ste chos sde chen po'i seng khri'i dgongs pa zhus nas bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa ta la'i hu thog thu bskal bzang thub bstan rab rgyas chos sde 'di'i khye la bsko bzhag mdzad/57

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'itshaname'i ga4 'am/tshes grangs dge ba'i nyin grwa tshang bshad sgrub gling dang / tshogs chen gyi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshor phyag dbang dang chos ston sogs rgyas par phul te/phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rang sger du zur bzhugs mdzad do/ / mdor na kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung las/ mdo smad tsong kha sprul pa'i sku 'bum zhes/ / grags snyan rol mo sa gsum rna rgyan gyur/ / nor 'dzin thig le gang der yab rje yi/ / thugs bskyed la brten ngur smreg 'dzin pa'i sde/ / tshar du dngar ba'i yid 'ong zur phud kyis/ / gus pas btud pa'i mi 'jigs chos kyi khrir/ / yongs 'dzin nor bu'i cod pan gtsug thogs nas/ / lung rtogs dbyig 'dzin khyon la dbang bsgyur ba/ /mtshungs bral smra ba'i rgyal po khyod 'khod pas/ / dkar phyogs skyong rnams 'dzum dkar rgod pas brel/ / zhes pa nas/ mdor na chos sde chen po'i lugs gnyis kyi/ / 'phel rgyas ji lta ji ltar gnang 'os pa/ / de lta de ltar thugs khur lhur bzhes te/ / dbyar gyi chu gter dpal la 'gran par mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs par khrir bzhugs nas rnam pa kun tu 'grig lam dang 'chad nyan kho na thugs la bcings te rting bskul mdzad la/ mdzad tshul yang 'jig rten gyi kha 'dzin lta bu ma yin par chos kho na dang mthun pa/ de'i nang nas kyang bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba dang mthun pa zhig cis kyang nas byed dgos tshul/ gzhan phyogs lta grub mi gtsang zhing spyod pa ma dag pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs na 'di phyi'i legs tshogs stor nyen che lugs sogs skyon mtshang la reg pa'i sha tsha'i bslab bya blo sna rang dbang med par bsgyur nus pa'i gsung nus pa can tshogs gtam gyi tshul du yang yang bstsal pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang chos 'grim don gnyer ba rnams mgrin gcig tu 'di las lhag pa'i bslab bya dang lam rim 'chad tshul 58

༄༅/ /tshul khrimalobastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/med ces gsung tshad mar bzung ste grwa pa rgan gzhon mtha' dag rang rang gi blo nus dang mthun pa'i dam chos sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol bar gyur te/ jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi gsung sgros las/ bshes gnyen gyi mchog mtshang la rgol ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gtong sgo'i skor yang zla zad skabs grwa tshang bshad sgrub gling la nyi ma bdun gyi bsnyen bkur dang / tshogs chen du dga' ldan lnga mchod skabs dge 'dun gyi sder tsha sbra dang ja thugarnams bzhag 'gyed sogs kyi bsnyen bkur yang yang phul ba sogs shin tu rgya che ba gnang 'dug pa ni/ 'dul ba'i mdor gnas kyi slob dpon chos dang zang zing gnyi gas sdud pa mchog tu bsngags pa ltar yin mod kyang /gtso bo ni mdo sde rgyan las/ de chos bgo skal la spyod zang zing min/ /gsungs pa de dgos so/ / dam pa rnams la yon tan gyi mthus mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur zhing / de'i zhabs la brten pa rnams kyang legs byas kyi dpal chen po 'thob pa ni skyes rabs las/ de la 'khor gsum rjes mthun yon tan tshogs/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du gnas par gyur/ / ces dang / 'khri shing gi ser skya'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ mkhas pa'i yon tan khyad 'phags kyis/ / bsgrubs pa'i dpal ni rnam par mdzes/ / zhes dang / 'khri shing yal 'dab bcu drug pa las kyang / chen po nyid la brten pa'i sbyor ba las/ / gang phyir thams cad chen po nyid du 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / chos srid zung gis ṭwāṃṭwāṃ bye/dī ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༷ṭwāṃrdo~X ṭwāṃṭwāṃ skyi ṭwāṃbhe bye tt+waṃ bye rdoshlau ༷hūm̐ bye ṭwāṃl// ro//༷/༷dī rdzogs ldan slar yang 'ong snyam som nyi la 'god e ma skal ba bzang / bsil 59

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isbyon me'i ga 'bum/ldan ljongs kyi lum bi nī yi tshal/ / mya ngan med pa tsan dan ljon pa'i drung / / lugs zung gom pa'i padma bstar ba yis/ / don kun grub pa'i mtshan snyan ngang gis bsgrags/ / rmad byung thugs bskyed yub drang zhing ldem/ / rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong sham bu rim par bkra/ / bslab gsum yid bzhin nor bu'i tog mdzes pa'i/ / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs/ / zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar ba nor bu'i do shal las gdan sa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling du grwa tshang spyi sgos kyi 'dzin skyong gtso bor mdzad tshul gyi dra ba ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas bcad rgya gnang ste nyams bzhes la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad cing / thun mtshams su rgya bod kyi mdo rgyud bstan bcos sogs la gzigs rtog rgya cher gnang / skabs shig tu bstan pa'i gsal byed ta le'i hu thog thu sku bsnyun cung zad bzhes par rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang bya bas khrus bcas zhus pa bzhin bstsal pas sku khams 'phral du dwangs/ de nas yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed ljags bsnyen kha skong gi sbyin sreg bcas mdzad/ a kyā rin po che'i drung nas rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum po ti 'ga'i lung gsan/ dgung lo nga gsum pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i thog ma'i me yos lor nyid kyi gdan sa dgon pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling dang mi nyag grwa tshang gnyis bdag gir mdzad pa'i thog mchod rten dkar po'i mi nyag grwa tshang gi grwa pa/ rgan gzhon rnams dang / mchod gzhis sogs nas dad 'dus rtse gcig gis sa ga zla ba 'dir grwa tshang rang du bzhi pa'i smon lam gsar 'dzug gnang dgos tshul nan cher zhus pa ltar/ smon lam btsugs nas zhal 'don la gtan chags su kun rig gi sgrub mchod dbyangs rta 'dur 60

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/gsum sku 'bum sman pa grwa tshang gi phyag len bzhin btsugs/ de nas dga' ldan dar rgyas gling du phebs te smon lam sogs su byon nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon gang legs mdzad/ phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ba rnams la phyag dbang / ljags lung sogs kyis re 'bras smin par byas/ a kyā rin po ches sgo me'i hor kya'i rang gzhi lhun grub rtser gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/bstan pa'i rtsa lag a kyā rin po che'i thugs bzhed bzhin khong gis dbu mdzad pa'i ser skya sum brgya lhag tsam la gdugs dkar gyi dbang chen dang / rje'i gsung 'bum nang gi le tshan 'gal zhig gi lung sogs bstsal/ gzhan dad ldan rnams kyi mos 'dun ltar phyag dbang dang rigs gsum mgon po'i bzlas lung / bka' bsgo/ ljags bsngo sogs kyis yid tshim par byas/sku 'bum du phebs te mkhas pa'i dbang po a ba ga lha ram pa ngag dbang 'od zer la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang dang / g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang bcas bka' chos kyi skor mang du bstsal/ bla ma des mchod rten chen mo'i mdun du sngar blangs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa phul te/ 'di 'dul ba rang skad la cher med kyang / lo rgyus de 'dra mang du snang / yang bskyar bsnyen dzogs kyi sdom pa len rgyur a kyā rin po che dang nyid rnam gnyis la u tshugs kyis zhus pa bzhin/ rje rin po che'i gser gdung chen mo'i mdun du thub dbang gi sku byin rlabs can bzhugs su bcug ste/ rje a kyā rin po ches mkhan po dang rje 'di ba'i las slob mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bstsal/rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mchog sprul rin po che sku 'bum du chibs bsgyur skabs/ nyid kyi bla brang du bla mchod dus bzang gi tshogs dbur gdan drangs te/ lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi khrid gsan nas bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan gyi zhu ba gnad can phul/ rje a kyu rin po ches rgyud 61

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonasa'i gsung 'bum/pa'i 'du khang gsar bzhengs byas par/ rgyud grwa'i las sne thun mong nas dkar chag rgyas pa zhig dgos zhes rje nyid la bskul ma zhus pa ltar ljags rtsom mdzad/ skyabs mgon chu bzang rin po che'i mchog sprul sku 'bum du phebs par/ nyid kyi bla brang du gdan drangs nas chos 'brel zhus te zhabs brtan zhu 'bul gang rgyas bstar/ mtsho sngon ching wang bsod nams rdo rjes kho rang gi sde pa'i drug pa'i smon lam la gdan drangs pa bzhin mtsho sngon du lan gol gyidagon par phebs nas ta le'i hu thog thu dang rnam gnyis zhal 'dzoms te smon lam sogs su byon nas dge ldan ring lugs rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/mi rje wang der 'tshogs ser skya drag gzhan kun nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang / gsang 'dus kyi dbang /gzhan lung sna tshogs bcas ser skya chig stong dang brgya phrag gsum lhag la bstsal/ nyin gcig gi ring dus 'khor gyi tshogs dbur bzhugs nas bstan ༵tram̐ rdordo diñtshag ༷ ༈rshan ༵༵ tsi/ na ṭwāṃgan ༷kaX dū dī~X nghru di~X ni/ lha mod ༵ nghru ku lle'i bsnyen sgrub nyin bdun gyi ring la mdzad de dbang gi sbyin sreg gnang bas rtags mtshan dang rten 'brel sna tshogs rang 'grig tu byung / wang chol ghan nas phyir phebs te rje 'di bar mjal dus/ lags da res nged chol ghan la song bas don thams cad grub cing / lhag par pha rol gye mi drag dbang che ba mang po tshur mgo sgur te dbang du 'dus byung ba rje nyid kyi byen rlabs yin zhus par/ nga la byin rlabs gang mchis/ dkon mchog gsum dang lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs kho na yin gsungs/ su ru tho li'i phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang / dad ldan rnams kyi 'dod mos ltar ser skya lnga brgya skor la kun rig gi dbang lung sna tshogs bcas bstsal/ gzhan sbyin bdag 62

༄༅/ /tshul khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/so so'i 'dod mos bzhin bka' bsgo/ ljags bsngo sogs kun gyi yid tshim pa gnang / ul ci thu da'i ching rdo rje ja sag gis gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ dpon pos zhus ngor 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnad smin bcas bsgrubs/ 'jigs byed kyi dbang dang gzhan lung 'ga' zhig zhus pa bzhin/ dpon po ser mo pa nyis brgya lhag dang bcas la bstsal/ yang bskyar wang gi ur ger phebs te wang yab sras kyi zhabs brtan du sgol dkar tshe sgrub nyin bdun gnang / bum pa'i nang du ril bu sum nyis tsam blugs de tshe sgrub grol nyin gang ste 'phyur byung bas wang thugs dgyes shing dad pa cher skyes nas mchod 'bul gzab rgyas zhus/ur ge nas phyir phebs skabs wang gis spyi sger gyi skyabs 'jug zhus shing /khyad par da ni nga rang lo'ang mtho bas 'chi ba la nges pa ci yod/ nga'i bu 'di thugs brtse bas ma bor bar chos srid gang thad kyi bslab ston sba gsang med par lhug rtsol dgos zhes sogs kyi zhu ba mdzad/ de nas bai zi mi 'gyur tt+waṃ ༵ ṭwāṃ dībye~X ༵/sa thasdipo ༵'ipo ༷ ༵ṭwāṃ dī ༵rdo ༵༷ ༵rjirdo rdzogaṭwāṃ jiX ༵ṭwāṃ ༵ ṭwāṃ bsod nams rdo rje sku gshegs pa'i sngas mgor gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi cho ga rnam dag sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas dbang bskur phyag len bzhin mdzad de 'khor ba spyi bye brag gi du kha las bsgral nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi dpal la bkod/ slar sku 'bum du phebs/ zla ba kha shas kyi ring la bcad rgya bsdams nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ljags bsnyen mdzad cing / mjug tu nyin nyi shu rtsa gcig gi ringal bdag 'jug bzhes te tshogs kyi 'khor lor tshim pa drug ldan du rol par mdzad/ byang phyogs kyi sbyin bdag sogs dad ldan mang du 'dus pa 63

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi char phab cing byang chub mchog gi sa bon bskrun par mdzad/ bsgrub bya brgya dang bzhi bcu lhag la so thar gyi sdom pa bstsal/skabs shig tu dbang phyogs kyi sbyin bdag sa yi dbang phyug dam pa su nyid g.yas ru'i du'u rengs wang ratna sirnyi'i sku mched bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhan po bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis nas byang phyogs su chibs sgyur gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan gsang sngar nas nan cher yang yang phul yod pa ltar gdan 'dren byed me khal rta bcas 'byor/ dgung lo nga lnga pa dkar po zhes pa sa sbrul lo'i dpyid gar chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling nas byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur/ phebs lam du'ang dgon sde sgrub sde sogs kyis mtshon dad ldan so so'i zhu 'bul ltar bsgrub bya 'dus phebs mang po la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ phyogs 'dus kyi dad ldan mtha' yas pa la phyag dbang dang dam pa'i chos kyi char ba 'dod mos ltar phab ste kun gye yid tshim par byas/ de nas rim par brgyud de su nyid dang dur bed gnyis kyis mtshams pā yan zer ba'i sa nas gdan 'dren zhu mi gtso bo su nyid g.yas ru'i wang ratna sirnyi dang / sku mched mkhan po bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis/ tā bla ma bsod nams nyi ma sogs kyis gtsos 'bangs blon ser skya mang pos chibs bsu zhus/ ho shos kyi dgon pa bde sgyed gling du phebs te rten 'brel gyi thog mar bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad/ don gnyer ba mang por 'dod chos gnang / mkhan po bla ma'i dgon par yang thog mar bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad/ rim bzhin dpon po rnams kyis mchod sprin rgyas par phul/ bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhan po bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis/ du'u reng wang ratna sirnyi/ tā bla ma bsod nams nyi ma sogs sku mched rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bka' chos kyi snyan gsan phul/ de nas dgon pa bde skyid 64

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/gling du phebs te/ so so'i 'dod mos bzhin bla dpon ser skya drag gzhan sum stong drug brgya lhag par nyin bcu gcig gi ring gsang bde 'jigs gsum kun rig rnams kyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / 'pho khyed/ gzhan lung sna tshogs bcas bstsal nas dge mtshan gyi dpal la sbyor bar mdzad/ bsgrub bya brgya dang lnga bcu dge tshul slong gi dngos por bsgrubs/ cha gan o bo'i dgon pa dge 'dun dar rgyas gling du lam rim bsdus don/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ bzlas lung mang po/ dur bed stso ne'i dgon par bla ma mchod pa/ thog mtha' bar sogs rje'i gsung 'ga' zhig gi lung / sngags ram pa bla mas zhus ngor dmigs brtse ma'i 'pho khrid/ gdugs dkar gye rjes gnang / sgol dkar dang sku lnga'i rjes gnang / rab 'byams pa blo bzang nyi mas zhus ngor sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang lung sna tshogs/ kirti bla ma'i 'dod mos bzhin bde mchog dkar po rdo~X sdiX rdo 'idra dīdī ga~X ༵ga~X ṭwāṃ/༵ /pa ṭwāṃdi ༵trī sdi ༷ ༷gyista me// dī dī~X thugs rje chen po'i dbang / 'od dpag med kyi 'pho khred bcas bstsal/thus lagyi chos rgyal gye gtor sgrub cig byed dgos nan tan zhus pa ltar bstan pa'i zhabs brtan la dmigs nas gtor sgrub mdzad/ dpon po tshe dpag skyabs dang em chi chos rje rnams kyis 'dod mos bzhin brgya rtsa'i lung sogs dang / masmi blo bzang tshul khrims kyis zhus ngor tshe bdag mgon po dang phyag rdor sogs kyi rjes gnang / seng gdong ma'i gtor chog 'jigs byed bskyed rim sogs kyi lung / dur bed ja khi rog chi la/ sgol dkar dang lha mo'i rjes gnang / bla mchod kyi lung / cha har tsam pa gnang so bcas la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / sgrol ma dkar ljang gi lung / so 65

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/nyid bo dhi ca khi rog chir tshe dpag gi rjes gnang / rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po'i bzlas lung bcas gnang / yang sngar gyi so nyid dgon pa bde skyid gling du phebs/ bla ma mchod pa'i dus bzang tshogs 'khor sogs cha lag tshang ba mdzad/ gu thi bla ma'i dgon pa bkra shis rab rgyas gling du phebs te sku sgye zhabs drung la lha mo'i rjes gnang / nyid kyi gsung gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi lung gnang / de nas so nyid u dzing me rin gyis mchod pa'i grwa tshang la phebs/ 'dus tshogs nyis brgya tsam la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung bstsal/ mtsho bdun du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i lam du'ang bla dpon ser skya drag zhan nyis stong brgal ba la phyag dbang dang / so so'i mos pa ltaradabang rjes gnang lung khrid sogs bstsal te skye bo kun gyi yid tshim par byas nas mtsho bdun a kyā rin po che'i bla brang du phyag phab/ byang phyogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po hal ha rje btsun dam pa dang bstan pa'i rtsa lag rje a kyā no mon han rin po che rnam gnyis/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma chen por mjal phrad gnang rgyur mtsho bdun brgyud nas phebs skabs/ rje btsun dam pa rin po cher lha rdzas dngul gyi maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/dngul srang lnga bcu sogs phul te mjal kha zhus shing / nyid rnam pa gsum po nyin kha shas kyi ring la lhan rgyas su bzhugs nas zab chos kyi gleng ba rgya cher mdzad/ nyid la rje btsun dam pa rin po ches rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang bya ba khrus dang bcas pa gnang dgos zhes bka' phebs pa ltar rjes su gnang ba spyi'i chos bshad gang rgyas kyis brgyan nas phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes te/kho bo gtan chags par khyed nyid dang lhan rgyas su 'dug 'dod che na'ang /yul gyis bskal pa'i dbang gis bsam pa bzhin mi yong 'dug da res rang cag gi skye ba sngon ma'i smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthus dngos su phrad 66

༄/ /4 khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/de dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel ba shin tu zab pa byung bas/ dam pa nyid nas tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i skyabs 'jug ces gnas tshul rnams zhib rgyas gsungs/ nyid nas kyang lha rdzas/ dngul maṇa/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs phul te skyabs 'jug nan tan zhus/ de nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i mchog sprul rin po cher mjal bar phebs pas/ lcang skya rin po ches gzigs pa che bzhes kyis bka' mchid mang du bstsal/ slar mtsho bdun gyi a kyā bla brang du phebs nas yun ring tsam bzhugs/ bstan pa'i gsal byed lcang lung paṇḍi ta mjal bar phebs pa la zab chos kyi bgro ba rgya cher mdzad/ ho'u chid g.yas ru'i wang gis zhus pa bzhin dam can skyes bu chen po'i rjes gnang dang / sor du su hūn gar tā pe zi la sgrol dkar gye rjes gnang bstsal/ dur bed tā wang zhe hor la gong mar mjal du phebs zhor la rje 'di mjal bar byon nas phyag dbang dang chos 'brel zhus/ mtsho sngon dang smad phyogs kyi dpon po mang pos mjal bar 'dod chos bstsal/ mjal ba bla dpon ser skya drag zhan chig khri lnga stong brgal ba la phyag dbang dang chos 'brel bstsal cing / lhag par rigs gsum mgon po'i bzlas lung ljags bsngo sogs gnang ste kun gyi rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ a kyā rin po che'i zhabs brtan du yi dam gyi bsnyen pa dang chos srung spyi la mchod gtor gang rgyas 'phrin bcol sogs gnang /hal ha rje btsun dam pa rin po che dang / a kyā rin po che rnam gnyis nas 7'jam dbyangs gong mar mjal phrad grub nas yang bskyar mtsho bdun du phebs pas/ nyin kha shas kyi ring lhan du bzhugs nas mdo sngags chos kyi bka' mchid mang du mdzad/ khyad par dka' gnas mang po bkrol bas chos kyi dga' bas rol par gyur/ skabs shig tu or du su hūn gar tā bai 67

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/zi'isras mo gnyis la gdon gyis zin te ci bya gtol med du gyur nas mgon skyabs su gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ phyag dbang bka' bsgo/ srung mdud sogs bstsal bas bu mo gnyis dran med du brgyal zhing / brgyal sangs nas kho rang gnyis kyi srog skyob dgos tshul gyi skyabs 'jug zhus pas nad las rim gyis grol te dpon 'bangs tshang mas nyin mtshan khor yug tu rje 'di la gsol ba 'debs pa byung / dur bed tā wang phun tshogs bsam 'grub 7gong mar mjal nas rang yul du ldog skabs lam du bsnyun gzhi drag po zhig gis thebs te gzhan gyi sa char mgon skyabs ye ma mchis par bzhugs pas/ nyid la skyabs btsal nas gsol ba btab par thugs brtse bas nye bar gzigs te phyag sman dang bka' bsgo sogs bstsal cing rim gro 'ga' zhig bsgrubs pas/ zhag gcig nas sku bsnyun las grol te dad pa lhag par ṭwāṃrdo rdo ༵ ṭwāṃ ༷ṭwāṃdī /di sdibaphu dī rjes rdon rdos zhu dhiX ༵ hūṃ~X dī nghru dīnghru/ ༈ṭwāṃ ༵ har gyi sde tsho brgyud de chibs kha yar bsgyur/ pheb lam du dad ldan ser skya lnga stong brgal ba la phyag dbang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs bstsal nas kun gyi re ba bskang par mdzad de a to chin ha ya gri wa'i dgon par phebs/ dge 'dun 'dus tshogs yongs la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung / 'pho ba'i man ngag bcas bstsal/ de nas rim par brgyud de glang chen dal 'gros kyis phebs pa'i lam zhor du cha har ku lu o lān shog gi dpon po bkra shis tsun tā mi sde bcas la sgrol dkar dang sgrol ljang sogs kyi rjes gnang / seng gdong ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / bzlas lung 'ga' zhig bcas bstsal/ de nas cha har ku lu o lān shog gi swo nyig dgon pa bstan pa dar rgyas gling du phebs/ dad ldan rnams la phyag dbang sogs bstsal/ der khal rta dang 68

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/chibs pa rnams bzhag nas 'dzam gling gi gnas chen/ shar ri bo rtse lnga/lhor ri bo gru 'dzin/ nub au ḍi ya na/ byang shambha la/ dbus rdo rje gdan te lngar gsungs pa'i nang nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhing /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ mdo sde phal po che/ yi ge brgyad pa'i cho ga zhib mo sogs las lung bstan pa gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar mjal bar phebs/ rta zhonakhal bkal nas 'gro ba gzhan la gnod pa las ma log pas dkar nag 'dres ma'i skyon gyis sbags te gnas mjal tshul mthun mi yong bar dgongs nas rtag ngu chos 'phags mjal bar phebs tshul bzhin dpon g.yog thams cad zhabs thang la phebs/ lam du yin gru'u mkhar gyi lha khang mchod rten du mar mchod mjal gnang / ri bo dwangs bsil gyi ri lnga las don yod grub pa 'phrin las kyi gnas byang ri'i rtse mor bzhugs pa'i lha khang gi rten rnams dang /ri'i phyogs phyogs su yod pa 'jam dpal dang gnas brtan gyi khri/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i mchod rten sogs la mjal te/ ltung bshags/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor sogs lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams bzhes cha tshang ba/ mjug tu smon lam rnam lnga bstan 'bar ma sogs gsungs te bstan 'gro'i don du bsngo ba'i spyan dmigs nan tan mdzad cing phyag mchod skor ba sogs gang rgyas gnang / de nas dun je'am wang he spung zhes thugs mi bskyod pa'i gnas shar ri'i rtser byon/ rten rnams la mchod mjal gnang zhing phyag mchod zhal 'don gyi rim pa thams cad gong bzhin spyan dmigs shugs drag po'i sgo nas gnang ste/ mjal lo tsam ma yin par rten che ba thams cad kyi drung du de dag 'chag med du phyag len la 'debs par mdzad/ sred med kyi bu'i phugs dang / tshag zhwa'i mchod rten/ spyan ras gzigs kyi khri/ sdong po 69

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'i 0ma'i khrung 'thugabakod pa'i phugs sogs zhib mjal dang bsag sbyang gang rgyas gong bzhin gnang / rgya gar gye slob dpon bdun phebs nas ting nge 'dzin la zhugs te ma langs pa'i steng du bzhengs pa sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi lha khang du phyag bteg bsag sbyang rgyas pa sngar ltar mdzad/ de nas 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i ba yar gyi nyin dang dus 'dzoms par/ 7gong ma'i gzim chung la mchod mjal rgyas pa zhus/ hwa shang gi lha khang mang po brgyud de lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzim chung dang / dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje btsun rol pa'i rdo rje'i sku gdung mchod rten la mjal/ nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dang mchod me brgya phrag mang po phul te/ ltung bshags/ skyabs sems/yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor sogs dkyus ma'i steng du bla mchod dang khrus gsol sogs bsnan te smon lam rnams dang bstan 'bar ma bcas gsungs shing bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon rgya cher mdzad/ dpon po tem mchi bla ma dang grwa rigs rnams kyi 'dod mos bzhin dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po'i lung sogs stsal/jid te zi zer ba'i lha khang dang / khyungs ri'i mchod rten che ba dang /gzhan yang mchod rten 'ga' zhig bcas par mchod 'bul zhus/ de nas hwa shang gi lha khang / 7gong ma'i gzim chung / gnam gang gi zla ba mthong ba'i chu mig ming swe je zer ba bcas la mjal/ de'i mdun gyi mchod rten dang / de'i gsham gyi hwa shang gi lha khang bcas la mjal/ de nas chu'i tshur kha'i hwa shwang chin ye sen gyi lha khang sogs la mchod mjal zhus/ de nas chen ho dun zer ba'i lha khang dang / brag gi phugs mig sogs la mjal/ de nas lho ri yongs grags nan the zer zhing kyin she'u phung ste mdog bzang bkra ba'i spo zhes grags pa'i rtser bzhugs pa'i kun bzang mchod rten dang lha khang /70

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/chingalang shi ste mdo las gsungs pa'i dwangs bsil rdo dang der yod pa'i hwa shwang gi dgon rnams la mjal/ de nas lo han dun/ gu chi leng / cin ga lin/ gru rin zi/ tshi pho'am ban shu zi zer ba rnams dang mchod rten sngon po ri mo can rnams la mjal/ de nas ching legs cho zer ba'i zam brgyud de zhag bab kyi sar lha khang zhig tu rgya'i chin ye sen zer ba'i ho shwang zhen can/ ho shāng thung shun ho shāng zhin min te hwa shāng gsum bzhugs yod pa de gsum gyis kho rang tsho'i 'dug sa'i khang pa la byi dor legs par byas nas rje 'di pa gdan drangs te bzhugs su bcug de'i mtshan gyi ring yongs rdzogs la rje nyid dang ho shang gsum ga lhan du bzhugs/ zhabs gras rnams khang pa logs shig tu bzhag ste/ rnam pa bzhi pos chos kyi 'gro ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ skabs la lar rnam pa bzhi gas rgya skad kyi ma ṇi gsung gin 'dug pa 'ga' zhig gis thos nas ya mtshan te mdun la song bas/ zhal ta'i mtshams bcad de rje 'di bas rang ga'i zhal 'don zhig dang / ho shwang gsum pos rgya skad kyi ma ṇi gsung ba'i tshul tsam las gzhan rnams sbas pa'i tshul gnang / sang zhog gsol dpon dge slong bstan 'dzin chos 'phel gyis gsol ja khyer dus rnam pa bzhi ga sngar dgung ji ltar bzhugs pa'i tshul de las cung zad kyang ma g.yos par bzhugs 'dug pasakho shin tu ngo mtshar skyes/ 'on kyang de nas phebs gar ha cang dgyes drag pa'i nyams kyis zhabs phyi nang ma 'ga' zhig la zhal rtsed kyi tshul du mdangs rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa ho shwang gsum dang zhag gcig lhan du bsdad pas skal ba shin tu bzang zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe mgur gyi tshul du/ zla 10tshes ngabazang nyin 'jam dbyangs kyi/ / gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga yi/ / ching ling cho rur 'jam dbyangs kyi/ / sprul pa ho shwang gsum 71

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i mame'i gsung 'bum/dang phrad/ / btsun pa mi nyag sprul ming bdag / 'jam dbyangs go 'phang mnyam thob shog / ces tshigs bcad 'ga' 'then pa zhabs gras pa shes ldan zhig gis thos te dgongs gzhi can gyi gsung yin par go nas shin tu dad de tshigs bcad de dag shin tu bsgrim nas blor bzung ste brjed thor bris/de nas phebs te goms pa lnga bcu tsam song dus grwa pa zhig gis kha ton gyi dpe lus pa dran nas phyir len rgyur song tshe ho shwang gsum ga mi 'dug par ma zad bsdad shul song rjes ci yang med par khang stong du snang zhes tshur 'ong nas bshad pas/ grwa pa thams cad kyis gzhi bzung nas gtan chags su bsdad yod pa'i rnam pa las 'phral du chas nas 'gro ba'i tshod min/ 'gro na'ang b.rader yong yod sa med pas nges par 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin par gor ma chag go zhes mgrin gcig tu gleng / de nas kwa swe'i spung dam yongs grags zhi ze zer ba nub ri'i rtser phebs/ khro sku dang mchod rten chen po zhig la mchod mjal zhus/ de nas gru the zer ba'i dbus ri mtshar sdug lhun po'i rtser phebs/ mchod rten che chung lnga dang yang mchod rten che ba zhig dang rdo'i sku che ba bcas la mchod mjal gnang / de nas dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i lha khang du phebs te brgya mchod dang snyan shal gang rgyas phul/ ltung bshags sogs sngar bzhin mdzad/ de nas dbyar gnas kyi lha khang dang / 'jam dbyangs bgres pa'i lha khang / sgrol ma'i lha khang rnams su byon nas phyag mchod rgyas par mdzad cing / nang rten du sgol ma'i bris thang zhig gdan drangs par mdzad/ slar sangs rgyas rabs bdun du phyag bteg rim par bde mchog lha khang dang / rje lcang skya rin po che'i ri khrod dang bla brang /rdo rje'i phugs sogs la mchod mjal rgyas par byas nas bya rgod phung po'i ri dang mtshungs par gsungs pa phu sa ting zer ba dang / lo ho zi zer ba 72

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/gnyis kyi rten rnams zhib mjal bar/ grwa tshang du mang ja sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas rgyab kyi 'jam dbyangs rang byon gye lha khang 'jam dpal sde chen zer ba dang / phu sa ting gi mdun na chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bzhengs par dgra bcom pa ma ting gis lung bstan pa gnas chen 'di'i lte ba dang rten gtso nor bu chen po'i mchod rten bya ba'i mchod rten dkar po chen po bcas la mjal nas skor phyag mchod pa zhal 'don sogs gang rgyas gnang / sog skad kyis khu ril su mi zhes 'bod pa zangs kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang dang / lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dkar po chung ba dang / nor bzang phug tu/ 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i lha khang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub khang brag sogs la mchod mjal zhus/de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub phug tu mjal zhing dar rgyas no mon han gyi lhakhang du phyag btegs so/ / mdor na gong gsal gyi rten rnams dang byang ri'i rtse nas g.yas skor du mjal skabs tha na lam du yod pa'i rdo dang bong ba yan chad la 'jam dbyangs dngos kyi 'dus shes kyis dag snang sbyangs pa las hab rgyug mi mdzad/ rten gang gzigs kyi rtsar ltung bshags sogs dang 'brel ba'i phyag gang mang / skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas dang / thun drug gi rnal 'byor/ bla ma mchod pa/ smon lam rnam lnga/ bstan 'bar ma sogs gsungs shing thugs smon gang drag mdzad/lam thag ring ba sogs kyis ji tsam brel dgos pa yod kyang zhal 'don khral rgyug tu ma song ba'i dal bur spyan dmigs gtad nas gsungs/ so so'i dkon gnyer la mchod sgron thebs dang / mchod pa thams cad shin tu gtsang sbra thon nges dang mgo mjug snyoms pa rgya gang che bstar/ gnas der bzhugs pa'i grwa tshang che phra so sor mang ja'i dod dngul srang bcu yan chad kyis 73

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 4ma/bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i gser gyi rgyal khab chen por phebs yung hwa' gung gi a kyā bla brang du bzhugs gnas mdzad/nang rten tsan dan jo bo/ gdugs dkar lha khang / bde ba can/mchod rten dkar po/ yung hwa' gung gi lha rten sogs la mchod sgon rgyas par phul te so so'i mdun du bsag sbyang gi rim pa rgya chen po snga ma bzhin star chags su mdzad/ de nas lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchog sprul rin po che dang / khri chen rgya nag pa'i mchog sprul rin po che/ zam tsha gser khri rin po che rnams la rim bzhin mjal phrad zhus/ pho brang du bzhugs pa'i sgrub sde so sor mang ja'i bsnyen bkur mdzad/ slar yang ri bo rtse lngar phebs/zhabs grwa pa mang mang cha har la btang ste/ rje nyid gsol dpon dang dge bshes gnyis bcas dpon g.yog bzhi bkwa' yin dun zer ba spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub khang zhes grags par byon te/ bla mchod dus bzang tshogs 'khor bcas cho ga'i yan lag tshang bar mdzad/ yun ring tsam bcad rgya bsdams nas yi dam lha'i ljags bsnyen mdzad skabs nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs nas thugs spro ba'i tshul gyi nyams mgur bzhes pa ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid/ / bla ma 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang / / bde chen 'khor lor 'bral med bzhugs la/ / lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs shig / bdag ni thag ring yul gyes bskal yang / /sngonabasags dge ba'i rlung gis bskyod de/ / phyi dang nang gi nyer 'tshe med par/ / zhing mchog 'di ru bde bar 'byor ro/ / a la la dga' ba'i skyid glu len no/ / brtse ba'i gter chen thugs rje las 'ongs/ / yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i bcud can/ / bkra shis dge mtshan chags pa'i gnas su/ / lam bzang sgrub pa'i go skabs rnyed do/ / a la la ma g.yeng ba'i dran 74

༄/ /྾ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/pa nang du bkug nas/ / khyod gsung snying po yig drug bgreng bas/ / rang gi shes rgyud 'dul dang chabs gcig / rigs drug sdug bsngal kun kyang sbyangs so/ / a la la nga brgyad ldan chu la bskol ba'i ja ni/ / yang yang btung yang ro zhim ldan pas/ / yid kyi bu chung tshim dang lhan cig / dran shes a la brtan par chags song / / a la la ma yid 'ong blta na sdug pa'i brag rir/ / dri ldan rtsi shing tho res brgyan cing / / sna tshogs bya skad snyan par sgrogs par/ / dmu rgod sems rta kha lo bsgyur song / / a la la ma sa bkra bzang zhing mtho khyad dbang gis/ / rang gi sems kyi gzengs kyang mtho zhing / / zhe sun zhum pa ci yang med par/ / yid ni dge la mchog tu sbyor song / / a la la ma mthon po'i gnas las kun tu bltas tshe/ / bzang ngan sna tshogs mthong ba ji bzhin/ / nang bltas shes pas rgyud la bltas na/ /bdag tu 'dzin pas bslad pa mthong ngo / / a la la ma rdo yi 'gram dang chu la brgal te/ / gnas 'dir gyen du bgrod pa bzhin du/ / srid bde 'dod pa'i chu las brgal te/ / thar pa'i jem skas mchog tu 'dzeg go / a la laza nang gi sems dang phyi yi gnas kyi/ / khyad par mthun pa de lta lags na/ / mgon khyod thugs rje cir yang 'gyu bas/ / 'gro rgyud smin par mdzad pa yin no/ / a la la ma bdag gi sngon bsags las smon bzang zhing / /deng 'dir mos gus kha zhe med pa/ / gnas kyi khyad par phyi nang mthun pas/ / ngo mtshar dge sbyor yid la sman no/ / a la la ma brtse ldan 'phags mchog thugs rje'i sprin las/ / byen rlabs gru char 'dod pa 'jo bas/ /bdag rgyud zhing sa brlan par mdzad de/ / dge sems myu gu 'khrungs par byas so/ / a la la 〉 spyir na gangs can yongs kyi lha skal/ / sgos su nyam chung bdag gi skyabs gcig / bshes gnyen bla ma'i rnam par byon te/ /75

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'isproname'i khrung 4ma/gtan bde'i lam bzang gsal bar ston cig / a la la ma bla ma lha la gsol ba 'debs pa/ / 'dis mtshon dge tshogs rgya mtsho ci mchis/ /mkha' mnyam mar gyur 'gro ba kun kyang / / bla med byang chen 'thob pa'i rgyur bsngo/ / a la la dga' ba'i skyid glu len no/ / tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i dge ba 'dis kyang / / bstan 'dzin dam pa'i mdzad 'phrin rgyas shing / / rgyal bstan dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel ngos/ / 'jig rten khams su dge mtshan khyabagyur/ / ces nyams mgur 'di ni gnas mchog ri bo rtse lnga'i spyan ras gzigs kye sgrub phug tu mi nyag tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi mas dga' ba'i skyid glur blangs pa'o/ / zhes pa ste dpyod shes pa zhig gis dpyad na rnam thar zhig la/ rang gi shes rgyud 'dul dang chabs gcig / rigs drug sdug bsngal kun kyang sbyangs so/ / zhes pa 'di gcig pus chog pa lta bur snang / byang chub mchog tu gzhol ba'i rgyud gcig pu/ / nyams mgur dri za'i 'phang 'gro brdung ba'i sgras/ / srid zhi'i mtha' la brten pa'i gru gzings ni/ / dum bur gzhig pa'i ngang tshul e ma rmad/ / ces kyang gtam du bya'o/ / yang 'di skad gsungs te/ zhing rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag / lha snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / gnas spyi bor zhabs zung padma dkar/ / dus rtag tu 'bral med bzhad bzhin bzhugs/ / bdag paṇa chung yul gyis bskal gyur kyang / / sngon dge ba'i 'phags pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ / zhing dam pa dge legs 'byung gnas 'dir/ / phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med par 'byor/ / sgos lha khyod thugs rjes byin brlabs shing / / 'gro shes rgyud dri ma mngon bkrus phyir/ / chu yan lag brgyad ldan dngos ston pa/ /gnas bkra shis dge mtshan 'khyil ba 'dir/ / yid dge la spyor 'dra'i brtson pa yis/ / las bzang po sgrub skal zhag 'ga' rnyed/ / mgon thugs 76

༄/ /ryā khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/rje'i 'od snang 'bum 'gyed pas/ / bdag ma rig 'khrul ba cung sangs te/ / lar rang gi spyod tshul brtags pa na/ / blo bdag 'dzin 'di yis ches bslad mthong / / da sgo gsum nyes spyod ci bgyis pa/ / mgon thugs rje nyin bzhin mngon mthong nas/ / spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing / /sgos rang nyid myur du 'chi ba'i tshul/ / dus nyin mtshan med par bsam pa'i ngos/ / mchog lam bzang sgrub la bskul bar mdzad/ / skyabs bslu ba med pa'i thugs rje dang / / bdag lhag bsam dag pa'i mos tshogs las/ / lha thugs je /chen po'i byin rlabs rgyun/ / bdag yid la 'bral med chags gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub khang du zhag 'ga' bsdad skabs bris pa'o/ / zhes gsungs/ yang skabs shig thugs la bzod glag med pa'i skyo shas kyi nyams chen po byung ste skyo mgur bzhes pa ni/ gnas spyi gtsug seng khri pad zla'i steng / / skyabs kun 'dus bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / dus rtag tu 'bral med dgyes bzhugs la/ /nyam thag pa'i gdung dbyangs 'di la gson/ / bdag thag ring yul gyis bskal na yang / / sngon bsags pa'i rnam dkar las kyi dbang / / zhing mchog 'dir nye zho med par 'byor/ / dge yud tsam sgrub pa'i go skabs rnyed/ / lar rang gi spyod tshul brtags pa na/ / skyabs dam pa'i drung na ya re nga / / na gzhon nu'i dus nas skyes chen gyi/ / ming grags snyan lang tshos mdzes na yang / / nang yon tan dam pa ma byung bas/ / bstan 'gro la phan bsam ngo re gnong / / mgon bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ /zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang bstan kyang / / don nyams len gnad du ma khel bas/ / rgyud tha mal du lus pa 'di la gzigs/ / mtshan ldan gyi mkhan slob dam pa'i drung / / so thar sogs sdom gsum legs mnos kyang / / dam tshig 77

༄/ /gung ca bayo lo zaske ga 'a4/dang sdom khrims yal bor bas/ / nyes ltung gi gong bu bdag la gzigs/ /thos bsam sgom 'bad lo byas legs kyang / / bdag 'dzin gyi 'khri bas dam du bcings/ / rgyud chos las gol yang chos bshad mkhan/ / phyi bla ma'i gzugs brnyan bdag la gzigs/ / don sgra spyir song ba'i dge sbyor gyes/ / rang gzhan la phan par re na yang / / rang rgyud la nyams myong ma mchis pas/ / nang bla ma rul ba 'di la gzigs/ / skyes mtho mnyam dman pa su la yang / / yid dag snang skad cig tsam ma 'byongs/ / rang cher rlom 'gran sems nga rgyal gyis/ /rgyud rul bar byas pa 'di la gzigs/ / skyon sna mang rang la mchis pa dag / mgon khyod la re rer ngo bgrangs te/ / snying khong nas gsol ba btab la gsan/ / bdag blo kha chos la myur du sgyur/ /tshe 'jug 'di chos su gtong ba yis/ / skyabs smon 'dun snying nas btsal byed na/ / mgon thugs rje bslu ba mi mnga' bas/ / bdag thar lam sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhing dam pa ri bo rtse lnga yi/ / gnas ting 'dzin rol pa zhes bya bar/ / nga mi nyag pan rgan spyod tshul dbyangs/ / mgon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi drung du len/ / zhes pa'o/ / nyams dang rtogs pa'i chu bo nang nas rdol/ / longs spyod 'khor lo'i mdud pa rang sar grol/ /zab rgyas gdams pa'i glu dbyangs len pa de/ / mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje ma yin nam/ / de nas lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'i ri khrod du phebs/ gso sbyong bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas kyis gtsos ri khrod pa rnams la bla mchod sogs khrid lung mang po/ gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang sogs bstsal nas dge ba'i sa bon khyad par can bsgrun par mdzad/ gso sbyong bla mas bskul ngor rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su len tshul dngos grub kun 'byung / ri khrod pa dge slong blo bzang rin chen 78

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/gyis bskul ngor ma cig lab sgon la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ hal ha blo bzang dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor rje nyid kyi mtshan sngags bzla tshul/ pa ring dpon po rin chen phun tshogs kyis bskul ngor lha mo'i gsol mchod rnams ljags rtsom mdzad/ gzhan yang der 'dus pa'i dad ldan ser skya drag gzhan thams cad la so so'i 'dod mos bzhin dam pa'i chos kyi char phab ste kun gyi yid tshim par byas/ de nas dgun mjug tu sngar gyi cha har po nyig dgon pa bstan pa dar rgyas gling du byon/ lcags rta'i gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi tho rengs dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i tshes gtor phyag len bzhin mdzad/ dgon pa de'i bdag po sprul sku la rab byung gi sdom pa bstsal te mtshan blo bzang tshul khrims nyi ma zhes btags/ sprul pa'i sku dang tā bla ma dam chos bzang po/ dge rgan rab 'byams pa blo bzang dngos grub rnams kyis gtsos 'dus tshogs yongs nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin bla grwa nyis brgya lhag la 'jigs byed sngags btu/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ sgrol dkar/dbyangs can ma dkar dmar/ nor rgyun ma/ sman bla sogs kyi rjes gnang / gnas brtan cho ga rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i bstod chen bzhi/'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ tshe dpag gi cho ga rdo rje gcod pa/ sman cho ga 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs za ma tog de'i bskyed rim gyi lung bcas bstsal/ yang dgon pa de'i bla ma dge 'dun bcas dang mchod gzhi thun mong nas zhus ngor ser skya brgyad brgya skor la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ rdo rje rnam 'joms sogs kyi rjes gnang / 'od dpag med kyi 'pho ba'i khrid lung sogs bstsal/ phyogs gzhan nas dad ldan ser skya nyis stong lhag 'dus par so so'i 'dod mos bzhin phyag dbang / bklag lung /ljags bsngo sogs bstsal te kun gyi yid tshim par mdzad/ rab byung /79

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 4ma/dge tshul/ dge slong bcas bsgrub bya bcu phrag gnyis la sdom pa phog de nas cha har gu lu o lan gyi al than bu si'i dgon par gdan drangs pa ltar phebs/ zer gun tā bla ma/ dge bskos dharma rin chen/ dge bskos shes rab/ spyi gnyer sogs las sne'i rigs dang 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhus pa bzhin ser skya stong phrag lhag la rnam 'joms kyi dbang rjes gnang gnyis/thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang / lung thor bu sna tshogs bcas bstsal/ dge bskos bla ma lnga pa'i lam du song bar brtse bas dgongs te bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs nan tan mdzad/ dge 'dun spyi nas bla mchod kyi khrid zhus par nyin kha shas kyi ring la gzab bshad nyams myong gis brgyan pa rgyas par bstsal/ or du su shog gi gu thi chos rje bla ma ye shes dpal ldan gyis zhus ngor ser skya lnga brgya tsam la tshe lha rnam gsum gyi rjes gnang / sman bla ring po'i lung bcas bstsal/ bla ma de'i 'dod mos bzhin phyag rdor gtum chen kyi mngon rtogs dmigs rim bcas ljags rtsom mdzad/ tsun tā bkra shis yar 'phel gyi mos 'dun ltar sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang /7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i zhabs brtan sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/ sor gsu thu'i dgon par byon te bla dpon ser skya thun mong nas zhus pa bzhin sgrol dkar dang gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang / lung 'ga' zhig bcas bstsal/ cha gan chos rje bla ma dge 'dun bkra shis kyi dad mos ltar nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang / gsang 'dus smon lam gyi lung / nyid kyi ljags rtsom 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung sogs gnang / cha har gu lu sha ra'i ja lan dbang mchog la gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i rjes gnang / gdugs dkar gyi lung / dad ldan rang rang gi yul phyogs kyi gzhi bdag sogs la bsang mchod 'phrin bcol/ g.yang 'bod sogs 80

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ljags rtsom thor bu mang po zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ mdzo dge phyogs kyi zhabs drung zhig gis dzi dkar lha lnga sogs rjes gnang 'ga' zhig rdza dkar mngon rtogs kyi lung sogs zhus pa ltar gnang / de nas bsgrub bya bsnyen gnas drug rab byung bco lnga/ dge tshul nyi shu lhag dge slong nyi shu rtsa bzhi bcas so thar gye sdom pa'i dpal la bkod de thar pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ or du su tsun gar tā bai zi'i sras chung ba dkon mchog mjal du 'ongs te gzhi'i gsung brtag zhus pa'i lan bstsal/ kho ring phyogs su gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan yang phul/ de nas cha har gu lu u lan gyi dgon pa bde ldan bkod pa gling gi 'dus spyi nas tā bla ma blo bzang chos grags ngo g.yog ched mngags btang ste dgon par gdan drangs pa ltar phebs/ er ti ni mer gen slob dpon ta'i ching chos rje bla ma hu thog thu blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos rab 'byams pa blo bzang dbang rgyal/ kun pe lig thu tā bla ma blo bzang chos grags/ er ti ni chos rje blo bzang 'jigs med/ er ti ni mergen nang so dge bskos/ slob dpon gu shri bde legs nyi ma sogs dge bshes mang po bcas 'dus tshogs nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi bka' 'bum dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum gyi lung / bla mchod kyi khrid sogs zhus pa ltar/ bla ma las snes gtsos 'dus tshogs yongs la smin rgyas su bstsal/ yang bla ma blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor dang zhe dgu ma gnyis kyi dbang zhus pas/ bla ma de nyid dang chos rje blo bzang 'jigs med/gu thi bde legs nyi ma/ rje nyid kyi mchod dpon drung yig pa dge slong tshul khrims bstan 'dzin bcas slob ma bzhi la 'gol po byas nas bka' drin du bstsal/ yang bla ma de nyid kyis gtsos pa'i 'dus tshogs yongs la rta mgrin 81

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshonaba' gsung 'byam/gsang sgrub kyi dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ dga' ldan phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rgyas pa/ sems bskyed cho ga cha lag tshang ma/ dad 'dus kyi ser skya stong phrag lhag la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / rigs gsum mgon po'i snying po'i bzlas lung bcas chos sbyin mi zad pa'i gter gyi sgo 'phar phyes te de thams cad dga' mgur rang ba'i dpal la bkod/ grwa tshang 'dus spyi nas bla ma mchod pa'i dus bzang zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang dgos tshul nan cher zhus pa ltar/ gdan sa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bla ma mchod pa'i dus bzang gi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin dang / rje btsun bla ma dam pa yongs 'dzin rin po ches mdzad pa'i bla mchod khrid yig rgyas pa'i nang ltar 'dzugs rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ nye gnas pa gsol dpon dge slong blo bzang nyi mas dbyangs rta 'dur gsum legs par khrid de bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i gsos su dmigs nas btsugs/ bkra shis gso spyong sogs kyang rgyun gyi phyag len ltar mdzad/ bsgrub bya lnga bcu lhag la rab byung / dge tshul/dge slong gi sdom pa bcas bstsal/ dgon pa de'i bshad sgrub kyi bya ba 'phel rgyas su dmigs te/ sgol ma maṇḍal bzhi chog yi dam chos srung rnams la gtor 'bul phrin bcol sogs gnad smin/ chos rgyal gyi drug cu pa/ lha mo'i gshegs gtor sogs bsngo bar mdzad cing / klu bum yang tshad ldan bsgrubs nas gnang / cha har khu be thu u lan gyi rtsis ram pa bla ma'i dgon pa'i mchog sprul bsnyun bzhes pa'i don du gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/khro bo sme brtsegs kyi bya ba khrus/ rnam 'joms kyi bya ba khrus bcas bstsal/yi dam chos srung la gtor 'bul phrin bcol gnang / bsgrub bya sum cu tsam la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ cha har hwa ya gri wa'i dgon pa'i bka' bcu ye shes rgyal mtshan la sku lnga'i rjes gnang dang lung kha shas/ cha har gu 82

༄/ /༅ khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/lus lan shog gi dpon po blo bzang dbang po la sgol dkar gyi rjes gnang /al than bu si'i dgon pa'i bla ma tho yon hu thog thul tshogs bdag dmar po dang dbyangs can ma dmar mo sogs kyi rjes gnang / gu lu khu kho'i jang gi dbang 'phel la seng gdong ma dang gdugs dkar gyi rjes gnang / 'chi med dzang gi la sgol dkar dang rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang / tsun tā dpon po mgon po la rnam 'joms kyi rjes gnang sogs rang rang gi 'dun pa ltar gnang / u lan dge bskos blo bzang gi rten la rab gnas bsdus pa dang klu gtor btang zhing sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang stsal/ su nyid slob dpon bla ma'i sgar thog tu phebs te dge mtshan spel ba'i cho ga gsungs par mdzad/de nas slar yang su nyid dus reng wang sku mched kyi thog tu phebs/ wang gi thugs 'dun ltar yi dam chos srung la gtor 'bul phrin bcol sogs gzab rgyas mdzad cing mjug tu g.yang 'bod byas/ tshe dpag grub rgyal ma'i rjes gnang bstsal/ hu thog thu bla ma skal bzang bsod nams kyis zhus te sgrol dkar dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / lam rim ba de lam bla mchod sogs kyi lung bstsal/ cha har a do chi shog gi rab 'byams pa nyi ma rdo rje la rjes gnang dang lung 'ga' zhig dang / tho go chi tsun ta la'ang 'dod chos ci rigs bstsal cing g.yang 'bod gnang / su nyid mkhan po bla mas ma cig grub rgyal lugs kyi rjes gnang zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/ su nyid su mi thu tā bla ma'i dgon par gdan drangs pa ltar phebs/ bla ma las sne sogs tshogs yongs nas dgon de'i 'du khang rten dang brten par bcas pa la rab gnas bka' drin skyong dgos tshul nan cher zhus pa ltar/ nyin gsum gyi ring la rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyi dgongs don bzhin spyan dbye'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa/ lha tshim par byed pa rgyas pa'i 83

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/sprun sreg dang / nyams chag skong ba zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bcas dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes cung zad kyang ma nyams par gnang ste yul phyogs mtha' dag dge mtshan gyis snang khyab par mdzad/ de nas dur bod tā wang phun tshogs bsam 'grub kyis sngar gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul yod pa'i rting gnon ched mngags kyi mi sna 'byor pas der chibs kha bsgyur/ dpon pos rta ma grin gtor zlog nan sgrub dgos tshul nan che ba ltar mdzad/ de nas ho shus dgon pa bde ldan gling gi 'du khang logs ris bcas gsar bzhengs la rab gnas dgos tshul zhus par snga ma bzhin dge legs char 'bebs kyi steng nas rgyas par mdzad de dam ye dbyer mi phyed pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bar mdzad/ rab gnas kyi bshad pa rgyab brten mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lung dang bcas pa don zab cing go bde ba mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog pa zhig gnang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub dang gdugs dkar gyi dbang sogs kyang 'dus tshogs yongs la bstsal/ mgon dkar gyi nor sgrub byed dgos tt+waṃX ṭwāṃ~X ༵༷ ༵ ༷'a /da ska~Xpas/ pa deb rshaX dīX ༷ga chi ṭwāṃsdiX tt+waṃ ༵dū rdo~X gsog pa'i zhing du dge 'dun gyi sde gdan drangs nas bka' 'gyur gsung du bcug cing smon lam yang 'tshogs 'dug par/ de'i dbur spyan drangs pa ltar byon te dge ldan lugs bzang rgyas pa'i thugs smon gang rgyas mdzad/bka' chos kyang mang du gnang / je'i ji tshe dpag skyabs kyi mos pa bzhin sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ u dzing thus lag chi dang / bu bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs kyi ngor sgol dkar tshe sgrub dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang yang bstsal/ dur bod sman ram pa ngag dbang 'od zer gyis gdan drangs thog kho rang gi grwa tshang gi smon lam tshogs dbur 84

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/gdan drangs te gsung chos smon lam sogs phyag len ltar gnang / bla ma de dang 'dus tshogs yongs la gdugs dkar gyi dbang sta gon dang bka' srung legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ lung sna tshogs bcas bstsal/ bsgrub bya drug cu skor la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa phogs ste tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs yongs su dzogs pa la bkod/ dur bed shog gi chos sde chen po bkra shis phan bde gling gi dgon par gdan drangs te/tshogs chen gyi seng khrir phebs nas phyag dbang dang lam gtso'i khrid rgyas par bstsal/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang gi tshogs dbur phebs/ bod kyi lha ram pa 'ig dang grwa pa gzhan zhig dang gnyi gas dam bca' bzhag nyid kyi zhabs phyi slob gnyer pa kha shas kyis bgro gleng byas te chos kyi 'bel gtam zab rgyas bstan pa'i la rgyar phan nges/ skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur ba byed du bcug nyid nas mtshan nyid grwa tshang la brtsi bzhag bstsal/bla ma las sne thun mong gis mtshan nyid grwa tshang la mtshan dgos tshul zhus pa bzhin/ thos bsam dar rgyas gling zhes 'dogs par mdzad/ / 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhus ngor dge 'dun lnga brgya skor la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang sta gon dang bcas pa dbang don de nyid yang gsal gyi dgongs pa ltar la zhal shes nyams myong gi man ngag du mas brgyan pa'i bshad pa sngags lam gyi gnad mtha' dag thon pa'i 'gran zla med pa dang / gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang sogs bstsal bas mkhas pa mtha' dag mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa brjod cing gsol 'debs la brtson par gyur/ tā bla ma blo bzang bsod nams/ mtshan nyid bla zur ngag dbang mchog ldan/rgyud pa bla zur tshul khrims yon tan sogs la 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs bstsal/ rgyud pa'i tshogs dbur phebs te nyin gcig gi ring 85

༄ / /gung thang bstan pa'itshoname'i gsung 'bumayi dam chos srung la gtor 'bul zin bcol gang drag mdzad/ 'du khang chen mo'i nang rten gyi mdun du sgol ma maṇḍal bzhi chog mchod spren rgya chen po dang bcas bsgrubs/ tshogs yongs la mang ja sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus shing grwa tshang so sor spyi 'jog gtos che ba bstsal/ er ti ni dar han mkhan po'i sprul pa'i sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan ngag dbang thub bstan nyi ma zhes 'dogs pa gnang / bla ma de'i zhabs brtan gsol 'debs shig dgos tshul 'dus spyi nas bskul ba ltar ljags rtsom mdzad/ phyogs 'dus kyi ser skya nyis stong brgal bar 'dod chos ci rigs bstsal te yid tshim par byas/ de nas dgon pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling du phebs/ 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhus ngor ser skya bdun brgya lhag la sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang /bla mchod/ smon lam sogs kyi lung gnang / bai thang tā tshe ring rdo rje la sman byādī hūṃs ga/bhe rdo ṭwāṃ~X /sras den dīs rshaX behūṃs tā rshaX gzhi dirgo~Xs ya/ ༵༈༵ tt+waṃrdo bstsal/ bla mchod dus bzang tshogs 'khor bcas phyag len ltar mdzad/de nas sngar gyi sbyin bdag su nyid du'u ring wang gi sku mched mkhan po bla ma'i dgon du phebs/ zla ba gcig gi ring la bcad rgya dam po gnang nas rdo rje'i rnal 'byor brtan pos yi dam gyi ljags bsnyen mdzad/ skabs shig tu bla mchod dus bzang gi ngag 'don gyi rim pa par du 'phung rgyu'i thugs 'dun yod thog nye gnas phyag mdzod che ching chos rab 'byams pa tshul khrims chos 'dzin/ gsol dpon mgron gnyer dar han rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis mthun rkyen sbyar te dpar du bsgrubs/dpar yig ba or du su chos rje ye shes dpal ldan dang / cha har gu lu u lan gye gu thi bde legs nyi ma gnyis kyis par byang smon tshig bskul ba bzhin 86

༄/ / khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ljags rtsom mdzad/ su nyid dus red wang nas/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i pho brang du tsi sha la bskyod skabs grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang zhus pa ltar bstsal/ mtsho sngon phyogs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag wang tshe ring don grub dang / yul tsu thu da'i ching wang ja sag rdo rje gnyis kyis ched mngags kyi mi sna btang ba 'byor te zhu yig rgyas pa/ rang yul du ma 'gyang bar 'byon dgos tshul nan tan ngag ma bcas zhus/ de nas yang yun ring po'i bar du bcad rgya gnang zhing / mtshams mtshams su bla mchod kyi dus bzang cha lag tshang ba phyag tu bstar/ dgung lo nga bdun pa lcags lug lo'i gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi nyin yi dam chos srung la gtor 'bul phrin bcol mdzad/su nyid wang dang mkhan po bla ma/ tā bla ma sogs sku mched thun mong nas lha rdzas/ maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs phul nas zhabs brtan rgyas par phul/ mkhan po bla mas sger du bla mchod dus bzang dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan gang legs phul/ tā bla ma'i 'dod mos bzhin bla mchod dus bzang dang sman bla'i cho ga gsungs/ lo gsar skabs phyogs so so nas 'dus pa'i dad ldan ser skya mang por phyag dbang dang bka' chos kyi skor rnams 'dod mos bzhin bstsal/ skabs shig rje nyid sku bsnyun cung zad bzhes par/ wang sku mched nas dge 'dun gyi sder bka' 'gyur/gdugs sher sgrol ma sogs gsung du bcug cing zhabs brtan yang phul/phyagaganyer sogs kyis zhabs brtan rgya cher bsgrubs shing / dur bed sman pablo bzang tshul khrims kyis phyag rtsa zhus sman phul bas sku bsnyun legs par dwangs/ tho yon dge slong chos dar gyi 'dod mos ltar g.yang 'bod dang /rten la rab gnas mdzad cing sgol dkar gyi rjes gnang bstsal/ a ro hor chinagu thi dge slong dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis 'dul ba'i skor nas dri ba 87

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/'ga' zhus par/ dris lan dogs pa chod nges su bstsal/ mdo smad khri ga'i phyogs nas rje rang gi gdan sa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling dang / mi nyag grwa tshang bkra shis chos gling gnyis nas ched mngags kyi mi sna rab 'byams pa ngag dbang nyi ma/ gnyer shes rab nyi ma ngo g.yog bcas skeb par 'byor phyag bstsal/ rang yul du gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba nan tan gyis phul/ ti yan chi bla ma'i dgon par phebs/ bla ma las sne sogs 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhus pa ltar bkra shis gso sbyong mdzad cing / sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi chogabla mchod dus bzang sogs phyag len bzhin gsungs/ sman bla'i rjes gnang / skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ lung mang po bcas bstsal/ dur bod thu sa lakyi bkra shis rnam rgyal dus chos su gyur pas/ de'i sras thi'i ji blo bzang donagrub kyi 'dod mos bzhin phebs/ ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga lho sgo dang bcas pa bsngo smon sogs gnang ste mtho ris kyi lam du drangs/ sras blo bzang don grub la grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang bstsal/ de nas dur bed ho sho'i dgon par phebs/ yul phyogs la bkra mi shis pa'i mtshan mas than pa ches cher byung ste skye 'gro nyam thag par brten/ dur nged wang nas char 'bebs zhus par/ yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed bka' sdod bcas la gtor 'bul phrin bcol gang rgyas zhus shing / gzhi bdag sogs la dkar gtor sogs bsngo bar mdzad de nyin lnga'i ring la dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs sgrub pas dgon pa de'i thad ga'i nam mkha' glo bur du char sprin dkar skya zhig byung ste rim gyis je cher song zhing phyogs kun tu khyab nas char gyi rgyun nyin mtshan khor yug tu babs te srog chags thams cad kyi dbugs gsos par gyur pas/phyogs de'i ser skya mtha' dag shin tu ngo mtshar zhing mgrin gcig tu gsol 'debs la brtson pa byung / de nas su nyid mkhan po bla ma'i dgon par 88

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/phebs/ bla mas mos pa ltar bka' chos kyi rim pa mang du bstsal/ yi dam chos skyong la gtor 'bul phrin bcol mdzad/ tā bla ma'i sgar du phebs nas mgon po'i gtor sgrub dang rnam sras kyi gter bum sgrub gnang mdzad/dus reng wang gi ur ger phebs/ wang gi a che la dge bsnyen ma'i sdom pa dang / wang gi sras chung ba'i gtsug phud bzhes te ming bstan pa dar rgyas zhes btags/ dpon po'i mos 'dun bzhin rnam sras bum sgrub dang g.yang 'bod gnang / wang sku mched nas zhus pa ltar sa bcud dang klu bum sogs phyag len bzhin bsgrubs te 'ga' zhig gnas gtsang sar gter du sbas/pe har khog zhugs kyi chos skyong zhig gis rje 'di ba'i gsang rnam lung ston rgyu mang po yod zer bas zhabs gras rnams kyis lkog tu zhus par ya mtshan che ba mang po gsungs/ cha har khu be thu o lan gyi dgon pa bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling gi chos rje blo bzang lhun grub kyis gcod khrid zhus pa rgyas par bstsal/mgon po'i gtor chog bsdus pa zhig kyang ljags rtsom zhus/ mdo sngags kyi dri ba mang du zhus par dogs pa'i mtha' sel nges bstsal te tshim par byas/cha har gu lu u lan gyi sprul pa'i sku tshul khrims nyi mas zhus ngor 'jam dbyangs la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas ta ri ༷nghru / ṭwāṃ ༷ /༷ desdi ṭwāṃdīrdo nghru ༵ra dī ṭwāṃ ༵ṭwāṃ rshaXṭwāṃ ༷ṭwāṃ dhi ༵ snro dī ṭwāṃ dhi ༵rsha~X dang / su nyid g.yon ru sogs kyi dad ldan ser skya bzhi stong lhag la phyag dbang / bzlas lung sogs yid tshim par bstsal/ paṇḍi ta bla ma'i sgar thog tu 'byor nas hal ha ju nang bai zi'i nu bo tho yon blo bzang rang grol gyis sku lnga dang lcam sring sogs kyi rjes gnang zhus pa bstsal/ gzhan brgyad stong sogs lung mang po gnang / de'i shog gi yul jus jo rig thu bla ma blo bzang 89

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgonama'i gsung 'tsho/rin chen la sgol ljang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ mi 'khrugs pa sogs kyi rjes gnang paṇḍi ta bla ma nyid nas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/tshe dpag mi 'khrugs pa bcas kyi dbang zhus pa rnams ser skya stong lhag la gnang / bsgrub bya dge tshul slong brgyad cu lhag la so thar gyi sdom pa bstsal nas thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ rje nyid kyis dbu mdzad/ paṇḍi ta bla ma bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan dge bshes chos rje bstan 'dzin bzang po sogs nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga bdag 'jug bcas gsungs bar mdzad/ yang sku bsnyun bzhes tshul mdzad pas zhabs brtan gang mang bsgrubs te/ dur bed esmi blo bzang tshul khrims kyis bzhes sman phul bas sku khams phral du drangs/ hal ha rje btsun dam pa dang / a kyā rin po che rnam gnyis la mtshams zhur mgron gnyer rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin mngags pa'i gdong so sor zhu yig rgyas pa phul/ mgron gnyer song ste rje btsun dam pa rin po cher phyag dbang zhus nas zhu yig phul bas sku'i 'tshams 'dri dang gar bzhugs sogs bka' 'dri zhib tu gnang / a kyā no min han rin po cher yang zhu yig dang rgyu mtshan gyi mol mchid rgyun ring zhus/mgron gnyer phyir ldog kha rje btsun dam pa rin po cher thon phyag zhus par/zhal nas drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mi nyag rin po che'i drung du bka' chos kyi skor mang po nyan rgyu yod kyang da lta brel g.yeng che zhing / sa thag ring ba'i stabs kyis mi thub pa 'dra/ phyis su zhal mjal te dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsir longs spyod pa dang zhabs pad brtan pa'i phyir yin gsungs te/ lha rdzas/maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gos chen yug sogs dang phyag ris rgyas pa bstsal nas khyod kyi de dag legs par zhus gsungs/ a kyā no min han rin po ches kyang / ston mjug 'dir mtsho bdun du bskyod rtsis yin pas lam 90
