༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/zhor du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi zhal dngos su mjal nas chos bka' zhu rgyu mang po yod/ khyod kyis ngas phul ba'i zhu yig dang rgyu mtshan rnams zhu dgos gsungs/ mgron gnyer phyir 'byor 'phral sku mdun du mjal te rgyu mtshan zhib rgyas zhus shing zhu yig rnams spyan lam du bstar/ ta ri gago'i pā thur ga li tā sgrol ma skyabs la grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang / 'pho khrid sogs dang / dge slong dharma la mgon po'i rjes gnang bcas bstsal/ tā bla ma ngag dbang yon tan gyi 'dod pa ltar g.yang 'bod gnang / de nas pā shing thu'i dgon par phebs/'dus tshogs yongs nas sman chog dang smon lam sogs kyi lung zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskangs/ hor tu ti yan chi bla ma'i sprul sku blo bzang mkhas mchog grags pa la bka' chos 'ga' zhig bstsal/ on po tā bla ma chos rje thub bstan ngag dbang gis gdan drangs pa'i 'dod mos bzhin rten la rab gnas bsdus pa mdzad/ 'jigs byed kyi ljags bsnyen sngon du 'gro bas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad/ sgol ma'i rjes gnang yang bstsal/ po dar gha na'i dgon par phebs/ 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhus pa ltar spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang sogs chos bka' mang du bstsal/ de nas paṇḍi ta bla ma'i sgar thog tu/ nyid kyis dbu mdzad/ paṇḍi ta bla ma/ sprul sku blo bzang mkhas mchog khri pa mgon po shes rab sogs grwa pa mang pos bla mchod dus bzang phyag len bzhin gsungs/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa zhu mkhan ṭwāṃsdedī tt+waṃ ṭwāṃX dī tt+waṃ dīsla rdong pa ༵ ༵ ṭwāṃ ༷༷rje dīX bhe/na lame rshadī hubardo/ sdiljo ṭwāṃX dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / 'dus tshogs spyi la sman bla ring thung gi lung bstsal/ gzhan don gnyer can mang por lam rim chen mo'i lung / byang 91

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'astem/chub bde lam gyi lung sogs gnang / slar yang mergon paṇḍi ta bla ma'i sgar thog tu phebs nas bzhugs skabs hal ha nas a kyu rin po che mtsho bdun du chibs bsgyur ba'i lam zhor du rje 'di mjal phyir phebs/ a kyā rin po ches snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang zhus pa dgyes bzhin bstsal/ nyid la a kyā rin po ches bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan zhu 'bul zab cing brling pa zhus te lha rdzas/ maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs sogs 'dog pa'i mchod sprin spros/ rnam pa gnyis nyin kha shas kyi ring lhan du bzhugs te zab rgyas chos kyi bgro ba byams 'jam dbyangs zhal 'dzoms pa lta bu gnang / dad ldan gyi seraskya bzhi stong brgal bar rnam pa gnyi gas res mos kyis phyag dbang dang chos bka' bstsal te kun gyi yid tshim par mdzad/ de nas rnam pa gnyis lhan du nyin kha shas la phebs skabs zhag sa thams cad du mtshan mo'i ring la a kyu rin po che'i thugs bzhed bzhin bka' chos dkon po'i rigs kyi lung khrid/ rjes gnang man ngag zhal shes rnams bstsal te thugs kyi bum bzang gang bar mdzad/ khong gi gsol dpon hor tsha pi lig thu 'jam dbyangs nyi mas bskul ngor drag po sum dril gyi sgrub thabs ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas lam gyes nas so sor phebs kha thugs nye bas 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i ngang nasaskyabs 'jug zhus te so sor phebs/ rje nyid slar yang su nyid wang sku mchedakyi sgar thog tu phebs/ mkhan po bla ma'i dgon par rje tsong kha pa'i dus mchod kyi nyin mchod sprin bla med spros te ltung bshags phyag dang 'brel ba/yan lag bdun pa/ thun drug rnal 'byor/ bstan 'bar ma sogs gsung ste rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/wang gi sras mo la dge bsnyen ma'i sdom pa bstsal ming lha btsun nyi ma zhes btags/ de nas su nyid wang sku mched so sos sgar thog tu gdan drangs 92

༄/ /༅ khrimalobastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/pas so so la 'dod chos lhug par bstsal/ wang gi dpon mo u du mā ris bskul nas rjes 'dzin smon tshig dang / mkhan po bla ma/ dus reng wang /tā bla ma/ thu sa lakyi pa thu sogs sku mched nas bskul ba ltar/ dgra lha chen po mched dgu'i gsol mchod rgyas pa zhig ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nas dgun zla 'bring po'i yar tshes dge ba'i nyin so nyid g.yas ru nas sku 'bum chos sde chen por chibs kyi kha lo mngon par bsgyur/ lam zhor du dad 'dus kyi ser skya bdun stong brgya phrag gnyis lhag dang / or du su tsūn gar tā bai zi'i sras dang sras mo sogs kyang mjal bar phyag dbang 'dod chos sogs kyes tshim par mdzad do/ / de ltar byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul du byon te gdul bya so so'i khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin gzigs te/ la la ni so thar gye bslab pa'i gzhi ci rigs la bkod de thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ la la ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid dang sems bskyed cho ga sogs kyi sgo nas theg chen thun mong ba'i lam du bcug la la ni dbang bskur rnam par dag pas gsang sngags kyi sgor bcug ste sku bzhi'i sa bon smin par mdzad/ gzhan yang so so'i mos pa bzhin du gtan pa med pa'i chos kyi mchod sbyin rgya chen pos re 'bras rdzogs par mdzad cing mthong thos dran reg thams cad don ldan du 'gyur ba'i rgyal sras kyi thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas dad ldan gye skye bo 'bum phrag du ma zhig mngon mtho nges legs kyi dpal la sbyor/ dam pa nang phan tshun chos kyi bgro bas bstan pa'i byi dor mdzad/ gnas chen la mjal skor dang thugs dam bsag sbyang tshad las 'das pa gnang / de thams cad phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che rgyas pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu bsngos te/ bstan 'gro yongs la dge legs kyi go skabs yangs por 'byed pa'i 'phrin las nyin 93

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithoname'i gsung 'bum/byed snang bas shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du khyab par gyur to/ / dge ṭwāṃṭwāṃ snro~X ṭwāṃshlau ṭwāṃ ༷ rte tram̐bye ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ niṭwāṃ niX ༷ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༷ ṭwāṃrdo hūṃ hūṃbye nga~X/hūṃrje/ ṭwāṃb/ / /'a/tt+waṃ spya ༵/ṭwāṃ dzhai byedī ṭwāṃX hūṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༷rdo ljags dirdo di snaX tt+waṃrsha /ṭwāṃ chu 'dzin lhan cig gtibs/ / mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i bde skyid rgya mtsho dang / / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chu gter lhan cig 'phyur/ / mkhas pa'i tshogs la bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/ / gnas chen rnams su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ / mchog gsum rten la mchod pa'i bya ba ste/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi rol gar gcig car bsgyur/ / zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal las byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul du bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul gyi dra ba ste bzhi pa'o/ / dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa mnir zhes pa chu sbrel lo'i dpyid zla dang por rgyal ba'i gdan sa chen po sku 'bum chos sde'i rgyud sman dpon slob dang /tshogs chen zhal ngo spyi gnyer sogs las sne'i rigs dang chen po'i yo byad rnams sgrengs te dge 'dun sum stong lhag gi ser sbrengs dang bcas phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rang sgar du ser khrir gdan drangs te chos ston rgyas parabs so/ / de nas sku 'bum tshogs chen du dge 'dun sum stong brgyad brgya lhag la zho lnga re'i sku 'gyed dang mang ja rnams bzhag gser sdong chen mo'i lha khang gsar bzhengs su dmigs te dngul rta rmig ma zung bcas phul/bshad sgrub gling dang / rgyud sman grwa tshang so sor/ sku 'gyed zho gang phun re 94

༄༅/ /tshul khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bcas phul/ mchod rten mthong ba don ldan gyi mdun du stong mchod dang /gzhan lha khang so sor mchod sgon gang rgyas bstar/ de nas chu bzang sprul pa'i sku rin po cher mjal bar phyag btegs te lha rdzas maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ mdzod gos yug dngul rta rmig ma sogs phyag rten du phul/chu bzang dgon par mang 'gyed btang dgon lung du byon te mang ja sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang / tho'u bkwan sprul pa'i sku rin po cher lha rdzas/ dngul maṇa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ mdzod gos sprin ris ma yug dngul rdo tshad sogs phyag rten du phul/ tho'u bkwan rin po che'i sku gdung mchod rten gyi drung du mchod sgron gang rgyas phul te skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas/ thun drug rnal 'byor khrus gsol sogs byas shing / smon lam bstan 'bar ma bcas gsungs te gsol ba shugs drag tu btab nas bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar/ de nas khri ka gser mo ljongs su phebs/mchod rten bla brang rang du bzhugs nas bcad rgya gnang / sku mtshams grol nas mchod rten mi nyag grwa tshang dang dga' ldan dar rgyas gling gi bzhi pa'i smon lam la res mos kyis phebs/ grwa tshang 'di gnyis la mang 'gyed gang rgyas dang spyi 'jog dngul rdo tshad re gnang / gsol dpon nyi ma'i a khu gshegs sar phebs nas bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor gnang / khri ga'i phyogs kyi sgrub sde rnams la bsnyen bkur gya nom pa mdzad/ de nas dbyar thog mtsho sngon du phebs/ smad nas cung zad 'gyang par yul lha 'phrang ba'i rnam pa zhig byung stabs/ nyid kyi 'khrungs sa yul chus o bo zhes 'bod pa'i lab rtse bstod de gzhi bdag la bsang mchod sogs gang rgyas gnang bas char chen po zhig bab bhe~X nghru dī didī ༵dīdidīsdi sdi nghrudī /soga~X dī nghru ༵nga doṭwāṃ dhridī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃṭwāṃzlo ༵rdoX /95

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gas 'bum/phebs/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i mchod gtor gang rgyas mdzad/ ul cus byā hūṃX ༷༷ ja lta ༵ ༵sne dī~X trī// lam ༷ /༵ dīX ṭwāṃrdo ༵༵ dhi~X ༷sdi bye bzhugs nas gsung chos smon lam gye dbur phebs te bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ 'dus tshogs la dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid dang lung diṭwāṃdi ṭwāṃ~X ༷༷ sab ༵ ༵/sa baniX rdongabee gadhiX dīṭwāṃ~X | tram̐ 'dīsde ༵ tram̐ dhri~X//slar sku 'bum du phebs/ or du su tho ngo thu sa laglis zhus ngor/ bstan pa'igasal byed che shos sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma/bya btang sgom pa ngag dbang smon lam sogs dge 'dun lnga brgya skor la rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang rta gon dang bcas pa/ lha mo dang seng gdong ma sogs kyi rjes gnang bcas bstsal/ de nas khri ga gser mo ljongs su byon/yul phyogs de'i rten byin rlabs can mchod rten dkar por grags pa zhig ral du song yod pas/ rje nyid kyis phyag mdzod chos rje la zhig gsos gsar bzhengs lta bu zhig byed dgos zhes bka' phebs pa ltar grub nas rtser dngul srang nyis brgya dang lnga bcu las grub pa'i gser zangs kyi nyi zla mchod rten de la ran pa gzi 'od 'phro zhing thig tshad dang ldan pa phul/ nang du gzungs dang rten sna du ma sogs gzung gzhug rgyas par bzhag nas/ nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur bzhengs te sgrub grogs dang bcas pas rab gnas rgyas pa mdzad/ de nas phyag mdzod che ching chos rje/ mgron gnyer rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ so kyā rab 'byams pa dge legs rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad blo bzang don grub/ drung yig gsol dpon sogs nas/ rje nyid kyi sku gong ma sngags chen 'phrin las 'bum gyi sgrub khang gsang 96

༄/ /༅ khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/sngags bde chen chos 'phel gling gi gzim chung ha cang rnying par brten mthun rkyen so so'i 'byor pa dang bstun par sgrub rgyur khas blangs nas/ desmi gnyer ba dge slong shes rab nyi mas las dpon byas te/ sa las dang tshon rtsi sogasagang legs dka' tshegs med par bzhengs grub nas las dpon gyis rje nyid gdan drangs te lha rdzas maṇḍal sku gsung thugs rten sogs rten 'brel gyi zhabs brtan phul zhing chos ston rgyas par zhus/ de nas sku 'bum du phebs/ yun ring po'i bar du thugs dam bcad rgya dam pos rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ljags bsnyen mdzad cing bdag 'jug kyang mang du bzhes/bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs shing bdag 'jug bzhes/smad phyogs kyi bla dpon du mas gtsos ser skya mang po la kun rig tshe dpagathugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang sta gon bcas bstsal/ bla brang nyid du seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog kyang sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas zla ba kha shas kyi ring la 'jigs byed kyi ljags bsnyen la gcig tu 'grus par mdzad/yang khri ga'i phyogs su phebs/ mchod rten bla brang du bcad rgya'i ngang du bzhugs/ khri ga'i yul gyi rten gtso kron gru'i lha khang sa skya paṇa chen gyis bzhengs par grags pa de'i nang rten du sman 'dam lam grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku shin tu che ba zhig bzhugs pa la/ gser zangs las grub pa'i dbu rgyan spus gtsang rin thang can zhig 'bul dgongs te 'phrod lam yod med yul lha'i drung du mtshan dang mo btab par gang legs chud cing / chos srung 'ga' zhig la lung bstan zhus pa'ang yul lha'i lung dang mthun par babs pas/ 'jam mgon bla mas jo bor dbu rgyan phul ba'i rnam thar bzhin/gza' skar phun sum tshogs par thub dbang rin po cher dbu rgyan phul te mchod sgron gang rgyas spel/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol sogs dang / thub 97

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronamatha gsung 'bum/bstan yang snying dge ldan ring lugs phyogs mthar rgyas shing / skye 'gro yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba'i thugs smon gang drag mdzad pas/ yul phyogs su bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma mngon sum du byung / de nas dbus gtsangal phebs rgyu'i thugs bzhed snga mo nas yod thog lha bla ma sogs la lung zhus phul bar chos kyi mdzad 'phrin nyid kyi thugs 'dun ltar 'grub tshul dang / chos skyong rnams kyis grogs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pas phebs rgyur thugs thag bcad de/ phyag mdzod la ma 'gyang bar dbus gtsang la 'gro rgyu yin/ der ma zad song nas chos nyan dang gnas mjal sogs bya ba mang po yod pas lo kha shas kyi ring la 'dug dgos zhes gsung phebs par/phyag mdzod che ching chos rje rab 'byams pa tshul khrims chos 'dzin rang gi bsam par yang mdo smad dang sog yul gye dad ldan sbyin bdag rnams kyi phul ba'i phyag rdzas kyi skor 'di chud ma zos par chos phyogs gtong rgyu zhig byung na snyam pa'i 'phen pa yod pa'i thog tu babs nas dga' dad spro gsum gyis spyir dbus la phebs rgyu bka' drin che/ phebs chas sogs myur du gra 'grig pa byed/ 'on kyang der yun ring bzhugs rgyu'i thugs dgongs gnang mi nyan/dgung lo nyung ba'i skabs yin na thugs gnyer gyi ched la bzhugs dgos mod/da lta nyid dgung lo mtho bas yun ring bzhugs na sa chu sogs mi 'phrod pas mjal skor gtong sgo sogs grub phral rang yul la phebs dgos zhes nan cher zhus/ de nas phyag mdzod chos rjes rje nyid kyi gsung dad blang gis/ jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten la mchod 'bul dang / rgyal ba yab sras kyi 'bul ba/ ser 'bras dga' gsum bkras lhun te gdan sa chen po bzhis mtshon chos sde che phra thams cad la mang 'gyed gang rgyas 'dang nges gra sgrig gang legs byas te/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa dpal gdong zhes pa chu bya'i lo'i 98

༄༅/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ston ga'i dus gza' skar phun tshogs kyi nyin/ gdan sa chen po sku 'bum nas dbus rtsang dag pa'i zhing du chibs kyi kha lo sgyur bar mdzad/ lam zhor du bstan pa'i sbyin bdag wang tshe ring don grub/ bee li 'jam dpal/ bai zi ratna sidhi/ ja sa ga da'i ching rdo rje/ tshwa 'dam ja sag eng khibī yar// ༷༷ lja diX ༷rnyin so ༵rdod u chogī dī sna nghrudīsare/ ba dīrsha pa~X kudī ༷ ༵༷ rim par brgyud nye zho med par byon te dgun zla dang bo'i nang / thog mar 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdan sa byang rwa sgreng rgyal ba'i dpen gnas su phebs/ jo bo dbu yon ma sogs rten la mchod sgon gang rgyas phul te/ ltung bshags phyag dang sprags pa/ skyabs sems/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor/ bstan 'bar ma sogs gsungs te bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sder mang ja dang 'gyed skar lnga re phul/ de nas lha sar phebs/ jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs la mchod mjal gnang ste/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi khyam rwa'i thog tu rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang bstan pa'i 'byung gnas ngag dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho dpal bzang por/ lha rdzas nang mdzod/ rgya dngul srang bcu las grub pa'i maṇḍal dar tshon gyi sne 'dogs can/ sku rten thub dbang gi sku tshag grub/ gsung rten tshe mdo gser bris/ thugs rten rnam rgyal mchod rten/ byur dmar gyi phyag 'phreng gser gyi bcu shad can/ dril gdan/ cod pan bcas thog ma'i phyag rten du phul nas phyag dbang zhus par/ rgyal dbang rin po ches thugs brtse gzigs chen pos lam skabs kyi bka' 'dri sogs mang du phebs/rgyal tshab de mo no min han rin po cher/ lha rdzas nang mdzod/ srang lnga las grub pa'i maṇḍal dar gyis spras pa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dril gdan/99

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/cod paṇa bcas phul nas mjal phrad mdzad/ bstan pa'i srog shing dga' ldan khri rin po cher/ lha rdzas nang mdzod/ dngul gyi maṇḍal/ dril gdan/cod pan sogs phyag rten du phul nas mjal/ khri rin po ches khyed da lam dbus gtsang 'dir phebs pa bka' drin che/ nyid kyi sku tshe gong ma de nyid kyi chos srid zung gi mdzad spyod phun sum tshogs pa gang yod bod yul 'dir khyad par du 'phags pa zhig byung ba'i gnas tshul mtha' yas pa gsungs/ de nas 'jam mgon bla ma'i dus mchod chen mo'i nyin jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos rten thams cad la zhal zas/ mchod me/ me tog spos ring sogs stong tshar re bcas stong mchod rgyas par phul te spyan 'dren khrus gsol/rnam dag gangs ri ma/ smon lam bstan 'bar ma bcas gsung ste thub bstan rin po che'i yang snying blo bzang 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs rnam par dag pa phyogs mtha' dag tu rgyas pa'i thugs smon shugs drag po mdzad/po ta lar phebs te rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par lha rdzas nang mdzod/dngul srang nyi shu'i maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gos tshon bsgrigs pa'i rten khebs che ba spus gtsang / mdzod gos dmar po sprin ris ma yug rgya dngul rta mig ma/ o tu su'i me yol/ chibs chen rta dang / dre'u/shing thog a mra sgam gang / shel dkar rta so ma sgam gang sogs kyi dngos 'bul btegs nas phyag dbang zhus par/ rgyal ba'i zhal nas/ sngon 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po mdo smad nas gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir phebs te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa bzhin da res kyang mdo smad kyi rje bla ma'i gdan sa chen po rje'i sku 'bum gyi mkhan zur mi nyag hu thog thu nyid yul gyis bskal yang sngon gyi thugs skyed smon lam bzang po'i mthus bde bar 'di phyogs su byon nas/ rang cag lhan cig tu 'dzoms pa skal ba 1ཿ

༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bzang zhes sogs kyi bka' mang du phebs te thugs brtse bas gzigs pa che bzhes gnang / yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri rin po che po ta lar bzhugs pa la lha rdzas nang mdzod dngul maṇa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gos mtshal kha yug gos kyi zhabs chag bka' min sgam gang bcas phul/ de nas bstan rgyas gling du rgyal tshab de mo no mon han rin po cher lha rdzas nang mdzod/dngul mkha/ sku gsung thugs rten/ mdzod dgos smyug mdog yug rgya dngul rta rmig ma/ o tu su'i me yol bcas sger 'bul btegs/ rtse mgron dpal mgon la lha rdzas bar mdzod/ bu la gha ras bcas gnang /rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang rin po cher lha rdzas nang mdzod/ dngul maṇa/dril gdan cod pan sogs phul nas mjal/ rje 'di pa 'jig rten gyi 'ar 'ur zang zing dang tshe 'di'i grags 'dod sogs ye mi mnga' ba'i stabs ngo g.yog nyung shas dang bcas nas nyam chung gnas mjal ba'i tshul byas te u lā sogs ma zhus par lha sar 'byor nas mjal kha zhus rjes gzhungs nas mkhyen te che drag mang pos khyed 'dra ba'i bla chen nyam chung ba gnas mjal ba'i tshul du phebs pa mdzes po ma red ces zhus shing / phyag gnyer sogs la khyed rang tshosagazhungs la zhus na srol bzhin u lā sogs gnang chog sngar ci la ma zhus pa yin zer nas bkyon par/ phyag gnyis sogs nas rje 'di pa 'jig rten gyi spros pa thugs la ma bzhed pa'i stabs sngon la rgyu mtshan ma zhus pa'i gnas tshul bshad/ gzhungs rang nas gzigs pa che bzhes kyis phog sogs rgya gang che bka' drin bstsalu bar de 'dra gnang mi nyan zhes zhus kyang nan tan gyis gtad de bzhes dgos pa byung / chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras srungs su phebs/ rten kun la mchod sgron gang rgyas phul te mchod mjal zhus shing bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ tshogs chen du dge 'dun 101

༄/ /yo thang b.lo pa'i ma'i khrung 4ma/drug stong nye ba la mang ja kha shas/ sku 'gyed dngul skar lnga re phul/ dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang la grwa ja dang sku 'gyed dngul ṭaṃ re bcas pas bsnyen bkur zhus/ so sor spyi 'jog kyang gzab rgyas gnang / sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'jigs byed kye mdun du brgya mchod dang / sngar rgyun zhal 'don gyi rim pa/ 'jigs byed smon lam/ bstan 'bar ma bcas gsung nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol 'debs thugs smon sogs gdung ba shugs drag gis mdzad/ de nas po ta lar phebs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa la lha ldan smon lam gyi tshigs dbur gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ gtsang du phebs rgyu'i gnas tshul zhus par rgyal dbang rin po ches gzigs pa che bzhes kyis bka' khyab bstsal/ rgyal tshab rin po cher yang lha ldan smon lam gyi mang 'gyed 'bul rgyu'i gnas tshul dang tshogs dbur gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul/ de nas gzhung gi mi sna dang phyag gnyer gyis gtsos zhabs zhu ba nang ma rnams nas lha sa smon lam gyi ja thug gi thebs dang / sku 'gyed rgyu'i rgya dngul rnams bstan gling ja sag la sprad nas bod dngul la brjes/ de nas gtsang bkra shis lhun por phyag btegs/ phebs lam du snye thang / rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde sogs la mchod mjal zhib rgyas dang mang 'gyed sogs kyang phul/ bkra shis lhun por 'byor nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par lha rdzas nang mdzod/ dngul srang bco lnga las grub pa'i maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ gos chen ser po yug dril gdan/ cod pan/ ri bo dwangs bsil gye rtsad pa'i 'phreng ba/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma/ chibs chen sogs phul nas mjal kha zhus par thugs brtse bas nye bar gzigs te bka' mchid mtha' yas pa bstsal/ phyag mdzod chen mor/ lha rdzas bar mdzod/mdzod gos yug zhabs lham spus gtsang bcas phul/ paṇa chen gong ma 102

༄/ /༅ khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnayopar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/gsum ga'i sku gdung mchod rten rnams la mchod sgon gang rgyas phul te/zhal 'don gye rim pa cha tshang bar mdzad/ de nas 'du khang chen mo'i stong gi nang rten thams cad la rten mjal zhus shing mchod sprin gang rgyas nas thugs smon sogs sngar ltar gnang nas phebs pa dang dus mtshungs su tshogs dung bus pas rten 'brel legs po byung gsungs/ de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa gso sbyong gi mgon du phebs pa'i zhabs phyir byon te las dang gdams ngag nyams su myong bar mdzad/ de nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshogs dbur spyan 'dren gyi snyan gsan phul bar dgyes gzigs kyis nyi skar sogs kyang gong nas bkod khyab bstsal/ gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin der tshogs chen gye dge 'dun sum stong brgyad brgya lhag la mang ja kha shas/ sku 'gyed dngul skar phyed brgyad re dang spyi 'jog bcas kyi bsnyen bkur zhus thog paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshogs dbur spyan drangs te/ nyid nas dngul srang nyi shu las grub pa'i maṇḍal dar tshon gyi sne 'dogs can/ nang mdzod ser po srid du 'dom do lhag pa phyag tu bsnams te/ shis brjod kyi sngun bsus nas skyes rabs kyi phreng ba'i rtogs brjod/lhag par paṇa chen gong ma thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes dpal bzang po/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab tu chibs kha bsgyur ba'i lam zhor du 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'khrungs gnas chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi chos khrir zla ba kha shas kyi ring la bzhugs te dge 'dun gyi sde la 'chad nyan mdzad/ phyogs mtha' dag nas yong ba'i bla dpon ser skya bgrang las 'das pa la chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba'i tshul rnams zhib rgyas dang / sku tshe 'di'i yang sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams rgyas par zhus pa'i thog zhabs brtan gyi rten 'byung du/ chos dung dkar 103

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga4 4ma/podar tshon gyis brgyan pa/ sku'i rten rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku brnyan/gsung rten tshe mdo gser bris/ thugs rten gser zangs kyi byang chub mchod rten/ dngul srang bcu las grub pa'i tshe bum phra ldan kha rgyan bcas/dngul gyi 'khor lo dpangs kha gang ba/ dung dkar dngul gshog ma cha/bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ dngul srang nyer gcig las grub pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun pad 'dab can/ sku'i nyer spyad mi 'dra ba bcu gsum/ rdor dril sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs/ gos tshag grub ma'i dril gdan cod pan zeg chen glang po'i mche ba/ nor bu bse ru'i rwa/ byur 'phreng che ba mu tig gi bcu shad sum ldan can/ mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ ri bo dwangs bsil gyi 'phreng ser nyi shu/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma bcu/ mdzod gos sna tshogs spus gtsang yug chen bcu gsum/ rgya zam bcu/ sa gdan mthing kha me tog gi ri mo can gcig gos ljang gu'i sa gdan me tog ma gcig khe bi su'i sga khebs dmar khra dang / gdan rdo rje rgya gram gyi ri mo can/ ja bag dang shing thog sgam kha shas/ snam dkar yug bcas rnam grangs drug brgya dang lnga bcu lhag phul te/ dgos don gyi gtso bo rgyal bstan rin po che'i yang snying rje tsong kha ba'i bstan pa rgyas shing 'gro ba yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / de'i rtsa ba rgyal ba yab sras nas bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas pa'i thugs skyed dang 'phrin las rgya gang che mdzad rgyu la rag las tshul mdo rgyud kyi lung khungs su drangs nas zhus shing / zhar byung nyid 'brel thogs dang bcas pa'i 'phral yun gyi skyabs 'jug zhus par/ paṇa chen mchog thugs shin tu dgyes te 'du khang gi rab gsal du paṇa chen gong ma'i sku bzhugs pa la yang yang gzigs te/ sde 'di par khyed kyis paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi rnam thar sku gsung thugs kyi bstod tshogs gzhan las khyad 'phags brjod byung 104

༄/ /4 khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/zhes sogs kyi bka' lung rgya cher bstsal/ der tshogs mkhas pa rnams kyang rje 'di'i sku yon mthong ste de las brtsams pa'i bsngags brjod phyogs kun tu sgogs pa byung / paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang shalha la'i smon lam gyi lung gsan/ snar thang du phebs/ sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma/ 'brom gyi shel gyi mkhar ba/ gnas bcu'i zhabs chag sogs rten la mchod mjal zhib rgyas/ tshogs la mang 'gyed kyi dod rgya dngul srang nyi shu lhag phul/ mchod dod rgya dngul srang bdun phul/ bkras lhun du phebs/ rje'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs/ rgyal tshab mkhas grub rnamaganyis kyi gsung 'bum/ paṇa chen rin po cher sku tshe na rim gyi gsung 'bum/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i rnam mgur sogs phyag dpe pu ti brgya lhag tsam gdan drangs/ de nas sku 'bum chos sde chen po'i chos srid rgyas pa'i don la dmigs paṇa chen rin po cher lung bstan zhus par bka' lan du/'dus tshogs spyi la bslab bya dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rgyas shing bshad sgrub 'phel ched du zhabs brtan gang rgyas bstsal/ rje 'di pas phyis su'ang gong sa nas thugs brtse bas nye bar gzigs te gang ci'i bka'i bslab bya lhug par bstsal rgyu'i zhu ba phul bar thugs dgyes pa'i zhal bzhes gnang / paṇa chen rin po cher thon phyag zhus par tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku brnyan bkra shis li ma/spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing bkod/ ston pa'i bres thang / paṇa chen sku snga phyi rnams kyi gsung 'bum cha tshang / paṇa zhwa sne ring / sku'i nyer spyad yongs dzogs/ chen po'i nyer spyad dbu gdugs ser po/ rta dar cha/ bka' shog tham ga gru sgor bcas gnang / thugs dgyes pa chen pos 'phral phugs kyi bka' mchid rgyas par bstsal cing lhag par mdo smad du bstan 'gro'i bya ba la sngar ltar g.yel med mdzad dgos tshul gsungs te thugs brtse bas 105

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/gzigs pa che bzhes gnang / phyag mdzod chen mos/ lha rdzas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku brnyan bod li/ snam yug spus gtsang tshos sna tshogs bcas gnang / de nas rgyal ba dben sa pa'i gdan sar mjal phyir phyag btegs/'dus tshogs nas rje 'di pa'i snyan pa gsan te ser sbreng bcas bsu ba mdzad/rgyal ba dben sa pa'i mchod rten/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi 'dra sku/ston pa'i tshem bzhugs pa'i mchod rten sogs rten rnams la mchod mjal dang skyabs sems sogs zhal 'don gyi rim pa sngar rgyun ltar mdzad/'dus tshogs su mang ja sku 'gyed sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ de nas rong byams chen du phebs/ mchod dod la rgya dngul srang lnga phul te zhal 'don mchod mjal sogs sngar rgyun ltar gnang / ngur smrig ces par sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi chog gsungs/ de nas lcags zam chu bo ri'i dben gnas dang rten kun la mchod mjal/ mang ja sogs kyi dod rgya dngul srang bcu phul/rwa bstod du byon/ rten la mchod sgron phul nas mchod mjal zhus/ tshogs su mang ja sku 'gyed dngul skar re phul/ sgrol ma'i zhabs rjes mjal/sems skyed sogs sngar bzhin mdzad/ rje btsun bla ma klong rdol rin po che'i gzim chung du rje de'i 'dra sku bzhugs par mjal/ mchod sgon gang rgyas phul te skyabs sems sogs dkyus kyi phyag bzhes star chags thugs smon rgya gang che bcas gnang / ri khrod pa rnams la mang 'gyed dod rgya dngul srang bdun phul/ de nas lha ldan du 'byor rjes se ra'i phur mjal zhus/ po ta lar phebs/ yang bskyar rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par lha ldan smon lam gyi tshogs dbur gdan 'dren byed rgyu'i snyan gsan phul bas zhal bzhes dang / thugs brtse ba'i bka' bstsal mang du gnang / de nas rten thams cad la mchod mjal zhus shing / rgyun par lha ldan gtsug lag khang la phyag 106

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/skor mdzad/ de nas dgun zla tha ma'i nyer dgu'i nyin po ta lar phebs/rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi 'cham dang gtor rgyag sogs la gzigs par mdzad/dgung lo drug cu pa dngos po zhes pa shing khyi gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi nyin tho rengs yi dam chos srung la mchod gtor phul zhing 'phrin bcol mdzad nas jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten rnams la mchod mjal gnang / nyi ma rtse shar la 'phags mchog phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i pho brang po ta lar phebs/rgyal dbang rin po cher nang mdzod ser po/ dril gdan cod pan sogs phul te lo gsar gyi mjal kha zhus/ bzhugs gral gyi gsol ston rgyas pa'i thog gral 'phros dang tshogs gleng gar phrug 'khrab pa sogs la gzigs pa mdzad/ rgyal tshab rin po cher/ nang mdzod/ dril gdan/ cod pan bcas phul nas mjal/ yongs 'dzin khri rin po cher yang lha rdzas nang mdzod/ bzhugs gdan bcas phul nas phyag dbang zhus/ phyi nyin po ta lar rgyal po lo gsar du grags pa'i bzhugs gral la yang bskyar phebs te rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par phyag dbang zhus pas/ rgyal ba'i zhal nas/sku 'bum mkhan zur mi nyag ho thog thub dag gi nye sar bzhugs dgos gsungs te khri'i mdun du bzhugs gdan brgyab nas der bzhugs su bcug ste dpe med pa'i dgyes nyams mdzad/ gsol ston gang rgyas thog rin chen rgyan cha ba dang gar mchod sogs la gzigs pa gnang / gsol ston grol nas rgyal dbang rin po ches rje 'di pa'i phyag nas bzung ste khrid nas gzim chung du phebs par der tshogs kun ya mtshan par gyur/ nyin re bzhin lha sa'i gling skor dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi skor ba la res mos kyis byon zhing brgya phyag mchod 'bul sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ de nas cho 'phrul smon lam gyi bco lnga'i nyin skyabs mgon phyag na pad dkar 107

༄7/ /gung thang bstanapa'i sgonace' gsung 'bum/'chang ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho nas/ bod yul du ser 'bras dga' gsum sogs la bka' chos thog mar bstsal skabs/ rje 'di bas tshe rabs kyi phreng bar zhing khams gang du byon pa'i 'khor gyi dang po dang / gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa'i sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel du/ gsung chos rwa ba nas lha rdzas nang mdzod ser po/ rgya dngul srang nyis brgya las grub pa'i maṇḍal che ba dbus su ri rab dang gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas tshom bur bkod pa bzo khyad can/ sku'i rten gser zangs las grub pa'i rje'i sku brnyan/ gsung rten thar mdo gser bris gos ser po'i na bza' can/ thugs rten 'chi bdag gi bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten/ rin chen dang po srang lnga las grub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ rgya dngul srang bcu bdun las grub pa'i rgyalasad sna bdun pad 'dab can/ dril gdan/ cod pan bcas phul/de nas nyid kyis spos 'dren byas te rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshogs dbur gdan drangs/ rje 'di pas yan lag lnga ldan gyi gus phyag sngon du btang ste/ lha rdzas nang mdzod ser po srid du 'dom pa gsum lhag yod pa dang / rgya dngul srang nyer lnga las grub pa'i maṇḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla dang bcas pa'i tshom bu can dar tshon sna lngas brgyan pa phyag tu bsnams nas/snyan dngags kyi lam nas drangs pa'i bden tshig dang bsngags brjod kyis zhu lam yangs por byas te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul ba'i zlos gar nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba dang 'brel ba'i rtogs brjod dngakhyad par rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma sku na rim gyis 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa kho na bdag gir mdzad cing /yang sgos rje tsong kha pa'i 'khrungs gnas sku 'bum chos sde chen por phebs nas bshadasgrub chos kyi mdzad pa rlabs che ba gnang tshul gyi bka' drin brjod pa 108

༄༅/ /tshul khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dang / skabs don sku phreng 'di nyid du'ang bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhabs zung padmo 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du lhun chags te zab rgyas chos 'khor skor dgos tshul rnams rgyas par zhus te rten 'byung du sku'i rten gser zangs kyi tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku brnyan khru gang lhag gsung gi rten tshe mdo gser bris/ thugs rten gser zangs kyi byang chub mchod rten kha gang lhag sku'i nyer spyad kyi skor cha tshang /rgya rnga dbyug bcas/ nor bu bse ru'i rwa/ khyu mchog ma te'i rwa cha/ theg chen glang po'i mche ba/ khri snyan sa la'i pags pa rwa bcas/ stag lpag sder bzhi cha tshang / dngul srang bcu dgu lhag las grub pa'i tshe bum zhabs stegs tshagaser ma/ kha rgyan gyi dkyil du tshe mtha' yas pa'i sku brnyan bzhugs pa/me dam tsha gser can nang du dngul las grub pa'i me tog srang gsum re can cha/ tsha gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dngul srang bdun re yod pa'i dngul skong cha/ dngul srang bzhi bcu las grub pa'i rgya gling phra ldan cha/ rtsa ba ya'i mchod zhal che ba nang du dngul shan can dbus su byu ru'i phra yod pa/ ste da'i mchod zhal byur bur jus bskos ma nang du dngul shan can/ dngul srang bco lnga las grub pa'i gsol lter nang du ri bo dwangs bsil gyi me tog gis bkang ba/ byur dmar gyi phreng ba che ba gser gyi bcu shad sum ldan g.yang ḍi'i phreng ba ma na hus brgyan pa khyung rgya srug gi bcu shad sum ldan/ri bo rtse lnga'i phreng ser nyi shu/ rgya dngul rta zag ma nyi shu la srang chig stong lhag tsam/ mdzod dgos mang nug bcas gos chen sna tshogs yug bcu dgu/jus chen sna tshogs yug nyer lnga/ gos sru ma tshon ris can kha gsum re yod paganyis/ gos chen lcags sgrog ma'i sog lwa ling sngon gyi nang sha can srus legs/ rigs lnga dkyil du rigs lnga'i sa bon yod pa mtha' skor gyi pa tra 109

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/rnams dngul las 'bur mar bcos pa/ gtsug tor tog tsha gser ma dngul sku dang byu rus brgyan pa/ gos tshon gyis grub pa'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs/ dril gdan che legs/ cod pan cha/ 'go snam skya ba gyon 'dang / sman rnying yug bu la gan bzhi/ wa dmar spus gtsang / bu la gha ri bub bcu/ tā dkar yug drug cu/ rgya zam lnga bcu/ khe bi su'i sa gdan legs pa gsum dang khri sho'u tse gcig khe bi su'i mal stan spus legs gcig shel dkar rta so ma sgam gang / phye gar sgam gnyis/ rgun 'brum dkar po sgam gnyis/ sog po rgun 'brul sgam bzhi/ a mra sgam gang / go ra sgam gang / chi zag ldang gsum/ lba ko bzhi/ zing sbag sgam bdun/ 'bru dkar ldang gcig snam dkar yug bcas rnam grangs chig stong nyis brgya dang bcu gcig gi 'bul lam zhus te rmug 'dzin bang mdzod phye ba bzhin rgya che la dngos gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i bdog pa dngos 'byor gyi steng rnam dkar dge tshogs dang bcas pa blos bslangs te kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang lhan cig dgyes pa skyed par mdzad/ tshwa dor no mon sogs kyi dus rgyal tshab la rgyal ba'i 'bul ba'i sum cha'am bzhi cha las mi dgos kyang / de mo gong ma'i sku dus hal ha 'ga' zhig gis rgyal ba las che bar byed pa'ang byung bas/ 'di skabs phyed chag byed kyin 'dug pa'i yul lugs dang bstun te/rgyal tshab de mo no min han rin po cher lha rdzas nang mdzod/ dngul srang bco lnga las grub pa'i maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ sku'i nyer spyad yongs rdzogs/ tsha gser gyi 'khor lo/ rgya dngul srang lnga brgya/ mdzod gos mang lhug dang 'jam ris sna tshogs yug chen lnga/ jus chen sna tshogs yug bcu/rgyan bzhi sngon po'i sog gos nang sha can/ dril gdan cha/ cod pan cha/110

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ri bo rtse lnga'i phreng ser bcu/ tā dkar yug bzhi/ rgya zam yug bco lnga/bu la gan bub/ wa dmar skya bub/ bul ha ri drug sa bi su'i sa stan dang mā khrad tsi/ khe bi su'i mal stan/ shel gar rta so ma dang phye gar sgam cha/ rgun dkar sgam gang / sog rgun sgam gnyis/ chi bag ldang cha/rgyan nag ldang ya/ zing sbags sgam cha/ gos dkar yug bcas rnam grangs lnga brgya dang gya dgu'i mchod sprin spros shing / lha sa'i smon lam gyi dge 'dun nyi khri sum stong lhag la lag 'don mang ja dang thug pa/ dngul ṭaṃ re re'i sku 'gyed bcas phul/ gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras bstan 'gro'i mgon du zhabs pad brtan cing chos srid kyi 'phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu dge mtshan rdzogs ldan bzhin 'byung zhing / khyad par phran mi nyag ho thog thu'i sgo gsum gyi bgyi ba mtha' dag rje'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba sogs kyi skyabs 'jug dang zhu 'bul rnams mdo rgyud kyi lung gi rgyab brten bcas zhus pa na/ rgyal dbang mchog nas thugs shin tu dgyes te/ khyed nyid nas 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rtogs brjod gang rgyas brjod byung /zhes sogs kyi bka' lung bstsal/ smon lam gyi tshogs su byon pas ser 'bras dga' gsum sogs kyi mkhan po rnams dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa mang nas mgrin gcig tu/ sku 'bum mkhan zur mi nyag hu thog thu'i zhu 'bul tshig snyan la don zab pa rgyas bsdus ran pa bshad pa 'gang chen zer nas ngo mtshar du rtsi zhing / de'i sgo nas sku yon zab cing brling ba'i mkhas pa chen po red ces bsngags brjod kyi dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa byung ste/sa paṇḍi tas/ mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes/ / blun pos mkhas pa ji ltar go / zhes gsungs pa'i dpe'o/ / de nas rgyal dbang thams cad 111

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/mkhyen pa gzim chung du byon nas rje 'di par lha rdzas nang mdzod/ tsan dan las grub pa'i jo bo lo ki shwa ra'i sku brnyan/ rin ril sogs rnyed dka'i rten gyi skor dang / chos kyi gaṇḍi gaṇa g.yog dang bcas pa/ sku'i nyer spyad bla chas skor cha tshang sogs kyis srid lugs dang mthun pa'i bdag rkyen bstsal te thugs mnyes pa'i tshul gyis/ kye sku 'bum mkhan zur zhes mdun du bos nas/ deng nged cag lhan rgyas nas smon lam la 'gro gsungs pa sogs thugs brtse ba'i gsung lhug par gnang / rgyal ba'i mdun der rje 'di pa la rgyal tshab rin po che dang / bka' blon rnams dang / sku mdun mkhan po sogs mi drag thams cad nas chos ldan gyi thugs bzhed grub pa'i rten 'brel du lha rdzas mdzod btags re bstsal/ de nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs phyi zhus nas smon lam la phebs/ thub bstan rin po che'i yang snying 'jam mgon snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rnams phyogs kun tu rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ smon lam grol nas rgyal dbang mchog nas rje 'di pa'i phyag nas bzung ste/ sku na ha cang phra ba'i nyams kyis da 'gro 'gro zhes 'khyed pa'i rnam pa mdzad de jo bo shākya mu ne dang nye skor rten rnams la mchod mjal gnang / mchod mjal grub pa dang / rgyal dbang rin po che'i zhal nas/khyed dgung lo bgres pas gzim gshag tu phebs la bde bar bzhugs zhes brtse ba'i bka' bstsal te rtse drung gcig la 'di pa skyel du bcug de nas/gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang / / ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang / / cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ / bsgrims te dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ / gsungs kyang / maṇḍa snying po dang / la len pa'i don yin pas 'gyur khyad kyis shin tu snying po len dgos pa'i dus su gzigs nas skyo ngal gyi rnam pa phra mo tsam yang mi mdzad par gnyid dang snyom las mtha' dag rgyang ring 112

༄/ / khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnalopar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/du spangs te long skabs gang byung thams cad la dus rgyun du jo shāka rnam gnyis la phyag skor mdzad cing / rgyal dbang rin po che'i zhal nyin ltar mjal/lha ldan smon lam gyi mchod pa dang / gtor rgyag bang rtsal 'gran pa sogs kyi ltad mo sna tshogs la'ang gzigs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa po ta lar chibs kha bsgyur dus chibs skyel du phebs rtsis byas par/ khyed dgung lo bgres pas 'o brgyal bar 'dug bskyod mi dgos zhes bka' nan phebs/ de nas se ra zeg chen gling du phebs/ 'dus tshogs su mang ja 'gyed sogs gang rgyas dang / rten rnams la mchod 'bul zhus/ gling skor la byon zhor du/ rje bla mas dbyar zhal bzhes kyi khungs nas rtsa shes ṭīka chen bka' rtsom mdzad pa'i gnas se ra chos sdings su phebs/ skyabs sems/thun drug gi rnal 'byor/ bstan 'bar ma sogs gsungs te rgyal ba'i yum pha rol tu phyin pa'i dngos bstan sbas don gyi rtogs pa rnams rgyud la skyed ba'i gsol 'debs dang / bstan pa'i snying po de nyid rgyas pa'i thugs smon nan cher mdzad/ de nas 'bras srung gi dben gnas dge 'phel du phebs/bdun phrag du mar bcad rgya bsdams nas yi dam lha'i ljags bsnyen mdzad/thun mtshams rnams su rje bla mas mdzad pa'i thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i smon lam gyi 'don thabs thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad/ de nasadaga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du byon/ rje rin po che'i sku gdung mchodarten yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i drung du mchod sprin sna tshogs spros te nyin gsum gyi ring la zhal 'don bshags sbyang sogs gang rgyas mdzad de rje'i bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i thugs smon gnang / gling skor la byon skabs klu 'bum kha mtshan gyi grwa rgan dge bshes shig zhabs phyir song bas skor lam gyi sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i sku rang byon dang / phyag zhabs kyi 113

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/rjes sogs 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa ltar gyi tho yig dang lo rgyus phyag bris su mdzad/ 'dus tshogs su mang ja kha shas dang sku 'gyed dngul skar phyed brgyad re phul/ byang rtse grwa tshang dang shar rtse grwa tshang so sor yang mang ja'i bsnyen bkur zhus/ nang rten thams cad la mchod pa snyan shal bcas phul te mjal kha zhus/ chos rgyal gyi mdun du brgya mchod phul/ brkyang bskum ma sogs gsungs te rdo rje'i g.yar dam bskul ba'i phrin bcol mdzad/ de nas bde chen rdzong du byon/ gsang sngags mkhar gyi nang rten mgon po la mjal rgyu yin byas par/ dkon gnyer des sog po bla ma ga ri byed ki yin zer ba sogs brnyas thabs kyi rnam pa dang bcas dal gyis song ste sgo phye bar mjal kha zhus nas mgon po'i mdun du mchod sgon rgya cher phul te/ skyabs sems/ yan lag bdun pa/ myur mdzad ma sogs gsungs shing / bla ma mgon po dbyer mi phyed pa'i gdung shugs drag po dang bcas phrin bcol mdzad pa na/ dkon gnyer gyi mthong snang la mgon po'i sku brnyan des spyan rje 'di ba gar phebs la gzigs pa'i nyams shig shar te/ dkon gnyer skrag nas sngar ma gus pa byas pa la 'gyod nas mthol bshags dang / khyed nyidasgyes bu dam pa 'gang chen red ces skyabs 'jug kyang nan gyis zhus pa byung / de nas brag yer ba'i dgon par phebs te sgrub phugs so so dang /byams pa lo ke shwa ra sogs la rten mjal mdzad/ 'dus tshogs la sku 'gyed dang mang ja'i dod phul/ de nas lha sar byon/ yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri rin po che mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan dam pa bstan pa'i srog shing rje ngag dbang snyan grags zhal snga nas kyi drung nas lam rim mchan bzhi ma'i khrid nyin nyi shu lhag tsam gye ring la gsan/ yang gsang 'dus dang bde mchog sngags btu gnyis kyi rjes gnang / yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal 114

༄/ /tshi khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bzang pos mdzad pa'i rigs gsum spyi sgrub kyi khrid/ sa bcud bum sgrub kyi lung bcos gsan nas bka' drin gsob byed du/ nang mdzod ser po/dngul maṇa/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza'i rgyu'i gos chen rgyu bzang yug kha shas/ rgya dngul rta rmig ma zung / gzhan dngos po gya nom pa'i 'bul ba sna tshogs bcas phul/ de nas yongs 'dzin khri rin po che dang / stag lung dge bshes dpon g.yog gnyis kyis rje 'di ba'i drung nas nyin kha shas la gtor chen zur dgu ba'i gtor chog rje rang gis mdzad pa'i thog mtha' bar gyi 'don thabs sogs bka' chos kyi skor mang tsam gsan/ tshogs mchod tshugs nas rten mjal tshogs mjal phyag skor sogs la 'grus par mdzad/ ser sbreng gi mchod pa dang gar mchod sogs la'ang zhib gzigs gnang / slong mo pa nyis stong lhag la ja mar gyi sbyin pa btang nas yid dga' bar byas/ po ta la'i rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi dus 'khor sgrub mchod tshugs rgyur sngon 'gro rdul tshon gye dkyil 'khor bzhengs rgyu'i sa thig chog skabs kyi gar thig sogs phyag len phra zhib kun la legs par gzigs rtog mdzad/ dkyil 'khor bzhengs grub nas sgrub mchod dngos gzhi'i nyin gcig rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshogs dbur phebs skabs rje 'di pas spos sna byas te phebs pas/ rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis kye sku 'bum mkhan zur zhes 'bod pa gnang zhing / 'di pa'i phyag nas khrid de brtse ba'i gsung mang du byon zhing mthar/ nged cag lhan du smon lam 'debs gsungs te tshogs gral gyi mgor bzhugs su bcug/ yongs 'dzin khri rin po che'ang phebs pas/ rgyal dbang thams cad gzigs pa chen pos dbu mdzad/ yongs 'dzin khri rin po che/ rje 'di pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus tshogs dang bcas pas nyin 'khyong gi ring la zhal 'don 115

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'ithoname'i khrung lam/dang thugs smon rgya gang che mdzad/ tshogs grol nas/ rgyal dbang rin po chegazim khang du phebs khar rje 'di pa mdun du bos te phyag g.yas kyes rje 'di pa'i phyag g.yas nas bzung ste/ 'o/ mdo smad rje tsong kha pa'i 'khrungs gnas gdan sa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling nas bod yul 'dir byon pa'i bla ma khyed ni rje rin po che'i rnam 'phrul dngos yin zhing / nged la'ang sku drin shin tu che/ deng 'dir nged cag lhan cig tu smon lam legs par btab pa yin pas/ phyis su'ang khyed kyis nga rang thugs nas ma brjed ces gsung gi gsang ba ches cher bstsal pas gzhal bar dka' ba'i gnas su gyur/spyir 'di ba dgung lo smin pas lo rjes mar dbyar 'gros kyis bde bar phebs chog rgyu la/ de ltar byas tshe phag lo'i smon lam tshogs dbu sogs byed dgos pas dga' ston mthar phyin pa zhig mi 'ong zhing / lhag par nag zla'i dus chen la gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i thugs smon rlabs chen 'di tsho mdzad rgyu'i steng du mi khel bas/ dgun dus tsha drag gis mi snga mi 'phyi bar dus thog 'di rang la phebs pa dang / rgyal dbang mchog nas kyang skye ba'i 'phreng ba/ ming go sa/ stobs 'byor snyan grags can gyi 'dzam gling gi bla chen ji snyed cig mdun du byon pa la 'di'i bcu cha tsam yang gnang ba'i bgros med pa/ pha bu phrad pa lta bu'i dgyes gzigs tshad med pa dang nad sbyar gyi gsung lhug pa stsol tshul/ chos kyi mdzad 'phrin lhan cig gnangab/ gtso che'i mtha' ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thog tu bab pa sogs sgo du ma nas dpyad na/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po sku 'phreng 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos skal du gyur pa'i sngon gyi rten 'brel zhig dang / drag po 'khor lo can tshun chad phyi ma'i rten 'brel gyi sgo du ma zhig yod par snang ngo / / rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin mi yol thugs bskyed mtha'/ /116

༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dus su smin pa yongs 'du'i sa bon las/ / dge legs dpag bsam srid pa'i rtser bsnyegs pa/ / phal pa'i 'khri shing tshogs kyis mtshon bya min/ /yab sras zung gi 'phrin las 'dab ma'i gar/ / rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings su bsgyur ba yis/ / dmigs med bde ba'i rdza rnga bzhad pa'i sgras/ / kun rmongs gnyid kyi go skabs 'phrog gyur cig / de nas rje nyid gzimagashag tu byon te zhabs phyi pa rnams la de ring rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa thugs rje can dang / yongs 'dzin khri rin po che/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu nged rang gis kyang smon lam legs par btab/ der ma zad rgyal dbang rin po ches thugs mnyes pa'i gsung rdo rje'i tshig bsam gyis mi khyab pa lhug par bstsal pas bka' drin ni 'khor mtha' ma mchis pa byung / rang gi 'byor tshod kyis jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs rten kun la mchod pa/ rgyal ba yab sras la 'bul ba/ ser 'bras dga' gsum bkra shis lhun po bcas dgon sgrub sde che phra thams cad la bsnyen bkur legs par grub tshar ba yin kyang / rab byung na sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar bzang po smon pa'i yul du byas te/ tshe lhag 'di don dang ldan pa zhig e yong snyam pa'i 'phen pa yod/ gal te de ltar ma byung yang bka' chos kyi skor du ma nyan rgyu sogs chos kyi bya ba mang po yod pas nged rang grwa pa gsum tsam byas te/ bod chos yul 'dir lo kha shas kyi ring la cis kyang 'dug rgyu yin gsungs bar/ phyag gnyer dang drung gsol do g.yog bcas nas snga sor chos rjes kyang zhus yod pa bzhin sku na mtho bas yun ring bzhugs nas chu sogs e 'phrod mi shes stabs nged cag gi blos mi long la/nged cag kyang long ba thang skyur bzhin du gnang lugs med par ma zad/mdo smad kyi grwa slob sbyin bdag rnams kyang thugs kyis 'dor mi rung bas cis 117

༄/ /yo ca bayopa'isgroname'i g.yo ཿma/kyang 'di lo phyir phebs dgos zhes phyag mang du btsal te ngu ngag gis gsol ba yang yang btab pas dka' dka' zhig la mthar snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas ngo ma chog par phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang / gnas tshul de thos nas dpyod ldan mang pos/ khong mdo smad du chos srid rlabs chen de 'dra la thugs kyis rbad chod mdzad de/ rdo rje gsum dang gtad pa bzhi bud bsnyegs thob gsum gye rnam thar bka' gdams gong ma'i mdzad srol gyi bzhed pa de 'dra byung ba 'ching ba nang nas grol ba'i khyad chos su 'dug ces chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i bsngags pa'i tshig gi me tog kun tu 'thor ba byung /rgyu mtshan de gsan nas yongs 'dzin khri rin po ches kyang / rje 'dir bod yul du lo kha shas la bzhugs rgyu byung na bstan pa la phan rgyu red ces mang po la gsungs snang ngo / / rgyal tshab de mo no mon han blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i drung nas 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing gi rjes gnang sogs gsan/'bras srungs su phebs te/ klu 'bum khang tshan gyi dge 'dun rnams nas bka' chos zhus par/ skyabs 'gro'i khrid shin tu rgyas pa bstsal/ khang tshan la tshom ja dang 'gyed spyi 'jog sogs gang rgyas kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs pad nas gsang bde 'jigs gsum gye smon lam gyi lung dang / yongs 'dzin rin po che'i drung nas dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid lung / rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin chung ba shar ba chos rje'i drung nas kyang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid bsdus pa zhig gsan/ ser 'bras kyi dge bshes nyi shu lhag la skyabs 'gro dang dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/ lam rim bde lam sogs lung gi skor mang po bstsal/ de nas po ta lar rgyal ba rin po cher thon phyag zhus par/ thub dbang gi sku brnyan bod li lha rdzas nang mdzod bcas srid na rnyed dka'i rten gye skor phal cher/ rgyal ba'i yum rgyas 118

༄/ /྾ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/pa dum pa bcu gnyis/ dga' ldan bstan pa'i gsal byed sha tsin sa rig chi er ti ni mkhan po zhes gzengs bstod kyi cho lo dang bka' shog tham ga gru sgor dang bcas/ chen po'i nyer spyad rta ngar cha sogs dang / na bza'i skor cha tshang bcas bdag rkyen sbam mtho ba bstsal/ rgyal dbang rin po ches gsol 'phro shel gar rta so ma gsol phor gang gnang ste thugs 'phrang ba'i rnam pas nang lugs kyi gsung gnad can mang du phebs/ sku 'bum chos sde chen por skabs skabs su me skyon sogs bkra mi shis pa'i mtshan ma phran tshegs 'byung ba zhig 'dug pas/ de dag sel zhing bshad sgrub zung gi bya ba gong 'phel du rgyas phyir dang / dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i ched du brtag zhus phul ba sogs spyi sgos kyi lung bstan gyi skor rnams kyi lan zhib rgyas su bstsal/ sku 'bum spyi la rten zhig gnang dgos zhus pa ltar thub dbang gi sku khyad 'phags shig gnang / yongs 'dzin khri rin po cher thon phyag zhus par/ nyid kyi dbu zhwa dang sku gzan ser po bcas bstsal te 'phral phugs kyi gsung yang mang du phebs/ rgyal tshab rin po che'i drung nas kyang srid lugs kyi bdag rkyen rgya chen dang phyi nang gsang ba'i bka' lhug par gnang / rje nyid bod yul du bzhugs ring der dad ldan rnams nas chos 'brel zhu ba dang brtag zhus/ skyabs 'jug zhu mkhan sogs ches mang po byung bas so so'i 'dod pa tshim par byas/ rgyud stod smad gnyis la mang ja dang sku 'gyed sogs kyi bsnyen bkur zhus/ mdo smad du gdan 'dren byed rgyu'i thugs bzhed bzhin 'phags yul gyi bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ro cog cha tshang ba snag shog spus legs/ sku'i rten ston pa thugs rje can gyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bres thang bco lnga gom chen khyad mtshar gye gong gsham bcas/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i skyes rabs zhal thang bcu lhag 119

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/gong mtshungs/ rje gling 'phur ma'i sgu brnyan kha shas/ thub pa rdor gdan ma rgya gar li ma kha shas/ jo bo rje sogs rten snying gi skor rnam pa mang po/gzhan yang 'jigs byed sogs yi dam gyi skor dang chos skyong du ma/ bla sku ci rigs/ sgol dkar ljang sogs bris 'bur gyi rten mtha' yas pa gdan drangs/ de nas dbyar zla dang po'i nang du gza' skar dge ba'i nyin gzhungs nas lugs srol dang mthun pa'i skyel mi sne shan pa dang rta 'ul sogs lha sa nas nag chu'i bar bstsal te mdo smad du chibs kye kha lo sgyur bar mdzad bye/༵ ma//༷/༷/ ༵/ hūṃ ༷ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ gaX rgya ṭwāṃka rdonihūṃ ༵ ṭwāskyu byeX ༷ ༷shaṃ bheṭwāṃbhepa ṭwāṃsdi ṭwāṃṭwāṃ bcas/ / bya dka'i tshogs gnyis spyod pa ma lus phyogs can 'ga' yis rdzogs par mdzad/ / deng dus thabs mkhas thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis/ /phyogs bcu'i dpal 'byor longs spyod kun bsdus te/ / snying gar phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas 'debs pa/ / de dag rnam thar khyod kyis ring du spangs/ /zang zing dngos po tshogs gnyis snying por bsgrubs/ / legs bshad dga' ston phan tshun skyes su spel/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'khor lo bsnyen pa yis/ / dngos grub gnyis kyi dga' ston mgron du khugs/ / zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang bo'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal las/ dbus 'gyur gyi ljongs su bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul gyi dra ba ste lnga pa'o /de nas nag chu ldang la sogs rim par brgyud de dung bu rer slebs pa na bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba'i 'phrog bcom byed mi mgo log dang / ske rtsi 120

༄/ /༅ khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ri shor ba mi grangs nyis brgya dang sum bcu lhag tsam gyis me mda' sogs mtshon cha'i rigs brdar te tsham rngam gyi rnam pa dang bcas tshur gzas nas 'ongs pa na/ zhabs phyi pa rnams kyis 'thab ya zhig byed dgos rgyu red snyam ste mtshon cha sta gon byas par/ rje nyid nas grwa pa rnams la de 'dra byed mi dgos skyon med/ ngas chos srung la phrin bcol byed/ spyir 'phrog bcom byed mi 'di tsho rgyag ches pa ma red/ rang rang gi kha ma sos bas sdug thug cingalas kyi mnar ba yin pas snying re rje/ bza' btung sogs kyi gsol ras zhe tshim pa zhig ster dgos gsungs te dmu rgod kyi spyod tshul de gzigs pas lhag par snying brje ba ni/ bzhi brgya pa las/ nad thebs bu la gdung 'gyur ba/ / de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i brtse/ / dam pa min la khyad par du'o/ / zhes dang / dpal sbas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las/ bsam pa rigs pa rnams kyi thugs dang ni/ / gnod pa byed pa la yang snying rje rgyas/ / drag por gyur pa la yang 'dab ltar mnyen/ / zhe sdang tsha gdung la yang shin tu bsil/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / 'on kyang chos srung rnams kyi mthus skad cig de nyid du nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la glo bur du rlung dmar drag po 'tshub pa dang lhan cig par/ sprin shin tu mdog nag cing mi sdug pa 'khrigs nas mun sros pa bzhin gyur/ 'brug sgra bzod dka' ba sgrogs shing phyogs kun tu glog gi ka ba zug nas thog 'phen pa dang /ser ba drag po rgyun ring tsam babs pas jag mi rnams 'jigs shing dpa' zhum ste lus sems gnyi ga bag 'khum nas tshur 'phrog bcom byed rgyu lta zhogarang rang gar 'gro'i gtol yang med pas/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/skabasader gnod sbyin lag na rdo rjes zad byed pa rnams ni/ / bdag nyid kun gyis rtag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi mi mthun phyogs/ / yin par shes nas 121

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga 'bum/drag po'i rlung gis dkris pa'i char dag spros/ / rnam par rmongs nas sa yi khung bur skyabs pa dag tu byas/ / zhes pa'i ngang tshul de kho na bzhin du gyur/de'i mtshams su kho rang tsho'i nang phan tshun la'ang don med par gcig gis snyad btsal te nang 'khrug byung nas 'thab res byas/ srung mas rgyud bskul bas bsam shes 'ga' zhig la dog pa skyes te/ nga tsho la bar 'dir don med par mi 'grig pa kho na yod pa 'di'i rkyen da res kyi 'grul ba 'di reg mi nyan pa zhig yin tshod red byas pa kun gyis blor bab ste thams cad kyis khyed rang tsho bde bar song / khyed rnams la gnod 'tshe'i rigs mi byed ces zhus shing mna' bskyal nas phyir log ste nyer 'tshe ci yang ma byung ba ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i gzi byin yin te/ byang chub chen po'i skyes pa'i rabs las/ bsod nams gzhi las 'bar ba'i yon tan rnams/ / nan tan sgrub pa'i byin gyis dga' bar 'gyur/ / dgra yang rang gi grags pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ / lhag par bkur ste byed pa nyid du gyur/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / pha rol gyi gnod pa brtsam pa'ang grogs su 'khyer nus pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams ni blo spyong rtsa tshig las/ yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsgom/ gsungs pa ltar ci byas rgyan du 'gro bas nam yang gnod pas badzi ba'i go skabs med de/ 'khri shing las/ rnam sdang skyon gyi dug gis yid ni sun phyung gyur rnams kyis/ / dam pa dag la gnod pa sgrub la 'bad pa rab no gang / / de nyid gal te de yi yon tan rab 'bar rjes byed par/ / gyur na srid 'dir su zhig rgya cher gnod dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / rtse mgron shang sde mkhan po ngag dbang mgron gnyer dang / zhabs gras rnams nas nged tsho ngo g.yog nyi shu rtsa bdun las med/ kho rang tsho grangs nyis brgya lhag 'dug pas/ da lam skyabs rje dam 122

༄༅/ /tshul khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/pa sku gzhog rin po che'i thugs rje kho na la brten nas nged rnams la gnod pa ma byung ba ma gtogs/ rgyu nor phar bzhag srog kyang thar dka' ba 'dug ces zhe thag pa nas bka' drin dang thugs rje dran pa'i legs sos ched du brjod pa dang gsol pa 'debs pas dus 'da' ba byung / de nas rim par ༵sbyidī de nyersha dīngade ṭwād da ldang lda did rna~X ༷ ༵/ma da ༷༷ rdodīn rsha ༵ba ༷ dīrdeX mos pa bzhin bstsal/ de nas bu ha'i chu khar byon dus phyag mdzod che ching chos rje rab 'byams pa tshul khrims chos 'dzin ngo g.yog rnams bsu bar 'byor te gzhi byes zhal 'dzoms pa'i dga' ston mngon du gyur/ de nas wang tshe ring don grub/ bee zi ratna sirnyi/ ja sag da'i ching rdo rje bcas kyi u rgornams nas phebs lam gye zhor la ja 'dren zhus par byon nas 'dod chos kyang bstsal/ ston zla 'bring po'i yar tshes bcu gsum 'phrod spyor dge ba'i nyin bstan pa'i gsal byed che shos sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi mas gtsos sku 'bum bla spyi thun mong nas rta bsu dang / bstan pa'i snang byed stag mtsher sprul pa'i sku blo bzang mkhas grub nyi ma ser sbreng gi mgor bzhugs shing / tshogs chen zhal ngo / bla brang phyag mdzod/ sku rten chos rje/ spyi gnyer tsho ba drug gi rgan pa sogs las sne'i rigs dang chen po'i yo byad bsgrengs pa'i mchod rdzas 'dzin pa rnams dang / dge 'dun sum stong lhag gi ser spreng dang bcas chos sde chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rang sgar du 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon por zhabs sen bkod/ sku 'bum spyi nas 'du khang chen mor tshogs chen gye tshogs dbur gdan drangs/ dge 'dun sum stong brgyad brgya lhag la phyag dbang dang lam gtso'i khrid rgyas pa zhig bstsal/ bstan 123

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'isgroname'i g.yo 4ma/pa'i sgron me rgyud pa bla zur che shos sprul pa'i sku rin po ches maṇḍal bshad pa 'bul ba dang bcas 'dus tshogs yongs nas brtan bzhugs phul/ nyid nas sku 'bum 'dus spyi'i rten du rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par zhus nas gdan drangs pa'i thub dbang gi sku brnyan 'du khang chen mor bzhugs su bcug paṇa chen rin po cher zhus nas 'dus spyir bslab bya gnang ba'ang dge 'dun mang gi snyan lam du sgrogs su bcug de nas khri ga'i phyogs su byon te rten la mchod 'bul dang / chos srung rnams la dbus phebs kyi 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi mchod sgon slad kyi'ang 'phrin las bcol/ mchod rten dkar po'i bla brang du zla ba gcig gi ring la bzhugs te sku ngal gso zhing nyams bzhes kyi rgyun bskyangs/ de nas sku 'bum du phebs/ or du su'i shog gi tho yon ngo g.yog bcas nas zhus pa bzhin dge 'dun lnga brgya lhag tsam la gsang 'dus kye dbang sta gon dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ shra ma ṇa/ seng gdong ma nag mo gtso 'khor gsum pa dang dmar mo gnyis/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ dzambha la ser po sogs kyi rjes gnang / byang chub bde lam gyi lung khrid bcas bstsal/rje rin po che'i dus mchod dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i skabs nyin bdun gyi ring la tshogs chen 'du khang gi rab gsal du bla mchod dus bzang gi tshogs mgor phebs te bstan 'gro mtha' dag la dgongs pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa gang legs mdzad/ de nas 'jam mgon bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa a kyā no min han rin po che rgyal khab bai cing nas mdo smad du byon pa'i bsu ba la phebs te zi ling du mjal phrad gnang zhing sku 'bum chos sder lhan du phebs/de skabs rje 'di pa'i sku cung zhig bsnyung tshul bstan par brten a kyā bla brang nyid du rje 'di pa gdan drangs nas a kyu rin po ches bla mchod dus bzang 124

༄/ /tshul khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan gnang smin phul bas rten 'brel gye zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / yang bskyar a kyā bla brang nas tshogs chen 'du khang gi rab gsal du rje rin po che gsung 'byon ma'i mdun la rje 'di pa bla mchod dus bzang gi tshogs dbur gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs te bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon mdzad/ a kyā rin po ches rje 'di pa'i mdzad spyod dang gsung 'byon lugs sogs sngar las ches 'gyur 'dug cing / khyad par 'khor ba la skyo ba'i tshul gnang ste thugs kyi bzhed pa zhing gzhan la gtad pa mkhyen nas 'phral du gsol dpon 'jam dbyangs nyi ma la lha rdzas mdzod btags dri ma med pa srid du ring ba zhig gnang nas rje 'di pa'i sku mdun du mngags te snyigs ma'i ngang tshul la skyo ngal gyi rnam pa mi mdzad par bstan 'gro'i mgon du rlabs chen thugs bskyed kyi go cha lhag par bgos te zhabs pad yun ring brtan pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po sems la 'dzin rgyu yod pa zhig cis nas kyang gnang dgos tshul sku phreng snga phyi'i thugs 'brel dam tshig tshun chad la bkar ba'i zhu ba dmar 'byin u tshugs mthar skyel gye zhib rgyas su zhus par/ nyid nas gsol dpon la thun mong gi gsung lan rgyas pa zhig bstsal cing / nang sbyar thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs gzhi dgos pa/ 'on kyang nyid kyi thugs thag pas gsung nan mdzad pa zlog tshul med pas lo kha shas la bzhugs rgyu'i gnas tshul rnams rang nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad de rgyas btab nas mgron gnyer rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin la gnang ste/ rje a kyā rin po che'i drung du phul bar/ khong gis gzigs te phyag thal mo sbyar nas pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po zhabs pad brtan par bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes blo gdeng thub pa'i gsung rdo rje'i tshig 'di 'dra bstsal ba ni bka' drin nges par bsam gyis mi khyab 'dug 'di rmi lam min nam gsungs te/ dang por 125

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronama'i gsang 'bum/mdzadaspyod la yid ma ches pas blo 'khrul byung tshul/ de nas gdung shugs kyis gsol ba btab pas brtse bas gzigs te zhal bzhes yid tshim pa gnang ba la spro dga' tshad med pa skyes pa'i ched du brjod pa rnams mgur dbyangs kyi tshul du zhus pa ni/ rje dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku/ / pha drin can gyi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / 'bangs dad gdung gi shugs kyis gsol 'debs na/ / pha brtse chen gyi ngang nas yud tsam dgongs/ / mgon rdo rje 'chang chen rang gshis la/ / bgres rgud kyi spro ba ma mchis kyang / / deng rang re snyigs dus slob 'bangs kyi/ / chu bur gyi mig gi snang ngo la/ / sku bgres shing bsnyun pa'i tshul zhig mdzad/ / tshul 'dis kyang cung zad yid ma ches/ / gsung tshangs dbyangs 'gag pa ma mchis kyang / / gsung zhan cing gre ba bsnyung tshul bstan/ / yongs 'bel gtam nyung zhing skyo tshig mang / /tshul 'dis kyang cung zad yid ma ches/ / thugs rnam kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes la/ / skyo 'khrul dang rnam rtog mi srid mod/ / yongs skyo shas kho nas 'da' bar mdzad/ / tshul 'dis kyang cung zad yid ma ches/ / don de slad slob bu'i tha shal bdag / sems las kyi khur pos non na yang / / ci byed kyi blo lhus ma things par/ / zhag shas shig 'gyang zhing thal bar gyur/ / de rjes su dben pa'i ri sul 'dir/ / gcig pu rang mno bsam btang ba'i tshe/ /'dzem med du zhu dgos spobs pa skyes/ / ring 'dris kyi nye gnas nyi ma la/ / snying gtam gyi tshig gsum rjen 'bul zhus/ / phrin las kyi byed po rnams la yang / / nang nyams kyi drang gtam lhug par smras/ / gang zhus kyi don 'dir brtser dgongs nas/ / skyo ngal gyi thugs 'dun rgyang bsrings te/ / bstan 'gro yi phan bde rlabs po che/ / yun mdzad kyi rdo rje'i bka' bzhes dang / / bden gtam gyi phyag ris spyi bor 'byor/ / tshul 'di lta'i 126

༄/ /4khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/rab dga'i bde ba 'di/ / mngon sum mam 'on te rmi lam lags/ / yongs dri lam lags kyang mi sad snyam/ / don 'gyur med kyi rdo rje'i tha tshig 'dis/ / bdag snying la ba de dga' mngon du byen/ / dad gdung gi rlabs kyis cher bskyod de/ / zhu tshig gi snying po dgung du 'phyur/ / phyag zung gi snyim pas bzung nas kyang / / zab brling gi rgya mtshor sim pa mkhyen/ /zhes thol byung du gsol ba 'debs pa'i zhu tshig dad gus kyi snying po mu tig gi phreng ba zhes pa 'di zla 11tshes 21dge ba'i nyi dros la dben pa'i ri sul seng ge'i ri khrod nas slob bu'i tha shal snang mdzad dgyes bzhad rdo rjes bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas/ bkra shis ri mos spras pa'i ṭam rdzar/ 'gyur med rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rten kheb bcas gus phyag dang bcas gsol ba btab pa lags/zhes pa'o/ / khyi phag gnyis kyi lo gsar rnying gi mtshams 'dir lhag par thugs sna bsdung ba'i rnam pa mdzad pa ni/ rjes ma'i lo mgor yang dbus nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dag zhing du phebs 'dug pas dus tshod de 'dra zhig la rje 'di'ang zhing khams gzhan du 'byon rgyu'i dgongs bzhed yin 'dug na'ang / sngon ston pas sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ba'i rjes su/gsol ba btab pas zla ba gsum du sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyes brlabs nas bzhugs pa bzhin/ a kyu rin po ches zhu nan ha cang che ba'i zhal ngo ma bzlog par khong bzhugs ring gi lo cha shas la nyid kyis kyang thugs 'phen phyir bsnur ba yin par gdon mi za'o/ / lo mjug la sku'i khams ha cang sang dwangs shig med kyang de la thugs snang mi mdzad par bcad rgya dam po'i sgo nas yi dam gyi ljags bsnyen mdzad cing / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang dbang len pa sogs kyang gnad smin mdzad/ de nas dgung lo re gcig pa na tshod ldan zhes pa shing phag gi gnam lo gsar bzhad 127

༄/ /gung thang bayo yo 0sgo khrung ཿma/kyi nyin sku tsha zhabs drung skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / phyag mdzod che ching chos rje gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i grwa rigs thun mong nas mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas zhabs brtan phul/ rgyar rtsang sgom chen a kyu bla ma dge legs kyi sprul sku'i gtsug phud bzhes te/ mtshan blo bzangadage legs nyi ma zhes 'dogs par mdzad/ rje a kyā rin po che byon nas lo gsar gyi mjal kha zhus shing brtan bzhugs rgyas pa phul/ de nas rnam pa gnyi ga dben gnas dga' ldan chos sdings su phebs te zhag kha shas bzhugs/ de'i ring la a kyā rin po cher nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang dang gzhan bka' chos mang po thugs kyi bzhed pa bzhin du bstsal/ a kyā rin po ches slar yang bla mchod kyi dus bzang dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan zhig kyang 'bul bar mdzad/ a kyā bla brang du lha mo'i rten mdos bzhengs rgyur rdzas dang bcas shom sogs ji ltar byed dgos pa thams cad la nyid nas ljags bkod zhib mo bka' drin skyong dgos tshul zhus pa ltar khur bzhes kyis bkod khyab mdzad nas bzhengs te nang rten du bzhugs su bcug par rab gnas sogs kyang mdzad/ dus rgyun par yang a kyā rin po ches chos srid kyi sku don gal che ba gang gi thad du'ang rje 'di par dgongs bstun gyis gnang ba ma gtogs/ bka' gros med par nyid kyi thugs bzhed rkyang pa ltar ye mi mdzad pas/ de'i rgyu mtshan a kyā rin po che nyid kyi zhal nas/ bdag gi bya ba thams cad rje mi nyag rdo rje 'chang chen por zhus nas sgrub na bla ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs dang thugs rjes las don de dka' tshegs med par 'grub yong bar 'dug gsungs/ phyin chad kyang blo gtad sa skyabs mgon nyid las gzhan ma mchis pas thugs la 'dzin dgos zhes yang nas yang du zhu ba gnang /de nas rje a kyā rin po che rgya nag tu 'byon khar/ rje 'di pas lha rdzas nang 128

༄/ /ོ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mdzod/ maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ sku'i nyer spyad cha tshang / snam ther bub du ma sogs kyi dngos 'bul dang bcas brtan bzhugs phul/ rje akyā rin po ches nyid la 'phral phugs kyi gnas tshul rnams zhib tu zhus shing tshe rabs kyis phreng bar 'bral med rjes 'dzin gyi skyabs 'jug zhus/ rje 'di bas dam pa nyid kyi sku tshe mdzad phrin sogs kyi ched du dmigs te dkon mchog la gsol 'debs dang chos srung la phrin bcol sogs byed/ rgan bu nga la'ang tshe rabs kun tu thugs nas ma bor ba'i skyabs 'jug gnang dgos zhes phan tshun skyabs 'jug zhu res mdzad de akyu rin po che rgya nag tu chibs kha bsgyur/ de rjes nyid akyā bla brang du byon te nang rten sgrol ma gsum gyi sku brnyan la gzungs 'bul nyid kyis gnang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sngar zhus yod pa ltar ring bsrel rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i gzungs gzhug rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin legs par phul te rab gnas kyang mdzad/ or du su shog gi sman pa bla ma dkon mchog rab rgyas kyis zhus pa ltar/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/rgyud bzhi/ man ngag bka' rgya ma sogs kyi lung dge 'dun brgya lhag tsam la bstsal/ de nas gser sku che chung mang po dang zhal thang mang po/ bka' 'gyur cha tshang / rje yab sras kyi bka' 'bum sogs glegs bam brgya dang dgu bcu lhag bka' gdams mchod rten sogs sku gsung thugs rten du ma sku 'bum mi nyag bla brang nas khri ga'i mchod rten mi nyag bla brang du mchod pa'i rten la gdan drangs/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i nang du hal ha'i phyogs kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig gis zhus pa ltar/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i gsung 'bum bu ti brgyad tsam gyi lung dge 'dun lnga bcu skor la bstsal/ ri khrod pa dkon mchog snyan grags kyis gtor ma brgya rtsa'i khrid zhus pa ltar lag len dmigs rnam phan yon dang bcas gsung bshad zhib rgyas su bstsal bas/ lha rdzas/129

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshonace' gsung 'byam/bka' gdams maṇḍal/ sku brnyan/ lam rim/ blo spyong / 'dul pa'i skor dang / bde lam zin bris sogs gsung rab bu ti bcur nye ba/thugs rten/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad lhung bzed sogs bdog pa ci 'byor yod 'bul lta bu byas te snying khung rus pas zhabs brtan gyi zhu ba rnam dag phul/skye zhing skye bar rje nyid dang mi 'bral ba'i skyabs 'jug kyang nan tan zhus par brtse ba'i zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / 'jam mgon bstan pa'i gsal byed che shos sprul pa'i sku rin po ches kun rig rgyud don gsal ba'i steng nas phyag rgya'i skor dang dka' gnad kyi dogs gnas ci rigs zhus pa rnams zhib tu khrid pa gnang / sku 'bum rgyud grwa'i 'du khang khyams kyi logs ris ston pa'i skyes rabs kyi bkod pa rnams bgres skyon cher zhugs pa la/ bstan pa'i srog shing a kyā rin po ches gsar bzhengs kyi mthun rkyen bstsal te/phyag mdzod che ching chos rje rab 'byams pa tshul khrims chos 'dzin dang bying 'dren zur ba dge slong shes rab rig 'dzin gnyis las dpon du bskos nas/bzhengs lugs kyi sa bcad go rims sogs nyid kyis zhal bkod gnang dgos zhes zhus pa ltar lha bzo ba rnams la sngar rgyun dang bstun pa'i go rim ma 'chol zhing sku'i bab tshon gyi mdangs sogs thig ldan gang mdzes dgos pa'i bkod khyab bstsal te bzhengs su bcug gtso sku che ba rnams la kha byang gsol 'debs kyi tshigs bcad kyang ljags rtsom mdzad/ dbyar zla tha ma nas ston zla 'bring po'i bar than pa me 'bar ba lta bus mi phyugs dang lo tog kun la gnod tshab che ba byung bas/ tshogs chen zhal ngo sogs las sne'i rigs nas chos skyong la lung zhus byas pa ltar/ rgyud sman gnyis kyi dpon slob las thog pa dang zur pa sogs dge 'dun nyer gcig re bcas lan du mar lha khang chen mo'i nang dang chu mgo sogs su byon nas dmigs brtse ma'i 130

༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/las tshogs nang gi char 'bebs kyi sgrub pa byas shing / dge 'dun sum stong brgal bas kyang rgyab skyor gyi rim gro dang / spyan 'dren khrus gsol/dmigs brtse ma sogs rgya cher bsgrubs na'ang sems can spyi mthun gye las dbang btsan pas char ma babs shing / tsha bas gdungs pas ri klung thams cad dmar hang nge ba ser skya'i grong lta bur gyur pas/ rje nyid nas kyang than pa 'dis lo phyugs kun la gnod pa che bar 'dug char 'bebs shig byas na dgongs pa'i thog tu/ tshogs chen zhal ngo dang bla spyi'i phyag gnyer sogs nas yang bskyar chos skyong la lung zhus byas par/ rje 'di pas char 'beb gnang dgos lung bstan bstsal pa ltar/ thams cad 'dun pa chig dril gyis nyid la char 'bebs kyi snyan gsan phul nas gsol ba btab pas 'phral rang la tshogs chen 'du khang gi rab gsal du rje gsung 'byon ma'i mdun du phebs/ sgrub grogs dge bshes bzhi dang bcas/ skyabs sems yan lag 'dun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyis thog drangs yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i bskang bshags tshar kha shas gsungs nas phyogs bzhir drug cu pa bsngos/ gzhi bdag la bsang dang gtor bsngo gnang / dngos gzhi dmigs brtse ma'i las tshogs ltar dang / rgyab chos gtor ma brgya rtsa/ klu gtor/ 'byung gzhi gtor ma bcas nyin gsum gyi ring la bsgrubs pas char gyi rgyun 'jam po zad mi shes pa nyin mtshan khor yug tu babs nas mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pas mi phyugs lo tog sogs kun gyi dbugs gsos par mdzad de thugs rje dang bka' drin gzhal bar dka' ba'i gnas su gyur/ de nas yun ring po'i bar du bcad rgya dam pos lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams 131

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgronace' ga ཿma/bzhes ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zil mngar la gcig tu rol par mdzad/dgun zla dang por rje rin po che'i dus mchod skabs lo ltar 'char can gye phyag bzhes bzhin tshogs chen 'du khang gi rab gsal du rje gsung 'byon ma'i mdun du bla mchod dus bzang gi tshogs dbur phebs te nyin kha shas kyi ring la bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs skyed rlabs po che gnang / dgun zla 'bring po'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu nas mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i bar la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing dbang blangs pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lor tshim pa drug ldan du rol bas dam tshig skong zhing gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kun dgyes pa bskyed/ de nas sku mtshams gnang ste thun dngosagazhir zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bskyangs shing / thun mtshams su ltung bshags dang 'brel ba'i phyag sbyang nan cher mdzad/ skabs shig sku bsnyun cung zad bzhes par phyag gnyer sogs zhabs gras thun mong nas zhabs brtan ci 'dra sgrub rgyu rje nyid la zhus par/ sman bla'i cho ga mchod pa gang rgyas kyi steng nas tshogs chen du gsung na legs zhes bka' phebs pa bzhin bsgrubs/ yang zhabs gras thun mong nas sku 'bum chos skyong la lung bstan zhus par/ rnam rgyal ma'i stong mchod gang mang dang sgrol dkar gye tshe sgrub sogs sgrub dgos zhes bstsal pa'ang gnad smin byas te bsgrubs/ mtsho skyid bai zi'i shog gi sman pa lo lon mkhas pa zhig 'dug pa gdan drangs par khong gis phyag rtsa brtag nas sman phul bas sku khams cung zhig dwangs pa byung /zhabs gras thun mong nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i snyan zhus nan tan du phul bar/ zhal nas/ da lta gang yin kyang bzang / tshe 'dir dge ba'i bya ba gang bsam yid smon ltar 'grub pas 'gyod pa med/ lo'ang rgas pas nges pa ci yod ces gsungs pas zhabs phyi pa rnams gsung de ci 'dra yin snyam the 132

༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/tshom du gyur la/ de ni paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ tshe ring du gnas na rnam dkar gyi/ / las bzang po sgrub bo shi yang sla/ / sems bag chags bzang po'i ngang du 'chi/ / a la la gson shi sems la snyom/ / tshe sgrub kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ / gsungs pa ltar gdeng thob pa'i gsung zhar lago rgyu mang po can gnad zab mo zhig go / ta ri gago'i rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nas/ lha rdzas/ maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/gosakyi smon lam rin chen dang / dur bod ze ji blo bzang don grub kyi bu chung bkra shis brtan/ tho yon 'jigs med sogs nas phyag dbang zhus/grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang dang gzhan chos bka' mang tsam gnang /bsgrub bya lnga bcu lhag dge tshul dang / sum cu brgal ba la dge slong gi sdom pa bstsal/ de nas dgung lo re gnyis pa 'dzin byed ces pa byi ba'i gnam lo gsar tshes nyin sku tsha zhabs drung dang phyag mdzod che ching chos rje gnyis kyes gtsos grwa rigs thun mong nas mkha' 'gro'i bsun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i zhabs brtan phul nas rten 'brel gang legs bsgrigs/ cho 'phrul smon lam la 'dus pa'i ser skya che phra chig stong brgal ba la phyag dbang 'dod chos bstsal nas yid tshim par byas/ phe kyā zhabs drung go 'phang hū thog thus 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gsung 'dus/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub sogs kyi dbang stagon dang bcas zhus par/ che shos sprul pa'i sku rin po ches gtsos sprul sku'i rigs dang / mtsho sngon mtsho skyes bai zi/ dur bed tho yon 'jigs med/ tha'i ji bkra shis tshe brtan/ dge bshes mang po bcas dge 'dun drug brgya lhag la bstsal/ bsgrub bya brgya dang bdun cu lhag la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal te thar pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings 'jug par mdzad/ margon bka' bcu smon lam rin chen la bka' shog dang gzengs 133

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgoname'i gsung las/༵hūm̐dīṭwāṃX ṭwāṃnān paṭwāṃ ṭwāṃX sacho groX trī~X ༷ṭwāṃ~X /pa'i dzhairdo pa ga chag zi ༷ tna ༵ṭwāṃ dang ja sag da'i ching rdo rje gnyis nas lha rdzas maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten bcas zhabs brtan rim bzhin phul/ bee zis 'dod mos bzhin yi dam chos srung la gtor bsngos phrin bcol mdzad/ skabs der nged kyis bris pa'idaga' ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon tshig gi dpe zhig phyag tu 'byor pas dgyes tshor cher mdzad cing / sbyar byang gi thad du/ deng dus rje bla ma'i bstan pa 'di zungs zad kyi nad pa sman pas bor ba bzhin bdag tu 'dzin pa mi 'dug ces pa de shin tu bden par 'dug gsungs nas thugs shin tu skyo bsaspyan chab bsil/ de skabs che shos sprul pa'i sku rin po che sku 'bum gyi mkhan khrir bzhugs rgyu'i sta gon gyi skabs yin pas/ khong la khyed khrir bzhugs rgyu dang smon tshig 'di 'byor pa rten 'brel 'grig pas tshogs su btsugs na legs gsungs te/ rnam pa gnyi ga dgongs mthun gyis tshogs chen dang bshad sgrub gling gnyi gar btsugs/ de'i thugs dgongs ni khong khri 'don la rten 'brel 'grig par ma zad/ nyid kyi sku tshe hril por bstan pa'i bya ba kho na mdzad de rje bla mas/ dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ / bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ / tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ / kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ / gsungs pa ltar bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu bsngo ba'i thugs 'dun nar mar yod pa dang ngo 'phrod par mngon te/ nyid nas bla mchod kyi dus bzang zhig sngar nas 'dzugs par gnang yod pa de'i skabs su'ang smon tshig 'di chag med dgos pa'i zhal ta nan cher bstsal/ grwa pa bgres gzhon tshang mas kyang thugs 'dun rtse gcig gis dang du bzhes pas 134

༄/ /ོ khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/rten 'brel legs tshogs che ba byung / de nas dpyid zla gsum par khri ga'i phyogs su phyag btags/ nyid kyi dgon pa dga' ldan dar rgyas gling gi 'du khang steng du tsha gser gyi ñdzi ra che ba gzungs gzhug bcas 'jog pa gnang nas rab gnas kyang mdzad/ de nas mchod rten mi nyag grwa tshang bkra shis chos gling du phebs/ rgya bod sogs nas lo tog gi don du char 'bebs zhus par nyin gsum gyi ring la spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ brgya rtsa/ klu gtor/'byung gzhi dang lan chags gtor ma sogs bsngo ba gnang bar brten nyin kha shas la char gyi rgyun chen po babs pas lus can rnams kyi re ba bskangs/ re zhigaphyi mtshams kyi yongs nas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub paṇḍi ta rnams kyi gsung dang / rje yab sras kyi legs bshad sogs phyag dpe'i skor la gzigs rtog zhib rgyas gnang / de nas phyag gnyer sogs grwa rigs thun mong nas sku gong ma'i sgrub gnas byin can gsang sngags bde chen chos 'phel gling du dbyar gnas shig 'dzugs rgyu'i gnas tshul nan cher zhus shing / rje nyid la'ang snga sor rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nas dbyar gnas dang gso sbyong byed rgyur dgongs nas gaṇḍi gnang 'dug pas/ da lam bstan 'gro'i phan bder dmigs dbyar gnas shig 'dzugs rgyu byung na dgongs yod par brten/dbyar zla drug pa nas rje 'di pas gtsos tshad ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gzhi gsum gye nyams len chos 'dul pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin phyag bzhes la zebs nges byas te btsugs/ dus rgyun gyi zhal 'don la mdo sngags zung gi nyams len gyi gnad yongs su rdzogs pa bla mchod cho ga'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa rnams ma lus par mdzad srol btod pas yul phyogs bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel sgo du ma nas 'grigs/ ston zla 'bring po nas sngar gyi khrag rlung gi bsnyun gzhi cher 'phar te sku khams shin tu mi dwangs pa'i tshul 135

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'isgroname'i g.yo ཿmamadzad pas/ phyag gnyer sogs nas sku 'bum chos skyong rnam gnyis kyis gtsos lha dang bla ma thams cad la lung bstan zhus par/ zhabs brtan rim gro rgya cher phul cing / lung bstan rnams su sku'i bsnyung gzhi dwangs mi dwangs gtso cher rje nyid kyi dgongs pa la rag las tshul rjen par gsungs/ mi nyag grwa tshang du sman bla gsung pa dang bka' 'gyur gsung sgogs byas/ dga' ldan dar rgyas gling gi dge 'dun sum cu tsam gyis sman bla'i cho ga dang chos rgyal gyi gtor sgrub btsugs/ bla ma a lag shes rab nas kyang rnam 'joms bum sgrub dang bya ba khrus zhus/ bde chen dpon slob rin po ches kyang zhabs brtan gye skor mang du bsgrubs/ sku 'bum tshogs chen du sman bla'i stong mchod tshar 'ga'/ bka' 'gyur/ gdugs dkar sogs gsungs pa dang / rgyud sman grwa tshang so sor zhabs brtan gyi skor rnams rgya cher bsgrubs/bla brang rang du gdugs dkar zlog chen/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i stong mchod tshar lnga/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub sogs spyi sger kun nas zhabs brtan tshad med pa bsgrubs/ mu ri wang gi shog nas sman pa mkhas pa zhig bos te sman phul yang phan cher ma thogs/ 'on kyang zhabs gras thun mong nas sku'i rim gro rgya cher bsgrubs te zhabs brtan gnad du smin pa zhig phul bas/thugs rjes nye bar gzigs te sku cung zad dwangs pa'i tshul gnang / de nas sku 'bum du phebs/ bsnyun gyi mjug ma dwangs pas sku khams sngar dang mi 'dra'ang snying rje'i go cha mi stod pas don gnyer ba mang por rnam rgyal lha dgu/'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/ lha mo 'od zer can ma/ ri khrod lo ma gyon ma/ nor rgyun ma/ sor 'brang sogs kyi rjes gnang dang / bla mchod dang lam rim bde lam sogs kyi lung bcas bstsal te rang rang gi re ba yongs su skong bar mdzad/ dgun zla 'bring por 136
