༄/ /4 khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/chos sde chen po'i gdan sa pa bstan pa'i gsal byed che shos mkhan rin po ches gtso mdzad/ sman pa bla zur nya kyu dge bshes rgyal mtshan nor bu sogs bla mchod kyi dus bzang la tshogs yongs nas gnas brtan cho ga dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul ba'i thog che shos mkhan rin po ches dus kyi tha ma 'dir thub bstan 'dzin skyong spel ba'i rgyu tshogs ma tshang ba med pa'i skyabs mgon nyid lta bu zhabs pad brtan dgos tshul tshig gi na yam tsam ma yin par thugs rje 'khul nus pa'i zhu 'bul gnad smin bcas phul/ de nas bcad rgya bsdams nas yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ljags bsnyen la rol zhing /bdag 'jug kyang yun ring po'i bar du bzhes par mdzad/ bcad rgya grol tegaser sku li ma che chung lnga bcu brgal ba la gzungs gzhug tshul bzhin du phul zhing nang rten gsar rnying thams cad la rab gnas mdzad/ dpal ldan smad rgyud gnyis pa gsang chen sngags kyi grwa tshang gi dpon slob gro tshang zhabs drung skal bzang bkra shis rgya mtshos gtsos dge 'dun 'dus tshogs yongs nas bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub mdzad pa'i mjug tu dpon slob rin po ches zhu 'bul gnad smin gyi sgo nas lha rdzas maṇḍal/ tshe bum bcas phyag tu phul te rgyud pa grwa tshang 'dus tshogs yongs nas zhabs brtan phul bar/rje nyid kyis phyag thal mo sbyar te gus pa chen pos bdag so so skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan la skyes chen dam pa rnams dang 'dra ba'i rang dbang ni ga la mchis/dam pa gong ma rje mi nyag rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi mtshan rnam par dag pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phran bdag la/ deng dge ba'i nyin 'dir dpal ldan smad rgyud kyi dpon slob rin po ches gtsos dge 'dun 'dus tshogs yongs nas chos dam tshig gi 'brel ba zab mo thugs la dgongs te rten 'brel gye khyad de ltar gnang ba ni bka' drin shin tu gzhal dka' ba'i gnas lags/ rdo 137

༄/ /gung ca ཿna pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'a4/rje 'chang dngos su phebs nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub mngon gyur du gnang ba dang khyad med/ gang yin kyang phran rang ngos nas tshe yun ring gnas pa'i ched du zla med mchog gsum dam par gsol 'debs bgyid/ dpon slob rin po che dang dge 'dun 'dus tshogs yongs nas kyang bdag gi chos ldan gyi bgyi ba gegs med 'grub pa'i skyabs 'jug dang shis brjod cig gnang bar zhu gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin nas sku khams sngar las cher dwangs shing zhal 'don gyi skor yang bsnyun med dus ltar mdzad pas grwa slob rnams kyis skyes bu dam pa'i khyad chos gzhan dang mi 'dra ba red/ kha sang rgyud pa grwa tshang byon nas zhabs brtan phul bas sku bsnyun grol zhing mdzad spyod thams cad sngar ltar 'dug ces dga' ba'i ca co sgrogs par gyur/ de nas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mtsho sngon wang tshe ring don 'grub sku 'bum du phebs/ rje 'di bar mjal zhing sku mdun du nyin kha shas bzhugs skabs dpon po la/ da ni nged rang lo'ang rgas shing khrag rlung stod 'tshang lta bus 'byung bzhi cher mi snyoms pa yang yang 'ong tshul la bltas na 'chi ba nam yong mi shes/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dang / skyabs mgon chu bzang rin po che sogs kyi sku gong ma de dag zhing gzhan du gshegs nas bdag cag rnams mgon med du gyur pa sogs bsams na'ang / bdag lta bu'i so so skye bo lta ci smos zhes sogs dus kyi 'pho 'gyur/ 'khor ba la yid brtan med tshul sogs dang legs nyes kyi blang dor rnams mang du gsungs/lhag par nged sngon grwa rkyang yin dus su khyed kyi yab mes sogs kyis mthun rkyen bsgrubs te chos sde 'di'i chos grwar zhugs su bcug pa dang / der ma zad kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa urger gdan drangs nas/ du lan gol gyi dgon par mi tra brgya rtsa'i dbang / dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang gzhan 138

༄/ /spyo khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mang po/ rjes gnang mtha' yas pa sogs gnang dus/ wang nas mgo 'dren byas te sde thog nas khal rta khyer 'ongs nas nged la dbang nyan rgyur yong dgos gsungs te bka' chos kyi skor tshang ma nyan du bcug pa sogs gang thad nas bsam na'ang bdag la drin can gyi pha ma las kyang drin shin tu che/ yab mes kyi 'brel ba de tsho thugs la bzhag ste phyis su bdag gi chos ldan gyi bya ba gang yod thams cad dpon po nyid nas thugs la 'dzin dgos/ slar yang bskyar e thug mi shes pas ngas gang zhus thams cad thugs nas ma brjed ces gsungs pas/ dpon pos kyang rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi nyan pa'i tshul zhib rgyas zhus te/ gsung ltar rang gis gang lcogs kyi zhabs 'degs byas chog ces zhus/ wang gis lha rdzas maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten sogs kyi mchod sprin dang bcas brtan bzhugs dang zhu 'bul rgyas pa phul/ dpon po'i mnga' 'og gi sman pa mkhas pa byams pa yeste la dpon rin po ches bka' phebs te sku mdun du 'dug tu bcug nas des kyang sku khams dang bstun te sman phul/ de nas bcad rgya'i ngang la phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa paṇḍal dang bcas pa sogs gtsor 'don gyis yun ring po'i bar du bzhugs/ bla brang rang nas zhabs brtan du rnam rgyal ma'i stong mchod dang bka' 'gyur klog 'don sogs gnad smin bsgrubs te yon 'bul yang gzabs/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa dbang phyug ces ba me glang gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi nyin zhabs drung dang phyag mdzod che ching chos rje gnyis kyis gtsos grwa rigs thun mong nas mkha' 'gro'i brtan bzhugs dang 'brel bar lha rdzas maṇḍal/ sgu gsung thugs rten bcas phul te zhabs brtan gye rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs/ stod smad kyi sbyin bdag ser skya drag zhan lnga brgya brgal ba la phyag dbang / rjes gnang / lung khrid sogs 139

༄/ /yo ca ga pa'isgronaryā ga 'bum/so so'i 'dod pa ltar yid tshim nges pa bka' drin bskyang / or du su shog gi zhabs drung ngag dbang dpal ldan nyi ma sogs bsgrub bya sum cu lhag la dge slong gi sdom pa bstsal nas thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ cha har shog gi tho yon rnam rgyal zla ba dang / nee man shog gi dge bshes ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gnyis nas dbyangs can ma dkar dmar nor rgyun ma sogs kyi rjes gnang zhus pa'i 'dun pa bskangs/ drung yig mchod dpon dge slong tshul khrims bstan 'dzin gyis 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang dang de'i mngon rtogs kyi lung zhus pa ltar bka' drin du bstsal/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen blo bzang dar rgyas kyi sprul sku la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang nas ngur sprig gi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ de nas phyag dpe'i skor la yun ring du gzigs rtog rgya cher gnang zhing 'thor bsdebs chad gsab tho gsal sogs zhib tig mdzad/ tshogs chen 'du khang gsar bskrun gyi mkhar las la brten tshogs chen rgyud grwa'i 'du khang du tshogs shing / rgyud pa grwa tshang gi dpyid chos rnams rje rang gi bla brang du btsugs pa la bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ dbyar zla dang po'i nang nas sngar gyi bsnyun gzhi ches cher 'phar te phyag gnyer thun mong nas sku 'bum chos skyong sogs lha bla ma thams cad la lung bstan zhus par/gtso cher sku gzhog nyid kyi thugs bskyed la rag las tshul rjen par gsung zhing zhabs brtan rim gro'ang rgya cher babs/ rje nyid la zhus par/ nga la rim gro sman bla'i cho ga mchod pa rgya gang che dang bcas gnad du 'gro nges pa ches mang po bsgrub na des chog ces gsungs pas/ tshogs chen du gtsang zhing gya nom pa'i mchod pa shin tu rgya chen po dang bcas sman bla'i stong mchod tshar mang po bsgrubs shing dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur yang phul du phyin pa zhus/zhabs phyi pa rnams nas spyi bsdus kyis tshogs chen dang grwa tshang so sor mang ja/140

༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/grwa ja/ spom btegs rgya gang che phul te bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur dag tshar/ gdugs sher sgrol ma sogs 'gro gang che dang / bla brang rang du rnam rgyal ma'i stong mchod tshar lnga tsam/ seng gdong ma'i gtor zlog gtsug tor zlog chen/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi chog tshar brgya phrag sogs zhabs brtan gye skor rgya chen po bsgrubs/ dar rgyas gung gi sde thog nas sman pa mkhas pa zhig bos te sman phul yang phan ma thogs pas/nyid kyi zhal nas sman pa'i sman gyis phan mi thogs/ de bas dkon mchog la blo bkal na skyon med 'gro gsungs shing sku khams cung zad bde nyams byung /de'i mtshams su hal ha'i phyogs kyi ri khrod pa tho yon tshe ring skyabs nas gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang zhus par/ spyi'i chos bshad mdo rgyud khungs dang gzhung bshad dngos gzhi la man ngag zhal shes sogs rjen par bstsal te dgyes nyams dang bcas bshes gnyen bcu lhag tsam la gnang / de dus sku bsnyun bzhes tshul ye med par khams bde skabs bzhin du bstsal pas bka' chos kyi tha ma 'di yin 'dug la/ chos mjug 'dir khel ba rten 'brel gyi dbang zhig tu thal bar mngon/ de nas rgyud pa grwa tshang gi dbyar gyi chos thog kyang 'di ga'i bla brang du tshugs yod stabs/ nyid kyi thugs bzhed la grwa tshang rin po che'i khrus dbang gsan 'dun byung ba ltar/ rgyud pa'i dpon slob gser tog no mon han rin po che'i sprul pa'i sku ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyis dbu mdzad 'dus tshogs yongs la nyin bdun gyi ring bsnyen bkur gya nom pa zhus pa'i steng nas khrus dbang gsan/ zhal nas/ grwa tshang byin rlabs can 'di 'dra ba'i drung nas khrus dbang nyan rgyu phar zhog yang yang mjal rgyu'ang dka' bas da lan skal ba bzang zhes gsungs te/ skye bo rnams bsod nams kyi zhing la gus pa skyed pa'i thabs mkhas dang dgongs 141

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/gzhi gzhan yang yod par mngon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen a lag shes rab kyis rnam 'joms bum sgrub yun ring mdzad nas bkru bya bsrung ba'i rim pa sogs kyang yang yang zhus/ de nas khri ga'i phyogs kyi rten gru'i lha khang yul phyogs de'i dad ldan tshang mas khur blang gis gsar bzhengs byas pa'i steng du rje nyid nas phun sum tshogs pa'i gzi brjid kyi 'od zer phyogs thams cad du 'phro zhing / bkra shis pa'i dpal gyis kun nas lham mer byas pa rin po che sa me sbram gyi gañdzi ra mtho khyad dang ldan pa gzungs 'bul rab gnas sogs kyis byin rlabs mi zad pa'i gter du bsgrubs pa 'dzugs par mdzad/de'angagalji ra zhes pa ni bod kyi skad du mdzod ldan zhes pa yin pas/ chos srid dpal 'byor gyi bang mdzod zad mi shes pa'i dga' ston la 'dod dgur longs spyod pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar phye ba yin par mngon/ legs byas dge mtshan de nyid su pra tiṣṭha badzra zhes rab tu brtan pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bya ba'i phyir/ khri tshab dge ba'i bshes gnyen shes rab dbang phyug la gsung yig bskur te/ yang bskyar du'ang rab gnas sogs dge legs spes ba'i cho ga rgya cher byed du bcug de bzhin du bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos grwa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi rig grol 'phags tshogs 'du ba'i bste gnas 'du khang chen mo gsar bsgrun gyi steng du'ang gser gye 'khor lo shin tu che ba nyin byed gzhon nu'i gzi 'od mngon par 'gro zhing / byin rlabs rten gyis gtams pas mi shis rgud pa'i mun pa drungs nas 'byin nus pa/ g.yas g.yon du de las dma' ba'i ri dwags pho mo'i gzugs dang bcas pa 'jog par mdzes/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad la 'byung zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mi 'jigs pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes te seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa na smra ba ngan pa'i ri skyes 142

༄/ /tshi khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/mtha' dag zil gyis gnon pa la bshad pa dang / yang ri dwags rnams sgra la dga' bas chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan par bsgrags te thar 'dod kyi gdul bya ma lus pa mgron du 'gug pa la bshad pa dang / dngos gnas la'ang bcom ldan 'das kyis wa rā ḍā sir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe ri dwags ru ru gser gye mdog can gnyis der 'ong nas chos nyan pa'i rten 'brel la bshad pa sogs gang ltar yang sku 'phreng phyi ma rnams su gdan sa chen po 'dis mtshon yangs pa'i 'jig rten kun tu chos kyi 'khor lo brgyud mar bskor te blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la log par 'khu ba rnams zil gyis gnon cing thar 'dod yongs kyi re ba skong ba'i rten 'brel rmad du byung ba bsgrig par mdzad pa yin no/ / de'ang rnam par thar pa spyi'i khog 'bub lugs ni/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams bstan pa thams cad 'gal med dang / gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar ba gcig la dra phad du bal bcug pa re mig gnang nas drangs kyang rdzogs par thon pa bzhin rang gis nyams su len na'ang dmigs skor gcig gi nang du sbyor ba'i bsgom bya'i rnam pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bsdus sgom du byas chog pa dang / gzhan la ston pa na'ang gang nas bshad kyang rung ba/ ci tsam bshad kyang ran pa/ ji ltar bshad kyang 'brel ba zhig 'ong bar gsung ba ltar/ dam pa'i rnam par thar pa'ang chen po bdun du bsdus te bshad pa'am/ phar phyin drug tu bsdus te bshad pa'am/ stobs lngar bsdus te bshad pa'am/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhir bsdus te bshad pa'am/ bslab pa gsum du bsdus te bshad pa'am/tshogasaganyis kyi spyod pa dang lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len gnyis su bsdus te bshad pa'am/ byang chub lam gye rim pa'i lus gcig tu dril te bshad pa sogs gang byas kyang rnam thar thams cad de'i 143

༄/ /gung thang b.lopa'is sa gsung 'thum/khungs su 'du zhing 'brel chags pa zhig 'byung mod/ da lta yongs su grags pa'i sa bcad len lugs mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ lta sgom spyod gsum/mkhyen brtse nus gsum/ bslab pa gsum sogs la sbyor ba rnams gtso bor byed par snang la/ de rnams kyang tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ shes la yod pa'i don de rnams/ / 'di ltar ldog pa'i dngos po can/ / zhes dang /byang chub sems 'grel las/ byas dang mi rtag dag bzhin no/ / zhes pa ltar ldog pa tha dad la ltos pa dang dgos nus kyis bye ba'i ldog cha tha dad tsam gyi go ba ster lugs mi 'dra ba re yod kyang / rje bla mas byang chub lam rim chen mor bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ston pa'i rim pa thams cad las bstan pa spyi bab dang mthun pa'i rgyud 'dul lugs shig gal che bas mdo sde rgyan gyis bslab pa gsum dang sbyar ba'i rgyud 'dul tshul 'di gtso bor byed dgos par gsungs pa bzhin yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni sangs rgyas kyis chos phung ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad gdul bya'i rgyud 'dul pa'i thabs su gsungs pa sha stag yin la/ rgyud 'dul tshul nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba drungs nas 'byen byed lhag pa'i shes rab yin kyang / de la sngon du mngon gyur pa mgo gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de la nyes spyod rags pa bzlog pa'i tshul khrims sngon du 'gro bas brjod bya rtogs pa'i bstan pa thams cad bslab pa gsum du nges/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rjod byed lung gi bstan pa thams cad sde snod gsum du 'du ba dang / de 'dzin pa'i tshul yang bshad pa dang sgrub pa gnyis su kha tshon chod par gsung ste/ mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ / de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar byas na don tshan gzhan rnams kyang 'di'i khongs su 'du ste/ mkhas 144

༄༅/ /tshul khrim4bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/btsun bzang gsum zhes pa'i mkhas pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i yon tan dang / btsun pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i yon tan yin/bzang po zhes pa byang chub kyi sems dang des zin pa'i spyod pa'i ming yin zhing / thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni gtso bo byang chub kyi sems la byed dgos pas spyod 'jug tu bsam gtan gyi le'ur byang chub kyi sems skyed tshul rgyas par gsungs pa dang / rgyan snang las kyang / zeg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa dang / zhes bsam gtan gyis rtse gcig tu byed tshul bying rgod khegs pa tsam la mi byed par nyan rang gi yid byed sogs dang ma 'dres pa gal che bar gsungs pas shes so/ / lta sgom spyod gsum ni bod kyi brda spyor tshul tsam ma gtogs/ lta ba shes rab sgom pa ting 'dzin/spyod pa tshul khrims las gzhan du med do/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ni mkhas pa'i yon tan shes rab kyi bslab pa'i khongs su bsdus so/ / mkhyen brtse nus gsum yang / mkhyen pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / brtse ba gong du snyeng rje'i snying po can gyi byang chub kyi sems ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i gtso bor bshad pa de bzhin yin la/ nus pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin las bsam pa'i don/ / 'byor ba thams cad skye bar 'gyur/ / zhes mi 'dod pa sel pa dang / 'dod don sgrub pa'i nus pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin las 'byung bar gsungs pas der yang sbyar chog mod/ 'on kyang gsang sngags kyi las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i nus pa 'byung ba/ dang po tshul khrims kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa la rag las pa'i tshul dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ sngags kyi rtsa ba dang por tshul khrims te/ / zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ tshul khrims 'chal la thub dbang gis/ / sngags 'grub par ni ma gsungs te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir nus pa'i yon tan gtso bor tshul khrims kyi 145

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'itshanama'i gsung 'bum/lag rjes la sbyar nas bshad na 'brel che'o/ / des na dang po lhag pa tshul khrimasakyi bslab pa'i yon tan ni ston pa'i gdung 'tsho ba 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bum par tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang / dge ldan bstan pa'i mnga' bdag skyabs mgon chu bzang rin po che rnams kye drung nas so thar gyi tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa bzhes te bstanapa'i sgor zhugs/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chu ru kha pa sogs phyi nang gi de nyid nyi shu dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon du ma'i drung nas dbang bskur rnam par dag pas gsang ba sngags kyi lam du smin par mdzad/ de nas bzung ste sgo gsum bag med pa'i dbang du skad cig tsam yang mi gtong bar/ dran shes kyi bya ra g.yel ba med pas sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams las cung zad kyang mi 'da' bar mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung ba kho na sgrub pa'i snying po dang nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad par snang ste/ thugs dam bcad rgya mdzad pa'i skabs thams cad la'ang dbang sdud tshe sgrub sogs mi gnang bar lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid dmigs skyong ba dang / lhag par bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa'i sgo nas dam tshig gso ba rtsal 'don mdzad/ brgya la nyes pa phra mo res gos na'ang ltung bshags dang sdom pa so so'i phyir bcos tshul bzhin mdzad de rgya mtsho ro dang mi 'grogs pa ltar ltung ba dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa jo bo a ti sha'i rnam thar bskyangs/ rgyun khyer 'chag med kyi thugs dam mdzad tshul yang / dgung lo nyer gsum rgya skabs nas bzung sku tshe hril bor dus rgyun zhog ka snga bar bzhengs nas ltung bshags dang spyi bshags tshar nyer gcig gi ring la phyag sbyang mdzad pa'i mthar yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal bcas pa phul te lam rim gyi khrid dmigs cha tshang ba rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang /146

༄/ /tshulakhrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i bskyed dzogs kyi dmigs rim gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags kyi zab khrid mang po skyong bar mdzad/ nang ja bzhes nas dros ja'i bar la/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rje'i gsung gi bstod chen bzhi/sa gsum ma/ rgyan 'jug dang brgyad stong pa gang 'gro/ bla mchod cho gaphyag chen rtsa ba sogs gsung ste zab rgyas kyi lam la shar sgom rtsal 'don gnang / dus mtshams so sor thun drug gi rnal 'byor yol ba med par skyong zhing skabs gang bder rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim zab gnad tshang ba'i nyams bzhes gtsor 'don gye sgo nas oṃ gsum ma'i bzlas pa mang nyung gang lcogs dang 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyang zhal 'don mdzad/ phyi dro'i char sgrol 'don rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang / yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bdag skyed bzlas pa gang 'gro dang bcas pa'i mthar chos srung spyi'i gtor 'bul gang rgyas dang gcod kyi nyams bzhes/ gzim khar yang thun drug rnal 'byor gye khongs nas ltung ba'i bsngo bgrang dang phyir bcos gnad smin sogs mdzad de nyin re bzhin brel g.yeng ji ltar byung yang thugs dam zhal 'don gyi rigs de rnams chag med gnang / phyogs gzhan du phebs pa'i tshe'ang thub dbang gi sku brnyan li ma/ sgrol dkar ljang gnyis kyi sku bod li/sman 'dam las grub pa'i jo bo rje'i sku/ sku 'bum tsan dan las grub pa'i rje tsong kha ba'i sku dang rje gling 'phur ma/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dang skyabs mgon chu bzang rin po che rnam gnyis kyi 'khrungs rabs sku thang /gsung gi rten brgyad stong pa/ mdo sde mdzangs blun/ rgyan 'juga'adul ba mdo rtsa/ byang chub lam sgon/ rje rin po che/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku snga phyi/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi gsung 'bum/ grub chen skal 147

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i me'i g.yo 4ma/ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum/ lam rim mchan ma sogs glegs bam ti brgyad cu tsam dang / thugs rten bka' gdams mchod rten rnams 'bral med bsnams nas gnas gar bzhugs su de dag bkod pa gang mdzes su bkram pa'i mdun du phyag 'tshal ba mchod pa gang rgyas maṇḍal dang bcas pa dbul ba/ nyes ltung phra mo tsam yang btang snyoms su mi 'jog par bshags shing sdom pa sogs jo bo chen pos 'bral spangs mchod rten gyi drung du ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin gnang / lhag par ston pa thugs rje can gyi sku brnyan byen can chung ngu zhig dang / sku gong ma'i mgul phur zhig yod pa rgyun du sku la bsnams shing / khams bsangs sogs kyi tshe gtsang sar 'jog gzhan yang yi dam gyi gsang thang / rgyud kyi glegs bam/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/kha ṭāg rgyan drug ka pā la/ bum pa sogs dngos dang tsa ka li ci rigs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas rnams 'bral spangs su mdzad cing / de dag gzhan sus kyang lag mi brgyud pa dang mthong yul du mi 'jog par ches sba ba gnang ste bsrung bsten bza' ba'i dam tshig gi cha phra mo tsam las kyang mi 'da' bas nges pa don gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i rje bor gyur/ lha khang chung ngu zhig tu mchod mjal gnang na'ang bshags sbyang gtso bor gyur pa'i yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa phul te lam thun mong ba'i lus yongs rdzogs/ thun drugarnal 'byor gyi sgo nas sngags kyi dam tshig gtsang mar mdzad de lam thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len skyong ba las rigs 'dra mi 'dra mang po mi mdzad/gzhan phan 'phrin las skyong ba'i dus dang tha na char 'bebs gcod cig tshun chad kyi skabs su'ang de'i dmigs bsal gyi zhal 'don re yod kyang tshang ma'i sngon 'gro dang rmang gzhi lta bu la dam tshig gso ba'i rim pa sogs rgyun gyi 'char can de rnams 'chag med yin la/ der ma zad zab zab mo zhig rjes 148

༄/ /4 khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/na yod mdog gis 'di rnams khral rgyug lta bu'i sab sub brel dbang du mi gtong bar gang rgyas gnad smin kho na mdzad pas/ sbyin bdag la la'i bsam par khos zhus pa'i rim gro gal chen mi gnang bar khong rang gi zhal 'don zhig gnang gi 'dug snyam pa 'char yang / gnad shes na nyams len dang log gnon thams cad gcig gis go chod par blo sbyong rtsa tshig las gsungs pa bzhin/ gcig shes kun grol rnams kyis mdzad lugs 'di 'dra zhig yin dgos te/ glang ri thang bas/ chos zab mi zab min/ blo zab mi zab yin gsungs pa dang / 'gro mgon sangs rgyas dbon gyes kyang / /mi rtag rgyud la ma skyes na/ / gsang ba 'dus pa mi zab ste/ / 'chi ba mi rtag dran pa na/ / skyabs 'gro tshig gsum zab pa yin/ / gsungs pa ltar/lam thun mong ba'i kun slong dang dam tshig rnam par dag pas dngos grub gnyis kyi gter sgo phyes pa zhig la las gang byed kyang 'grub sla la tshegs med pa chos nyid yin pas/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtshos/ chos nyams len shes na thams cad zab/ / lha sgrub tshul shes na thams cad myur/ / gsungs pa ltar ro/ / spyi mthun gyi las kyis bskyed pa'i than khyer chen po mtha'i bskal pa mngon du 'ong ba lta bu'i skabs du mar yang gong smos bzhin char 'bebs kyi rim pa re mdzad pa tsam gyis bde blag tu babs pa ni/ tshang mas 'don rgyu'i chog bsags rgyu'i rdzas/ byed rgyu'i lag len thams cad 'dra'ang 'bras bu mi 'dra ba tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i stobs mi 'dra ba'i khyad yin te/ 'di 'dra la'ang tshul khrims gtsang ba kho na gal che ba blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo las/ sad ser la sogs mi 'dod byung ba'i tshe/ /dam tshig tshul khrims tshul bzhin ma bsrung ba'i/ / las ngan mtshon cha rang la 'khor ba yin/ / da ni tshul khrims la sogs gtsang bar bya/ / zhes gsungs 149

༄/ /yo ca b.lo lo ma'i khrung 4ma/la/ 'dul ba lung las/ tshul khrims ldan pa smon pas 'grub/ / gsungs pa bzhin tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i bden tshig brjod na shing skam la'ang me tog bdun re 'khrungs na/ char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang / rab gnas sogs mdzad pa'i yul du dge mtshan rgya chen po 'byung ba rnams de'i nus pa'i cha shas phra mo tsam zhig yin par mngon no/ / deng dus phal mo che lam thun mong ba la sna mi phebs par sngags la mtho snyegs byed/ sngags kyi 'jug sgo dbang dang dam tshig la rtsal du mi 'don par lag len la rngams/lag len yang bsnyen sgrub bzhag nas las sbyor la 'jug pa ni shog bu'i me tog dang ri mo'i mar me bzhin dgos nus ci yang med pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam du 'gyur ro/ / dam pa 'dis ni de las bzlog ste bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/khyod ni yon tan rgyu rnams la/ / mngon dgyes 'bras bu rnams la min/ /sgrub pa bzang po 'di nyid kyis/ / khyod kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ 'bras bu de dang de 'grub pa la rgyu gang dang gang gtso ba de nyid nan tan du bsgrubs te mchod rten gye bang rim bzhin mas rim nas brtan par byas pa'i mthus/ 'bras bu grub pa'i tshe na zo chun gyi 'phrul 'khor bzhin du stabs gcig la don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ nad gdon sogs kyis gtses pa'i shin tu nyam thag pa rnams srung mdud bum chu tsam gyis zhi bar byas pa dang / nor longs spyod kyi dbul bas gdungs pa rnams zhal g.yang tsam gyis stobs 'byor rgyas pa dang / skye bo khengs dregs can du ma zhal mthong ba tsam gyis dbang du gyur pa dang /bstan pa la log par 'khu ba mang po thugs ma mnyes pa tsam gyis nus pa zad de spa bkong ba'i tshul gong du zur tsam smos pa dang / gzhan yang nyid la log par 'khu ba'i bsam sbyor can du ma zlog pa sogs ma mdzad kyang rang nyes 150

༄/ /spyo khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnamapar thar pa nor bu'i do shal/su song ba'i lo rgyus mang du yong par snang ngo / / de ltar thugs rje dang byin rlabs mngon tshan shin tu che ba'i dbang gis mthong thos kyi skye bo rigs mi gcig pa tshang mas bla mar bkur zhing zhabs kyis reg pa'i rdul tsam yang dad pa'i rten du byed pa dang / khengs dregs dor te nyid kyi slob ma dang sbyin bdag gi grangs su e tshud bltas nas padma'i mtsho la bung ba 'du ba bzhin byed pa de thams cad kyang lhag pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu yin te/phar phyin bsdus pa las/ rkang pas bkra shis gyur pa'i rdul dag kyang / /phyag 'tshal mgos gtugs thob pa kun tu 'khyer/ / zhes dang / rje bdag nyid chen pos/ tshul khrims nyes spyod dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu/ / nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i zla ba'i 'od/ / skye dgu'i dbus na lhun po lta bur brjid/ /stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / gnyis pa lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i yon tan ni/ 'di la thun mong ba zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin dang / thun mong ma yin pa phar phyin theg pa nas bshad pa gzhan don la rtse gcig pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje theg pa nas bshad pa bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gsum yod pas/ dang po mnga' tshul ni/ zhus lan nor bu'i phreng bar/ bdag gi yon tan sba bya zhing / / zhes pa ltar/dam pa 'di ni yon tan thams cad bum nang gi mar me ltar sbas pa bka' gdams gtsang ma'i brtul zhugs kho na lhur bzhes pas de tsam yang yod pa'i rnam pa zhal gyis mi bzhes mod/ 'on kyang de yod par rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis kyi sgo nas rjes su dpog nus te/ zhi gnas kye tshogs la nyan sa dang sgom rim byang chub bzang po jo bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u gnyis sogs las ches mang du gsungs na'ang / be'u bum sngon mo las/ ting 151

༄༅/ /gung thang bstanami'i sgonama'i gsung 'bum/'dzin bskyed phyir yan lag la gnas/ / de yi gtso bo'i yan lag tshul khrims/ / zhes sogs ltar/ thams cad kyi sdoms dang rtsa ba lta bu tshul khrims3ma par dag pa dang dran shes mi lhod pa gnyis yin pas/ dang po gong du bsgrubs zin cing dran shes g.yo ba med pa'i tshul ni nyid kyi nyams mgur las/ g.yeng ba'i dran pa nang du bkug nas/ / zhes dang / yid kyi bu chung tshim dang lhan cig / dran shes a ma brtan par chags song / /zhes sogs kyis go nus te/ tshogs kyi skad dod sambha ra zhes pa yang dag par 'grub pa'i dngos po zhes pa yin pas tshig gi nus pas kyang shes la/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las kyang / rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skye bar/ / rjes su dpog pa gang yin pa/ / don gzhan la ni mi ltos phyir/ / de ni rang bzhin yin par brjod/ / ces gsungs so/ / 'bras bu'i sgo nas kyang rjes su dpog nus te/byang sems kyi zhi gnas sgrub pa'i dgos pa'i gtso bo gcig ni/ lam sgon las/ myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs/ / yongs su rdzogs par 'dod gyur pa/ / des ni 'bad byas mngon shes dag / 'grub par 'gyur gyi le los min/ / zhi gnas grub pa ma yin par/ / mngon shes 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ / zhes gzhan don rang rang gi skal ba bzhin byed pa la mngon shes dgos pa dang / mngon shes mtshan nyid pa 'grub pa la zhi gnas sngon du 'gro dgos par gsungs so/ / bdag nyid chen po 'di ni snyigs dus kyi skyes sprul la la ltar lha mthong 'dre mthong gi rnam pas yin min thams cad phyogs gcig tu bshad nas re re'i thog tu khel ba na mngon shes kyi kha bo sgrogs pa de 'dra mi mdzad kyang / rang la blo gtad pa'i grwa slob yon bdag gi rigs la chos srid rnam dkar gyi bya ba gang bsgo ba de gsung bzhin du bsgrubs na rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las mi yol bar 'grub nges pa dang / de 'dra ma byed ces bkag 152

༄/ /spyo khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/pa'am/ dngos su ma bkag kyang dang po nas thugs la mi bzhed pa rnams mi 'grub pa'am/ 'grub kyang skyon dang bcas par 'gro ba a kyā rin po ches gsungs tshul gong du bkod pa des mtshon te rgyus yod thams cad la mthun snang du grub pa ni mngon shes kyi gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa'i 'bras rtags yang dag yin no/ / de'ang chos zab pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa'am/ gang zag gcig la phan pa rgyu mtshan du byas te thams cad dpar gcig tu btab na gdul bya so so'i skal ba mchog dman/ dbang po rno rtul/ khams dang mos pa mi 'dra bas mtha' gcig tu phan dka' la/ rje 'dis ni so sor gzigs te/ la la ni mdo sngags kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i zab gnad kyi sgrub pa la spyor/ la la ni 'phags bod kyi gzhung chen mor mtha' rgya chod pa'i thos bsam la sbyor/ la la ni bsag sbyang dang kha 'don bzlas brjod sogs la spyor/ la la ni sman rtsis sgra snyan ngag sogs tha snyad rig gnas kyi bslab sbyang la sbyor/ la la ni gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs cho ga phyag len gyi rim pa la spyor/ la la ni sum rtags dang gzab gshar gyi yi ge 'bri klog gtor ma'i bca' bzo tshun chad slob tu bcug ste/ rang rang gi blo nus dang mthun pa'i dgos don 'di 'grub snyam du sems la 'dzin rgyu dang / de'i sgo nas bla ma'i bka' drin dran rgyu re nges can du 'ong rgyu yod pas/ mthong thos dran reg thams cad don dang ldan zhing / sgo mtha' dag nas 'gro ba'i rgud pa sel thabs dang / 'phral yun gyi phun tshogs 'grub pa'i thabs ma tshang ba med par 'gyur ba bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod kyis gang las 'gro ba dag / ma drangs rgud pa de gang mchis/ / gang dang 'jig rten ma sprad pa'i/ / phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gtan gyi 153

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshonas gsung lam/bslab pa'i gtso bo gzhan don la rtse gcig tu gyur pa'i tshul ni/ ma brtags btang stoms sogs kyi dbang du cung zad tsam yang 'gyur ba mi srid par gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po'i rim pa sngon dang phyi ma'i gnas skabs thams cad gzigs nas gang phan gyi thabs la sbyor tshul bshad ma thag pa de nyid byang chub kyi sems kyi byed pas gzhan don la rtse gcig tu gzhol tshul yang yin te/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ gzhan don chos kyi gtso bor gsungs pa yang / / gdul bya'i dbang po khams dang bag la nyal/ / tshogs dang sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' shes shing / / rang don ma chags gdul bya 'dul la dgongs/ / zhes so/ / der ma zad bsngo ba tshig bzhi pa gcig mdzad na'ang bstan 'gro spyi'i don du bsngo tshul rnam thar gyi dkyus su yang yang smos pa de dag kyang / dbu ma bzhi brgya par/ dbugs kyang sems can rnams la ni/ / sman slad kho nar 'byung / gsungs pa bzhin spyod lam thams cad gzhan don kho nar gzhol ba'i mtshan ma yin la/ sbyin bdag las nor longs spyod sogs bsod pa la gzhan don gyi ming btags pa'ang / deng dus phal mo che tshol ba'i skabs su ming la gzhan don zer yang / lag tu chung pa na rnam dkar phyogs su cung zad kyang mi gtong bar/ gnyen bshes bdun rgyud tshun chad kyi don la mdzod phugs su rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas 'jog pa rnams ni gzhan don gyi dri mi bro bar ma zad/ legs par brtags na rang gis rang bslus pa kho na yin pas rang don yang med de/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ dbang khrid lung gis zas nor tshol ba dang / /lto phyir rdzun gyi cho ga byung rgyal gyis/ / phan sems med par grong chog brtson pa ni/ / bdag gzhan bsru ba'i gzhan don gzugs brnyan yin/ / gsungs pa ltar ro/ / 'di bas gnas skabs der sbyin bdag gis 154

༄/ /྾ khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/phul ba len pa'i rnam pa tsam mdzad kyang zhal ta pa'i 'du shes tsam gyis de'i dad rdzas de cung zad tsam yang chud ma zos par dkon mchog gi rten bzhengs pa dang / sde 'dis mtshon pa'i chos sde che chung du mar bshad sgrub kyi rgyun skyong ba'i 'dzin zebs su gtong ba/ dbus kyi rgyal ba yab sras sogs dam pa rnams la dngos 'bul/ jo shāka sogs rten la mchod pa/ gdan sa chen po bzhis mtshon pa'i dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ ri bo rtse lnga sogs rgya bod kyi gnas chen kun la mchod 'bul dang gtong thebs sogs su sbyar te sbyong rgyud tshe dpag med kyi skabs las gsungs pa bzhin rnam dkar gong 'phel gyi tshogs su 'gro nges mdzad pa ni nges pa don gyi gzhan don yin no/ / rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams dben par ting nge 'dzin bsgrub pa las kyang 'di bzhin mdzad na sgrub pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba'i tshul dang / de nyid de'i dbon pa'i don du 'gyur ba'i tshul/ nyi khri las/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi yid la bya ba dang ma 'dres na/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po de ni dben par rnam par spyod pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa'i don/yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ gang zhig grong ngam 'on te dgon par gnas kyang rung / / theg pa gnyis kyi sems bral byang chub mchog nges na/ /'di ni 'gro don zhugs pa rnams kyi dben pa ste/ / zhes dang / dben pa 'di mi shes pa'i zhes sogs kyis rang don yin byed kyis dben tshul 'di ma shes par ri sul stong par lo brgya stong du bsgoms kyang byang sems kyi dben pa'i don ma tshang bar gsungs/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtshos kyang /don bya ba nyung ba lhur byed pa/ / spyir dam pas bsngags 'os mchog yin kyang / / khyed sems dpa' che la mdzes ma yin/ / zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang sdud pa las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' ting 'dzin bsam 155

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i 0sa'i gsung 'bum/gtan gnas/ / dgra bcom rang rgyal zeg par 'dod pa'i blo skyed na/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rgod cing sems g.yeng gyur pa ste/ / zhes byang sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa'i mi mthun phyogs spong ba la/spyir btang gi bying rgod dang rnam g.yeng bkag pa tsam gyis mi chog par/nyan thos 'jig sred kyi sgrib pa dang / rang rgyal brtse med kyi sgrib pa sogs rangadon yid byed kyi mtshan ma rnams 'di'i ldog zla'i rnam g.yeng gi gtso bo yin pas de spong dgos par gsungs te/ rnam g.yeng gi gtso bo der ngos bzung ba'i shugs la bsam gtan gyi gtso bo gzhan don kho nar gzhol ba'i byang chub kyi sems su go nus la/ bsam gtan gyi phar phyin dang byang sems kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin bslab pa gnyis don gcig pa zeg pa chen po'i spyi skad yin no/ / gsum pa bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin brnyes tshul ni/ sku tshe hril por gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i rim gnyis nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad de skyes sbyang gi shes rab/rtag sbyor gus sbyor gyi brtson pa/ dam tshig sdom pa'i bsrung mtshams/ lha sngags la yid ches sogs byang chub rdo rjes ji ltar gsungs pa'i thabs kyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med par sgrub pa mdzad 'dug pas 'bras bu rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs yod med la dogs pa'i gnas tsam yang ga la mchis/ 'on kyang sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kyis dngos su zhal gyis 'ches pa ma mdzad pas rgya cher smra ba dka'ang zur tsam brjod na/ mtshan mo'i ring la gzim dang ting nge 'dzin bsres nas dge sbyor skyong ba zhig yod ces rgyus yod rnams gleng bas/phal pa gnyid log pa bzhin lus sems thams cad lhod lhod po dang shig shig por song ba de 'dra min par/ sha tshugs kyi sgrim cha dang / mdangs kyi gsal cha sogs gang la bltas na'ang nang du ting nge 'dzin zhig la mnyam par 156

༄/ /༅ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bzhag yod pa'i nyams shes rgyu yod pa zhig yin par snang / de lta na gzim dang bsres nas skyong rgyu'i dge spyor yang dge sems gang yang rung ba tsam zhig ma yin par nges te/ khrus ldang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor sogs bla med kyi rgyud don ltar rnam pa kun tu mdzad bzhin pa mngon sum gyis grub pas/ de la dpagan 'di'i skabs su'ang nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba lho brag mar ba'i thugs bcud/ bsre ba skor dgu'i man ngag gi snying po de nyid yin pa gor ma chag go / de'i skyong tshul ni gnyid du 'gro ba'i tshe sdud rim gyi dmigs pa bskyangs te/ stong bzhi rim par shar pa'i 'od gsal gye dus na de dang stong pa nyid sbyar ba'i bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa gtso bo yin la/ spyod bsdus las/ sa mthug gyur pas rab tu ring gnyid log ces sogs kyis phal ba la'ang rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung rgyu yod pa bzhin/ bdag nyid chen po rnams la tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par byed pa'i rjes thob kyi nyams len ngo mtshar ba mang po'ang skyong rgyu yod par snang bas de 'dra zhig yin par mngon no/ / gsum pa lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i yon tan ni/ gnas lugs rigs pa don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab/ gnas lnga rigs pa kun dzob rtogs pa'i shes rab/ sems can gyi don sna tshogs sgrub tshul shes pa'i shes rab gsum dang / yang na ji lta ba rigs pa/ ji snyed pa rigs pa/ gnas lnga rig pa'i shes rab gsum zab pa myur ba gsal pa rgya che ba'i shes rab bzhi/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab/skyes sbyang gi shes rab gnyis/ thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gsum sogs ji ltar du byas te bshad kyang rung mod/ 'dir shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis kyi dbang du byas te brjod na/ dang po la lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul dang / nyer len 157

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i ma'i gsung 4ma/gyi rgyu tshul bzhin yid la byed pas gzhung lugs rgya mtshor sbyangs tshul gnyis/dang po ni/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi sgor 'jug pa'i bshes gnyen gong du smos pa rnams dang / khyad par mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi gdams pa zad mi shes pa rgya mtsho las chu bcu ba bzhin mnos te bstan pa'i gnad la nges pa ster ba'i bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa ni kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje yin la/ gzhan yang dge ldan bstan pa'i srog shing dga' ldan khri rin po che/ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje thu'u bkwan rin po che/chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba rtsad nas chod pa kun spangs blo bzang rgyal mtshan/rigs pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang nyi ma sogs bshes gnyen dam pa du ma rigs kyi cod pan du bkur te/ gsung gi bdud rtsi mnos nas god pa med par thugs rgyud la gtams pas yon tan mi zad pa'i gter du gyur pa yin no/ / gnyis pa nyer len gyi rgyu gzhung lugs la sbyang ba mdzad tshul yang rgyas par gong du brjod zin pa ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la thog mar mang du thos pa gal che bar gzigs nas/ chen po'i ming dang go sa sogs kyis chog shes rlom sems ma mdzad par khengs dregs dor zhing dka' ba khyad du bsad de nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang / de'i don la dpyod pa/ brgal brtags kyis rtsod pa/ gzhung gi dpe khrid/ dka' gnad la dri rmed sogs phyogs sgor mo nas gsan spyong rdo rus thug pa mdzad/khyad par du gzhung chen mo po ti bcu phrag lhag pa 'dzin skyor gnang ste tshogs rgyug phul tshul sogs sngar bshad zin la/ rgyud grwar phebs nas mdo sde kun gyi za ma tog dang rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi sbas pa'i gnad rnams bshad rgyud chen po drug la brten nas 'grel tshul dpal ldan zla ba dang rje bla ma'i legs bshad rnams kyis gtsos gsang 158

༄/ /tshulakhrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/chen rgyud sde kun gyi gnad don lam rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas nyams su len tshul/ zhal shes kyi man ngag cho ga phyag len sogs mtha' dag la sbyang ba mthil phyin pa dang / zhar byung rig gnas kun la'ang sbyangs tshul sogs kyang gong du song zin pas bskyar mi dgos/ gnyis pa rgyu rkyen de dag gi 'bras bu 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mtshungs zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad tshul la/ 'chad pa'i yon tan ni/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba dang / dbyig gnyen gyi rnam bshad rigs pa sogs nas byung ba ltar bshad tshul gyi skyon thams cad dang bral zhing / yon tan tshang ba'i tshul brjod bya'i rnam grangs mang yang snying po bsdus na/ dang por chos ston pa'i kun slong byams snying rje dang bstan pa ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes sogs kyi sgo nas/ ston tshul brjod don gyi snying po mi gsal ba/ gong 'og 'khrugs pa/ha cang rgya 'byams pas gnad du mi 'dril ba/ zer zlos kyi rnam grangs mang pos nyi ma 'phul ba/ gzhan la bsnyad 'dogs zur za mang pos dri ma can du byed pa/ lung rigs kyi gtad so med par tshod 'jog byed pa sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar mdo rgyud bstan bcos tshad ma dang / lhag par rje yab sras kyi gsung dri ma med pa re gzhir bzhag ste/ 'brel dang mtshams sbyor mdor rgyas sprod tshul gyis go bde ba/ gnad 'gag gi spyi sdoms nas bzung ste gsung bas 'dus che ba/ lung rigs kyi zur phyin pas nges shes brtan po skyed pa/ rtogs sla'i dpe dang sbyar bas nyan spro ba/ khyad par du gang gsung thams cad chos kyi mde'u sne nang du bskor te rgyud 'dul thabs 'ba' zhig tu mdzad pas phan che ba sogs khyad chos bsam las 'das pa zhig yod pa'i stobs kyis nyan pa po ming dang go sas rlom pa/ rtog ge'i nga rgyal gyis dregs pas/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang gis khengs pa/ rigs rus kyis 159

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/snyems pa thams cad kyang rta dmu rgod srab kyis kha lo bsgyur ba bzhin blo sna rang dbang med par bsgyur thub pa dang / slar yun ring 'gor yang de'i tshe 'digasungs pa yin snyam du sems la gzer btab pa bzhin mi brjed par 'dzin rgyu yod pas yid dang rna bar skyel mkhas pa ste/ mdor na po to pa'i rnam thar mdzes pa'i padmo las/ brgal lan sun 'byin chos dmag zer mchu nyung / / dbang za rang bzos bsdus don mi mdzad cing / / don gyi mtha' chod tshig nyung don kun go / mang thos lung ldan don gyi sa mtshams phyed/ / grub mtha' ma 'dres chos skad bzang la brten/ / ci bshad sgom don blo sna bsgyur la mkhas/ / nyams pa zur gso tshig 'bru dam pa bkrol/ /'khrugs pa kun bsdebs 'byams pa ngag tu 'dril/ / zhes gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin tshang ngo / / de'i gnad kyis chos don du gnyer ba'i mkhas pa gzu bor gnas pa thams cad slob mar gyur te gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob kyis rgya bod hor gsum gyi yul thams cad du khyab pa byung ba ni/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod kyi slob ma bzang po'i shing / / dge ba'i me tog gis brgyan pa/ / dbyid kyi shing ni me tog gis/ / brgyan pa lta bur mdzes pa lags/ / zhes pa 'di'i tshig ris ltar byas na slob ma de nyid yon tan gyi rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i don lta bur 'gro'ang / 'di slob ma bla ma'i rgyan du song nas che ba 'don tshul yin pas/ 'gyur yang / slob ma dge ba'i me tog gis/ / bzang po'i shing khyod brgyan gyur ba/ / dpyid kyi shing ni me tog gis/ / brgyan pa lta bur mdzes pa lags/ / byas na shing las skyes pa'i me tog gis shing brgyan pa bzhin/ bla ma'i gsung las skyes pa'i slob mas bla ma brgyan pa'i dpe don gnyis shin tu 'brel lo/ / sa paṇa gyis thub pa'i bstod pa las kyang / khyod kyi yon tan smos ci 'tshal/ / sras kyi yon tan mthong 160

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/bas khums/ / skya rengs shar ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ / padmo'i gnyen gyi 'od zer go / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma'i sku'i che ba 'don pa'i mdzes rgyan yin kyang zhib par bgrang gis mi lang la/ rags rim tsam zhig smos na/nyid kyi bla ma'i khrod na tshur yang chos gsan pa'i bla slob gnyi gar gyur pa dbus 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing dga' ldan khri rin po che ngag dbang snyan grags nges don gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgya rtsang sgom chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan rnam pa gnyis dang / a kyā rin po che'i mdun nas kyang chos lung 'ga' zhig gsan la/ 'on kyang bstan pa'i rtsa lag a kyā rin po che blo bzang 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho ni rje 'di nyid las mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi gdams pa'i thugs bcud ma tshang ba med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhes pa'i nang gi thugs sras gtso bo yin no/ / gzhan yang 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i 'dren mchog mtshungs zla med pa byang phyogs bstan pa'i mgon po hal ha rje btsun dam pa dbang phyug 'jigs med rgya mtsho/ ta le'i hu thog thu bskal bzang thub bstan rab rgyas/ dgon kyā dam chos bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ gser tog sprul pa'i sku ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho/ stag mcher sprul pa'i sku blo bzang mkhas grub nyi ma/ che shos sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ gro tshang rgyud pa bla zur skal bzang bkra shis rgya mtsho/ mtshan sgrogs mkhan chen dge 'dun don grub kyi sprul sku/ rgya yag sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ ske kyā zhabs drung / sgom chen rin po che'i sprul sku blo bzang dge legs nyi ma/ sman pa bla zur nya kyā rgyal mtshan nor bu/ sman pa blazur gro tshang sprul sku/ de'i bla zur so nyid ngag dbang dam chos/ sman pa'ikhri pa gro kyā bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ co ne zhabs drung skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ a rig zhabs drung bsod nams bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/161

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'itshonas gsung 'bum/bstan pa'i gsal byed lcang lung parnyi ta/ mkhas dbang pā rin tho yon blo bzang dge legs bstan 'dzin/ a bag lha ram pa ngag dbang yar 'phel/bhe rje dirdo ṭwāṃ hūṃṭwāṃ bhedī dī nab /rdoX ṭwāṃdī sprul snar nga~Xn daX tt+waṃdhri zlo ṭwāṃ~X ṭwāṃ dhri /bzang mkhas mchog grags pa/ mur gu chig bde ldan bkod pa gling gi mer gan ta'i ching chos rje blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ cha har khu be thu u lan gyi chos rje blo bzang dge legs/ zhabs drung 'jigs med bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ so nyig bstan pa dar rgyas gling gi sprul sku blo bzang tshul khrims tt+waṃ/ /g.ya~X ṭwāṃṭwāṃ rdoṇḍi gta mcho ༵che ṭwāṃ ༵/di dī ma~X ༷ ṭwāṃrjirdo ṭwāṃsargya ༵kram rdo~X /rgya madhri/su nyid g.yon ru ti le bi thi ru chos rje'i sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan chos 'byor/ a bag zhabs drung / mar du su er ti ni chos rje'i zhabs drung ngagadabang dpal ldan nyi ma/ or du su sman pa bla zur dkon mchog rab rgyas/ or du su hang gin zhabs drung rin chen 'byung gnas/ gro kyā zhabs drung sogs dam pa'i skye 'phreng 'dzin pa'i sprul sku dang chos kyi gdan khri 'dzin pa'i bla ma mang po dang / gzhan yang or du su shog gi sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po ngag dbang smon lam/ or du su wang gi shog nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa ri khrod pa dkon mchog snyan grags/ or du su gling bsres bka' bcu mthu stobs/ u rad smon ram pa dpal 'byor sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtshor blo gros kyi gru gzings 'dod dgur 'jug pa'i dge bshes/ chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba dor te spong ba bsam gtan la gcig tu gzhol ba'i ri khrod pa sogs bgrang gis mi lang ngo / / mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i sbyin bdag gi rim pa ni/ thog mtha' bar gsum du mdzad 162

༄/ /tshul khrimasabastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/'phrin gyi gdugs dkar 'deg pa'i yu ba lta bu mi rje mtshungs pa med pa ching wang bsod nams rdo rje/ de'i sras sa skyong mi'i dbang phyug dam pa wang tshe ring don grub/ mu ring wang phyag rdor/ bai li 'jigs med/ de'i sras bai li 'jam dpal/ pe li 'phrin las dpal 'byor/ pi zi mi 'gyur/de'i sras pe zi ratna sirnyi/ pe ṭi mtsho skyes/ dar rgyas gung / ja sag yul cus thu da'i ching rdo rje/ sras ja sag da'i ching dbang chen don grub/ tshwa 'dam ja sag mang kheb yar/ ja sag bstan skyong / de'i sras ja sag rab brtan sogs mtsho sngon gyi sa'i char gtogs pa'i dpon rigs ches mang po dang / byang phyogs hor gyi yul nas sa skyong dam pa su nyid g.yas ru'i du'u reng wang ratna sirnyi sku mched bcas/ dur bod tā wang phun tshogs bsam 'grub/ ho'u ching wang / or du su jun gar tā pe zi sogs dad pa'i lang tsho gtong ba'i rgyan gyi mdzes pa'i dpon po che chung / mi bzang se dod/khyim bdag 'byor ldan sogs mtha' yas so/ / dge tshul slong bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen sogs kyi sdom pa mnos te byang chub gsum gye khang bzang du 'jug pa'i nor bu'i zem skas btsugs pa khri phrag las lhag la/ chos 'brel tsam mnos te mtho ris dang thar pa'i sa bon bskrun pa tshun chad ni bgrang gis mi lang ngo / / rtsod pa'i yon tan ni/ spyir da lta bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i bya ba kun gyi nang na mdo dbus yongs la dar rgyas che ba rtsod pa yin par grags mod kyang / phal mo che zhig gis rtsod tshul ni/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ rnyed bkur 'khor dang grags pa don gnyer ba'i/ / 'gran sems phrag dog bdag bstod gzhan smod kyis/ / nges shes grangs dang shag sbyong lhur len pa/ / nyon mongs so nam thos pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /gsungs pa lta bur song ba mang la/ de min yang rkun po sngar ma nor la 163

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshanas gsung 'thum/'jab pa bzhin du rang gi zhe 'dod pha rol pos shes kyis dogs pa'i tshig sub sub pos ming zur re'i steng nas yin kyang mgo skor ci thub dang / phyi rgol gyi kha nor ba tsam la'ang dngos 'gal gyi rgyang 'bod e thub lta ba sogs re dogs mang po/ dpal chos kye grags pa'i rtsod rigs dang / sa paṇa gye mkhas 'jug sogs las rtsod pa rnam dag gi 'gal zlar gsung ba kho na las/chos kyi de nyid rigs pa gsum gyis gtan la phab ste ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma drungs nas 'byen pas rang gzhan gnyi gar sman pa de lta bu dkon yang /dam pa 'dis ni gzhung chen mo'i go don gzhir bzung ste rang gzhan gnyi ga chos kyi gnad la nges pa sna re yin kyang skyed ci thub/ log rtog re re'ang sel ci thub kyi phan sems dang 'dun pa rnam par dag pa las/ mkhas grags kyi re ba dang / phyi rgol sma 'bebs kyi bsam pa sogs nam yang mi mdzad pas/ rtsod zla rnams kyang ci tsam 'grogs pa bzhin je gus su 'gro ba zhig yod pa grwa thog mnyam pa'i rgyus yod rnams gleng ngo / / rtsom pa'i yon tan ni dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdor/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa zhes sogs dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ gzugs rgyan rang bzhin yod tan ldan pa me long nang song na/ / zhes sogs kyis rang bzhin gyi rgyan zab rgyas kyi lus bzang po'ang rjod byed phun sum tshogs pa'i gsal byed kyi rgyan gyis mdzes parabyed dgos par gsungs la/ rje bla ma'i rin po che gsum gye gtam gyi sbyor bar yang de bzhin du gsungs te/ bstan bcos kyi spyi khog shin tu bzang ba'i nang du'ang sbyor tshul nyes pa re re byung na rgyan mang na chung sna bcad pa bzhin du mdzes pa dman par byed par daṇḍis gsungs so/ / de ltar tshig don phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba la snyan ngag gi gzhung sogs la sbyang 1yo

༄7/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dgos par gzigs te tha snyad pa'i rig gnas rnams la'ang thos bsam tshul bzhin du mdzad pa na skyes sbyang gi blo gros phun sum tshogs pas dka' tshegs med par smra ba'i dbang phyug tu gyur par nges te/ sngon kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che'i bkas bskul nas tha snyad rig gnas rnams la sbyang ba mdzad pa'i tshe rje de nyid kyis stsal pa'i chab shog las/ yid 'phrog chu skyes lte bar 'jo sgeg mkhan/ / bai ḍūr rgyud mangs sgra las chos phung kun/ /glur len smra mkhas 'dod pa rnams kyi lha/ / tshangs pa'i bu mos dge legs stsol gyur cig / tha snyad rig gnas shes bya'i thang chen du/ / blo gros cang shes gom stangs bsgyur mkhas shing / / legs bshad ngo mtshar ltad mos tshim gyur pa/ / dam pa'i rang rtags gsal ba'i blo ldan khyod/ / ces thugs shin tu mgu ba'i bka' phebs pa dang / rje thu'u bkwan rin po ches stsal ba'i chab shog las kyang / rmongs chen glang po'i mche ba nyer phyung nas/ / sna tshogs rigaganas sgro mdangs mtshar sdug can/ / rgya chen thos pa'i rma bya zhon nas su/ / mkhas mang 'chi med gral du nyer sleb ste/ / ma rig mun sel rig gzhung gser gyi sgron/ / rnam dpyod sug bar thogs pas dus mtha' 'di'i/ / skye sprul bzang rdzu'i mun khung 'dod sred kyi/ / gnyid du yur ba rnams la co 'dri zhing / / zhes dang / dar zab kyis dkris lder bzo'i rnam par thar/ / 'dzin min ljags mnyen glog gi gar bsgyur bas/ / legs bshad sgra brgya sgogs pa'i chos kyi sprin/ / khyod ko thub bstan lha lam mdzes rgyan nyid/ / ces gcam bu tsam ma yin par gnas tshul gye rang bzhin drang por 'doms pa'i gsung gis bsngags pa brjod pas shes so/ / 'on kyang bar skabs shig nas jo bo chen pos/ ngang pa'i chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ / rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang par bya/ / zhes dang / snying po nges 165

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i g.yo lam/par bsdu ba las kyang gsungs pa ltar be'u bum sngon mor yang / bsgoms pas tshe 'di don yod byas la/ / rig pa'i gnas lnga smon lam gyis sbyang / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin nang du yang dag 'jog la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar gyur te/ de la ltos nas tha snyad rig gnas kyi spros pa dang rtsom pa'i rnam grangs mang po g.yeng ba'i rgyur gzigs nas cher ma mdzad kyang / dad ldan rnams kyis nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul te snga phyir gsung rtsom thor bu gnang ba phyogs gcig tu bsdebs na po ti gcig lhag tsam yod pa rnams ni/ don zab cing tshig sbyor legs pa/ go bde la 'dus che ba sogs mkhas pa mgu ba'i legs bshad 'ba' zhig tu yod do/ / de ltar shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la thogs pa med pa khyu mchog rlabs po che'iganas thob pa'i tshul de rnams kyang lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab ba'i yon tan yin la/ 'on kyang mdo sde rnams las lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i dbye ba gtso bor dngos su gsungs pa ni/ rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal las/ lhag pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum 'jog pa la/ sa 'dir byang phyogs so bdun rags pa dang phra ba la ches mkhas pa'i shes rab kyi bslab pa zhes sogs kyi don dbu ma 'jug par/ byang chub phyogs lhag bsgom pa las skyes pa'i/ / zhes byang phyogs so bdun sogs lam la mkhas pa'i shes rab kyi brlab pa dang / bden rang bzhin/ zhib mor rtogs la'ang shin tu mkhas pa 'thob/ / ces bden bzhi la mkhas pa'i lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / 'di brten 'byung ba'i de nyid mthong ba de/ / shes rabaganas pas 'gog pa 'thob par 'gyur/ / zhes rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i lhag ba shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum du gsungs pa de dag thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par tshul 'di nyid kyis shes dgos te/ nyid kyi 166

༄/ /྾ khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/rtogs brjod skal ldan ma las/ gzhung phar phyin dbu ma la sogs pa/ /nang bltas kyi blo yis gang nus skyor/ / zhes bka' pod chen po lnga la sbyang ba mdzad pa de'ang kha phyir bltas kyi rtsod pa'i yan lag tsam ma yin par thugs rgyud la nang du bskor te de dang de'i don gyi rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs pa 'ba' zhig gi phyir du mdzad nges pa dang / de ltar na phar phyin gyi gzhung la sbyangs bas gzhung pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbas don mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs/ / zhes sogs kyis mdor bstan pa bzhin du skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye rim par bsdus te rnal 'byor pa gcig gi nyams len gyi lus gcig tu 'dril bas lam phra rags kyi gnad thams cad la nges pa rnyed de lhag pa'i shes rab dang po thugs la skyes par 'grub/mngon pa mdzod la sbyangs pa'ang gnas dang po gsum gyis khams kyi rab dbye mtha' yas dang snod bcud kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag gis bsdus pa'i shes bya sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gtan la 'bebs/ gnas bzhi pa lnga pa gnyis kyis las kye dbye ba dang de'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug sogs spang bya kun 'byung gi bden pa gtan la 'bebs/ gnas phyi ma gsum gyis 'gog lam gyi bden pa gtan la 'bebs pas lhag pa'i shes rab gnyis pa thugs la 'khrungs par 'grub/ dbu ma'i gzhung la nang du bskor te sbyangs pas srid pa'i nad brgya sel ba'i sman mchog nyes brgya'i 'ching ba gcod pa'i ral gri/ bstan pa'i snying po dpal mgon klu sgrub yab sras dang 'jam mgon tsong kha pa yab sras kyi thugs bcud zab mo rten 'byung gi de kho na nyid gzigs pas lhag pa'i shes rab gsum pa thugs la 'khrungs par 'grub cing / rnam 'grel ni dbu tshad seng ge 'jing bsnol zhes dbu ma'i lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i rigs par ngar 'dogs byed kyi yan lag dang / 'dul ba ni de dag thams cad kyi 167

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan ba'i sgroname'i gsang lam/gzhi rten du dgos pas/ mdor na rgyu thos bsam mdzad tshul tshig gi na yam dang shag 'gyed pa tsam du ma song ba'i rnam par dag pa 'di nyid kyi sgo nas 'bras bu lhag pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs tshul rjes su dpog par byed dgos pa yin no/ / mdor na phyin drug bsdu bzhi sogs rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la goms pa ngang du gyur pas sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag bstan 'gro'i gsos sman du 'gyur zhing /rang don yid byed kyis bslad pa cung zad kyang med par de thams cad gzhan don 'ba' zhig tu bsngo bar mdzad pa'i stabs kyis slad mar yang nam mkha' jisred gnas kyi bar du tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa rlabs po che cung zad tsam yang mi nyams par gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / 'gro ba ma lus pa'i mgon dang skyabs su gyur ba sogs gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mi zad pa'i gter du gyur pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ thabs mchog shes pa gang zhig bsod nams yang dag bsdus pa shin tu rgya chen kun/ / gzhan dang thun mong byas nas nyin gcig bzhin du rdzogs pa'i byang chub yongs bsngo zhing / / bzang po'i gnas su skyes pas rtag tu dge byed mngon shes yon tan rnams kyis rtsen/ / sangs rgyas sras de kun gye bla na 'dug pa yon tan gter du shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / rnam dag tshul khrims chu gter las bhe ༷she bhehūṃ shaṃni hūṃṭwāṃ ma hūṃ ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ bhe ṭwāṃ/ bye/ hūṃ ༷/ngoXllī bhesde / nghru bsdus bshad pas mgo skor dang / / gnad don ma phig kha 'chal rtsod pa dang / / gzhan las brkus te rtsom pa'i khur 'dzin rnams/ / re zhig thugs 168

༄/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/ngal spangs te bde bar mnol/ / khyod gsung tshad mar gyur pa tshangs pa'i thig / sde sgod mtshams las mi 'da' rgyal gsung kun/ / mdo dang sngags kyi lam bzang lus gcig tu/ / gnon pa'i rgyal thabs khyab 'jug gom pa bzhin/ / gang gi yon tan nyi 'od gser zhun gyis/ / bris pa'i yi ge bklag pas gang du dzogs/ / 'on kyang rmad byung rnam thar bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / ci tsam myang bas gdung sel bde ba ster/ / zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal las sku tshe'i mjug gi mdzad pa rnam thar spyi'i don bsdu dang bcas pa'i dra ba ste drug pa'o/ / de nas sku bsnyun shin tu lce ba'i tshul bzhes shing / gsol ba'ang cher mi mdzad par shas cher mnyam gzhag lta bu zhig gi ngang du bzhugs pa na/ zhabs phyi ba nang ma rnams kyis da ni bsnyung gzhi dang sku'i bab/ gsung gi shugs gang la dpyad na'ang dgongs pa gzhan du gtad tshar 'dug snyam du kho thag chad pa'i mya ngan gyi shugs dang bcas te 'phral phugs kyi gnas tshul du ma dang / lhag par spyir bstan 'gro dang / sgos nged cag rnams kyi mgon du sprul pa'i sku dwangs gsal myur 'byon gyi bka' drin dus las mi yol ba thugs rjes gzigs dgos tshul dang sku gdung ji ltar byed rgyu'i skor rnams zhus par/bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che'i thugs rje kho na la rag las gtso cher rim gro la 'bad pa gal che/ khyod tsho rang rang so so nas legs nyes ci byung yang mchog gsum dam par gsol 'debs legs po gyis zhes sogs kyi bslab bya dang / gdung zhugs 'bul byas na dngos gtsang ba yong tshul sogs 'byung 'gyur gyi skor rnams brtse bas nye bar gzigs te zhib rgyas su gsungs/ lha rten dang phyag dpe do dam byed rgyu dang / re zhig zhal 'don gyi skor cha 169

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsang 'byam/bgos te mdun nas 'don rgyu sogs sku tsha zhabs drung skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / gzhan grwa pa gnyis la gtad pa gnang bas khong rnams kyisabaton pa'i tshe zhal 'don bgos skal gyi cha shas re de'ang tshar dka' ba byung bas lhag par ya mtshan du gyur/ zhabs phyi ba nang ma gnyis la nyin re bzhin khrus gsol dang mnol bsang bdug rgyu'i bkod pa gnang ba 'da' ka ma'i thugs dam gsal ched yin par snang / chos sde chen po'i gdan sa pa che shos mkhan rin po che gtsos 'dus spyi nas zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu'i snyan gsan zhus par/ bka' drin 'khor mtha' ma mchis pa lags/ 'on kyang dus tshod ston zla 'bring po'i tshes mgo la phul na legs zhes rjes kyi rten 'brel du sgyur bar mdzad do/ / de ltar dgung lo re gsum gyi bar du bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad de zhing 'di'i sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pas/ me mo glang gi lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gi snga dro'i char/zhal 'don gyi skor rnams sngar rgyun ltar gsung zhing khams shin tu dwangs pa/bsnyun gyi tshul yang ye med par bzhugs pa la/ nyin gung gi sngon tsam rta'i dus tshod la slebs pa na glo bur du sngar bshams pa'i khri khar zhabs gnyis skyil krung / phyag gnyis sdigs mdzub bsnol thabs su byas pa rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya mdzad de gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir du gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul bstan to/ / mi shig ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༷/ / ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃ spyu ༷/ ṭwāṃbye/ /༷ / ༷ shaṃ ༷shaṃ sgo~X ṭwāṃshaṃ /bye ༷/ bye rtebhe bye ma lus sel ba yi/ / gsung snyan de yang thos pa'i lam las 'das/ / kye 170

༄/ /spyo khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/hud bus pa mya ngam thang bskyur bzhin/ / mgon med skyabs med gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams/ / thugs rjes nam yang 'dor ba mi rigs pas/ / slad kyang brtse bas rjes 'dzin bka' drin mdzod/ / de'i mod la sku mdangs sngar las je gsal du song zhing sku bong je chung dang gnyer ma sogs ye med par gzhon sha chags pa'i 'od phung gi rang bzhin can/ ya mtshan pa'i dris nye skor kun la khyab pa byung / nang gi rtogs pa'i rten 'brel gyis phyi rol tu nam mkha'i dkyil shin tu g.ya' dag cing rgya mthing bzang po ltar sngo ba dang /mtha' skor gyi phyogs kun nas mchod lha rnams kyis gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs nas mchod pa phul ba'i rnam pa lta bu'i sprin dkar gyi phreng ba nye bar 'khrigs/ rlung bser bu'i rgyu ba phra mo tsam yang med pas nyin zhag gsum gyi bar du gzim chu nga gi khyams su mchod pa sna tshogs dang / khyad par du mchod me stong phrag brgal ba phul ba re re'ang rlung gis mibaskyod pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mang du byung bas skye bo rnams bshes gnyen dam pa'i dmigs bu dang bral ba'i mya ngan gyis non bzhin du'ang ya mtshan gyis ltas kyis yid 'phrog ste ched du bajod pa'ang byung ngo / / tshogs chen gye dge 'dun tshang mas gdung mdun du khrus gsol dang smon lam sogs gsungs te zhal mjal zhus shing / bshad sgrub gling sogs grwa tshang so so nas sger du'ang khrus gsol dang smon lam bcas gsungs te tshe rabs rjes 'dzin dang yang srid myur 'byon sogs kyi gsol 'debs nan tan zhus/ zhag gsum gye mtshams nas 'od gsal chos dbyengs su bzhugs pa'i thugs dam grol ba'i rtags shangs bug sogs nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pa sogs byung / de nas slar yang tshad ldan gyi gzhung dang phyag bzhes jilta ba bzhin dri bzang gi chus khrus gsol legs par byas shing gnas yig 171

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sbyor ba dang / na bza' dbu rgyan sogs phul nas bzhugs su bcug ste/mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa bkod pa gang mdzes kyis mtha' bskor/phyogs nye ring gi slob ma che phra mang po dang / lhag par zhabs zhu ba rnams kyis nyin mtshan khor yug tu bla mchod dang khrus gsol/ gsol 'debs mang po/ smon lam gyi rigs phyag dang mchod pa ci 'byor yang yang bshams pa sogs rje btsun bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi thugs zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs la sgo du ma nas gzhol bar gyur/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa kha shas kyis gdung chog gnad smin gsungs/ che shos mkhan rin po ches dbu mdzad bla ma mchod pa'i dus bzang pa tshogs yongs nas nyin bco brgyad kyi ring la dus bzang gi 'don cha dkyus bzhin gsung /gzhan chog grwa pa so so nas gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ bde mchogadus 'khor/ kun rig sogs rgyud sde so so'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs shing dbang len mkhan gyi dge 'dun khyon bsdoms lnga brgya lhag dang / dpal ldan smad rgyud nas kyang sku gdung gi mdun der bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas bdag 'jug bzhes shing / sman pa grwa tshang nas kyang de bzhin gnang ba sogs dam pa de nyid kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i dge pa rlabs chen zhag zhe dgu'i bar du bsgrubs pa la phyag gnyer sogs nas khur blang gis bsnyen bkur zhabs tog gya nom pas mnyes par byas/ sku 'bum chos sde chen po'i dge 'dun sum stong brgal ba la mang ja bcu phrag lhag dang / sku 'gyed zho do skar lnga/ bshad sgrub gling sogs la sku 'gyed zho re/smad rgyud grwa tshang la zho lnga sogs 'tshem med du phul/ chu bzang / gser khog dgon lung / bkra shis 'khyil sogs dgon sde che chung mang po la'ang mang 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa zhus/ rje chu bzang sprul pa'i 172

༄/ /spyo khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/sku rin po cher kha btags/ maṇḍal 'gyog cang / dngul gos sogs dang /rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mchog sprul rin po che/ rje thu'u bkwan rin po che'i sprul pa'i sku/ kho bo cag sogs la'ang lha rdzas mdzod btags/ gos chen yug dngul sogs pa dog pa rgya cher bstar/ sku 'bum du bzhugs pa'i bla ma gdan zur/ sprul sku che phra mtha' dag gcig kyang ma lus pa la phyag rten gya nom pa phul/ rje nyid kyi grwa tshang bkra shis chos gling / dga' ldan dar rgyas gling sogs kyis mtshon dgon sgrub sde rnams la mang 'gyed gang rgyas bcas dgongs rdzogs kyi zhag grangs khongs su phul zhing slar rim pa bzhin/ dbus su paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par ljags bsngo zhu rten lha rdzas gos dar sogs gya nom pa dang / yongs 'dzin dga' ldan khri rin po cher lha rdzas gos dar sogs rgya che ba phul/ lha sa smon lam gyi tshogs la mang ja sogs kye bsnyen bkur/ rgyal tshab de mo no mon han sogs dbus rtsang gi sprul sku che phra mang po dang / mdo smad kyi bla ma gdan zur sprul sku'i rigs mngapo la'ang 'os bstun gyi phyag rten rim par bstar/ rje nyid la dad pa thob pa'i bla dpon che phra dang ser skya mtha' dag gis gdung 'bul gyi zhal 'debs kyang so so'i 'byor 'khos dang bstun pa'i gang legs bgyis te skye ba'i phreng bar mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes par byed pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/gza' tshes dge ba'i nyin smad rgyud dpon slob gser tog sprul pa'i sku ye shes thub bstan rgya mtsho dge 'dun rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas dpalardo rje 'jigs byed kyi cho ga la brten nas sku gdung rin po che zhugs 'bul mdzad/ de'i tshe nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing / nub phyogs byams pa lung ba zer ba nas 'ja' tshon zhig shar te pur khang gi steng du zug pa mang pos mthong zhing / du ba'i mdog kyang lha bris mkhas pas tshon mdangs spel 173

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i sgoname'i ga༅ 4ma/ba lta bur shin tu bkra ba'i ya mtshan pa pur khang gi steng du yid tsam 'khod nas thog mar nub byang dang / de nas phyogs kun tu song / zhugs 'bul mdzad mkhan gyi bla ma dge 'dun rnams la yon 'bul dang zhabs tog gzab rgyas zhus/ pur khang la nyin zhag drug gi ring mchod pa rgya cher phul te/nang slob 'ga' zhig dang zhabs phyi pa rnams nas pur khang gi sgo phye bar/ sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum rab dbye las/ 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel ni/ /yon tan stobs kyis byung ba ste/ / skye bo rnams kyi bsod nams rten/ / zhes dang / garma chags med kyis/ dbu bum ril dung dkar g.yas 'khyil sogs/ / de byung na mchog ste nor 'khrul med/ / ces pa ltar dbu thod ril por bzhugs pa'i nang du thugs ljags spyan gsum babs shing / ring bsrel mang du byon pa der 'khod thams cad kyis mngon sum du mjal bas lhag par dad pa'i gsos su gyur/ gdung rus btu tshul dang shul du ji ltar bya ba rnams kyang phyag len ltar byas/ sku tsha zhabs drung dang phyag mdzod che ching chos rje sogs zhabs zhu ba rnams nas khur blang bgyis te sku gdung rin po che bzhugs yul gyi mchod rten phyag tshad dang ldan zhing gser mdangs gzi 'od 'bar ba/ rin po che du ma'i phra tshom gyis mdzes pa'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa che legs gnyis bsgrubs pa'i nang du thugs ljags spyan gsum dang sku gdung gi ring bsrel rnams bzhugs su gsol zhing / gzhan yang rten sna du ma dang gzung 'jug cha tshang ba sogs dam pa gong ma'i phyag len dang mthun par phul nas khri ba'i gdan sa bkra shis chos gling gi bla brang dang / sku 'bum chos sde chen po'i nyid kyi bla brang phun tshogs 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gzim chung gnyis su skye dgu'i bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa dam par bzhugs pa la rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas par byas te byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar zhing 174

༄༅/ /tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dge mtshan gye dpal chen po brgyud ma nas brgyud mar 'byung ba'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa du ma'ang lhun gyis grub par gyur to/ / dpag bsam shing dang dzogs ldan sprin bzhin du/ / gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rlabs po ches/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zag med dgongs pa dang / / gdul bya'i bsod nams tshogs chen lhan cig rdzogs/ / mya ngan gdung ba'i rno tsub chab rom yang / / thugs rje'i 'od kyis chu ru zhu ba las/ / rnam dkar 'du byed lbu ba'i 'phreng bar bcas/ / rtag 'dzin rgyud kyi zhing skam rlan par byed/ / ha ri tsan dan bcad gtubs bsregs pas kyang / / bsung zhim ngad kyi dri bzang 'thul ba ltar/ / kun bzang spyod pa'i sgyu 'phrul ji ltar du/ / bstan yang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho mchog tu 'gyur/ / zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal las sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdzad pa dgongs rdzogs kyi rnam dkar sgrub tshul dang bcas pa'i dra ba phyed pa ste bdun pa'o/ /byedī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ༷rdo/༷sa/ rdo 'a// ṭwāṃX sdubyer nghruhūṃ ༵ snru tt+waṃ hūṃṭwāṃ shaṃni ṭwāṃ ༷ hūṃ~X ṭwāṃṭwāṃ niXbhe ༷rjirte ṭwāṃṭwāṃ byedi poṭwāṃdhri // ༷༵ṭwāṃ/ ṭwāṃ/༷ ༷༷༷ ༷ ṭwāṃṭwāṃ sdi ṭwāṃX rdo // ༵ ༷ṭwāṃ dka'ispyod pa rgya mtshor bslab pa'i tshul/ / bgrang yas bskal pa rgya mtshor brjod mi nus/ / 'on kyang rgyal sras spyod pa'i cha shas tsam/ / rnyog bral dwangs pa'i yid kyis bsngags pa yang / / bsod nams mi zad gter du 175

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/'doms pa yi/ / rgyal gsung tshad mas yid ni spro bas drangs/ / rga bas non pa'i mi sdug sprin nag las/ / dar bab lce yi 'khrul 'khor glog dmar gye/ /rjes 'gro legs bshag snyan 'gyur 'brug gi sgras/ / skal ldan mdongs mtha' dad pa'i gtos bzang 'dzin/ / rnyed bkur bung ba'i glu dang mi 'grogs shing / / phyogs lhung tsha ba'i gdung ba ring du spangs/ / rnam dag dad pa'i chu gter rgyas byed pa/ / phul byung rtogs pa brjod pa'i zla zer 'dis/ / khams gsum 'byor par rngam pa'i kha gdangs shing / / chags sdang ris su gcod pa'i mche ba gtsigs/ / chos min ngar skad mthon por sgrogs rnams kyi/ / zhal gyi padmo padmo bzhin du byed/ / rnam 'byed shes rab mig gis mthong ba'i lam/ / dad brtson gom pas bgrod pa'i gzur gnas rnams/ / ded dpon mchog gi bshul 'di ma bor bar/ / mi gnas zhi ba'i grong khyer bsnyegs par mdzod/ / sgra don phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam thar gyi/ / rgun 'brum yongs smin mngar ba'i ro bda' ba/ / phyogs 'dzin mchu nad bral ba'i mgron kun la/ / phan dang bde ba'i dga' ston mchog tu sbel/ / tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i rnam dkar las kyis mtshon/ / sbyin dang ༷༵ bhe bhe ni ༷ rte bheX shaṃ /she bhe/༷// ༷/bhe/ | ༵ bheshaṃ/༷ /༷༷ shaṃbhe chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dge mtshan gyi/ / rdzogs ldan snang bas rtag tu rtsen gyur cig / ces dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas shing grub pa'i 176

༄/ /spyo khrimayobastan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal/dbangaphyug rje btsun bla ma dam pa tshul khrims bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni sku tsha co ne zhabs drung skal bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ bo kyā chos rje'i sprul sku ngag dbang phun tshogs/ phyag mdzod rgan pa che ching chos rje rab 'byams pa tshul khrims chos 'dzin/ khri 'tshab bla ma rab 'byams pa shes rab dbang phyug sgom pa ngag dbang smon lam/ phyag mdzod gzhon pa dar han rab 'byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ chos rje bstan 'dzin bzang po/ rab 'byams pa tshul khrims bstan 'dzin/ rab 'byams pa mi 'jigs rdo rje/ rab 'byams pa ngag dbang phun tshogs/ hor kyu'i ri khrod pa grags pa don grub/or du su dge slong dkon mchog snyan grags/ dbu mdzad dge slong blo bzang don grub/ drung yig dge slong tshul khrims bstan 'dzin/ gsol dpon dge slong blo bzang nyi ma/ desmi dge slong shes rab nyi ma/ dge tshul rgyal mtshan don grub/ dge tshul blo bzang don grub/ dge tshul blo bzang tshul khrims/ dge tshul shes rab dar rgyas/ dge tshul rin chen zla bzang / dge tshul blo bzang dpal 'byor/ dge tshul blo bzang skal ldan/bstan pa dar rgyas sogs zhal slob sku 'khor thun mong nas gser gyi maṇḍal sogs bdog pa rgya chen po dang bcas nan tan du bskul zhing / nyid kyi rtsa ba'isbyin bdag sa skyong mi'i dbang po wang tshe ring don grub/ bee li 'jam dpal don grub/ bai zi ratna sirnyi/ ja sag yul jos thu da'i ching rdo rje sogs nas kyang dngul gyi maṇḍal/ gos chen yug kha shas sogs kyi skyes dang bcas snga phyir bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rtsom gdan gyi sa bon gsal zhing legs par 'dug pas de nyid gzhir bzung / ngag rgyun khungs dag 'ga' zhig rang gis thos pa dang / gong 177

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'isgroname'i ga las/'og bsgrigs te dpyad pas go ba rnyed pa rnams kyis zur brgyan gal che ba rnams tshad ma'i lung dang sbyar te/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i bgrang bya bcu gnyis song ba 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lor/ rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du dgun mtshams kyi skabs thun gseng la sug bris su bgyis pa las/ dpe shog tu 'bebs pa po ni gtsug lag 'byed pa'i blo mig can sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa 'dis kyang maci nā tha dī tī ya dza ya bee shā sa ra sarba dikka lo da ya tsa pusgo dīsto stachu / /178

༄/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /༄7/ / bstan pa'i rtsa lag yil gog san er ti ni mer gen paṇḍi ta hra thog thu blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas kyi rnam thar nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sgrib med spyan ras zur tsam btsa' bas kyang / / phra zhib blang dor gnas kun 'khrul med du/ / smra ba'i blo dang spobs pa'i mchog sbyin pa/ /'jam mgon bstan pa'i 'khor los shis pa stsol/ / blo bzang rgyal bstan nyin mor byed pa la/ / thugs bskyed dar bab 'phrin las 'od stong gis/ /phan bde sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyas mdzad pa/ / mtshungs bral 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig / rdo rje rnon po'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gar/sras bcas rgyal ba'i longs spyod 'khor lo ru/ / bskal pa'i phyi mthar bkram yang gtugs min pa/ / blo chung sbrang bu'i 'dab mas ji ltar gzhal/ /gser ldan khor yug yangs pa'i nor sbyin phyogs/ / thub bstan dbyar gyi lang tshos zin pa na/ / mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes mchog padma'i 'phreng / /kun kyang ljongs der rgyan du lhags pa bzhin/ / snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs bcas sprul pa'i gar/ / rgyal dbang yab sras rdo rje'i bka' lung gis/ / bstan pa'i nyi ma rim brgyud skye ba'i 'phreng / / bsngags pa'i mardo ra ba ci yang 'thor/ / utpal 'dab ltar yangs pa mkhyen pa'i spyan/ / ldan pa 179

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/gang dag mdzad pa'i sgo gcig nas/ / rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bkod pa rdzogs pa'i tshul/ / mngon par chub pas mos gus spu long g.yo/ / 'on te skog gyur gnas la tshad ma'i lung / / dpang du byas te tshu rol mthong bas kyang / / mngon par dmigs pa'i mdzad pa thun mong ba/ / 'ga' tsam dad pa'i gsos su sbel bar bya/ / dge legs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi / rmang gzhi dad pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan cing / / tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i blo gros yangs pa rnams/ / phyogs lhung dor te gus pas bsten par mdzod/ /de'ang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge ta bya dge dang ldan/ / zhes ri bo dge ldan pa'i lugs bzang byang nas byang gi phyogs mthar dar bar lung bstan pa bzhin gyi dus la babs pa na/ dpal 'phreng seng ge nga ro'i mdo las rgyal sras kyi smon lam mtha' yas pa thams cad smon lam chen po gcig gi nang du 'dus shing chub pa ni dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam du gsungs pa dang / lung gzhan las kyang / de tshe grags chen rgyal sras rnams/ /phyogs der bstan pa 'dzin par smon/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams ni yul dang dus gang na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba der bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes nas gdul bya'i skal pa dang 'tsham par theg pa gsum gyi byang chub tu bkri bar mdzad pa ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin dus las yol ba nam yang mi srid pas/ rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi gter mdzod/ byang phyogs kyi skye 'gro rnams mtho ris dang thar par 'khrid pa'i 'dren pa bla na ma mchis pa/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i rtsa lag blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid rlabs po che'i thugs bskyed rta ljang shing rta bdun gyis drangs te/ skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams yangs pa'i lha lam ngos la yang yang mngon 180

༄/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /par shar nas/ skye dgu'i legs byas kyi pad tshal cir yang bzhad par mdzad pa'i tshul kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang bos mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs bdun ma dang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs bcu gsum ma sogs yid ches pa'i lung gis gsal bar bstan pa ltar yin la/ de'i nang nas 'dir 'ga' tsam smos na/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i mdun sar khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab par 'khrungs te sems bskyed pa ni mtshon pa tsam yin te/ bdag cag gi ston pas thugs bskyed tshul la'ang drin lan bsab pa/ mdo sde bskal bzang / pad dkar/ myang 'das/rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod sogs las mi 'dra ba sna tshogs gsungs pa ltar/dam pa 'di'ang rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi skye bar gsungs la/ de ni jo bo yabasras dang sku 'phreng du mar 'brel te rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslab tshul bka' gdams glegs bam las 'byung ba ltar ro/ / der ma zad khu rngog 'brom gsum 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po dang sbyar ba'i tshe rngog 'jam dpal gyi rnam 'phrul du gsungs la/ de ltar na zla bas 'jug 'grel du/'phags pa 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpar gyur pa nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la sogs pa sems bskyed pa 'dzin du gzhug par 'don pa yin no/ / zhes bshad pa ltar rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu gyur pa dang /rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo'i tshul 'dzin pa sogs gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas ni smra bsam gyi ra ba las 'das so/ / thun mong ba ltar na'ang lha chos bdun ldan gyi bka' gdams nor bu'i phreng ba'i bdag por gyur te/ man ngag byen rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i rtsa ba 'di nyid la thug go/ de bzhin du shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan yang mkhyen brtse nus pa mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs la dbang 'byor cing / ngor chen sogs skabs de'i sa skya'i 181

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bstan 'dzin kun gyis gtsug rgyan du bkur te gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi gdams pa'i bdag por gyur pa dang / de nas khri thog bcu drug pa rgya ra gur ba chos skyong rgya mtsho'ang rje bla ma'i mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag thugs su chud de byang rtse dang dga' ldan gyi khrir phebs/ thub pa'i gos sku chen mo bzhengs pa sogs mdzad pa rlabs che zhing / smad rgyud kyi khrod chen brgyad kyang 'di nyid kyis mdzad de dge ldan bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa sogs rgya bod kun tu mkhas grub kyi skye 'phreng du ma bzhes nas bstan pa'i srog bzung ba yin la/ de nas dus kyi rim pas byang phyogs chen po hor gyi yul dublo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba'i thugs bskyed 'phrin las kyi dus la babs pa na/ thugs rje dang mkhyen pa zung du 'jug pas 'gro kun thar pa'i lam du bkri ba la 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'gro mgon bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / de'i yang srid lus can mtha' dag la brtse ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa bdag nyid chen po rje btsun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs sku 'phreng gong ma so so'i rnam thar rgyas pa gzhan las shes par bya yi 'dir dpyod pa'i sgo tsam bstan pa yin no/ / dri bral dngas pa'i shel gyi me long ni/ / tshon brgyar 'grogs pa'i mdangs su gsal ba bzhin/ / gang la gang 'tsham gdul bya'i skal ba dang / / mthun par bstan pa'i bkod pa bsam mi khyab/ / rgyal ba'i chos kyi gsang mdzod 'phags lam gyi/ / yan lag brgyad ldan klung chen 'bab pa'i phyogs/ / de na thabs shes gshog yangs gom pa yis/ / rgyal sras chu skyar tshogs rnams lding zhing rtsen/ / de nas skye ba'i 'phreng ba 'di nyid bzhes te bstan 'gro'i mgon mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ bya ra'i lung o nam pa la jing zhes pa'i klung chen gyi 'gram du rgad po tshe dbang bya ba dang rgan mo dge 'phel bya ba rigs rgyud med cing longs spyod kyis dbul 182

༄/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /bas shin tu nyam thag pa gnyis yod par brtse bas dgongs shing rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal ba can du dgongs te byon pa yin no/ / de'ang rab byung bcu gsum pa'i bgrang bya bcu gcig pa stong 'grel ltar na i shā ra ste dbang phyug tsi na'i skad du khang tshe'u/ dbang thang bstun pa me mo glang gi lo 'bras ldan gyi dus su rgan mo de nyid lci ba 'thu bar song ba'i tshe chu 'gram gyi gad rtsa zhig tu bdag po med par byis pa shin tu chung ngu zhig 'dug pa mthong tsam nas yid du 'ong ba'i dga' ba chen po dang bu'i 'du shes skyes nas blangs te/ 'di ni ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ gang na dam pa bzhugs pa yi/ / sa de yid du 'od ba yin/ / zhes pa ltar byams pa goms pa'i bdag 'bras dang las 'brel gye mthur mngon no/ / slob dpon padma rdzus skyes su grags pa'i rtsa ba'ang 'di 'dra zhig la brten pa'i lo rgyus yod la/ rje btsun tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i slob dpon gyi rnam thar rgya gar lugs las yab yum gyi ming dang bcas pa gsungs so/ / de nas khong gnyis kyis bu bzhin gces par bskyangs pas dzing gi padma bzhin du lang tsho 'phel zhing / de phyin chad khong gnyisakhyang sngar dang mi 'dra bar 'tsho chas sogs rnyed sla bas dga' spro dang ldan par gyur/ rgan mo rang bzhin gyis drang zhing snying rje che ba zhig yin pa'i steng du dam pa 'di nyid pheb pa'i byen rlabs kyis dkon mchog la shin tu gus shing / gang 'byor gyi sbyin pa la spro ba rgyas te/ rgyus yod med la ma ltos par thag ring gi mgron po ngal dub kyis gdungs pa rnams la 'tsho ba stob pa sogs rnam dkar la brtson par gyur/ byis pa de'ang tha mal gyi byes pa gzhan dang mi 'dra bar rtsed mo byang pa'i tshe'ang sa rdo shing sogs la sangs rgyas dang chos mchod rten/ bla ma dgon pa sogs kyi ming btags nas bsgrigs te chos bshad pa dang dgon 'debs pa sogs legs pa'i rten 'brel du 183
