༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/'gyur ba rikho na mdzad/ skye bas thob pa'i yon tan gyis dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / gzungs sngags bzlas brjod la brtson pa/ 'gro ba la snying brtse ba/ mngon shes dang nus mthu ldan pa ste/ ma rgan gyi mig na ba'i tshe bsang shing gis bdug pa'i rnam pa byas pas myur du bde ba dang / mig la ling tog byung ba 'ga' zhig la phyag gis byug pas nad zhi ba dang / la lar khyod kyi nad 'di lo zla 'di tsam na sos yong zhes gsung ba de kho na bzhin gyur pas ngo mtshar gyi gnas la bkod de/ lam sgon las/ mngon shes ldan pa'i nyin mtshan gyi/ / bsod nams dag ni gang yin te/ / mngon shes dag dang bral gyur la/ / skye ba brgyar yang yod ma yin/ / gsungs pa ltar gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i rgyu la dbang 'byor pa'i rnam thar ro/ /skabs shig ro grib kyis gsung ngag mi gsal ba zhig byung yang rim gyis je dngos su song / dgung lo bdun pa'i tshe yab yum gnyis rgyal po'i khral gyis hob te zhes pa'i sa char 'ongs/ snga phyi'i mdzad pa ya mtshan pa rnams la brten nas yab yum gnyis dogs pa skyes shing / dpyod ldan gyi skyes bu gzhan rnams kyang 'di rang ga ba zhig min par 'dug ces gleng ba byung ba'i thog nyin gcig glo bur du nged yil gog san hu thog thu yin zhes gsal bar gsungs/ dgung lo bcu pa'i skabs rmi lam du mdun gyi nam mkha' la mi yig kha dog dmar po 'od 'tsher ba zhig 'dug pa'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling gi snod bcud thams cad gsal bar byed pa byung ba ni byams mgon gyes rjes su 'dzin pa dang 'phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i ltas su mngon/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i tshe yab rgan dus chos su gyur par ci 'byor gyi dge ba bsgrubs/de nas gzhan las bza' btung sogs bslangs te rgan mo rang gi ma dang 'dra bar drin che bar dgongs nas shin tu bkur zhing gso bar mdzad pa'ang dam 184

༄/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /pa'i ngang tshul yin te/ dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ de skad ma yi sri zhu ni/ / chos kyi mchog tu bcom ldan gsung / / zhes pa ltar ro/ / phyogs gzhan la 'tsho ba slong bar phyin nas phyir ldog pa'i lam du bya khye ltog pa mang po gzigs nas gang rnyed de dag la byen te phyir lag stong du 'ong ba'i dus mang la/ res 'ga' phyag na ster rgyu'i zas med pa'i tshe btsan thabs kyis bskyugs te de dag la byin nas tshim par mdzad/ 'di'ang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las sbyin pa la phyi dang nang dang gnyi ga'i sbyin pa gsum du byas pa'i phyi mar gsungs te/ snying rjes rang dbang med par bskul pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar rmad du gyur pa'o/ / dbu ma 'jug par/ rang sha ster la'ang gus par byas pa yis/ / snang du mi rung dpog pa'i rgyur yang 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar sbyin pa la lhag par dgyes pa ni nang gi byams pa dang snyeng rje'i nus pa rjes su dpog pa'i mtshan ma yin te/ khā ta dang skya ga sogs bya rnams kyang mi skrag par sku drung du bsnyen pa ni/ sngon rnal 'byor pa chen po'i drung du ri bong gi phrug gu zhig 'ongs nas rtse ba dang / wa zhig na bza' la snom zhing phyi bzhin 'brang ba sogs byams pa goms pa'i 'bras rtags su gsungs pa bzhin no/ / 'byor pa chung yang rang bzhin bzang zhing 'grogs na bde ba/mgron gyi bsnyen bkur sogs la 'bad pa'i dbang gis skye bo drag zhan sna tshogs 'du ba zhig yod pas/ nyin gcig mi bcu gsum 'ongs par ma la bza' btung sbyin rgyu'i skul ma byas pa na ci'ang med pas thabs mi 'dug zer ba la/ mchod pa'i lhag ro khre dang 'o ma phor chung gang re tsam 'dug pa 'di btsos nas byin byas par/ 'dis ci'ang mi 'dang bas dgos pa med byas kyang nges shes zhes nan gyis 'tshod du bcug ste byin pas thams cad 'grub par da dung mi zad pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bu bstan nas thams cad ngo mtshar la 185

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sa'i khrungaḥm/bkod/ lan cig mi tshang gzhan zhig gi khyim du gzims pa'i tshe khyim gyi nang thams cad 'od kyis gang ste yo byad chung ngu rnams kyang gsapa bar mthong ba na/de'i bza' mi gnyis gas byis pa 'di'i mthu yin par shes/ nas gus 'dud byas/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa blo bzang rin chen dpal bzang po las rab tu byung nas mtshan blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas su gsol zhing dkyus gcig la dge tshul gyi sdom pa'ang bzhes te bslab pa'i gzhi bcus bsdus pa'i tshul khrims legs pa bsrung zhing thos bsam la'ang skabs gang yod du 'bad pa lhur bzhes pas rgan mo'i bande zhes ya rabs tshul bzang gi dpeza byed pa byung / longs spyod kha drag ci'ang med pas gnad ma go ba rnam brnyas thabs lta bu byed/ dam pa nyid nas nged kyis slar hob to'i mkhan po byed dgos/ a la dar zer ba'i sa 'dir yang dgon pa zhig 'debange sha dgos zhes 'byung 'gyur rjen par gzigs pa'i gsung drang por phebs na'ang /skabs de'i snang tshod la de 'dra zhig yong tshul shes byar mi srid pa lta bu dang /yid kyi dku na'ang med pa zhig yin stabs phal mo che bzhad gad du byed de/'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ nang du yon tan kun ldan yang / / cha lugs ngan na kun gyis brnyas/ / gsungs pa'i dper snang ngo / 'on kyang 'khri shing las/ / sprin gyis long yang gza' nang na/ / ku mud ldan la zla ba sdug / ces gsungs pa bzhin bla ma blo bzang rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid nas bum nang gi mar me bzhin dam pa 'di nyid nang du nyams rtogs kyi yon tan la mnga' 'byor ba mkhyen te/ 'di ni skyes bu phal ba zhig min zhes mthong gzos che bar mdzad cing spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin du bskyangs/ dam pa 'di nyid drung nas dbang rdo rje 'phred pa zhes rdo rje rnal 'byor mas a bhya kār la dngos su stsal ba rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo hrag bsdus kyi 186

༄༅/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /smin byed dbang gi rim pa brlan gyi kṛ ya dang sbrags pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ gsang chen rgyud sde'i rgya mtshor zhugasnga nas dngos grub kyi rtsa ba dam tshig spyi dang bye brag mtha' ga mig gi 'arwas bu bzhin du bsrungs/ skabs shig nas ul ya su tha'i mkhar gyi nye 'khor du byon nas der bzhugs/dgung lo nyer brgyad kyi skabam nub cig mnal lam du tshes gsum gyi zla tshes lta ddhi / bye nghru / dīhūṃrdo ṭwāṃṭwāṃ ༷ dhri rdo/ rdoswā py-i dī dīsdi dī snadī bhe ༵ rtsardo ba dī ༵ rdo dhri lnga pas mtshan pa zhig rmis pa dang / nyer dgu'i skabs lug thug dmar po zhes pa'i ri'i g.yon zur du gur che ba bzhi yod pa'i mdun ma'i nang du dngul dkar las grub pa'i thab shin tu che zhing brtan la yid du 'ong ba zhig na sol bakha shas yod pa rnams dor nas thab de blangs 'ong ba zhig mis pa sogs nas bzung snyan grags rgyas te yul mi rnams gus pa je che dang 'phrin las je rgyas su song snang bas/ mnal lam de'ang bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshedakyi 'phrin las la brten nas nag phyogs kyi bdud sde pham par byas te gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi 'od snang dkar po yar tshes kyi zla ba bzhin gong 'phel du 'gro ba/ zang zing gi 'byor pa ji tsam rgyas kyang dkor sgrib kyi rgyur mi 'gyur bar rnam dkar rlabs po che sgrub pa'i thabs su 'khyer bas dad ldan sbyin bdag rnams kyi sdig ltung lhag med du bsreg pa sogs kyi mtshon don zhig yin nam snyam/ de nas mkhan po gu shri chos rje dang / dben par sgrub pa la gzhol ba gu thi mthu stobs rnam gnyis kyi drung nas lhag lha du ma'i rjes gnang sogs 'don chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo so gsum gyi dus rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen pa can nam chi gu thi dpal rdo rje las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rta mgrin yang gsang /187

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung ཿma/spyan ras gzigs sogs kyi dbang dang / sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ 'di dag gi skabs snga phyi kun tu chos gsan pa/ dpe cha 'dzin skyor/ thugs dam bzlas brjod/ phyag dang mchod pa sogs chos spyod rnam bcu ya ma bral bar mdzad pas/ bka' gdams glegs bam du/ nga thos dus tsa na bsam sgo ma bsngo/ / bsam dus tsa na thos sgom bsngo/ / gsungs pa bzhin thos bsam sgom gsum lhan du mdzad pas gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don la mkhyen rab kyi klong rdol zhing nyams rtogs kyi yon tan dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas/ gdul bya 'phrin las kyang cher rgyas te dad ldan gyi gra slob sprin bzhin 'dus/ nad pa nyam thag 'ga' zhig sogs mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon mdzad cing / legs nyes kyi blang dor sogs gsal bar lung bstan pas/ grags snyan gyi rol mo phyogs kun tu khyab bo/ / khyad par du dgung lo so drug pa chu byi'i lor byang phyogs skye dgu'i 'dren mchog rje btsun dam pa'i zhabs la mjal bar dgyes pa'i bka' mchid mang du gnang zhing brtse gzigs che bar mdzad/ bstan pa'i btsas su dgongs te gdan lnga brtsegs rgyab yol dang bcas pa'i gzos sgo dang / er ti ni yil gog san mer gen paṇḍi ta zhes pa'i cho lo gnang /dngul dem sogs zang zing gi gnang cha'ang sbam mtho ba stsal/ rje btsun dam pa'i bka' lung de la brten nas phyogs nye ring kun tu yil gog san ge gen zhes mtshan gyis khyab par gyur/ chos kyi gdan khrir bzhugs pa'i bla ma che chung dang / sde 'bangs stobs 'byor lung las sogs kyis mtho ba'i dpon khag mang po/ chos don du gnyer ba'i tshul mthun gyi gra slob/ nad gdon gyis gzir ba'i 'gro ba nyam thag pa sogs mchog dman kun gyis gtsug rgyan du bkur te 'di phyi'i re sa dang bsod nams kyi zhing sa dam par 188

༄/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /gyur to/ / sku snga ma'i dus sogs su 7gong ma bdag po chen pos mi mkhyen kyang skabs 'dir hob tu'i dmag gi mgo ba am ban tshe dpag zer bas dam pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad phrin sogs mthong nas gus par yod pa'i thog / kun tu bde ba'i lha khang gi mkhan po nā ro paṇa chen ho thog thu 'phos nas de'i tshab cig sko dgos byung ba'i tshe am ban gyis gong ma chen por/ dam pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan che zhing yul phyogs kyi skye bo thams cad shin tu gus pa zhig 'dug pas kun tu bde ba'i lha khang gi mkhan por bskos na e chog ces gre tsi phul bar dgyes pa'i bka' babs te/ dgung lo zhe drug pa rda chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo ston zla ra ba'i yar tshes kyi dga' ba dang por kun tu bde ba'i lha khang gi mkhan por mnga' gsol/ sngar nyid nas mkhan sa 'dir bzhugs rgyu'i gsung phebs thog tu khel bas/ de dus brnyas thabs byed pa rnams kyang 'gyod pa skyes nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes/ dgon 'di'i mkhan po snga ma rnams 7gong ma chen por mjal zhu ma nus kyang / nyid nas zhus par dgyes pa'i spyan bskyangs dang gser gye bka' bzang po babs/ mkhan sa 'dir bzhugs pa nas bzung dur bod/ ja ha ching / thor gong / u ri yan has sogs thams cad kyis bla mar bkur/ ji skad du lung las/ dam pa'i mgon bcas bde dang chos ldan zhing / / de yi grags pa phyogs su rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas yul phyogs de rnams su'ang nad 'khrug mu ge sogs med par bde zhing skyid pa dang rnam dkar dge ba'i las la brtson par gyur/ tshang mas mgrin gcig tu dam pa 'di nyid la gsol ba 'debs shing bsngags pa brjod pa lhur byed do/ / sngar nyid kyi sbyin bdag hal ha g.yas ru'i rā gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i dpon khag 189

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'isgroname'i ཿnga 4ma/rnams nas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog la rje 'di'i 'khrungs rabs kyi bka' rtsom zhus pas 'khrungs rabs bdun tsam gyi gsol 'debs shig gsungs yod na'ang / skabs 'dir gung tshe brtan rdo rje dang chos mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par zhus nas 'khrungs rabs bcu gsum gyi gsol 'debs rgyas pa zhig bka' rtsom dang /nyid la 'bob lcag cha sogs kyi gnang cha dang bcas gzengs bstod mdzad/skabs shig har sha ta'i ther god kyi dpon po bstan skyong dbang rgyal gyi yul phyogs su 'brum nag mched tshab che bas skye bo mang po sdug bsngal bar gyur pa'i mgonaskyabs la dam pa nyid phebs dgos par 7gong ma chen po'i gser gye bka' bab bzhin phyogs der phebs/ skye bo brgya phrag du ma dus kyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs te phan bde'i lam la bkod/ so so nas kyang gser dngul gos dar rkang 'gro sogs pa dog pa'i dngos po yod dgu'i mchod sprin rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du gtibs/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so/ / zhes las kyi 'bras bu dus su smin na sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyob pa'i thabs med par gsungs pa bzhin dpon po de nyid sngon gyi 'phen pa zad pa'i las dbang bzlog tu med par gzigs nas 'di'i srog nged kyis skyob mi nus par 'dug ces gsal bar gsungs shing / des yon phul ba rnams kyang lan gyi tshul du phyir slog ste bdag gir ma mdzad/ nyid rang yul du phyir chibs bsgyur phral dpon po de'ang dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pas thams cad sngar gyi gsung la yid ches lhag par skyes/ yang skabs shig gong ma chen po'i bka' phebs te ho pag sa ra'i thor god kyi sa char byon nas de phyogs kyi rje blon sde 'bangs mtha' dag mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam la spyar/ dgung lo nga lnga pa lcags mo lug gi lo 1༅

༄/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /7gong ma'i gser zhal mjal skabs bstan 'gro la phan 'dog che bar dgongs nas dgyes pa chen pos gser gyi bka' lung bzang po dang / gos chen ser po/ byu ru'i rgyan 'phreng / shing rta ljang gu sogs gnang ste bka' drin tshad med pas bskyangs/ 'jam dbyangs mi rje'i rnam par rol pa 7gong ma bdag po chen po zhabs pad bskal pa khri phrag khri phrag gi bar du brtan pa'i ched dgon pa zhig gsar bzhengs kyi 'phen pa gnang ste/ u yi ya su tha'i mkhar gye jang jun am 'ban brgyud nas 7gong du gre'i tsi phul bar bka' lan 'dod pa bzhin babs pas chu sprel nas bzung las mgo brtsams te/ lha khang che ba gcig chung ba lnga/ 'du khang sgo khang bcas brgyad ka rtsig pa shing cha sogs sra zhing brtan pa/ bkod pas thon zhing gser tshon bzang pos shin tu mdzes pa rnam par rgyal pa'i khang bzang lta bu dang / khor yug lcags ri rgya chen po/ lha khang che ba'i nang du dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan shin tu byon legs/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung dang rje bla ma'i dbu lo sogs ring bsrel rnam bzhis yongs su gtams pas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ seng khri rgyab yol sogs kyang gser 'od 'bar zhing rin po che'i phra tshom gyis spa ba dang / 'khor nye ba'i sras brgyad/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi sku brnyan grangs mtshungs/ ldeb ris la sangs rgyas stong sku/ tshe lha rnam gsum dang sgrol ljang bzhi'i sku brgya phrag re/ 'du khang nang du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku dang bka' 'gyur cha tshang / steng gi gnam rgyan la tshe dpag stong / chos skyong mang po'i sku thang sogs dang / lha khang gzhan rnams la gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs yi dam lhag pa'i lha mang po dang / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sogs dam can chos srung mang po'i sku brnyan rngam brjid dang ldan zhing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba rnams 191

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonasa'i gsung 'bum/bzhengs/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi nyams dang ldan pa'i rgyal chen bzhi sogs sku thams cad kyang mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i chag tshad dang ldan zhing gzi 'od 'bar bas mig gi bdud rtsi lta bur bskrun/ lha khang thams cad du mdzod gos gser ma sogs kyi bla bre dang / phye 'phur rgyal mtshan ka 'phan sogs kyis mngon par bkra pa 'ja' 'od 'khyug pa lta bu/ dbyibs legs 'od 'bar rgyu bzo sogs khyad du 'phags pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad du mtshar du dngar/ phyi ngos kyi ldeb ris la nye sras brgyad/ grub chen brgyad cu/nyid kye 'khrungs rabs bcu gsum ma/ mchod pa'i lha mo mang po dang bcas go mtshams med par bris pa sogs mthong thos dran reg don ldan du 'gyur ba'i bkod pa bla na med pa gnang ste nye zho med par thugs kyi bzhed pa bzhin grub/ rten brten pa kun gyi rgyu song dang / las byed kun la yon sogs gang 'os yid tshim par stsal pa bcas rags rim phyogs bsdoms bgyis pa dngulasrang khri phrag lnga tsam song bas dad ldan rnams kyis phul ba'i bdog pa mtha' dag byang chub snying po mchog gi mthas gtugs par smin pa'i bsod rdo ༵di di nidazhe ༷'i pagaṭwāṃX trī ༵༈disalo testo dibre~X ༵dhri ngadoṭwāṃ dro ༵ ༷rji |rji ༵ṭwāṃdī /'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i dus tshes dge ba la dge 'dun rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas pas spyan dbye'i cho ga smin rgyas phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas legs par bsgrubs te dam ye dbyer med du brtan par byas/mjug tu 'cham dang byams pa gling skor sogs byas pa'i tshe me tog gi 'dab ma'i rnam pa gsal ba'i kha ba cung zad bab pas sa steng dkar 'jam du byas/de 'phral nam mkha' yongs su dngas shing nyi 'od gsal bas bag dro zhing byin chags pa sogs rten 'brel rang 'grig tu byung / de nas hal ha/ dur 192

༄༅/ /rnam thar nor bu'i me long /bed/ ja ha chid/ thor god/ u re yan has sogs kyi sbyin bdag ser skya drag gzhan mang du 'dus pa thams cad kyis lha khang rnams la phyag mchod/dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur sogs lha mchod mi mchod rgya chen po dang / rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid la na bza' nyer spyad/ dngul srang stong rwa can sogs kyi mchod sprin spros te zhabs bad yun brtan gyi gsol 'debs zhus/byin rten dang dngos po'i gnang cha sogs gang 'tsham du stsal te mgu bar mdzad do/ / de ltar bstan 'gro la sman pa'i thugs skyed rlabs po che'i sa bon dus su smin pa'i 'phrin las kyi yal ga phyogs brgyar rgyas/ zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor las g.yo ba med pa'i nyams rtogs kyi 'bras bu g.yur du za/snyan par grags pa'i dri bsung mngar po byang phyogs kyi 'dzin ma'i khor yug khyab par 'phro/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i grib bsil snum pos nyam thag ༷ṭwāṃ ༷༷ /༷ ༷/ rteṭwāṃ shaṃ bhe sdiṭwāṃ bye shlau ṭwāṃ rto dī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ sde ṭwāṃbhe sdiX nor rgyas kyis drangs pa/ / bdag blo'i rin chen ri bo mardo ras/ / dam pa'i yon tan chu gter bsrubs pa las/ / rtogs bajod gsar ba'i zla ba 'di 'khrungs so/ / legs bshad dzing bur 'khyil ba phyogs dang mtshams/ /gang du drangs kyang chil chil 'bab ba las/ / ngo mtshar lbu ba dkar bo'i 'phreng dkrigs pa/ / ched du brjod pa'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun 'di babs/ /rnam pa gsum gyis bskal pa'i bshul ring lam/ / yid ches lung dang bden tshig mkhar ba la/ brten nas sdeb legs gom stabs bskyod pa 'dir/ /nongs pa mchis gang mkhas pa'i tshogs la 'chags/ / rlabs chen thugs 193

༄/ /gung thang bayo rsāsgonama'i rsāng 'a4/bskyed yu ba rab brtan cing / / jes lags dbang gi rgyal po'i tog mdzes pa/ / bshes gnyen dam pa'i mdzad bzang gdugs dkar po'i/ / bsil bar byang phyogs skye dgus ngal gso mdzod/ / gnam sa'i khor yug 'gengs par gdangs pa'i zhal/ / srid gsum dgra bgegs kham du byed ba yi/ /srung ma ye shes spyan ldan tshogs rnams kyis/ / bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod/ / 'dren mchog zhabs pad rdo rje'i gshis su brtan/ /mdzad 'phrin 'od snang sa gsum kun tu khyab/ / 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs phyogs mthar rgyas/ / rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston 'phel gyur cig / rtse gcig gus pa lhur len slob ma'i tshogs/ / rgyal blon 'bangs bcas tshe rabs 'phreng ba ru/ / bla ma mchog gis 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ / yang dag lam gye bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces byang phyogs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa yil gog san er ti ni mer gan pani ta ho thog thu blo bzang bstan pa dar rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed dpa' ris zhabs drung er ti ni mkhan po ngag dbang mkhyen brtse sogs thur chen dgon thos bsam dar rgyas gling gi bla sbyi thun mong nas snga phyir yang yang bskul zhing / chos rje blo bzang dkon mchog ngo g.yog ched gtad kyis 'ongs te bskul ba bzhin/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa ratna ā nantas bgyis pa 'dis kyang sarba pra dza kā le ṣā shri ya ( snyi ma stu / /194

༄༅/ /mkhayogrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabarjod legasatshogasasgo 'byed/༄7/ / nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen chen po mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa legs tshogs sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal gyi cha shas yongs gang phyag rgya'i ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes/ / dmigs med mkha' la bde chen snying rje'i sgyu 'phrul rlung gi bgrod pa brten/ / rnam pa kun tu 'phel 'grib snang bas 'gog pa med par rtag 'char ba/ / rdo rje 'chang dbang zhabs skyes kurdo dad pa'i zur phud rgyan du rol/ de nyid ngur smrig 'chang ba'i zol brten pa/ / 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i padma bzhad pa'i gnyen/ / 'jigs med dbang po srid zhi'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / deng nas byang chub bar gyi mgon mdzod cig / yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje/ / tshul bzhin bsten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru/ /legs par mthong nas 'bad pa du ma yis/ / gus pa chen pos tshul bzhin bsten pa las/ / de yi 'bras bu rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / thun mong lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang / / gsang chen rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar son pas/ / mkhas shing grub brnyes bstan 'dzin mchog der 'dud/ /khengs dregs 'dod pa'i phyogs su ma lhung bas/ / nor bzang mched zlar gyur pa de yi gtam/ / rang bzhin gsong por brjod pa'i bden tshig gis/ / thar 'dod 'jug ngogs ma nor dbye bar bya/ / de yang sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa 195

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/rnams bstan pa'i byung rim lta bu sbyi'i lo rgyus kyi khongs su thor bu thor bur byung ba'am/ rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i bstod pa nyung shas re dang /gdams pa'i brgyud rim lta bur byung ba rnams khog bsgrigs te/ rnam thar gye ngag rgyun tsam byung ba las paṇa grub re re bzhin gyi rnam thar so sor bsgrigs pa'i srol ma byung ngo / / 'on kyang de'i tshe gdul bya rnams dbang po rno bas phyogs re re tsam gye sgo nas kyang bla ma'i yon tan dpog nus shing /skyes bu dam pa de dag gis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas spel ba'i bshad rgyun dang / zab mo'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i grub 'bras sogs bstan pa la phyag rjes rgya cher bzhag pa dang / de la brten pa'i grags snyan 'jig rten kun la ri mor bris pa bzhin du gnas pas rnam thar gyi yi ge logs su bkod pa la ma ltos so/ / de nas dus kyi lang tsho rim gyis snyigs ma'i mtha' la gzhol bas/ dam pa dang dam pa ma yin pa'i bye brag phyed pa nyung bar gyur pa na/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis de'i dbye ba shes pa dang / bshes gnyen la dad pa 'phel zhing de'i mdzad pa'i rjes su slob pa'i phyir bla ma so so'i rnam thar re bsgrigs pa'i srol phye ba yin par snang /de las kyang da dung ches shin tu snyigs mar gyur pa na skye bo rnams blang dor 'byed pa'i blo'i nus pa chung zhing / chags sdang gi kun rtog g.yo ba'i phyogs su lhung ste dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dang / zang zing gi 'du 'god tsam la snying por byed pa'i ngan rtog 'dod pa'i phugs su 'chang ba'i rang mdangs kyis bla ma'i rnam thar sgrig tshul sogs kyang srid kyi khe grags kho na rtsal du bton pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba mang du spro bar snang ba ni blo gzu por gnas shing blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rnams mgu bskyed pa'i thabs su mi 'gyur te/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan rgyas/ skyon mang dug gi 196

༄za/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogayobajod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/tsher ma'i tshogs 'khrigs kyang / / yon tan yongs 'du'i tshul bzhin sgro btags te/ / dbyar skyes rnga gsang stong ltar cher sgrogs pa'i/ / rnam thar tshul la kho bo yid ma ches/ / dam pa'i snying la 'jigs pa sbyin byed pa/ /dugagasum chang gis rab tu myos pa yi/ / zlos gar mngon par bsgyur kyang tshul bstan zhes/ / yol ba'i phag tu 'chel la'ang bdag mi dad/ / mdo rgyud dam pa'i gzhung dang bstun pa na/ / mngon mtho'i 'bras bzang bskrun pa'i sa bon kyang / / rnam par myags mod 'on kyang kun mkhyen du/ / rlom zhing gsal bar sgogs la'ang bdag mi mgu/ / gti mug mun pas yid bslang ngo tsha bral/ / bag med spyon pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyang / / zeg mchog gsang ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa zhes/ / gya gyu'i rnam thar tshul la'ang bdag mi mos/ / chags sdang brling po'i thugs rgyud zho 'thung bu'i/ / rus par 'gran kyang gsung 'jam zhi dul can/ / ngur sprig gis mdzes tsher ma daragatums can/ / 'phyon ma'i rnam thar tshul la'ang bdag mi dga'/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar ro/ / des na sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar ni/ 'ga' zhig gis dal 'byor rnyed dka'i chos skor la rtsal du bton pa'i khungs nas sa lam gyi rtogs pa gzhan thams cad rdol ba lta bu/ la las mi rtag pa kho na gtso bor bsgom pas/ de la myong ba thon pa na des sna drangs te sa lam gyi rtogs pa gzhan thams cad rtsol ba med par skyes pa lta bu/'ga' zhig la rang gi sems nyid ngo sprad pa na de'i shugs kyis sgro 'dogs thams cad lhag ma med par chod de grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gyur ba sogs gdams pa rang rang gi bka' babs mi 'dra ba'i lo rgyus sna tshogs yod la/ dpal nā ro pa/ mnyam med jo bo chen po/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs phal cher bshes gnyen dam pa 197

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgroname'i khrung 'bum/dka' ba brgya phrag gi sgo nas bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten pa kho na lam gyi srog tu byas pa'i stobs kyis lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i gter du gyur cing / rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las sa steng kun tu khyab pa byung ngo / / des na zeg pa che chung mdo sngags gang gi dbang du byas kyang yang dag pa'i lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba la de'i rmang gzhi lta bu lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'di nyid la chig dril du 'bad dgos pa ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug yin te/ chos yang dag par sdud pa las/sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes/ / yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsungs/ / zhes ston pa yang dag par dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang thog mar rgyu bshes gnyen bsten tshul phyin ci ma log par nyams su bstar ba de'i 'bras bu rang rgyud la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin pa brnyes te/ rang gis ji ltar mngon du mdzad pa'i thabs kyi rim pa de nyid gdul bya rnams la ston par mdzad pa yin no/ / sngon byon dam pa'i skye bo de dag gi rnam par thar pa ji lta ba bzhin du bdag nyid chen po 'dis kyang da lta'i skye bo yang dag pa'i lam gyi rmang gzhi 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang rul bzhin du gyur skyes bu la ci yang mi sems par man ngag zab zab mo kho na la mtho snyegs su byed pa'i lugs dor te/ thog ma kho nar mgo bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'di la rten 'brel gyi cha phra mo tsam yang ma 'chug par gzhon nunor bzang gi rnam thar las 'byung ba bzhin du phyag len la 'debs par mdzad pa ni/ rnam par thar pa gzhan thams cad kye rtsa ba dang snying po lta bur snang bas/ de'i gnas tshul gyi gzhung bsrings shing / de la brten nas lung rtogs kyi yon tan brnyes tshul dang / bstan 'gror phan pa rlabs po che mdzad pa sogs yan lag gi tshul du byas te 'god par bya'o/ / de la 198

༄za/ /mkhayogrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshog4sgo 'byed/gang du 'khrungs pa'i gnas ni mdo smad lho rgyud kyi sa'i cha mdzo dge smad du grags pa'i nang tshan ru stod ma'i shog tu yab mdzod pa sgom pa rgyal dang /yum 'brug mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su chu mo phag gi lor sku 'khrungs/ yab yum gnyis ka yang rang bzhin gyis chos la dkar zhing sdig spyod la 'dzem pa sogs ya rabs kyi ngang tshul can gnyis yin la/ 'byor ba ha cang mi che yang dbul bas nyam thag pa yang ma yin pas bar mar gnas pa zhig ste/ de yang 'dul ba lung las/ ha cang phyug po'i khyim dang ni/ / dbul ba'i khyim du mi skye bar/ / bar ma'i khyim du skye 'gyur zhing / rtag tu rab byung mang bar shog / ces mtha' gnyis gar mi gnas pa'i khyim de lta bur skyes pa ni rab tu byung zhing chos sgrub pa dang rjes su mthun par sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsngags par mdzad do/ / lhums su gnas skabs yum gyi rmi lam du dge slong dbang phyug seng ge zer bas gser gye rdo rje 'od 'tsher ba zhig gtad de 'di la gtsang spra legs par gyis zhes zer ba dang / yul mi gzhan 'ga' zhig la yang rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba ci rigs byung zhing / khyad par sku 'khrungs pa'i mtshan mo der khu bo rgyal mtshan zer ba'i dge slong bgres po rje btsun ma sgol ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung ste rgyun du bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pas/ byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan ci rigs thob pa zhig yod pa de'i rmi lam du sgom pa rgyal tshang gi khyim gyi phu na ston pa'i gser sku zhig bzhugs pa la mi mang po mjal zhing / rgya mo'i cha byad can gye bu mo 'ga' zhig gis khrus gsol byed pa rmis te/ phyir nyin zhog ka de'i gnas tshul bshad bzhin pa'i thog tu sgom pa rgyal 'ongs te/ nged la bu chung zhig skyes yod pas der khrus shig byed dgos byas par/ khong yang ya mtshan du gyur te/ de ma thag dga' bzhin du song nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs chus khrus dang mnol bsang 199

༄/ /gung thang bam pa'i me'i ga lam/bdug pa sogs byas/ pha ma gnyis la yang gtsang spra gal che tshul nan tan gyis bshad/ rmi lam rjes ma 'di ni 'byung 'gyur dang mthun pa'i mtshan ma don chen po dang ldan pa zhig tu mngon te/ lung rnam 'byed las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yi bstan bcos ni/ / mdo dang chos mngon yin gsungs 'dul ba ni/ / ston dang bstan pa nyid yin/ zhes dang / so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ da ni mya ngan 'das 'og na/ / 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa zhes/ / rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par/ / nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun bstod/ / ces rjod byed 'dul ba'i sde snod dang / brjod bya lhag pa'i tshul khrims gnyis ni bstan pa'i gzhi dang ston pa'i dod du gsungs la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'dul pa 'dzin pa chen po dag la mnyam med thub pa rin po che'i chos kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur zhes 'dul ba'i sde snod kun tu bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad cing / khyad par du gso spyong gi gzhi las/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa/ zhes pa nas/ ston pa 'das pas de'i bstan pa la 'di ni ston pa dang / 'di ni rten yin te/zhes thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gdung 'tshob tu gsungs pa dang /sku brnyan yang kun rdzob pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sangs rgyas kyi dod du byas pa 'brel shin tu mtshungs so/ / yum gyi rmi lam yang skabs der yul phyogs su bu tshong cher ma dar ba'i dus yin pas rmis pa bden nges yin la/ de lta na rje'i rnam thar sogs su'ang 'byung ba ltar don shin tu che'o/ / chung ngu'i dus nas byis pa phal ba dang mi 'dra bar spyod pa gtsang zhing mthong na yid du 'thad pa zhig yod pas/ thams cad kyis kyang 'di chos kyi bag chags can zhig tu 'dug ces gleng ba byung / rim gyis skyed bsrings te cung zad nar son pa na rte'u ldang rnams dang lhan cig rtsed mo byed pa'i tshe yang g.yam pa 200

༄༅/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/sgor mo'i steng du dkar gong spungs pas maṇḍal 'bul ba sogs skabs der mthong 'dris 'ong don med pa'i chos mthun gyi rtsed mo sna tshogs byed pa byung /'di ni sngar sgrub pa la gzhol ba dang / sku tshe 'dir yang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel gnad can zhig ste/ kha cig nga la rta 'di 'dra yod/ gnyer ba 'di 'dra yod zer ba dag las bag chags gong mar gyur pa zhig go / dgung lo brgyad pa lcags rta'i lor bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims bzhes shing mtshan bstan 'dzin seng ger btags/skabs de na bsrung bya'i mtshams sogs dri ba'i yul 'phral du mi rnyed pas thugs 'tsher zhing la las 'di ltar byed mi rung zer ba re byung bar/ de ma thag nas dga' bzhin du de'i tshig dang du blangs te spong ci thub mdzad/'di ni skye ba'i phreng bar 'chal tshul spong ba la goms pa ngang du gyur pa'i rnam thar te/ da lta 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs rgya chen po la sbyangs pa mthar son du rlom pa mang po yang / gang na gnang ba'i cha zhig yod snyam du yang cha 'ba' zhig gi sgrub byed tshol ba ni phugs rul pa'i rtags yin pas/ lag len dogs mtha' nas byed dgos par kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba dang / rje yab sras kyisagasungs so/ / klog slob pa na yang klog gi slob dpon de la gus pa che zhing / des gang gsungs thams cad do gal chen pos thugs la bcings te brtson pa lhur mdzad pas/ ma 'gyang bar phral klog sbyar klog kun la byang zhing / de'i zhar byung la yul phyogs su dar cha che ba'i chos spyod sogs kyang phal cher thugs la chud par mdzad/ klog gi slob dpon de nyid rjes sor 'das pa'i skabs su gnas der bzhugs med kyang / gsan ma thag tu phebs nas gdung gi zhabs la 'jus te/ mchi ma'i rgyun bcad par dka' ba'i gdung shugs drag po dang bcas smon lam dang gsol ba btab/201

༄/ /yo thang gas pa'isgroname'i go lam/phyogs dben par gdung gi cha thams cad dri bzang gi chus legs par bkrus te gnas yig 'god pa sogs bkur sti'i rim gro phal ba'i blor mi shong ba lta bu mdzad/ da lta mtha' dbus kun tu klog gi slob dpon la bla mar brtsi ba shin tu dkon pas/ chos la 'jug pa'i thog ma rang nas de'i rten 'brel rnam pa gzhan du 'gro ba mang yang / dam pa 'di ni gzhan gyis bcos pa la ma ltos par de la yang bla mar 'dzin pa zhig shugs 'byung du yod pa ni/ skye bo col chung bkra shis dang dge mtshan gyi lta ba la goms pa 'ga' zhig / chu zom re dang phrad pa tsam la rten 'brel 'grig par sgrogs pa lta bu ma yin par rje bla mas gsungs pa bzhin/ de ni 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa kho na yin no/ / des na bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis klog slob pa'i slob dpon la yang shin tu gus par bya dgos te/slob dpon a nus/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / / rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ / ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ / yi ge'i spyor ba bshad par bya/ / gsungs pa bzhin thos bsam sgom pa mtha' dag 'di'i steng nas byed dgog pas bka' drin ngos zin par gyis shig / klog pher pa tsam ma yin par sum rtags la yang zhib thigs su sbyangs pas/ sngon 'jug rjes 'jug pho mo ma ning gi dbye ba sogs gtsug lag gi gnad la go ba gting tshugs pa byung / byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas snga ma'i las 'brel gyi dbang gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la lhag par dad pa che ba zhig yod pas/ lan cig sman pa zhig gis sman 'thu bar mngags pa na/ gzer 'joms me tog kha dog dmar ser can gyis ri klung thams cad gang ba'i phyogs gcig gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku'i rnam pa dang / de'i zhing khams sogs rjes su dran pa'i dad gus kyis ba spu g.yo ba byung / 'di 202

༄/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/ni sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi dus na tshogs su me tog sngon po brims pa snang ba'i rkyen gyis snga ma'i bag chags sad de zad par sngon po'i ting nge 'dzin grub pa'i byung ba dang cha 'dra'o/ / na tshod gzhon nu'i skabs der yang res 'ga' rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku'i rnam pa yid la byas pa na phyogs mtshams thams cad 'jam dbyangs kyi sku che chung sna tshogs kyis go mtshams med par gang nas bzhugs pa'i nyams dang / yang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku'i rnam pa yid la byas pa na/ snga ma'i snang ba gnas gyur te spyan ras gzigs kyi sku de lta bus gtams pa dang / de bzhin du phyag rdor gyi sku de 'dra bas yongs su gang ba sogs phal mo che zhig zhal gzigs su sgrogs pa'i tshod kyi snang ba de 'dra ba nar mar 'byung ba zhig yod kyang / dam pa 'di ni thugs shin tu sgam pas de la mtshar du mi 'dzin par/ dper na rgyang ring po'i grong la sogs pa'i bkod pa yid ngor lam gyis shar ba dang 'dra bar nyams dang don spyi'i snang ba tsam yin pas/ gtad pa cher med dgongs te btang snyoms su 'jog pa gnang / dgung lo bco brgyad pa lcags 'brug gi lo/ mkhas pa dang grub pa ma lus pa'i gtsug gi nor bu/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po mdzo dge'i dgon par chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba'i tshe zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal ba na/ lag gcig ma yin par rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa'i bag chags kyis tshad med pa'i mos gus drag pos yid rang dbang med par g.yos te dad pa'i mchi ma 'khrug cing lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba byung / dam pa nyid kyi zhal nas kyang /de skabs skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhal mjal ma thag tshe 'di snang gi shes pa 'gag 'gro ba lta bu'i dad pa skyes shing / de nas bzung ste nyin mtshan thams cad du kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa brjed ma myong zhes gsungs 203

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsang 'bum/'dug pa ni rnam dpyod can zhig gis bltas na ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar chen po yin te/ 'di'i dad pa skye tshul yang / da lta'i skye bo rgod pa'i kha la bltas na rgod bro zhing / ngu ba'i kha la bltas na ngu bro ba rnams kyi dad pa g.yam la rgyug gi dga' lhang lhang pa de tsam ma yin par/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ blo gzu bor gnas pas tshe 'di snang gi bya byed sogs rang gi 'dod dbang thams cad rbad chod byas te/ sgo gsum gyi bya ba mtha' dag bla ma'i dbang du bzhag nas bdag nyid bran du dbul zhing de'i rjes su 'jug pa/ ci gsung gi mtshams las mi 'da' ba ni snod ldan slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyi gtso bo/ yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i dad pa rnal ma'i skye tshul yin no/ / der ma zad nyin mtshan kun tu bla ma brjed ma myong gsungs ba yang dam pa'i rang rtags bla na med pa yin te/ dper na bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rmog lcog pa'i zhal nas/ spyan ras guzigs dkar na dkar/ kye rdo rje sngo na sngo/ rje btsun ma rang dmar na dmar/nga ni gang du gnas kyang bla ma'i snang ba dang 'bral ma myong bas tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas de da yong ba 'dra zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de nas mdzo dge'i dgon pa spyis gsol ba btab pa bzhin skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang rje btsun 'jigs med dbang po nyid dkyel 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i bdag por bzhengs te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad lha bcu gsum ma'i smin byed dbang gi rim pa sta gon dang bcas rgyas par stsal pa'i dbang gral du bzhugs nas legs par gsan/ de skabs ban gzhon dkyus ma'i gras yin pas mtha' gral tsam las ma thob kyang legs par bsgrims te gsan pas dbang brda ji bzhin par 'phrod/ bla ma 'di lta bu dang sa khad nye ba 'di 204

༄༅/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i togasabarjod legs tshogayosgo 'byed/nas da bar du ma mjal bar sa 'og tu bsdad pa e yin snyam gdung ba drag po dang / gsung bshad phyag len kun gyis yid gting nas phrogs pas mos gus spel mas mchi ma yang yang 'chor ba byung / chos nyan pa bla dpon che dgu mang po yod kyang / sgra bsgyur mar pas/ mgron gyi gtso bo a bo mthu chen yin gsungs pa dang / skyo ston bsod nams bla mas/ don gyi dbang de lab sgron gyis thob song / tshig gi dbang de khyed rang rnams nyon gsungs pa ltar/ dbang gi rtogs pa rnal ma skyes pa'i rdo rje slob ma mchog tu gyur pa ni 'di nyid yin pa slar rim pas gsal bar gyur pa de yin no/ / de nas dgung lo nyi shu tsam la yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po mkhas grub rin chen pa'i zhal snga nas kyi drung nas 'og ma rnams bskyar bsgrub kyi thog tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes te mtshan mkhas grub bstan 'dzin du btags/ dngos blangs las 'das pa'i pham 'dra dang bshags bya'i nyes byas rnams dang / blangs pa'i phyogs mthun gyi bsdam bya'i nyes byas/ ltung med so so'i dmigs bsal sogs/ mdor na gzhi bcu las gyur ba'i gnang bkag gi bcas mtshams phra zhing phra ba mtha' dag dri gtugs zhib tu byas te phyag len la btab/ chos mthun gyi spyod pa rnam par dag pa la bshes gnyen pa yang thugs shin tu dgyes te spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin du bskyangs/ dam pa de nyid kyi drung du bzhugs te lo mtshams mdzad nas nyin re bzhin tsha rting khar byang chub bde lam gyi steng nas khrid dmigs gang 'tsham re gsan/ de'i nyams rtogs go bsdur gyis gegs sel bogs 'byin gyi sgo nas rgyud dang 'byor nges gnang ste/ yang khrid kyi 'phro skyong ba sogs mdor na 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ blo gsar ba la dge rgan gyis sbyor gzhung mdzub khrid byed pa lta bu'i bcas bde sla chos su ma song 205

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgroname'i g.yo ཿma/ba dgos par gsungs pa ltar/ bshad lung la khrid du btags pa tsam ma yin par sman pa mkhas pas lag len ngo sprod byed pa lta bu dmar khrid kyi lugs su gsan cing skyong bar mdzad/ rdor sems sgom bzlas dang 'brel ba'i yig brgya 'bum phrag sogs sngon 'gro'i chos bzhi la nan tan mdzad cing /khyad par bshags sbyang la 'grus par mdzad/ thun mtshams su bka' gdams pha chos bu chos sogs dam pa gong ma mang po'i rnam thar la gzigs rtogs dang / srod tho rangs gnyis su yig drug gi rnal 'byor gtso bor byas/ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po mtha' dag gi rnam thar phyag bzhes la zung 'jug nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i lam gyi ded dpon lta bur dpal rdo rje 'jigasabyed chen po'i bsnyen sgrub rnam par dag pa re sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro lta bur byed dgos pas/ lo mtshams kyi mjug gi cha la de'i bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas grangs bsags pa tsam ma yin pas gnad du 'gro nges pa gnang / mtshams grol nas rang yul du phebs te lo shas dgun gyi ring la sku mtshams dang / ston dpyid kyang zla mtshams re lta bu ma chag par byas/skabs shig tu skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen por mjal rgyu'i don la ched gtad kyis bkra shis 'khyil du phebs/ mtshan mo rmi lam du 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sku shin tu byon legs 'od zer 'phro ba zhig dang mjal bar rmis/phyi nyin mjal khar phebs pa na gzims 'gag pa rnams kyis gzhan ma'i mjal ba che phra rnams nang du mngags kyang / 'di pa yun ring por bkag ste nang du ma btang / thabs mkhas kyis zhu ba nan tan byas kyang tshig tsub mos spyo ba sogs 'o brgyal shin tu che bar byung / 'on kyang sdong po bkod pa las/'di ni bdag gi dge bshes chos smra ba/ / chos kun yon tan yongs su ston byed de/ / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod lam yongs ston pa/ / yin zhes 206

ro༅/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogayobarjod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/sems gcig bsam nas 'dir 'ongs so/ / 'di dag bskyed pas bdag gi ma lta bu/ / yon tan 'o ma ldud pas ma ma 'dra/ / byang chub yan lag yongs su sbyong ba yin/ / dge bshes 'di dag gnod pa rnam par bzlog / rga shi thar byed sman pa lta bu ste/ / bdud rtsi'i char 'babs lha dbang brgya byin 'dra/ / zla nya lta bur dkar po'i chos kyis rgyas/ / zhi ba'i phyogs ston nyi ma gsal ba 'dra/ / dgra dang grogs la ri bo 'dra ba ste/ / rgya mtsho bzhin du mi 'khrugs sems dang ldan/ / yongs su skyong dang mnyan pa 'dra ba zhes/ / de 'dra'i sems kyis nor bzang 'dir 'ongs so/ / byang chub sems dpa' bdag gi blo skyed pa/ / sangs rgyas sras po byang chub skyed byed pa/ / 'di dag bdag bshes sangs rgyas bsngags pa zhes/ / de ltar dge ba'i sems kyis 'dir 'ongs so/ / zhes gsungs pa'i don bzhin dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal ba'i phan yon sgo du ma nas gzigs pas thugs drangs te/de dag gi byed spyod sogs la thugs snang ci yang med par bla ma dang nam zhig mjal snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig gis yun ring por sgug sdong byas/mtshamaso shig la gzhan gye mjal ba mang po zhig nang du btang song ba'i rjes la zhen nas phebs pas bka' chos shig gnang rgyur chos nyan pa mang du 'tshogs yod pa de'i phyi mtha'i sgo 'gram zhig tu bzhugs pa na/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas gzigs te sku mdun pa zhig la bka' phebs nas nang du bos te chos nyan pa'i mdun gral zhig tu 'jog par mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gye rjes gnang zhig gnang byung bas bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus dang dga' skyo 'dres ma'i nyams kyis snang ba bun long du gyur te/ yab sras mjal ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i 'khri shing las/ ku bee ra sogs smin ma g.yo ldan pas/ / der ni mngon par 'jug 'dod bzlog 207

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung ཿma/gyur pa/ / bzhin ni mdzes bral brjod pa 'khrul gyur pa'i/ / sa bdag mchog tu gzi byin med par gyur/ / rgyal ba'i bka' yis de dag rnams kyis btang / / ci zhig ltar stes de mdun sa gzhi thob/ / zas gtsang spyi bos de la phag 'tshal nas/ / de yi mdun na rab dang sems kyis gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu zhig byung / tshul 'di ni sngon khya dge'i dpon slob rin po che kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa mjal bar phebs skabs gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dang mjal ba zhig rmis pas/ rjes sor mi tra'i dbang gi mgo de nas brtsams te gnang ba dang 'grig pa ltar/ nges pa'i don du bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa las gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa'i rdo rje slob ma mchog tu sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs 'khrul ba med pa'o/ / de phyin chad kyang skyabs mgon mchog dang nam mjal res kyis 'jam pa'i dbyangs dri lam du 'byung ba zhig yod la/ bka' chos kyi thog ma yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dbang nas brtsams pa sogs blo'i nor can rnams kyis brtags na gung bsgrig rgyu mang du yod dam snyam/ de nas nyams mgur gyi khrid/ sman chog bsdus pa'i lung sogs chos bka' gzhan yang ci rigs gsan te phyir phebs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dgon li mkhas mchog rin po che yun ring por bsnyung tshul bzhes skabs nyin mtshan med par bsnyun g.yog gang drag sus kyang do zla mi thub pa zhig gnang / sngar tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang ji tsam 'bad pa las kyang da res kyi bsnyun g.yog byas pa de sgrib pa dag tsha ba dang / byin rlabs 'jug tshab bla lhag tu che ba'i rtags mtshan mang du byung ba na/ bla mas 'di ltar gnang ba 'di bdag gi sgrib pa 'dag pa'i thabs kho nar 'dug dgongs te lhag par dad pa je 'phel dang / dka' spyad la spro nyams tsha bas gdungs pa'i glang chen pad mtshor 'jug pa lta bur gyur/ bla ma yang rgyun par jo bo 208

༄༅/ /mkha4thub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/bka' gdams pa'i rnam thar bzhin yon tan thams cad bum nang gi mar me ltar sbas pa kho na mdzad kyang / skabs der slob ma'i rgyud shin tu dag par gzigs pa'i dgos dbang dang / ha cang mnyes pa'i stobs kyis gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa du ma lhug par gsungs shing 'byung 'gyur gyi don la bslab bya mang po yang lung bstan gye tshul du stsal/ khyad par du khyod la phyis su byams sku zhig bzhengs pa'i khur 'bab rgyu yin pas/ de dus brtson 'grus chen po byas na dgos pa khyad par can zhig yod gsungs pa dang /yang nga jo bo a ti sha lta bu zhig yin na khyod 'brom ston pa lta bu zhig red/nged gnyis skye ba snga ma mang por 'brel yod 'dug cing / da dung yang mi 'bral ba zhig 'ong zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ de dang mthun par bla ma sku 'das nas zhag bdun song ba'i mtshams su dam pa 'di'i mnal lam la/ bla ma phebs nas tshe 'di dang bar do'i sgom nyams las kyang / phyi ma'i sgom gyi nyams brgya 'gyur gyis lhag par 'dug gsungs pa dang / yang bla ma nyid kyis chibs rta dkar po zhig bcibs/ khong yang chibs kyi 'phong la bzhag ste bde ba can dang dga' ldan sogs dag zhing mang por phebs/ der shing ljon pa zhig gi steng nas shing thog ser po dri dang kha dog phun sum tshogs pa zhig phyag tu lhung byung ba bzhes pas thugs rgyud la smra mi shes pa'i dga' bde'i nyams khyad par can skyes pa'i mnal ltas ya mtshan pa byung / bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs kyi bya byed mtha' dag kyang nyid nas gtso bor 'gan khur bzhes te/ rgya che la dngos dag pa sbyor dngos thams cad gra 'grig pa'i bkod khyab dang / rang gi bdog pa'i dngos po phrag tshegs yod pa'i nang nas cung drag thams cad kyang de'i khongs su btang / de ltar 'das mchod kyi skor mtha' dag par tshags su tshud pa na/ sngar bla ma dam pa nyid nas 209

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i yo khrung khrum/phyogs 'di na khyed rang gi rgyun du bsten pa'i bla ma zhig la/ khya dge'i sgom chen rin po che'i dngos slob/ kha gro'i ri khrod pa'i gnas brtan pa 'di bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig yin pas de la brten na legs gsungs yod pa'i don bzhin/ kha gron nang par grags pa'i 'dul 'dzin chen po de nyid kyi drung du byon/ gzims khang gad bdar dang sku gsung thugs rten dgram tshul/ mchod shom rgya che la bkod pas thon pa gzi 'od 'bar zhing khor yug tu dri bzang gi ngad 'thul ba zhig byas yod pa gzigs ma thag 'di 'dra'i byi dor legs po ang zhus pa na/ 'o byi dor dang mchod shom 'di ltar byed pa jo bo bka' gdams pa'i phyag len yin gsungs pas/las 'brel gyi dbang gis gsung de tsam la brten nas kyang dad pa lhag par g.yo ba zhig byung / bde lam gye khrid cig zhus pa de lan gnang rgyur ma song bas/ slar yang bskyar gyis phebs te gsan pa shin tu rgyud la 'byor pas blo 'khul che ba byung / dgung lo nyer brgyad pa sa stag lo/ be ri dpon slob rin po che'i mdun nas bde lam gyi khrid/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma'i khrid/'phokhrid sogs khyed dmigs du ma dang / gsang 'dug 'khor chen gnyis kyi dbang / lhag pa'i lha dang chos skyong du ma'i rjes gnang sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu med par 'gro ba kun la mnyes gshin pa ltar/ skye bo ma rabs rnams rgyu med par dam pa dag la sdang zhing khon du 'dzin pa chos nyid yin pas/ dam pa 'dis kyang mdzad pa mtha' dag chos bzhin du byas pa de rang rang gi spyod pa ngan pa de la sun 'byin lta bur song ba ma bzod pa'i skye bo ngan pa 'ga' zhig gis sgo du ma nas snyad btags te shin tu thugs sos mi bde bar byas/ 'on kyang gshe ba'i lan du slar gshe ba sogs dge sbyong gi chos bzhi dang 'gal ba'i bya ba cung zad tsam 210

༄7/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogayobarjod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/yang mi mdzad par ma zad/ rkyen ngan lam du khyer bas dge sbyor gyi bskul mar song / 'on kyang de dag ngang khang nye bar bzhugs na las ngan rnams kyis sdeg pa bsog nyen che bar dgongs te/ de rnams la brtse ba'i sems kyis ri bo rtse lnga lta bu thag ring ba'i gnas nges med cig tu 'byon rtsis gnang yang / be ri dpon slob sogs bla ma rnams kyis sa 'dir bzhugs na phugs su bstan pa la phan che bar gzigs nas bshol 'debs kyi gsung nan tan gnang bas bla ma'i bka' bzlog ma nus par bzhugs/ mi bsrun pa'i 'gro ba de dag gi khrod nas 'ga' zhig phyis su dge ba'i las 'phro sad de rang gi nyes pa la nyes par mthong / dam pa 'di nyid kyi mdzad pa skyon cung zad kyang ma 'dres par mthong ste bdog pa'i dngos po yod 'bul lta bu byas nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i slob mar gyur te/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa yang / / phyi nas bag dang ldan pa nyid gyur nas/ / zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes kyi dper song ba yang yod do/ / dgung lo nyer dgu pa'i skabs su kha gron nang pa'i drung nas gser phreng ma gtogs pa rje'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung / lam rim dang blo spyong du ma'i lung khrid/ nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ de'i ston ka legs bshad gser phreng gi lung grub dbang blo bzang shes rab kyi drung du gsan te kha bskang / dgun dpyid phal cher sku mtshams mdzad de lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams bzhes zab mo'i rgyun bskyangs/ de'i phyi lo be ri dpon slob rin po che'i drung nas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs/'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang / 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang sogs gsang sngags kyi zab chos du ma dang / 'bum khang ri khrod nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i drung du paṇa chen blo 211

༄/ /gung thang bam pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs/ lcang skya'i gsung 'bum phal cher sogs kyi lung / gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po kha gron nang pa'i zhabs pad nas yum 'bum pa/ lho brag bka' 'bum/ dben sa bka' 'bum/ mi la'i rnam mgur gnyis/ khya dge dpon slob rin po che'i gsung 'bum/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur 'bum/ blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ tshig rkang brgyad ma/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ blo sbyong nyi ma'i 'od zer/ bla mchod ṭīkka sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bgo skal rgya cher bzhes/ yul gyi lha bzo mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bos te skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i bris thang shin tu byon legs mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa'i chag tshad dang ldan zhing / gser tshon gong gsham zhal khebs sogs cha mtha' dag nas phun sum tshogs pas mig gi bdud rtsir gyur ba zhig gsar du bzhengs bzo bo las byed mtha' dag kyang gtang rag gi yon rgya chen po gnang ste yid tshim par byas/ sku tshe 'dir rten bzhengs rlabs che ba mdzad pa'i thog ma 'di nyid yin 'dug pa ni/ ji skad du/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chur shes bzhin/ / byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam par thar pa dmigs rkyen du byas te/ de'i rjes su zhugs nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la slob par 'dod pa'i nang gi lhag bsam rjes su dpogs pa'i mtshan mar gdon mi za'o/ / dgung lo so gcig pa'i dpyid kha gron nang pa'i drung nas 'jigs byed bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid smin rgyas su gsan cing / dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa sogs la'ang zhib tu sbyangs/ de'i ston ka be ri tshang nas kha gron nang pa gdan drangs te sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang zhus pa lhan du gsan/ de'i zhar la bee ri 212

༄7/ /mkhamagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/tshang gi drung nas kyang mgon po bka' bcu gsum dang / rnam sras bka' chen bco lnga'i rjes gnang dzogs par mnos/ de nas lo 'gar bkra shis 'khyil du yang yang phebs te skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs pad nas/rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ gong ma gong chen rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas rje bla ma yab sras kyi bka' srol thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes ṭīka chen dang sgrub thabs pad dkar zhal lung / dbang chog dgongs pa rab gsal sogs kyi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin gyi phyag len phra zhib/ gsung bshad zab cing rgya che ba bcas stsal pa legs par gsan/gzhan yang grub chen khru i ba'i lugs kyi 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang /gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / thugs rje chen po'i dbang sogs dbang rjes gnang du ma dang / kun gzigs lnga pa chen po'i gsung gi snying po 'jam dpal zhal lung gi khrid shin tu rgyas pa/ rten 'brel bstod pa'i bshad lung / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chad nyid kyi gsung 'bum shas che ba'i lung sogs chos kyi bdud rtse'i dga' ston ngoms pa med par spyad/der ma zad skabs shig tu dam pa 'di nyid nas khur len byas te skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang mdzo dge smad du gdan drangs nas/ grub chen dril bu pa'i lugs kyi 'khor lo bde mchog phyi dkyil lha lnga dang / lus dkyil lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang / 'jigs byed sngags btu'i rjes gnang sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ bde lam gyi lugs ltar smon 'jug stabs gcig pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga mdzad/ bsnyen bkur 'bul nod sogs kyang nus pa rtsal sprugs kyis gang drag bsgrubs/ bkra shis 'khyil nas rgyal sras chen po khri pa blo bzang snyan grags/ grub pa'i dbang phyug khri pa bsod nams grags 213

༄/ /gung thang bayo rsāsgronayo khrung 'bum/pa/ mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan khri pa bsod nams dbang rgyal rnams kyi sku drung du yang mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ khyad par du khri rin po che bsod nams dbang rgyal ba'i drung du yang yang gtugs te lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung / lam sgon dang lam gtso/ pe'u bum sngon po/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ tshig rkang bzhi pa rnams kyi khrid/ bka' gdams gzhung drug gi lung /bde lam gyi zhal shes dang zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi khrid lan kha shas sogs snyan brgyud man ngag gi gnad shin tu mang po mnog chos su gsan/ khri rin po che 'di nyid thugs rgyud zhi zhing dul bas gzhan la skyon brjod smad ra sogs gtan mi mdzad kyang / de skabs se 'bras dge gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i yang rtse yin pas/ thugs khengs pa zhig sus kyang yong dka' na'ang / dam pa 'di la thugs gtis mgu ste/ mdzo dge'i dge tshul tshang de grwa sar ma sbyangs pa zhig la/ gzhung chen mo'i go ba gting tshugs pa de 'dra ya mtshan zhes yang yang bsngags brjod mdzad pa bdag gis dngos su thos/ chos gsan pa de thams cad kyang nyan lo/ thob lo/ shes lo zhes bya ba'i rnam grangs bsags pa tsam ma yin par khrid rnams rim pa bzhin bskyangs te rgyud 'khul nges pa dang / dbang rjes gnang rnams 'bras bu lam byed kyi bag chags thebs nges su mdzad/ lung rnams kyang legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig / ces dang / sems thams cad kyis nyan par gsungs pa bzhin/ tshig gcig kyang ma chad par rna ba legs par gtod cing / gzhung gi le'u dang mdo rgyas kyi mtshams phyed la/ don gye spyi'ikhogs phub pa sogs chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gro nges su byas te gsan pa kho na yin par snang / lo snga phyi ci rigs su snga ma'i slob dpon sbyin chung ba dang / be ri dpon slob rin po che rnam pa 214

༄za/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtog4brjod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/gnyis ka zhing gshegs par sku gdung gi bya byed dang / dgongs rdzogs kyi rnam dkar sgrub rgyu thams cad kyi skabs su yang gzhan gyi ngo bsrung tsam ma yin par/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa zhig la bla ma'i 'das mchod las lhag pa med par gsungs pa'i don thugs la bcings te/rgyubasam sbyor mtha' dag gi sgo nas bla ma'i dgongs pa yongs su dzogs pa'i thabs la 'bad pa lhur bzhes/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i gsung nas 'byung ba ltar gyi rje bla ma'i rnam thar shin tu rgyas pa'i zhal thang mdzes tshon spel ba tsam ma yin par lo rgyus zhing bkod du zon nges kha byang dang bcas pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis gsar du bzhengs te/ bzang gos sna tshogs kyi gong gsham sogs rgyu yon 'gro gang che'i sgo nas 'khor gsum yongs su dag par bsgrub zhal thang de rnams kyang rjes sor zhig skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang la phul 'dug / mdor na nor rdzas phyag tu gang byung thams cad gtso cher bla ma la phul zhing / lhag mas sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang / dkon mchog gi mchod pa bsam las 'das pa gnang / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs tshul yang gzhan gyi mig sngar gang mdzes dang / ngoms che ba'i rigs mi gnang bar rgyu gang bzang rnams de'i khongs su 'gro thabs kho na gtsor 'don gnang ste/ zhal thang rnams la yang gong gsham tsam ma yin par/ rgyab mdun gnyis gar khyad med du gos chen bzang po rim pa du ma dang / masdi chos 'don sogs kyi zhal khebs brtsegs ma mang po na bza'i tshul du 'bul bar mdzad/ rten bzhengs pa de dag kyang nor gye 'du shes lta bus gcig bsogs gnyis bsogs mi gnang bar re zhig bar du mchod pa rgya chen po re phul nas/ de rjes chos 'brel gang thob kyi bla ma rnams la rim bzhin 'bul bar mdzad de/ da lta'i lha rten bsgrig mkhan gyi bla ma rnam pa'i 215

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i g.yo 4ma/phyag len dang shin tu mi mthun no/ / dgung lo so bzhi pa'i steng du lo hril por bcad rgya gnang ste/ thugs dam zab mo'i nyams bzhes kyi rgyun bskyangs pas nyams rtogs kyi klong rdol ba byung / skabs 'di nas bzung sku tshe hril por lo re bzhin bstan pa bstan 'dzin spyi dang / khyad par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang sogs kyi zhabs brtan du dmigs te lo re bzhin ma mtha' mar rgya ma bzhi brgya lhag re tsam gyis mchod me sogs mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bul bar mdzad/ sku mtshams grol rjes rkang tsha'i sgar nas don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la rje'i gsung 'bum po ti bcu skor gyi lung dang / zam tsha chos 'khor phyogs kyi du mas gdan drangs te gsol ba btab pa bzhin rje'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung gnang / 'dul 'dzin chen po ye shes rgya mtsho'i drung du brgyad stong pa'i lung gsan cing /khong gi thugs bzhed bzhin phar la yang ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i lung sogs chos bka' ci rigs phul/ ra lung ri khrod du yang lung khrid sogs kyi bka' drin zhu mkhan mang du byung ba so so'i re ba bskang / sngar mdzo dge'i phyogs su sku dpar sogs gtan med pa la/ co ne nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dpar gcig phyag tu 'byor pa bsnams te zhabs thang la ka chur phebs nas/ de la ma phyi byas te sku dpar mang du blugs/ dgung lo so lnga nas lo kha shas kyi ring nyid kyis gtso mdzad de rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku 'bum phrag bcu lhag pa bzhengs/ de thams cad kyang grangs gang 'gro tsam ma yin par/ rgyu'i 'jim pa byen gyis brlabs pa sogs nas bzung rgyud sde'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhing sla chos su ma song bar dri gtsang khang yid du 'ong ba so sor legs par bsgrigs nas dri bzang gis bsgos pa'i phye mas bar gtams te/ re re tsam yang dbu zhabs ma log pa'i lag len shin tu dngos gtsang ba byas/216

༄༅/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/de'i snying bo'i tshul du mchod rten sku tshad ma lnga bzhengs shing snga phyi kun la paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes ltar gyi srog shing gter 'khor gzungs 'jug sogs gang rgyas dang / gzungs kyi na bza' yang gos chen 'ba' zhig las byas pa sogs rgyu 'gros che bar gnang / bshes gnyen dam pa kha gron nang pa dang / brag sgom pa rnam gnyis kyis rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i snang brnyan che ba re bzhengs rgyu'i thugs 'dun gtang kyang bzo bo mkhas pa zhig yul phyogs nas ma rnyed par/ de'i don la dam pa 'di nyid reb kong phyogs su zhabs thang la phebs/ lha bzo dge slong bstan pa rgya mtsho zer bas bzhengs pa rnams byon legs par gzigs nas/ de nyid bos te lhan du phyir phebs/ lha bzo'i grogs ldan gang dgos kyi rigs thams cad nyid nas bran bzhin du bsgrubs/ nang gi sku brnyan che chung du ma dang / phyi'i gtsug lag khang rten brten pa mtha' dag gi las khur nyid gcig pus gzhung bzung ste mthar phyin pa bsgrubs pas/ bla ma yang thugs dgyes pa'i rtser son par gyur/ dgung lo so bdun pa sa mo phag gi lo'i ston ka de nyid du tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa kha gron nang pa blo bzang bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad cing / kha skong gi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bstan pa'i gzhi ma lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi gtso bo bslab gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i rje po dam par gyur/ de ma thag lung sde bzhi mtha' dag gi dgongs don la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa 'dul 'dzin chen po ye shes rgya mtsho'i drung nas 'dul ba'i bslab bya lag len dang bcas pa zhib tu gsan 217

༄/ /yo thang gas pa'i sgroname'i khrung lam/te/ dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bcas mtshams phra rags thams cad thugs su chud par mdzad do/ / tshul 'di lta bu ni sngon thub pa'i bstan pa yar ldan gyi dus bzang por byon pa'i skyes mchog rnams kyi phyag bzhes bla na med pa yin te/ dam pa de dag gi rnam thar du dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes ma thag kā ri kā lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel lam/ sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel lta bu re nges par gsan/bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag tu 'dul gzhung che ba re gsan cing / de yang snga ma 'ga' zhig me tog phreng rgyud gtsor 'don gnang la/ kun mkhyen mtsho sna ba yab sras rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras sogs kyis mdo rtsa brgya cher 'grel dang bcas pa gtso bor mdzad pas/ de 'dra re nges par gnang ba'i srol yod kyang / da lta bstan pa'i tha ma shin tu snyigs mar son pa'i dbang gis sdom pa len pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam yod kyang / blangs pa'i de ma thag nas bsrung dgos pa dang / srung tshul gyi bslab bya nyan dgos pa'i gtam tsam yang mi grags pa ni/ rje ngag dbang byams pa'i zhal nas/ so thar byang sems dang rig 'dzin/ / sdom gsum lon tshad du blangs nas/ / dran tshad lag len du 'debs pa'i/ / spyon pa rang phung la gzigs dang / zhes gsungs pa ltar phung khrol gyi gzhi che shos yin pas/ bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis dam pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di lta bu la kha mig yar lta ba gal che'o/ / kha gron nang pa'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar de ga'i ri khrod pa rnams la byang chub bde lam gyi khrid myong ba la bskor bas rgyud 'khul zhing / lung rigs kyis brdar sha chod pa mjug tu sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas bla ma'i phyag bzhes ma nyams pa dang / be'u bum sngon mo'i lung sogs chos kyi bdudartsi'i sgo 'phar phyes/ ri khro ji srid nam gnas kyi bar sbyor ba'i chos drug 'chag med kyi srol bzang po btsugs/ byi ba'i lo paṇa chen thams cad 218

༄za/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i togayobarjod legasatshog4sgo 'byed/mkhyen pa rgya nag phyogs su chibs bsgyur gnang bar gzhan thams cad spro dga' che bar byed kyang / dam pa 'di nyid thugs shin tu ma bde bar nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu zhabs brtan bsgrubs shing / gzhan ri khrod pa mang po la yang rgyu yon sogs sbyar nas rim gro phon che ba bsgrub tu bcug / sgol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku yang 'bum phrag du ma bzhengs shing / snga phyir sku dpar 'debs pa sogs kyi skabs su las byed mtha' dag nas so so'i gzungs sngags bzla ba dang / bstan 'gro mtha' dag gi don du 'gyur ba'i smon tshig nyid kyis gsar bsgrigs gnang ste/ 'don bzhin du las byed pa sogs cha mtha' dag nas don chen por 'gyur nges 'ba' zhig mdzad/skabs der skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas mdzo dge smad 'dir sbyin bdag gi ngos nas mthun rkyen 'dzom par 'dug kyang / mdo sngags gang gi yang 'chad nyan phyag len sogs sems la 'dzin rgyu zhig med pa mi legs par dgongs te/ yul phyogs kyi skye bo rnams bsod nams rdzogs pa'i ched dang /rang rang gi yon sbyong / thub bstan rin po che'i zhabs 'degs su yang cung zad 'gyur bar gzigs nas rgyud grwa gsar 'dzug gnang ba'i tshe lus longs spyod mtha' dag ltos pa med par bla ma'i zhabs tog tu bkol/ khyad par du bla ma brgyud pa rags rim dang / yi dam chos bsrung du ma'i zhal thang da lta'i dus la ltos pas ri mo 'gran zla med pa lta bu/ mdzod gos khyad 'phags 'ba' zhig gi gong gsham can shin tu che legs grangs mtshungs mang po yang gsar du bsgrubs te tshogs khang du 'grim rgyur phul/ de skabs g.yo dge sman pa la kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'di rang gis dag snang sbyangs pa tsam ma yin par rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dngos yin/ skabs 'dir bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas phyogs 'dir smad rgyud kyi 'chad nyan sogs 219

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/bstan pa'i srol gtsang ma zhig tshugs 'dug mod kyang / 'di na bdud rigs kyi mi 'ga' zhig yod pas mtha' ci 'dra 'ong mi shes/ 'on kyang khyed rang tshos 'ju sa 'chang sa bla ma 'di la byas na las dkar po'i mtha' bzang bas gtan 'dun ma 'chug pa zhig yong gsungs/ khong gis kyang bsam sbyor mtha' dag gi sgo nas bla ma'i zhabs tog bsgrubs shing / snga sor paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rgya nag tu phebs skabs sku phebs kyi sgo nas sku don ༵rsha ༷ ṭwāṃ ༷ rdoni ༵de ༷༵ tt+waṃ rdo rdo ༷ ṭwāṃ~X ༵nga ṭwāṃ ba~X hūṃ~X dzhai~X ditt+waṃ /dro gshamagyi rgyur 'gro ba byas/ rjes sor zhig nyid kyi mdun du sku phebs zhus pa'i tshe/ chos skyong chen po nyid nas/ nga be har rgyal po la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyis gyon par genang ba'i gos de khyed gnyis kyis gzhan du bkol ba ci yin/ phyir khyer yong dgos gsungs pa na/ nyid nas med tshul zhus par thugs shin tu khros te/ zhal gyi rnam pa yang rgyun gyi lha khog gi nyams cung zad med par srin po khros pa lta bu kha dog dmar nag spyan rtsa dmar zhing shin tu blum la khro gnyer dpral par bsdus pa/ drag sku bzhengs pa rnams las kyang brgya 'gyur gyis lhag pa'i 'jigs rngams can blta bar mi bzod pa zhig tu gyur te/ drag po'i nga ro dang bcas cis kyang khyer yong dgos gsungs pa na/ gos ni ji ltar byas kyang 'bul ba'i thabs med/khyed snang srid kun gyi bdag po yin pas nged rang gi snying khrag phul ba yin zhes thugs thag pa nase zhus pas/ de ma thag chos skyong thugs zhum pa lta bus yud tsam dgongs pa la bzhugs/ skad cig nyid la sngar gyi rnam pa thams cad gnas gyur te/ shin tu zhi zhing dul ba'i tshul gyis/ 'o na nged lha khog dang bcas pa byang chub snying po'i bar du dam pa nyid nas thugs la 'dzin 220

༄za/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabajod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/dgos zhes gus pa lhur blangs/ der ma zad rjes sor zhig sku rten la khog zhugasakyi tshe lus sems shin tu ngal ba zhig yod pas/ slar mi 'bab pa'i thabs shig gnang dgos zhes yang yang nan gyis zhus ngor/ chos skyong la yang de lugs kyi bka' bsgos pa phyin chad ma babs pa sogs snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po nyid kyang dam pa 'di'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i mtshan ma snga phyir mang du yod do/ / de skabs gsungs pa bzhin lo grangs nyi shu tsam snro /༵ dhri skyeskya ༷ṭwāṃ ༷༷ caṭwāṃ dī ༵rdo ༷dī~X rto dihūṃ ༷/nga ༷dī ༵dī rdo ༵ ṭwāṃrdo med pa yang a ma 'drer mthong gi skye bo smon lam log par thebs pa 'ga' dzhai ༷ ṭwāṃ di / ༵ hūṃ~X nghruX dīdi te/ dadīgepo 'abheṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ rshaṭwāṃrsha rdoṭwāṃnghrudhi dī~X ṭwāṃbhe ṭwāṃ gyis 'dun pa rtse gcig gis sbyin bdag byas te/ sngar gyi rgyud grwa'i phyag bzhes ma nyams pa'i dgon pa zur du gsar 'debs byas pa'i tshe/ thang ga rnams kyang der gdan drangs te da lta rten gtsor bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /lcags glang dang chu stag gi lo gnyis gar bde lam gyi khrid sems bskyed mchod pa dang bcas shin tu rgyas pa re gnang / stag tshang lha mo nas ki rti sprul pa'i sku'i yongs 'dzin du phebs dgos tshul zhus pa na/ rang ngos nas de 'dra la thugs bzhed med kyang / rong ba ljags nag pa rje bla ma'i dngos slob tu gyur pa dang / de phyin gyi skye rgyud thams cad kyang gzhan phan 'phrin las che bar snang bas/ sku tshe 'dir yang rje'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba zhig e yong dgongs te de phyogs su phebs/ chos lung 'ga' zhig gnang zhing bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen la phan pa'i thos bsam mdzad tshul sogs kyi bslab bya mdzad pa rnams sprul pa'i sku nyid nas dam pa'i rang rtags kyis dang 221

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlanamatha gsung 'bum/du bzhes pa byung / gnas de nyid du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa gnang skabs shig dri lam du dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i gtso bo'i go sar skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dang / 'khor rnams kyi go sar ral gri re yod pa zhig rmis pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mos gus mthar phyin pa'i rtags su mngon la/ dpyad gzhi 'gang che ba gzhan yang yod dam snyam/ yang shing ljon pa shin tu mtho zhing yal 'dab nghru dhi | ṭwāṃX ṭwāṃ rtse mo~Xdi phe ༵༵sa na ༷da ga ༵ ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵dī ༷ṭwāṃdi sding rgya ༷ma ༷ rdo/ ༵༷ rdo snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang / de'i don du rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs dgos pa 'dug snyam pa shar te/ bsru med bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gi / 'phrin las lha mo'i gzugs su shar pa yi/ / brtse ldan rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma la/ / shugs drag dang ba'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ / skye rgu'i phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan pa'i bcud/ / rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i mdo sngags kyi/ / bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel bar byen gyis rlobs/ / zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'di gnyis thol byung du brtsams nas gsol ba 'debs pa zhig rmis/ tha na rmi lam tshun chad du yang bstan pa kho na thugs la bcings te/ de'i don ma gtogs dgongs rgyu med pa 'di lta bu ni nges pa don gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin te/ da lta bstan 'dzin chen por sgrogs shing rlom pa'i khrod na/ phyogs lhung tsam gyi sde dgon re bskyangs te/ chags sdang gi 'khor lo bskor ba la bstan pa bzung bar ming btags pa ma gtogs/ bstan pa spyi la dmigs nas 'di rgyas pa zhig byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa thugs rgyud la lan re tsam yang skye ma myong bar sku tshe 222

sa༅/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabarjod legs tshogayosgo 'byed/hril gyis 'das pa shin tu mang bar snang ngo / / yang lan cig lha mo'i gnas khang gi nang du phebs nas bdun mtshams shig mdzad pa'i tshe/ bud med mang pos rin po che'i snod mi 'dra ba sna tshogs zas du mas bkang ste 'dren pa'i nyams snang dang / rmi lam du gnas khang gi sgo na dpag bsam gyi ljon pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhig yod pa'i rtsa bar phebs pa na/ bud med 'ga' zhig gis 'di'i rtse mor song zhes zer ba bzhin du byon par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang sogs lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma mang po bzhugs 'dug par phyag dbang zhus te phyir phebs pa na/ bud med shing lo gyon pa zhig 'dug pa des sdong po 'di'i steng na rin po che gang yod thams cad khyod kyi bla ma mchod pa'i yo byad kho na yin pas gzhan la ma gtod ze ra ba zhig rmis/ rjes sor yang gzhan 'ga' zhig la de rmi lam yin na yang don chen po can zhig yin 'dug pas/ ngas zas nor cung zad re rnyed tshad thams cad bla ma mchod pa'i phyogs la btang ba yin zhes gsungs snang bas/ mnal ltas de dag ni rang dga' ba tsam ma yin par dngos gnas la bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan pa 'ba' zhig yin pa gor ma chag go / gnas der gzhan gyi yang chos mthun don gnyer can nyams khrid sogs zhu mkhan 'ga' zhig byung ba so so'i re ba bskangs/ phyir phebs te yos bu'i lo yang lam rim gyi bka' chos sngar bzhin gnang / gzhan yang snga phyi ci rigs par bka' gdams gzhung drug rigs tshogs dang byams chos/ dben sa bka' 'bum sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi chos sbyin rgya cher stsal/ shing 'brug lo skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus su phebs rgyu'i zhabs brtan du dmigs te zhi khro sbrags sgrub kyi sgo nas a ra pa tsa dang / rtsa sngags snying po rnams rgyun ring por bsgrubs nas zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi sbyin sreg bsam gyis mi khyab pa 223

༄/ /ca ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga4 'bum/gnang / de rjes bka' sdod dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i bskang ba 'bum ther gnyis bsgrubs shing drug cu pa stong phrag lhag pa bsngos/ dam gtsang gi slob ma ri khrod pa mang po la yang cha rkyen gnang nas chos rgyal bskang ba bsgrub tu bcug / de skabs gzhan gyi ri khrod pa zhig gi rmi lam la 'phags pa shing sku'i mkhar na gong ma'i rgyal khab tshun chad mthong ba'i khang bzang mtho la yangs pa phur 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi sku bzhugs pa gcig tu khong rnams chos rgyal gyi bskang bskul gtong bzhin par yod pa'i bskul ba'i nang gi gshin rje mo bzhi'i bskul gyi mtshams der dbu mdzad kyis skad gdangs drag po dang bcas/ mdo smad byang phyogs yul khams kyi/ / yangs pa'i grong khyer rgyal khab na/ / 'jam dbyāngs smra ba'i seng ge bzhugs/ / khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ / zhes 'don pa rmis/ phyi nyin zhog ka snga bar grwa ba zhig 'ongs te bla ma rin po che mdang glo bur du phebs te dbu mdzad kyi nang du bzhugs yod pas/ khyed rang der shog gsung gi zhes bshad pas kho gting nas ya mtshan par gyur la/ ya mtshan che bar yang snang ngo / / gzhan yang skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhabs brtan du sher snying / sgrol ma/ rnam sras bskang ba rnams 'bum phrag re/ sgol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa khri lhag / yig brgya 'bum zer du ma bcas bsgrubs/ gang bsgrubs thams cad kyang khral chos lta bu grangs 'gro thabs dang / 'ol tshod kyis 'di tsam song yod ces grangs mtho 'dzin byas pa ma yin par/ sgrub pa po rnams la bsnyen bkur phul du phyin pa rkyen theg nges pa dang / nor rdzas gang bzang gis yon gzab rgyas zhus/ zhal 'don dal brel snyoms la tshig re re yang chad lhag tu mi 'gro bas dngos dag pa byed du bcug / thams cad kyi skabs su mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phal ba'i blor mi shong ba lta bu sogs cha thams cad nas gnad 224

༄༅/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabarjod legs tshog4sgo 'byed/du 'gro nges pa byas/ skyabs mgon rin po che dbus nas phyir phebs ring gi lo gcig gnyis shig tu gnyan chen sogs yul lha rnams la bsang shing rgyab khal du ma dang / ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi thud sogs bsang rtsi mi khur mang pos bsang mchod shin tu rgyas pa lan mang du gnang / mtshams shig tu de'i rigs rbad chod gnang bas/ 'ga' zhig gis bsang mchod rgyun ma bcad tsam gnang e dgos zhus par/ da de dag blo yul las 'das song gsungs /rdo ༵ ༵bhe dī / brtett+waṃ ༷ didis ni baX ṭwāṃd/ / ༵ ༵ rnama~Xgu kyi ༷ ya/ nga /ṭwāṃrdo gsungs pa bzhin/ cung zad tsam la khros bas nyer 'tshe du ma byed pa dang /kho mgu na grogs byas te bya byed lam du 'gro zhing nus mthu che che 'dra ba byung bas rim gyis blo kha de phyogs su bsgyur te/ mthar skyabs 'gro tshun chad gtong bas phongs tshab shin tu chen po 'byung ba de lta bu la dgongs pa'am/yang na chos skyong bran du 'khol bas las bzhi'i 'phrin las gang dgos de dag gis thogs pa med par bsgrubs te/ 'jig rten pa rnams la cung zad kyang stos mi dgos pa'i gdeng thob pa gang rung zhig tu sems so/ / yang zhabs brtan la dmigs te mazing shog bzang por gser gang 'drong gis sher phyin stong phrag brgyad pa yig gzugs shin tu che bas po ti bzhir longs pa zhig bris te/ po ti re re la sang bzang gos kyi thum bzhi bzhi phul/ bris pa rnams kyang rta sga 'khor/ gyon pa cha tshang sogs yon gyis mgu bar byas/ mdor na 'brug lo nas bzung lo gsum gyi ring 'dir 'char can gyi bka' chos 'chag med rnams dang / dmigs bsal re gnyis ma gtogs nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu bla ma'i zhabs brtan bsgrub rgyu kho na la gzhol bar mdzad/rta'i lo'i dgun skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa phyir gdan sar phebs 225

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas gsung 'bum/pa'itshe/ rgya bod sog gsum gyi bla dpon che dgu/ dgon lag du ma dang bcas pa'i bsu ba gzab 'phyor can stong phrag brgal bas rim par bsus pa na/ dam pa 'di nyid sgrub sde'i dge slong gi tshogs dang bcas zhabs thang la bsu bar phebs te/ khyung rtse'i thang du chos gos rnam gsum gyon nas dmigs brtse ma'i gdangs dbyangs dang bcas g.yas bskor gyi tshul gyis bsus pa na rang dbang med par yid la dang ba 'dren zhing / ri klung thams dhri~X /dhi rdo ༷ ṭwāṃX ba~Xng khrom dī ༵ ṭwāṃ/ ༷ pa~Xgab nadī diX didī dī di tt+waṃX kur chos rgyun nyag phra ba mang po sor chud par mdzad tshul dang / gtong sgo gnang tshul sogs sku don gyi bka' mchid zhib tu gnang / dbus phebs kyi sku don rnams la khyed kyis sku rim bsgrubs pa de gnad du 'gro ba byung / da dung byams chen bzhengs rgyu la 'tshub cha che bar snang bas sku rim sngar rgyun bzhin ma lhod pa byed dgos gsung / spyir skyabs mgon nyid nas gnang skyes dang / legs so dbugs dbyung tshun chad re ltos yod pa'i rigs rnams la so so'i khams dang mthun par gang la gang 'os kyi bdag rkyen bka' drin skyong ba zhig yod kyang / dam pa 'dis rang gi rgyu nor thams cad phangs med du btang ste/ lo zla mang po'i bar du sbrel nas zhabs brtan kho na bsgrub pa la yang gnang sbyin lta zhog / sku rim gnad du song 'dug gsung ba tsam mgatogs/ tshig gi gtang rag cig kyang ma mdzad pa ni pha rol po'i kun slong la chos brgyad kyi snang shas cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa mngon sum du gzigs pas bla slob gnyis ga'i che ba rmad du byung bar snang ste/ dper na sngon mnyam med jo bo chen pos lha btsun bo dhi rā dzā la zhe sa dang bkur sti chen po gnang nas/ byang chub 'od la de 'dra cung zad tsam yang ma gnang ba'i tshe/226

༄za/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legasatshogasasgo 'byed/kho'i sems la byang chub 'od las khyed rigs dang bsod nams kyis khyad du 'phags tshul zhig gsung du re nas jo bo la nyid kyis bdag la bkur ste chen po mdzad kyang / byang chub 'od la mi mdzad pa ci yin zhus par/ byang chub 'od nga'i slob ma yin gsungs/ kho kha skyengs te 'o na bdag slob ma ma lags sam zhus par/ slob ma lags lags gsungs pa'i dpe bzhin/ da lta phal cher bla mas tshur la ngo dkar nag 'tsho dgos pa 'di slob ma'i rgyud rul ba'i rtags yin no/ / de nas yang phyir phebasta te chos rgyal dang rnam sras kyi bskang ba 'bum phrag re/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa khri tshar bcas bsgrubs/ nyin gcig maṇḍal bzhi pa zhig sgrub rtsis kyis sgrub grogs 'ga' dang bcas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gsung bzhin pa'i skabs/ dge slong byams pa'i nyams snang la tsong kha brgyad cu'i zhal thang zhig gi khre tra pa las gnod byed bsgral ba'i rnam pa lta bu de'i zur nas ma he 'jigs su rung ba zhig thon pa lta bu'i nyams shar te lus kyi ba spu gzeng zhing 'jigs chum me ba zhig byung /mtshams der khong rin po che nas snga ma'i 'don pa 'phro bzhag ste/ glo bur du brkyangs bskums ma zhig gi dbu bskul nas gsung song ba la/ rjes sor de'i rgyu mtshan zhus par/ de 'don dgos ba zhig 'dug gsungs pa ma gtogs gsal kha ma mdzad kyang / skabs der dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i gzigs snang zhig byung bar ze tshom med do/ / lug lo skyabs mgon mchog nas bkra shis 'khyil du tshogs mang la bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho dang /rdzogs rim rim lnga gsal sgron gyi bshad lung rgyas par stsal skabs phebs nas gsan cing / de'i zhar la skyes rabs kyi bshad lung sger du zhus/ rong ṭwāṃXsdu dzhai ༵ṭwāṃ di rdo ṭwāṃ rdo ༵ ༵ dī~X ṭwāṃdīX ༵ṭwāṃrsha ༵dhriX /bhe /dzhaihūṃ ṭwāṃ sag rshabhe 227

༄༅/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/de'i rgyud grwa dang lhan du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang gsan/ rgyun par zhabs brtan bsgrub rgyu rtsal 'don gnang / de'i phyi lo bla brang du phebs te skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs drung nas ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i grub chen mi tra dzo ki la 'phags mchog rgyal ba rgya mtshos dngos su stsal ba mi tra brgya rtsar grags pa'i dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par gsan/nyin bzhin phyi dro'i cha la rong po rgyud pa'i bla ma mkhan chen drung yig blo bzang rgya mtsho sogs du ma la sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i rnam thar sogs chos lung mang du gnang / de skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas byams chen mthong ba don ldan gyi gzungs 'jug sgrub rgyu'i khur len byed dgos pa'i bka' phebs/gzungs 'jug bri sgrub dang dril tsul gyi phyag len sogs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bzhes gzhir bzung / kun gzigs lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'ga' zhig gis zur brgyan te lag tu len tshul gyi bkod khyab dang / khyad par du dam pa 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma rig byed ma'i byen rlabs kyi bka' bab tu gzigs nas/ de'i smin byed kyi rim pa chos skor gye lung dang lag len/ don kun 'grub pa'i 'khor lo sgrub tshul sogs kyi zhal shes man ngag du ma dang bcas gdams ngag cha tshang bar gnang / phyir phebs te gzungs 'jug gi shog bu dang gser shog / mtshal snagagazungs kyi na bza'i rgyu'i gos rnams sgrub pa'i phyir rang nyid co ge'i phyogs su phebs te/ rin thang sogs la ma gtsags par spus gang gtsang phon che bar bsgrubs/ gzungs gzhug rgyas bsdus so so nas 'byung ba dang / gzhan yang rgyud 'bum sogs su bzhugs pa'i gzungs shin tu mang po rnams phal cher gser bzang po 'ba' zhig gis bris shing / gzhan yang rin po che sna tshogs btul ba'i phye ma dang mtshal sogs kyis gzungs re re yang brgya stong 228

༄za/ /mkhayogrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogayobarjod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/mang po bris/ khyad par du byams 'jam dbyangs sgrol ma dkar sngon dmar gsum gyi sngags rnams re re bzhin bris ma dang par ma bye ba phrag mang po bzhengs/ rin po che'i rigs dang span sna tshogs kha che'i dri bzang sogs kyis bsgos pa'i shog bu la bla ma yi dam sna tshogs kyi sku brnyan gser tshon gyis bris pa dang / par ma bsdoms pas 'bum phrag lngar nye ba dang / gzhi de lta bu la rin po che'i phye ma dang sbyar ba'i rgya snag bzang pos gzungs dang mdo phran yang stong phrag mang po par/ gnas so sor 'bul rgyu'i gzungs rnams kyi mjug tu smon tshig tha dad pa nyid nas gsar bsgrigs gnang ste gser mtshal sogs kyis bris pa dang par ma khri phrag mang po so sor sbyar/ paṇa chen dang rgyal dbang so so'i bzhed pa ltar gyi gnod sbyin 'khor lo rgyas bsdus tshan pa mang po dang / tshogs bdag 'khor lam̐ tshar mang po tshon gyis legs par bris te/ thugs ga'i sngags 'phreng dang mtha'i mu khyud kyi sngags rnams gser 'ba' zhig gis bris/ gzungs 'jug thams cad la re re bzhin du gos chen ser po sha stag gi na bza' phul te/ dar skud ser pos legs par dkris/ de nas dam tshig gtsang ma'i dpon slob bcu bdun tsam gyis zla ba gnyis dang zhag gsum gyi bar du thun bzhir bcad de gzungs 'jug de dag legs par bsgrubs/ mjug tu mar rgya ma stong dang lnga brgya tsam dang /de'i tshod kyis rdzas chen gzhan rnams kyang 'dzom gang ches sbyin sreg nyin bcu'i bar du phul/ gzhan yang de'i yan lag tu zla ba gnyis dang zhag bcu'i ring sgol ma dkar sngon gnyis/ 'phags ma rig byed ma/ phyag rdor gos sngon can/ 'jam dkar/ mgon chos sogs kyi bsnyen pa yang kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas tshad dang ldan pa gnang / lo 'di nas bzung sku tshe hrel por lo re bzhin skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku don du dmigs 229
