༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/nas sgol ma dkar sngon dmar gsum gyi sbyin sreg la so sor mar rgya ma brgya re/yam shing rgyab khal re/ 'bru rnams 'jag re/ khyad par du sgrol ma dmar mo la khron sum cu re'i rin gyi sman dang rin po che gos dar sogs chag med du 'bul ba gnang / lo ltar gyi zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nas bzhi pa'i bco lnga'i bar la mar rgya ma lnga brgya re'i mchod me yang nges can du 'bul ba rnams 'char can yin kyang / gzhan gyes mthong na mi legs gsungs nas shin tu sbas pa kho na mdzad/ slar yang zla ba gcig gi ring gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang gter bum rnams bsgrubs te rnam sras g.yang 'bod mang po dang bcas rten rnams la byin phabs/ 'di skabs kyi sgrub grogs rnams dang / phyi'i las byed mtha' dag gi cha rkyen dang yon/ sbyin sreg gi dgos chas dang / lo 'khor du mar rgya ma stong phrag du mis mchod me phul ba sogs kyi rgyu 'gros gzhan rnams lta zhog gzungs 'jug gi na bza'i gos dang / gser tshon shog bu rnams kyi rin kho na la yang dong tse khron che ba stong phrag gnyis brgal ba song 'dug la/ mdor na de'i gong du zhabs brtan bsgrub rgyu'i khongs der phyag rdzas gang yod btang ba lta bu yin kyang / 'di res yang gzungs gzhug skor gyi las don shin tu rlabs che ba bsgrub rgyu rnams cung zad tsam yang phyag ma thogs par thugs bzhed bzhin lhun gyis grub pa ni/ 'dul ba lung las/rgyal po rnams ni tshig gis 'grub/ / lha rnams bsam pas 'grub pa ste/ /tshul khrims ldan pa smon pas 'grub/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba kho na'i nus mthur sems so/ / khyad par du 'phags ma rig byed ma ni sku tshe du mar 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha yin pas/ skyabs mgon mchog gis legs babs pa ltar de'i bsnyen sgrub gnang ba na/ byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa mngon mtshan che ba mi ring 230

༄7/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtog4brjod legayotshogasasgo 'byed/bar byung / de'i sgrub pa gnang tshul rgyus med pa'i slob ma zhig gi rmi lam du yang / nyid nas dbu rgyan zhig bzhes yod pa'i steng du bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku lnga yod pa mis pa dang / yang phyis su slob ma zhig gi nyams snang la dam pa nyid lha mchog de'i rnam par bzhengs pa'i sku lus shel sgong ltar dwangs shing gsal ba/ de'i thugs ga'i sa4 bon gyi go sar skyabs mgon mchog gi yang srid rin po che bzhugs pa'i snang ba shar pa sogs snga phyir rtags ya mtshan che ba mang du snang ngo / / de ltar lo gnyis kyi ring gzungs gzhug bzhengs rgyu dang sgrub rgyu sogs tshags su tshud par byas te/ lcags khyi'i lo gzungs gzhug rgyab khal sum cu tsam yod pa de thams cad tshon gyes spras pa'i sgam mang por bzhugs su bcug nas bla brang du gdan drangs/ 'bul ba'i tshe yang nyid kyis phyag bstar te gzungs re re tsom yang dbu zhabs ma log cing /srub cung zad re tsam la yang dri bzang gi bye ma gos dar gyi nang du thum bur byas pas bkang ste/ bar stong cung zad tsam yang med pa sogs phyag len shig tu ngos dag pa gzhan 'gran med pa lta bu byung bas skyabs mgon mchog kyang thugs shin tu dgyes/ spyir sngon gyi dus bzang po rnams su bzhengs pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ phyis kyi rten gsar bzhengs la byams chen rten dang brten pa 'di lta bu phyogs gang du yang med cing / khyad par du nang gi gzungs 'jug la 'di 'dra ba'i gzungs sngags sogs 'dzom che zhing / bri sgrub thams cad dngos dag pa dang / gzhan gyi mig gis mi mthong ba'i sar yang rgyu gang bzang gi 'gros shin tu rgya chen po byas pa 'di 'dra ba gang du yang mi srid pa lta bu yin la/ de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bde legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba las 'bras la yid ches gting tshugs pa'i stobs kyis yin par snang bas/ skye bo bsod nams gsog par 'dod pa rnams kyis rang gi 231

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/sgrub lugs kyang dam pa'i rnam thar 'di dag dang bsdur te/ ngoms chos tsam ma yin par chos rnam dag tu 'gro ba zhig byed pa gal che'o/ / de yang sngon gyi dam pa gong ma rnams 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rten 'brel bla ma la brten nas 'grig pa dgos pas/ gnas pa tshe'i rten 'brel bla ma la brten nas bsgrigs pa sa ra ha lta bu/ rnam 'byed shes rab kyi rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa shā ri'i bu lta bu/ bgo ba gos kyi rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa tha ga li lta bu/ bza' ba zas kyi rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa rdeng ge pa lta bu/ spyad pa nor gyi rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa ma tai gi lta bu/rgyan 'dod yon gyi rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa ind+ra bo dhi lta bu/ 'du ba 'khor gyi rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa surya dharma lta bu/ snyan pa grags pa'i rten 'brel— bla ma la bsgrigs pa tsatram̐ go mi lta bu/ nang zhi pa'i rten 'brel bla ma la bsgrigs pa khri ding garba lta bu dgos par gsungs pa bzhin/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la yang zas gos yo byad/ nor 'bru rkang 'gro rin po che la sogs pa'i longs spyod ji snyed cig byung na yang 'khor ba'i bde 'byor thams cad chu shing bzhin du snying po cung zad tsam yang med par gzigs pas/rang don du de la zhen chags cung zad tsam yang mi mdzad cing / rang gzhan gnyis ga'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ pha rol po rnams kyis dad pas sbyin pa cung zad tsam yang chud zos su mi gtong bar bla ma'i sku don gyi phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu 'gro nges pa dang / sgo gsum gyi bya ba mtha' dag kyang rang don yid byed kyis ma bslad par bla ma'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur nges pa kho na mdzad/ nor rdzas lta bu rang nyid kyis bla ma la phul zin pa na/ des chos dang srid kyi bya ba ci 'dra zhig tu bkol yang / de nyid mkha' khyab kyi bstani pa dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don yin par je tshom 232

༅/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshog sgo 'byed/med pa'i stobs kyis rjes su yi rang 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur la/ da lta 'ga' zhig rang gisaphul ba'i rdzas de bla mas srid skyong gi phyogs lta bur btang na chud zos su song snyam du 'gyod pa byed pa ni mdzad pa de yang dgos dbang gis de ltar bstan pa don chen po can yin pa ma shes par/ 'jig rten rang dga' ba'i bya ba lta bur bzung ba'i skyo na yin la/ gang zag gcig gi spyod par sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yin min gyi cha gnyis 'byung tshul med pas/ kha nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ / zhes ci tsam smras kyang / don la de nyid rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i 'jig rten pa dang / mdzad pa mtha' dag 'jig rten pa'i spyod par bzung ba'i rang mtshang phyir bstan pa kho na yin te/sgra sgyur mar pas nor rdzas gang yod gser du bsgyur nas nā ro pa la phul ba na/des nam mkha' la gtor yang slob ma'i tshogs dzogs par bshad kyi/ chud zos su song bar ma gsungs so/ / 'di'i lo snga phyi ci rigs par chos bzhin duspyod pa'i slob ma don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis gsol ba btab pa ltar/'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung gi snying po byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo'i bshad lung zhig kyang stsal la/ gzhan yang chos bka' thor bu ba 'ga' zhig gnang /phag lo'i ston skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa sku khams ma bde ba'i skabs zhabs brtan gtos che ba nyin mtshan med par bsgrubs/ skabs shig tu zhabs 'brang ba 'ga' zhig la nga'i rmi lam du nam mkha' na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku zhig 'dug pa rim gyis je mtho je mthor song ste/ mthar nam mkha'i dbyings su mi mngon par thim song ba zhiwa rmis/ bstan pa'i gegs chad dang snyigs ma'i skye bo bsod nams zad pa'i stobs kyis gsol ba thebs pa zhig mi yong ba 'dra gsungs/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes la rdo rje 'chang chen po dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pa'i gnas tshul gsan ma thag bla ma dang 233

༄/ /yo ca b.lopa'isgronama'i ga 'asgegadakyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med du byas te phyi nang gsang ba de bo na nyid kyi mchod pa bsam gyes mi khyab pa phul/ rjes 'jug thams cad la yang zhal ta gnang ste/ da rang re rnams mya ngan byas pa kho nas go mi chod/ bla ma thugs rje can des dus nyin mtshan kun tu thugs la bcings rgyu ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na yin/ bstan pa spyi khyabakyi don la rang re lta bus smon lam re 'debs pa ma gtogs sa chod chen po mi yong yang / rang rang gi steng la babs pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba re yod pa de ma shor ba byed dgos/ de'i yang rtsa ba lta bu rang gis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung rgyu 'di yin/ de byas na bla ma'i dgongs pa yang rdzogs/ rang gi don yang 'grub pas bsgrim dgos zhes sogs zhal ta rus pa can mang du gnang ste/mngon mtshan chung la sa chod che ba'i dgongs dzogs bla na med pa bsgrubs/byi ba'i lo mgor bla brang zhabs sdod rnams gros mthun gyis bla ma'i sku don ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa la khong las lhag pa mi rnyed pas/ skyabs mgon mchog gi yang srid myur phebs kyi rim gro gtso cher nyid nas 'gan khur bzhes dgos tshul zhus te bla brang du gdan drangs/ 'on kyang mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs shas cher nyid kyi phyag rdzas steng nas bton te sgol ma maṇḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga mang du bsgrubs/ lo der sku gdung gi mchod rten chen po bzhengs bzhin par yod pas/ de'i gzungs gzhug kyang sngar rgyun ltar nyid nas bkod khyab bka' drin skyong dgos/ da lan cha rkyen gang dgosabla brang gi phyag rdzas nang nas 'gro ba zhig byed dgos zhus par/ sku gdung mchod rten gyi zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu byung ba rang skal ba bzang pas cis kyang khur len byed/ cha rkyen 'phral du mi dgos pas slar rim gyes zhus chog pa byed gsungs kyang / phyis su nang nas cung zad kyang ma bzhes par rang gi 234

༄/ /mkhayogrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabarjod legalotshogs sgo 'byed/phyag rdzas kho na'i steng nas sngar bzhin gzungs gzhug thams cad bri sgrub sogs lo gcig pu'i kho ngas der tshags su tshud nges mdzad nas glang gi lo mgor 'bul ba gnang / ma cig lab sgron gyis gnang ba'i dgon gnas 'di'i skor gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan zhig tu/ klu bdud phyogs su mchod rten rtsigs/ / zhes pa'i lung bstan dus thabs kyis dgon pa'i byang shar ngos su mchod rten zhig bzhengs dgos byung ba'i tshe/ kho bo cag tshogs 'du mang dang bcas nas mchod rten gyi phyi'i chag tshad nang gi gzungs 'dug thams cad kyang tshad dang ldan pa gnad du 'gro nges shig dgos 'jug pas/ nyid nas thugs khur bka' drin skyong dgos zhus par dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes/ ljags bkod zhib mo mdzad de rgyun du bcar sdod kyi do dam dge slong mkhas mchog gis bgyis shing / gzungs 'jug rnams nyid kyis thugs khur bzhes te phul du phyin pa bsgrubs/ mchod rten las mgo tshugs ma thag stong gi rnam pas 'tshub che tsam byung yang / legs par grub pa nas bzung dgon pa'i chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag la phan pa shin tu che bas bka' drin bla na med par gyur/ skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs brtan du mdo sde bskal bzang shog bu re la gser shog stong bam re 'gro nges byas pa gcig dang / gser dngul spel mas bris pa tshar gcig sgrol dkar gye bstod pa 'khor ba las sgrol ma tshar re la sngags tshar re btags pa stong phrag gcig rnams yig gzugs legs shing dag thon par byas te bris/ gzhan yang mchog sprul myur gsal gyi don du gser thang du ma dang / mdo rgyud gsung rab mang du bzhengs yod 'dug kyang zhib cha ma nges/ de skabs rgyud grwa dang 'bum khang ri khrod gnyis sku gsung thugs rten mang bas yul gyi bcad lta bu dang / cho ga phyag len rnam par dag pas gson gshin kun gyi don la 235

༄/ /gung thang bam pa'i zame'i khrung 'bum/bsod nams kyi zhing sar 'gyur nges pa/ yul phyogs gzhan kun kyang yid smon 'cha' ba'i gnas su yod pa la/ yul mi'i bsod nams kyis ma 'chun pa dang / phyi nang nas bdud rigs du ma dpung bsgril te rang gi phan bde'i rtsa ba rang gis bshig par ma zad dam pa 'di'i sku la bsdo ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa mang du brtsams pa na/ smra tshang dka' bcus dam nyams 'di dag gi snying gdon gyes brlams nas ci byed ci 'dug pas gzhan zhig tu byol na zhes snyeng thag pa nas nan zhus byas par/ khyed sems mi bde mi dgos/ nga la yang skyabs mgon de nyid kyi byen rlabs cung zad zhugs yod pas/ 'di tsho 'dra ba zhig gis thub mi yong gsungs/ rgyun par sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho na mdzad kyang / de'i tshe kho shin tu sems ma bde ba la snying rje nas gdeng tshad kyi gsung phebs par snang / da lta grub pa'i dbang por grags pa phal cher/ kha ngoms/ lto 'grang / sos dal ba'i tshe mngon shes dang grub rtags yod yod 'dra yang / gal la thug pa'i tshe gtad so med par u thug nas sdod par snang bas/ de lta bu'i rkyen ngan ru 'dzing gi tshe cung zad tsam yang bag tsha ba med par/ bla ma la blo khel ba'i gdeng thub pa ni grub pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba zhig go / spyir bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas yin kyang /de'i tshod kyi byin rlabs 'byung ba la slob mas de sangs rgyas dngos su mthong dgos shing / byang sems su mthong na de'i tshod kyi byin rlabs dang / so skye phal bar mthong na byen rlabs gtan mi 'jug pas/ byin rlabs che chung slob ma rang nyid la rag las pa yin te/ sngon 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos phag mo grub bla mar bsten te/ mos gus kho na bsgoms pas rtogs pa klong du gyur te rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por song ba na/ phag gru'i slob ma tsa ri pa zer bas/ nged gnyis bla ma mi gcig par snang / kho'i bla ma 236

༄za/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogayobarjod legs tshogayosgo 'byed/sangs rgyas su 'dug / nga'i bla ma dge bshes khams pa yin zhes bshad pa'i dper snang ngo / / skyabs mgon nyid la yang / bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan dpal gyi sa skya man chod nas/ shar rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun chad du mkhas grub kyi slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu yod kyang / mos gus kyi rtser son pa ni skyes mchog 'di nyid yin pas/ thar pa rtser mjal skabs shig tu yang /dad pa can gyi sgom khang na/ / bla ma sgo nyal byed kyin yod/ / ces mi 'bral ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad pa 'di 'dra gzhan su la yang gsung ba mi snang ngo / /de nas snyegs ma'i dus kyi dgon sgrub sde sogs kyang re gnyis tsam ma gtogs phal cher bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba las zhabs 'dren du 'gro ba mang zhing / skye bo skal dman rnams kyis sdig pa gsog pa'i rgyur 'gro ba sogs dgag bya mang du gzigs pas thugs skyo nas/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi 'dzin bdag mi byed par dgongs pa na/ bu slob rnams kyis dgon gnas shig 'debs dgos pa'i zhu ba nan tan du phul kyang ma gsan/ de nas nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma kha gron nang ba dang / reb tsha'i brag sgom pa/ 'dul 'dzin ye shes rgya mtsho rnams kyis kyang dngos dang gsung 'phrin ci rigs kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i tha ma 'dir sems can re re tsam la yang phan pa'i phyir/ snying stobs skyed dgos pa'i dus yin pas ci nas kyang dgon pa zhig 'debs dgos tshul nan che ba'i gsung ma bzlog pa dang / gtso cher da dung yang dmu rgod kyi sa'i mtha' 'dir skyabs mgon mchog gi 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chab rgyun 'dren pa'i 'bab stegs su dgongs te zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas ru stod ma'i ser skya thams cad mgrin gcig gis khong tsho'i sa der 'debs dgos par zhus pa bzhin du thugs thag bcad/ de'i stod smad kyi sa gnas kha shas la brtag pa gnang bar da lta'i dgon gnas 'dir babs pas/237

༄/ /ca ca b.lo pa'i me'i ga4 ཿma/zhal slob 'ga' zhig gis de ha cang dgra jag gi sar song bas mi 'thad tshul zhus pa na/ 'o na dpe mo zhig 'debs gsungs nas rig byed ma'i chos skor gyi mtshams shig nas zhal phyes par/ gzhan sde'i mtshon 'gog go cha ma bgos shing / / pha rol gzhom pa'i dpung tshogs grogs med par/ / khams gsum gnas pa'i che btsan stobs ldan gyi/ / g.yul las rnam rgyal rig byed lha khyod dpa'/ / zhes babs 'dug pa gzigs te/ 'o 'di 'dra zhig babs yong snyam pa yod gsungs par/ thams cad yid ches skyes nas snga ma'i gsung steng du bzhag / de nas dgung lo nga bzhi pa me pho 'brug gi lo ston pas sher phyin gye mdo dang dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i dus chen khyad par can nag zla'i nya la gnas der phebs nas bkra shis gso sbyong dang /sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa'i lung gi dbu btsugs/ thog mar sa 'dul gyi skabs su bud med dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs can zhig la thog mar sa brkor bcug pa sogs rten 'brel gyi bcos pa ngo mtshar ba 'ga' zhig gnang ba ni dgongs gzhi khyad par can zhig yod par mngon te/ de'i sngon tsam la ru stod ma'i mi tshang re re'i sgor bud med mda' dar bzung ba re re yod pa dang / gnas de'i ri klung thams cad 'char ga'i mtshams sprin gsar ba lta bu'i 'od kyis khyab pa sogs mnal ltas ngo mtshar ba mang du byung snang ngo / /gnas der don gnyer can du ma la byang chub lam rim chen mo mchan sum sbragasakyi steng nas bshad lung shin tu rgyas pa dri ma med pa'i rigs pa dang /shes byed kyi lung / gsal byed kyi dpe/ dam pa gong ma du ma'i bshad rgyun sogs kyis brgyan pas shin tu 'byams klas shing / de yang phyi nas phar mda' sgron pa bzhin nan gyis sbyar ba de 'dra ma yin par/ snye ma nang nas 'bus pa bzhin nyams myong gi khog nas 'ongs pa'i gang gsungs mtha' dag 238

sa༅/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogayobarjod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/go rgyu gting zab cing / nyams len kho nar 'bab pa/ sems ngo la lhan gyis 'byar 'gro ba zhig gnang bas nyan pa po mtha' dag blo shin tu 'khul ba byung / bshad lung gnang rgyu'i thog mar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rjes gnang zhig stsal 'dug pa yang dgos pa khyad par pa zhig yod par sems/nyin gcig de dang ha cang thag mi ring ba'i sa zhig nas 'thab 'dzing zhig byung ste 'ga' zhig dgon pa'i nang du bros yong ba na/ pha rol po de dag gi rjes bsnyegs nas 'ongs te/ khong dpon slob rnams kyis phyir bshol ba la yang tshig ngan sna tshogs smras/ mtshan mo der brag mgon po'i mdun ri'i rtse nas 'ja' dkar po 'od dang ldan pa zhig byung ba dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i ngos su zug pa byung bas/ phyi nyin bka' chos kyi skabs su kha sang nged rnams la ngan smras byas pa der yul lha dkar phyogs pa rnams ma dgyes 'dug / 'on kyang rang gzhan su la yang gnod 'tshe ma byung na legs pas/ thams cad kyis de thugs la bzung nas 'phrin las bcol dgos gsungs te/ dkar gtor bsngo ba sogs mdzad kyang zlog ma thub par de phyogs su ser ba drag po babs shing / nad 'khrug sogs nyer 'tshe sna tshogs brgyud mar byung / da lta rang don la babs pa'i tshe mig gi lta lugs legs nyes tsam yang mi bzod kyang /bla ma'i sku dgra dang bstan pa'i spyi dgra sogs la byams snying rje kho na sgom pa'i byang sems rnams dang / dam pa 'di'i mdzad spyod gnyis 'gal ba ltag sprod kho nar snang bas/ gdug la rtag tu byams byed pa/ / zhes pa'i rtsa ltung gi ngos 'dzin ma 'dra ba yin nam snyam/ nyid nas gsung bkod gnang ste lo gnyis kyi ring gzims khang dang grwa gshag drug cu skor sogs legs par bsgrubs/ de'i zhar la phyogs so sor phebs te don gnyer can rnams la rang rang gi mos pa ltar gyi 'dod chos mtha' yas pa gnang ba dang / bla 239

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'isome'i gsung 4ma/brang du yang lan mang po phebs nas yang srid rin po che'i sku don gye rim gro rgya gang che lo re bzhin gyi dkyus ma dang / skabs thob kyi rim gro 'phar ma mang du bsgrubs/ lan gcig bla brang chen mor rnam sras bsnyen sgrub cig gnang ba'i skabs/ mtsho chen po yid du 'ong ba me tog gis brgyan pa zhig tu ba dmar po gnyis 'gro 'ong byed pa'i snang ba dang mnal ltas ya mtshan pa 'ga' zhig rmis shing / dge slong byams pa sogs sku 'khor 'ga' zhig la yang rmi lam ngo mtshar can sna tshogs byung snang / sbrul lo'i ston mjug gnas chung gi sku rten zhig la yang srid rin po che'i don gyi dri ba gnang ba'i tshe/ khyed skyes bu dam pa yin/ skyabs mgon rin po che'i yang srid gang yin nged kyis bshad mi dgos/ khyed kyi thugs na yod pa de yin mod/ ces gsungs 'dug sku rten de la nged kyis dris pa'i tshe yang srid 'khrul med rong po'i sha bi nar na yod pa de yin zhing / kha sang zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du thag yang bcad tshar yod zer byung / slar rtsad bcad pa na de gong tsam la dge slong byams pas skyabs mgon rin po che'i yang srid 'di la yang dogs gnas mang po yod pa dang / deng sang bstan pa'i gegs 'tshub kyang shin tu che ba'i stabasakyis 'khrul med cig lag tu 'ong mi 'ong ci 'dra yin zhes sems khral byas pa na/ khong rin po che nas khyod sems khral byed mi dgos/ da dung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di de tsam gyi tshod la ma sleb pas skyes bu dam pa'i thugs bskyed kyis bslas mi yong / skyabs mgon mchog gi yang srid kyang phral cher rong po sha bi nar gyi de yin 'gro mod gsungs 'dug pas/ snga phyi thams cad khog gcig tu 'bab par snang / dgung lo nga drug pa sa rta'i lo bla brang du phebs nas skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gdan sar phebs rgyu'i don la dmigs bsal gyi sku rim mang po bsgrubs/ khri 'don gyi legs 240

༄/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i togs brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/'bul btegs pa na/ mchog sprul rin po che nas kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dgyes nyams che ba mdzad cing / nyid la yang dag pa'i gzigs snang khyad du 'phags pa zhig byung 'dug dme bo'i dgon gsar gyi yang bya byed mtha' dag gi mgo 'dren bkod khyab nyid nas mdzad cing / snga phyir mchod rdzas sogs gang dgos kyi gnang cha yang spam mtho ba stsal/ dgon 'debs rgyu'i don la brtag pa gnang ba'i tshe/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i lhag mos 'od gsal du sdud pa'i rim pa de nyid ji lta ba bzhin rmi lam du 'char ba zhig byung gsungs pa ni/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ / sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'od gsal de nyid lha'i 'khor lo mtha' dag gi 'byung gnas yin pas/ de dag gi rnal 'byor sgrub pa po 'dus pa'i dge 'dun dkon mchog dam pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde zhig 'chag rgyu'i mtshan ma yin nam snyam/ gzhan yang snang ba de lta bu rang dga' bas nyin mo nan tan du gsal btab kyang mi 'char ba zhig dam pa 'dir rmi lam na yang ji lta ba bzhin 'char ba ni/ bsre 'pho'i man ngag gi sgo nas go 'phang mthon por slebs pa'i khyad chos mkhas pas ya mtshan gye gnas zhig go / 'du khang gi shing cha 'dren skabs shog pa'i nang du 'then 'khyer cung zad byung skabs zhabs phyi 'ga' zhig gis skyon yod med zhus par/ra ba 'dir dam can chos rgyal gyis gar byed pa zhig rmis pas skyon med gsungs pa bzhin/ ma 'gyang bar 'dums te thams cad 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gyur/ skabs der yang zhal slob gcig gi rmi lam du yang / khong la dad mi dad kyi skye bo tshan gsum tshogs pa'i mdun ngos na ma te brjid chags pa zhig yod pa de'i mchan khung nas sprug pa zhig chad de/ mi dad pa'i skye bo de dag gi steng khyab par g.yogs pa sogs dge ldan bstan pa'i bka' 241

༄/ /yo ca bayo ba'i sgronama'i ga ཿma/srung chen po nyid kyis thun mong ma yin par bdag tu mdzad nas 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i gtan tshigs shin tu mang ngo / / lug gi lo 'du khang gi rtsig gzhi 'dzin skabs/ gnas kyi shar lho'i mtshams na brag mgon po zer ba zhig yod pa de nas rdo chen bcu gsum mchod rol sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas thog mar blangs te rtsig gzhir bkod/ de'i tshe brag mgon po'i rtse nas bya rog cig 'phur yong ba gzhan gyis bkag kyang ma khogs par dgon gnas su lha bsang chen po btang yod pa'i thog tu babs pa la dpag na/nyid la de'i tshe chos srung gi gzigs snang sogs mang po byung yod tshod du 'dug kyang zhal nas su la yang ma gsungs 'dug grwa pa rdo 'khur mkhan rnams la yang kun gzigs kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i mdo dang / de'i smon lam sogs 'don bzhin par byed rgyu'i ljags bkod bstsal/ 'du khang gi shing bzo rnams kyang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs su bskyed nas mchod pa'i rnam pa mdzad cing / las byed kun la gla mi zhig dang mi 'dra ba'i bza' btung gang bzang gis bsnyen bkur/ thob thang gi yon 'bab nges kyi thog tu gzhan gyis ma shes pa byas te lkog nas kyang dngul gos dar sogs bdag rkyen tshad med pa gtong ba po la ser sna'i dri ma med kyang len pa pos len mi spobs pa lta bu gnang / de skabs kyi mdzad tshul de ni zeg pa chen po'i lam gyi gnad shes pa gcig gis bltas na rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i spyi sdom chen po dzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi nang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba'i nyams len kho nar 'gro ba zhig gnang yod 'dug pas/ dkyus ma'i mkhar las shig dang mi 'dra bar ma zad/ 'dul ba rkyang ba'i phyag len lag gi bla bsko ba sogs spyor dngos thams cad bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur bar byas pa'i rnam thar las kyang lhag pa zhig go /las byed rnams kyang yon gyis mgu bar ma zad/ bla 242

༄/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtog4brjod leg4tshog4sgo 'byed/ma'i rnam thar la dad pa bcos min skyes te rang rang gis gang shes kyi las ka mtha' dag g.yo zol med par dga' bzhin dang du blangs pas las 'gro che la sra zhing brtan pa/ bzo bkod shin tu legs pas yul phyogs na sngar yod kyi lha khang 'du khang thams cad las ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig byung /spre'u'i lo skya bzo mtha' dag grub cing / gnas der phyogs 'dus kyi chos nyan pa shin tu mang po la ba ri brgya rtsa dang snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang sogs chos kyi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston rgya cher stsal/ rnga rgod sprul sku dang the bo sprul sku sogs bsgrub bya du ma la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang ste bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bkod/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams la nyams len snying por byed dgos kyi bslab bya nan tan du bstsal/ de'i lo rjes mar tse ne'i phyogs nas lha bzo mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bos te 'du khang gi shing brkos phal cher la gser ljib thum sogs shing rtsi ldeb ris mtha' dag tshon rtsi gang bzang gis rgyu 'gros tshad med pa'i sgo nas mdzes shing 'od 'bar ba rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang lta bur bsgrubs/ phyogs ris med kyi bla ma sku skye sogs chos nyan pa mang du 'dus par sgrub thabs rin 'byung gi rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / 'jam dbyangs chos skor nang gi lha so so'i rjes gnang / gzhan yang zur bka'i rjes gnang mang po dang / de'i gseng bar du so so'i 'dod pa ltar gyi lung khrid mtha' yas pa sogs chos bka' dpag tu med pa zla ba mang po'i bar rgyun mi 'chad du gnang / rin 'byung nang gi lha mo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang byed rgyu'i zhog ka der/ de'i bca' gzhi sogs byed mi dgos gsungs kyang /mchod dpon gyis rjes gnang ma tshang dogs pas/ de'i mchod gtor sogs bshams nas bzhag pa'i stabs kyis thad der mi gnang ba'i thabs med pa 243

༄/ /gung thang ba༅ pa'i nama'i gsung 'bum/zhig byung / de'i tshe glo bur du 'jigs shing spyi g.ya' ba'i zil chen po zhig dang 'ur chom gyi sgra chen po rgyun mi 'chad pa/ mchod shom sogs kyang 'dar sil sil byed pa zhig byung ba na/ nyid nas gsung 'phro bzhag ste dmigs pa gtad nas bzhugs pas re zhig gi mtshams nas je 'jam du song / skabs der gang nas yong med par 'du khang nang du 'tshub ma chen po zhig kyang yun ring por 'khyug ste mtshams shig rgya mthong khar thon nas song ba sogs 'tshub dang dngos grub gang yang med par rjes gnang skur nyag gcig pa rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i rtags mtshan re nges par 'byung gyen yod 'dug / bla brang nas gdan drangs te skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che'i zhabs brtan rgya che ba yun ring por bsgrubs/ de skabs nyin gcig nged kyi rtsar phebs te/ rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho thog mar gdan sar 'god rgyu'i sngon der bod kyi mi chen so so'i 'dod dbang gis 'azen 'khyer sna tshogs pas lam rgyugs dka' bar byung ba la/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes kyis rig byed ma'i bstod pa zhig mdzad de thugs rgyud bskul bas 'phrin las kyi sgo phye ba yin par 'dug / bcom ldan 'das ma la bstod pa mang yang de nyid gzhan thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig snang / da lan yang skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che 'di'i mdzad 'phrin kho nar dmigs te/bstod pa de nyid la 'grel pa tshig gi 'bru gnon tsam ma yin par/ ma rgyud kyi lam gyi 'gros dang sbyar ba'i shin tu rgyas pa po tir longs pa zhig rtsom dgos zhes bskul ma gnang byung bar/ rang nyid sngar blo kha ma phyogs pa lta bus sngags phyogs la 'dris cha chung zhing / bstod pa de yang don shin tu brling ba zhig yin 'dug pas bri ba rngo mi thogs tshul zhus kyang / dam pa nyid bya ba gang brtsams de nyid ldog tu med par mthar 'don pa zhig yin 244

༄za/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabarjod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/'dug pas ci nas kyang 'bri dgos zhes gsung nan ha cang che ba ma bzlog par bstod 'grel rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba 'di nyid bris pa yin la/ da lta dus kyi tha mar song ste legs bshad la legs bshad du shes pa dkon pas gzhan la phan thogs dka' yang / rang rgyud la bag chags cung zad 'jog pa'i rkyen du song bas bka' drin bla na med par gyur/ dang dus phal mo che zas nor zhig ma byin par gtam bzang po tsam gyis mi mgu ba'i rang dpe lha la bkab ste/ dngos grub zhu ba la yang mchod gtor gal che ba las/ gzhung rtsom pa lta bu de'i rgyur 'gro snyam pa mi snang bas/ dgongs tshul 'di tsam yang bstan pa'igand mkhyen pa'i rang rtags su gsal lo/ / lo chigs snga phyi ci rigs par phyogs phan tshun du ma nas dbang rjes gnang lung khrid man ngag sogs chos bka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang 'dug pas rags rim tsam phyogs sdoms su bkod na/ co ne'i dgon chen nas rje bla ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yi dam lnga'i ya gyal dbang gi che ba dpal phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po dang /kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal bzhi'i dbang chen/ sgrub thabs rin 'byung / snar thang brgya rtsa/'jam dbyangs chos skor/ mgon po bka' bcu gsum/ 'jigs byed sngags btu/ rta phyag khyung gsum sogs kyi rjes gnang / khrid dang lung thor bu pa mang po/ chags phyogs nas dbu ma lung rigs sgron me dang /grub mtha' rin chen 'phreng ba sogs kyi lung / 'jam dbyangs chos skor/rdor sems/ 'jam dkar sogs kyi rjes gnang / dgon li dang brag dkar ri khrod gnyis nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa'i dbang / dgon li sprul sku la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog cing / lam rim gyi khrid/ lung sna tshogs dang zur bka'i rjes gnang mang po/ rkang tsha'i 245

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i g.yo 4ma/phyogs nas lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung tshar gnyis/ yum 'bum pa/be'u bum sngon mo/ chos sbyong rab gsal sogs kyi lung / snar thang brgya rtsa dang 'jam dbyangs chos skor gyi rjes gnang / rnga rgod snang nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa/ kun rig bcu gcig zhal rnams kyi dbang chen/ lha 'dris ri khrod nas bde gsang gnyis kyi dbang / chos 'khor gla ri mgo phyogs nas byang chub bde lam gyi khrid/dbang dang rjes gnad 'ga' zhig sogs gang la gang 'dod kyi chos sbyin rgya cher bstsal/ phyogs nye ring du ma nas tshul khrims kyi bdud rtsi don du gnyer pa'i phyir 'ongs pa rnams la tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa phog pa thams cad kyang thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi mthus bsrung sdom la brtson pa lhur byed pa kho na byung / re gcig pa chu phag gi lo phyogs yas mas nas reb tsha bka' 'gyur ba'i sprul sku/ rnga rgod sprul sku sogs dam pa'i skye rgyud 'dzin pa'i sprul sku du ma dang / sgrub pa la gcig tu gzhol ba'i ri khrod pa mang po/ dka' ram dge bshes du ma sogs don gnyer can brgya phrag du ma 'dus pa la mi tra brgya rtsa'idabang chen yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyud sde so so'i skabs kyi sgos chos mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sogs lag len phra zhing zhib pa 'khor lo'i mgon po skyabs mgonardo rje 'chang chen po'i phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin du bstsal te/ snod ldan slob ma mtha' dag gi rgyud la nges legs sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i sa bon grung po 'debs par mdzad/ dbang gi mjug tu skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas bla brang du dbang 'di gnang skabs sku na mtho yang / bstan pa thugs la bcings te sku tshag la ma gzigs par phyag len zhib mo'i sgo nas dbang yongs su rdzogs par gnang / sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar gsan yig sogs la bltas na deng sang zur bka'i dbang tsho phal cher chad 246

༄/ /mkha grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs bajod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/song ba lta bu red/ yin kyang dus shin tu snyigs pa'i stobs kyis chos rgyun zab mo nub pa la snang rung byed mkhan su yang mi 'dug khyed bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa thugs la bzhag ste/ dbang rgyun 'di dag ma nub par spel dgos zhes bka' phebs tshul gsungs pas bla ma'i yon tan dran pa'i gdung shugs kyis mchi mas brnangs te/ re zhig gsung mi thon pa byung bas chos nyan pa rnams kyang dang pa dang skyo bas sems bzong bzong por gyur/ gzhan yang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi dbang sogs zhu ba po so so'i mos pa ltar gyi zab chos du ma lhug par bstsal/ ri mo'i las la byang chub pa'i pir thogs dbang po 'ga' zhig bos te thub pa'i dbang po rgya gar lugs kyi gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pa'i sku thang shin tu legs pa nyer gsum/bsgrim btag gi hor gos sngon po nor bu cha bdun ma'i gong gsham can/bzang gos kye rgyab sha dang zhal khebs sogs khyad du 'phags pa grangs mtshungs su bsgrubs/ de bzhin du yi dam chos skyong so so'i zhal thang lnga mdzod gos kyi gong gsham dang bcas pa yang gsar du bzhengs/ so sor phyi nang du nang mdzod kha dog sna tshogs dang / bzang gos dmar ser malji spus gtsang sogs kyi na bza' rtsegs lnga bcu skor re dang / phyag mtshan go khrab sogs kyi spyan gzigs bsam las 'das pa phul/ sku thang snga phyir bzhengs skabs dang / 'du khang gi tshon gtong skabs sogs su bzo bo rnams la yon tshad las 'das pa bstar yang / mngon chung kho na mdzad de zhabs 'brang ba rnamasakyis rgyu song gi tho re bsgrigs pa la yang thugs mi dgyes par/ ded kyis rten bzhengs cung zad re byas pa 'di rnams chos brgyad kyi bsam pas byed ma myong bas de 'dra gtan mi dgos gsungs te/ de phyin chad las byed rnams la gnang sbyin mdzad rgyu sogs de dag la sbas nas lkog tu sbyin par 247

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'izlanasa'i g.yo ཿma/mdzad/ de'i stobs kyis rgyu song zhib cha ma nges kyang / rags rtsis tsam la gnas bcu'i zhal thang rnams kyi rgyu yon kho nar yang dngul srang bzhi brgya lhag pa song ba'i tshod du snang / bka' chos gang gnang ba thams cad kyang dbul pos gzhan gyi nor bgrang ba lta bu rang la nyams myong med pa'i kha bshad tsam ma yin par/ dang po bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten te/ des dgyes bzhin bstsal ba'i gdams pa zab mo legs par gsan/ gsan pa'i de ma thag nas bshes gnyen bar ma chad pa las rim par brgyud pa'i gdams pa byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba de nyid rang gi rgyud la sbyar nas nyams myong skye nges su byas te sbyangs/ de rjes gzhan la 'chad ngan dam chos zong du 'grem pa lta bu chos brgyad kyis bslad pa cung zad kyang med par slob ma la snying brtse ba dang / tshul de la brten nas thub bstan rin po che ring du gnas par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam sngon du btang ste/ bshad pa'i tshul yang ma bshad log bshad ha cang bshad pa sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar/ slob ma'i rgyud tshod la sbyar ba'i bshad pa rgyas bsdus 'tsham zhing / tshig nyung ngu res kyang don rgya chen po ston pa dang /brjod bya mdo rgyud kyi zab gnad tshang bas shin tu brling yang / rjod tshul slob ma'i rna bar skyel mkhas pa'i dbang gis blo mchog dman mtha' dag gis go bde ba/ go ba skye tshul yang gzhung de dang des de ltar bshad pa red zer ba tsam gyis shes bya mang po'i rnam grangs tsam ma yin par/ rang gi rgyud thog tu phabs te 'di dang 'di ltar byed dgos pa 'dug snyam du chos min gye spyod pas gnong zhing / nyams len la spro ba ngang gis 'phel ba sogs gang gsung thams cad rgyud 'khul ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu mdzad/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi dbang rjes gnang sogs mdzad pa'i tshe/ bsnyen sogs dag pa 248

༄za/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabarjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas phyag len gyi cha phra mo tsam yang sla chos su ma song ba byas te stsol ba dang / lhag par rgyud sde gong ma'i dbang sogs kyi mjug tu/ bla ma lnga bcu par/ de nas sngags sogs byin pa yis/ / dam chos snod du byas nas su/ / rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni/ / klag dang 'dzin pa nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig so so'i ngos 'dzin go bde ba re dang bcas te/ dam sdom tshul bzhin du bsrung tshul gyi bslab bya nan tan rdo rus thug pa gnang / khrid sogs kyi tshe byis pa chung ngu thang la 'khyams pa ltar gtad so med par gang zin nas bshad pa de 'dra ma yin par/nyams len sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim pa cha tshang la/ blo ngor 'dum bde ba skabs su gang babs kyi gegs sel bogs 'don/ khrid dmigs 'og ma 'og ma nas gong mar 'jug tshul sogs kyi gnad mtha' dag myong steng nas man ngag lag bcangs lta bur gnang / dam pa nyid kyis gsungs pa'i skabs su yang byang chub lam gyi rim pa 'di jo bo'i man ngag yin tshul dper na/ bung bas me tog gi bcud bsdus pa de rang gi lto bar bsags nas ro bcud phun sum tshogs par song ba de sbrang sgam du bsags pa la gzhan gyis sbrang rtsi zhes longs spyod du yod pa ltar/ jo bo chen pos rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag thos bsam gyis gtan la phab/ bsgom pas nyams su bzhes te/myong ba khyad par can 'khrungs pa na rang gi thugs rgyud la nyams rtogs ji ltar skyes pa'i rim pa bzhin du/ lam sgron gyi skabs nas de thams cad skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par bsgrigs te/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis gzhung nyung ngu de'i sgo nas gsung rab mtha' dag nyams su blang du yod pa zhig mdzad pa 'di jo bo'i man ngag tu 'jog tshul yin gsungs pa bzhin/ nyid kyis kyang phyag len du zebs nges pa kho nar mdzad/ khyad par du byang chub lam gyi rim 249

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgroname'i gsung 'thugapa'i don rang gis nyams su len pa dang / gzhan la 'chad pa thams cad la mgo bshes gnyen bsten tshul zhes rlung ltar grags kyang / rang steng du bskor ba na mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ de bzhin rnal 'byor mi brtson pa/ / tshul khrims bsngags pas 'tsho ba dag / phyi ma'i dus na 'byung 'gyur te/ / de dag la ni tshul khrims med/ / gsungs pa bzhin rtsa ba bla ma'i dam tshig gi rmang gzhi zad de/ nyams len gyi mgo tshes gcig lta bu nas 'chugs pas/ lhag ma rnams cha 'dra tsam yang skye ba'i go skabs nam yang mi srid la/bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni byang chub lam gyi rim pa che chung du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i chos skor 'di rnams ni gang las kyang gal che ba gtan gyi 'dun ma'i rtsa bar snang / zhes gsungs pa thugs la bzhag ste/nyams len gyi snying po 'di nyid la chig dril du byas pas rtogs pa gong ma thams cad kyang thugs rgyud la spungs pa bzhin du 'khrungs/ dam pa nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / nged kyis bla ma mang du bsten pa gcig la yang dam tshig gi sel 'jug ma myong / thams cad kyi nang nas kyang skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa la dad pa lhag pa thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan khong gi mdzad spyod thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don kho na las ma 'das pa/ skyed sdug legs nyes ci 'dra zhig byung yang de la mi gzigs par bzod pa'i go cha gyon nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi don la brtson pa skad cig tsam yang mi 'dor ba 'di yin/ khyed rang rnams kyang bla ma'i yon tan dbyis phyin par mthong ste/ dad pa mi ldog pa'i gdeng zhig med na bdud kyi g.yo skyon kha bar lag bar nas rgyud la zhugs te skyon rtog sna tshogs pa zhig skyes yong / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dus rgyun par rang sems la bya ra byas te/ bla ma'i mdzad pa la skyon rtog zhugs ma zhugs brtag dgos 250

༄༅/ /mkha4grubabastan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshog4sgo 'byed/gsungs pa dang / yang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'di rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos yin/ ba'i chu bur gyi mig gis bla ma sangs rgyas su ma mthong yang / mos gus kyi mig gis bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong byas na rdzun du mi 'gro/ don 'di la lcags longs byas kyang ya nga ba med gsungs/gsung 'di'i don phal cher zhig gis go tshul la bla ma'i gzugs sku mtshan dpe sogs kyis brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'i rnam pa lta bur ma mthong yang /yid kyis de ltar bsgoms pa'i mos ngor gsal snang thob pa lta bu la go ba ni don gyi phyogs tsam du yang ma song zhing / deng dus bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi dmigs skor skyong bar 'dod pa phal cher yang / bla ma sangs rgyas su sgom tshul de tsam gyi steng nas byed pa dmigs pa'i gnad ma shes pa yin pas/gsung de'i don cung zad bshad na 'di yin te/ spyir gsang ba 'dus pa las/ byang chub kye sems rdo rje bzhin du blta bar bgyi'o/ / zhes pa dang /lagan rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ slob dpon la slob mas ji ltar blta bar bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la ji lta ba de bzhin du'o/ / zhes sangs rgyas dang 'dra par blta dgos zhes gsungs pa rnams/ngo bo skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan yin pa sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i don yin gyi/ rnam pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i don ma yin pas/ dogs pa de nyid sel ba'i phyir du rje bla mas byang chub lam gye rim pa las/ de dag gi don ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas yin par shes pa na/de la skyon rtog pa'i blo mi 'byung zhing yon tan sems pa'i blo 'byung ba ltar/bla ma la yang ched du byas te skyon rtog pa rnam pa thams cad du 'dor zhing yon tan rtog pa'i blo spyong ba'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ / gnad 'di ma go bar rnam pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku can du bsgoms pas gsal snang skyes kyang skyon 251

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'i sa khrung ཿma/rtog khegs pa'i nges pa med do/ / lha sbyin legs skar sogs kyis thub pa'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa dngos su mthong yang / skyon rtog ma khegs par ma zad rang gi lag par lcags sreg gis 'khor lo 'bri ba sogs 'gran zla byed pa lta bu yin pas/ don 'di la dgongs te lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ slob dpon gyi ni yon tan bzung / / skyon ni nam yang bzung mi bya/ /zhes gong du sangs rgyas su blta bar gsungs pa de'i dgongs pa rang nyid kyis bkral ba bzhin no/ / ngo bo skyon kun zad du mthong ste ci mdzad thams cad la dag snang skye ba zhig byung na/ rnam pa rang cag dang skal ba mnyam par bstan pas tha mal gyi rnam pa 'di lta bur snang ba la skyon mi 'byung zhing / de ltar du bsgom dgos pa'i skabs kyang mang po yod la/ der ma zad rdo rje 'jigs byed lta bu yang ngo bo rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dang snying rje'i rang gzugs su blta dgos pa las/ rnam pa shin tu khros pa'i rnam par bsgom yang skyon rtog tu mi 'gro ba bzhin no/ / des na chu bur gyi mig gis sangs rgyas su ma mthong zhes pa ni sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi rnam pa can du mthong ba dgos pa'i gtso bo min pas de ltar ma mthong ba dang / mos gus kyi mig gis sangs rgyas su mthong zhes pa ni mdzad pa mtha' dag yon tan 'ba' zhig tu mthong ste skyon rtog cung zad kyang ma zhugs pa'i don yin pas/rjes 'jug bla ma'i rnam thar bzhin du slob par 'dod pa dag gis kyang gnad 'di shes par gyis shig rje btsun dam pa nyid nas sbas pa'i brtul zhugs khon lhur mdzad de/ rang gi yon tan rnams gzhan la cung zad tsam yang sgrog par mi byed kyang / bshes gnyen bsten tshul 'di dag ma sbas par lhug paragasungs pa ni/ da lta dus kyi dbang gis chos shes par rlom pa rnams kyang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba 'di la zon mi byed pa'i mig ltos ngan pa 252

༄༅/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtog4brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/nyams smad pa dang / bla ma bsten pa la yon tan du mthong ba dkon pas/tshul de gsungs kyang yon tan bsgrags pa la mi 'gro bar dgongs pa yin te/nyid la 'brel thogs pa'i sbyin bdag sogs rgyus yod phal cher rnam thar lo rgyus gleng ba'i tshe 'phral phugs kyi legs nyes sogs lung bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin thog tu khel ba dang / nad gdon sogs kyi nyer 'tshe drag po bla sngags nus pa can gzhan sus kyang phan ma thogs pa rnams nyid nas spyan dmigs rim gro cung zad re tsam mdzad pas zhi ba dang / 'go ba'i nad rims can gyi sar gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ la lar gzhan rnams ma 'gro gsungs nas nyid gcig pu phebs shing / 'ga' zhig tu 'dzem mi dgos gsungs pa bzhin thams cad song ba la/ nyes skyon cung zad kyang ma byung zhing / phal cherade 'dra'i rigs gang du phebs pa nas bzung ste nad rims rgyun chad pa dang / sbyin bdag 'ga' zhig mdun du 'ongs pa'i khrod nas gcig cung zad ma bde yang sbas nas yong pa mkhyen te/ khyed tsho'i khrod na cung zad re mi bde mkhan yong tshe tshad rims yin 'gro bas/ sems chung byas pa dga' gsungs pa bzhin ma 'gyang bar mngon du thon pa sogs mngon shes dang grub rtags yod tshul gyi rnam thar re brjod rgyu rgyus yod mtha' dag la yod pa las/bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba de rnam thar du shes mkhan dang brjod mkhan dkon par snang ngo / / shing byi'i dgun skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po che rong phyogs kyi dgon lag so sos gdan drangs par phebs pa'i tshe dgon gsar du spyan drangs/ bsu ba'i bkod pa dang gsol ston sogs gzab rgyas kyis bkur ste rim gro bla na med pa zhus/ dgon gsar rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad phul te/ ji srid nam gnas par bla brang gi dgon lag byed rgyu'i yi ge nyid nas bkod pa gnang nas bris te/ dpon po rgan po 253

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i yo khrung 'bum/mtha' dag la mi 'gyur ba'i zel rtags 'jog tu bcug / rgyu nor gyi 'bul ba yang stabs gcig tu byas nas cha chung ba'i skyon gyis ngoms chos lta bur 'gyur du dogs nas/ lan snga phyir nyid kyi gzims khang dang 'du khang /'brogagi mi rtsa'i khyim sogs so so nas phul ba bsdoms par/ rta nor brgya skor dang / dngul dong tse gos phrugs sogs bsdoms pa srang bdun brgya'i skor zhig phul/ bla ma lnga bcu par/ bla ma'i rdzas ni srog ji bzhin/ / de yi sdug pa'ang bla ma bzhin/ / bla ma'i 'khor ni gnyen bzhin du/ / mnyam par bzhag pas rtag tu bsam/ / zhes gsungs pa'i don thugs la bzhag ste zhabs 'brang ba rnams la yang bsnyen bkur dang yon gya nom pa bstar te ches shin tu mgu bar byas/ de nas bzung ste gsung 'phros sogs kyi skabs du mar nged rang gis nyin mtshan med par bla ma'i 'phrin las 'ba' zhig la bsams te dka' las byas nas 'bad pa bzhin bstan pa'i bdag po la 'bul rgyu byung bas/ da ni rang gi bsam pa rdzogs pa yin gsungs te thugs sna bstungs pa'i rnam pa yang yang mdzad/ khyad par shing glang lo'i lnga ba'i nang du nyin gcig g.yo dge sku rten la/ nged kyi mi tshe gcig gi bsam don la 'di ma 'grub bya ba gcig kyang med/ da lo phan la mi sdod gsungs nas rjes kyi bya ba 'ga' zhig gi zhal bkod gnang bar/ sku rten gyis zhabs pad brtan dgos pa'i gsol 'debs nan zhus byas pas/ ngas bshad pa 'di sems la zungs la gtam gzhan la ma 'khyar ba gyis gsungs/ de nas cher ma 'gyang bar sku khams ma bde yang / zhabs brtan sogs sgrub tu ma bcug par ma zad/ chos bka' gnang rgyu dang 'byon bzhud sogs sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad nas so so'i re ba bskangs/ 'on kyang sku nyams rim gyis je ngan du 'gro ba sogs babs lci ba zhig tu yod pa'i gnas tshul gsan te/ bla 254

༄sa/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogasabajod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/brang nas dar han ched mngags kyis btang bas/ brgyad pa'i bcu gsum la brtan bzhugs phul bar rten 'brel la dgongs pas zhal bzhes bzang po gnang / zhabs brtan sgrub rgyu'i zebs phul ba'i steng nas rim gro yang gal chung du ma song ba mdzad dgos tshul nan zhus byas pas 'dun pa ltar bsgrub tu bcug de'i bco brgyad nas sku khams kyang cung zad je dwangs su song ste/phyogs 'dus kyi chos nyan pa rnams la lam rim gyi bshad lung gnang ba'i dbu tshugs/ de skabs bzhes pa cung zad tsam yang ma gnang bas sku nyams la bltas na bzhengs bzhugs tsam yang dka' ba'i tshod yin kyang / khri khar phebs te gsung chos kyi mgo tshugs pa nas sku'i gzi mdangs je gsal du song /gsung gi gdangs mtho zhing gsung bshad shin tu rgyas la zab cing brling ba thogs med du stsal pas chos nyan pa phal cher gyi sems la/ sku khams mi bde ba cung zad kyang mi 'dug snyam pa'i tshod lta bu byung / sku 'khor 'ga' zhig gis nyid sku khams ngan yang bka' chos gnang tshe gzi mdangs je rgyas su 'gro ba zhig 'dug pa ci yin zhus par/ de mdo bton pa'i stabs red gsungs pa ni/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs su/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor byed pa der dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum la mdangs dang spobs pa sogs bsgrub par gsungs pa de lta bu zhig yin par mngon/ bka' chos kyi mthar sngon skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas 'di'i bshad lung gnang ba'i dus su brtse ba'i lta stangs kyis 'khor gyi tshogs der yang yang gzigs pas/ thugs kyi dgongs pa la brtags na rje bla ma'i gsung gi snying po gsung rab mtha' dag gi bcud bsdus pa 'dir 'chad nyan tshul bzhin du byed mkhan re byung na dgongs par 'dug pas/ 'di'i 'chad nyan lan bdun byed rgyu'i dam bca' byas te sngar lan drug song /255

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'ilhanas gsung 'astem/rjes ma 'di mi thub pa e yin snyam yang / da lan bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas legs par 'grub pa byung bas/ dam bca' mthar phyin pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba thams cad du yang nged rang dpon slob rnams rje bla ma'i bstan pa 'di dang mi 'bral bar 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu'i 'dun pa tshang mas thugs la 'dzin dgos zhes yang yang gsungs shing / nyid nas thugs dmigs rgya chen po nan tan mdzad/ dgu pa'i tshes gsum la bka' chos rdzogs par grub/ tshes lnga nas slar yang sku 'khrugs par zhabs phyi pa rnams dang / sku rten sogs kyis sman dang rim gro byed dgos tshul zhus pa na/da de 'dra'i dus tshod min/ sku rten khyod la lnga pa'i bcu bdun gyi nyin ngas bshad yod pa de yin/ lo snga ma zhig nas rlung gi rgyu tshul dang nyams snang sogs la dpags na rang gi tshe'i 'phen pa'i dus tshod dngos la slebs pa yin gsungs nas gsan bzhes ma mdzad/ de nas sku khams rim long du song ba na sku 'khor nang ma rnams kyis gal te da lan zhing gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa zlog tu med pa zhig yin tshe/ slar yang nged cag gi mgon du yang srid 'khrul ba med pa zhig phebs dgos zhus par/ skyes chen dam pa snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa rnams la sprul sku 'byung ba ma gtogs/ nged lta bu la sprul sku 'byung ba ltas ngan yid pas sku skye med/ thugs dam la sdod pa'i rgyu tshogs med pa la ro tsog pur bzhag nas gdung mjal dang mchod 'bul sogs chos brgyad kyis bslad pa'i tshul 'chos kyi rigs ma byed/ zhag gsum gyi bar du phung po bsgul bskyod ma byed/ sngar lo bcu gsum gyi steng nas ru stod ma'i sa cha'i ri zhig gi ngos nas rang gi lus bya rgod la sbyin pa'i 'phen pa btang yod pas zhag gsum pa'i mtshan mo/ dge slong mkhas mchogadon grub/ bstan 'dzin gsum gyis sngar nged kyis bstan yod pa'i ri der 256

༄༅/ /mkhas grub bstan 'dzin pa'i togs brjod legs tshog4sgo 'byed/skyol la re zhig gzhan sus kyang ma tshor ba byed dgos/ 'di nged rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i dge rtsa yin pas bar chad byed mi nyan zhes dam tshig la bkar ba'i gsung nan gnang / chung ngu'i dus nas rang gi lus gzhan la bsdos te gtong sems goms par mdzad pa'i tshul 'di ni theg pa chen po'i lam gye gnad shes pa zhig gis brtags na rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin te/ skye bo phal cher lus sha khrag gi phung po mi ring bar 'dor dgos pa 'di la gtan du bar bzung ste/ 'dun ma gang byas thams cad 'di'i 'tsho skyong gi thabs 'ba' zhig tu byas na yang / nam zhig 'chi bdag gi pho nyas zin te phyi mar 'gro ba na/ shul du skyur dgos pas bya ba thams cad chud zos su song / der ma zad lus la gces par bzung ba'i dbang gis de la brten pas gnyen la chags pa dang / dgra la sdang ba sogs phungakhrol mtha' dag skyed pa yin la/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni rang gi lus kyang brnyan po lta bur gzigs te zhen pa med pa'i stobs kyis de la brten pa'i chags sdang sogs skye ba'i gnas med cing / gnas skabs chos sgrub pa'i yan lag tsam du lus zungs brten pa tsam gyi 'tsho ba dang / gzab 'phyor gye rigs su mi 'gyur la/ ha cang hrul ba yang ma yin pa mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i gos tsam gyis chog shes par mdzad pa'i steng nas lus de nyid cungazad tsam yang bag yangs su mi 'jog par chu bo brgal ba'i gru gzings bzhin du chos sgrub pa'i rgyu 'ba' zhig tu bkal bar mdzad pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag gis lus can thams cad la/ / lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis/ / rtag tu gsod dang smod pa'am/ / brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag / bdag gi lus la rtse byed dam/ / co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang / / bdag gi lus 'di byen zin gyis/ / 'di yi khra tas ci zhig bya/ /257

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'isgonasa'i gsung las/zhes dang / lus 'di bsnyod kyang gzhan 'gro na/ / khyod ko ci ste sha thang gso/ / 'di la gla rngan byin nas ni/ / phan pa med pa 'di la ni/ / thams cad sbyin par mi bya'o/ / 'gro dang 'ong ba'i rten tsam du/ / lus la gru yi blo bzhag ste/ / sems can rnams don sgrub pa'i phyir/ / yid bzhin gyi ni lus su bsgyur/ / zhes pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin mdzad de/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lus la yang zhen pa cung zad kyang skye ba'i go skabs med par mdzad na/longs spyod la zhen pa med pa lta ci smos/ dam pa nyid kyi zhal nas kyang deng phyogs phan tshun mang por song ba 'di bla ma'i 'phrin las la phan pa zhig e yong ma gtogs rang don zhig e 'grub snyam pa min/ dngos po phran tshegs shig kyang lag tu byung ma thag nas bla ma la bsngos te snying po blangs zin pa yin/de las lhag pa 'khor ba'i longs spyod kho rang la snying po gzhi nas ma grub pa'i stobs kyis len tshul med gsungs pas kyang shes so/ / de ltar lus dang longs spyod gtong bar ma zad/ dge rtsa yang gzhan don kho nar gtong bar mdzad de/ sku 'da' kha'i tshe/ bdag gi sha khrag bya khyi la/ / bsam pa thag pas byin pa yi/ / dge ba gang nges 'gro ba kun/ / byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog / ces rkang pa dang po gnyis bsgyur nas/ des thog drangs te spyod 'jug smon lam cha tshang bar yang yang gsungs shing thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ rjes su rnam dkar bsgrub pa'i tshe yang de ltar byed dgos kyi bkod khyab mdzad pas dpogs nus so/ / de ltar bslab pa kun las btus par gsungs pa bzhin/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa gsum char la btang bsrung dag spel bzhi bzhi'i sgo nas slob pa ni/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba yin no/ / sprul sku 'byung ba la bkag cha nan tan du mdzad pa yang / kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos/ slob dpon bsten dang brtson pa ma dgos par/258

༄/ /mkhayothubabastan 'dzin pa'i rtogs bajod legayotshogasasgo 'byed/chosakun ma lus mkhyen par khas 'che ba'i/ / skye rgu'i 'dren par rlom pa'i tshul bden na/ / mdo las rgyu 'bras gsungs pa gtam du zad/ / tshe rabs snga phyi med pa'i 'gro ba dag / med phyir skye ba tsam la su zhig mchir/ /rmongs rtul rigs mthun dbus na chen po'i gar/ / 'gying ba yis kyang thub bstan ches cher smad/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ dam pa re'i ming tsam gye phag tu 'chel nas thos bsam sgom pa gang yang mi nus par dkor zas 'ba' zhig la spyod pas rang nyid phung bar byed cing / chen po'i go sar 'khod de chos min gyi bya ba la zhugs pas bstan pa'i dbu 'phangs smod pa sogs mig ltos la gnod pa dang / lhag par deng dus de las kyang ches snyigs mar gyur te/lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhal nas/ 'byor ldan grwa pa bcu lhag yod phyin chad/ / shi nas 'dzam bu'i gling du skye nges shing / / de yang sngon gyi nye rigs sbyin bdag la/ / cis kyang rang dbang med par skye dgos pa'i/ / deng dus sku skyes rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ byis pa de nyid skye srid du nying mtshams ma sbyar ba'i snga rol nas gnyen bshes grwa rigs so so'i 'dod dbang gis zol sbyor sna tshogs pas rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu ba'i g.yosgyu'i mdzad 'phrin gyi mgo tshugs te/ rten 'brel thog ma nas nyes pa grong bas gnyen bsgrigs pa lta bu mang du 'byung ba la thugs khrel bar 'dug pa shin tu mang bar snang ngo / / 'on kyang skyes bu dam pa 'jig rten du 'byung ba ni gtso bo gdul bya'i skal ba la ltos shing / dam pa nyid nas kyang sku skye yin zer ba zhig mi 'byung zhes nan tan mdzad pa las/ sku'i skye ba tsam zhig gang du bzhes pa kha tshon gcod dka' ba'i gsung zur du ma zhig stsal 'dug ste/sku rten gyis nged cag phyi mar rje nyid dang gang nas mjal ba'i smon lam 'debs dgos zhus pa la/ shasta lar skye ba'i smon lam thob gsungs pas/259

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung 'byam/go khrab bzang po zhig phul te smon lam btab/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni lan gcig dam pa nyid kyi mnal lam du shambha lar 'byon rtsis mdzad pa na/thugs la kun slong zhig bco dgos pa 'dug snyam nas/ rje bla ma'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa zhig byed dgos snyam pa'i 'phen pa khyad par can zhig btang ste phebs ba rmis la/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan ye shes kyis/rje'i gsung rab rnams grub pa'i dbang po dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis shambha'ir gdan drangs te/ da lta rang re'i dge lugs pa rnams la dar ba las kyang de na bshad sgrub kyi 'phel rgyas chen po yod gsungs pa sogs gung 'grig par snang ngo / / yang thugs zin gyi slob ma 'ga' zhig la/ skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyis rang re rnams la byams pa'i gzungs gzhug sgrub rgyu gtad de 'brel dga' bo zhig 'jog rgyu byung ba dang / dgon li rin po che'i gsung gcig kyang yod pas/ dga' ldan du smon lam btab na dga' bo e 'byung gsung / yang skabs gcig tu nged rang la dbang yod na kun mkhyen bla ma'i legs bshad dang mdzad 'phrin gang du dar ba'i phyogs gcig tu smon lam 'debs kyin yod/ 'on kyang sku skye yin zer ba zhig mi 'byung / mi mngon par btsun chung tsho'i khrod nas zhugs te thos bsam sgom gsum zhig byed rgyu byung na de legs gsungs pa rnams 'phal kha bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ dag pa'i zhing du skyes nas kyang brtse ba shugs drag pos kun nas bslang ste/ thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis gtso bor ma dag pa'i zhing du phyin nas/ zhes sogs lta bu zhig dgongs pa'i mthil yin par mngon/ dgon pa'i don dang rjes kyi rnam dkar sgrub tshul ji ltar byed zhus pa la/ dgon pa skyabs mgon rin po cher phul zin pa de yin pas/ bla ma len tshul sogs 'di ltar gyis zhes zhal bkod mdor 260

༄༅/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs bajod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/bsdus dang / gtso cher thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'da' khar 'phags pa'iganas brtan chen po bcu drug la bstan pa gtad pa bzhin du nged rang gis kyang / ston pa'i rnam thar rjes 'jug gis nyams len du 'khyer ba'i khul byas te/ thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug dang bcas pa'i zhal thang 'di rnams bzhengs pa yin pas/ dgon pa'i rten gtsor bzung ste phyag mchod dang gsol 'debs gang drag byed thub na/ byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma khyad par can zhig kyang yod pas nged cag dpon slob rnams gnas brtan chen po rnams kyis rjes su 'dzin cing / dgon pa yang dga' rab gnas pa zhig yod 'gro dge rtsa'i don du skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa gdan 'dren zhig zhus te khang pa dang cha byad sogs shul na gang yod 'di thams cad phul na nged rang gi bsam pa ltar gyi dge rtsa de yin/ dgon sgrub sde sogs la mang 'gyed byas na mi zem zhing / nged kyis sngar yang byed ma myong ste/mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ / bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ / zhes gsungs pa de lag len du btab pa'i khul yin gsungs/spyir dkon mchog gsum gyi nang nas dge 'dun bsod nams kyi zhing du bsngags kyang / bla ma ni mchog gsum ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin pas de las kyang bsod nams kyi zhing du 'gyur che la/ phal cher de las dge 'dun gtso bor byed pa ni mi mang gi kha chod pa'i gtam 'dod pa dang / bla ma gcig pu la blo ma khel bar dge 'dun mang po'i khrod du sangs rgyas byang sems re yod 'gro snyam pa'i blo skyon zhugs pa shas che bar snang / gdung mjalabyed pa sogs kyang nan tan du bkag pa ni/ mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ kho bo mi chen po min/ sems chen po yin/ gsungs pa ltar/ngam pa nyid yon tan gyi tshogs kyis mngon par mtho yang / 'jig rten 261

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i g.yo 'bum/lugs kyi mthon po'i che tshugs sogs la mi dgyes pas tshul 'chos kyi rigs de 'gog ched yin par snang / de nas skyes rabs kyi stag mo lus sbyin dang /ded dpon snying rje chen po'i zhal thang gnyis bkram du bcug nas mchod shom rgya chen po gnang ste thugs smon nan tan mdzad/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ snga nas shi dang 'drar brtsis nas/ / shi na'ang mya ngan byed pa med/ / drung na 'khod pa su dag kyang / / mya ngan gnod pa byed med pas/ / 'di yis sangs rgyas rjes dran sogs/ / sus kyang g.yengs par 'gyur ba med/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ snga mo nas sku 'da' tshul sogs 'byung 'gyur thams cad gyu ru lugs su yang yang gsungs pas/ sku 'khor rnams kyang blo thag chod zin pa dang / bla ma'i gdams ngag gis yid gsos pas mya ngan gyi rnam pa sogs ma byas par gang gsungs bzhin dpon slob lhan cig pas smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor sogs nan tan mdzad/ de'i tshe thub pa'i dbang po'i rnam thar gyi rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa sbyangs pa na snying stobs kyi shugs lhag par 'phel te/ sku lus da lta rang gtong snyam du thugs shin tu rangs par gyur nas dge slong mkhas mchog la/ gzhan la mi mngon par byas te nged do nub lta bu zhig la bskyal btang na gsung bar/ sems kyis ma bzod pas phyag 'tshal te zhu ba nan cher byas nas bshol thub tsam byung / dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung ba'i zhal nas/ des na shes pa che chung / sgo drag zhan/'dun ma mkhas mi mkhas thams cad dus der gsal ba yin/ rang 'chi ba'i tshe dga' ya le/ brod su re ba cig byung na shes che/ sgo drag 'dun ma mkhas/ rang mgo thon pa zhes bya/ gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/ tshe ring du gnas na rnam dkar gyi/ / lam bzang po sgrub po shi yang bde/ / las bag chags bzang po'i ngang du 'chi/ / a la la 262

༄/ /mkhasagrub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/gson shi sems la snyoms/ / tshe sgrub kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /gsungs pa bzhin du 'chi ba la mi 'jigs par ma zad/ dga' ba lhag par skyes pa 'di lta bu ni chos pa rab kyi rnam par thar pa rjes 'jug la spro ba skyed pa'iganas ngo mtshar can zhig go / skabs der dge slong byams pa gzhan zhig tu mngags par slar mjal e thub snyam the tshom du gyur pa'i tshe/ dus tshod cig bzung ste 'di la phyir 'byor ba gyis dang skyon med gsung ba yang de kho na bzhin du gyur/ de nas mi mang gi gtam la cha bzhag med/ nged rang bar skabs su bla ma'i sku don la 'gro bsdad mang tsam byed dgos byung nas rta re zhon pa ma gtogs/ sngar gyi ru stod ma'i dge tshul dbyug pa bzung nas 'gro mkhan de yin pas/ da dgon dang khang gzhis thams cad bla ma la phul te/ nged rang sngon gye 'phro de dang mtshams sbyar te/ bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis/ blo phugs chos la gtad/ chos phugs sprang la gtad/sprang phugs shi la gtad/ shi phugs grog stong zhig la gtad/ gsungs pa ltar gyi gtad pa bzhi po de rang gi smon pa'i mthil rang yin pas/ de la brgyur bkod ma byed gsungs te zhal bkod gnang ba mi 'gyur ba'i ched du yi ger bkod cing / tha na bu slob rnams kyis bdun tshigs kyi ring la zhal 'don gnang rgyu'i rim pa yang thun bzhir bcad de/ chos spyod 'ga' zhig yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ chos rgyal gyi gtor 'bul/ lam rim smon lam dang / bstan 'bar ma/ rkang pa dang po gnyis bsgyur te spyod 'jug smon lam gsung tshul sogs 'don sgrigs kyi yi ge tshun chad kyang gnang nas/ bu pha khyim du 'gro ba bzhin spro dga'i gdeng dang bcas te gzugs sku'i bkod pa nye bar bsdus so/ snga ma'i zhal bkod bzhin gdung zhag gsum du bzhugs pa de'i ring la rlung 263

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgroname'i ga4 lam/bser bu phra mo tsam yang mi ldang ba dang / sku gdung ri khar gdan drangs skabs dgon pa'i mdun ngos nas 'ja' kha dog sna lnga pa zhig dang / rgyab nas 'ja' dkar po zhig shar ba gnyis ga'i sne gcig tu 'dres te shar nub tu zug pa'i ltas ya mtshan pa byung / de nas zhag gnyis kyi mtshams su dbu skra dngagadung rus kyi lhag ma re e yod snyam du bltar phyin pa'i tshe/ sngar ri klung thams cad kha ba 'thug pos non yod pa la/ gdung bzhugs pa'i khor yug rgya khyon che tsam zhig tshun chad du kha ba cung zad kyang med par sa thams cad smug shig ge byed cing / shul na gdung rus cung zad tsam dang dbu skra nyag ma gcig kyang mi 'dug par/ mi gzhan re yong ba e yin snyam nas/mtha' 'khor du bltas pa'i tshe/ kha ba'i nang du kho rang rnams phar 'gro tshur 'gro rjes ma gtogs med pa'i rgyu mtshan blo'i ra ba las 'das par gyur/ de skabs bdag gi rmi lam du shar phyogs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgribs pa dang / shul der zla ba dkar zhing gsal ba zhig 'char ba rmis te khong la lta ba e yin snyam yang / zhag shas kyi 'phror sku khams legs par bde 'dug ces pa'i gtam zhig thos pas/ rmi ltas de ci yin snyam the tshom du gyur na yang de skabs gsang rgya byas pa yin 'dug pas/ rjes sor dris tshe zhing brjes pa'i dus tshod dang rmi lam gnyis ji bzhin par 'grig snang ngo / / de nas bu slob rnams kyis zhal chems bzhin/ skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gdan drangs te nor rdzas kyi snying po gang yod phul/ skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang dam pa nyid kyi bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs kyi bzhed dgongs rnams ji bzhin 'grub pa'i spyan dmigs kyi mtshams sbyor nan tan bka' drin bskyangs/ rjes 'jug bu slob thams cad kyis kyang bla ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i mos gus shugs drag pos rgyud bskul te/ bla 2yo

༄/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs bajod legasatshogs sgo 'byed/ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir rang gi sgo gsum dge ba la sbyor ba'i brtson pa lhur blangs/ der ma zad skabs der yul phyogs de na chos don du gnyer ba'i skye bo ya rab dam pa'i rnam thar gyi rjes su blo kha yar phyogs pa'i rigs la nyid kyi slob ma dang / sbyin bdag tu ma gyur pa med pa lta bu yin pas/ so so nas gdung 'bul sogs kyi spros pa rgya chen po byed 'dod kyang zhal chems kyi stabs kyis byed rgyu ma byung bas/ rang rang gi sa nas dad pa rtse gcig pa'i gsol 'debs/ phyag mchod bzlas brjod sogs dge sbyor la chig dril du 'bad pa kho na byung bas zang zing med pa'i dge tshogs shin tu dngos gtsang ba/ 'a 'ur chung yang don shin tu chen po dang ldan pa kho nar gyur pas dam pa rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pa ni 'di lta bu'o snyam du lhag par yang rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas su gyur to/ / gong du smos pa de dag gi snying po mdor bsdu na/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul la bsam sbyor gnyis las/ dang po la rtsa ba dad pa sbyangs pa dang / bka' drin rjes su dran pas gus par bya ba zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid tshig gi na yam tsam du ma song bar bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos gus bcos min gyis thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul ba dang / spyor bas bsten tshul lasprir bsam pa khyad par can gyi sgo nas/ bla ma'i bsnyen bkur kho na byas pa yang sgrub pa'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ jo bo chen po'i dus su 'brom gyis lotstsha mdzad cing / a mes kyis phyag g.yog kho na mdzad/ dgon pa pas rtse gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bsgoms kyang rtogs pa snga ma gnyis mtho bar byung ba bla ma'i byin rlabs yin par gsungs pa dang / bya yul pas spyan snga ba'i phyag g.yog kho na zhus par/ 'ga' zhig gis 'di dad pa dang shes rab can zhig 'dug pa la/ mi tshe g.yog tu btang ba ma legs zhes bshad pa'i tshe/ nga'i 265

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgroname'i ga lam/bla ma'i phyag g.yog zhus pa de chos yin pa khong tshos ma shes par 'dug gsung nas rgyun par rten dge tshul du bzhugs te/ me 'bud thal 'phyags tshun chad kyis g.yog gang dgos zhus pas/ nyin gcig gzims khang gad bdar byas pa'i snyigs ma phyir 'phod du song ba'i sa nas de kho na nyid kyi don mngon dugyur par gsungs pa bzhin no/ / 'on kyang ngo bo'i sgo nas phye na mdo sde rgyan las/ bkur sti rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / / sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ / zhes zang zing gi mchod pa/ bkur ste'i mchod pa/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa gsum du dbye bar mdzad pa de dag las re re ba tsam ma yin pa cha tshang ba nyams su bzhes te/ zas nor longs spyod gang rnyed mtha' dag pu sa la'i 'dab ma tsam yang rang don du mi 'chang bar bla ma la phul ba zang zing gi mchod pa/ bla mas sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang / dge 'dun gye sde 'dzugs pa sogs kyi zhabs 'degs la skyo ngal gyi 'du shes cung zad kyang med par dka' spyad rgyan du song brtag tu ngu'i rnam thar la 'gran bzod pa'i sgo nas bkur ste'i mchod pa dang / bla mas ji ltar gdams pa bzhin gyi lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i sgo nas rjes 'jug rnams kyang der 'khrid par mdzad de/bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa phyogs mthar spel ba sgrub pa'i mchod pa ste/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gsum ga re re'i cha la yang / gzhan gyis 'gran mi bzod pa de lta bu zhig mdzad de/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpag bsam gye ljon pa chenapo nye bar 'khrungs pa las/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi yal ga phyogs bcur rgyas shing / rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad 'phrin gyi me tog mngon par bzhad pas grags snyan gyi dri bsung phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun tu khyab 266

༄7/ /mkhas grubabastan 'dzin pa'i rtog4brjod legs tshogasasgo 'byed/par gyur to/ / zhes bya ba ni rnam par thar pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid yin no/ / smras pa/ thub pa kun gyi ye shes gcig gyur 'jam dbyangs nyin mor byed pa'i 'od/ / ris su ma chad 'jig rten kun la snang ba'i go 'phang mchog sbyin yang / / dang sems 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i tshal du lhag par 'gyu ba'i rol rtsed kyis/ / yon tan sbrang rtsi'i dog pa rgya chen grags pa'i bsung dang lhan cig rgyas/ / rtsa ba dam tshig rmad byung sdong bu las/ / dngos grub rnam gnyis yal ga brgyar bres pa'i/ / ngo mtshar byang chub rdo rjes rab bsngags te/ / gzhan gyes ched du brjod la ltos ci 'tshal/ / 'on kyang phra rags srid pa'i mtsho brgal te/ / sku gsum nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i thabs/ / bla ma'i lam gyi gru gzings mtshon pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyi rtogs pa brjod pa 'di byas so/ / bla ma'i bla mar gyur pa mthon po'i spor/ / byin rlabs chu bo gyen du mi 'drongs pas/ / mos gus thugs kyi gshong bur 'khyil ba las/ / nyams dang rtogs pa'i rtsi bcud dang por 'khrungs/ / 'phral snang dam par bcos pa'i yon tan tshogs/ / dbyar gyi shwa 'od rdol 'dra mang na yang / / bshes gnyen gangs kyi ri las dal 'bab rgyun/ / ma dros klung du 'khyil ba khyod nyid tsam/ / mos gus gdengs can dbang po'i srub thag gis/ / bla ma'i byen rlabs ri bo mdī ra/ / mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtshor bsgril ba las/ / mkhas dang grub pa'i snang byed zung du shar/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid ston pa'i chos/ / de nyid smra dang sgrub pas 'dzin na yang / / gdugs dang gling bu'i gar 'cham mi ldan pas/ / bstan 'dzin chen po min zhes su zhig smra/ / sgro gdugs blum por bskor ba'i ma yu ra/ / rang skad gling bu bsgyur ba gzhan gyis gsos/ / stag rnga brdobs pa nags kyi shā nas kyang / / snyigs dus chen po dag la 'phya ba 267

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i ga4 4ma/bzhin/ / mtha' yas yon tan tshogs kyis nor 'dzin khyon/ / zab mo bla ma'i lam gyi gom gcig gis/ / rnam gnon sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mi'u thung 'dis/ / cher rlom dregs pa'i stobs ldan 'og tu bcings/ / lhag bsam rtsegacig snying stobs go bgos te/ / dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo nyer bzung nas/ / rdo rje gsum gyi mtshams las mi 'da' bas/ / gtad pa bzhi yi dgongs pa mtha' ru 'khyol/ / lha gcig dī paṃ kā ra'i bzhed dgongs bzhin/ / lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams srol 'dzin pa/ / lha mi'i mgon zhig 'di na mchis so zhes/ / lha yul na yang snyan pa'i rol mo 'khrol/ / e ma tshul khrims pad ma'i spubs ltar gtsang / / mang du mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar yangs/ / gzhan phan lhag bsam zla ba ltar dkar ba/ / dam pa'i rnam thar bsam gyen rjes yi rang / / de phyir phyogs lhung nyi zlas phyed min par/ / gzur gnas rnam par dpyod pa'i 'gram chang gis/ / phye ba'i rtogs brjod sirdu wa ra'i phreng / / thar 'dod yongs kyi mgul ba'i rgyan du mdzod/ / ngan song sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor bying ba'i nyam thag 'gro/ / rnam grol thar pa'i gling du 'jug 'dod rnams/ / bshes gnyen gru gzings mchog dang 'phrad gyur cig / don gnyis lhun grub sbrang rtsi'i snying po can/ / tshogs gnyis 'dab brgya'i phreng ba bzhad pa yi/ / theg mchog rnal 'byor spyod pa pad mo'i tshal/ / bshes gnyen nyin byed 'od dang 'grogs gyur cig / gang la brten na bde chen ye shes kyi/ / rang 'od dag pa rab 'byams brtan g.yo'i khams/ kun la dbang bsgyur rgyal po'i gnas 'thob pa/ / bshes gnyen dkyil 'khor bdag pos skyor gyur cig / ces mkhas pa dang grub pa zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel bar byed pas mtshan dang don 268

༄༅/ /mkha4grub bstan 'dzin pa'i rtogs brjod legs tshogs sgo 'byed/mthun pa'i skyes mchog dam pa gang gi rtogs pa brjod pa legs tshogs sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dam pa nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i grwa slob du ma dang / khyad par dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa dpal ldan grags pas yang yang nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes dben gnas yid dga' chos 'dzin du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa 'di yang / thar 'dod rnams lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi thog ma'i rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rgyur gyur cig / / / oṃ ye dharmā te tu pra bha ba he tuste ṣānta thā ga to khya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni rodha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ༄ swāhā/ / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye sāhā/ /smras pa/ nang du srid zhi'i khams las 'das pa'i mdangs/ / sna tshogs 'phrin las gzugs su shar ba na/ / mi dang mi min rgyal dang rgyal sras kyis/ / bsngags brjod dbyangs su 'khrol ba dngos po'i gshis/ / khyad par snying la 'jam dpal zhugs pa'i rlabs/ / mgrin pa'i 'o mtshor dbyangs can dpal mo dang / / lhan cig rtsen pa'i sgyu 'phrul byed po des/ /nyer bskrun rnam thar me long a ho rmad/ / der ni nor bzang gnyis pa'i rang bzhin gzugs/ / phyin drug spyod pa'i gar dang lhan cig par/ / mngon sum shar bas skal bzang yid kyi mkhar/ / dad gus chu 'dzin gsar ba'i rnam 'gyur 'dzin/ / gang de'i dpal mo dus mthar mi nyams shing / / thar 'dod yid kyi mtsho chen gso slad du/ / chos sbyin 'dzad med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ni/ / ngo mtshar par gyi yur ba'i srol du btsud/ / de mthus thub bstan kun gyi yang snying mchog / blo bzang ring lugs mkha' lding 'bar ba'i shugs/ / 'khrul ba'i zas bral bshad sgrub mtshor zhugs pas/ / 'gro snying kun mkhyen tsinta mā ṇir shog / 'dun ldan snying la rnam thar tshon bzang 269

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i khrung 4ma/gis/ / mngon par bris pa'i dad pa'i ri mo ni/ / byen rlabs nyi ma'i 'od dang lhan cig par/ / sku bzhi'i pho brang mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur cig / par 'dir sgo gsum 'brel thogs thams cad kyang / / tshe rabs 'phreng bar dal 'byor rten rnyed cing / / bshes gnyen dam pa'i ded dpon la brten nas/ / sku gsum rin chen gling du phyin gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni dge ldan bstan pa 'phel rgyas gling gi gnas brtan dkon mchog byams pa dang /nye gnas dkon mchog don grub gnyis kyis rnam thar 'di'i nyid par du bsgrubs pa'i par byang smon tshig tu ban chung rigs smra dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis smras pa'o/ /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ / rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus shing / / dpal ldan bla ma'i dam ga la gnas shog / dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar pa la/ / skad cig tsam yang log lta mi skye zhing / / ci mdzad legs par mthong pa'i mos gus kyis/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la 'jug par shog / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / / 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / / sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ / rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog / bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje'i bden pa dang / / ye shes spyan ldan srung ma'i mthu stobs kyis/ / rnam dag smon gnas ji bzhin 'grub pa dang / / phun tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /270

༄cu/ /rnam dag gangs ri ma'i 'grel pa rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jug ngogs/༄7/ / rje bla ma mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul dang 'brel bar bstod pa rnam dag gangs ri ma'i 'grel pa rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /yab gcig 'jam dpal rdo rjes mdo sngags kyi/ / tshul gnyis shing ta'i srol bzang dbye ba'i phyir/ / bslab gsum ngur sprig 'chang ba'i skur bstan pa/ / sku bzhi'i bdag nyid btsong kha pa la 'dud/ / lnga phrag snyigs ma bdo ba'i tshe thung 'dir/ / drug pa rdo rje 'chang dbang myur lam gyis/ /bdun ldan zung 'jug dpal la spyor ba yi/ / brgyad khri bzhi stong chos phung snying por bsgril/ / skye dgu'i thar lam mtshon pa'i mig gcig pu/ / stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gye gdung 'tshob de'i/ / bgrang yas yon tan phung po'i cha shas tsam/ / bstod pa'i tshig gi dgongs don 'grel la spro/ / de'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba nyid dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po la gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi dam pa'i skyes bu nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar shin tu mang yang / de'i khrod na 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i btsug rgyan mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma ni/ ji skad du rgyan las/ blon po chen po lta bur pha rol phyin la 'jug bya'i phyir/ / byang chub chen po'i phyogs mthun brdal la rtag tu spyan byed phyir/ / gsang ba'i 271

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronace' gsang 'bum/gnas ni rnam gsum rtag tu yang dag 'dzin pa'i phyir/ / zhes sogs ltar/rje bla ma'i rnam thar thun mong ba mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba gsum gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba mtha' dag la lkog tu ma gyur ba'i spyan mnga' ba'i nang gi thugs sras bla na med pa yin te/ de'i phyir rje bla ma rang gis kyang / lhun po'i drung na gser ri ji bzhin du/ / 'gran zla med pa'i dge legs khyod la sbyin/ / zhes gsungs so/ / smra ba'i nyi ma de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje bla ma'i rnam thar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/bstod pa'i rab byed 'ga' zung bcas bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rje bla ma'i thugasabaskyed thun mong ma yin pa'i go cha bzhes tshul las brtsams te gang du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i bkod pa dang sbyar te bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di nyid kyi don nyung ngu'i tshig gis 'grel pa la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ dge ba bsngo ba gsum/ dang po ni/ na mo maspu sgo ṣā ya/rnam dag gangs ri'i 'phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i/ / phyogs 'dir bdag cag mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ / blo dman bsam pa'i ngo dang 'tsham pa'i sku/ / ston mdzad bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes gsungs/de'ang don ngo bo rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyer ma mchis pas/bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med du byas te mchod par brjod pa rgya gar gyi skad du mdzad do/ / de nas tshigs bcad kyi don ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ 'jig rten nga ni mya ngan 'das/ / sa yi steng 'di stong gyur na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ / de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ / kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ / zhes dang / slob dpon padmas/ 'jam dbyangs sprul ba gdul bya bstan pa'i bdag / mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa 272

༄/ /rnam dag gangs ri ma'i 'grel pa rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jug ngogs/'byung / / zhes dang / ma cig gi lung bstan las/ 'phags pa 'jam dbyangasade nyid me mo bya la sku 'khrungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srol btod/ ces sogs dang / mkhas grub rje'i gsang rnam du/ rig pa'i khu byug la dpal ldan zla bas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs mtha' 'khob tu dge slong gi rnam pas 'byon par 'dug pas/ khyod kyang der skye ba long zhes bskul tshul sogs bka' bstan tshad mar gyur pa du mas 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul du bstan pa grags che la/ 'jam dbyangs zhi khro don la gcig kyang tha dad pa'i ldog cha tsam nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed kyi sprul par bstan pa'ang / khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtogs pa las/ da ni lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe/ / nga yi bstan pa 'byung bar byed/ / bstan pa thams cad nub pa'i tshe/ / nga yi bstan pa 'byung bar byed/ / las ngan mtshams med byed pa'i tshe/ / de tshe nga yi bstan pa 'byung / / zhes sogs rgyud lung rtsod med yin la/skyo lugs nas brgyud pa'i gtam rgyud kyi rtogs pa de rwa ba dag mi bzhed kyang /srad rgyud gong ma rnams tshad mar byed pa der/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la/ /nga yi bstan pa 'byung ba'i tshe/ / rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa la/ / bka' bsgos las rnams tshul bzhin gyes/ / zhes pa'ang chos rgyal lnga brgya tha ma'i tshe gshin rje'i gshed rang nyid mi'i gzugs su shar ba rje btsong kha pa'i bka' srol 'di'i bstan srung gi gtso bo byed dgos par bka' bsgos ba yin zhes gsung rgyun la 'byung bas/ 'dis kyang rje bla ma 'jam dpal khro bo'i rnam rol tu 'grub bo/ / gzhan yang chos rje don grub rin po che'i mnal lam du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis sang phod da tsam lung pa 'di'i mda' ru yong gsungs pa'i phyi lo dus tshod der 'khrungs pa dang / mchims blo bzang grags pas chos rje don rin pa la mdo smad du phebs na 'jigs byed dang mjal tshul/273

༄/ /yo ca bayo ba'itshunama'i ga ཿma/de'i tshe mtshan yang nged kyi ming 'di btags na rten 'brel yod tshul lung bstan pa dang / tha na lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe yab kyi mi lam du ri bo rtse lnga nas yin zer ba'i btsun pa me tog gi phreng bas brgyan cing glegs bam bsnams pa zhig gis gnas g.yar dgos zer ba sogs snga phyi'i rtags mtshan du mas kyang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang ngo bo gcig par 'grub bo/ / der ma zad yum gyi rmi lam du lha dang lha mo du mas spyan ras gzigs la bsu ba byed zeranas gser sku zhig nam mkha' nas spyan drangs pa rang la zim par rmis pas spyan ras gzigs dang / yab kyis lcang lo can nas phyag na rdo rjes 'phangs zer ba'i gser gyi rdo rje zhig yum la thim par rmis pas phyag rdor du 'grub tshul rtogs ldan pas rnam thar zur 'debs su gsungs/ spyir 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul par tshad ma'i lung gis bsgrubs pa de nyid kyis rigs gzhan gnyis kyang shugs la 'grub ste/ bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lha'i rgyal bo'i skyes rabs las/ de yang rigs gsum mgon po las/ / tha dad nyid du ga la 'gyur/ / sems can kun la spyan ras gzigs/ / 'di ni snying rje byams pa'i rigs/ / nga ni snying rje chen po nyid/ / nga la spyan ras gzigs zhes grags/ /lus ngag yid gsum zhi 'jam pas/ / 'gro ba kun gyi dpal du gyur/ /'jam pa'i dpal du'ang 'gal ba med/ / kun mkhyen shes rab che ba'i rigs/ / phyag stong re na mi rtog pa'i/ / rdo rje dpal bo re bzung ste/ / gdul dka' 'dul ba nga yin na/ / phyag na rdo rjer 'gal ba med/ / de ni dpa' bo drag po'i rigs/ / de gsum rigs gsum mgon po nyid/ / phyogs su ma zad dngos yin no/ / zhes rigs gsum mgon po ni sku'i rnam pa tha dad pa tsam las dngos po'i gnas tshod rgyal ba thams cad kyi gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs 274

༄/ /rnam dag gangs ri ma'i 'grel pa rmad byung bkod pa'i 'jug ngogs/rje/ skyob pa'i nus mthu gsum yin pas de gsum ngo bo gcig tu tshogs pa las ya bral du 'gro ba nam yang mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ / des na 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa 'di ni sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis kyang / sku'i rnam pa de nyid blo dang skal ba dman pa'i gdul bya rnams kyis mthong mi nus pas/ de dag gi skal ba dang 'tsham par byis pa'am tha mal ba'i sku'i rnam par bstan nas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i snying po yongs su rdzogs pa la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad cing sgom pas nyams su bzhes/ de nyid gdul bya rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du 'doms par mdzad de/ sangs rgyas dngos su byon kyang de las lhag pa'i gdams pa ston rgyu med pa de lta bu'i tshul gyis bstan pa rin po che la ma rtogs log rtog gi dri ma ma lus par bsal nas/ yang dag pa'i lam bzang nyin mo bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pa'i stobs kyis rje btsun byams pa mgon pos/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa 'dra ba zhig 'ong bar shes par byos shig ces seng ge'i sgras dbugs dbyung zhing / rgyal ba rang nyid kyis kyang / sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ / zhes lung bstan te/des na mgon med rnams kyi mgon mdzad tshul yang / mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ tshig spyi'i bshad sgrub rtags kyi dge sbyong gis/ / thub bstan ming tsam lhag mar gyur pa'i dus/ / bslab gsum lung rtogs rgyal ba'i dam chos kun/ / khyod kyis nyin mor mdzad/ ces bstan pa'i snying po ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur te/ rnam grol don du gnyer ba rnams long pa long khrid med pa bzhin 'khyams pa na/ slar yang mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i cha mtha' dag cung zad kyang nyams pa med par 'jig rten kun tu rgyas par 275
