༄༅/ /phulabyung legayobashad ma'i 'grel ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston/las ma 'das pa'i tshul la nges pa snyed pas blang dor cung zad kyang ma 'chol bar byed pa skyes bu chung ngu'i lam dang / mngon mtho'i rten re gnyis brgyud pas mi chog gi / 'khor ba 'di las gtan du thar ba zhig ma byas par bde ba'i go skabs nam yang med par gzigs nas de las thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung rkyen gang gis kyang bzlog tu med pa tsha bas gdungs pa'i glang chen mtsho nang du 'jug pa lta bu'i 'breng gi lam rang gcig bu tsam ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi don du bya dka' ba'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa ma tshang ba med pa'i khur 'dzin pa skyes bu chen po'i lam ste 'og ma 'og ma brtan nas gong mar slob pa las mtho snyegs dang thod rgal du byed pa ma yin pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin go rim ma log par slob pa ste/ dpe glang po che gom pa mi 'chol bar cha mnyam por 'gro bas glang chen stabs gshegs zhes pa yin la/ stobs che bas bzlog dka' zhing khur chen po bkur nas dal 'gros kyis 'gro ba'i khyad par so so dang sbyar ba yin no/ /de ltar lag len du 'khyer bde chos shes par 'jog pa ma gtogs/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis/ sde snod don la mkhas pa'i nga rgyal can/ / blang dor gnas la long ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ / zhes dang / bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgos lce sgom gyis bsdebs pa las/ paṇḍi ta las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem pa 'di'ang mi rigs/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin kha bshad brag thog nas chu 'phyo ba bzhin byed kyang / las 'bras rgyab tu bskyur te gzhan mgo skor ci thub byed pa ni/ sngon ne tso zhig gis sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyad/ zer bzhin du 'bu thu ba'i dpe ltar chos ma shes pa yin pas mdo sde rgyan las/ thos pas chog par 'dzin spong ba/ / de ni chos shes pa zhes brjod/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ / nges par shes pa 323

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'i sgronayo khrung 'bum/yin na blo der zhugs 'gro ba yin la/ sems zhugs na lus ngag gnyis sems kyi bran yin pas de'i rjes su mi 'brang ba'i dbang med cing / de'i nang du sgom yang tshang yod pa yin te/ 'jig rten na'ang bya ba gang la ngang gis zhugs 'gro ba der goms pa che bar 'jog ba bzhin/ / chos kyi don lag tu len pa la ngang gis zhugs 'gro ba de sgom yin gyi/ brag phugs su lus gnad lta stangs byas nas bsdad pa tsam gyis sgom du mi 'gro ste/ rgyan las/yang dang yang du sems pa dang / / 'jal dang nges rtogs goms pa'i lam/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhan la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis spel tshul la/ spyir bshad pa dang / khyad par du 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ don dang ma 'brel 'byam bshad dang / / gzhung dang ma 'brel snyan tshig kun/ / brgal brtag me lha'i zhal zas su/ / stob pas blo gros rnam par dag / ces ltar snang tsam ma yin pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum rnam dag mdzad tshul bstan pa yin te/'chad nyan dang rtsod pa sogs bstan pa'i bya bar 'gro mi 'gro'i dbye ba 'byed pa 'di shin tu gal che bas/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'chad nyan bstan pa 'dzin zhes gsungs pa yang / / nges 'byung rnam dag khrims la brten bcas nas/ / nyan po gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer la/ / mkhas pas sde snod 'chad la dgongs pa yin/ / tshe 'di rnyed grags 'dod pas 'khor bsdus te/ / ma dad mi 'dod bzhin du chos 'chad cing / / nyams len mi byed chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu/ / 'chad nyan 'di yang 'khor ba'i zhags pa yin/ / rtsod pas bstan pa 'dzin par gsungs pa yang / / rang gzhan grub mtha'i gzhung lugs kun shes nas/ / pha rol yang dag lam la zhugs pa'i phyir/ / lta ngan rigs pas bzlog la dgongs pa yin/ / rang nyid 324

༄za/ /phulabyung legasabashad ma'i 'grel ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston/grags 'dod pha rol dma' dbab 'dod/ / g.yo sgyu'i spyod pa tshig tsub ngan sems can/ / ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud sreg / de lta'i rtsod pa 'di yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ / zhes gsungs so/ / rtsom pa'ang kun byang blang dor gyi gnad ston rgyu med par mngon brjod kyi ming cher ma grags pa mang po bsgrigs pas go mi thub pa gtsor 'don gyis mkhas khyad 'don pa ni/ rje ngag dbang byams pas bstan bcos gze ma ra mgor/ su la mi phan med pa nyid dang mtshungs/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dgos pa gdul byas don bde blag tu rtogs pa yin gyi/ ma rtogs par rmongs pa skyed pa dgos don du mi rung ngo / / de bzhin du snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor 'grig kyang brjod don mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang mi 'byor na/ ma ning rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes pa ltar/ / mthong na mtshar yang 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub/ gsungs pa de yin pas/ rje ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis kyang tshig lhug tu sbyor rgyu'i gzhung chen mo med par tshigs bcad dam dum sbyor ba snying po med par gsungs so/ / des na gsung rtsom yang sngon chad po ti gsum bzhi tsam yod pa gzhung don 'dus che la tshig sbyor legs pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston kho nar yod do/ / bstan pa'i bya ba dang 'gro ba'i don du rlom tshad der 'gro ba'i nges pa med pas rang sems dpang par bzhag nas zhu dag byedadagos kyi/ da lta 'ga' zhig skyes bu dam pa nges 'byung sa ltar brtan yang / snying rjes rlung ltar g.yo ba dag la 'gran btsugs te/ rang rang ltogs la me ltar 'bar zhing / rgyal khams chu bzhin myul te rnyed pa btsal ba'ang 'gro don byas pa yin mdog byed mod kyang / dngos su gzhan bslus don gyis rang bslus te/ bdag gzhan bslu ba'i gzhan don gzugs brnyan yin/ / zhes mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas gzugs brnyan gsal ba'i me long du 325

༄/ /yo thang bstan yosgroname'i khrung 'bum/gsungs ba de las ma 'das so/ / phyi'i rnam 'gyur 'dra'ang nang gi bsam tshul ma gcig bas nor ba 'di 'dra yod pa ni/ garma chags med kyis/gdulabya don spyod ces bya dang / / lto phyir gnam dib grong chog gnyis/ /'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs yod/ / ces pa ltar ro/ / bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi nang nas gtso bor gyur ba'ang / tsand+ra go mis/mkhas ba'i bya ba rnam gsum las/ / rtsod 'chad ngag la ma nges pa/ / srid phyir mi 'khrul rtsom pa ste/ / zhes rtsom ba gtso bor bshad lugs gcig kyang yod na'ang / 'chad rtsom gang la'ang ma rtogs log rtog gi dri mas ma sbags pa'i gser sbyang btso ma lta bu zhig 'byung ba la chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi shes rab phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas brgal brtag byed pa 'di las gal che ba med pas/ 'dir yang de gnyi ga rtsod pa'i brgal brtag gis sbyangs te/ dper na chos dbyings bstod par/ ji ltar me yis dag pa'i gos/ / sna tshogs dri ma'i dri ma can/ / ji ltar me yi nang bcug na/ / dri ma tshig 'gyur gos min ltar/ / gsungs pa bzhin rdo rgyus kye gos mer bsregs pa ltar 'khrul ba'i skyon thams cad bsal nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rma med pa zhig 'byung ba yin no/ / kha cig 'jig rten 'di'i lto gos gtam gsum gyi steng nas sor gang gi mtho dman yang mi bzod par chags sdang gi pho rus 'don yang / chos phyogs la blang dor ro snyoms kyis dag snang sbyong khul blun po thams cad dang mthun 'jug gis bzang rdzu byed pa ni g.yo can snyan par smra ba'i rang bzhin yin gyi dam pa'i rnam thar ga la yin/ dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar las/dgagagazhag byed kyang shes/ byas na 'gro don yang 'ong ba rig bzhin du 'gal 'du lung rigs kyi gnod pa 'bab pa de rnams la thams cad phun sum tshogs zer na ni bstan pa la gces spras med pa dang / snying rje chung bar 326

༄༅/ /phul byung legs bshad ma'i 'grel ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston/yang mi 'gyur ram/ zhes dang / thub bstan byi dor las/ rang nyid skye bo phal pa blun po 'ga' zhig gi blo yul du grub par bya ba'i phyir dang / rnyed bkur cung zad 'du ba'i sgo mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i phyir tsam du shes bzhin du chos ma yin pa chos su ston par byed pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ rang gzhan bsru zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams par byed pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ chos min gyi skyon mthong bzhin du chos su smra ba ni dad pa byed pa min gyi/ chos sgong gis sdig pa bsags pa yin par rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mdo las gsungs so/ / lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gnadaje lta ba bzhin du lung rigs kyis gtan la phab pa'i tshe/ gzhan gyi grub mtha' nor ba rnams rta rgyug pa'i zhor la me tog gcod pa bzhin sun phyung yang nyes par 'gyur ba'i gnas med de/ bzhi brgya pa las/ chos 'di rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ / rtsod pa'i phyir ni ma gsungs te/ / 'on kyang me yis bud shing bzhin/ / gzhan sreg 'gyur na nyes pa med/ / ces dang / dpal ldan zla bas kyang / bstan bcos las dpyad rtsod la chags pa'i phyir/ / ma mdzad rnam grol phyir ni de nyid bstan/ / gal te de nyid rnam par dpyad pa na/ / gzhan gzhung 'jig par 'gyur na nyes pa med/ces gsungs so/ / der ma zad gzhan lta spyod nor ba shes shing bcos su yod bzhin du yal bar dor nas de ngan 'gror lhung na lhag par byang sems kyi bslab bya dang mi mthun pa'i nyes par 'gyur te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'i yul du ni/ / gal te 'ga' zhig ma bskul bas/ / ngan song 'gro bar 'gyur na de/ / blo ldan gzhan gyi smad byar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig grub mtha'i dgag gzhag mang bo gnang bas phyogs ris che zhes zer te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mu stegs pa'i gzhung 327

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/klog pa tsam yang bkag / byams pas phyir rgol tshar gcod pa'i phyir sgra tshad gnyis la slob dgos par gsungs/ dpal ldan zla bas/ gzhung lugs rnams ltar gzhan lugs bzhed gzhung 'di las gzhan la dga' blo dor bar bya gsungs/ pe'u bum sngon mo rtsa 'grel tu'ang / de ltar thag bcad lam der 'jug bya/ / sgu ru ru ru gzhan du mi 'tshol/ zhes dang / sgu ru ru ru byas nas gzhan du rtsa dang thig le 'khor lo la sogs pa'i man ngag mi 'tshol gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems de thams cad phyogs ris che ba yin zer ram/ des na lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ bdag ni sangs rgyas phyogs mi 'dzin/ ser skya sogs la mi sdang yang / / gang zhig rigs par ldan pa'i tshig / smra ba de ni ston par 'dzin/ zhes dpyod ldan gzu bor gnas pa'i rang rtags yin no/ / 'on kyang deng dus phan tshun gang la'ang pha shul bus zin nas rang rang gi grub mtha' ngo shes mkhan dkon par snang bas/lta spyod nor ba rnams bkag kyang dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ ngan pa rnams la gdams pa yang / tshig pa za 'gyur zhi mi 'gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin mkhon gyi rgyu las med pas/ nges pa rnyed pa'i lam ma nor ba de rang gi snying la bcangs nas bag chags ci thebs byas na chog par mthong ste kho bos ni dgag gzhag sogs kyi spros pa bskyung ba lags so/ / yang bka' chos sogs kyi dus slob ma'i skyon la rjen par btsugs pas blun po la la mi dga' zhing /'jig rten pa 'ga' zhig gi thabs mi mkhas zer mod kyang / bka' gdams pa'i gsung sgos las/ bshes gnyen gye mchog mtshang la rgol ba yin/ man ngag gi mchog mtshang thog tu bab pa yin/ zhes dang /mtshang nas brus te ma bshad na/ / blun po khyod la go ba med/ / gsungs pa de yin zhing / gzhan yang dpal 'phreng gi mdo las/ tshar gcod pa'i sgo 328

༄za/ /phul byung legayobashad ma'i 'grel ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston/nas bstan pa 'dzin tshul dang / byang sar tshar gcod pa'i tshul khrims/'dul bar nan tur lnga sogs gsungs pa gang yang ma mthong bar byang sems bya ba 'jam 'jam kho na zhig tu go ba'i rmongs yus yin no/ / gnyis pa khyad par du 'chad nyan gyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng tshul ni/ dpal 'byor khur gyis dub rnams kyis/ / ring du dor bya'i dbang khrid lung / / nor bu'i do shal ma lus pa/ / khyod kyi mgrin par lhan cig 'dril/ / dbyangs can ngag gi longs spyod la/ / dbang mdzad de yi zhal gyi sgor/ / blo gsal tshogs kyi re ba'i mig / bu lon chags pa bzhin du gtod/ / ces pa ste/ sho lo ka snga ma ni ched du bajod pa'i tshom las/ dang por bdag nyid rig par gnas byas nas/ / phyi nas bdag bzhin gzhan dag gdul bar bya/ zhes dang /rnam 'grel las/ rang nyid nges shing gzhan dag la/ / nges pa skyed par 'dod pa yis/ / zhes pa ltar gzhan la ston pa la rang gis sngar thos shing gtan la dbab pa ni med mi rung gi rtsa ba yin pas bshad pa'i rim pas 'dir bkod kyang / don gyi rim pa bshes gnyen bsten pa'i skabs dang 'brel bas sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ / de ltar chos kyi mdzod du gyur pas phyogs ris med nas chos don du gnyer ba'i slob ma padma'i mtsho la bung ba bzhin 'dus par dbang rjes gnang lung khrid kyi char phab cing / khyad par du khrid kyi sgor zhal shes man ngag dang bcas pa'i bka' bab lta bur yod/zhu ba po mtho dman mang nyung 'byor pa sogs la ltos pa med par gang 'dod dusnal bas phal cher gyis phod btsong ste nam 'dod du zhus nas bu lon can gyisgo bsrung ste bsnyags pa bzhin byed pa ni skyes rabs las/ sbyin nam mi sbyin snyam pa'i rnam rtog pa/ / yid la sems pa phongs pa rnams la med/ /ces gsungs pa'i dpe bzhin mi gnang dogs pa med pa'i dbang gis yin la/329

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'isomatha ga༅ ཿma/de ltar byas kyang thugs sun pa dang khro ba med pa ni skyo ba spangs pa'i rnam thar ro/ / mdo smad lho rgyud kyi ljongs phal cher du chos bka' gnang zhing slob ma'i tshogs rgya che la/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ mkhas pa rang gi yul bas kyang / / yul khams gzhan du mchod pa thob/ / ces dang / rgyal po rang yul tsam na che/ / dam pa gang du phyin kyang bkur/ / me tog phal cher nyin re'i rgyan/ / gtsug gi nor bu gang du'ang mchod/ / gsungs pa bzhin skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul sku thag gcod rgyu'i don du phebs pa'i tshe/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis sogs bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po du ma dang / grwa sa gsum gyi dge bshes mang pos kyang chos kyi gter du shes nas shin tu dkon pa'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du zhus pa dbus gtsang gi ljongs su'ang chos rgyun nyag phra ba du ma'i chad mthud la shin tu phan pa byung ste dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam grub pa'i rnam thar ro/ / gnyis pa sngags kyi bstan pa bzung tshul ni/ gsang chen chos kyi chu klung brgya/ /'dus pa 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ / dam tshig skya ba 'dzin mkhas der/ /rimaganyis nor bu lag rtser gnas/ / zhes pa ste/ spyir rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag yin kyang 'dir dmigs kyis bkar te dpal ldan 'dus pa dang sbyar ba ni 'dus pa'i rgyud shes shing nyams su blangs na rgyud sde gzhan thams cad kyi gnad der 'du ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ gzhan mtha' dag der 'du ba ni sgon gsal las/ thub pa chen pos chos phung po/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yi/ / dpal ldan 'dus 'di snod yin te/ /de bas de ni rgyud kyi rtse/ / zhes dang / nag po spyod pas kyang / dpal ldan 'dus pa lhag yid 'ong / / rgyud rnams kun son gtso bo yin/ / zhes mdo sngags kyi gsung rab ma lus pa la 'dis rgyas btab ste thams cad kyi 330

༄za/ /phul byung legalobashad ma'i 'grel ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston/dgongs don 'di las 'dar med pas rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po dang mdo sde kun gyi za ma tog tu gsungs te/ gshed dmar dang dgra nag sogs rgyud gzhan dang gzhan las kyang / rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis bsngags brjod mdzad pa mang la de gang gi lam nyams su len pa'i tshe'ang man ngag gi gnad 'di nas btsal dgos pa shin tu mang ngo / / dper na ri mthon po'i rtse mor phyin na ri phran thams cad stabs gcig tu mthong nus pa bzhin/ 'di'i dgongs don legs par khong du chud na rgyud gzhan thams cad bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur te/ de'i rgyu mtshan mthar gtugs na sgron gsal du/ ji srid ya ra la ha'i bar/ / zhes pa nas/ de de'i rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ zhes gsungs te/snga ma rnams yi ge sa ma dza gsum la byas nas 'dus pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i don du bshad kyang / dpal nā ro bas 'bru gsum la bshad pa sku gsung thugasado rje gsum gye don yin pas dgongs pa shin tu zab ste/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi bsgrub bya sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mam sku gsum las ma 'das shing / de sgrub pa'i gnad thams cad 'dir tshang bas rgyud kyi mtshan la'ang 'dus pa zhes btags par rgyud phyi ma las gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de ltar na rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis gang la thos pa bya ba'i yul 'dus pa'i rgyud dang rgyud 'grel zab cing brling la rgya che ba'i rgya mtsho lta bu rnams bstan/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la 'jug tshul ni byis pa klog slob pa bzhin tshig tsam bslab pas mi chog par/ 'jug sgo smin byed kyi dbang rnam par dag pa mnos/ dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i steng nas rgyud nyan pa dang bshad pa la sogs pa byas na rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len du 'gro bas/ de ni/ dam tshig skya ba 'dzin mkhas de/ /331

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'is ma'i gsung 'bum/zhes rkang pa gsum pas bstan/ de ltar byas na rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa bde blag tu skyes pas 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul ni rkang ba bzhi pa/ rim gnyis nor bu la rtser gnas/ / zhes pas bstan to/ / 'dir gtso bor rang gis nyams su blangs tshul la sbyar yang / sngar rang gis nges nas gzhan rjes su bzung tshul bshad pa de mdo sngags gnyi ga la sbyor dgos shing / 'di la khyad par du rgyud kyi dgongs pa mtha' drug tshul bzhis rgyas btab pa rnams bshad rgyud chen po drug dang klu sgrub yab sras sogs kye man ngag la brten nas legs bshad kyi nor bu thang mar brdal te rgyud grwa gnyis sogs su 'chad nyan mdzad tshul gyi lo rgyus mang du yod kyang yig tshogs che bas ma spros so/ / gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ ji ltar bstan pa 'dzin byed pa'i/ / yan lag kun rdzogs khyod lta bu/ / gang las 'byung ste dbus 'gyur du/ / mtshon byed grags pa'i mtshan ma yin/ / zhes bya ste/ da lta ha cang snyigs ma'i mthar song bas skye bo thams cad blo dman zhing col chung / ma rabs kyi spyod pa'i rjesathu blo kha phyogs sla bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin re bzhin nyag je phrar 'gro ba'i dus 'dir snying stobs bskyed de bstan pa'i cha re re tsam 'dzin skyong byed pa'ang ya mtshan dang bsod nams che ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/g.yul chen po'i nang na gang skye bo mang po bsrung pa'i phyir dmag gi mdun na 'dug par 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag ni nyung bar 'gyur ro/ / yang shā ri'i bu gang dpa' ba 'os par 'gyur bar byas pa g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba de dag de na g.yul mi bzad pa chen po'i dus na skye bo mang po'i phyir dmag gi mdun na 'dug pa de bzhin du/ shā ri'i bu de'i tshe dam pa'i chos rab tu 'jig pa nye bar gnas pa na gang lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa 'dod pa/ dpa' ba brtson 'grus brtan pa/ go cha sra ba bgos 332

༄za/ /phul byung legasabashad ma'i 'grel ba mkhayopa'i dga' ston/pa de dag brtson 'grus chen po'i stobs bskyed de bdud kyi dmag las rgyal zhing 'di lta bu'i chos dkon mchog 'di las snying po cung zad tsam len par 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs la/ dpe chos su'ang shā 'od chen po byung ba'i tshe pha bong re re la sa chags rdo chags kyis 'ol kha bsgyur ba bzhin/ snyigs ma'i brlang spyod rdol ba'i dus su'ang skyes bu dam pa re re'i thugs rje la brten nas bstan pa'i srol cung zad rer gnas thub par gsungs pa lta bu yin zhing /bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel pa'i bya ba mtha' dag la dpal 'byor pa'i skyes bu dam pa gang las 'byung ba'i yul de ni kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/mkhas pa gar bsdad bstan pa'i 'od stong dang / / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i pad tshal gcig car du bzhad pa nyin byed dbyar gyi gling bzhi bzhin/ / sngon dus dam pa kun dang sangs rgyas kyis/ / chos 'khor bskor kyang dam pa'i bshes bral ba'i/ / yul de bzang yang mun pa'i rang bzhin te/ / nyin min ston gyis btang ba'i yul dus bzhin/ / yul dus gang na chos sgron 'dul ba'i las/ / bshad sgrub 'od stong bar ba'i yul phyogs te/ / mchod rten mchog dang yul gyi lte ba dang / / dbus dang thig le sogs su sangs rgyas gsungs/ / zhes pa ltar bstan pa'i gnas tshul gyi sgo nas 'jog pa las/yul gcig la dbus 'gyur gyi ming don rtag brtan zer zug tu gnas pa min pas/ ched du brjod pa'i tshom las/ gang na dam pa bzhugs pa yi/ / sa de yid du 'ong ba yin/ / zhes gsungs la/ mngon rtogs rgyan las kyang /byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid/ ces gsungs so/ / don mdor bsdu na bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yin min sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin mi 'dzin gyi sgo nas 'jog dgos la/ bstan pa 'dzin tshul mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis/de 'dzin byed dang smra byed dang / / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ gsungs 333

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i masa'i khrung ཿma/pa ltar/ lung gi bstan pa bshad pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa gnyis las ma 'das la/ khyad par de gnyig legs par tshang ba'i tshul sgro skur dang phyogs lhung gis ma bslad par rnam par thar pa'i rang bzhin gsong por smra ba 'di ni bstod pa'i don gyi snying bo yin no/ / de ltar na 'gro ba'i bde skyid ma lus pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las shing / bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu la rag las pas/ zhabs pad brtan cing rgya mtsho dang klu dbang gi dpe bzhin gang gi 'phrin las dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gnyis srog gcig tu gyur te rgyas par smon pa ni/ de slad smra ba'i seng ge khyod/ / thar 'dod mgon du rtag brtan zhing / / rgyal ba'i bstan dang chabs gcig par/ / bzang po'i 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig / ces pa'o/ / sbyar byang ni/ zhes mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi rgyud pa slob zur dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di ni dang brtson blo dang ldan pa dkon mchog mkhyen rab kyis bskul bar brten/ deng dus che mtho'i rigs la 'ud kyis bstod pa lta bu ma yin par/ mkhas pa'i yon tan mthong ste rang bzhin brjod pa'i tshig gis gzengs bstod pa sngon byon dam pa'i lugs srol bzhin du mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba can/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes bris pa 'di'ang blo dang ldan pa rnams chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa ste 'di'ang dgos don dang bcas drang po zang thal du smras pa yin no/ / nya yis ma bton bstod dbyangs rig byed 'di/ / yon tan sa chen 'degs pa'i rus sbal dang / /'jig rten khengs dregs 'joms pa'i phag rgod de/ / smra ngan dgra 'joms mi yi seng ge yin/ / phyogs lhung sgro btags spun pas ma bslad par/ / drang 334

༄༅/ /phul byung legs bshad ma'i 'grel ba mkhasapa'i dga' ston/gtam gtsang ma'i nas 'bru sil ma 'di/ / blo ldan yid kyi zhing sar smin pa las/ / dad brtson dge ba'i lo tog rgyas gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni a mchog bde mo thang dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi khri ba mkhas btsun bzang po'i rgyan ldan dkon mchog dpal 'dzin gyis sngar nas bstod pa 'di la 'grel pa zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba dang / mdzo dge smad dga' ldan rab rgyas gling nas dad brtson ldan pa 'tsho byed dkon mchog phun tshogs kyis rnam thar zhig dgos zhes nan gyis bskul bas/ rnam thar byed na bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul 'di 'dra zhig dgos par mthong ste bstod pa'i tshig ṭīka tsam ma yin par mthun sgrub kyi rnam thar rags rim tsam dang sbyar nas gnyis 'thus su byas te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /'di yang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde'i/ / thugs rje la brten bkra shis 'khyil gling gi / lho rgyud mdo sngags chos sgra sgogs pa'i tshal/ /dga' ldan chos 'khor gling du legs par grub/ / / /sarba dza ga rta/ / / /335

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronace'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / gnyan rtse dpon slob rin po che'i bstod 'grel nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya chen thos pas ngag gi dbang phyug brnyes/ / tshul bzhin sgrub pas chos kyi de nyid gzigs/ / 'phrin las bzang pos rgyal bstan 'phel mdzad pa/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ / ngag dbang chos kyi chu gter 'phel ba'i bcud/ / bstod dbyangs 'jigs bral 'chi med dbang po'i chab/ / bstan pa'i rjes 'jug dad pa'i srog zungs su/ / 'grel byed rin chen sgron mes gsal bar bya/ / de'ang mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas thub bstan rtsa lag dam par gyur pa 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'khri pa rtsad nas chod pa'i kun spangs chen po/ 'gro ba mtha' dag yang dag pa'i lam bzang po la bkri ba'i jeg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rje btsun bla ma dam pa ngag dbang chos 'phel pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsol 'debs skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i bka' rtsom 'di nyid kyi tshig don cung zad tsam zhig 'chad pa la/mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug gi don dang gsum/ dang po ni/rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lus can yongs kyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che kho na yin zhing /de'i dbang gis bstan pa de nyid nges par 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams ni 336

༄/ /bstod 'grel nor bu'i do shal/'gro ba yongs la bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstod bkur bsngags pa'i zhing bla na med pa yin no/ / 'on kyang da lta ches shin tu snyigs mar song ste/ kha drag dbang che/ stobs 'byor go sa sogs kyi sgo nas bstan 'dzin chen por btags pa la snying po ci yang med pas/ bstan pa 'dzin tshul dpyis phyin pa ni mkhas mchog dbyig gi gnyen pos/ de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lung gi bstan pa bshad pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa gnyis las ma 'das pas/ rab byed 'dir yang de'i dbang du mdzad de/ ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ / bshad sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la/ / lhag bsam mtsho ltar 'phel pa'i sems dpa' mchog / rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du'ang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ / zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ ngag gi dbang phyug brtan pa'i 'khor lo gsum ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba'i gar gyis rol pa rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa lta sgom spyod 'bras gang gi cha la'ang 'khrul ba'i dri ma phra mo tsam gyis kyang ma gos pas gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu/lung gi bstan pa ka rī ka lnga bcu pa nas rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bar dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa rung chu 'debs pa tshun chod kyi bcas pa phra mo nas bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi bar rnams bshad sgrub ya ma bral ba'i sgo nas nyams su bzhes te/ chos min gyi g.yul ngo pham par mdzad cing chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid rtse'i bar du bsgrengs te 'dzin pa la smon lam rlabs po che'i mthu grub pas/ snyigs ma lnga shin tu bdo ba'i dus 'dir yang zhum pa 337

༄/ /gung thang bstanaba'isgronas gsung 'bum/dang skyo ngal med par lhag bsam gyi 'jug pa dbyar gyi chu mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i snying stobs kyi go cha brtsan po'i sgo nas rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi khrod na'ang rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mchog tu 'phags pa rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs so zhes mdor bstan pa yin no/ / gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ klog pa thos bsam gyi sgo nas lung gi bstan pa bzung tshul/spongs pa bsam gtan gyi sgo nas rtogs pa'i bstan pa bzung tshul/ bstan pa'i gnad rnams thugs la 'khrungs te skal ldan gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ brtson 'grus chen pos dam pa'i zhabs bsten nas/ / sde snod gsum la legs par sbyangs pa yis/ / rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan lhang nge ba/ / mkhas pa'i dbang po khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes spyir srid zhi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul yin la/ khyad par du sdud pa las/ bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu brten par bya/ / ci'i phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos kyi rtsa ba bla ma la rag las par dgongs te/dka' spyad dang brtson 'grus chen pos mdo dbus gnyis gar zeg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye mtshan nyid tshang ba'i bla ma dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs/ bsam sbyor gnyis kyi tshul bzhin du bsten nas mnyes par byas/ de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi lam bslab pa rin po che gsum brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa mdo mngon 'dul ba'i sde snod gsum la rtag sbyor dang gus sbyor gyi brtson pa shugs drag chu bo'i rgyun lta bus legs par sbyangs par mdzad pa'i mthu yis gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa brnyes te/ gzur gnas mkhas pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis kyang 'di ni tshig gi na yam tsam yin par gsung rab la nang byan tshud pa'i smra ba'i dbang phyug 338

༄/ /bstod 'grel nor bu'i do shal/bla na med pa'o zhes gcam bu dang zol bstod lta bu ma yin par/ don la gnas pa'i rnam dkar gyi grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon po gdan sa gsum gyi mkhas pa'i khrod na lhang nger 'phags pa mtshungs zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po khyod la gsol ba 'debs zhes lung gi yon tan gyi cha nas bstod pa mdzad do/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ sgrub pa mdzad tshul dang / grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag nyams len du/ / gzhol ba'i tshul 'di dgongs nas dbon pa ru/ / chos brgyad spangs te mang du thos pa'i don/ / rtse gcig goms par mdzad la gsol pa 'debs/ / zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig bka' stsal pa thams cad rnam bshad rigs pa las/ thos rtsod sgrub pa lhur len dang / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ thos rtsod lhur len pa gzhan sde'i bstan bcos lta bu ma yin par sgrub pa nyams len dang thos bsam sgom pa'i rim pas mthar rnam grol gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu gzhol ba'i tshul rje bla mas/ zhi 'gyur min mdzad khyod la med/ / ces dang / dpal ldan zla bas/ bstan bcos las dpyad rtsod la chags pa'i phyir/ / ma mdzad rnam grol phyir ni 'di nyid bstan/ / ces dang / mdo sde rgyan las kyang / de ni bag chags rtog cing zhi ba dang / / rab tu rtogs pas rnam par grol bar byed/ ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin du dgongs nas nang rnam g.yeng las dben zhing /phyi 'du 'dzis dben pa sgrub pa'i bsti gnas du mar rnyed mi rnyed/ dga' mi dga'/ snyan mi snyan/ bstod smad gnyis bcas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba ring du spangs te/ tshe 'di snang gi re dogs gang yang med par ci tsam mang du thos pa'i don de dag thams cad rang rgyud 'dul ba'i yan lag tu kha nang du bskor nas rtse gcig tu goms par mdzad de/ bka' gdams 339

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i lo khrung 4ma/gong ma'i rnam thar lhur bzhes pa'i bdag nyid chen po khyod la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa tshig don tsam yin la/ rgyas par na dben pa'i ri sul du mar 'tsho ba dka' spyad drag po rje btsun mi la lta bu'i snyeng rus bskyed tshul gyi rnam thar lo rgyus rnams kyang 'di dang sbyar nas bshad na legs so/ / gnyis pa ni/ dran dang shes bzhin lcags kyu rnon po yis/ / gdul dka'i sems kyi glang po rab bsdus te/ / dul ba'i brtul zhugs rdzogs pa'i dpal yon can/ /tshul khrims mthar phyin khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes gsungs don ni dbus mtha' las/ dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang / / byid dang rgod pa rtogs pa dang / / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rtsa ba'i dmigs pa la rgyun chags su gtod pa'i dran pa dang / phyin ci log gi g.yeng ba 'gog pa'i shes bzhin gyi lcags kyu rnon po de yis gdul bar dka' pa'i sems kyi glang po che thog med nas dug gsum mi dge ba'i phyogs su 'khyams pa de nyid btsan thabs su log pa'i lam las bzlog nas dbang du bsdus te/ zhi zhing dul ba'i tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs kha na ma tho ba med pa la bkod do/ /'di ni so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ sems rta kha glan dka' ba la/ / mthun pa'i gzer rnon brgya pa yi/ / srab ni so sor thar 'di yin/ / zhes dang /'di ni lang tshos rnam 'khrul ba'i/ / rkang gnyis gzhon nu'i lcags kyu yin/ / zhes pa rnams kyi dgongs pa yin zhing / dbu ma snying por/ yid kyi glang po log 'gro ba/ / dmigs pa'i ka ba brtan po la/ / dran pa'i thag pas nges bcings nas/ / shes rab lcags kyus rim dbang bya/ / zhes pa'ang ting nge 'dzin sgrub tshul gyi skabs yin kyang / bslab pa gsum gye go rims sgrub pa'i skabs su ting nge 'dzin sgrub tshul gyi mchog tshul khrims yin par bslab btus su gsungs pas 'di dang don gcig go / de ltar lus 340

༄/ /bstod 'grel nor bu'i do shal/ngag gi nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims yongs su dag pa na/ rgyan las/bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyon mongs mngon 'gyur gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sa bon spong ba'i shes rab kyi bslab pa'ang phun sum tshogs par gyur te bslab gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal yon can du 'gyur ro/ / de'ang dpal gyi skad dod shrī la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad pa mang du 'jug kyang / 'dir bslab pa gsum gyi khongs su chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i don te/ de ltar na dngos su tshul khrims mthar phyin zhes gsungs pa'ang u pa li bzhin chos 'dul ba'i bka' bab lta bur gyur pa'i gnad kyi gtso bo smos pa yin la/ don gyis de la brten pa'i yon tan lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rnams mngon du mdzad de grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa yin no/ / deng dus phal cher 'di 'dra ba la grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags su mi 'dzin par mngon shes phran tshegs re'am/ rdol lag rjes bzhag pa lta bu la ches ya mtshan du byed pa ni chos kyi gnad ma go ba yin te/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ tshur shog bya rgod bsten par gyis/ / zhes skyon brjod mdzad pa bzhin/ mngon shes phra mo dud 'gro la'ang yod pa mang zhing / mkha' la rgyu ba'i yi dwags rnams dang / des rgyud brlams pa phal cher la 'byung /rdo la lag rjes 'jog pa lta bu rtswa a wa zos pa'i ra lug yan chad kyis thub kyang des phyi mar phan rgyu cung zad kyang med pas/ chos kyi grub 'bras shapta zhes pa'i sha sa na des tshig gis bshad par/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ shes rgyud kyi nyon mongs la gnod thub pa dgos te/ rgyal bas chos bstan pa mtha' dag kyang byis pa'i 341

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 4ma/rtsed mo lta bu de 'dra'i don du ma yin par sems rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs kho nar gsungs bas so/ / gsum pa skal ldan gzhan rjes su bzung ba'i tshul ni/gang gi yon tan padmo'i skyed tshal du/ / 'khor ba'i blo gsal bung ba ma lus pa/ / legs bshad sprang rtsi'i bcud kyis tshim mdzad pa/ / mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes bshes gnyen dam pa gang gi lung rtogs kyi yon tan padmo'i dri bsung mngon par 'thul ba'i chos kyi skyed tshal du dad pa'i shugs kyis nye bar 'khor ba'i thar 'dod blo gsal gyi bung ba ma lus pa rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis tshim par mdzad pa sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang bka' drin gang gi cha nas kyang mtshungs zla med pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs zhes pa yin la/ rgyas bar na sgrub sde du ma phyag 'debs mdzad tshul gsung las skyes pa'i bu chen rnams kyi mtshan dang de dag gi yon tan brjod pa'ang bla ma'i che bar 'gyur te/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod kyi slob ma bzang po'i shing / / dge ba'i me tog cher rgyas pa/ / dpyid ga'i shing ni me tog gis/ / brgyan pa lta bur mdzes pa lags/ / zhes dang / sa paṇa gyes/ dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin sdud/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / gsum pa mjug gi don la/ je ltar brtsams pa'i tshul/ brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngo ba/ sbyar byang gsum gyi dang po ni/ de ltar bla ma'i rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ / chu thigs tsam zhig spel ba'i/ zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/dge ba yis/ zeg mchog bshes gnyen khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / / rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog / ces gsungs/ don ni/'dir smos pa 'di nyid yon tan cha tshang bar bshad pa yin nam zhe na/ de 342

༄/ /bstod 'grel nor bu'i do shal/ltar bstod pa byas pa 'di ni bla ma'i rnam thar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rgya mtsho lta bu las/ yongs su grags pa'i mdzad pa'i cha shas chu thigs tsam zhig tshigs bcad du spel ba yin gyi/ cha tshang bar brjod par ga la nus/'on kyang zhing khyad par can gyi mthu la brten pa'i dge ba 'di yis mkha' mnyam 'gro ba mtha' dag tshe rabs kun tu theg pa mchog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyod dang skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing / gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms pa med par myong ste sa lam gyi rtogs pa rim gyis bgrod nas rgyal ba'i go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du thob par shog ces dge ba mi zad par byed pa byang chub mchog tu bsngo bas rgyas btab bo/ / sbyar byang ni/ ces 'khor ba'ibya ba mtha' dag chu shing ltar snying po med par gzigs nas dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par mdzad pa'i sems dpa' chen po gnyan rtse dpon slob ngag dbang chos 'phel pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni ri khrod pa dge slong bkra shis rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngar lung dang rigs pa smra ba 7dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i sdes dben gnas bkra shis dge 'phel du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni dge slong ngag dbang phun tshogs so/ / zhes gsungs te go sla ba'i dbang du byas nas ma spros so/ /smras pa/ yab rje'i dgongs pa zab mo'i sprin gyi klong / / 'grel byed snyan pa'i 'brug sgra rol pa yis/ / dga' dad gar gyis rtsen pa'i mdongs mtha' ma/ / rnam grol gtos bzang 'dzin pas sgeg gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni rdor zhar ngag dbang chos 'dzin sogs don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gi mos ngor/ chos smra ba 7dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mas mdo smad bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /343

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar dang 'brel pa'i kun bzang 'khor lo sogs kun 'khor sna tshogs kyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legs bshad ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /legs bshad 'od brgyas thub bstan nyin mor byed/ / rin chen sems kyis 'gro kun bu bzhin dgongs/ / 'dzam gling kun na mtshungs pa'i zla med pa/ / jo bo a ti sha la gus phyag 'tshal/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i zlos gar gyis/ / bod yul mun gling dkar por bsgyur mdzad cing / /khyad par bka' gdams gtsang ma'i srol 'byed pa/ / rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs/ / 'dren pa lha bzhi'i thor cog spyi bor bcings/ / bslab gsum ka shi'i ras bzang lus la bgos/ / sprul pa'i drang srong sku mched gsum la sogs/ / bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar bsam zhing dang / / lugs bzang de nyid zab gsang 'dab ma brgyar/ /bzhad phyir mar me mdzad dpal slar byon pa/ / rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ / yab sras brgyud par bcas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mdo smad zhing khams 'di yang thugs rje yis/ / skyong bar 'brom rje nyid kyis zhal bzhes bzhin/ / byon pa kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i sde/ /'khrungs rabs brgyud par bcas la gus pas 'dud/ / jo bo bka' 344

༄za/ /kun 'khor sna tshogasakyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legasabashad/gdams pa dang dge ldan zhes/ / ming 'dogs tha dad tsam las rgyal ba'i bka'/ / mtha' dag gdams par shar bas 'khrul bral gyi/ / lta sgom spyod la dbye ba 'ga' ma mchis/ / de phyir rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rma med pa'i/ /bstan dang de 'dzin rnams kyi rnam thar las/ / brtsams te bstod pa kun tu bzang po yis/ / bsngags pa'i me tog 'phreng ba deng 'dir spel/ / 1mdo sngags bstan pa'i gnad kun tshang ba lha chos bdun ldan lugs 'di kho nar mngon/ / rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mar mi'i gdams ngag kun kyang 'dus pa'i phyir/ / gsang chen bstan la'ang lugs 'di lhag par rgyud don ston pas ji ltar bstan dang mthun/ / de phyir dad pa mi g.yo ba yis lugs 'dir 'jug pa skal ba mchog tu bzang / / chos 'dul spyod las mi 'da'ang nang du rim gnyis rnal 'byor nyi 'od rtse dga' 'dzin/ / chags sdang nga rgyal kun nub zhi dul spyod pa ji ltar pad ma'i sbubs bzhin gtsang / / nam yang khro med snying rje rgyas pas 'dzum dkar gsal zhing 'gro kun gnyen ltar dgongs/ / thugs mchog bzang pos 'gro kun mgon gyur skyabs gyur gling dang dpung gnyen gyur nges na/ / lha cig jo 'brom thugs rjes zungs mdzod cig ces snying nas 'dud do srid las skyob/ / chos kyi rgya mtsho phan bde'i gzhir gyur mar gyur 'gro ba'i srid zhi'i rgud pa sel/ /thub bstan yongs dzogs phyogs mthar dar rgyas yun du 'phel bar byed la mtshungs zla med/ / bka' gdams srol 'dzin dam pa sku mched gsum sogs mgon po mtshungs med rnams kyi lugs/ / mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nying khu skal bzang thar 'dod snying nas 'jug ngogs de/ / lung rigs 'bum sde'i nyi ma bzhin du gsal byas yab rje'i bstan pa'i srol 'di yin/ / de slad rgyud lnga'i srid mtsho sgol 'dod mtha' dag lha chos bdun ldan 345
/bhebhe///snyebhe/snye/////snye/

༄༅/ /kun 'khor sna tshogasakyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legs bshad/thog mar bcu bdun 'phreng rnams bklags pa yis/ / lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams gsar rnying gi / bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams kyi rnam par thar/ / bcos mas ma bslad rang bzhin gsong bor brjod/ /khyad par gsang sngags gsang bas 'grub pa'i tshul/ / ma rtogs blun po la la bka'agadams par/ / mdo phyogs tsam las mar mi dang mtshungs pa'i/ /gsang sngags gdams pa zab mo med ces zer/ / de phyir phyi ru chos 'dul la gnas shing / / nang du zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor skyong / / rgyal bstan gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer ba yi/ / khyad chos rtsal du bton nas bsngags pa brjod/ / de rjes steng gi dbus nas mgo brtsams te/ / zur la chos skor tshul du bklags pa yis/ / rgyal dang sems dpa' sems ma khro bo'i rigs/ / sde tshan so sor gcig tu bsdoms pa'i dngos/ / bstan pa'i rjes 'jug spyi dang gangs can pa/ / gzhan phan 'phrin las byang chub sems gnyis kyi/ / lhar gyur thub pa'i dbang po spyan ras gzigs/ / sgrol ma mi g.yo mgon rnams rim par bstod/ / de rjes gru bzhi kun nas dbus bklags pas/ / mdo mngon 'dul ba'i sde snod sngags dang bcas/ / gru bzhi lam du 'khyer zhing kun gyi gnad/ / cig tu 'bab pa'i ngo mtshar dga' ston spel/ / la la klog tshul grangs mang kho na'i phyir/ / bzang legs mchog sogs tshig tsam bsgrigs pa yi/ / rjod byed sgra yi grangs su chud tsam de/ /ma yin brjod don 'brel chags rim par smras/ / dge bas thub bstan snying po dri ma med/ / bka' gdams srol bzang phyogs mthar rgyas pa dang / / de nyid bshad dang sgrub bas tshul bzhin du/ / 'dzin bzod skyes mchog dam pas sa khyab shog / rten mchog 'di rnams bzhengs par 'brel thogs pa'i/ / skye bo kun kyang tshe rabs thams cad du/ / jo bo yab sras rnams 347

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronasa'i gsung 'bum/kyis rjes bzung ste/ / bka' gdams gtsang ma'i rnam thar skyong gyur cig / ces pa 'di ni mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang gdams pa kun la nang byan tshud cing gcig tu bstan pa'i khur 'khyer ba'i lhag bsam gyi go cha can khri rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan nas jo bo yab sras dang rje bla ma'i bzhed srol ltar gyi bshad sgrub gtsang ma'i rgyun 'phel rgyas kyi rten 'brel kho nar dgongs te gser zangs las grub pa byis pa lo brgyad kyi tshod tsam pa'i jo bo yab sras sogs bka' gdams gong ma rags bsdus kyi sku brnyan sum cu skor sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs kyi thugs khur dang gang ci'i cha rkyen bsgrigs shing / so nyid shog gi gra slob rnams nas sbyin bdag gi mthil byas te rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i bgrang bya gnyis pa rnam byung gi lo bka' gdams pho brang gsar bsgrig skabs bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar dang 'brel ba'i kun bzang 'khor lo zhig 'bri dgos tshul bskul ma gnang ba ltar/7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa legs byas sgo brgya dbye ba'i rgyur gyur cig / / /oṃ suste/ sgra dbyangs dbyar rnga dang 'grogs bsngags tshig mardo ra yi char/ / lha yi dzing ring khyab par 'bebs pas yid srub sder bcas gdung byed cing / / dregs ldan sa 'dzin 'phreng ba'i rtse na zhabs sen thun mtshams 'char ga'i 'od/ / nyer mdzes 'gro ba'i bla ma rnam 'dren shākya seng ges dge legs stsol/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan nor 'dzin khyon/ /snyigs ma'i chu mtshor bying tshe thabs mkhas kyi/ / rus sbal zol gyis 'degs pa'i snying stobs che/ / yab rje rgyal ba gnyis pa rgyal gyur cig / rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i zil mngar bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / gcig tu 'khyil ba nor bu'i 348

ro༅/ /kun 'khor sna tshogs kyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legs bshad/za ma tog / khams gsum skye rgu'i bla na bsten pa yi/ / 'dren mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho gtsug na rgyal/ / blo gros bzang po'i mkhyen brtse'i lam yangs por/ / dpal ldan rgyu skar can gyi bdag po zhes/ / snyan par rab grags rgyal kun ye shes cha/ / gcig bsdus snang mtha'i mgon por snying nas 'dud/ / rgyal ba'i dbang po pad dkar 'chang ba nyid/ / slar yang gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon du/ / ngur smrig gar bsgyur 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sde/ / 'khrungs rabs brgyud par bcas la snying nas 'dud/ /'jam mgon lugs bzang gser gyi shing rta che/ / kha lo sgyur mdzad 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i zhabs/ / la sogs mi 'jigs chos kyi khri 'phang la/ /mnga' bsgyur yongs 'dzin rim byon phyag gi yul/ /1rgyal ba kun las thugs bskyed rmad byung rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mi pham 'jam dbyangs rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /2'dren mchog mchog gis lung bstan klu sgrub thogs med theg mchog bstan/ / bstan pa'i snying po gsal mdzad 'phags yul mkhas pa rnams kyi mchog / 2'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig jo 'brom mkhyen brtse'i dpal 'byor rgyas/ / nyi ltar bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas mdzad smra ba'i mchog gyur yang / / 4lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i gzhir gyur rnam mang tshul ston mdzad/ / ma rig mun pa sel mdzad klu sgrub lugs gyur rigs gzhung dag / 5ma lus gsal mdzad bsngags 'os 'dus grwa sgo mang legs bshad sgo/ / sgo brgya'i legs tshogs sbel mdzad sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor rab 'phel zhing / / 6mang mang skye rgu'i bkur bya'i bkra shis grags pa'i ba dan mang / / mang thos zab don smra mkhas dpal ldan mkhas pa kun gyi mchog / 7sgo 'phar yangs por phye bas bkra shis dpal 'byor kun nas 349

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/'dus/ / srid zhi'i phun tshogs chu gter bkra ba zhwa ser bstan pa'i dpal/ / shis brjod dbyar rnga'i sgra ldan bkra shis char 'bebs 'dod can grwa/ zhi bde'i 'ja' tshon bkra shis bkra shis mchog gi dpal dang ldan/ / khabakra shis chos kyi dpal la mnga' bsgyur sgo gsum zhi dul zhing / /rab 'byams gsung rab sgo brgya'i zab don sgo 'byed lung rigs bkra/ /༵hūṃ/chog ༵༷pa dīX ༵/༵ tram̐~X ༷tt+waṃXni tt+waṃ ༷rdo~X pa~Xkha ༵kha~Xng ma spra ༵dī ṭwāṃ bkra shis/ / 11gter gyi 'byung khungs ji bzhin 'gro kun tshim byas rnam par bstan/ / gsal bstod rnam dag zab mo'i don gzigs mkhas mchog rnam mang sgo/ / 12grub pa'i dbang phyug go 'phang mchog brnyes 'phags tshogs rnam par mkhas/ / mkhas par skyon bral yon tan rab rdzogs mkhas grub rnam par mang / / 12mkhas mchog 'jam mgon lugs 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang rgyal/ / rgyal mchog khrims dag rnam mang sgo mang mkhas dbang grub mchog mkhas/ 14mkhas dbang mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i mthar son 'phags chen 'dus tshogs rgyal/ / rgyal mchog lha yi lha tshogs 'dus chen 'phags mchog grub dbang mkhas/ / 15mkhyen gter mi yi gar mkhan yab rje'i lugs bzang rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / rnam par dag pa'i lung rigs 'od zer 'bum 'gyed mkhas grub mchog / 16kun bzang chos kyi dga' ston 'gro la stsol mdzad rgyal ba'i lugs/ / tshogs mchog rnam dag khrims ldan 'phags bod gzhung don kun gyi sgo/ / 17rab 'byams legs bshad nor bu'i tshogs kyi gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ / chen po'i gzhung mang 'chad rtsod rtsom la kun gye rtser son mang / / 1 gsung rab drang nges legs par 'byed mkhas bstan pa'i srog shing gnyis/ / 'phags seng dgongs don 350

༄za/ /kun 'khor sna tshogasakyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gye legs bshad/sgo 'phar phye la bsngags tshig chu gter 'dus/ / 1bamangon pa gong 'og gzhung mang rnam mang rigs pa'i rlabs 'phro ba/ / mang thos gru gzings bkra shis legs byas shugs kyis 'gro mkhas tshogs/ / 2 0'dul ba'i legs bshad gter gyi sgo 'byed bstan pa'i rtsa lag rgyal/ / sgo gsum tshul khrims dri bsung bkra ba zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan/ / 21tshad med 'phrin las bkra shis gter gyur rigs grol brgyad ldan mang / / mchog sbyin yongs smin bkra shis rgyas mdzad chos kyi khri 'dzin pa'i/ / 2 2dbu tshad 'od snang bkra ba bstan pa'i gzhir gyur rigs pa'i sgo/ / rtsa lag mtshungs bral sgo mang lugs mchog spel mdzad bstan pa'i bdag / 2 2rgyud don dri bral thugs tshud lus can phan bde'i dbyig gi gnas/ / bstan 'dzin mkhas mang 'dus tshogs thub bstan yang snying 'dzin pa po/ 24mdo rgyud zla 'od bdud rtsis nyon mongs gdung sel phan mdzad 'byung / / rgyal sras tshogs mchog thar pa'i ded dpon zla bral yang dag khyod/ / 25grub dbang brgyad ldan blo bzang grags pa'i mdo sngags legs grub pa'i/ / grub mchog bye ba'i bste gnas 'dod dgu'i dpal steng rgyal bstan nyid/ / 26mkhas btsun bzang ldan mchog brnyes grub mchog dpal ldan lugs mang mkhas/ / mkhas dbang grub mchog 'dren mdzad sdom gsum bslab pa'i 'dus kun rgyal/ /rgyal bstan kai la sha yi spor 'gying zhing / / 'jigs med spobs pa'i lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ / dri med rigs pa'i mche sder 'phreng ba g.yo/ /mkhas mang gdong lnga pa rnams bsngags par 'os/ / de phyir bdag blo rta ljang gzhon nu yis/ / bstod tshig kun bzang 'dab brgya'i ge sar 'phreng / /ches cher bzhad pa'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i ro/ / myong 'dod bhra ma ra0yis gar sgyur zhing / / mtho ris rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang mchog / bsil 351

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i ga4 'bum/ldan khor yug yangs pa'i dga' tshal du/ / legs byas tshig mda'i lam nas 'ongs pa bzhin/ / nyer mdzes zeg mchog chos kyi garnyo la/ / yangs pa'i sgo 'phar kun gsal sgeg mo'i bzhin/ / mdzes byed kun bzang bstod tshig srid pa'i mig / blo gros 'phrul gyis mi 'dra'i bgrod lam lnga/ / thog mar nyer drug 'phreng rnams thar chags klog / de nas phyogs bzhi'i thigs 'phreng gnyis gnyis dang / / gru bzhi'i thigs 'phreng re re dbus su klog /de nas nang du zur gyis chos skor tshul/ / de nas thar chags mtha' skor g.yas su skor/ / 'di ltar bsngags pa'i chu 'dzin dkar po'i 'phreng / /'dren mchog dgyes pa'i mchod sprin kho bos spros/ / 'phags yul bhe dar ba dang gasmi ra 'i/ / lugs bzang kun 'khor nor bu'i phung po las/ /bod rgan rtog bzo'i mching bur mtshar 'dzin pa'i/ / dus dang bstun nas 'di ltar sbyar ba la/ / nongs pa mchis na gzur gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs/ / shong dpang brgyud par bcas la bdag 'chags so/ / chags sdang rmongs pa mi yi sha tshugs can/ / rang mtshang ri bo'i spo la gnas bcas nas/ / gzhan skyon rdul phran tshol ba'i bya ra pa/ / de dag rnams la ma mthol nyes pa chung / / 'dir 'bad las byung rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs/ / zla zer phog pa'i gangs ri'i ngogs 'dra ba/ / 'di yi mthu las dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde/ / khrims gtsang bshad sgrub dbyar/ / zhesapa'i sho lo ka gcig bris yod kyang grwa khang sgo 'byor du ma bkod 'dug ces zhes nas dngos su thos pa bris pa yin/ mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / / grags snyan phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa yis/ / rang gzhan don gnyis dga' ston lhun 'grub shog /kun bzang 'khor lo brjod bya rjod byed kun khyad du 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar can 'di ni 7rje btsun bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid dgung lo nyi shu'i skabs su mkhas dbang 352

༄7/ /kun 'khor sna tshogs kyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gye legs bshad/'gran zla dang bral ba sgo mang dpon slob hor skal bzang dngos grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyis sgo mang grwa khang gsar gsos kyi skabs de'i sgo 'phyor du 'bri rgyu'i kun bzang 'khor lo zhig dgos tshul gyi bskul ma zhus pa bzhin gnang ba yin tshul zhal nas thos te phran ratna ā nantas phyis su yang yang rtsad bcad nas yi ger bkod pa'o/ /rnal 'byor lhag bsam shugs kyis bskul ba yis/ / tshogs gnyis spyod pa myur du dzogs byas te/ / 'gro ba'i ded dpon bla na med gyur pa/ / thub mchog srol 'dzin brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ / khyad par rgyal ba'i dbang po tsong kha ba/ / kun mkhyen bzhad pa'i rdo rje sku 'phreng dang / / de sras thu bo khri chen mchog sprul sogs/ / bka' drin 'khor med rnams la snying nas 'dud/ /1dben par bka' gdams rnam thar spyod/ / chos la gzhol zhing 'du 'dzis dbon/ / sgrub gnas mchog 'dir don gnyis kyi/ / dpal la spyod phyir legs gnas nas/ / no rtul yid dbang rim pa bzhin/ / lam bzang mngon dga'i yid kyis sgrub/ / g.yeng med kun dga' dben pa'i rir/ /sgom sgrub la dga' g.yel ba med/ / rnam kun mngon par chos sgrub pa'i/ /rtsa ba chos dang bla mar gus/ / zab lam mtshon gyis dngos 'dzin dang / /gces 'dzin 'ching ba phye mar brlag / myur du smin cing grol bas bde/ /bde stong gsang chen rnal 'byor brten/ / sgom sgrub la gzhol rtag tu bde/ / bde ba'i dga' ston srid na mtho/ / gnas lugs zab mo'i ting 'dzin la/ / dngos 'dzin 'khrul ba'i ra ris spong / / gzhan phan gnas gyur chos kyi mchog / theg chen chos la mngon par spyod/ / srid pa'i rtse dga' spangs pa yis/ / gtan gyi bde dga' zad med thob/ / lus ngag yid gsum mngon dul ba'i/ / tshangs spyod tshul khrims yid bzhin nor/ /353
/bheṭwāṃṭwāṃṭwāṃbhesnyi//ṭwāṃṭwāṃṭwāṃbhe/

༄za/ /kun 'khor sna tshogasakyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legayobashad/rjes su mos blo yis/ / lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang / / skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim sngags dang bcas/ / mchog nas mchog tu chos skor tshul gyis brjod/ / grwa zur bzhi nas dbus klags thun mong gi/ / dben pa sngags kyi dben gsum dang bcas mthus/ / dga' bzhi'i bdag nyid bde stong rnal 'byor gyis/ / bde chen sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa mtshon/ / chos 'byung zur sprad steng 'og lcags kyu sogs/ / klog tshul rnam grangs mang tsam byar rung yang / / don gye snying po snga mar 'dus pa'i phyir/ / byis pa 'brid pa'i sbyor ba 'dir ma byas/ / blo ldan rnams kyis ltas mo tsam min par/ /'di don ji bzhin gtsang ma'i dpen gnas su/ / rnam dag sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa yi/ / brtson pa skyed pa'i lcag gi skul mar mdzod/ /snyigs ma'i ngang tshul mthong ba yis/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam par thar/ / lhag par rjes su dran pa'i 'os/ / 'jam dbyangs bla mas 'gro 'di skyongs/ / / bstan la phan pa'i nus pa bag tsam med kyang chen por rlom/ / bar pa ta bzhin snying rje med par 'gro la gnod pa'i sems/ / tshangs spyod bshig pa'i khrel med spyon pa sgo gsum 'chol par spyod/ / kun tu bsten na phung byed pa yi snying gtam lhag par ngan/ / skyon gyi gong bur bstan bzhin grub phyir mkhas btsun re ba ci/ / rmongs pas rtag chad mthar 'dzin thob pa khyod kyis nyes kun byas/ / blun po 'gro ba'i 'dren pa min zhing bkur 'os mchod pa dman/ / 'dis mtshon ci byas sa lam don gnyer rnams kyis spangs 'os pa/ / gtam ngan 'khrug pas thar 'dod gzhan la don med 'tshe byed bdud/ / mos gus byed pa kun kyang bslu na bsten pa ga la rigs/ / drang po'i spyod bral g.yo khram gnyis kyi gter mdzod grol bas phung / / slad ma'i skye 355
/bhebheṭwāṃbhe//bhett+waṃṭwāṃbyebhebye

༄za/ /kun 'khor sna tshogayokyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legs bshad/gle dzwas thun gseng du/ / thogs med stsal pas 'di tsam yang 'jam dpal dngos kyi rtags yang dag / i ta ye paṇḍi tsa ratna ā nanta'o/ / / / ye shes gzigs pa sgrib med zla zer gyes/ / srid par kun spyor rmongs pa'i 'jigs 'phrog pa/ / thub pa'i dbang po dgra bcom tshogs bcas la/ / zol med sgo gsum dang bas phyag bgyid do/ / 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos blo bzang rgyal pa'i dbang / / mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'dab brgya'i tshal chen po/ / bzhad pa'i grags snyan srid pa'i mthar 'phro ba/ / rdo rje 'chang dngos brgyud par bcas la 'dud/ / de dag bstan la ri mor byed pa'i sde/ / rnam grol thar pa'i gling 'dir bzhugs pa yi/ / mchog gsum rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ / kun bzang 'khor lo'i tshul gyis bstod par bgyi/ /༈dpag yas 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rgyal ba'i dbang po gtan gye skyabs/ / gang bsam 'dod don ma lus stsol ba yid bzhin nor mchog ste/ / srid pa'i 'khri ba ma rig drungs phyung sras bcas rgyal rnams kyi/ / sku yis bkangs shing byin rlabs gzi 'bar rten dang brten par bcas/ /gtan bde'i srog tu bkod pa'i dge tshogs de mthus slob 'bangs kun/ /thub pa'i lung rtogs bstan pa la slob tshul khrims gtsang ma'i dngos/ /bstan la thos bsam sgom pas mchog tu slob cing dpal 'byor tshogs/ /bshad sgrub bya bas bdud kyi g.yul bcom dge ldan lugs mchog rgyas/ /legs par bshad pa'i chos kyi mthu yis dgra yang dge la sbyor/ / 'khrul bral mdo sngags bstan pa'i dpal gyur dge 'dun tshogs kyis gang / / rig gnas gsang chen mdo dang bcas pa dar rgyas dge legs 'phel/ / mi sde'i 357
/bheṭwāṃṭwāṃṭwāṃbheṭwāṃbheṭwāṃṭwāṃṭwāṃbhe/

ro༅/ / kun 'khor sna tshogs kyi skor ngo mtshar 'phrul gyi legs bshad/pa'i ngo mtshar 'phreng ba spel/ / kun bzang 'khor lor ji ltar smon pa bzhin/ / kun kyang thugs mthun mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan/ / kun la thos bsam sgom pas rab zhugs te/ / kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shig / ces pa 'di ni yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dpal rgya ma tshos khur bzhes kyi or du su ta la da shog rnam grol thar pa gling gi gtsug la ga khang dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i sku sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa khyad 'phags bsgrubs pa'i tshe 7btsun pa dkon mchog bsta na pa'i sgro na mes 'phral du spya ra ba'i yi ge pa ni dpyod ldan sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga'o/ / / /359

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonagra'i gsung 'bum/kun bzang 'khor lo 'di gnyis gzim khang dge legs bde yangs kyi 'gram g.yas g.yon gyi khang chung gnyis kyi gyang logs su bkod yod/ / ser bzhis mdor bstan gang 'phel ba/ / thar chags klags pas rgyas par bshad/ / dkar bzhis mngon bstan sde bzhi po/ / gru nas dbus klog rgyas par bshad/ / thar chags klag pa yi ge'i don/ / zur bzhi klags pa spyi yi don/ / mtshams bzhi klag pa sbas pa'i don/ / gru nas dbus klags mthar thug don/ /360

༄༅/ /bden gtam de nyid gsal ba'i me long /༄7/ / bden gtam de nyid gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shing phag zla tshes la/ tsha kho so mang rgyal mo bsod nams sgol mas/dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel dang / rje nyid kyi rnam thar bka' rtsom gnang dgos zhes nan gyes zhus pa'i lan du gnang ba'i chab shog gi bar skabs tshigs bcad ni/ bstan pa'i lcags ri tsha ba kha gsum gyi/ / gtso bor gyur ba so mang rgyal khab nas/ / gser bzang khri phrag 'thag ris lha dar gyi/ / skyes bcas mi sna ched du mngags ba'i gdong / / snyan ngag kun gyi rgyal po 'khri shing gi / don 'grel rtogs brjod lhug par byas pa dang / / kho bo'i gnas tshul zhib bar bkod pa yi/ / rnam thar dgos tshul yi ge nan cher byung / / ma ga dha bzang gnyis pa mi'i dbang mo/ / ma chen bsod nams sgrol ma'i dgongs bzhed bzhin/ / ma bcos rnam thar gtsang ma 'ga' mchis na/ / ma sbas gsong bor smra ba'i 'os yin kyang / / rnyed bkur longs spyod 'du 'dzi'i zhags pa yis/ / rnam par bcings pa'i dad tshul brjod pa la/ / rnam par thar ces don mi mthun gyi gtam/ / co 'dri lta bur snyegs ma'i dus 'dir sgrogs/ / 'di na dam pa'i mtshan tsam bzung byas te/ / 'di snang g.yeng ba'i bran du khol ba las/ / 'di phyi bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyur nges pa/ / 'di 'dra bgyis zhes bsnyad du med pas gnongs/ / 'on kyang skyon yon 'dres ma'i spyod tshul rnams/ / sgo skur 361

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'isgroname'i ga ཿma/spangs te drang por brjod byas ni/ / dgag bya chung zhing skal mnyam 'ga' zhig la/ / cung zad phan yang srid pas 'di skad gsol/ / mdzo dge smad ces bya ba'i yul du skyes/ / lha dang bla mas brtse bas lung bstan mdzad/ /rtags dang rten 'brel mang po las kyis bsgrigs/ / dam pa'i gdan sar 'khod pa'i rnam thar yin/ / dgongs gzhi can gyi lung bstan 'ga' zhig la/ / brten nas rje btsun shes rab sirga sogs/ / dam pa'i skye phreng du ma bdag gir byas/ / rdzun phugs brag la gtad pa'i rnam thar yin/ / rang lo bdun par rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ / yab rje 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs drung nas/ / rab tu byung zhing dge tshul sdom pa mnos/ / thub bstan sgo ru zhugs pa'i rnam thar yin/ / de nas lo 'gar byes pa'i rol rtsed dang / /sbrags te klog dang blo 'dzin khral bzhin byas/ / dad dang snying rje 'dres ma'i yul du gyur/ / mthong pa don ldan bya ba'i rnam thar yin/ / bcu gnyis steng du bsdus grwa'i rtsod par zhugs/ / dbus chas 'bul sdud g.yeng ba shas che yang / /rtsod zla rnams kyi rjes su ma lus tsam/ / rtog ge'i bag chags sad pa'i rnam thar yin/ / bla ma mang po'i chos sna ma bsogs kyang / / mtshan ldan bshes gnyen 'ga' yi zhabs bsten nas/ / de la log rtog ma shor tshul bzhin bsten/ / khe nyen dpyod pa zhugs pa'i rnam thar yin/ / gzhung chen so so'i rtsa ba rgya bod kyi/ / 'grel pa mtha' dpyod bcas la sbyangs pa yis/ / shes lo thos lo'i rnam grangs brgya phrag brgal/ / rtsa spur me mched lta bu'i rnam thar yin/ / bka' gdam gzhung drug 'grel ba don gsal dang / / mdo rtsa la sogs gzhung chen bshad pa dang / / lam rim sogs kyi khrid kyang mang du byas/ / dmus long sgon me thogs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /dge 'dun 'dus pa sum stong man chad la/ / rdor phreng mi tra sogs kye dbang 362

༄༅/ /bden gtam de nyid gsal ba'i me long /bka' dang / / spyi dang zur bka'i rjes gnang mang du byas/ / gsang sngags gzugs brnyan spel ba'i rnam thar yin/ / las 'bras blang dor bstan nas gzhan dag rnams/ / phan dang bde ba'i lam la 'god byed kyang / / rang nyid sdug bsngal rgyul spyod pa ni/ / snyigs dus bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i rnam thar yin/ / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhas pa'i mdun sa ru/ / bka' pod lnga yi zab gnad phra zhib nas/ / tshig 'khri'i spros pa tshun la zhum pa med/ /rtsodapo'i grags skam thob pa'i rnam thar yin/ / snga ma'i gzhung la sbyar byang btags min zhing / / mngon brjod spel pa'i tshig bsgrig tsam min par/ /brtsams chos 'ga' zung bstan du yod pa 'di/ / bstan la lag rjes bzhag pa'i rnam thar yin/ / mdo sngags gzhung lugs gang gi tshig don la/ /dpyod pa'i blo gros 'jug par mi dka' yang / / don gyi nyams myong rgyud la ma skyes pa/ / chu nad rdo ba skam po'i rnam thar yin/ / 'phags bod mkhas pa'i legs bshad ro brgya'i zas/ / spyad pas deng dus mkhas rlom ngag sgros kyi/ / zan don tsam la 'gram chu mi ldang ba/ / dred po chos rgyus mkhan gyi rnam thar yin/ / yul khams mang po'i rnyed bskur sdud pa dang / / grwa slob mang por chos sbyin 'gyed pa sogs/ / bla chen spyi yi phyag srol rgyas par byas/ / chos brgyad rta rgyug 'gran pa'i rnam thar yin/ / dad rdzas nye du'i tshogs su ma bskor bar/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang bzhengs pa dang / /dgon sde du mar bsnyen bkur bgyis pa sogs/ / dkor gyi bu lon chung ba'i rnam thar yin/ / dad ldan du mas bskul te mdo smad kyi/ / phyed tsam bskor kyang dngos 'bul gang byung las/ / pha rol 'drid pa'i thabs dang 'khrul ma bkyes/ / lugs gnyis mkhyen rgya chung ba'i rnam thar yin/ / mtho la gus bas ngo 'dzin ma byas shing / / dma' la smod pas brnyas thabs ma byas 363

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgoname'i ga 4ma/te/ / mnyam la 'gran pas gral rtsod ma byas pa/ / blo rgya yongs thang zhan pa'i rnam thar yin/ / dbu ma'i lugs bzhin dam par 'jog byed ni/ /ming tsam brda' tsam rtog pas btags tsam las/ / rang gi ngos nas grub pa'i dpyad bzod kyis/ / stong 'di don dam bden pa'i rnam thar yin/ /snying rjes gzhan don sgrub ba ltar snang yang / / phugs kyi gtad so rang don kho nar gnas/ / snang tshul gnas tshul mi mthun rdzun pa ru/ / grub 'di kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam thar yin/ / nyams len byed rgyu ma dran nyi shu thal/ /byed do byed do'i ngang la nyi shu thal/ / ma byung ma byung zer zhing bcu lhag thal/ / mi tshe stong par zad pa'i rnam thar yin/ / nyin mtshan don ldan chos kyi 'da' ba yis/ / dge sbyor dang du mi tshe bskyal min yang / / tshe dang grong chog snyoms par ma byas pa/ / mi rgan skyid nyal brgyab pa'i rnam thar yin/ /bla ma'i sku dgrar mdza' gcug ma byas kyang / / rang la sger gyis gnag pa su la yang / / sdang bas dmod bcol tsam yang bgyis pa med/ / ma nus jo bzang byas pa'i rnam thar yin/ / bzlas brjod dmigs pa rgya chen dka' na yang / / cung zad phyi ma'i don du dmigs pa las/ / nor sgrub dbang sdud gcig kyang ma byas pa/ / 'khos chung 'dod pa bsgyungs pa'i rnam thar yin/ / thub bstan rgya chen spel bar ma nus kyang / / khas blangs bslab khrims gtsor gyur rang rgyud kyi/ / bstan pa bsam bzhin bshig par ma byas pa/ / bstan 'dzin gral 'jug bsnyegs pa'i rnam thar yin/ / ci dgar spyod pa'i snying stobs bdag la med/ / lha mthong 'dre 'thong mngon shes bdag la med/ / dgra bo sgrol ba'i nus pa bdag la med/ / las can chos mgo thon pa'i rnam thar yin/ / rang nyid bgrang bya sum bcu brgal ba nas/ / lo ltar bsgrub bya sum brgyar nye ba tsam/ / rab byung bsnyen dzogs 364

༄༅/ /bden gtam de nyid gsal ba'i me long /bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod/ / thar pa'i sa bon btab pa'i rnam thar yin/ /grub mtha' so so'i bzhed gzhung phyogs tsam mthong / / kun kyang rnam grol sgrub ba'i thabs su go / de phyir yab rje'i bstan la yid ches rnyed/ /chags sdang rmongs zhen dor ba'i rnam thar yin/ / byi ru'i rgyan ldan rakka'i phreng ba bzhin/ / phal ba'i spyod tshul yon tan 'ga' zung bcas/ / sgo skur spangs pa'i bden tshig srad bu la/ / bstar 'di mkhyen dpyod sor mos bgrang bar mdzod/ / / / ces pa 'di ni tsha kho so mang rgyal mo'i 'phrin lan du bskur ba mdzo dge dgon gsar dga' ldan rab rgyas gling gi grwa ba tshul khrims dar rgyas kyisadapar du brkos 'dug pas/ lhag bsam dag pa'i dge 'bras kyis/ / bstan dngabastan 'dzin dar zhing rgyas/ / rtag tu dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / / sa lam bgrod pa mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di yang btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mas bris pa'o/ / sarba mgo li/ /365

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/༄ ste/ / kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rje rin po che'i bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang tha mal tshul bzung ste/ / mkhas grub kun gyi mdzad pa'i khur bsnams nas/ / thub bstan srog 'dzin rgyal ba gnyis pa la/ /gus pas btud nas de tshul mdo tsam gleng / / de'ang grub ba'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa kun gzigs lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bstod tshig 'di nyid kyi don la gnyis/dang ba bskyed de bstod pa dang / 'dun pa bskyed de smon pa'o/ / dang po la mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul/ de nas gzhan don du sprul pa'i bkod pa bstan tshul/ sprul nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ / dang po ni/mi 'gyur mtshog tu yangs pa'i bde ba che/ / bla med ye shes bdud rtsi'i snying po can/ / sku gsum gsang ba rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ / stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' rgyal ba gnyis par 'dud/ / ces pa ste/ kun rtog g.yo ba'i rlung dang bral bas nam du'ang mi 'gyur zhing / 'gro ba'i don du dag pa'i rten dang brten pa mtha' dag par 'char bas mchog tu yangs pa'am/thabs kyi rnam pa rgya che ba 'bras bu'i theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa lhan skyes kyi 366

༄༅/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya/bde ba chen po dang / rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad kyi snying po'i don bla na med pa'i ye shes srid pa'i sdug bsngal gye 'chi ba 'phrog pa'i sman gcig pu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba/ 'chi med thar pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa'i bdud rtsi'i snying po can zung 'jug ngo bo nyid kyi sku'am/lam 'bras sogs las 'byung ba ltar/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gzhan gyi blo las 'das pas na gsang ba dang / 'jig rten mtha' dag gi don du 'gyur bas na rgyan/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'khor ba ma stongs par du 'jug pas 'khor lo ste/ yul dang dus nyi tshe ba tsam ma yin par/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pa thams cad kyi mdzod du gyur cing /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa sogs stobs bcu'i sgo nas 'gro ba rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i thabs tshul yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal la mnga' 'byor pa/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di la rgyal ba gnyis par grags pa don du gnas pa'i rje bla ma la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud par mdzad pa'o/ / 'dis ni rgyu'i jeg pa'i shes rab dang / 'bras bu'i zeg pa'i thabs dbyer mi phyed par sbyor ba'i tshul bstan la/ rgyal ba dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar yang dag pa'i lta ba'i snying bo can gyi rdo rje jeg pa'i lam bzang 'dzin cing spel bar gsungs pa dang yang 'brel zhing / / bla med spyi'i lugs kyi bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong ma yin pa rnam med kyi bde ba chen po dang / stong ba stong gzugs kyi sku gnyis dbyer med pa'i bde stong dbyer med ces btags kyang / rgyud sde gzhan dang sgo bstun na/ bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i zung 'jug dngos kyi don du song ba de nyid dang yang sbyar du rung ngo / / gsang gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i don dang tha snya da ni lam 'bras su gsal la/ stobs bcus gzhan ngon sgrub tshul 367

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gatshi ཿma/dpyis phyin pa byangs dang 'jug 'grel sogs su shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa gzhan don du sprul pa'i bkod pa bstan tshul la/ dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul/ / ye shes rang snang las grub 'og min gyi/ / ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed zem skas las/ / rgyal sras dam pa'i rnam par bde bar byon/ / ces rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo'i rnam par bstan tshul dang /rnam 'dren kun gyi mkhyen pa'i phung po gang / / gcig gyur 'jam mgon mi yi srid pa'i gar/ / bsams bzhin rnam par rol ba'i mdzad pa la/ / bskal bzang rgyal ba stong gis bsgrun du med/ / ces rgyal sras 'jam dpal gzhon nu de nyid slar yang mi'i srid par rol pa'i yang sprul gyi tshul bstan to/ /gsum pa sprul nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul la gsum/ mdor bstan/rgyas bshad/ don bsdu ba'o/ / dang po ni/ blo gros lang tsho dar ba'i mig stong can/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i sa srung la zhon te/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rdo rje rtse brgya pas/ / rgol ngan sa 'dzin bcom pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /zhes 'jam dpal zhi khro la gsungs pa bzhin/ rje'i rnam thar gtso bo'ang chos rnam 'byed kyi steng nas 'jog dgos pas/ skyes sbyang gi mkhyen rab mtshungs zla med pa'i tshul dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum ya ma bral zhing /'chad rtsod rtsom pa zung du 'jug pa dang / bstan pa dri mar byed pa'i smra ngan mtha' dag bcom tshul rkang pa bzhis rim bzhin bstan to/ / gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas lung rtogs yon tan brnyes tshul/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngal rgya'i brang 'gro'i mdud grol dri bral sku'i/ / ma la yar skyes lcug phran gzhon nu dag / na tshod phra yang phan bde'i dri bsung ni/ / nam yang zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po/ / srid 368

༄/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangayokyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya/'byor glog gi bu mo'i gar mkhan ma/ / sdug bsngal mun par mal 'cha'i mtshang rig ste/ / 'khor ba mtshan mo'i mtha' las nges 'byung ba'i/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyi skya rengs dang po shar/ / zhes sho lo ka gnyis kyis rigs phun sum tshogs par bltams tshul dang / bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshul bstan/ gzhon nu'i lus can rgan po'i blo 'chang ba'i/ / rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs pa'i snying stobs kyis/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i sa chen dbus gtsang gi / ljongs su bde bar gshegs pa 'di rmad byung / / mang thos dgyes dgur spyod la ches sred pas/ / shes bya'i lus phrar spyad de bcal zin pa/ / slar yang thos brtson mi phyed mdza' gcugs kyis/ / 'khyud pa'i skal bzang 'di kos dam du bcings/ / zhes tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dbus 'gyur 'chang du byon tshul dang / rjes 'jug rnams la phan pa'i phyir gzhi nas thos ba brtsams tshul bstan te go sla'o/ /thos pa mdzad tshul dngos ni/ nang don rig pa'i 'o mtsho rab 'khyil bar/ / rnam 'byed shes rab lag ldan nyer zhugs pas/ / tha snyad rig pa'i me tog tshogs kyi rtser/ / blo gros sor mos reg min gang du mchis/ / zhes ka dī ka lnga bcu pa nas/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i bar gyi nang rig pa mdo rgyud mtha' dag la ris su ma chad par sbyangs pas mkhyen rab kyi klong rdol ba na/ sgra snyan sdeb sbyor sman la sogs pa tha snyad pa'i rig gnas rnams mkhyen pa'i cha shas re res kyang zhar byung tsam la bde blag tu rtogs pa'i tshul bstan to/ / bsam pas sgo 'dogs bcad de zla med pa'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob pa na/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i 'khor du ma dang grags pa shin tu rgyas par gyur kyang / 'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mor gzigs te/ de'i rjes su mi g.yeng bar bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi don du gzhol ba'i tshul ni/ 'jam 369

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'isgronasa'i gsung 'bum/mgon mkhyen par chags pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ / gzhung lugs rgya mtsho rtogs la mtshar du ci/ / khams gsum las rgyal lus med mda' lnga yis/ /ches srab bla gos 'bugs par nus min mtshar/ / zhes pas bstan nam snyam/de ltar chos brgyad kyi dri ma med par skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la gzhung chen po'i bshad pa mdzad tshul la gnyis las/ mdo phyogs kyi bshad pa mdzad tshul ni/ sde snod kun sbyangs yang dag grub pa'i 'bras/ / dka' chen du mar 'byams klas bshad pas ci/ / ring mo nyid nas ji lta ji snyed kyi/ /chos kun thugs su chud zin ma yin nam/ / zhes dang / sngags phyogs kyi bshad pa mdzad tshul/ bde stong rang bzhin rgyas pa'i dbang po'i gzhu/zung 'jug gur khyim rnam par bkra ba nas/ / gsang chen chos kyi rgyud mang bsgrags pa'i tshe/ / sa ra ha de mkha' spyod gnas su bros/ / zhes gsungs so/ / shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga po mtha' dag la thos bsam ji ltar mdzad pa thams cad kyang kha phyir bltas su ma song bar rgyud steng du sbyar bas/gzhung lugs mtha' dag rnam grol sgrub pa'i gdams ngag tu shar ba'i tshul ni/khengs ldan gnas lnga rig pa'i lus phra ma/ / rnam dpyod zur mig lcags kyus nyer btab tshe/ / 'khyud min mdza' bas mgul bar dam bcings te/ /gos pa med par mkhyen pa'i klong du sem/ / zhes pas bstan to/ / bsgoms pasagasung rab kyi de nyid mngon du gyur ba'i tshul la/ mdo phyogs kyi zab gnad mthar thug pa stong pa dang rten 'byung gi de nyid ji lta ba bzhin gzigs pa'i tshul ston pa ni/ rang bzhin dag pa'i thugs kyi shel dkar du/ / chos kun sgyu mar snang ba'i rnam rol gzugs/ / rgyu dang 'bras bur nges pa'i gzigs mo la/ / dus gsum rgyal ba phal cher yengs sam snyam/ / zhes dang /sngags kyi zab gnad mthar thug pa sgyu lus kyi rnam gzhag mkhas rlom gzhan 370

༄/ /daphyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skye4sgra brgya/rnams spyi don gyi sgyu ma tsam las/ sbas don dang mthar thug gi sgyu ma ji lta ba bzhin 'jog ma shes pa rnams/ me tog siju wā ra de nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'byed mi thub kyang / mdzes ma'i 'gram chang gis 'byed pa ltar/ rje nyid gcig pus ji lta ba bzhin gzigs shing phye ba'i tshul/ sgyu lus sirnyu wā ra'i 'dab ma'i sgo/ / mkhas rlom nyi zla'i 'od kyis phyed min pa/ / legs gsung rked med kha yi zegs ma'i chang / / 'thor tshe 'dab brgya pa de rang dbang ci/ /zhes gsungs so/ / thun mong snang tshod dang mthun par lhag pa'i lha'i zhal gzigs pa sogs grub pa'i go 'phang gsar du brnyes tshul dang / des don thun mong ma yin pa ltar na de la mi ltos pa'i khyad par gnyis gnyis sbyar te bshad tshul gsum las/ dang po snang tshod la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis lta ba'i dka' gnad sogs the tshom gyi dra ba bcad kyang / gnas tshod la 'jam dpal nyid dang ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i tshul/ 'jam dbyangs bshes gnyen rol par nges rnyed nas/ / khyod blo'i ri dwags dka' gnad sgog gi rgyar/ / bcings rnams zur phud lnga pa'i gsung mtshon gyis/ /bcad la mtshar du 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ / zhes pas bstan/ rgyan drug / mchog gnyis/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ lca dril/ jo bo yab sras sogs paṇa grub du mas byen gyis brlabs pas de dag gi dgongs pa thugs su chud pa'i tshul bstan kyang / des don sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum gyi bkod pa dang chabs gcig pa'i tshul/ rnam 'dren sras bcas grangs med tshogs rnams dang / / lhan cig gsang gsum bkod pas dus 'da' na/ / 'phags mchog paṇa grub 'ga' zung gzigs zhes pa'i/ /bstod bsngags mgon 'di'i che ba'i 'os su min/ / zhes gsungs/ snang tshod la rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ sgol ma dkar ljang 371

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/sogs lhag pa'i lha du ma'i zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs par bstan la/nges pa'i don du rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' dag spro zhing sdud pa'i byed por grub pa'i tshul ni/ rigs kun khyab bdag dbang por mngon grub pa'i/ / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro bsdur mnga' 'byor na/ / lhag pa'i lha 'gas byin gyis brlabs so zhes/ / bsngags brjod dar dir sgog la re ba bskyungs/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i gnad mtha' dag la 'khrul ba'i cha bra mo tsam yang med pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon chad gzhan gyis dbye bar ma nus pa'i grub mtha' rnam par dag pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba'i tshul/ mkhas grub cher rlom phal gyis khugs min pa'i/ /mtha' bral lta dang rim gnyis dka' gnas gzhung / / legs bshad rgyud kyis bkug 'di thun mong gi / gdul bya'i snang ngor bstan pa'i mdzad pa'i dpyid/ / ces gsungs la/ de ltar rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i skyon yon thams cad ji lta ba bzhin gzigs kyang / gzhan la sdang zhugs med par ma zad/ gzhan dag gi grub mtha'i ma nor ba'i cha thams cad kyang rang lugasakyi yan lag tu khyer te bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs pa'i tshul/ nges pa'i don du spangs rtogs phun tshogs kyi/ / yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal stug gdong lnga'i dbang / / 'khrul ba'i gcan gzan dregs pa'i nga ro la/ / dgra zlar mi sems rang gi ngang tshul yin/ / zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis pa mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub tshul la/ dang po mkhyen pa'i yon tan ni/ rgya chen mkhyen pa'i srang la shes bya yi/ / gnas lugs mtha' dag bcal tshe rdul phran ltar/ / gyur pas skyengs te chos kun 'chi med gtso/ / stong nyid bshol med mngal du yud kyis bros/ / zhes kun byang gi chos thams cad mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul/372

༄/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya/brgya byin bshol med byi bo byas/ / zhes mig stong byung ba'i gtam rgyud kyi dpe dang sbyar nas gsungs so/ / de bzhin du brtse ba'i yon tan yang / brtse chen lhag pa'i bsam pa'i lced kyi khur/ / nor 'dzin bu mos ma bzod jul ba'i chu/ / ches cher babs la khyab 'jug zhabs bsil du/ / skal ldan shing rtas phab ces sgros su gleng / / zhes 'gro ba ris med pa mtha' dag gi don rang gir bzhes pa'i lhag bsam gyi khur lce ba gzugs su grub na yangs pa'i sa chen po 'dis kyang theg dka' ba lta bur yod tshul/ skal ldan shing rtas gaṅgā phab pa'i gtam rgyud dang sbyar te rab btags kyi dpes gsungs so/ / nus pa'i yon tan bdud sde thal bar brlag tshul ni/ dus dgra'i nus mthur grub pa'i thog mda' yis/ / nag phyogs brag ri bcom dang lhan cig tu/ /'dod lha'i lus kyang tshig par mgrin sngon gyis/ / mig mes bsregs zhes rig byed gtam du mchis/ / zhes sngon dbang phyug chen pos mig dbus ma me'i mig gis 'dod lha bsregs pa'i rig byed kyi gtam rgyud dang sbyar te bshad do/ / rgyu de gsum gye sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub tshul yang /gang gis thar par drangs min skyes bu ni/ / med phyir rgyal rnams rang gi gdul bya dag / ma rnyed zhi ba'i dbyengs su mnal ba la/ / gdul dka'i snyigs ma lnga bdor sgro yis btags/ / zhes skal ldan gdul bya rnams gang la gang 'tsham du yang dag pa'i lam la sbyar te/ rgyal ba kun gyi mdzad pa'i khur rje nyid gcig pus bdag gir bzhes pa'i tshul gyis mdor bstan cing /de'i nang nas bye brag tu lung gi bstan pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas spel ba la 'gran bla med tshul/ srid zhi'i khams na 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /dpe zlar 'os pa tshol phyir nyi zla zung / / dal med mkha' la rgyu yang ma rnyed pas/ / ngal te thun mtshams sgeg mo'i phang par nyal/ / zhes nyi zla zung gis 373

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i ga4 lam/de'i 'gran zlar 'os pa zhig btsal te ma rnyed ces rab btags kyi sgo nas gsungs so/ / de nas rtogs pa'i bstan pa la gnyis las/ thun mong ba lam bslab pa gsum la gdul bya 'god tshul ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang dbyer med pa ni/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab pa'i gzhir/ /mtha' yas lus can ma lus nges spyor pa'i/ / mdzad pa mchog 'dis khyod dang zas gtsang sras/ / tha dad dbye ba'i go skabs rtogs nus min/ / zhes gsungs shing / thun mong ma yin pa snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i gsang sngags kyi myur lam la 'khrid par rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i tshul/ bskal brgyar bsgrub bya snyigs dus tshe gcig la/ / zung 'jug sku bzhi'i lam du 'gro ba kun/ / 'khrid la khyod dang khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / / sprul longs rtags kyis ma 'dres nges pa rnyed/ / ces pas bstan to/ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ thabs shes rin chen sna bdun la brten nas/ / lung rtogs bstan pa'i gling bzhir dbang sgyur ba'i/ / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba can/ / kun mkhyen tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes pa ste/ gser gyi 'khor los sgyur bas gling bzhi mtha' dag la 'dod dgur dbang sgyur ba bzhin/ thabs khyad par can ring nas goms pa'i rlabs po che'i thugs bskyed dang / bstan pa'i gnad mtha' dag la lkog tu ma gyur pa'i shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas thub pa'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag gcig pur grub pa/ gzu bor gnas shing chos kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mngon sum du grub pa'i rang bzhin brjod pa'o/ / gnyis pa 'dun pa bskyed de smon pa la/ thog mar nges legs kyi rgyur gyur pa mngon mtho'i go 'phang dal rten brgyud mar 'thob pa'i phyir smon pa ni/ deng nas tshe rabs lha yi lam yangs par/ / mi khom 374

༄/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya/skyon gyi chu 'dzin dang bral ba'i/ / dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i bsil zer rab spros pas/ / gtan bde'i ga pur thigs par longs spyod shog / ces dang /mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang skad cig kyang mi 'grogs par/ yongs 'dzin mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rjes su 'dzin par smon pa ni/ 'khrul ba'i khung bur log smra'i lce rkyong ba'i/ / ltar snang bshes gnyen sbrul gyis mi gtse zhing / / yang dag lam ston yongs 'dzin klu dbang gi / gtsug rgyan yid bzhin nor bu thob par shog / ces pa'o/ / de lta bu'i bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su bzung ste/ gang la slob pa'i yul gyi bstan pa'ang / phyi ru nyan thosastsod skyong zhing / / nang du 'dus pa la rab dga'/ / zhes rgyal ba rang nyid kyis ji ltar bsngags pa bzhin/ lam thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lta sgom spyod pa mtha' dag gi gnad tshang ba rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snying po rje bla ma'i bka' srol dri ma med pa 'di nyid dang mjal bar smon pa ni/rmad byung rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrims dang ldan/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs che/ / bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis rnal 'byor spyod/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar shog / ces pa ste gnad shin tu che'o/ / bstan pa de la'ang mjal ba'i ming tsam gyes mi chog par rang gis nyams su lon pa zhig dgos pas/ rjod byed gsung rab mtha' dag la thos pa ngoms pa med par byas te/ 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas spel bar smon pa ni/gang gi legs bshad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i tshogs/ / 'thung la nam yang ngoms pa ma mchis shing / / de don 'chad dang spel ba'i rgyud mang sgra/ /srid rtse'i bar du sgog pa'i dpal thob shog / ces so/ / de'i brjod don yang dag pa'i lam la slob pa la/ thun mong ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i nang nas chung du dang thun mong ba mngon mtho'i rgyu dge ba bcu la slob 375
