༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgoname'i ga4 'bum/pa'i phyir smon pa/ skye mang nyer brgyud mun pa sdug po'i nang / / 'di snang bde ba glog 'od skad cig mar/ / rtogs nas mngon mtho'i sgron me nyer 'degs pa'i/ / dge ba'i rtsi bcud grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes dang /srid pa las yid 'byung ba 'bring dang thun mong ba ni/ srid pa'i bde ba dbyar gye chu gter che/ / sdug bsngal mya ngam thang du 'gyur shes nas/ / ldog med zeg gsum 'phags pa'i go 'phang gi / mi zad rgya mtsho che la 'jug par shog / ces pas bstan/ snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas phyin drug gi spyod pa sgrub pa skyes bu chen po'i lam la slob pa'i phyir smon pa/ zhi bde'i mun par mar gyur 'gro ba'i gzugs/ / ma mthong rnam par grol ba'i tshul shes te/ / phyin drug spyod pa'i 'od stong rab spros nas/ / kun mkhyen ye shes snang ba rgyas par shog / ces pa'o/ / de ltar lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs te/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang chen rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la slob pa'i phyir smon pa/ grangs med bskal gsum kun gsal dzogs dka'i tshogs/ / rta ljang rlung shugs rim gnyis 'khrul 'khor gyis/ / snyigs dus tshe thung chu tshod drug cu la/ / lhun grub 'bad med bgrod par byin gyes rlobs/ / zhes pa yin la/ 'di'i mjug smon pa'i tshig tu ma byas par/byin gyis blobs zhes 'byung ba ni/ lam gye rtogs pa de dag skye ba'ang rje bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin gyis rang gi shes rgyud brlabs ba'am/ bsgyur dgos par shes pa'i ched yin te/ 'dis ni gong ma kun la'ang go bar bya'o/ / de yan chad kyis spyir smon pa'i don cha tshang bar song yang / khyad par du rje bla ma'i bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa ni lhag par thugs la brnag pa'i don yin pas/ de la ched du dmigs te yul dus mtha' dag tu rgyas pa'i phyir smon pa'i sho lo ka gsum mdzad pa'i dang po/ khyad par mgon khyod bstan pa yid 376

༄/ /dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs kyi don 'grel dbyar skyes sgra brgya/bzhin nor/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ / ring lugs dpal 'byor skal bzang 'gro kun gyis/ / mi zad dga' ston spyod la nus ldan shog / ces mtha' dbus kun tu rje bla ma'i srol 'dzin gyi skyes mchog mang du byung ste/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel bar 'gyur ba dang / 'khor ba'i skye srid 'dab chags bgrod pa'i 'gros/ / sna tshogs mtho dman bar mar rgyu ba'i tshe/ / 'jam dpal snying pos rjes su nyer bzung ba'i/ / grib ma gnyis pas rjes su 'brang bar shog / ces pa kun gzigs lnga pa chen po rang nyid kyi sku tshe'i 'phreng ba kun tu rje'i bstan pa 'di nyid 'dzin cing spel ba'i don du yin la/ chos phung sprin gyi lus phra'i phang pa nas/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa 'brug gi sgra/ / bzang po'i bskal pa dbyar dus ji srid du/ / mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dpal du 'grub gyur cig / ces pa ni tshul de dag gi sgo nas lus can yongs kyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i yang snying rje bla ma'i rang lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid bskal pa'i mtha'i bar du mi nyams par gnas pa'i phyir du smon pa mdzad pa ste/ dpal phreng gis zhus par dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam ni yang dag pa'i smon lam mtha' dag gi sdoms su gsungs pa bzhin no/ / sbyar byang go sla/ 'dir 'bad dge bas rtag tu dal 'byor gyi/ /rten thob bshes gnyen dam pas rjes bzung ste/ / bstan pa'i snying po thos bsam sgom pa yis/ / phra rags srid mtsho'i pha rol phyin gyur cig / de'ang bstod pa 'di nyid sngar 'di phyogs su dar so chung ba'i dbang gis blo 'dzin klog pa sogs ma myong yang / nye char su nyid g.yas ru'i shog nas chos dang donadang nges tshig 'byed pa'i blo mig can ku thi 'jigs med blo bzang gis nan cher bskul bar brten/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes 377

ro༅/ /gung bang bstanapa'isgronas gsung 'bum/chatshang bar thar chags su tshar gcig klog pa dang bstun/ spyi khogs kyi sa bcad blo la shar tshod tsam zhig ja spyor gnyis kyi ring la thol byung gi tshul du bris pa yin pas/ rnam dpyod can rnams kyis dpyod pa'i gzhi tsam mdzad de/ gzhung gzhan dang gung bsgrig nas zhib dpyod mtha' chod par mdzad na legs so/ / / /378

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga ོ/༄7/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang phyag mchod skor ba'i phan yon bstan pa rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang phyag mchod skor ba'i phan yon bstan pa rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / kun bzang sgrib med sems kyi rdo rje'i bdag / bde chen mtshan dpe'i lang tshor yongs smin las/ / mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde'i dpyid 'jo ba'i/ / 'byung gnas bde gshegs chos kyi sku la 'dud/ / skal bzang lha lam yangs pa'i me long ngos/ / thugs bskyed tshon gyis legs bris drug phrag zung / / mdzad bzang gar gyi ri mo yongs smin pa/ / ston pa mnyam med gang de gtsug gis mchod/ / de yi bstan pa 'gro gsum dag byed rgyun/ / grol lam yan lag brgyad ldan lha yi chab/ / bshad sgrub rlabs phreng brgya yi 'jo sgeg gis/ /rtsen bzhin yid kyi rol mtsho'i klong du sim/ / bslab gsum rim gnyis yal ga'i phyogs rdzogs shing / / bgegs 'joms grub pa mchog sbyin yongs 'du'i phreng / / theg gsum 'phags tshogs mkha' 'gro chos srung gi / zol 379

sa༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronace'i gsung 'bum/brten dge 'dun 'dus pas rtag tu skyongs/ / dkon mchog gsum char bsdus pa skyabs kyi phul/ / srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog 'dren pa zla med pa/ /thub dbang gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po des/ / byang chub bar du dgyes bzhin rjes su zungs/ / byin rlabs 'od brgya'i dpal mnga' de yi mthus/ /bdag blo 'dab brgya'i phreng ba bzhad pa las/ / gtsug lag lugs brgya'i ngo mtshar snying po 'di/ / skal bzang lha brgya'i dga' tshal rgyan du 'khrungs/ /rnam 'dren thub pa rnamatsha ni chos kyi sku/ / zhi ba 'dum byas pas rab tu phye/ / 'on kyang stobs sogs bstan du rung ba yi/ / rnam par 'phrul 'di bsod nams 'jug ngogs yin/ / sgo gsum legs byas srol du btsud pa'i rgyun/ / rtag gus spyor ba'i brtun pa ma snyigs pas/ / bsod nams phung po rnam 'gyur dang bcas bzhin/ / grub 'di byed po'i ri mo yongs su smin/ /sngon rabs bzang bo'i dus su dge ba'i sar/ / rlabs chen bsod nams snang ba ci yang sred/ / de dang rjes mthun shas kyi lhag ma 'di/ / cher snyigs yul dus mtshams las brgal ba bzhin/ / mdo smad rgyal khab yangs pa'i bsod nams zong / / legs smon byed pos bsgyur pa dpal gyi nor/ /'gro ba byin rlabs snang ba'i bgo skal gyis/ / mi pham mchod sdong nam mkha'i nor bu bzhin/ / brnyan po'i longs spyod 'dzam bu brikṣa'i 'bras/ / zhing mchog ma dros klong du son pa yi/ / bsod nams gser gyi gar bur grub pa 'di/ / thong tshe ser sna'i spar mo ngang gis lhod/ / dbang med khrims kyis bsdus pa'i dpya khral dang / / bun skyed bsngos bsgyur la sogs khram pa'i zas/ / ma yin sdig dang ma 'dres rgyu sbyor gyis/ / bya ba las kyi 'khor lo che 'di bsgrubs/ / dad ldan dad pa'i sbyin rdzas yin mod kyang / / chud gzan ma gyur rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du/ / bsod nams mi zad gter du bsgrubs 380

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga ོ/pa yis/ / rang gzhan gnyis gar sman yon bgyis so snyam/ / sen mo'i dkar dmar shas kyi dad zas 'di/ / gnyen 'khor dga' 'du'i tshogs nas longs spyod pa/ / 'phral snang spyid kyang phyi ma'i g.yang sa cher/ / mdzo sbrel bzhin du lhung ba ya re nga / / de slad dngos 'dzin lcags kyi dra ba'i spubs/ / dum bur bshig pa mthon po'i 'ud kyis ci/ / 'on kyang 'di snang dres ma'i thag pa yis/ / ma bcings phyi mar phan pa'i don du bsam/ /rlabs chen byang chub sems kyis kha bsgyur ba/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje bskul la rag / 'on te rang yang ngal gso thub bstan ljon/ / phan bde'i grib bsil yun du gnas par smon/ / sde dgon phyogs ris tsam gye bstan pa dang / / zhwa yi kha dog tsam gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ / ming dang gyon pa tsam gye skya ser la/ / snying po ma mchis ri mo'i stag g.yag bzhin/ / des na thub pa chos kyi gangs ri las/ / chad med 'phags bod rim par babs pa'i rgyun/ / mdo sngags zung 'jug chos kyi nying khu 'di/ / legs byas gshong bur 'khyil na ci ma rung / / mchog tu mos dge phun tshogs blo gros kyi/ / rnam dpyod dpung ba'i ka ba la brten nas/ / rgyu 'bras chos kyi phung po mchod sdong du/ / bsgrubs pa'i ngo mtshar bcos ma min 'di spro/ / phyogs phyogs 'dab stong bzhad pa'i pad tshal las/ / legs legs ge sa ra yi bcud bsdus pa/ / mngar mngar sbrang rtsi'i dog pa rgya chen 'di/ / yang yang myong ba'i dga' ston dus la babs/ / lus can kun la phan pa ga bur du/ / 'dzag pa'i zla ba gsar ba 'ongs so kye/ / dad brtson 'dab ma grol ba'i ku mu da/ / phyag mchod ge sar ldem pa'i gar byos shig / ces bya ba ni gleng bslang ba'i skabs te/ de nas gnyis pa rten bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus/gsum pa rten ji ltar bzhugs pa'i mtshan byang / bzhi pa rten bzhengs pa'i 381

༄khya/ /gung thangabastan pa'izla sa gsung 'thum/phan yon/ lnga pa rten la phyag mchod byas pa'i phan yon/ drug pa skor ba'i phan yon skor ba byed tshul dang bcas pa/ bdun pa bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab pa ste don tshan bdun gyi sgo nas bshad par bya'o/ / de la gnyis pa rten bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus ni/ spyir sku gsung thugs kyi rten byung tshul la/ston pa zhal bzhugs pa'i tshe lha chen po rnams kyis jo shāka sogs thub pa'i sku che chung du ma bzhengs pa lta bu 'bur sku dang / 'od zer ma dang chu len mar grags pa sogs bris sku byung tshul mang du yod la/ gsung rten lha'i dbang pos gser gyi glegs bu la bai ḍūrya zhun mas sher mdo bris pa dang / klu rnams kyis gsung rab mtha' yas pa'i glegs bam bris te klu yul du spyan drangs pa'i lo rgyus mang ngo / mchod rten ni de las kyang sngon du byung ste sku bltams pa dang / gtsug phud breg pa sogs kyi tshe de dag tu mchod rten brtsigs par 'dul ba lung las gsungs/ der ma zad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gang du dar ba der sku gsung thugs kyi rten yang nges can du 'byung ste/ sngon sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi sku gdung la rgyal bo mdzes pas mchod rten bzhengs par las brgya pa las gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus sku gsung thugs rten du ma rgyal po kri kri sogs kyis bzhengs shing rab tu gnas pa'i lo rgyus shin tu mang ngo / 'dir skabs su babs pa mchod rten ni/ chos longs sprul gsum gyi rten du phye bas chos sku'i rten dang /sku gsung thugs gsum du phye bas thugs rten yin te/ nag po spyod pas/chos kyi sku yi bdag nyid can/ / mchog gi yon tan gzugs can gyi/ /mchod rten rin chen/ zhes dang / mdo rtsa'i ṭī ka las/ mchod rten ni chos kyi sku yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes dang / lung zhu ba'i 'grel ba las/mchod rten gyi gnas ni chos kyi sku ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'i bdag 382

rnam dkar la4la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/nyid dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gye rkang pa dang / dbang po dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang / mkhyen pa dang /stobs dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams kyi gzugs brnyan nyid du bslab pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes thugs zag pa med pa ye shes chos kyi sku'i mtshon byed du gsal bar gsungs so/ / sangs rgyas sogs kyis chos sku'i rten yin pas sku'i rten du 'jog dgos tshul dang / blos bslang de gsum du phye ba'i thugs kyi rten du bshad pa rgyab 'gal kho na ste/rang don chos sku gzhan don gzugs skur byas shing / gzhan don gzugs sku bzhugs gnas dang bcas pa rang don chos skur byas pa'i phyir ro/ / des na rgyud bla ma las/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ / de la brten pa kun rdzob sku nyid do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun rdzob pa'isku longs sprul gnyis sogs gzhan don phun tshogs nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba la/de'i gzhir gyur pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu ni rang don phun tshogs don dam chos kyi sku yin pas de nyid gtso bor gyur pa la dgongs nas mdo rgyud rnams su rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon gsungs pa'i skabs su shas cher mchod rten la sbyar nas gsungs so/ / de lta bu'i mchod rten gyi dbye ba yang / kun gzigs lnga ba'i gzungs 'jug 'khrul spong las/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi mchod rten/ bla na med pa'i mchod rten/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten/ theg pa so so'i mchod rten dang lngar gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ de ltar nges par 'jig rten khams ni mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sku ste 'khor lo mchod rten rang bzhin no/ / zhes dang / dri med 'od las/ lhun po dang 'jig rten gyi khams ni mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sku ste mchod rten gye dngos po/ zhes sogs 383

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i tse'i khrung ཿma/kyes snod bcud gnyis gar sbyar ba la brten pa yin cing / 'di skor dgongs 'dus sogs snga 'gyur la shin tu mang ngo / / gnyis pa ni/ thig le dbang gi rgyud las/ shar du byams pa rdo rje brtsegs/ / lho ru snying rje rin chen brtsegs/ / nub tu dga' pa padma brtsegs/ / byang du btang stoms rgya gram brtsegs/ zhes tshad med bzhis rigs bzhi grub tshul dang sbyar nas bshad pa la brten pa'o/ / gsum pa ni/ 'khor lo 'byung ba'i rgyud las/byen rlabs sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir snang / zhes sogs kyis byen ldan stoms gter sogs brgyad gling bzhi so sor bzhugs par bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang bar snang yang / lung phran tshegs las/ de'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling du sku gdung gi mchod rten brgyad dang / bum pa'i mchod rten dang dgu/sol ba'i mchod rten dang bcur gyur to/ / zhes brgyad ka 'dzam gling du bzhugs par gsungs la/ dang po de ltar yin kyang phyis sgra sgrog pa'i skal ba klus khyer te cha bdun 'dzam gling du bzhugs par yang gsungs so/ bzhi pa ni/ sngon te ru gas drag po btul ba'i tshe/ yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du kye rdor lha mo brgyad kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad byung bar bdud rtsi chen po mchog gi rgyud bam po so bzhi pa las bshad pa la brten pa ste/'di la kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas 'khrul spong gi snying po bsdus par/ yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du mchod rten brgyad ces gsang sngags kyi theg pa gzhan las 'byung la/ yongs grags la sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa khyad par can re mdzad pa'i tshe mchod rten re bzhengs pa'i mchod rten brgyad ces gsungs so/ / rgyud der/ dur khrod chen po bal yul yin/ / ma mo chen mo pu ka si/ / mchod rten kha sho bya rung gnas/ zhes sogs kyis rnam pa gzhan du bshad pas da lta yongs grags kyi lo rgyus dang mi mthun no/ / lnga 3༅

rnam dkar layol skulabyed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/pa ni/ 'dul ba'i sde snod dang mdo myang 'das sogs las nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas rnams dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba tshun chad kyi mchod rtenabyed tshul tha dad par gsungs pa la brten pa ste/ de yang mdo rtsa ba las/ mchod rten ni rnam pa gnyis te/ gtsang khang can nyid dang / ka ba lta bu nyid do/ / de rab byung ba rnams la 'os pa nyid do/ / gal te dge ba yin na'o/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni rnam pa thams cad do/ / rnam pa ni bang rim bzhi dang / 'dab ma dang / bum pa dang / pu shu dang / srog shing dang / gdugs bcu gsum dang char khebs dag go / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni char khebs med pa'o/ / nyan thos rnams kyi 'bras bu'i tshad kyis de'i gdugs gcig lhag pa'o/ / so so skye bo rnams kyi ni byi bo'o/ /zhes zeg pa gsum gyi gang zag la mchod rten bya tshul so sor gsungs pas/༵dzhai ༵ dhi tt+waṃ ༵ dīdī dīdi sdi ṭwāṃ~X ༷zlo /༵ ༵rnyi dhidi ṭwāṃdī rji~X ༷'i stedī rdo ṭwāṃ~X so skyes byi bo dang / rgyun zhugs la chos 'khor ram 'dul ba'i brda chad ltar gdugs gnyis las mi 'byung bas mkhar sil btsug pa'i 'dra chos sbyar du medado/ / 'bras bu bzhi la gdugs gnyis gsum bzhi lnga byed par nyid kyi rnam bshad dang rgya cher 'grel du drangs pa'i lung las gsungs la/ phran tshegs dang ma mor dgra bcom la gdugs bzhi bya ba sogs su gsungs pa khungs mi 'dra bas mdo rtsa'i dgongs pa snga ma gtso bor byas pa'o/ / bse ru lta bu'i dgra bcom la char khebs med cing / sangs rgyas kyi de la thams cad tshang bar yod do/ / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis lhung bzed kha spubs pa lta bu'i mchod rten/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten/ rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba lta bu'i mchod rten gsum gsungs pa stag los zeg chen kho na la sbyar yang /385

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'itshonama'i gsung 'bum/mdo rtsa'i gtsang khang can dang 'di'i khang bu brtsegs pa 'dra zhing shā ri'i bu la de lta bu byas par gleng gzhi'i skabs su 'byung bas de gsum mchod rten spyi'i dbye bar byas na legs te/ da lta rgya gar nas byung ba khang ba rim pa mang po brtsegs pa'i rnam pa zur bzhi 'am brgyad 'dug par yongs grags gasdo la'i bkod pa zhes zer ba dang / de mthun rgya nag phyogs su mchod rten zhes zer yang / bod la grags tshod 'di dang phyogs tsam yang mi mthun pa'i khang ba thogamang du brtsegs pa zhig yod pa 'di rnams kyang de gsum gyi grangs yin par skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen pos bsungs so/ / mdo myang 'das las sangs rgyas la bang ma rim bcu gsum 'phang lo dang bcas pa/ rang sangs rgyas la bang rim bcu gnyis sogs su gsungs la/ kri ya la muñtsar/ bcu gsum ni dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi'o/ / dgu dang bdun ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi'o/ /zhes snga ma rnams dang mi 'dra bar bshad do/ / de dag las sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la nang gses kyi dbye ba mang yang gtso bo mchod rten brgyad du 'du la/ de'i thog ma sku bltams pa'i tshe gter lnga brgya sogs bkra shis pa'i sgo mang du phye bas bkra shis sgo mang nas 'dren par bzhed pa mang yang / rang lugs bltams ma thag phyogs so sor gom pa bdun bdun por ba las padma skyes pa dang / padma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyis ma gos pas 'khor bar skyes kyang skyon gyis ma gos pa'i mtshon byed padma spungs pa dang po dang / gnyis pa sku bzhi mngon par byang chub pa'i mchod rten/ gsum pa chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe bden bzhi rnam thar brgyad sogs mtshon byed sgo bcu drug nas brgya rtsa brgyad sogs yod pa bkra shis sgo mang / bzhi pa mu stegs ston pa drug sogs btul te gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pas glo 'bur can gyi cho 'phrul mchod rten/ lnga pa 386

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/gzhan don du 'byon pa mtshon byed zem skas can gyi lha babs mchod rten/drug pa dge 'dun gyi dbyen bablums pa'i tshe de'i rgyu dug gsum lta ba dang bzhi bcad de rnam thar brgyad la gnas pa mtshon byed bang rim gyi gru bzhi bcad de zur brgyad du yod pa dbyen bablums mchod rten/ bdun pa sku tshe zla ba gsum du byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe bang rim blum po gsum pa 'chi bdag las rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten/ brgyad pa 'khor ba'i spros pa dang bral ba mtshon byed bang rim med pa'i myang 'das mchod rten rnams so/ / dbye ba 'di rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo 'og tu 'byung ba dang /li yul lung bstan pa/ klu sgrub kyis mchod rten brgyad la bstod pa/ dri med 'grel ba rnams su 'byung la/ 'on kyang dri med 'grel bar sku gdung cha brgyad du bgos pa'i mchod rten brgyad zas gtsang dang gsal rgyal sogs kyis sbyin bdag byas nas bzhengs par bshad pa khas blangs mi rung ste/dus tshod mi 'grig pas de ni spyir btang gi shāka thub mchod rten brgyad dang /sku gdung gi mchod rten brgyad 'dres pa'i yig skyon zhig byung bar mngon/de ltar sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs dus mdzad pa khyad par can re bstan pa'i sar dad ldan rnams kyis de rjes su dran pa'i mtshon byed mchod rten re bzhengs te dus ston btsugs/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su yang so so'i gdung skal la mchod rten dpag tu med pa bzhengs te bsod nams zad mi shes pa'i gter gyi sgo brgya phye/ de rjes rgyal ba nyid kyis lung bstan pa bzhin chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis mchod rten bye ba bzhengs te sa steng mdzes par byas/mgon po klu sgrub kyis kyang rdo rje gdan du mchod rten du ma bzhengs pa sogs rgya gar na dar shos shin tu che la/ bod gangs can 'dir yang chos rgyal gyi dus bsam yas dang lha sar mchod rten 'ga' zhig bzhengs/ phyis su chos 387

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sa'i gsung 4ma/rgyal kun bzang pas rgyal rtser mchod rten chen mo dang / jo nang pas rtag brtan du sku 'bum chen mo/ thon mi'i gdung rabs bcu gsum pa rgyal chen gling pa'i zhal ngo yar rgyab dpon po bsod nams rnam rgyal dang lha rje bsod nams rgya mtsho gnyis kyis byams pa gling du mchod rten khyad du 'phags pa bzhengs pa rnams yul dus gnyis ka bzang zhing khong rnams sde 'bangs dang chos srid kyi 'byor ba shin tu che bas de'i lag rjes lta bu ga la yong / 'on kyang rang 'byor dang bstun pa'i rten bzhengs byas tshul gyi lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ bdag rang lo bdun pa'i steng du gdan sa 'dir 'ongs/skyabs mgon thams cad gzigs pa chen po rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhabs drung nas bstan pa'i sgor btsud cing de nas bzung ste chos kyi bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab par mnos/ de skabs skyabs mgon mchog nas rjes tshang smyung gnas par dgon 'di nang du mchod rten chen po zhigabyung na legs 'dug pas khyod kyis e thub ces gsung tshul khong gi ngag nas yang yang thos pas/ bla ma'i bka' drin bsab byed 'di 'dra re byed rgyu byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang skyes/ rang lo bcu bdun pa la dbus su song ste sgo mang chos grwa lo brgyad 'grim pa'i ring slob gnyer kho na'i 'dun par gcig dril gyis gzhan ma'i bya byed thams cad rgyang skyur byas te lo nyer lnga'i thog sprul pa'i dam bca' ma yin par grwa skor tshul bzhin bgyis/ de'i tshe rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bong ba gser gzigs kyi tshul du snyan brgyud man ngag gang dgos stsol ba'i zhal bzhes sogs bka' drin shin tu che bar yod pas lo shas sdod 'dun yod kyang / skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dbus phebs phyi ma'i skabs yin pas dgongs pa ma khrol bar rang yul ldog dgos byung / thos don nyams len zhig e yong gi re bas lo shas 'bad khul 388

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/byas kyang dge spyor re'i mgo brtsams pa na 'du phung mi bde ba kho na gcig rjes gcig non lta bur byung ste de ga'i bsam sbyor thams cad than pa'i dus kyi sprin bzhin dngos med du gyur/ rang lo nyer dgu pa la skyabs mgon mchog nas mkhan chen ngag dbang grags pa'i gdan sa da tshang dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong byed dgos kyi bka' nan phebs te der phyin/ da gzod dge sbyor rnam dag cig mi 'ong bar 'gro 'dug sogs byed dgos pa la gzhan don du ming btags nas dkor zas sdug bsod byas kyang mthar chud zos las med pas rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu bar 'dug/ des na dkon mchog gi zhing sar 'gro nges dang lhag par sngon dus kyi kun slong bzhin rten bzhengs shig e thub snyam pa shar/ 'on kyang rang lo sum cur sleb pa lcags phag lo'i dgun thog skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad par brten byi ba'i lo nas bzung dgon pa'i chos srid thams cad kyi khur rang dbang med par thog tu lhung bas/ 'chad nyan 'grig lam gtong sgo sogs kyi sems khur la brten nas rten bzhengs sogs yid kyis bor/ lhag par rang lo so lnganas rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten dgon lung byams pa gling gi khri yang 'dzin dgos byung ste lo gsum gyi ring gdan sa gnyis ka zung 'brel du bskyangs/so bdun pa la skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho gdan sar bkod/ phyogs mtha' chod pa dka' yang dgon pa'i nang 'di'i gra 'tshogs 'chad nyan 'grig lam sogs zur cung zad kyang ma nyams par phyag tu sprod rgyu byung ba'i dga' spro'i thog nas ba'i dgongasapa zhus/ khri'i skabs der yang rigs grwa snga phyi kun la srang khrir nye ba'i tshong song yang de'i zhar la 'cham chen skabs bkram rgyu'i chos rgyal gyi gos thang chen mo/ bla ma khri pas bsten rgyur gnas chung gi gser sku/ byams 389

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronatse'i gsung 'byam/mdun du dngul gyi maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma dngul srang lnga brgya las grub pa rang ming spel ba'i smon tshig 'bur dod can/ srang nyis brgya skor gyi ka 'phan gser mgo ma bzhi/ ka bar dgu khebs pa'i gos kyi bla bre rnams dang / snga sor dbus nas 'ongs skabs gser gyi rgyal mtshan cha sogs gang dgos kye 'jog pa phran tshogs lan mang tsam byas rung / da dung yid tshim pa zhig ma byung bar da ni bdag cag rnams kyi me tog phog pa'i lha skal lta bu skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang sku 'phreng rim byon yin pas 'khrungs rabs lha khang zhig byas na snyam yang / 'di nas bzo bo sogs mi 'grig stabs bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po tho yon rab rgyas la sku brnyan bzhengs rgyu'i sbyin bdag bskul/'di nas dge rtsa mtha' dag chud mi za ba'i phyir smon lam gye dus mchod gtong rgyu'i gra bsgrigs te/ rang lo bzhi bcu pa lcags bya'i lo srang bdun stong brgal ba'i zong gis cho 'phrul dus mchod nyin ltar gyi phog sogs lha mchod mi mchod rgya cher byas/ de'i steng du srang nyis stong lhag las bsgrubs pa'i 'khrungs rabs kyi sku yang cha tshang bar 'byor pa la gzungs gzhug/ mchod khri/ ka 'phan/ bla bre/ mchod ting sogs gang dgos thams cad gsar du bsgrigs te 'khrungs rabs lha khang byas/ dang bor rten bzhag de gas 'thus pa dang / rgyu nor gang yod smon lam gyi khongs su 'gro ba byed rtsis yin kyang / dkon mchog gi thugs rjes mthun rkyen 'dzoms che ba lta bus da dung dad rdzas kyi dngos po lhag lus dga' rab 'dug pa dang / mtshams deragayeng ba'i 'phro btsan chod byed rgyu yang rkyen du ma zhig gis gra mi 'grig par 'dug la/ chung ngu'i dus nas rang gis yang yang yid la blangs pa'i dam bca' lta bu yin stabs/ mchod rten mthong grol chen mo 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i sbyor ba brtsams/ chos 'khor dang sgo khyim sogs bzhengs rgyur 390

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/'di nas srang stong phrag lhag tsam dang / sbyin bdag skul byed snam phrug byin rten sogs phon mi chung ba bcas mi sna mtsho bdun du mngags/ rang lo zhe gcig la sleb pa rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por las mgo gtsugs te lo gsum gye ring zla ba bdun re tsam la las mi nyung skabs dgu bcu skor dang / mang skabs brgya dang bzhi bcu skor gyis bar ma chad par byas pa thams cad kyis g.yo zol med par hur skyed 'bad pa dang blang gis las 'gro che zhing / de'i ring mi gcig la yang na tsha sogs kyis las ka 'chag dgos pa zhig ma byung ba dkon mchog gi thugs rjer snang /dngul 'di nas khyer ba'i steng du su nyid kyi grwa rgyun bgres gzhon thams cad nas lhag bsam dag pas zhal 'debs gang legs byas pas gzhi bzung /nes man/ u cu mu chin/ a ba ga/ hal ha sogs nas kyang grogs ldan byed mkhan kha shas byung ba bcas kyi steng nas chos 'khor za ra tsag nyi zla tog bcas kyi dpangs gzhu 'dom lnga lhag pa dang / sgo khyim thog tshad lhag pa/sku brnyan mi tshad long ma long du ma dang / dbu rgyan che chung kha shas garjir dang / mtha' 'khor du 'jog rgyu'i rnam bcu dbang ldan cha du ma/ 'khor lo dang ri dwags pho mo sogs phal cher cha tshang bar grub ste/ lam skabs sogs su 'gal rkyen gye rigs cung zad kyang med par nam dgos pa'i dus thog tu 'byor/ rgya bod kyi yul tha dad nas bzos kyang slar bsgrigs pa'i tshe mi gcig gis thig btab pa bzhin chad lhag dang che chung 'dzol skyon med par 'grigs pa skyabs mgon thugs rje can gyi byin brlab tu nges pa rnyed/ de ltar rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa rnams kyi rgyu song dang / 'di nas bzo po'i yon gyi nang du song ba/ gser tshon dang 'khor shog sogs kyi rin/dngul gyi mchod cha gsar bzos sogs kun bsdoms par dngul rkyang srang 391

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i ma'i khrung 'a4/stong phrag gsum dang nyis brgya skor/ gzhan ma lha bris pa/ 'bag bzo/gser mgar/ lcags mgar/ lcags skud bla mkhan/ gos bzo ba/rdo rtsig pa/ gyang rdung / rdo 'khur/ spyo bzo/ gras rdo bzo mi/ shing bzo sogs kyi dpon g.yog thams cad la rgyun gyi lto chas/ gla phog gang gzab/ 'dzug sgang grol gsum gyi ston mo/ go babs dang bstun pa'i ster spyin sogs gang thad nas khral chos lta bu ma yin par/ rgyu song gi 'bras bu la bsam ste yid tshim nges byas pas/ lo snga phyir rta nor gos phrug/ za ma ras/ kha btags/ spyon pa/ dung tse/ ja mar nas rtsam phye 'bras sogs gang song tho rags rim tsam 'dug pa dang / steng 'og gi lha khang kun tu mchod cha yongs rdzogs gsar bsgrigs/ ka bar bzhi bcu skor phal cher khebs pa'i gos kyi bla bre nang sha dang bcas pa/ 'khor lo dang gzungs gzhug gi skor/ rgya nag tu 'gro chas dang sbyin bdag kun la mtshams rten/me mda' sum cu skor sogs lcags khal brgya lhag/ go sa'i khang ba/ kha shas dang shing cha sogs kyi rin/ 'phral gyi cha rkyen gang dgos rnams su song ba lam tsam bsdoms par/ ri gong dngul srang stong phrag lnga dang bdun cu'i skor thob/ shing byi zla ba dgu pa'i nang du las mjug grub ste/ lha babs kyi dus chen la rang nyid dang rdo rje slob dpon 'ga' bcas kyis rab gnas mdor ba bsdus tsam byas/ shing glang zla ba dang po cho 'phrul gyi dus chen dang bstun te/ skyabs mgon thams cad gzigs pa chen po'i mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyis dbu mdzad/khri chen dpal ldan grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ sde khri sprul ba'i sku/ sgo mang mkhan zur blo bzang chos dar/ sgo mang mkhan po sangs rgyas rdo rje'i sprul sku sogs chog grwa pa dang bcas pas nyin gnyis kyi ring bkra shis snye ma'i steng nas 392

rnam dkar la4la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/spyan dbye'i cho ga rgyas par mdzad de byin rlabs kyi gter chen por bsgrubs/gong sa rin po cher dngos 'bul spus gtsang dang / bla ma rnams la tshan grangs/ gzhan thams cad la 'gyed sogs 'tshem med du byas/ tshogs pa sum stong du nye bar ja bar khag re dang bsod btags re phul zhing bstan 'bar ma sogs gsung nas me tog gi char phab/ rab gnas skor gyi 'gro sgo bsdoms par srang stong dang brgyad brgya nyi shu'i rtsis song ba bcas/ snga phyi thams cad khyon dril na dngul srang khri phrag gcig dang dgu bcu'i skor song /spyir kham sog gi mis rang bzhin gyis stes zhib cha mi 'ong 'dug pas/gser khang chen mo'i byams chen thog tshad bzhi pa gtsug lag khang 'gran zla mid pa dang bcas pa/ bzo bo yang dbus nas blangs pas gla phog thams cad gang 'dod lta bur byas stabs 'gro sgo bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / tho nang du sum khri lnga stong gi tshod las ma thebs 'dug cing / lha sa'i dkyil 'khor rting gi byams sku thog tshad gnyis pa der gtsang khang sogs zur du bzo mi dgos pa'i sku rkyang la yang sum khri sum stong tsam song tshul dkar chag tu 'dug pa ltar na bod pa'i zhib rtsis de 'dra byas tshe gser khang lta bur srang 'bum phrag brgal ba 'gro zhing / rten bzhengs 'di la yang de cha lngar byas pa'i gcig tsam ma mtha' 'gro ba'i tshod du snang mod kyang / mtho 'dzin byas pa dgos pa mi 'dug pas gnas skabs tho nang du gang thebs phyogs bsgrigs byas pa yin no/ de yang byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyi rtsis zin pa sogs bdag lta bu la dka' mod kyang / bsam pa'i khyad par spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / khyad par bstan pa byang nas byang du dar bar lung bstan pa chos sde 'di nyid yin par klong rdol bla ma rin po che sogs tshad ma'i skyes bu du mas gsungs pas/393

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i 0me'i ga 'a4/dgon sde 'dir mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang /rang nyid kyang tshe rabs kun tu bstan pa'i snying po mchog la thos bsam sgom pas tshul bzhin du 'jug cing / khyad par rang nyid kyis thog drangs rang la 'bral thogs kyi 'gro ba mi dang mi min thams cad ma 'ongs pa na rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i 'khor gyi thog mar gyur te yang dag pa'i lam gyis btsan sa zin pa'i phyir du dmigs te bzhengs par bla ma yi dam chos srung rnams kyang thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te rjes su bzung ba'i 'bras rtags su bya ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad la 'gal rkyen gyi cha phra mo tsam yang med par/yid kyis smon pa bzhin du 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa dam par lhun gyis grub ste/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ zhib mor bsags pa las ni nor 'byung zhing / / nyin mtshan bsam pa las ni blo 'byung ste/ /ya rabs mdzangs pa las ni phyag ris 'byung / / rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan nga re dga'/ zhes sogs dang / nga yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di/ / rin chen sna las grub pa ste/ / rtsig pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ / nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ / mthong ba tsam gyes nyams re dga'/ / de phyir bsam gyin blo re bde/ zhes sogs dga' glu bcu gsum dang / gzhan yang rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi seng ge 'gying rtsen/ g.yu mtsho 'khyil pa/ dbyangs ring khug pa/skyid pa'i glu ring / drang shing dkar po/ stag ri dgu brtsegs sogs dga' skyid kyi glu gar mang du byas pa ltar/ rang 'khos kyi legs tshogs shin tu che bar byung ngo / / rten bzhengs grub pa'i lo der zi lang yi bhan lcas tā zhin/ mtsho sngon po'i sa skor la 'gro ba'i zhor gyis dgon par 'ongs nas mchod rten la mjal te ya mtshan che bar byed cing de nas phyir zi lang du ldog pa'i lam khar gre ci zhig 'byor bar/ mdo smad du dgon pa dang lha khang 394

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga ra/sogs ci 'dra yod bka' 'dri gnang ba dus 'grig pa'i stabs kyis yi bhan nas dgon so so'i gnas tshul dang / lhag par 'jam dbyangs hā thog thu'i dgon du gong ma chen po'i zhabs brtan la mchod rten khyad 'phags shig bzhengs 'dug tshul zhus pas/ yang bskyar rgya dpangs sogs kyi tshad dang /nang du lha khang ci 'dra yod bka' 'dri phebs shing / de nas ma 'gyang bar gong ma rang gi phyag gis bris pa'i tsa bon tshe ring gnam gye she mong gi bka' rtags phyag rgya'i re khā can bstsal pa ni chos kyi dbang du byas na/ ljongs 'dir bstan pa nam gnas bar du gong ma'i gdan sar yang 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa rim can byon par gsungs pas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che/'jig rten gyi lugs dang bstun tshe/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po'i bdag rkyen 'di 'dra gang byung gis 'bad rtsol ci tsam byas kyang 'ong dka' ba zhig rtsol ba phra mo tsam yang ma byas par gnam babs kyi tshul du byung ba ya mtshan che zhing / yi ge rnams kyi don bod skad du bsgyur na/ dkon mchog thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling kun khyab/ ces pa lta bu zhig tu snang bas rten 'brel gyi che ba yang rmad du byung bar snang ngo / / zhes bya ba ni gnyis pa rten bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus kyi skabs so/ /gsum pa rten ji ltar bzhugs pa'i mtshan byang ni/ phyi rten dang nang bzhugs kyi skor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ shod kyi mdun ngos su rigs lnga'i lha khang ka ring gnyis ma/ steng phyogs su skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gi 'dra sku gser zangs las grub pa dang / dbus su seng ge'i khri la rnam snang /shar du glang chen gyi khri la mi bskyod pa/ lhor rta mchog gi khri la rin 'byung /nub tu rma bya'i khri la 'od dpag med/ byang du mkha' lding gi khri la don grub rnams sku tshad byis pa lo bcu gsum pa'i tshod tsam/ rnam snang gi g.yas 395

༄/ /yo thang bayo pa'isgronas khrung 'am/g.yon du rgya nag li ma'i byams pa khru tshad dang de mtshungs 'jam dbyangs kyi sgu gnyis khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa/ gsung rab po ti brgyad brgya skor/ldeb ris la tshe dpag med/ don yod zhags pa/ sgol ma dkar ljang /rta mgrin dmar chung dang phyag rdor/ mgon chos lha mo rnam sras gnas chung sogs dang / rgyal chen bzhi/ g.yas kun gzigs lha khang du/ 'jam dbyangs kun gzigs kyi snang brnyan khri rgyab yol dang bcas par thog tshad gnyis pa/ gnas chen du ma'i sa sna dang byin rten phon che ba sman 'dam sogs kyi rgyu las grub cing gser zangs kyi dbu rgyan dang rin po che 'gang che ba du ma'i phra rgyan sogs rgyu bzo shin tu legs shing phyin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ g.yas g.yon du gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro dang byams mgon gyi sku mi tshad tsam pa khri rgyab yol can gnyis/ gtso bo'i rgyal yol gyi rtser tsan dan las grub pa'i rje'i sku khru gang ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi nam mkhar sprin la bzhugs pa'i spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor gyi sman sku khru tshad re/ g.yas g.yon gyi grwar gsung rab po ti brgyad brgya nyi ci skor/ldeb bris la/ rje bla ma/ rgyal tshab/ mkhas grub/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ / 'dul 'dzin 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ byams chen chos rje/ rje shes rab seng ge/ dge 'dun grub/ tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa/paṇa chen bsod grags/ rgyal ba dbon sa pa/ paṇa chen chos rgyan/ rgyal dbang lnga pa/ rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs/ khya dge blo gros rgya mtsho/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang / thu'u kwan rin po che sogs gser mdog cod paṇa 'chang ba'i bstan pa 'di la bka' drin lhag par che ba'i bla ma rags bsdus dang / steng 396

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/gi cha la thang ga'i rnam par 'jam dbyangs dang rdo rje 'jigs byed/ shing rta chen po gnyis rnams bzhugs/ phugs kyi gsung rab lha khang du/ po ti bzhi re tsam lhan du po ti re re byas te rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog tshar du ma sogs ka bar gsum gyi rim pa'i thog so gnyis khrigs kyis khengs par brtsegs pa la dkyus ma'i tshad kyi po ti bzhi stong lhag pa bzhugs shing /g.yas g.yon gyi grwar po ti brgyad brgya ma long tsam/ ldeb ris la ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mchog zung bcas dang / gnas brtan chen po bcu drug ha shang dang dge bsnyen dharma/ gtad rabs bdun/ chos 'phags dang rtag ngus sher phyin 'chad pa'i bkod pa bcas bzhugs/ g.yon gyi kun rig lha khang du/ kun dga' rwa ba thog tshad gnyis par gtso sku mi tshad dang /gzhan ma'i rtsa lha so drug rnam snang mngon byang / rdor dbyings/ seng ge'i sgra/ dzam lha rnams khru re/ thams cad gser ljib thum khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa/ de dag gi steng gi bang rim la/ khru tshad ma'i thub dbang /'od dpag med/ byams pa/ sgrol ma sogs gser ljib thum dang / birba pa/ pha dam pa/ rje btsun mi la/ phag mo grub/ bu ston/ paṇa chen chos rgyan/ kun gzigs lnga pa/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi sman sku khru tshad gser tshon gyis mdzes pa shin tu byon legs/ dngul gyi gdung rten gnyis dang / gzhan mchod rten che ba brgyad/ sman sku byen can gsar rnying nyi shu skor sogs dang / 'gram gnyis la gsung rab po ti bdun brgya brgyad cu tsam/ ldeb ris la jo bo rje/ khu rngog 'brom gsum/ nag tsho lha bla ma/khu dbon rnams dang / steng phyogs su rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi/ zla ba bzang po/ / la lī ta/ lca nag dril gsum/ g.yas g.yon du mkhan slob chos 397

༄/ /yo ca bam rsā lo ga ཿma/gsum/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ pu to pa/ mar pa/ lab sgron/bu mo bsod nams rgyan/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa/ bu ston/ cha ba chos seng / garma rol pa'i rdo rje sogs ris med kyi skyes chen dam pa bstan pa'i rtsa lag bka' drin can rnams kyi sku bcas bzhugs/ bar thog gi phyogs bzhir zhal ras lha khang lcags khra bcas dang / dbus mi bskyod pa/ shar rnam snang / lho rin 'byung / nub 'od dpag med/ byang don grub kyi lha khang du so so'i sku brgya skor re phyogs mdog tu byas pa la de dang cha 'grig pa'i bzhugs gnas grwa mig dang bcas pa/ thog so gsum pa'i khor yug tu bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi sman sku mtho gang re can gser ljib thum/bzhugs gnas grwa mig mchod shom dang bcas pa cha 'grig bum pa'i nang bde ba can gyi zhing bkod du byas pa'i phur gser zangs las grub pa'i 'od dpag med kye sku khru lnga ba/ rma byas btegs pa'i khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa/mdun du sras kyi thu bo gnyis kyi gser sku pad sdong la bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du khang bzang gi bkod pa rim brtsegs kyi dbus su 'od dpag med kyi sku khru tshad re re/ steng du rgya bod kyi li ma'i 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bcu skor/ 'gram so sor gser zangs las grub pa'i sku khru tshad ma kha shas/ sdeb ris la bde ba can gyi zhing gi snod bcud kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pa ngo mtshar ba bcas bzhugs so/ / seng khri'i phyi rol gyi g.yab khor yug tu ka bar re la 'khor lo bzhi re bzhag pas 'khor lo che ba brgya dang brgyad/ sgo khang gi 'gram dang nang du yang 'khor lo kha shas/ldeb ris mdun ngos su ltung bshags kyi lha tshogs dang sman bla mched brgyad bzhugs shing / phyogs gzhan gsum la 'khor lo re re'i steng du yi dam gyi lha re 'bab pa byas te/ rdor phreng mi tra brgya rgyam sogs kyi rgyud sde bzhi'i lha 398

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/gtso rags bsdus tsam bzhugs pa g.yas kyi gru nas brtsams te rigs lnga yab yum/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/ 'jam rdor/ 'jigs rten dbang phyug bde mchog rigs bzhi/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ gdong drugadus 'khor/ dus 'khor lhan skyes/ kye rdor thod pa can/ kye rdor mtshon cha can/ phag mo don grub/ phag dkar/ ku ru kulle/ ma hā ma ya/sangs rgyas thod pa/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'/ spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ 'khor chen sogs bla med dang / nub kyi gru nas rnal 'byor rgyud rnam snang / rdor dbyings/ gtsug dgu/ chos dbyengs gsung dbang /bya spyod la rnam snang mngon byang / mi ru shi ṣa/ tshe dpag med dkar po/thogs med kyis zhal gzigs pa'i byams pa/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo/'jam dbyangs seng ge'i sgra/ a ra pa tsa na/ 'jam dpal nag po/don zhags/ nam mkha' rgyal po/ ha ri ha ri la zhon/ sems nyid ngal gso/ sa snying / sgrib sel/ kun bzang / nam snying / bdud rtsi thigs pa/ phyag rdor mdo lugs/ rnam 'joms/ khyung gsham can/rgyud phyi ma'i rta mgrin/ shwa na bzhi skor/ lcags ral/ mi g.yo ba/stobs po che/ bgegs mthar byed/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ nā ga rakka/ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgol ma/ nor sbyin sgrol ma/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgol ma/ sna tshogs yum/ sher phyin ma/ 'od zer can ma/ lo gyon ma ser ljang gnyis/ rnam rgyal ma/ gdugs dkar/ sor 'brang / spyan ma/dbyangs can ma dkar dmar gnyis/ nor rgyun ma/ dug sel ma/ tsurdo/'chi med rdo rje lha mo/ ral gcig ma/ gza' yum/ seng gdong ma/dzam dkar/ dzam dmar/ rnam sras tshe 'phel rnams bzhugs/ steng 'og gi mthong skor rim pa gsum la rgyang ring po nas mthong bar ma ṇi che ba 399

༄/ /yo ca b.lo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 4ma/khor yug tu brkos/ sgo khang gong 'og sogs kyi gdung la gzungs sngags du malañtsa dang bod yig gis bris pa sogs phyi nang thams cad mthong thos dran reg don ldan du byed pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyis go mtshams med par gtams so/ / sgo khang gi thog sor rang gi ngag rtsom 'ga' zhig dang /gzhan yang nyer mkho'i dpar mang tsam bzhugs/ nang bzhugs kyi rim pa yang / 'phags pa 'od zer dri med rnam dag 'od kyi gzungs las/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bram ze chen po khyod song la/ grong khyer ser skya'i lam gyi sum mdo na mchod rten ring bsrel can rnying ba ral pa zhig yod pa de slar brtsigs te mchod rten gyi rtse mor srog shing btsugs la/gsangasngags yi ger bris pa de'i nang du bcug ste mchod pa byas nas gsang sngags lan bdun bton na/ khyod kyi tshe'ang phyir nur te 'phel bar 'gyur la/ 'chi ba'i dus byas kyang bde 'gro mtho ris kyi gnas longs spyod che ba rnams su skyes te bskal pa stong phrag brgya'i bar du bde ba'i longs spyod kyang phyir 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur/ de nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par skye bar 'gyur te bskal pa brgya stong du mar bde ba chen po myong bar 'gyur ro/ / de nas kyang shi 'phos te rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams kyi gnas su skye bar 'gyur te/ de yang bskal ba chen po stong phrag brgya'i bar du bde ba'i longs spyod mi zad pa myong bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs gang du skyes pa'i gnas kun tu'ang yid gzhung zhing tshe'i bar chad med pa dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad nas dus nam du yang sems can dmyal bar ltung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / rtag tu yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnams dang 'phrad cing / rjes su dgongs par mdzad do/ / zhes ring bsrel gyi snying po can du byas na phan yon bsam 400

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/gyis mi khyab par gsungs pas/ ring bsrel yang gang la byed na/ rgyud sde spyi rnam las/ byang chub rgyan 'bum da lta bod na tshang ba mi bzhugs/ sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gis de drangs par de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel/ sku gdung gi ring bsrel/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel rnams mchod rten du gzhug par gsungs te/ chos sku'i ring bsrel ni gzungs rnams so/ /sku gdung gi ring bsrel ni sku gdung las byung ba'i ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam mo/ / sku bal gyi ring bsrel ni sku gzugs te/ de dag rim pa ltar mchog dang / 'bring dang / tha mar gsungs so/ zhes ring bsrel gsum du bsdus shing / phyi ma sku brnyan sogs la gsungs pa shin tu gnad che ste/bka' chems bka' 'khol mar/ ci ste sangs rgyas byin rlabs de/ / so so skye bos shes mi 'gyur/ / de phyir sangs rgyas ma byon pa'i/ / zhing na sku gzugs yod min zhing / / mtha' khob kla klo rnams na med/ / bstan pa nub na yod min zhing / / mu stegs byol song sogs mi mthong / / de phyir sku gzugs sprul pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar sar lha bzo mkhas pa 'byung la/ mu stegs dar tshe lha bzo ngan pa dang / kla klo dar tshe lha bzo gtan nub par bshad pa bzhin 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos kyi dod lta bur sprul pa'i ring bsrel du bzhag pa/ thugs bde stong ye shes kyi dod gzungs la de'i ring bsrel du bzhag pa dang go don 'dra'o/ /'on kyang da lta grags che ba ring bsrel bzhir byas te/ chob/ sku'i ring bsrel sngar ltar dang / yungs 'bru lta bu yongs grags kyi ring bsrel/ sku gdung gi ring bsrel gdung rus sogs dang / sku bal gyi ring bsrel dbu skra na bza' sogs la gsungs pa dang bstun te 'god pa la/ steng 'og gi sku brnyan kun gyi nang du bzhugs pa bsdoms par gzungs 'jug rgyas bsdus cha 401

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas gsung 'thugatshang ba sum brgya dang bdun cu skor/ zur du gzungs sngags 'bum phrag du ma/ gdugs dkar sogs kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs/ mdo phran che chung bzhi bcu/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rgyun gyi gzigs dpe lam rim chen mo/ smon lam chos spyod brgya lhag bzhugs la/ spyir phyi rten du bkod pa'i gsung rab rnams kyang mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs su gtogs pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog cha tshang gnyis/ cung zad ma tshang ba kha shas/ gser 'bum gsum/ dngul 'bum bdun cu skor gyis gtsos pa'i 'bum cha tshang brgya dang gya lnga/ gser gyi brgyad stong ba bcu bdun sogs brgyad stong pa tshar nyis brgya dang lnga/ dkon brtsegs sum cu skor dang / phal chen bzhi bcur nye ba/ bskal bzang brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/ thar mdo nyis brgya sum cu skor/ rdor gcod stong dang dgu brgya lhag gzhan yang mdo rgyud sna tshogs kyi po ti stong phrag du ma sogs khyon bsdoms par gsung rab po ti khri phrag tsam bzhugs pa dang / 'khor lo'i nang du yig drug bye chen bdun tsam dang / ke ka ni/ yig brgya sogs gzungs sngags 'bum phrag du ma bzhugs pa thams cad kyang nang rten chos sku'i ring bsrel gyi khongs su gtogs so/ / yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel yang / sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung sprul pa'i dge slong a ka ra ma tis gdan drangs pa'i nang tshan dpal sde ba nas brgyud de gzhung sar bzhugs pa de las 'phel ba'i ring bsrel gcig bdag cag gi ston pa'i 'phelagadung ma skyes dgra'i skal ba gter du sbas pa mya ngan med kyis bton pa'i nang tshan bya sgong tsam zhig rgya nag tu phebs pa/ des 'gro mgon 'phags par phul zhing / phyis rgyal rtse dang bsam rtse sogs pa rgyud de gzhung sar bzhugs pa las 'phel ba rdog che ba gcig dang chung ba lnga/ jo bo rje'i 402

rnamadakar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga tha/'phel gdung gcig dga' ldan gser gdung chen mo nas babs pa'i 'phel gdung gcig mtshan byang mi gsal ba rten rnying khrod kyi 'phel gdung che chung gsum rnams bzhugs/ gzhan yang shā ri'i bu'i tshem las grub pa'i ril bu/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rus rgyan/ dpal nā ro pa'i rgyan drugam cig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshem gyi ril bu/ kha che paṇa chen gyi snam sbyar/srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs lham/ rje btsun mi la'i sgom thag phag mo gru pa'i dbu zhwa dang gzims phyid/ rje btsun grags pa'i phyag ting / sa paṇa gyi zhun thig las phebs pa'i 'jam dbyangs/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i spyan ra/ lho brag grub chen gyi tshems las grub pa'i ril bu/ chos rje don grub rinapo che'i phyag ḍam/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i na bza' dang dbu lo tshem las grub pa'i ril bu/ mkhas grub rje dang byams chen chos rje'i tshem gyi dum bu/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi zhun dzig mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i phyag rjes/ 'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor gyi snam sbyar/ rgyal bdage 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshem gyi cha shas/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku rags/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi tshem gyi dum bu/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i na bza' dang dbu lo/ / rgyal dbang lnga ba'i na bza' dang dbu skra rnams cha tshang ba min yang dum bu re 'am ril bur bsgril pa 'khrul med kho na yin pas byams chen mthong ba don ldan gyi gzungs 'jug skabs yang cha shas re phul yod/ da lta 'di 'dra'i rten 'dzoms che ba lag tu mi 'ong yang /sngar khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs pas dga' ldan gser gdung chen mo bzhengs skabs dang / phyis gzhung sa'i chos srid kyi 'dzin skyong gnang skabs phyag tu byung ba sa gsum na rnyed par dka' ba'i rten khyad 'phags kho na yinano/ / gsar du 'byor ba yang 'phel gdung bzhi/ jo bo rje'i phyag tshwa 403

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/gnyis/ smri ti'i phyag tshwa gcig rje rin po che'i phyag phreng rdog gcigarje'i phyag tshwa 'od dpag med kyi sku bzhi dang 'jigs byed kyi sku gcig rje'i sku 'od zer ma gcig 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i phyag tshwa gnyis/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs chag bubs/ de'i bur tshwa/ phyag rjes/paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi na bza'/ phyag tshwa kha shas/ phyag nas/rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i na bza'/ dbu lo/ gdung ras/ bur tshwa/ grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dol bu/ sku gzan zheng / rje btsun ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi na bza'/dbu skra/ mkhar sil gyi shing / dam rdzas ril bu/ gdung ras/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje'i na bza'/ skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbu lo bubs/ phyag phreng / sku gzan byed/ sku lcug shangs mtshal/ gdung ras/ bur tshwa/ phyag nas/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i gdung ras/thub kwan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gdung rus/ grub dbang blo bzang don grub pa'i dbu skra/ rtsang dbus kyi rten bsdus/ skye bdun/bdud rtsi/ gtsang chag rin chen sogs ril bu sne mang / lha sa'i jo bo'i zhal gser dang phyag dpar/ dga' ldan chos rgyal gyi na bza'/dga' ldan gyi 'jigs byed par ma/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku stong drug brgya/don zhags brgya dang lnga bcu/ mi la'i sku sum brgya sogs bla ma yi dam sangs rgyasakhyang sems nyan rang chos srung sogs kyi sku brnyan dpar ma dang bris ma nyis stong lnga brgya skor/ bal yul gyi ston pa'i bzhugs khri'i sa dang / stag mo lus sbyin gyi sa/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor dang ko ma sa la garnya'i sku dkar/ mtsho ma pho gi bye ma/ ra la'i za 'og phugs/ zhur mo'i gangs/bragadakar dbu ma rta so sogs mi la'i sgrub phugs rnams kye sa sna/ g.ya' 404

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/bzang / ri bo mdangs can/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ pha bong kha/ rwa sgreng / yer ba sogs kyi gnas sa/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi rtsa/ ri bo rtse lnga'i rdo'i ril bu dang kun bzang / sku 'bum gyi tsan dan/ dmar tshad dan tig yang tig lo kya tun sogs kyi gnas rdos mtshon pa'i rgya bod kyi byin rten dang sa sna sogs cha shas re ma tshang ba med pa lta bu yin no/ / de yang shod khang mtha' skor gye g.yab dang bcas pa seng khri'i khungs dang / de'i steng gi thog so gnyis la sked par gleb pa'i so phag gi pu shus bskor ba bang rim bzhi dge bcu dang bcas pa'i rnam pa/ de steng bum gdan la bum pa nang du ka ba bzhi dpangs thog so gcig gi tshad/ de steng bre yan chod thog so gnyis lhag tsam ste dpangs thog so drug brgal ba dang / rgya khyon seng khri'i mthar ngos re la ka bar dgu re 'byung bas/ da lta yongs grags kyi mchod rten chung ngu rnams dang tshad mi mtshungs kyang skyon med de/ sku gzugs kyi cha tshad tā ra nā thas mdzad pa las/ mchod rten la cha tshad nges pa can gsung ba nyung zhing /sku gzugs la mdo rgyud gnyis ka nan tan du gsungs pas/ gnas skabs phal cher du tshad dang mi 'gal ba la nan tan du bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku brnyan ni gang bzhengs rgyu'i sku de dang rnam pa mthun dgos pas tshad las 'das na nyes dmigs che bar sdom 'byung sogs las yang yang gsungs kyang / mchod rten ni nang gi spangs rtogs sogs mtshon byed tsam las de dang dbyebs bstun rgyu med pas snga ma dang mi 'dra bar ma zad/ dus kyi 'khor lo las mgrin thung mchod rten/ dri med 'grel pa'i mgrin ring mchod rten bshad pa shin tu mi 'dra la/ bu ston dang stag lo/ brag nag pa/sprul sku 'phrang kha sogs kyis gsungs pa rnams kyang rigs pas dpyad de mdzes btsal bas rgya dpangs sogs mi 'dra ba kho nar 'byung / grags che 405

༄/ /yo thang bayo yo sa'i gatshi lam/bar mchod rten gyi dpangs la rgya nyis 'gyur lta bu byed kyang / shin tu che ba rnams de ltar byas tshe mi brtan pas/ dpangs la rgya'i phyed du byas kyang chog ste/ stag lo'i dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las/ rgyar dpag tshad tsam la 'phangs sude byed pa bshad pa/ zhes pa nas/ rgya ches grags pas 'phang du de'i phyed las slong mi thub pa la dgongs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / der ma zad sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten chen mo phal cher yang dpangs tshad las rgyar che ba sha stag yin te/ dper na shrī dha na ka ṭa ga'am/dpal ldan 'bras spung gi mchod rten yang rgyar ngos re la dus 'khor lugs kyi rgyang grags bcu ste 'dom khri phrag re yod kyang / dpangs sngon rgyal po ba la mi tras ras yug 'dom bzhi brgya pa zhig rtse mo nas brkyangs pa bang rim steng ma'ikhar sleb par bshad pas/ rgya khyon gyi khungs su song ba'i shul nas de yan gye dpangs la 'dom brgya skor lhag mi lus pa'i tshod du snang ste/ de'i 'dra bshus la bu ston gyis zhal byang btab pa las/ rgya che zhing dbangs mi mtho ba rtse nas ras yug 'dom bzhi brgya yod pa brkyangs pas bang rim gong ma la sleb pa tsam bzhugs/ zhes pa ltar te/ gzhan yang bya rung kha shor/rgyal rtse'i mchod rten chen mo sogs dpangs las rgya che ba'i khungs thub mang ngo / /de bzhin du bum pa yang yongs grags stod che la smad phra bar byed kyang /stag los/ sa la bzhengs na bum pa dang bre gdong bskyung zhing gzhan rnams bskyed/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'di 'dra la dmigs bsal gyis de mi dgos shing / gzhung gzhan las dril bu'i cung gang lta bur gsungs pas/da lta bka' gdams gdung rten du grags pa thams cad kyang dbyibs de ltar 'byung ngo / / gal te tshad dbyibs gcig kho nar ma byas kyang nyes par mi 'gyur na chag tshad bshad pa dgos med du 'gyur ro snyam na ma yin te/ de 406

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga ra/nigazhan gyi dgag bya dgos pa sogs med tshe chag tshad cig la ma brten na rtog bzo kho na mched bas skabs shig nas rnam pa ci yang min pa zhig tu 'gro ba 'gog pa'i ched yin no/ / tshad kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa yod phyin de dang ma mthun pa nyes pa kho nar 'gyur na/ yi ge la yang rdzab chen rdzab chung /'bru chen 'bru chung / nang gses kyi li lugs/ ldan lugs sogs kyi mtshan nyid so sor bshad pa mang zhing / khyad par rtsa ba lta bu rdzab chen gyi rnam bzhag thu mi'i dgongs pa ska pa dpal brtsegs kyi lugs bzhin khyung po g.yu khris thig ris su btab pa sum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyis dar rgyas su byas pa ltar/ mchos nyer gcig bu chos bcu drug spyi chos gsum/gces so brgyad/ yi ge rang rang la sgos kyi thig 'debs lugs sogs mang yang deng sang de ji lta ba bzhin byas pa mi srid na'ang / gsung rab bzhengs pa dgag bya med pa bzhin no/ / yang mchod rten 'di gong du mchod rten gyi dbyeb mang du bshad pa de las gang du gtogs snyam na/ khang bu brtsegs pa'amagacan yang can du grags pa de nyid yin no/ / mchod rten brgyad kyi nanganas gang du gtogs she na/ dus 'khor ṭīka chen gyi kha skong zhang zhung pas mdzad pa'i ye shes le'ur/ spyir mchod rten gyi dbye ba mtha' yas pas de brgyad gang rung du 'du ba'i nges pa med kyang / khyad chos phyogs mthun re'i sgo nas gang yang rung bar bsdus chog par gsungs pa ltar na 'di la glo 'bur dang zem skas pad spungs sogs med pas gzhan du dogs pa mi dgos shing / 'di'i bang rim la sgo kha shas yod kyang bang rim bzhi gar cha mnyam du med pas byang chub chen por gtogs pa byas na legs so/ / zhes bya ba ni gsum pa rten ba stor bzhugs pa'i mtshan byang gi skabs so/ /bzhi pa rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon brjod pa la/ de yang dpal ldan 407

༄/ /yo ca bayo yozla sa'i yitshi 'bum/zla bas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ / thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid zhi'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag sgol ba'i mgon skyabs gcig pur gyur pa ni dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum las gzhan na med pas/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis de nyid gtsug rgyan du bzung nas bkur ste rim gro bya dgos te/ chos thams cad kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ / dkon mchog gsum po ma gtogs pa/ / yon gyi gnas 'ga' yod ma yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /bkur ste bya ba'i tshul yang ston pa bzhugs pa'i dus nas mdzad pa khyad par can gang bstan pa'i sa der mchod rten brtsigs nas de la phyag mchod sogs kyi dge ba rlabs po che bsgrub pa'i srol bzang byung ba bzhin/ rab mchod rten dang / tha na sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i thabs kyi mtshon byed ci rigs byas pas rang gzhan gyi don mchog tu 'gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ lam po che'i bzhi mdo skye bo mang po 'du ba'i sar mchod rten dang khang pa brtsegs pa'am/ rdo ba'i ka ba'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rjes su dran pa gang yang rung ba byed de/ zhes spyir bstan nas/ 'di lta ste dper na/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'am/ mngon par 'byung ba'am/ byang chub kyi shing drung du bdud 'joms pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i cho 'phrul chen po'am/de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po yang dag pa rab bstan pa'am/ lha las babs pa'am/ lha yul du mngon par 'dzegs par byed pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brtsigs par byed pa yin zhes mchod rten gtso bor gsungs/ khyad par du mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/rten dang brten pa legs bskrun dang / / dge 'dun gnas mal bca' ba 408

rnam dkar layol skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga ོ/sogs/ / dge nas dge bar rtag tu 'gyur/ / bskal ba bye ba stong du yang / / dge ba yongs su chud mi za/ zhes brten pa sku gzugs sogs dang rten khang ba/ de'i yo byad sogs gang bsgrub kyang phan yon mtha' yas pa 'byung bar gsungs la/ 'di ni lung zhu ba'i 'grel pa dge legs bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa las/ mchod rten de nyid gnas yin te/ bsod nams mtha' yas pa 'du ba'i sgo rgyas par byed pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes dang / khyad par du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mchod rten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / bzhugs gnas pho brang yin par bshad/ces pa spyi don du bshad pa ltar/ rten du 'gro bar ma zad dngos su yang rten lha khang dang / nang du sku gsung thugs rten/ phyi dbyibs mchod rten gyi rnam par yod pa kun gyi sgo nas rten dang brten pa thams cad bzhengs par yang 'gro bas/ de'i phan yon ni me tog brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ste sems dang bas mchod pa dang / gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam la mchod pa byed pa ni rnam par smin pa mnyam par shes par bya ste/bye brag gam tha dad med do/ / zhes dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/gang la la zhig bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / da lta bzhugs pa la mchod pa byed pa de'i phan yon rnams ni mtshungs/ mnyam zhing 'dra'o zhes nga 'chad do/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni chos kyi sku'i rab tu phye ba yin gyi/ gzugs kyi sku'i rab tu phye ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes sangs rgyas dngos su mchod pa dang khyad par med par gsungs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis a bhya ka ras thub pa dgongs rgyan las/'dir sangs rgyas ni gnyis te/ don dam pa ni sgu gsum gyis yang dag par 409

༄/ /yo thang bayo rsāsgronama' ga g.yo/bsdus pa'o/ / tha snyad pa ni sku gdung gi mchod rten dang sku gzugs dang /zhes pa nas/ mnyam par sems rab tu dwangs pa'i rnam par smin pa mnyam par gsungs so/ / zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas/sku 'dra dang sku gdung de min kyang mchod sogs sangs rgyas dang mnyam pas sangs rgyas kyi tha snyad byas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de ltar na nyan rang dgra bcom sogs la bsnyen bkur ba lta bu'i dge rtsa thams cad las 'di nyid ches khyad par du 'phags te/ rmad du byung ba'i mdo las/ 'dzam bu'i gling dpag tshad bdun stong yod pa dang / lus 'phags pa'i gling dpag tshad brgyad stong yod pa dang / ba lang spyod dpag tshad dgu stong pa dang /sgra mi snyan dpag tshad stong phrag bcu pa dang / lha'i dbang po'i khang bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal byed rnams rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin du byas te/ dad pas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / phyir mi 'ong ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dang /phyogs bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun la phul ba bas/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs su mya ngan —las 'das pa'i mchod rten 'jim pa las skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam byas la/ khab tsam gye srog shing btsugs te/ rgya shug gi lo ma tsam gyi gdugs gsol nas/nas 'bru tsam gyi sku gzugs byas la/ yungs 'bru tsam gyi ring bsrel bcug na de ni de bas bsod nams che'o zhes nga smra'o/ / zhes dang / sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa las kyang / stong gsum gang ba'i dgra bcom pa rnams kyi bcings pa bkrol te bsnyen bkur babs/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel kyi phyir mchod rten brtsigs pa bsod nams mang bar gsungs/ las rnam par 410

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/'byed pa'i mdor rgyal po'i rigs su skye ba nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar gyi phan yon bco brgyad gsungs la/ gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa las/ thub pa'i dbang po'i mchod rten bzhengs pa yis/ / mya ngan rnam bsal lus kun rgyas pa dang / / gtso bor gyur pa rin chen mdzod mang dang / / sa steng dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur/ zhes sogs gnas skabs kyi phan yon du ma dang / dkon mchog ta la las/ gzugab rnams sbyong ba'i 'od zer rnam gtong zhing / / mi dbang rnams kyis bsam yas sku mthong ste/ / sku gzugs ri mo sna tshogs mang po dang / / mchod rten byas pas gzugs sbyong 'od 'grub po/ / zhes gzugs sku 'grub pa'i mthar thug gi phan yon bstan la/mdor na gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ / sku gzugs rnam pa brdul phran ci song ba/ / de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyes/ / lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid 'thob/ /gzugs dang gzugs med khams kyi ting nge 'dzin/ / phun sum tshogs pa'i sa mchog kun myang nas/ / tha mar skye dang rga la sogs pa yi/ / sdug bsngal med pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob/ / ces gsungs pa bzhin/ mchod rten rdzogs par bzhengs pa dang de'i grogs byed pa rnams la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par ma zad/ de'i nang du 'jim gong tsam zhig 'jog pa yang phan yon shin tu che ba'i tshul/ lung gzhi las/ gang zhig rab dwangs sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ / mchod rten la ni 'jim gong 'jog byed na/ / dzaspu chu bo'i gser gyi gar bu ni/ / stong phrag brgyas kyang de dang mnyam pa min/ / zhes gsungs la/ der ma zad dam chos pad dkar las/ byes pas rtsed mos de dang de dag tu/ / gang gi rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dang / / bye ma las ni phung po byas pa yang / / de rnams 411

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i sgoname'i gatshi 4ma/kyis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur/ zhes dang / 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa las/ gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i phyir bzhad gad dam/ ku re'am byis pa'i kyal ga'am/rtsed mor byed pas 'jim pa las mchod rten byed na/ de dag thams cad sdug bsngal mthar byas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ zhes rtsed mo tshun chad la mchod rten gyi rnam pa bzhengs pa yang zhing gi mthus thar pa'i rgyur 'gro bar gsungs na/dad pa'i kun slong rnam dag gi sgo nas de'i bya ba la brtson pa lta ci smos te/slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ gtsug lag khang gi don du ni/ / tshig gis rab tu bskul ba dang / / tshogs pa yi ni grogs byed cing / / nges par kun tu 'gro byed pa/ / gnyid log pa'am langs pa na/ / bsod nams rgyun ni tshad med 'phel/ / zhes gsungs shing / tha na rten bzhengs pa de'i bza' btung gi cha byad bsgrub pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis rkang 'og tu shi ba'i 'bu srinaphra mo tshun chad kyang 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur ba'i tshul/ paṇḍi ta nags kye rin chen gyi gsung rgyal dbang bdun pas rten de ba tu drangs pa las/sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs pa'i dri gtsang khang dang gtsug lag khang dang gnas ma la bzhengs pa lta ci smos/ tha na de rnams kyi sgo khyams dang /g.yos mal byed pa'i khang phran tsam bzhes pa'i ched du gom pa bdun brgyab na yang ngan song du mi 'gro zhing lha lus 'thob po/ / dkon mchog gsum bzhugs pa'i gnas gzhi bzo ba de la dmigs pa'i bza' btung gi sbyor ba'i du ba phog pa'i sems can dang / las mi'i rkang 'og tu srog chags shi ba rnams kyang ngan song gsum gyi gnas su mi lhung / pha la pha la/ zhes gsungs pa yang rgyal ba'i bka' tshad mar gyur pa'i khungs dang ldan pa gzhir 412

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/bcas shing / 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin pas phal ba'i blor shong dka' yang don bslu ba med de/ dper na khyim bdag dpal skyes sngon srin bur skyes pa chus khyer te mchod rten la skor ba zhig byasapas thar pa'i sa bon bzhag nas ston pa'i drung du dgra bcom thob par lung las gsus pa bzhin no/ / sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i phan yon yang phal cher mchod rten dang phyogs mtshungs lta bur gsungs mod/ 'on kyang sgos chosakhyad par ba du ma yod pas zur tsam smos na/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ sngags pa las ni dang po pas/ / gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste/ / bris sku sgrub na myur bar ni/ / dngos grub rgya chen thob par 'gyur/zhes ting 'dzin sgrub pa'i dmigs rten du bsngags shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi le'u las/ gal te mtshams med pa lnga byas su zin kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa rnyed de sku gzugs byas na/las des sems can dmyal ba myong ba chung ngu myong ste zeg pa gsum gang yang rung bas nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes sogs kyis sdig ltung 'dag padang / dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bcu dang ldanan/ mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par skye'o/ / bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang / mchod rten zhig pa gso ba dang / pha ma la lus kyis rim gro byed pa dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon la lus kyis rim gro byed pa dang / zhes sogs kyis mngal du mi skye bar gsungs pas mtshon te skye sgo dman pa thams cad khegs par 'gyur ba dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'dren pa'i gzugs sku rab tu mdzes byas na/ / de ni mchog gyur skyes bu mang mchod 'os/ / blo ldan phyug cing che nyid rgya cher ldan/ / dbang ldan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 413

༄/ /yo thang b.lo pa'i sgoname'i ga4 'bum/'gyur/ / zhes sogs gnas skabs kyi phan yon du ma gsungs la/ gtso bor gyur pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ de bzhin gser dag dang ni dnguladag dang / / tsardo gyis ni sku gzugs bzang po dag / mdzes shing shin tu lta na sdug pa gyis/ / ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'thob/ / 'jim pa dang ni de bzhin rdo ba dang / / shing dang ri mor bris pa'i sku gzugs dag / shin tu mdzes shing lta na sdug par bgyis/ / ring por mi thogs ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'thob/ / ces myur du yang dag pa'i lam bzang mngon du 'gyur ba dang / don rnam par nges pa'i mdor/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sred med kyi bu chen po lta bur kun tu mdzes pa 'di ni sngon de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byas pa dang / mchod rten zhig pa bcos pa dang / gzhan dag 'jigs pa dbugs dbyung ba byas pas 'grub/ces mthar thug rgyal ba'i gzugs sku 'grub pas zeg dman gyi dge rtsa kun las lhag pa yang / dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sangs rgyas dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa bas/ 'jam dpal/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang zhig sangs rgyas kye sku gzugs cig ri mor bris pa 'di ni bsod nams grangs med pa bskyed do/ / zhes yul sangs rgyas la brten pa'i dge ba ni ngo bo che chung gang yin kyang 'bras bu zad pa med pa'i bla med byang chub kyi rgyu kho nar 'gro bar gsungs te/ dam chos padma dkar po'i thabs mkhas pa'i le'u gnyis pa las kyang / gang gi rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag / bsod nams rgyal mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku/ / bdag gis bris sam 'bre ru bcug kyang rung / / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / zhes 414

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/bsam pa thag pas bzhengs pa dang / der ma zad/ gang dag de la de ni slob pa'i tshe/ / rtsed mo dag dang gsar ba byed pa na/ / rtsig ngos sen mos shing bus gzugs bris pa/ / de dag thams cad byang chub thob par 'gyur/ / zhes rtsed mo tshun chod du byas na yang byang chub kyi sa bon bskrun pa ni mthong thos dran reg don ldan du 'gyur ba'i smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / smon gnas mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi byed pa bla na med pa yin no/ / gzhan yang phan yon mtha' yas pa'i tshul mkhas mchog dpa' bo'i sku gzugs kyi gtam sogs las 'byung yang ma spros so/ / de nas gsung rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon yang mdo rgyud rang rang gi nang du de nyid bri klog 'dzin cing chub pa dang / don sems pa'i phan yon mi 'dra bar gsungs pa smos kyis mi lang la/ cha shas tsam mtshon na/ rgyal ba byams pas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / / nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / / 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / / de sems pa dang bsgom pa ste/ / spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ / bsod nams phung po gzhal du med/ / ces chos spyod bcu'i bsod nams gzhal du med par gsungs pa'i rtsa ba 'di la rag las shing / gzhan yang gnas skabs kyi dbang du byas na/rdo rje snying po'i gzungs kyi mdo las/ yi ger 'bri ba dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston pa de la tshe 'di la yon tan ji snyed cig mchis par 'tshal bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ de la lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams bsrung bar shes par bya'o/ / de chos thams cad la ze tshom med par shes par bya'o/ / zhes dang / dkon mchog ta la las / chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'bri ba de ni mig na bar mi 'gyur/ zhes sogs mthong ba'i chos las nad gdon sogs kyi nyer 'tshe 415

༄/ /yo thang b.lo pa'isgroname'i ga4 la /zhi ba dang / sgo mtha' yas par sgrub pa'i gzungs las/ bla med byang chub la reg bar du yang / / de ni ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes dang / /gzungs rnams dang ni gzugs dang longs spyod dang / / sangs rgyas mthong las nyams par yong mi 'gyur/ / zhes tshe rabs kun tu rten bzang rnam par dag pa thob cing / sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral bas gzungs spobs sogs kyi yon tan thams cad bde blag tu thob par gsungs la/ mdor na gzungs de nyid las/ mdo sde thos nas rjes su yi rang dang / / yi ger bris dang gzung dang bklags pa yi/ / bsod nams phung po ji tsam bskyed pa ni/ / sems can kun gyis shes par yong mi nus/ / de ni tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba mthong / / de dag la yang dad pa bsam yas rnyed/ / mdo sde zab mo'i tshul yang shes par 'gyur/ / de ni myur du byang chub mchog 'tshang rgya/ /zhes mthar thug mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar gyi phan yon tshad med pa 'byung bar gsungs so/ / khyad par du theg pa chen po'i sde snod rnams ni rigs can gsum gyes bsdus pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas yin pasade la brten pa'i bsod nams ni gzhan gyi dge rtsa thams cad las khyad par du 'phags te/ sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na/ / sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom gyes btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te/ / sems can mchog la bklags byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ / zhes dang / 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa las/ dzasbu'i gling gi sems can thams cad 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la 'jog cing /bzhag nas kyang lha'i lo stong du yo byad thams cad kyis mchod pa pas/ gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di las tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 416

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/yang nyan pa dang / 'chang pa dang / 'bri ba dang / 'brir 'jug pa dang /gzhan la rgyas par byed na 'di ches bsod nams mang du 'phel lo/ / zhes gsungs te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang / spyod 'jug las/ sems can khams ni tshad med la/ / phan 'dod de ni de 'dra'o/ / zhes pa ltar/ dmigs pa dang ched du bya ba thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pas/ phan yon yang de ltar 'byung ngo / / tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas zeg pa chen po'i mdo rgyud de dag cha tshang ba lta zhog nang gi mtshan re re 'dzin pa la yang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ming tsam la rtogs pa gang lags pa de yang bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur na/ yi ger 'bri ba dang / gos dang rgyan gyi mchod pa chen po dag gis mchod pa bgyid pa dang / yi ger 'drir rtsol pa lta ci smos/ zhes dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin shrī te ru ga'i/ / mtshan gyis sdig pa 'jig par 'gyur/ / bsam gtan bsam pa tsam gyis sam/ / klog cing kha ton bris pa yis/ / mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur la/ / yang na 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'thob/ / ces sogs gzungs dang mtshan gyi phan yon bstan pa shin tu mang ngo / / phan yon de ltar gsungs pa sngon gyi dus bzang po la dgongs kyi/ snyigs dus de ltar mi 'ong snyam na shin tu mi rigs te/ snying rje pad dkar las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus lnga brgya pa na/ tha na bris te 'chang bar byed na/ de bsod nams ches mang du bskyed par 'gyur gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bskal pa chen po bcu'i bar du pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni de lta ma yin no/ / zhes snyigs ma'i dus tshul khrims sna re bsrung pa/ thos bsam sna re byas pa tshun tshad lhag 417

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgronas khru/ nga 4ma/par phan yon che bar gsungs pas/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes kyi myur lam du las stobs che chung gsungs pa'i tshe dus kyi stobs zhes bsnan nas gsungs ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no/ / zhes bya ba ni bzhi pa rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon gyi skabs so/ /lnga pa rten la phyag mchod byas pa'i phan yon bshad pa la/ sa'i snying bo 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ 'jig rten dag na bde zhing skyid pa/ / de kun dkon mchog mchod las 'byung bas/ / de bas bde zhing skyid pa 'dod pas/ / dkon mchog mchod la rtag tu brtson bya/ / zhes spyir srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad dkon mchog mchod pa'i 'bras bur gsungs la/khyad par du mchod pa'i bye brag mi 'dra ba du mas bsnyen bkur pa las phan yon rnam pa tha dad pa so sor 'gyur ba'i tshul/ rnam 'dren stobs bcu mnga' ba nyid kyis tshangs pa'i dbyangs su bsgrags pa ni 'di ltar/ rgyal po gsal rgyal la gdams pa las/ mchod rten mchog la gdugs brtsegs phul ba yis/ / lha dang mi yi nang du skye ba dang / / sred med bu yi lus 'dra lus kun brtan/ / bkur sti byas pa'i yon tan ldan par 'gyur/ / thub dbang mchod rten rdo thal byugs pa yis/ / lha mi'i 'jig rten dag na tshe ring zhing / / lus sems nad dang mya ngan me spangs te/ / rtag tu skyid cing nor gyis phyug par 'gyur/ / gser dngul spa ba'i gleg mas g.yogs pa yi/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i mchod rten byas pa yis/ / mi rnams srid pa'i khyad par gzhan dag tu/ / lus mkhregs 'od kyang 'bar zhing mdzes par 'gyur/ /su dag la la mchod rten sku gzugs la/ / dad pa'i sems kyis bla re 'bul byed pa/ / de dag sa steng rgya mtsho'i mtha' klas pa/ / ma lus gnon byed rgyal gcig dbang byed 'gyur/ / bde gshegs mchod rten dag la dga' 418

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/bzhin du/ / rnam mang rgya chen gdugs ni btags pa yis/ / lha mi'i 'jig rten dag na gdugs 'dra bar/ / lha dang mi yi dbang po lta bur 'gyur/ /mi rnams su dag sku gdung snyeng po can/ / dri med bsod nams 'byung gnas gyur pa la/ / ba dan mdzes pa sna tshogs 'dogs pa dag/ mthu dang ldan zhing srid gsum mchod gnas 'gyur/ / bde gshegs mchod rten cod paṇa btags pa yis/ / mi dbang dpal dang lha dbang dpal thob cing bde ba'i mchog kyang nyams su myong gyur nas/ / rnam par grol ba'i cod pan khyad par 'thob/ / rgyal ba'i mchod rten dag la dri phul bas/ / tshig btsan grags pa chen po dag dang ldan/ / tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs yid 'ong skye ba dran/ / de dag gis ni rgyan rnams sna tshogs 'thob/ / mkhas pa su dag bde gshegs mchod rten la/ / dad pa'i sems kyis phreng ba 'dogs byed pa/ /gser phreng rin chen mang pos legs spras pa/ / bsod nams las ldan de yi mgo la thogs/ / ston pa'i mchod rten dag la rgyan 'phreng 'dogs/ / de dag do shal rgyan ldan nor bu dang / / gdu bu dag dang dpung rgyan mchog rnams kyis/ / lus brgyan 'jig rten dag na rgyu bar 'gyur/ / su dag bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten la/ / sa dang lce bas nyug pa de dag ni/ / lha dang mir skye lus mdog sdug pa dang / / rnam dag rma med bde dang ldan par 'gyur/ / thub dbang mchod rten byi dor byas pa yis/ / shin tu lta na sdug cing mig tu mdzes/ / byad bzhin bzang zhing padma'i mdog dang ldan/ /srid pa'i skyon rnams dang yang bral bar 'gyur/ / su dag spos mchog spar ba'i 'bru mar gyis/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten nyug byed pa/ / de dag spos kyis mchod cing tsardon gyis/ / lus byugs nyi ma'i 'od dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ / mi rnams gang dag thub dbang mchod rten la/ / spos chu 419

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'irsāske khrung ཿma/dwangs shing gtsang bas khrus gsol ba/ / de dag lus la dri ma med pa dang / / gdung ba med cing mdog 'jam mya ngan med/ / su zhig sangs rgyas mchod rten sku gzugs khang / / tshon rtsi sna tshogs rnams kyis mdzes byed pa/ / de ni bde gshegs mnga' ba'i yon tan rnams/ / sna tshogs ldan pa kun gyis brtsegs par 'gyur/ / zhes dang / las rnam par 'byed pa'i mdor/ bram ze'i khye'u ne tso la bka' bstsal pa/ bram ze'i khye'u de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la thal mo sbyar pa'i phan yon bcu 'di dag ste/bcu gang zhe na/ rgyal po chen po'i khyim du skye ba 'thob pa dang / rgya che ba'i gzugs dang / rgya che ba'i g.yog 'khor dang / rgya che ba'i mchod pa dang bkur ste dang / rgya che ba'i nor dang / rgya che ba'i thos pa dang / rgya che ba'i dad pa dang / rgya che ba'i dran pa dang / rgya che ba'i shes rab dang /rgya che ba'i rtogs pa 'thob ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la thal mo sbyar ba'i phan yon no/ / phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ gzugs bzang la mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bur 'gyur ba dang /mdzes shing mig tu sdug par 'gyur ba dang / skad snyan zhing smra ba snyan par bzung ba'i tshig tu 'gyur ba dang / bag tsha ba med par 'khor gyi nang du 'gro ba dang / lha dang mi rnams dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / gzi brjid chen por 'gyur ba dang / gang zag ni 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos rnams dang 'grogs par 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon no/ / phyag dar byas pa'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang 420

rnam dkar la4la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/zhe na/ gzugs bzang ba dang / blta na sdug par 'gyur ba dang /mdzes par 'gyur ba dang / skad snyan par 'gyur ba dang / de'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug srab par 'gyur pa dang / lam du 'gro na rtswa dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo rnams med par 'gyur ba dang / btsun pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang /mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag dar byas pa'i phan yon no/ / me tog phul ba'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'jig rten na me tog lta bur 'gyur ba dang / sna'i dbang po nam yang nyams par mi 'gyur pa dang / lus kyi dri nga ba rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang /dri zhim po 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su de'i tshul khrims kyi dri ngad ldang bar 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi sa mngon du 'gro bar 'gyur ba dang / sdug pa'i chos rnams thob par 'gyur ba dang /longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang /myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la me tog phul ba'i phan yon no/ / mar me phul ba'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'jig rten na mar me lta bur 'gyur ba dang /sha'i mig rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / lha'i mig 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / dge ba dang mi dge ba'i chos rnams la shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / ma rig pa dang gti mug gi mun pa sel ba dang / shes rab kyi snang ba thob par 'gyur ba dang / de 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe nam du yang mun pa na gnas par mi 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang /mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba 421

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'byam/ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mar me phul ba'i phan yon no/ / spos phul pa'i phan yon bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'jig rten na spos lta bur 'gyur ba dang / sna'i dbang po rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / lus kyi dri mi zhim pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / rtag tu dri zhim par 'gyur ba dang / gzugs bzang bar 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten gyi sa mngon du 'gro bar bya bar 'gyur ba dang / longs spyod che bar 'gyur ba dang / mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / sdug pa'i chos rnams thob par 'gyur ba dang / myur du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la spos phul ba'i phan yon no/ /zhes sogs mchod pa'i khyad par rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i lag rjes 'grub tshul so sor gsungs la/ thun mong du bstan pa yang / 'phags pa byams pa'i mdo las/ mar me stong phrag gcig gam/ me tog phul ba stong phrag gcig gam/ utpal sngon po stong phrag gcig gis mchod pa byed pa dang /mchod rten de dag gi tog byed pa dang sku gzugs byed pa de dag ni byams pa sangs rgyas pa de'i tshe de'i drung du skye zhing dang po'i chos thob par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa nas/ me tog snyem gang tsam mam/ mar me gcig tsam 'bul pa'am/ gzhan dag bsod nams byed pa la rjes su yi rang pa ste/dge ba 'di dag byed pa'i lha dang mi rnams kyis yang ngag par dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes bstan pa 'di la de lta bu'i dge rtsa bsgrubs pa rnams skabs 'dir ma grol yang / byams pa'i 'khor gyi thog mar skyes nas smin cing grol bar gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ spos dang dri dang byug pa yis/ / mchod bya bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / / rnam pa sna tshogs gos mchog dang / / gzhan yang nor 422
