rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/bu'i gdub kor rgyan/ / rnam pa sna tshogs bca' dang bza'/ / yang dag sbyar pa dbul bar bya/ / rnam pa sna tshogs phun sum tshogs/ / ci 'dod kha zas byas pa la/ / de bzhin sngags ni bzlas byas dbul/ / sems can dge ba'i skye gnas 'gyur/ / dam pa'i 'gro ba'i skye gnas su/ / grong mchog dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ / mthar ni byang chub gzhol 'gyur zhing / / phyis ni zhi bar yang dag 'gro/ zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ gser dang rin chen dra ba dag/ nyid kyis mchod rten rnams la thogs/ / gser dang dngul gyi me tog dang / / rdo rje byu ru mu tig dag / aṇḍa rnyil dang beeḍūrya/ / mthon ka chen pos mchod rten mchod/ / ces dang / yang de nyid las/ mchod rten mar me phreng ba dang / / mun khang dag tu sgon me dang / / mar me 'bru mar byin pa yis/ / lha yi mig ni thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten mchod par rol mo dang / / dril bu dag ni phul ba dang / / dung dang rnga ni rab phul bas/ / lha yi rna ba thob par 'gyur/ zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas gsungs pa bsam gyes mi khyab la/ khyad par dwangs shing bsil ba'i yon chab gtsang ma phul na shes rgyud kyi sdig ltung sbyangs te sa lam gye rtogs pa skye ba'i dgos pa che zhing bsgrub sla la/ ser sna sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'jug pas bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gtso bor mdzad/ de bzhin du khrus gsol byed pa yang dkor dang las sgrib sogs kyis shes rgyud rnyog pa'i dbang gis nyams len tshul bzhin mi 'ong ba sel ba'i thabs la mchog tu bsngags te/ dpal ldan dpa' pos/ khrus gsol gang zhig mchod byed na/ / de dag rnyog pa thams cad kyi/ / dri ma bkrus nas thar pa 'thob/ /ces dang / gsal rgyal gyi mdo las/ mi rnams gang dag thub dbang mchod rten la/ / spos chu gtsang zhing dwangs pas khrus gsol ba/ / de dag 423

༄/ /gung ca bstanaba'i ryā ga4 las/lus la dri ma med pa dang / / gdung ba med cing mdog 'jam mya ngan med/ / ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / de bzhin du spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa la/ / dar gyi dbul ba phul byas nas/ / lha yi dag dang mi rnams kyi/ / don rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes snyan shal dang / za ma tog lta bu'i gtam las/ maṇḍal me tog bcas byed pa/ / 'gro ba'i bdag po tshe ring zhing / / sna tshogs nad kye 'jigs las sgrol/ / gang yin de yis skad cig 'thob/ / bde gshegs maṇḍal byed de dag / pha rol phyin drug thob 'gyur te/ / chu dang sa bsres btang sbyin pa/ / grog ma sogs sel tshul khrims te/ / bsres nas nyed pa bzod pa yin/ / 'bad pa byed pa brtson 'grus yin/ / skad cig de la rtse gcig tu/ / sems 'dzin byed pa bsam gtan yin/ / legs par gzob pa shes rab po/ / zhes maṇḍal phul ba'i phan yon bshad la/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ zhing 'di rin chen zhes sogs dang / spyod 'jug las/nam mkha' ra byams zhes sogs kun gyis bstan cing / bla ma lnga bcu par dus drug tu 'bul dgos par gsungs pa sogs shin tu mang / khyad par du mar me 'bul ba ni tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can yin pas/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u gnyis par/gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ / mar me brgya ni dbul bar bya/ / zhes dang / de'i 'og tu yang / gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ / dri dang me tog de bzhin spos/ / cho ga bzhin du de bzhin mchod/ / mar me brgya yang 'bul bya zhing / / zhes mar me brgya snga phyir lan gnyis gsungs pa phyi nang gi khyad dam/ mar me gtso che ba'i don du sbas don kun gsal las gsungs te/ da lta brgya mchod du grags pa yang khungs 'di 'dra la brten 424

rnam dkar lalol skul byed dkar chag rsā rnga ོ/par mngon no/ / de dag gis mtshon te gdugs rgyan bla bre ba dan rnga yab dril bu bdug spos zhal zas la sogs pa phul ba dang / de'i steng gi brgya bsal ba/ zhig ral bcos pa/ phyag dar byas pa/ rdo thal byugs pa/chag chag btab pa sogs so so'i rnam smin 'byin tshul zhib tu shes par 'dod na spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo/ gsal rgyal gyi mdo dkon mchog ta la sogs su blta'o/ / phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon bcu gong du bshad pa de yin la/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong dag dge slong 'dis 'di ltar skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la yan lag thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal te sems dang bar byed pa la ltos/ btsun pa de lta lags so/ / dge slong dgadage slong 'dis sa ji tsam non pa'i 'og dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong na gser gyi 'khor lo la thug gi bar na bye ma ji snyed yod pa de snyed du/ dge slong 'dis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid stong 'gyur du longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / sman mdo brgyad brgya ba las/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla baiḍūrya'i 'od de la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa sna tshogs byed na/ de dag ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal med par shes par bya'o/ / zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ / 'on kyang phan yon mdo rgyud nas bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin 'byung ba la phyag 'tshal tshul gyi kun slong kun spyod tshul ldan dgos shing / de yang mdo sde rnams su sdong po rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin lus thams cad sa la phab ste phyag bya bar gsungs pa da lta'i brkyang phyag tu grags pa 'di yin pas/ de byung na mchog dang / yang na mdortsa ba las/ phyag ni rnam pa gnyis te/ yan lag lngas phyag btsal ba dang / sgyid pa la 'khyud pas btsal ba'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyi ma bod 'dir cher ma dar kyang / snga ma byed pa la lag pa'i mthil gnyis/ pus 425

༄/ /༅ ca bstan pa'isgronama'i khrung 'cha/mo'i lha nga gnyis/ dpral ba ste lnga ka sa la reg pa dgos pas/ phyag gcig btsal na yang gnad du 'gro nges shig gal che/ de yang rnam smin rgya che chung dang / dus myur bul shin tu mi 'dra ba ma gtogs/ zhing gi mthu la brten pa'i stobs kyis gus pa'i rnam 'gyur cung zad tsam zhig byas pa dang / ngag nas g.yam la rgyug pa lta bus phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod pa tshun chad kyis shes rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag nas 'khor ba mtha' can du byed pa yin te/mdo sde pad dkar las/ mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyar/ / yongs su tshang ba'am thal mo ya gcig gam/ yang na mgo bo skad cig 'dud pa dang / / de bzhin lan cig lus kyang 'dud pa dang / / gang gi ring bsrel gnas pa de dag la/ / g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes/ / tshig gcig lan 'ga' brjod par byas pa yang / / de dag kun gyes byang chub mchog 'di 'thob/ ces gsungs shing / tha na lta ba log pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag lta bus de mthong ba la brten nas mi dga' ba skyes na de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal drag po myong yang / zhar la 'brel bzhag pa des nam zhig na rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dper na bzod par smra ba'i yan lag bcad pa'i lo rgyus sogs skyes rabs rnams su 'byung ba bzhin yin te/skugasung thugs kyi rten 'di dag sangs rgyas kyi 'azin las kyis bskrun pa sha stag yin pas dgos pa de lta bu zhig med na de dag la ston par mi 'gyur zhing /mngon rtogs rgyan las/ grong sogs su de'i nyon mongs rnams/ / rgyun gcod rgyal ba'i nyon mongs med/ / ces nyon mongs med pa'i khyad par gsungs pas kyang 'grub po/ / 'di dag rtog ge'i blo yul du shong dka' ba'i gnas yin kyang / pad dkar las/ bde gshegs gzugs ni rtsig ngos bris pa la/ / 'khrugs zhin pa yi sems kyis bltas na yang / / de dag rim 426

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga ོ/gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong / zhes dang / snyeng rje pad dkar las/kun dga' bo gang dag tha na rmi lam du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten mthong nas sems dang bar byed na/ kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa klas shing mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthas gtugs par 'gyur bar nga smra'o/ / zhes tshad mar gyur pa'i lung las gsungs pas/ bsam mi khyab kyi gnas la bsam mi khyab de nyid rgyu mtshan du byas nas yid ches par byed dgos te/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs las/ bsam mi khyab la dad byas na/ / rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab ces gsungs shing / de bzhin du spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad tshad med pa de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon phul ba yang tshad med do/ / mtha' yas so/ / bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ / mtshungs pa med do/ / dpag tu med do/ / grangs med do/ / zhes dang / lung phran tshegs las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa sa la lhungs kyang srid/ / sa 'di ri dang nags tshal mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par 'gyur srid kyi/ / drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ zhes gsungs pa rnams yid la bcings te bde legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba las 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa dang / dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi thugs rje byen rlabs la mos pa drag po bskyed de lo zla zhag shas kyi g.yar po lta bu'i lus dang longs spyod kyi steng nas zhing sa khyad par can la sa bon ci thebs kyi snying po blangs pa'i phyir nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad par bya'o/ / zhes bya ba ni lnga pa phyag dang mchod pa'i phan yon gyi skabs so/ / drug pa skor ba byed tshul phan yon dang bcas te bshad pa la/ thog mar skor ba bya ba 'di 427

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i 0me'i g.yo ཿma/dgos ched ci zhig tu gtogs pa yin shes dgos pas/ de ni blo gros bstan pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel bshad las/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa la rnam pa gnyis te/ zang zing gis mchod pa dang / sgrub pas mchod pa'o/ / zang zing gis mchod pa la yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rnyed pas mchod pa dang /bkur stes mchod pa'o/ / de la chos gos dang lhung bzed la sogs pa phul ba ni rnyed pas mchod pa'o/ / phyag 'tshal ba dang skor ba byed pa la sogs pa ni bkur stes mchod pa'o/ / zhes skyabs yul rnams la bkur ste bya ba'i yan lag tu gsungs so/ / de la phan yon ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ mchod rten skor ba zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ / mi khom brgyad rnams spong bar 'gyur/ / lha dang de bzhin mi rnams kyi/ / tshe ring ba yang de yis 'thob/ / sha za dang ni srin rnams kyis/ / de la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ / bskal ba brgyar yang de dag rnams/ / zhar dang grum por yongs mi 'gyur/ / mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ / stobs dang brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs/ / de ni le lo med pa dang / / shin tu sgrub pa thob par 'gyur/ / mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ / mngon shes drug ldan zag pa med/ / nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa yi/ / dgra bcom rdzu 'phrul chen por 'gyur/ / mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ / 'jig rten dag tu de bzhin gshegs/ / mtshan rnams kyis ni brgyan pa dang / / gser gyi sku mdog thob par 'gyur/ / zhes sogs dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ 'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ / su zhig bskor ba byed pa ni/ / tshe rabs dag ni thams cad du/ / byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ /dran dang ldan zhing blo gros ldan/ / bsod nams ldan zhing 'jigs med 'gyur/ / mchod rten skor ba byas na ni/ / tshe rabs dag ni thams cad 428

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/du/ / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / / srin po rnams kyis mchod par 'gyur/ / ngas ni gang dag bstan pa yi/ / mi khom brgyad po de dag spongs/ / 'jig rten sgron ma mnyes byas nas/ / yang dang yang du bste stang byed/ / bdag med stong pa'i chos thos na/ / de ni chos la rmongs mi 'gyur/ / myur du dad pa thob 'gyur zhing / / chos don ji bzhin mkhas par 'gyur/ / 'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la/ / mi gang bskor ba byed pa yi/ / bsngags pa bskal pa bye bar yang / / brjod pas zad par bya mi nus/ / zhes dang / gsal rgyal la gdams pa las/ su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam/ / sku gzugs dag la skor ba byed pa de/ / phyi ma'i tshe na dgra chen rnams kyis btud/ / bzang po'i snod gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan/ / mi rnams su dag dga' zhing gus pa yis/ / bla med mchodarten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ / lus kyi las rnams byed pa de dag ni/ / srid pa kun tu mdzod rnams shin tu rgyas/ zhes sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs la/ khyad par sgrib sbyong gi mchog tu gyur pas ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs tshul/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs las/ dga' ba'i sems kyis gom pa'i gar stabs 'ga' bor te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes smra ba de dag ni bskal pa'am/ bskal pa brgya'am/ bskal pa stong ngam/bskal pa brgya phrag stong du yang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i gnas med do/ /zhes dang / gsang ba ring bsrel gye za ma tog las/ sems can gang dag mchod rten de la skor ba gcig gam/ phyag 'tshal ba gcig gis mnar med pa la thug pa'i bar la sogs pa rnams las yongs su thar par 'gyur zhing /bla na med pa yang dag par dzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur 429

༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i khrung las/ro/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de yang sgo gsum bag med pa'i 'phyar g.yeng dang ngag kyal mi dge ba'i rnam rtog sogs kyi dbang du 'gro bzhin par skor ba byas kyang phan yon de tsam mi 'byung la/ lus kyi spyod lam/ ngag gi bzlas brjod/ yid kyi dad gus gsum ga tshogs pa'i sgo nas byas na lus ngag yid gsum ga'i dge sbyor tshang bas don shin tu che ste/ mchod rten skor ba'i mdo las/ lus kyi las kyang skor ba yin/ / ngag gi las kyang skor ba yin/ /yid kyi las kyang skor ba yin/ / smon lam btab pa'ang skor ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ de la dgongs te sngon jo bo a ti sha rgyun du skor ba mdzad pa la/dge bshes ston pa rin po ches/ dge sbyo ra bzhugs nas mi mdzad par skor ba nyi tshe mdzad pa ji ltar lags zhus pas/ khyod kyis ma go ba yin/ 'di la lus ngag yid gsum ga'i las yod pa yin/ bsgom pa la gcig las med/'di las las 'khos che ba med gsungs pa dang / yang 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa la skor ba las bsod nams che ba med/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi las gsum gas bskor ba yin/ rgya gar na grong khyer chen po la skor ba byas pas dngos grub thob pa dang / gtsug lag khang la skor ba byas pas dngos grub thob pa dang / kha sarba ṇi'i lha khang la skor ba byas pas dngos grub thob cing nad sos pa sogs kyi gtam rgyud mang du yod gsung / de'i stobs kyis bka' gdams pa la skor ba'i srol dar shos che zhing / 'brom rin po che yang rgyun du skor ba mdzad do/ / phyis zhabs kyis mi lcogs pa na khyogs byas nas kyang skor ba gsum gsum ma chag par mdzad ces bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros las 'byung / des na sems yeng ma yeng du ma song bar yid kyis dad pa'ikun slong shugs drag po gsal 'debs pa ni rtsa ba yin te/ 'dul ba lung gzhi las/ mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ / sangs rgyas 430

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na/ / dzasbu'i chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ / zhes so/ / de'i tshe ngag gis bzlas brjod sogs la 'bad dgos pa yang / kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri med las/ tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi'am/ bco lnga la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gzungs sngags 'di gnyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas shing ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la skor bcos na 'phral du sdig pa'i dri ma dang nyon mongs pa thams cad/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi dri ma dang / ser sna dang phrag dog dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten la skor ba bya'o/ / yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'di gnyis kyang dus gcig tu dran par bya'o/ / de ni gaṅgā'i klung bye ba phrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba skyed par 'gyur ro/ / bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga'i las kyi sgrib pa rnams yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi ngan song rnams las yongs su thar par 'gyur ro/ / tshe ring por 'gyur ro/ / sbrul gyi pags pa brjes pa bzhin du lus bor nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ / zhes gsungs la/'dir bstan pa'i gzungs gnyis ni/ oṃ na maste ya dhi kā ṭwāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hre da ya gaste dzwa la dzwa la/ dharmā dha tu gaste saṃ bha ra ma ma a yu rma sho dhā ya saṃ shotwa ya sarba pā paṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sastodhā ṣa bi ma la bi shudhe/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/i baṃ si dza sā hā/ zhes dang / na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ṭwāṃ/ ma hā tsinta ma ṇi dzwa la zhes sogs kyi gzungs ring gnyis yin zhing / gzhan yang de bzhin 431

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'isgronayo khrung ཿma/gshegs pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi mtshan dang / na mo bha ga wa te/ ratna ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakre budhā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ rasne rasne ma hā rasne/ rasne bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes dang / oṃ na mo da sha dika tri kā la sarba ratna tra yā ya/ na ma pra dam su pra dag/ sarba pā paṃ pa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs 'di gnyis kyis kyang skor ba stong 'gyur du 'gro ba sogs phan yon mtha' yas par gsungs/ gzhan yang bka' gdams gong ma'i man ngag las skor ba rten bcas rten med gnyis gsungs pas/ rten bcas 'di lta bu la mtshon na 'dir bzhugs pa'i sku brnyan rnams kyi mdzod spu dang / glegs bam gyi yig 'bru mchod rten gyi bum pa sogs nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yid dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang chos srung phyogs gzhan gyi sku gsung thugs rten la sogs pa thams cad spyan drangs te rten 'di rnams la thim par mos shing / rang gi lus brgya stong khri 'bum sogs su sprul par mos/ ngag tu gzungs de rnams brjod bzhin par song na phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing / gnas chen thams cad skor ba byas par 'gro'o/rten med ni sku gsung thugs rten dngos su med pa'i thang stong lta bur yang skor ba byed 'dod na/ hūṃ ser bo las byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du skyabs yul thams cad bzhugs par mos la bzlas pa sogs snga ma bzhin du byas pas bsod nams rlabs po che 'thob po/ / gzungs de dag blor mi zin na gzungs sngags zab mo gang shes kyis rung la/ khyad par rang cag kha ba ri ba'i lha skal spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs la 'bad na byin rlabs myur bas shin tu legs te/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum las/ skor ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ thugs rje chen po'i sku gcig la/phyi ltar na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / nang 432

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/ltaran brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad/ gsang ba ltar na yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad bstem la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes bzlas shing skor ba bya'o/ /rten las 'od byung nas rang la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad byang bar bsam la skor ba bya'o/ / zhes gsungs pa lta bu re ma mtha' yang dgos so/ / kha cig phyag mchod skor ba la sogs pa 'di dag chos zab mo'i nyams len mi shes pa'i phal pa rnams la bsngags pa yin gyi/ blo'i nus pa shin tu che ba rnams la 'di mi dgos snyam pa gtan nas mi rung ste/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba 'od shin tu gsal ba zhes bya ba byed de/ mchod pa dang rim gro byed pa de/ sems dang po bskyed pa yan chad/ sa dgu pa thob pa'i bar dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro byas pa'i brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ zhes sogs kyis sa gong ma gong ma'i skabs su lus ngag gi dge spyor yang ches gong 'phel du 'gro bar gsungs shing / byang sa las kyang / byang chub sems dpa' de de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims chas dang / gdan dang / basbun gyi gsos sman dang / yo byad rnams dang / gus par smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / sngon du ldang ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchod pa rnam pa bdun rgya chen po zhes bya'o/zhes phyag mchod skor ba sogs rgyal sras kyi nyams len rmad du byung bar gsungs so/ / la la rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig 'ga' zhig gi dgongs pa ma phyed par gsang sngags pas 'di 'dra mi dgos par smra ba yang log par rtog pa yin te/ rje mi las/ nga res 'ga' 'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgom/ 'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgom tsa na/ / 'gro 'dug skor bar shes pa'i gdams ngag yod/433

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/ces gsungs pa lta bu grub chen du mas gsungs tshul dang lo rgyus mang du yod la/ ma hā ra ta zhes sogs kyi sngags don ltar sngags rang lam la skor ba byed tshul thun mong ba las kyang ches zab tu btang nas byed dgos pa yin no/ / skor tshad ni rgyal dbang bdun pa'i gsung las/ skor ba'i tshad ji tsam du bya ba ni mtha' gcig tu nges pa bzung du ma mchis kyang / deng sang skor 'bum du grags pa ltar gyis gzhal na/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang rang gi 'bad pas nus tshad du byed pa las grangs kyi nges bzung la cher mi ltos/ 'on kyang sngon 'gro khrid chen bzhi'i skabs su phyag 'bum maṇḍal 'bum/ yig brgya 'bum sogs gsungs pa'i rigs 'gre sbyar te rten gtso gang la gzhal ba der grangs 'bum phrag gcig 'gro ba'i tshod la skor tshad du grags pa ltar na/ rten gtso 'od dpag med kyi pad gdan la gzhal te/de nyer lnga'i 'gyur gyis seng khri'i 'gram 'khor bas/ mchod rten rang la skor ba bzhi stong byas tshe gtso bo la 'bum phrag gcig gi tshod 'khrol dang bcas te 'gro'o/ / de ltar phyag mchod skor ba sogs kyi dge ba'i cha shas phra mo re la yang phan yon mtha' yas/ de lta bu 'byung ba ni mngon pa kun btus su bsam mi khyab kyi gnas bzhi gsungs pa las/ las dang 'bras bu'i 'brel ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa de nyid yin pas/ skye bo blo gros mchog tu gyur pa'i dbang non rnams chos nyid kyi rigs pa'i sgo nas legs par nges pa drangs te chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa phyir mi ldog pa bskyed na byin rlabs dang dngos grub shin tu myur ro/ / 'on kyang dbang po no bar rlom pa rigs lam 'char rkyen pa ltar snang yang / don gyi gting mi dpogs par rtog ge'i rigs pa ltar snang du mas g.yeng ste zab mo'i chos la yid mi ches pa ni/rgyan gyi 'grel pa rnams su sbob pa myur ba'i sbyor skyon bshad pa bzhin shes rab 434

rnam dkar lasal skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/'chal byed dang dngos grub kyi gegs yin pas/ de las dbang po rtul po'i lugs kyi yid ches pa'i lung gi rjes su 'brang ste dad pa bskyed na byin rlabs myur te/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ / don la ze tshom med pa yi/ / mkhas pa la ni dngos grub myur/ / yang na blun po dad pa brtan/ / de la spyor ba'i dngos grub nye/ / rtog cing dpyod pa'i rtog ge ba/ / de la sbyor ba'i dngos grub ring / zhes dang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ri dang nags bcas sa 'di gas 'gyur zhing / / rgya mtsho'i chu dag de bzhin 'pho 'gyur la/ / zla ba nyi ma sa la lhung gyur kyang / / rgyal bas bshad pa rnam pa gzhan mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa rnams nas lan gcig ma yin par yang dang yang du gsungs pa la je tshom med pa'i dad pa rtse gcig tu bskyed de/ des kun nas bslang ba'i phyag dang mchod pa/ gsol 'debs bzlas brjod skor ba sogs la 'bad na ji skad du rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos/ gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis mughi ka / 'bad med ster ba'i legs byas skor ba'i las/ / dge tshogs rnam dkar nya lceb khog yangs por/ / bkang ba'i 'gro rnams 'di dang phyi mar 'tshengs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di phyi kun gyi legs tshogs ma lus par lhun gyes grub pa zhig 'byung ngo / / zhes bya ba ni drug pa skor ba byed tshul phan yon dang bcas pa'i skabs so/ / bdun pa dge ba'i dngos po rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ oṃ suste/ bden tshig grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong gis/ / phun tshogs gser ldan yongs la dbang 'byor pa/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras nyan rang rig pa 'dzin/ / mtha' dag legs smon 'grub pa'i mgon mdzod cig / bsam spyor mi dman brtson pa'i chu bo brgya/ /435

༄/ /yo ca bstanapa'isbyoname'i ga4 la /legs byas dzing bur gcig tu 'khyil ba gang / / mngon mtho nges par legs pa'i phyogs gang du/ / bgrod pa bsngo ba'i 'jug ngogs srol la brten/ /gser sbyangs gar bu gcig gi cha shas las/ / rnam pa tha dad bsgrub pa'i bzo bo bzhin/ / dge ba dman 'bring mchog gi 'bras ldan du/ / bsgyur ba'i mnga' bdag 'gro na gzhan yod min/ / de phyir bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i las/ / rnam par dkar ba'i phyogs su snang ngo cog / don med 'khor ba'i lam du mi ltung bar/ / rnam grol rgyu yi srang bur bstar gyur cig / mdo rgyud 'khrul bral gser sbyangs khams las grub/ / bslab gsum bcud ldan bstan pa'i kā la sha / sri zhu'i mgul chings g.yo ba dang bcas pas/ / 'gro kun gtsug tor rtse nas dbang sbyin shog / khyad par dge ldan rang lugs gser gyi rnga/ / khor yug srid du brdung ba'i sgra bo ches/ / ma rtogs log rtog 'khrul ba'i dpung tshogs las/ / rnam par rgyal ba'i dga' ba mtshon gyur cig / brjod pa ma nor rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gye/ / 'phang 'gro'i lto bar spel legs sdeb sbyor du/ / drangs pa'i snyan tshig rgyud stong 'khrol ba las/ / sgra rig dbyangs kyi dkyel 'khor rdzogs gyur cig /phyogs glang grags pa'i gzhung lugs 'od ma'i gzhu/ / rnam dpyod 'dom gyis nyer gzhal rigs pa'i mdas/ / rgol ngan lta ba log pa'i 'ben bshig pa/ / gtan tshigs rig pa'i lus rtsal 'byongs gyur cig / lus bzo kun phan las kyi gru char 'bebs/ / ngag bzo 'degs 'jog 'gyur khug sgra brgya rgod/ / yid bzo rnam dpyod 'phrul gyi glog 'gyu ba'i/ / bzo rig sprin sngon phung po 'khrigs gyur cig / chags sdang rmongs pa'i mun nag tshang tshing nas/ / gdungs pa'i dug rlangs mi bzad spro ba yi/ / rlung mkhris pad gan nad rims gdug pa'i sbrul/ / gso rig mkha' lding dpung pas 436

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/gzhom gyur cig / las nyon bag chags nag po brtsegs pa yis/ / yongs su zin pa'i gdung pa rab bcil te/ / rnam grol zag med dga' ba'i mchog sbyin pa/ / nang don rig pa'i bdud rtsi myong gyur cig / 'chad mkhas tshig don cha shas yongs gang zhing / / rtsod ngag dri med rigs pa'i 'od dkar spro/ / rtsom pa'i nyams 'gyur ri dwags mtshan ma can/ / smra ba'i zla ba tshar du dngar bar shog / tshul khrims yon tan tshogs kyi chu 'dzin klong / / ting 'dzin glog 'phreng dra ba 'jug cing ldang / / shes rab zab mo'i 'brug sgra rol ba yi/ / grub dbang bye bas thub bstan mkha' khyab shog / rang khyim gsal pa'i me khyer tsam min par/ / ris med 'khor lo gsum gyi 'od snang can/ /rgyal bstan spyi la dgongs pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams/ / bzhed pa'i snye ma 'bras bus gang gyur cig / blo bzang chos tshul thub bstan chu bo brgya/ /'jigs med rnam dpyod hub kyis nyer gzhal te/ / slar yang sa gsum skye dgu'i nyer 'tsho ru/ / legs gsung bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'bebs gyur cig / lung rigs sgra dbyangs chos kyi shugs 'chang ba/ / bkra shis ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / / skye dgu'i bsod nams spo mthor bzhad pa'i sgras/ / sa gsum rgud pa ming gi mthar byed shog / zhi dul tshangs spyod spu sdug gos kyis klubs/ / legs bshad snyan 'gyur gtam gyis mgrin pa gang / / bgrang yas blo gsal thar 'dod ko ki las/ / thub bstan dpyid kyi dga' tshal mdzes gyur cig / drin du mi bgrang dad pa'i kha lo yis/ /bstan la bskur ste rim gro lhur byed rnams/ / de dang rjes mthun tshe dpal bsod nams sogs/ / legs pa'i dpal gyis phyir yang bste bar shog /rlabs chen bsod nams gzhir gyur maṇḍa lar/ / gser dngul rkang 'gro nor 'bru rdo shing sogs/ / rgyu sbyor lhag bsam tshom bur dgod pa kun/ /437

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'itshoname'i khrung 'bum/mngon mtho nges legs dga' ba'i dpal thob shog / mthong thos dran reg gdul bya gling bzhi'i mkhar/ / rnam grol sa bon rnam bzhi'i mdangs 'phro ba/ / ngo mtshar mchod sdong rin chen lhun po 'di/ / thub bstan rol mtsho'i rgyan du gnas gyur cig / sad ser nad rims 'khrug pas ma rnyogs shing / /bde 'byor lbu ba dkar bo'i phreng dkrigs pa/ / dus kyi rgyal mo'i chu bo rnam bzhi yang / / 'chol med legs byas rgya mtshor 'jug gyur cig / rab gtum srin po khros pa'i lto ba na/ / bag med rtsen pa byis pa'i blo can rnams/ / bden don chos kyi glu yis rgyud bskul te/ / zhi ba'i go 'phang sgrub la gzhol bar shog / sgo gsum dge bar bsgyur ba'i gom stabs kyang / / chos brgyad 'og 'gyu'i gdon gyis ma bslang bas/ / yon por ma yin chos lam drang po ru/ / zhugs te yang dag lam bzang myur bsgod shog / phung khrol kun gyi byed po nang gi dgra / de yi rang mdangs phyi rol nyer 'tshe sogs/ / bar du gcod pa'i ming yang mi grags shing / / mthun pa'i dngos kun lhun gyis grub par shog / ma 'ongs tshe rabs padma dkar po'i phreng / / bshes gnyen nyin byed 'od kyis mi gtong zhing / / tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ / yid kyi bung ba'i nyer 'tshor smin gyur cig /mi zad nor gyis gang zhing legs par bsdams/ / nyer 'tshes mi tshugs mthun pa'i rlung gis bskyod/ / rab tu brtan pa'i shes rab gru bo ches/ / phra rags srid pa'i mtsho las brgal gyur cig / dbyengs kyi mkha' la kun rtog las nyon lus/ / 'byung ba rim brtsegs srid pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ / me gsum las 'das lta ba'i byin za yis/ / phyis 'byung med pa nyid du sbyong gyur cig / mkho ba sbyin pa'i dri dang phyogs su ldang / / snyan smra rab myos bung ba'i sgra ldan pa/ / don mthun yon tan sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas 438

rnam dkar la la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/gyis/ / skal bzang skye bo'i rgyan gyi don spyod shog / gdod nas dag pa ma lus 'gro ba'i khams/ / glo bur dri ma sbyangs pa'i byang chub mchog / stobs sogs yon tan yongs su dzogs pa yi/ / kun bzang 'phrin las snang ba 'bar gyur cig / bdag sogs dge ba'i bsam sbyor sa bon ni/ / bde gshegs thugs rje'i brlan gsher gyis smin cing / / bslu med rten 'byung dus su phyin pa las/ / gang btab smon pa'i 'bras bu smin gyur cig /ltar snang dge la dman pa'i kun slong gis/ / 'bras bu'i rnam pa gzhan du bsgyur ba kun/ / sras bcas rgyal ba'i bsod nams dang 'dres te/ / phul byung rnam par smin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / rnam dkar don ldan las kyi don mthun rnams/ khro sogs mi bzad chom pos mi 'phrog phyir/ / thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs bskyed btsan dzong du/ / rtag tu zhugs nas rtag pa'i dpal thob shog / blo chung dge ba'i chu thigs nyam chung yang / / mthu chen rgyal sras sbyong ba'i rlabs chen mtshor/ / gcig tu 'dres te gtan tu mi zad pa/ / kun bzang smon pa'i 'bras bzang smin gyur cig / ces bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa dang phyag mchod skor ba'i phan yon bstan pa mchod rten mthong grol chen mo'i dkar chag lha'i rnga chen zhes bya ba 'di ni/ spyir bstan pa'i gnas tshad mdo sde bskal bzang /snying rje pad dkar/ zla ba snying po'i mdo/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo 'grel/thub dgongs/ yum gsum gnod 'joms sogs su lo stong dang / nyis stong / phyed sum stong / lnga stong sogs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba mang bas/phyi ma sgra ji bzhin par byas shing / de la yang 'das lo rtsi tshul mang nyung gi lugs gnyis las/ mang ba'i phyogs ltar na dgra bcom/ phyir mi 'ongs/rgyun zhugs te 'bras bu'i le'u gsum/ shes rab/ ting 'dzin/ tshul 439

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'ithonama'i ga4 'tho/khrims te sgrub pa'i le'u gsum/ lung mngon pa'i le'u dang / mdo sde'i le'u'i nang nas bzhi brgya go drug rnams song zin pa'i go bdun pa yin zhing /thub bstan rin po che lo zla rer yang gnas na ci ma rung snyam du smon pas 'das lo nyung ba ltar byed tshe/ de la yang ston pa'i 'khrungs lo sogs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis bshad tshul sna tshogs yod kyang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dus 'khor ṭīka chen gzhir bzhag na/ bstan pa lo nyis stong drug brgya bzhi bcu ste/ tshul khrims le'u'i steng nas brgya bzhi bcu pa dang /dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bstan pa'i gnas tshad dus bzhir gsungs pa las/rdzogs ldan/ gsum ldan/ gnyis ldan rnams 'das nas/ rtsod ldan gye yang nyis brgya re lngar sleb cing / rje bdag nyid chen pos rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang la ri bo dge ldan btab nas sum brgya go bdun dang / lnga brgya tha ma tshugs te lo grangs bcu lhag gi rjes la kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'khrungs shing / rje de nyid kyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa glang la bkra shis 'khyil btab nas/ go bdun pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i mjug gi cha/khro bo zhes pa shing mo glang gi lo/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mchod sdong gsar bzhengs kyi bgyi ba legs par grub ste/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa spel ba'i phyir dkar chag cig kyang bsgrig 'dun yod pa'i thogadad brtson ldan pa dkon mchog bde chen gyis 'di'i dkar chag mchod rten gyi rnam bzhag dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul yang yang bskul zhing /sprul sku 'jigs med mkhas mchog dus 'khor dpon slob don yod tshul khrims/ smon pa dpon slob blo bzang rgyal mtshan rnams nas kyang / rten gyi dkar chag dang / phyag mchod skor ba'i phan yon/ skor tshad la sogs pa shin tu rgyas pa mdo rgyud kyi khungs dang bcas pa zhig bre dgos tshul gyi 440

rnam dkar las la skul byed dkar chag lha'i rnga chen/bskul ma gnang ba bzhin 'phral du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong dkon mchog kun dgas bgyis pa 'di yang legs byas kyi dge mtshan phyogs brgyar 'phel zhing / thub bstan rin po che'i gsos sman dam par yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig / / / dkon mchog thugs rje'i bden mthus legs ṭwāṃṭwāṃ nibye ༷/ṭwāṃX/ rte/dī paX hūṃX ༷༷ bye/ ༷ ༷ni hūṃ hūṃg /danghru//༷ ṭwāṃ ༷ nishaṃ 'byams pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis 'di ga'i ngag rtsom dpar du ma 'khod pa rnams rko dgosatshul thebs dang bcas te bskul ba bzhin bsgrubs pa'i tshe bris pa'o/ / / /441

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'izlanas gsang 'bum/༄7/ / lung ston byams pa'i dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi gatrī zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shes rab 'khor los srid pa'i rgyu ba bcad/ / snying rje tha gus srid min srid par bcings/ bden gnyis gom pas 'jig rten gsum gnon pa/ /stobs kyi 'jug pa bcu mnga' de la 'dud/ ye shes lnga yi cod pan gdengs ga'i 'od/ / gang gi spyi bor bkod bzhin gsung gi mchog / sbas don snyeng po'i mdzod brgya phyag tu gtad/ / mi pham rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal gyur cig / las nyon na kras rab dkrugs srid pa'i mtsho/ / sdug bsngal rlabs 'phreng srid rtser 'phyo ba las/ / sgrol ba'i ded dpon gcig pur khyod bsten no/ / 'phrin las gru gzings sbyor cig thugs rje'i gter/ / grags pa'i sgra brgya rol pa'i sprin dkar la/ / re ba'i mig 'bur gtod pa'i mdongs mtha' yang / / bsod nams 'du byed gar dang lhan cig tu/ / snying la mngon dga' rgyas pa'i ca co 'chor/ / rgyal gsung longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngo bo nyid/ / ngag gi longs spyod dbyangs can ngang mo'i gar/ / mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'o mtsho ru/ / ci dgar longs spyod mgrin rnga 'di na brdung / / mchog gsum rten gyi ngo bo bzhengs pa'i tshul/ / phyag mchod skor ba bcas pa'i phan yon rnams/ / mthong thos rnam grol lha yi rnga bo che/ /bsgrags zin zlos bur 'god pa'i ngal ba bskyungs/ / deng ni nyams 'gyur la2

༄/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi gazlo/'dab ma'i bkrag mdangs dang / / don gyi snying po dad pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ / thung ngu gnyer pa'i blo gsal bhra ma ra / / dga' skyed me tog phon po 'ga' tsam spel/ / gzhung lugs rnam mang thos pa'i dngos grub la/ /'dod chung chog shes 'gram pa mi ston par/ / legs bshad nor bu skyug pa'i ne'u le'i khar/ / rna ba'i yol go gtad de bzed pa mdzod/ / de'ang rgyal ba rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs pa'i tshe phyag g.yas pa spyi bor bzhag ste byin rlabs zhugs pa'i tshul mdo sde sa bcu pa dang lang gshegs/ rab zhi rnam nges sogs du ma las gsungs shing / khyad par du bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/de nas lung bstan thob don du/ / zhes pa nas/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs sbyin byas la/ / dbugs dbyung ba yi mchog bya ba/ / zhes byang chub tu lung ston pa'i tshe phyag g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa'i phyag rgya bcas te lung bstan pa la dgos pa dang rten 'brel khyad par can yod par gsungs/don de la dgongs te paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis kyang / de tshe rgyal ba byams pa rab tu dgyes/ / phyag g.yas bdag gi mgo la bzhag bzhin du/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu lung bstan nas/ / zhes gsungs shing / rje btsun ngag dbang byams pa'i ljags bkod kyi bris thang mang por yang de bzhin 'byung bas/ rten 'brel gyi sgo la bsams nas byang chub tu lung ston par mdzad pa'i byams mgon gyi snang brnyan gsar bskrun bgyis te dkar chag mdo tsam 'god pa la/ rten bzhengs mchod kyi phan yon sogs ni mthong grol chen mo'i dkar chag tu bshad zin pa las shes par bya zhing /'dir gang gi phyir bzhengs pa'i dgos pa/ gang gis bzhengs par byed pa'i bzo bo/ gang bzhengs pa'i rten gyi ngo bo/ de ltar bzhengs pa'i dge ba bsngo ba ste don tshan bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 443

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'ijoname'i khrung 'bum/bstan pa la thos bsam gyis zhugs pa rnams bstan pa 'di la thog ma kho nar smin cing grol ba'i tshul lung sde bzhi sogs las rgya cher 'byung ba dang /bstan pa 'di la bya ba cung zad byas pa rnams kyang ma 'ongs pa na byams mgon gyi gdul byar 'gyur bar ston pas mdo sde du ma las gsungs shing /byams mgon nyid kyis kyang rang gi 'dul skal du gzigs pas da lta nas bdag gir mdzad pa ni byams chos lnga skyes su bskur te bdud ste'i bgo skal snga mgyogs su sbyin par mdzad pa 'di nyid kyis shes la/ kun mkhyen bla ma sku snga phyi sogs dam pa gong ma rnams kyis kyang byams mgon gyi sku re bzhengs te rjes 'jug rnams de la 'brel ba 'jog tu 'jug pa ni mdzad srol nges can lta bur snang bas/ rang nyid kyis kyang de dag gi rnam thar smon pa'i yul du byas te bya ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid la zhugs pa yin pas tshul de dbyangs kyis bsnyad na/thub dbang rang gi bstan la smin grol lam/ / bgrod pa ma rdzogs zhi ba'i mgron pa kun/ / khyod kyis skyong zhes mgon dang gdul bya ru/ / phan tshun mtshams sbyor bka' chems rim par bzhag / 'od srung bstan la ches phra'i sa bon yang / / nyi ma'i gnyen gyis mod la smin pa'i tshul/ / sde bzhi'i lung gi dus ston dar ba'i gtam/ / phyi ma'i skal bzang mtshon pa'i mtshan ma mchog / rgyal bstan 'di la da lta zhugs so cog / rgyal tshab nyid kyis slad nas 'dren pa'i brdar/ / rgyal yum dgongs 'grel mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs/ / rgyal ba'i thugs bcud zab dgu skyes su bskur/ / de lta'i ngo mtshar rno ldan kyo ba yis/ / drangs pa spro ba'i yid kyi padmo'i kha/ / rgyal ba'i nyi ma gang gi rjes phyogs las/ / rnam dkar 'du byed sbrang rtsi'i bcud du 'dus/ / lung chos smra ba'i sgo la rmongs pa'i rgya/ / tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i sgo la g.yeng ba'i rgya/ / bya ba las kyi sgo la ser sna'i rgya/ / btab ste thang stong 444

༄za/ /dkar chag gdangasasnyan chos kyi gasno/bstan la ci zhig brgya/ / mkhas pa'i rna bar legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / phal pa'i lag tu gtong ba'i nor gyi rgyun/ / kun la rten mchogachag gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ / lam gsum 'bab pas 'gro gsum dri ma 'khrud/ / spyi bor bla ma'i zhabs rdul lhan skyes bzhin/ / mgrin par legs bshad rol mo lhan skyes bzhin/ / snying la skyo ba'i 'du shes lhan skyes bzhin/ / sgo gsum rnam dkar bya ba lhan skyes bzhin/ / dkon mchog rgyal ba kun 'dus kurdo'i gnyen/ / 'jigs med snang ba'i byin rlabs byin pa yis/ / yid dbang dad pa'i rgya mtsho rgya che ru/ / 'phyur ba'i legs byas rlabs chen rlabs 'di 'phros/ / mtha' yas mchog gsum rten rnams byin rlabs kyi/ / gter du mnyam yang khyad 'phags rten 'brel sgo/ / dam pas legs phye'i srol bzhin byang chub tu/ / lung ston byams pa mgon po'i sku 'di bsgrubs/ / btog pa'i snying po sdeg med gtsang ma'i dngos/ / gtong ba'i rgyu 'bras ngesna sems spro du yis/ / rtse gucig yid kyis blang dor sdu nor bar/ / bsgrubs pa 'di yang rgyal ba'i gzhung lam yin/ / gnyis pa gang gis bzhengs pa'i bzo ba ni/snga sor 'di 'dra'i rten bzhengs shig gi 'dun pa yod kyang nye 'khor du de lta bu'i bzo bo med la/ thag ring zhig tu gtad na bkod pa sogs blo dang mthun pa zhig mi 'ong bas ji ltar byed snyam du the tshom gyi ngang la gnas ba'i tshe bzo bo 'di nyid glo bur du 'ongs te theg mchog 'khor lo bzhi la brten nas re ba'i shing rta ji ltar smon pa'i lam du bgrod pa'i rten 'brel rang 'grig tu gyur to/ / de'ang 'di'i skyes yul ni hor rgyal po rnams kyis chos kyi rgyal srid rim par bskyangs shing / 'jam mgon sa paṇa dang garma pakshi sogs dam pa mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas lang gru'u sde bzhir grags pa'i mkhar 445

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i me'i khrung lam/gyi nang dbul phyug bar ma'i khyim skyid de ba zhig yin la/ der gza' tshang mi mthun pa sogs mi bde ba'i rkyen ci'ang med kyang lo bcu drug bcu bdun nas bzung yul du gtan mi 'khor bar mgar bslabs te phyogs sna tshogs su 'khyams shing 'gro ba dang / phyogs rer lo zla kha shas rer bsdad de yon gye 'phro sogs len pa lta ci/ rang gi lag cha sogs kyang bskyur te 'gro bas phal mo che rlung sengs lta bur rtsi'ang / de 'dra yin na slar dngas nas phyir 'khor dgos rgyu la blos gang bcad de las slar 'gyur ldog med pas bsam bzhin du de ltar byas pa yin par snang / phyogs 'dir yang sngar gtan nas 'dris med cing 'di na rgyus yod kyi mi bsnyegs nas 'ong sa gcig med kyang 'di phyogs su bsnyegs 'ongs pa dang / rang la'ang 'di bzo sogs ji ltar yin zhib cha rgyus med bzhin du phan tshun blo mthun pas bya ba'i 'khor lo rtsom rgyur song ba ni sngon gyi legs smon dang dkon mchog gi thugs rjes rgyud bskul bar mngon/ bzo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin yang 'phral la gzhan gyis ci zer ba'i rjes su mi rgyug par gyong bo lta bu/ yun du 'grogs na ngang tshul bzang zhing phan sems che bas 'grogs bde ba gnas skabs rgyu nor tshol ba lta bur snang yang 'phral gyi zas gos sgrig rten phran bu re byung tshe dga' tshor che zhing /nor che ba re byung tshe 'di 'dra bzung nas gar 'gro rgyu yin zhes de tsam gyi 'dod pa med pa dang / nor gyi rin thang sogs blo la shin tu gsal yang tshong sogs kyi tshe ma shes pa ltar byas te rgyal kha gzhan la ster zhing / gzhan sus kyang ma mthong bar byas nas dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs 'dod chung chog shes kyi spyod pa ya mtshan pa dang / rin po che'i rigs mang po rtsis gdab med par lag tu bzhag kyang skyon med par ma zad phra legs pa re nyer spyad lta bu la 'deb rgyu byin na'ang der gtong mi bra par dkon mchog 446

༄/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan choyokyi gazlo/gi rten la 'gro thabs byed/ gser gtong tshul rgya nag gi lugs 'di bzhin byas na 'gro sgo chung zhes la las bshad par/ mthug na bzang zhes de'i tshig la mi nyan zhing / dbus bzo rnams gser byugs te bsregs ma thag btsod du bcug pas mdog dmar sang nge ba 'ong tshul bshad kyang / gser ci yin rung rang mdog de gar bzhag na bzang zhes mi nyan pa ni de rigs la 'dris chung ba'i stabs yin nam snyam yang / phyis su brtag tshe dkon mchog gi zhing la rgyu 'gro gang che dang g.yo sgyu ma 'dres ba'i kun slong rnam dag cig yin par mngon te/ bzo bo phal cher sku'i phyi nang rgyab mdun la khyad 'byed kyang /'dis ni mthong mi mthong gi sa gang la'ang zhib cha byed tshul tshod gcig kho nar snang ba ni las 'bras la yid ches pa'i mtshan mar mngon/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa zhig phog na snyam ste 'phros btang bar/ kho bo rab byung zhig byas na snyam yang srung dka' bar snang / ba za bla ma'i mdun nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhig blangs yod zer te/ sdom pa len rgyur srung mtshams kyi mno bsam sngon du gtong ba 'di ni deng dus kyi phal mo che dang mi 'dra ba'i blo ldan gyi gtam du snang / mdor na shā ri'i bus zhus pa las/ bzo bo blo ldan gtsang spra che/ / bstan bcos kun la bslab pa dang / / nga rgyal chung zhing sgrub phod la/ / brtson zhing dge la spro ba dang / / shes rab che dang nan tan che/ /lhag par gso sbyong bzung ba dang / / bslab pa la gus chos brgyad spangs/ /nyin mtshan kun tu mi g.yel bar/ / dge ba la ni brtson pa dang / / bri ba'i las mtha' rab tu byang / / bram ze gtsang ma'i spyod pa bzhin/ / khrus dang gtsang sbra dag la gnas/ / 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ / zhes sogs kyis mtshon mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod chung chog shes/dkon mchog la dad pa/ las 'bras la yid ches/ skyo ngal med pa'i 447

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i 0sa gsung 4ma/brtson 'grus/ sgo gsum bag yod pa'i tshul khrims/ des shing gzu bor gnas pa'i rang bzhin/ blang dor ma log pa'i shes rab sogs bzo bo'i mtshan nyid ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams tshang zhing / de'i ldog phyogs kyi skyon mtha' dag dang bral ba zhig ste/ sngon gyi lo rgyus la lar sprul pa'i bzo bo zhes grags pa rnams kyang gnas skabs de'i mi rnams kyi snang tshul la 'di 'dra ba'i mi dkyus ma re yin zhing / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis byams sku bzhengs pa'i tshe bzo bo glo bur du lhags pa'i tshul ngo mtshar che bar gleng ba'ang 'di bzhin yin pas/ rang gi ngos nas blo 'gel nus na dkon mchog gi thugs rje ni nyi 'od dang chu zla bzhin mchog dman kun la mnyam par 'jug pa gdon mi za ba zhig go / de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ mthun dgu rkyen du 'dzom pa'i lhal ljongs 'dir/ / ya rje dasna pa'i mdzad srol brnag pa'i tshe/ / ring nas leghas smon gyis bkug bzo bo yis/ / bsgrubs pa bstod nams mthu bzhin gegs med grub/ / chos nor sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon mtho ba/ / lang gru'u sde bzhi'i grong khyer ma la yar/ / skyes kyang sna tshogs yul grur legs byas kyi/ / khang bzang sna tshogs 'degs pa'i ka bar gyur/ / sngar nas 'dris pa'i 'brel ba ma mchis kyang / / legs spyad mdun mar lhan cig tshogs pa yi/ / pho nyar rang gi sngon dge'i rta zhon nas/ /mchog gsum thugs rje'i khye'u dkyus so snyam/ / gtad med kun tu 'khyams pa ri dwags bzhin/ / dam bca'i mtshams las mi g.yo ri bo bzhin/ / su dang mi bstun gyong po'i shing skam bzhin/ / 'grogs na gshis bzang 'jam pa'i shing bal bzhin/ / sngon rabs gtam du sprul pa'i bzo bo zhes/ /grags pa'i g.yer kha 'khrol ba de dag kyang / / mkha' las rdol min spyod dang 448

༄༅/ /dkar chag gdangasasnyan chosakyi gaṇḍi/rnam par bcas/ / de tshe snang bar 'di ko tsam du bas/ / bzo bo bi shwa garma gnyis pa zhes/ / smras na kun gyis col chung gtam du sems/ / lha yi zhal bzang jo shāka gnyis pa ru/ / mngon sum tshad mas grub la bston du ci/ /spyan zur mchu sgros badzes pa'i 'dzum zhal tsam/ / bzo bo phal gyi spyod yul lags na yang / / bcu drug lang tsho gsar ba'i gzhon nu'i nyams/ / 'di nyid kho na'i sor mo'i 'phrul las byung / / smra ba rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ / phan par dka' ba snyigs ma'i dus mtha' 'dir/ / mig gi bdud rtsir 'phrul ba'i 'dzum dkar gyi/ / ga pur thigs pa kurdo'i dpyid du gyur/ / thub pas legs bsngags 'dod chung chog shes dang / / dad brtson blo gros khrims kyi 'dab 'phreng can/ / bsod nams sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas gsar ba zhig / legs byas do ra mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'khrungs/ / gsum pa gang bzhengs pa'i rten gyi ngo bo la phyi'i sku dang nang gi gzungs 'jug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thog mar rang gi lus tshad cig bzhengs rgyu'i 'phen pa byas te lha bzo skal bzang la brir bcug pa gzhal tshul gyis rim pas je cher song ste dkyug mtho bcu bzhi lhag tsam du gyur pas dge tshogs gong 'phel gyi rten 'brel mngon par 'grigs/ ma phyi'ang 'du khang phur bzhugs pa'i jo bo'i sku 'di ni sngon gzhung gi srid skyong mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis byas te bod kyi bzo grwa ma nyams par yod pa'i dus lha sa'i jo bo rin po cher dpe blangs te gzab nas bzhengs pa yin pas sngon chad phyogs 'dir bzo legs pa'i tshad bzhag lta bu yin stabs de dang hor rgyal po'i dus kyi sku brnyan byon legs 'gal zhig la dpe byas pa yin na'ang / rjes sor grub pa'i tshe de dag las nyams ches khyad par du gyur pa jo shāka rnam gnyis kyi sku nyams la 'gran bzod pa dang / lhag par zhal gyi gzhon nyams sogs jo bo mi bskyod 449

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'isgronace' khrung 4ma/rdo rje ji lta ba zhig byung / 'ga' zhig phyag tshad kyi gzhung bshad la mkhas kyang lag tu blang ba'i tshe ji bzhin mi 'ong ba mang la/ 'di gzhung tshig gshar rgyu mi 'dug kyang cha mtha' dag zhib tu gzhal ba'i tshe gzhung don dang cung zad kyang mi 'gal bas/ ji tsam brtags kyang cha ma snyoms pa lta bu'i skyon gdags rgyu med par ma zad/ gzhan dang bsdur te yun du bltas kyin sku'i stod smad/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad skabs phyed la shin tu 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa/ mdzes khyad sngar las lhag pa re bsnan gyin shar 'ong ba lta bus yun ring por 'dris kyang nam bltas pa'i tshe gsar mthong gi dus dang 'dra bar yid dang mig 'phrog pas lta bas chog mi shes pa ste/bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod kyi sku de gang gis ni/ / lan brgyar mthong dang gang zhig gis/ / dang por mthong ba de ga nyig / 'dra bar mig ni mgu bar mdzad/ / ces pa ltar ro/ / der ma zad mdo sde rnams las dbu gdugs ltar blum pa/ dpral pa'i dbyings zla ba ltar rgyas pa/spyan utpa la'i 'dab ma 'dra ba/ 'gram pa zum zhing rgyas pa/ mgrin pa dung 'dra ba/ ro stod seng ge lta bu/ sked skabs ldem zhing 'khril ba/sku'i kho lag yangs pa sogs mtshan dpe'i khyad par gsungs pa rnams kyang rgyun par 'ol spyi tsam las mi 'char yang / 'dir sku'i steng du bltas na gzhung nas bshad pa de 'di ga rang du 'dug snyam nas nyams 'char tshul sngar dang mi 'dra bar blo ngor khrig ge ngo 'phrod pa zhig 'ong bar snang / khyad par du phyag g.yas pa spyi bor bzhag ste lung ston pa'i rnam pa mdzad pa de'i steng du sku'i cha thams cad bsgrims shing phyogs te dgongs pa gtad nas bzhugs yod pa'i nyams shig mkhas blun thams cad la mthong tsam nyid nas 'char rgyu yod kyang / de bzo tshul 'di'i stobs kyis yin par 'dug ces smra rgyu dang /450

༄/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi garji/rtsol bas byas pa'i nyams shig med par rang byon shugs 'byung gi nyams shig tu sna ba ni nges par thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa'i mtshan ma dang / ma 'ongs pa na byang chub tu lung ston pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grigs pa yin nam snyam du dga' ba lhag par 'phel lo/ / phra rgyan yang dbu rgyan dbus ma'i dkyil du margad phug ron gyi sgo nga tsam zhig dang padma rā ga mazeb mgo tsam gcig rtse mor margad mthe bong tsam gcig dbu rgyan bar ma gnyis kyi rtser su gardo mdzub rtse tsam re/ mgul rgyan gyi gsham du pad rag mdzub rtse tsam gcig margad dang su gardo sran chen tsam re/ gzhan yang g.yu byu ru mu tig mu min spos shel sogs che chung sna tshogs pa dang / stod smad rgyab mdun gyi 'phreng ba gang dgos la byu ru dang g.yu'i 'phreng ba spus legs grangs mtshungs kyi 'gram du gser gyi 'bur sgril yod pa/ phra rgyan ha cang spungs che bas rdzob por ma song zhing / nyung bas thor bu'ang ma yin la/ g.yas g.yon sogs cha mtshungs pas mdzes pa skyed pa sogs mdor na phra rgyan gos 'khyud mdangs sogs gang thad nas phun sum tshogs kyang / gtso bor gyur pa ni spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ mkhas pa tshugs dang tshad la brtag / chags can rgyan dang na bza' lta/ / blun po tshon dang mdangs la brtag / gsungs pa bzhin mkhas pa'i skye bo blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis sku'i chag tshad dang sha tshugs la gtso bor byed dgos so/ / da lta dus dbang gis bzo bo rnams kyang yon len pa'i thabs tsam las lag len chag tshad slob pa dkon pa snang na'ang / ma mtha' mig gis mngon sum du mthong ba 'di lta bu re la dpe bgyis te 'bad na rang la skyed thon cing skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa sogs don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur ro/ / de'ang 'di ltar/ grangs med tshogs gnyis ri mo yongs smin pa/ / mi pham rgyal 451

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/ba'i sku las rang 'dra zhig / skal ldan zhing la mngon mtho nges legs kyi/ / ko ṭa ba dang sā lu gdab pas brel/ / mu mtha' yas pa'i 'gro la brtse ba'i spyan/ / mi mngon chos kyi dbyengs nas gzigs pa'i mdangs/ / me long dag par gzugs bzhin gsal ba yis/ / mos gus rtsol med 'dren 'di a ho rmad/ / yun du bltas kyin mtshan dpe'i nyams rdzogs shing / /yang yang brtags kyin cha tshad 'khrul ba med/ / gzhan dang bsdur gyin cha kun snyoms shing mdzes/ / tshul 'di bsams kyin dga' dang spro ba skyes/ /mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rkang pa drug pa'i glu/ / mkha' la dri za'i 'jig rten rdzogs pa yang / / rgyal sku'i snang brnyan padma'i dga' tshal du/ / babs pas nges shes don gyi zil mngar myong / / margad padma rā ga su gardo / / mu tig g.yu byur spos shel mu men shel/ / rin chen phra tshom sna tshogs me tog gi /'phreng ba mdzes ldan gser bzang ljon pa bzhin/ / thog ma nyid dang ring du 'dris pa'i mig / mtshungs par 'phrog pa bsod nams tshogs kyi sku/ /snyegs ma'i mthar yang mngon sum gyur pa ni/ / rgyal ba'i thugs rje gzugs can nyid du nges/ / brtse ba'i dgongs pa kun tu gtad pa yi/ / nyams 'gyur 'dzum dkar 'od kyis gsal ba 'dis/ / byang chub snying po mchog tu lung ston pa'i/ / rten 'brel thog ma'i sgo 'phar phyes so snyam/ / deng dus dus 'khor sdom 'byung la sogs kyi/ / phyag tshad tshad ldan mkhas las ma bslab cing / / bris 'bur man ngag ngag rgyun ma thos par/ / rmongs pa'i rang bzo bzo bo'i che bar zlom/ / a ho bzo rig las la gzhol ba rnams/ / blo gros mig gis gzhung don blta ba 'am/ / tha na chu bur mig gis 'di 'dra la/ / bltas te dal ba don dang ldan par gyis/ / nang rten rnam pa bzhi las/ chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungs 'jug rgyas bsdus tshar 452

༄༅/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan chosakyi gashlau/bcu/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi rgyud tshar gnyis re/ mtshan brjod tshar gsum/ rdor gcod tshar lnga/ tshe mdo tshar bzhi/ sdud pa tshar gcis byams chos lnga tshar gnyis dang / yang rgyan tshar gnyis/ sman chog rgyas pa tshar gnyis/ bsdus pa tshar gcig 'jug pa tshar gcig byams smon tshar bdun/ smon lam lnga tshar gnyis/ sher snying tshar gsum/ gdugs dkar tshar gcig dga' ldan lha brgya ma tshar lnga/ byams pas dam bca'i gzungs lnga khri sum stong brgyad brgya/ mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs dang tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs sgril bcu gcig re/ sman bla'i gzungs sgril gsum/ tshe gzungs sgril bzhi/ a ra pa tsa stong / ma ṇi sum khri lnga stong /dmigs brtse ma nyis stong / gangs can mkhas grub ma sum brgya/ sgol dkar snying po nyis stong drug brgya/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring brgyad brgya/kun rig rtsa sngags sgril gnyis/ yig brgya dgu brgya/ sku bal dang sku gdung gi ring bsrel yang smṛ ti'i phyag tshwa thub pa'i sku gcig rje'i phyag tshwa'i 'od dpag med dang 'jigs byed/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i pur tshwa/byams sku stong dang bdun brgya/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhi brgya lnga bcu/sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku sna tshogs sum brgya can tshar gnyis/ mi la'i sku sum brgya/ rje'i sku lnga brgya/ sgrol dkar gyi sku bzhi brgya bdun cu/ dzam dkar gyi sku stong dang bdun brgya/ ston pa'i 'phel gdung / chos 'phags kyi tshems kyi dum bu/ sangs rgyas glang po'i gdung gi tshems kyi cha shas/ lha sa'inang rten sangs rgyas mtha' sku me long ma'i cha shas/ nag po spyod pa'i rus rgyan/ nyi lo pa'i bzhugs gdan khri snyan sa la'i pags pa/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshems las grub pa'i ril bu/ pha dam pa'i sgom thagapaṇa chen shākya shrī'i sku chos/ srong btsan sgam po'i na bza' dang zhabs chag 453

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/gi dum bu/ bal po a su'i rdo rgyus kyi sgom thag rwa lo'i dbu lo dang snam sbyar sogs ris med kyi rten sna tshogs/ jo bo rje'i snam sbyar gyi tshal bu/'brom ston pa'i dbu lo/ pu to pa'i dbu nab/ sha ra ba'i sku mtshal/'chad ka pa'i zhabs chag mtsho sna pa'i snam sbyar/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i sku chos/ rgya ma sangs rgyas dpon gyi snam sbyar/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi sku chos/ gnyos rgyal ba lha nang pa'i dbu lo/ lho brag grub chen gyi dbu zhwa sogs bka' gdams gong ma'i skor/ sa paṇa gyi zhun thigs/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku ber/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku chos/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi snam sbyar/ tshar chen gyi dbu lo/bdag chen kun dga' blo gros kyi na bza' sogs sa skya'i rten/ mar pa'i sku per seng ge 'gying gnon/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i na bza'/ mi la'i sgom thag dwags po lha rje'i na bza'/ phag mo gru pa'i sku chos/ garma pakshi'i na bza'/ 'bri gung skyob pa rin po che'i na bza'// thang stong rgyal po'i sgom thag rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa'i na bza'/ 'brug pa pad dkar gyi rta phying / 'brug pa kun legs kye dom gsham/ spyan snga lhag gzigs pa'i na bza'/ grub chen ye shes bzang po'i sku chos/ rnal 'byor byang sems kyi snam sbyar sogs bka' rgyud pa'i skor/ 'jam mgon tsong kha ba chen po'i dbu zhwa/ snam sbyar/ phyag 'phreng rdog gcig rgyal tshab rje'i tshom 'bras/'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gdung ras/ na bza'/ mkhas grub rin po che'i bzhugs gdan/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i snam sbyar/gnas brtan bzang skyong pa'i snam sbyar/ byams chen chos rje'i gser zeb kyi lung ngu / ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ gnas rnying kun dga' bde legs kyi gding ba/ spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi sgu chos/ rje dge 454

༄༅/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan choyokyi garji/'dun grub kyi gdung rus/ mkhas grub nor bzang pa'i snam sbyar/ 'jam dbyangs dga' blo'i snam sbyar/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i na bza'/paṇa chen bsod grags kyi na bza'/ rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/rgyal ba dben sa ba'i dbu zhwa/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dbu lo/paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gye dbu lo/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho'i na bza'/'khon ston gyi dbu zhwa/ sku lnga pa'i dbu lo/ thang sham/ sku rags/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dkon mchog rgya mtshan gyi dbu lo/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyi dbu lo/ gtsang chab ril bu/ pad dkar 'dzin pa'i sku mtshal/ ljags kyi cha shas/ rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs pa'i dbu lo/ rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ sku chos/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dbu lo/ shangs phyis/ sprul sku bsod nams ye shes dbang po'i dbu zhwa'i nang sha ge re bka' bzhi sangs rgyas dbang phyug gi sku chos/ rong po chos pa rin po che'i sku chos/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi gdung rus/ dbu lo/ rje dge legs rgya mtsho'i dbu zhwa/ 'phags pa lha 'jigs med dpal ldan bstan pa'i mgon po'i dbu lo/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi snam sbyar/ 'phags pa lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku chos/'phags pa lha chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu zhwa/ 'phags pa lha 'jigs med bstan pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ 'phags pa lha mthong ba don ldan gyi na bza'/ ba so sprul sku ngag dbang dkon mchog nyi ma'i ḍi rdzar/ ba so sprul sgu ngag dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi sku 'gag ba so sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ rgyal sras sprul sku blo bzang dpal ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ rgyal sras ye shes grags pa'i na bza'/ rgyal sras skal bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ sku mtshal/ brag yab 455

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/sprul sku blo bzang rnam rgyal gyi snam sbyar/ yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i na bza'/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med bang po'i tshems/dbu lo/ zhabs sen/ klong rdol grub dbang rin po che'i gdung ras/stag phu blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gye dbu lo/ stag phu blo bzang chos kyi dbang phyug gi dbu lo/ thu'u bkwan rin po che blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gdung rus/ zhi bzang 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/ lcags rwa sprul sku ngag dbang 'phrin las dpal bzang gi dbu lo/ mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i na bza' sogs ri bo dge ldan ba'i bstan 'dzin dam pa mdo dbus khams su byon pa phal mo che'i byin rten sna re tshang bar bzhugs so/ / gzhan yang bre sgrub tshul bzhin byas pa'i don kun grub pa'i 'khor lo ril bu dang bcas pa/ tshogs bdag dang gnod sbyin 'khor lo tshar gsum re/ byang chub shing gi dum bu/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi lcags shing gi lo ma/ bsil ba tshal gye rdo nag sku 'bum tsardon yi ge can/dga' ldan chos rgyal gyi na bza'/ ri bo rtse lnga'i rdo'i ril bu dang ri lnga'i rdo/kun bzang / stag mo lus sbyin gyi sa/ chu bo gaṅgā'i bye ma/ gangs te se'i bye ma/ tsa ri'i gnas rdo/ lo kyā tun dang a ra ba tsa'i sgrub phugs kyi sa/ko ma sā la garnya dang bya rung kha shor gyi sku dkar/ brag dkar dbu ma rta so/gangs bu le sogs mi la'i sgrub gnas phal cher gyis mtshon rgya bod kyi gnas chen phal mo che'i sa sna/ chos rje don grub rin po che'i gdung gi bdud rtsi ril bu/ gtsang dbus kyi rten bsdus/ skye bdun/ ma ṇi/ bdud rtsi'i ril bu sogs rten sna thor bu'ang bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs so/ / gong smos na bza' sogs bub tshang min yang cha shas 'khrul bral kho na yin te/de'ang rta tshag rje drung rin po che dang sgo mang chos grwa lhan du 'grim skabs 456

༄/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi gashlau/thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur yod pas/ rjes sor khong nas gzhung gi chosasred yongs kyi bdag po mdzad tshe zhus pa bzhin phyag tu gang yod kyi rten sna cha tshang bar gnang bas gzhi byas/ gro tshang dang mdzo mo mkhar/ thu'u bkwan bla brang sogs kyi nang rten dang / khri pa byams pa rgya mtsho'i nang rten rnams rkang tsha'i snang lug yod pa dang / khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyis rje'i gser gdung bzhengs dus nas yod pa'i rten rnying sogs kun bsdoms pa las 'phags bod kyi byin rten 'dzom che ba 'di bzhin byung ba yin pas yid ches kyi gnas su bzung ste phyag mchod gsol ba 'debs pa sogs kyi sgo nas mngon mtho je legs kyi sa bon bskrun par bya'o/ / e ma to bye ba ther 'bum gzugs sku'i skar tshogs la/ / go 'byed chos sku'i ring bsrel go la'i rlung / / yid skyob gdangs su shar ba'i gzungs kyi phreng / / mu mtha' yas pa'i za ma tog tu grub/ / rab mang gzungs dang byin rlabs rten gyi tshogs/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba'i chos sku ro gcig par/ / rab sgrub cho ga lan grangs brgya phrag gis/ / rab tu brtan pa'i rdo rjer byen gyis brlabs/ / 'khor los mthil mdzes zhabs sen reg pa'i rdul/ / sa gsum shis par bsgrubs pa shākya'i tog / gzhan phan thugs bskyed yongs grub rgyal ba'i sras/ / 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇa grub phal mo che/ / khyad par lnga brgya'i gtsug nor a ti sha / lha chos bdun ldan jo bo bka' gdams pa/ / gdan gsum tshang ba rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rje/ / sa skya'i bla chen yab sras brgyud par bcas/ / mar mi dwags brgyud rig 'dzin ras dkar gye/ /'dab ldan gol shor mtha' spangs phyag rgya che'i/ / mkha' la lding ba'i rgod po bka' rgyud sogs/ / sngon byon dam pa'i byin rten tshar du dngar/ / brtan g.yo'i dngos kun kun mkhyen 'od kyis gsal/ / mtha' yas 'gro rnams 457

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i gatshi ༅ma/rnam kun brtse bas skyong / / bdud sde'i dpung tshogs tshogs gnyis stobs kyis bcom/ / phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal dbang grags pa'i dpal/ / sras mchog gnyis sogs dngos kyi zhal slob dang / / paṇa chen snang mtha' pad dkar 'chang ba'i mgon/ / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs/ / 'khrungs rabs bsam 'phel nor bu'i 'phreng bar bcas/ / cod paṇa gser 'od 'gyu ba'i bstan 'di la/ / bshad sgrub bya ba'i ri mo cher bgyed pa'i/ / skyes mchog tshad mar gyur pa ji snyed kyi/ / byin rlabs rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ / sngo dang 'bru sman ril po ma yin gyi/ / sbyor ba tshang bas nad kyi gdung sel ltar/ / 'khrul bral dam pa'i ring bsrel na bza' sogs/ / rten sna 'dzom rnams srid gsum rgud pa 'phrog / zag bcas bsod nams las kyis 'du bgyis pa/ / dbang po'i gtsug nor reg pas lhar bsgyur na/ / tshogs gnyis rig sngags grub pa'i gser 'gyur rtsis/ / reg pas rin chen mchog 'gyur smos ci 'tshal/ /bskal mang bsags pa'i las nyon mun pa'i dpung / / dmigs med dbyings su bskrad de rgyas 'debs pa/ / kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer 'bum 'gyed pa'i/ / rten mchog rta bdun rgyal po'i gzi byin 'bar/ / 'phags bod mkhas grub phyogs brgya'i ri bo las/ / dal gyis babs pa'i byen rlabs rten mang gi / klung brgya gcig tu 'khyil ba'i yid bzhin mtshor/ / dad ldan ngang mo'i tshogs rnams gar byos shig / de'ang rten gyi rgyu mtshan mtha' dag snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pas brjod na rig gnas la sbyangs pa rnams dga' ba skyed kyang phal mo che'i don du 'gyur dka' bas/ brjod don dngos gzhi lhug pa'i sgo nas brjod cing tshigs bcad rnams kyis kyang de la dgos nus ci rigs kyis zur brgyan nas bkod pa yin pas/ dgos pa'i 458

༄za/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi gazlo/gtso bo rten gyi yon tan mthong zhing mos gus bskyed nas thar pa'i sa bon ci zebs byed dgos kyi/ tshig tsam la 'chel bar mi bya ste/ deng dus blo gros cungazad gsal ba rnams kyang snyan ngag gi tshigs bcad dam dum sbyor ba la yon tan gyi mchog tu rlom nas gzhung chen mo la sbyang bar mi byed pa ni zla ba'i sgron gsal las/ zla ba lta 'dod sor mo'i rtse la blta dang mtshungs/ /gsungs pa bzhin yin pas tshig la mi rton don la rton par byed dgos la/brjod don phun sum tshogs pa'i steng nas rjod byed kyang snyan tshig dang 'brel ba byung na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba ni/ rin po che'i gtam gyi spyor ba las gsungs pa ltar yin pas mkhas pa rnams kyis dgongs par bya'o/ / de'ang 'di skad ces bya ste/ sgra don phun tshogs bcad lhug rgyud dang tog / spel bas smra ngan mu stegs klad 'gems shing / / skal bzang skye bo dge ba'i dus ston du/ / 'bod pa'i chos kyi gatrī 'di brdungs so/ /rgyan mang khur lce don gyi bus pa dang / / don gye gzhon nu phyogs kyi gos can rnams/ / rang bzhin gsal byed mdzes pa'i rgyan gsum can/ / snyan ngag rgyal po 'di yi 'bangs su rgyug / mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan sna tshogs su/ / spung zhing gsig pas rna ba tsha ba la/ / rgyan du rlom min rna bar lhan skyes bzhin/ / 'jang ba'i mu tig rna lung don dam rgyan/ / 'on kyang thub bstan dbyar gyi dus ston yol/ / gzhung chen sgra brgya ba rnams sgra med gyur/ / gcam bu'i snyan tshig bser bu g.yu 'brug bzhin/ / phyogs brgyar rgod pas yid skyo'i sru long ldang / / blo ldan dad brtson ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs/ / rjod byed dri bsung kho nas ma ngoms par/ / don zab puṇḍa rī ga'i bcud myang ste/ / rnam grol sbrang rtsi gsog pa'i cho ga mdzod/ /459

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgron me'i gsung 'bum/bzhi pa dge tshogs byang chub tu bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa ni/ rnam dkar gyi phung po 'di'ang sde bzhi'i dpal gyi rim pas thar pa bla na med pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba dang / phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas shing /'jig rten khams su nad mug 'khrug rtsod sogs zhi nas bde 'byor nyams pa med pas 'tsho ba dang / tshe rabs kun tu ma pham mgon pos rjes su 'dzin cingakhyang chub tu lung bstan nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa mtha' dag la slob pa dang / khyad par du byams chos lnga so so'i brjod bya'i lus dang mthun par lam gyi rim pa la bslab nas don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur bsngo ba ni/shugs 'byung norsha gyi shing sna 'phrul sbyor gyis/ / dgos pa'i don chen gzings su bsgrubs pa 'dis/ / rgyu 'bras cho sa tshul rgya mtsho'i 'jings brgal te/ / bla med thar pazhi gling du phyin gyur cig / drang srong dzahru'i zhal sgo las 'ongs shing / / mdo sngags rlabs kyi 'khri shing brgyas rtsen ma/ /bskal ba'i mthar yang mi nyams 'phyur ba yis/ / sa gsum rgud pa'i dri ma 'khrud gyur cig / rtsub 'gyur tshal du zhi dul spyod pas mdzes/ / bre ta pu rir 'byor pa'i rgyag glu len/ / snyigs ma'i mtha' la dzogs ldan dpal 'bar bas/ / srid gsum zag med dga' bas rol gyur cig / rnam dag thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyan mang can/ / dgu gnyis bsgril ba'i dal 'byor srad bu la/ / chad med bstar ba skye ba'i bgrang 'phreng ni/ / ma pham thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dren gyur cig / ma 'ongs tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus kyi tshe/ /ma pham bla mas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung ste/ / ma rnams don du byang chub sems bskyed nas/ / ma lus zeg mchog spyod la slob gyur cig / 'jam mnyen padma'i myu gu gsar ba bzhin/ / legs par brkyangs pa'i phyag g.yas 460

༄/ /dkar chag gdangs snyan chosakyi gaṭī/skyabs sbyin ni/ / spyi bor bzhag ste bla med byang chub tu/ / lung bstan phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob shog / gang zhig shes par bya ba kun mkhyen me/ /gang zhig sgrub par byed pa'i sbyor ba chu/ / gang zhig zag med chos kun bsags pa'i sa/ / gang gang ji ltar gsungs bzhin 'grub par shog /theg mchog rigs kyi sa bon myu gur brtas/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i drod gsher gyis bskyagangs pas/ / rgyal sras spyod ༷ yal ga'i phyogs dzogs te/ /spadās rtogs 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud par shog / chos kun maston nyid mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ / mthong ba sdib byed rab rib kun sel ba'i/ / gnyen sto de nyid rtogs pa'i mig sman gyes/ / bla med zegu pa'i 'jug ngogs gsal byed shog / khyad par cho1sa can rgya che kun rdzob dang / / chos nyid spros bral zab mo gnyis med don/ / ji bzhin rtogs nas tshogs gnyis spyod pa yis/ / rgyal ba'i chos gzugs sku gnyis 'grub par shog / mdor na mardog gsum thugs rje'i mthu la brten/ / ma dag khasnas kyi dri ma yongs sbyangs nas/ / byadu chub snying po yon tan gter thob ste/ /'phrin lashā bzang pos 'gro kun sgrol gyur cig / ces lung ston byams pa'i dkar chag gdangs snyan chos kyi galbo zhes bya ba 'di ni gtsug lag lta ba'i blo mig yangs pa sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dgas bskul te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang skul ba po nyid kyis bgyis pa 'di'ang 'gro kun byams pa mgon pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /461

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i 0sa'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / bde ba can gyi zhing gi yon tan sems pa dang sbrags te smon lam 'debs tshul byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru a mi tosnye wā ya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhing mchog sgo 'byed dang 'brel bar zhing gi yon tan sems pa dang sbrags te smon lam 'debs tshul ni/ bde smon gyi gong ngam/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa gtso bor byed na/mdo las/ de la dad pa zhing der skye/ / zhes zhing gang du 'pho'ang der skye ba'i 'dun pa de'i rgyu'i gtso bor gsungs pas/ 'od dpag med spyi bor spyan drangs te rtsa dang thig le gsal btab zin nas gsol 'debs kyi gong der bya la/ de'ang g.yam la rgyug tsam ma yin par blo gting nas 'khul ba'i gdung shugs dang bcas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis/ / bslu med bden par gsung ba'i mdo sde las/ / gang gis phra rab rdul snyed 'jig rten khams/ / bshig cing bshegs te rdul du byas gyur pa/ / de bas mang ba'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnams/ / rin chen bkang ste sbyin pa byin pas ni/ / gang gis dpag tu med pa'i 'od mtshan dang / / bde ba can gyi yon tan khyad 'phags rnams/ / thos nas dga' ste thal mo sbyor byed pa/ /bsod nams 'di yi char yang 'gyur ma yin/ / de lta bas na de bzhin gshegs de yi/ / yon tan thos nas mgu dang dad skyed la/ / bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams mchog tu/ / 'gro bar bya phyir mos pa drag po skyed/ /462

༄/ /smon lam 'debs tshul byin rlabs myur 'jugagasungs phyir dus gsum dge tshogs ci mchis pa/ / gcig tu bsdoms te zhing mchog der skyes nas/ / 'od dpag med mgon gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ / 'dod dgur spyod pa'i rgyu ru bsngo bar bya/ / mi mjed zhing nas nub kyi phyogs nyid du/ / bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong sangs rgyas kyi/ / zhing khams rnams ni 'das par gyur pa na/ / rmad byung bde ba can zhes bya ba yod/ /de ni sa gzhi rin chen du mas spras/ / shin tu nyams dga' lag mthil lta bur mnyam/ / rin chen las grub ri bo ma gtogs pa/ / nag po'i ri rnams kun gyis dben zhing gtsang / mdzes shing yid 'ong rnam dag zhing gi mtha'/ / rin chen bdun gyi chu shing lngon pa dang / / rin chen ta la'i shing gi 'phreng ba yis/ / yongs su bskor bas skar mas zla ba bzhin/ / bdag sogs kun gyi rnam dkar dge tshogs kyang / / khyod kyi dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang 'dres mthus/ / mi gtsang sdug bsngal nyes tshogs mthar bskrad de/ / ljon mdzes rin chen ri bos bskor ba'i mthil/ / me long ngos ltar mnyam la dwangs shing gsal/ / phyogs mtshams kun tu go skabs ches yangs pas/ /mig dang yid la spro ba'i mchog spyin pa/ / zhing mchog bde ba can der skye bar shog / gser dngul beeḍūkhye dang shel dang spug / mu tig dmar po rdo yi snying po ste/ / rin chen bdun las grub pa'i ljon pa la/ / yid la bsam dgu'i rgyan bzang dpag med 'phyang / / shing gi rtsa ba sdong bu yal ga sogs/ / 'jam zhing reg na bde ster dri zhim ldan/ / dri yi bzhon pas bskyod tshe rnar snyan pa'i/ / mnyan pas chog mi shes pa'i sgra rnams 'byung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshogs kyis rtsol med du/ / byin pa'i lha yi gos dang rgyan gyis spras/ / me tog sil mar bkram byas 'dzin ma'i ngos/ / mnan na nem pas lus sems bde dga' skyed/ / khyad par dri zhim rlung gis bskul ba 463

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/las/ / nor bu'i yal 'dab bskyod pa'i snyan 'gyur dbyangs/ / rna ba'i bcud len zab mo'i don ldan pas/ / rtag tu chos kyi 'du shes skyed gyur cig / dag pa'i sems can rnams kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ / yid 'dzin ta ma la dang a ka ru/ / rgya spos tsardon sbrul snying gis bsgos pa'i/ / nyal 'gro'i rgyun rnams sgra snyan sgog cing 'bab/ / dwangs bsil chab kyis dri ma kun sbyong zhing / / mu tig lbu ba 'thor ba'i rlabs 'phreng dang / / 'jo sgeg gar gyis rtsen pa'i bya tshogs kyang / / gdangs snyan chos kyi sgra yis sim byed shog /rab 'byams smon lam stobs las 'ongs pa yi/ / rin chen padmos bskrun pa'i 'od zer rtser/ / dam chos sbrang ste'i dga' ston 'gyed pa yi/ / sprul sku sa gdul bya'i bung ba tshim par mdzad/ / dpag tshad du ma'i khyon 'gengs 'dab ma'i rtser/ / bye ba brgya stong so drug grangs snyed kyi/ / rgyal rnams 'ja' tshon 'od phreng la gnas pas/ / dgyes pa'i zhal bstan gsung gis dbugs 'byin shog / yid kyi re ba rdzogs byed longs spyod rdzogs/ / phun tshogs 'byor pas sa dang bar snang kun/ / mi mnyam med par yongs su dkrigs pa ni/ / gser gyi gzhi la chu gter chen po bzhin/ / khang bzang gdan khri bla bre rnam bkra zhing / / mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ / mkho dgu'i dngos po ma tshang med bstabs pas/ / zag med dga' bde'i dpal la rol gyur cig / dag pa'i sems can las bzang gis sprul pa/ / mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyi lus ni rab tu mdzes/ / yon tan du mas rgyud ni legs par gtams/ / gnas skabs kun tu chos kyi dga' bas 'tsho/ / glog bzhin 'khyug pa'i thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / zhing mang bgrod nas rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru/ / rab 'byams tshogs gnyis bskrun nas slar yang ni/ / rang gi zhing du dga' bdes rol par mdzad/ / de lta'i 464

༄/ /smon lam 'debs spyo byin rlabs myur 'jugagrogs mchog mngon shes lnga ldan zhing / / rgyal ba kun la bsod nams lhag par byas/ / gsung gi bdud rtsi myang bas nyin re bzhin/ / bla med byang chub sa la nyer 'gro ba/ / de dag rnams dang spyod tshul lta ba kun mtshungs par spyad de blo dang brtson pa'i shugs/ / nya gang zla ba'i zer gyis reg pa yi/ /dbyar gye chu gter ji bzhin rgyas gyur cig / khyad par snang mtha' yas pa'i thugs kyi sras/ / phyag na padma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ / ye shes rgya mtsho sems can rgya mtsho'i phyir/ / snyeng stobs rgya mtshos ma zhum go bgos shing / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung du thugs bskyed nas/ / thos pa rgya mtsho tshol bas ngoms pa med/ / ma lus chos tshol tshul la rab tu mkhas/ / 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtam gyi snying po rtogs/ / chos kyi gtam la nam yang 'jigs pa med/ /rtag tu sems can grol bar byed la brtson/ / de ni 'dren pa'i gtso bo 'od dpag med/ / thub mchog de yi rigs su skyes gyur pa/ / rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob grags ldan dpa' bo che/ / dag pa'i zhing gi rgyal sras rnams yin no/ / brtse ldan de dag rnams kyis bu bzhin du/ / bskyangs pas mi mthun bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / / 'dus pa gcig kyang bgrang gis mi lang ba'i/ / nyan thos tshogs rnams mtha' dag zil mnan te/ / rab 'byams zhing du sprul pa'i zlos gar gyis/ / lus can rmongs pa'i mun pa drungs phyin pa'i/ mdo sngags zung 'jug chos kyi sgron me sbar/ / chos kyi dung bus chos kyi rnga chen brdung / / chos kyi rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtser bsgrengs te/ / rgyal ba kun gye bzhed pa skong gyur cig / zhing mchog de yi nor 'dzin lte ba na/ / sna tshogs nor bu'i rgyan spras dpag bsam shing / / dpag tshad stong dang drug brgyar mngon mtho zhig / yal 'dab khor yug rgyang grags lnga brgyar khebs/ / lo 'bras me tog bzhad pa'i dri bsung rgyas/ / mthong thos 465

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'isgroname'i gsung 'bum/reg pas nyon mongs gdung sel ba/ / de yi rtsa bar yid 'phrog ma lca ras/ / btegs pa'i khri 'phang mngon mthor pad zla'i steng / / rgyal ba'i dbang po byi ru'i lhun po bzhin/ / mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar gzi byin lhang nge ba/ / yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan chos kyi char/ / mkhyen brtse'i sprin gyi phung po las thon pas/ / rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i 'khor gye tshogs/ / rab 'byams zhing nas lhags dang der bzhugs pa/ / mtha' dag smin cing grol bar mdzad bzhin du/ / bgrang yas bskal par 'tsho zhing gzhes par bzhugs/ / bde ba can gyi zhing na 'gro ba'i skyabs/ / ljon pa'i dbang po'i drung na 'od dpag med/ / rgya chen 'khor gyi dbus na brjid pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas bsod nams phung po khyod la 'dud/ / 'dren pa khyod kyi 'od kyi tshogs/ / 'jig rten khams su shong gyur ba/ / kye ma rgyal ba'i zhing gi ni/ / rgya khyon khongs dag shin tu yangs/ / rgyal ba kun gyi zhing gi yon tan rnams/ / khyod nyid gcig pus bdag gir mdzad pas na/ / mi mjed zhing gi sems can 'di dag rnams/ / snyigs ma lnga yi nyes pas sbags sam snyam/ / rab mtho ri yi dbang bo de/ / rab rgyas zla ba'i bzhin ldan zhing / / rab mdzes utpal sngon po'i mig / rab tu ldan na khyod dang mtshungs/ / mkhyen brtse'i yon tan du ma'i dpal 'bar zhing / / 'khor tshogs dbus su legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed/ / srid mtha'i bar du gzhan gyi don bzhugs pa/ / gnas skabs kun tu khyod kyis 'gro kun skyongs/ / mgon po khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa yang / / zhing khams gang du gnas kyang mi bskyud par/ / bde ldan zhing du 'dren par dam bcas pa/ /grub pa'i bden pa bdag la bstan du gsol/ / khyod kyi thugs rje'i dri bzhon gyis bskul bas/ / bdag gi dge ba'i gru gzings 'dir brten nas/ / pha 466

༄/ /smon lam 'deb44 byin rlab4myur 'jugam 'brel thogs rigs drug 'gro kun kyang / / bde ldan nor bu'i gling der skyel bar shog / bgrang yas bskal bar bsags pa'i snod bcud kyi/ /'byor ba'i yon tan mkha' dang mnyam pa der/ / bdag sogs lus can yongs kyis ci dga' ru/ / spyod pa'i bgo skal bzang po myur thob shog / de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi 'phro mthud la/ smon lam gyi grangs su tshigs bcad kyi rim pa 'di dag bskyang bar byas kyang rung ngo / / zhes pa 'di ni dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rab 'byams pa ngag dbang don grub dang dge slong dkon mchog chos grags gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ byin rlabs kyi khyad kyis zhing gi yon tan phal cher rje'i gsung gi tshigs bcad rang sor bzhag nas de dang mthun pa'i smon lam gyis zur brgyan/ rje'i gsung gi tshig lhug pa nas kyang 'ga' zhig kha bskang ste 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni sngags ram pa ratna ā nanta'o/ / / /467

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/ro༅/ / rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i gsang pa'i rnam thar bzhugs so/ /dpal ldan tshogs gnyis chu gter las 'khrungs shing / / spangs rtogs yon tan dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs/ / gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'od dkar can/ / smra ba'i zla ba lus can gtsug na rgyal/ / mi mnyam thugs bskyed dbyar gye dpal mo'i byin/ / rgyal bstan nor 'dzin khyab par spro ba yi/ / sprul pa'i zlos gar padma dkar po'i phreng / / bshad sgrub sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston ci yang rgyas/ / mtha' klas 'gro ba'i khams kyi dzing bu ru/ /brtan g.yo rab 'byams bkod pa'i zla snang 'bum/ / cig char spro yang nyer bzhi'i mkha' dbyings las/ / mi g.yo sku bzhi'i rgyal thabs bla na med/ /stobs bcu'i 'jug pa srid zhi'i dngos kun gyi/ / rjes 'gro rab 'byams rgyal gsung gsang ba'i mdzod/ / grags pa gting yangs rol mtsho'i phyogs cha yang / / dbyangs can ngang mo 'bum gyi rtse dga'i gnas/ / 'on kyang thugs rjes ha ri tsardon gyi/ / grib bsil dge ba'i lam du ngal bso ba/ /gang zhig de yi ngo mtshar bsngags pa yi/ / gtam gyi gling bu bsgyur la spro ba 'dzin/ / 'dzam gling mkhas dang grub pa ma lus pa'i/ / ral pa'i cod pan nor bu'i rkang stegs can/ / chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa zhes/ / snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na g.yo/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / mtshan 'dzin 'pho 'jig g.yul ngo las rgyal 468

༄/ /'jigasamed dbang lo gsang rnam/yang / / 'gro ba'i don slad sprul pa'i zlos gar ni/ / rgya bod mtshams kyi ljongs 'dir bsgyur ro zhes/ / bka' lung 'gyur ba med pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / de nas gzigs pa lnga yis mkhyen bzhin du/ / ḍa ki'i mtshan ldan yum gyi lhum zhugs tshe/ / chos kyi rgyal po rgyal chen rnam sras sogs/ / chos bsrung rgya mtshos g.yel med bya ra mdzad/ / dpal ldan nga/ / dge mtshan ltas dang bcas te bltams pa na/ / 'jig rten skyong rnams lha yi gos bzang phul/ / tshul khrims phung po yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ / gos bzang dran shes nor bu'i ska rags 'chang / / dpal ldan ྾/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo a ti sha / mngon sum gzigs pas dga' ba dpag med 'khrungs/ / paṇa chen du mar 'khrungs pa'i ngang tshul kyang / / rjes dran rnam 'gyur rigs pa'i gad rgyangs bsgrags/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / dge ldan bstan la dbang bsgyur rten 'brel gyis/ / 'jam dpal snying po'i snang brnyan rnyed pa na/ / nyin mtshan kun tu phyag mchod lhur mdzad pas/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas mngon sum rjes su bzung / / dpal ldan ma/ /bag med byis pa'i spyod pa kun spangs shing / / gtsug lag rab 'byams 'bad med thugs su chud/ / don zab snyan tshig spel la thogs med pas/ /blo chen rgan ngo/ rnams kyi snyems pa phrogs/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / cung zad snyun gyis zin tshe pha dam pa/ / mngon sum byon nas gegs sel bsrung ba mdzad/ / yum chen lab sgron dus nas lhan cig tu/ / thugs bskyed smon lam zab mos 'brel bar nges/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / yi dam chos bsrung du ma'i zhal gzigs shing / / phyi nang rten 'brel kun la dbang bsgyur bas/ /ri mo'i 'phrul gyis gdon bgegs dpung bcom ste/ / zla grags sgyu ma'i rol rtsed slar yang bstan/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / 'khrul bral dam pa'i lung gis 469

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'iskyoname'i gsung 'bum/nges rnyed cing / / sngon gnas rjes dran ngo mtshar mdzad bzang gis/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa kun gyi yid 'phrog ste/ / chos kyi khri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / yab gcig blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po yis/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs zab mo'i brda thabs kyis/ / mdo sngags zab rgyas chos tshul ma lus pa/ / ji bzhin nyams su len pa'i gdams par shar/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / 'jam dbyangs gzhon nus mngon sum byen brlab cing / / skyes thob blo gros lus rtsal rab rdzogs pas/ / rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ / smra ngan dpung bcom blo gsal dga' ba bskyed/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang snang stong srin po'i skur/ / bzhengs pa myur mdzad ye shes mgon po yis/ / 'du 'bral med par rtag tu rjes 'brangs nas/ / 'phrin las g.yel med sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / gnam sa'i khyon kun 'gengs pa 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / 'jam dpal bka' sdod las kyi gshin rje yis/ / dge ldan chos kyi gsang mdzod yongs gtad nas/ / bgegs tshogs kun 'joms rdo rje'i g.yar dam bcas/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / rgyal dbang mchog dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen/ / rol ba'i rdo rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sde/ / mai tri'i zhabs sogs yongs 'dzin mang bsten nas/ / sa steng gdams pa kun gye bdag por gyur/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / khengs dang dregs pa'i bag chags ring blangs te/ / sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs pa'i mos gus kyis/ / legs tshogs rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul la/ / gangs ljongs 'di na 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / ngag gi dpal ster 'jam dbyangs dkar po yis/ / mngon sum rjes bzung mkhyen pa'i klong rdol zhing / / tshig don mtha' dag mi brjed gzungs thob pas/ / mdo rgyud 470
