༄/ /'jigalomed dbang po'i gsang rnam/man ngag kun gyi gter du gyur/ / dpal ldan ྾ / / bstod tshig don yod zhags pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ / mngon sum mgron du bkug pa'i dbyangs ldan ma/ / mgrin par 'khyud pas sngon med legs bshad kyi/ / dga' ston spel ba'i spobs pa bla na med/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / sbal ti 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gdan sa ru/ / kun mkhyen gong ma'i dus bzhin a tsaryas/ / sku tshe'i tshad dang mdzad pa 'phrin las sogs/ / 'byung 'gyur mtha' dag ma nor lung bstan mdzad/ / dpal ldan nga/ / dpal ldan 'bras srungs chos kyi sde chen nas/ / 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ / yi dam lha tshogs rten dang brten pa rnams/ / mngon sum gzigs shing byin rlabs dga' ston myong / / dpal ldan ྾ / / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs lhur mdzad kyang / / thol byung tshul gyis 'byung 'gyur bslab bya sogs/ / gang stsal rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin cung zad kyang / / dus las mi yol sgrib med mkhyen pa'i gter/ / dpal ldan ma/ / pha rol sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs dang / / som nyi'i dra bar chud rnams ma zhus kyang / /gdul bya'i mos pa ji bzhin gzigs pa yis/ / gsal bar 'doms mdzad thar pa'i sa mkhan mchog / dpal ldan ma / / paṇa chen mchog dang thugs yid gcig 'dres te/ / dgos dbang khyad 'phags gzigs pas yab srasaganyis/ / bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung gnas rwa sgreng du/ / zhal 'dzom dag pa'i snang ba 'byams su klas/ / dpal ldan ྾ / / mdo smad yul gyi gdan sa chen po kun/ / 'khor lo gsum gyes skyong bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ / spyan ras gzigs kyis lung bstan bskul ma mdzad/ / gzhan phan snying rje'i rol pa kho nar nges/ / dpal ldan nga/ / grub pa'i zhing mchog dben gnas thar pa rtser/ / zab gsang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas tshe/ /471

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/te ru ka dpal rten dang brten pa yi/ / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i snang ba mngon sum gzigs/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / 'dzam gling che dgu'i snying stobs las 'das pa/ / bgrang yas 'khor tshogs rims nad du kha las/ / sgrol la 'jigs bral grub pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ / paṇa chen snang mtha'i 'phrin las ru mtshon bsgreng / / dpal ldan ྾/ / chu klung 'khrugs pas 'dab 'brel grong khyer che/ / bcom pa'i khrod nas nyid la skyabs tshol rnams/ / nyer 'tshe las grol snod bcud rten 'brel la/ / mnga' bsgyur nam yang bslu med skyabs kyi mchog / dpal ldan ྾/ / gzhan gyi rbad 'dre gdon bgegs nad rims dang / / sad ser than pa la sogs nyer 'tshes kun/ / spyan dmigs tsam dang bden tshil re res kyang / / lhag med zhi mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug che/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / bo dong dgon par 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ / 'ol khar lha chen po de gung rgyal dang / / rgyun gyi 'byon bzhud la yang rma rgyal sogs/ / dkar phyogs skyong ba kun gyis bsu skyel mdzad/ / dpa' ldan ྾/ / chos 'khor lha sar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang / / gdan sa chen por yab rje'i snang brnyan gyis/ / snyan shal bzhes shing dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ / dge ldan bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / dbus gtsang gnyis dang mdo smad ljongs kun tu/ / dbang khrid man ngag gdams pa ma lus pa/ / mkhas grub kun la lan brgyar spel ba yis/ / gsang chen bstan pa'i me ro rmad nas gsos/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin mtha' klas pas/ / sa steng kun tu khyab kyang rang don la/ /sred pa'i 'dun pa cha tsam ma 'dres par/ / bden pa'i tshig gis zhal bzhes thub pa mchog / dang la ldan nga/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pas mkhas kun 472

༄/ /'jigs med dbang po'i gsang rnam/gtsug gi rgyan/ / mthu stobs nus pas grub rigs tshogs kyi rje/ / 'phrin las bzang pos 'jig rten kun gye mgon/ / thub bstan yongs kyi mnga' bdag drin can rje/ / dpal ldan nga/ / mtha' bral de nyid mngon sum gzigs pa yis/ / dngos 'dzin 'ching ba'i dra ba kun bcad cing / / zab lam rim gnyis rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas/ / tha mal snang zhen dri ma ma lus sbyangs/ / dpal ldan ྾ / / 'gro kun mi pham mgon gyis rjes 'dzin cing / / nyid kyi zhal skyin la dgongs byams mgon gyi/ / snang brnyan gsar bskrun rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ / ye shes mngon sum zhugs pa'i gzi byin 'bar/ / dpal ldan nga/ / 'brom rjes stong chen thig le'i spro bsdu bzhin/ / gzugs sku'i bkod pa dbyings su sdud pa'i brdar/ / gre phugs a yig 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ / skal ldan du ma'i mig la mngon sum bstan/ / dpal ldan ྾/ / rab 'byams rgyal pa'i 'khor lo ma lus pa'i/ / gsang gsum yon tan me tog sil ma'i phreng / / tshom bur bsdus pa dkon mchog gsum gye dngos/ / 'jigs med dbang po srid zhi'i gtsug gi rgyan/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / de ltar dad pa'i yid kyi rnga yab rtses/ / zab gsang yon tan chu yi phung po las/ / cha tsam spel ba'i bdud rtsi'i zegs ma ni/ / bdag gzhan bsod nams myu gu'i gsos su 'grem/ / de yi dge bas dal 'byor rten gyi gzings/ / thos bsam bsgom pa'i bdan gyes mdzes pas/ / phra rags 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho bsgral gyi bar/ / ded dpon mchog gis rtag tu skyong gyur cig / srid la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i nges 'byung dang / / gzhan phan khur du 'khyer ba'i byang chub sems/ / rgyal ba dgyes byed yang dag lta ba rnams/ / zung du 'brel ba'i lam bzang mngon gyur shog / de nas gsang ba sngags kyi lam zhugs 473

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/te/ / dngos grub rin chen gter gyi sgo gcig pu/ / rnam dag dam tshig sdom pa cha tsam yang / / mi nyams srog dang bsdos te bsrung bar shog / dag pa'i 'khorayo 'dab brgyar grol ba las/ / lhan skyes bde chen sbrang rtsis myos pa yis/ / zung 'jug 'dab yangs g.yo ba'i rkang drug gis/ / chos kyi sgra dbyangs rtag tu sgrogs gyur cig / / /ces dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi zhal skyin/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bka' drin mtshungs zla med pa rje btsun dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ / mdo dang sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gnad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug dam pa rgyud pa dpon slob dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rdo ram pa skal bzang dpal 'byor/ rab 'byams pa mtha' yas rgya mtsho/ / dka' bcu 'jam dbyangs nor bu/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ sbyin pa rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs chos grags sogs don gnyer can du mas snga phyir bskul zhing / gtso cher rang nyid tshe rabs kun tu rje btsun snga ma mchog gis 'bral med rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir du dmigs te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar/ /dpal ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi 'du khang chen mo'i yang rtser bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /474

༄༅/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyi4bsngags pa'i rol mo/༄7/ / dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar ba gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor lo rab 'byams gsang ba'i mdzod/ / rin chen 'byung gnas mthu yi rta gdong me/ / bdud rigs mthar byed 'jigs pa'i tsham rngam can/ / grub pa'i dpa' bo bde ba'i rdo rje rgyal/ / gshin rje'i gshed dang mnyam sbyor ro langs ma/ / mi sdug drag mo chen mo'i skur bstan yang / / rgyal gsung dbyangs kyi rang gdangs tshangs sras mar/ / nges pas lan brgyar 'dud do ngag stsol cig / dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ / zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug che/ / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po gang gi gtam/ / gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo'ang yin/ / don bzang sbrang rtsi gsar pa'i ro bda' ba/ / snyan 'gyur yan lag brgyad ldan chus bsgrungs te/ / smra ba'i ljags yangs rtse mos reg tsam gyis/ / yid rab 'phrog pa'i mod la btung 'os 'di/ / rnam dpyod gser sbyangs dag pa'i khams las grub/ / rnam bkra rigs pa'i dar gyi mgul ching can/ / bdag blo rin chen bum bzang las 'ongs pa/ blo 475

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isbyoname'i gsung stem/gsal gzhon nus dad pa'i snyim par longs/ / de la 'dir mkhyen rab mtshungs zla med pa'i rnam dpyod kyi grub gzings la brten nas gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son cing / brtse ba snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur te bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i khur chen 'khyer ba la nam yang mi ngal ba/mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung gis nag phyogs bdud rigs kyi g.yul ngo mtha' dag ming gi lhag mar byas te mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor sgrengs par byed pa'i rje zitsun bla ma dam pa grub ba'i dbang phyug chen po blo bzang don grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las/thun mong du grags pa mdor bsdus tsam zhig gtam du bsnyad par bya ba la/dang por mkhyen pa'i yon tan las brtsams te rigs phun sum tshogs par skyes nas thos bsam ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ bar du brtse ba'i yon tan las brtsams te bstan 'gro'i don sgo du ma nas khur du bzhes pa'i tshul/ tha mar nus pa'i yon tan las brtsams te bdud rigs kyi nyer 'tshe rmeg med du bcom nas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pas bzhed dgongs lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gsum gyi sgo nas shes par bya'o/ / dang po ni/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i 'phrin las gser gyi shing rta'i kha lo sgyur ba'i thugs bskyed dus babs kyi dbang gis kun mkhyen bla ma dgung lo nyer drug la phebs pa'i chu glang gi lor rje 'di mdo khams smad kye sa'i cha rgya bod kyi so mtshamasakhri kha'i yul phyogs su yab bla ngag dge bsnyen bya ba'i sras su bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes/ 'khrungs tsam nyid nas sngon goms bzang po'i bag chagasayongs su sad pa'i dbang gis bag med pa'i ngang tshul ring du dor te/spyod lam dul zhing sku byin chags pas skye bo kun gyes mthong na dga' ba mig gi bdud rtsi gsar pa lta bur gyur/ cung zad nar son pa nas dam pa'i spyod 476

༄༅/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chosakyis bsngagasapa'i rol mo/pa shugs 'byung du gnas pa'i dbang gis gzhan gyis bslab pa la mi ltos par dman mchog gi zhing la brten nas bsod nams kyi myu gu bskrun pa dang /sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i skye bo mthong ba na shas mi bzod pa'i snying rje skyes tede'i don la brtson pa dang / 'bu srin phra mo la yang gnod 'tshe spong ba sogs blang dor phyin ci ma log par mdzad pas yul mi rnams kyang 'di lta bu'i byis pa ya rabs ces ya mtshan pa'i dper byed pa byung / dgung lo drug gi thog la mo bde chen du khu bo rab 'byams pa zhig yod pa'i rtsar klog slob tu phyin pas dka' tshegs med par thugs su chud/ khu bo rab 'byams pa yang shin tu yid mgu nas mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du gces par bskyangs/ cho ga chosaspyod sogs kyi dpe mang du phul te gzigs su bcug pa rnams la lan re gnyis tsam bklags pas 'dzin thub pa dang / gang bzung thams cad ma bsnyel ba byas te skyor sbyang la yang brtson pa khur du bzhes/ khyad par du yi dam 'jigs byed dang gsang bdag/ chos skyong chos rgyal dang lha mo rnams la tshe rabs du mar 'brel ba'i bag chags kyi dbang gis thugs zhen che bas bdag gir bzhes te mngon rtogs gtor chog bzlas pa sogs chag med nan tan che bar mdzad/ rab byung dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa nas bzung blang 'das so drug gis mtshon pa'i bcas rang gi ltung ba phra rags thams cad la shin tu 'dzem zhing / sgo gsum bag yod pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas te yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rmang gzhi tshugs par mdzad/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ / sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhi tshul khrims gtsang ma'i steng der thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral ba zhig dgos pa'i dbang gis/gnas chung sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen pos/ lhan ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag 477

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronatse'i gsung 'bum/khang dang / se 'bras sogs kyi bkod pa rmi lam du bstan pa'i rkyen gyis gsan sbyong la dbus gtsang phyogs su phebs 'dod thun mong ma yin pa 'khrungs/ sngon gzhan phan rlabs po che bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams kyi rgyu mthun las thugs bzhed gang yin bde blag tu 'grub pa zhig yod cing dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis kyang 'phrin las sdongs grogs mdzad pa'i ༵ rdodī ༷dī dhrisdidū nghrurnyi trī~X ༈༵ ṭwāṃdisapo ༷ra phe ༷༷gas bhe dīdingarna ༷ didzhai dī / ༷ byon lnga ldan sogs la snyan shal phul te thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin pa'igasol 'debs dang smon lam shugs drag gnang bar legs pa'i mtshan ma shar/ gangs can bstan pa'i 'byung khungs dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi grwa tshang bzhi'i ya gyal/ /gur dkar po'i tog lta bu/ mkhas grub bye ba'i bste gnas bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ bdag nyid chen po dpon slob don grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung nas bsdus grwa'i rtse bzhag thog mar gsan/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya bral dge 'dun phun tshogs dge rgan du bsten nas rtsi bzhag dang sbyor ba rtsi ba sogs la chig dril du 'bad pas ring po ma lon par rigs lam gyi sgo phye ste rtsod grwa shin tu dmar ba byung / lo gcig gnyis kyi khungs su bsdus grwar grags pa tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rigs pa'i sgo du ma phyogs gcig tu dril ba dang / blo rtags sogs rtog ge'i gsang tshig ma lus pa thugs su chud/dpon slob rin po che nas dgyes gzigs shin tu che zhing / smra ba'i spobs pa bla na med pa'i grags pa dang bcas 'dzin grwa thod rgal gyis gzhung gsar du phebs/ rgyan rtsa 'grel/ rnam bshad/ gser 'phreng / kun mkhyen chos 'byung gi yig cha rgyas bsdus sogs rgya bod kyi gzhung du ma blo 'dzin dang 478

༄/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang ra chosakyis bsngagasapa'i rol mo/dpe klog ci rigs kyi sgo nas nges par byas te/ thams cad gung bsgrigs nas dpyad pa zhib mor gnang bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbas don mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa mtha' dag la nges shes gting tshugs pa rnyed/phar phyin gyi rtsod pa ji tsam 'phel ba bzhin gyi de thams cad gzhan dang shag 'gyed pa'i thabs tsam ma yin par/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len gyi man ngag kho nar gzigs te chos kyi mde'u sne nang du bskor ba'i dbang gis thugs rgyud je dul dang / bsags sbyangs sogs kyi nyams len la brtson pa je cher song / bya ba gang la yang dang por thugs kyi 'phen pa gnang ba de'i steng nas rdo la ri mo bris pa bzhin 'da' bar mi mdzad pas/ shas cher nyin mtshan khor yug tu thugs dam gtsor 'don dang / chos mtshams kyi nyin kha shas re la rtsi bzhag thugs 'dzin zhag kha shas re'i mtshams su rtsi bzhag mtshan skyongagis bcad gnang ba'i dus thog der kha char bu yug sogs rkyen ci byung yang de'i dbang du mi gtong bas brtsams pa mthar 'don pa mdzad/ 'on kyang thugs rab che zhing brjed pas chung bas thal 'phreng zur bkol rje yab sras kyi gsung skabs su gang babs sogs skyor rgya shin tu che ba la/ grwa thog de na sus kyang 'gran du med par grags/ de nas dpon slob kun dga' 'od zer gyi drung nas dbu mdzod 'dul ba gsum la gsan sbyong mdzad/lhag par dbu ma'i skabs su gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi lta ba'i gnad 'tshol ba la 'phags pa rtag tu ngu lta bu'i don gnyer gyi 'dun pa ha cang shugs drag pa'i stobs kyis rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal stag lung grags pa'i dbu ma/ dbu ma'i rnam bshad theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru dzing sogs yig cha mi 'dra ba bdun bzung ste skyor sbyangs mdzad/ 'di 'dra ba mtshan nyid pa'i ston chen gzhan su la byung ba'i sgos tsam yang dkon par snang / mdzod 479

༄/ /gung ca bstanapa'isgroname'i g.yo 'bum/kyi skabs su yang chos mngon dang / thar lam gsal byed sogs yig cha du ma 'dzin skyor dang / rtsod pa rdo rus thug pa gnang bas gzhi lnga'i rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ji lta ba bzhin 'byed pa la/ slob dpon rgyal ba'i sras dang mtshungs pa'i mkhyen rab kyi lus rtsal yongs su rdzogs/ khyad par du chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta nyin bdun la dzogs par thugs 'dzin mdzad pas/ thams cad kyis 'di ni gzungs thob pa'i gang zag cig tu the tshom mi 'dug ces bsngags pa'i rol mo 'khrol/ 'dul ba'i yig cha thugs la bzung ste/ lung sde bzhi/ mdo rtsa 'grel/ gleng 'bum sogs la zhib tu sbyangs pas dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bcas mtshams ma lus pa thugs su chud/ kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i zhal sa nas las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa mnos te spong bdun 'khor bcas kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams/ rung chu 'debs pa tshun chad kyi bcas mtshams phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang phyag len la btab ste/ tshig don gnyis ga'i cha nas nges pa don gyi 'dul 'dzin chen por gyur/ de ltar sbyangs yun thung yang skyes sbyang gi shes rab thogs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod kyi gru bo che/ rtag sbyor gus sbyor gyi brtson 'grus mthun pa'i rlung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son te bka' po ta chen po lnga'i dgongs don nor bu'i mdzod la 'dod dgur dbang 'byor/ de dang mthun par dpon slob rin po che nas kyang smon lam grwa skor byed dgos kyi bka' phebs pa ltar dgung lo nyer lnga pa me glang gi lo lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i thog jo bo shākya mu sa'i mdun sar gdan sa gsum gyi mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu tshogs pa'i dbus su dam bca' bzhag ste legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston kun tu bzang po'i mchod sbrin rgya cher spros/480

༄za/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyisabasngags pa'i rol mo/rgyun par nyams len gtso bor gnang zhing / rtsod tshe yang gzhung gi dka' gnad gang zab kyi steng nas go don tshol ba gtsor 'don mdzad pas/gnad ma rtogs pa kha cig gis rigs pa'i brdar sha de ci mchod med snyam pa'i log rtog dang rang lta mchog 'dzin gyi mngon rlom mtho ba'i dbang gis rigs ma gya gyu'i sgrub byed sna tshogs btang bar/ rgya mtsho bzhin du zab cing ku sha'i rtse ltar ma 'dres pa'i mkhyen dpyod kyis rim pa bzhin so sor phye nas lan mdzad pas/ pha rol po dag spobs pa yongs su gtugs te mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas dgos pa byung / de'i tshe grwa sa phan tshun gyi mkhas pa'i dbang bo gzu bor gnas pa thams cad kyis 'di lta bu'i na tshod gzhon nu la yon tan gye gting zin pa zhes bstod bsngags me tog dkar pos mngon par mchod/ lha sa pa rnams kyang sku'i bab dang / lan sgra dag gsal gsum gyi sgo nas myur por mdzad pa'i gsung gi gdangs sogs la brten te 'di 'dra ba'i dge bshes rnam dpyod don pa zhes ngo mtshar ba'i tshad du byed pa byung /sngar kun mkhyen bla ma mchog nas ri bo dge 'phel du byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i nyams khrid smin rgyas lo ltar yang yang gnang pa'i gdams pa'i nying khu ma lus pa thugs kyi dpal be'ur 'chang zhing / da dung yang 'di lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnyed par dka' bas/ mdo sngags zab rgyas kyi gdams pa ma tshang ba med pa zhig zhus te/ dgra med gnyen med kyi bas mtha' zhig tu tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms pa'i nyams len gtsang sang nge ba/ gtan gyi gtsan sazin pa zhig bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag nar mar 'khrungs te/ ji skad du/ rnam smin yon tan 'dab brgyad pazo'i dbus/ / rnam dag tshul khrims dmar ser ge sar/ / rnam 'dren gsung gsang nyi 'od kyis bzung bas/ / rnam mang thos pa sbrang rtsi'i zil mngar rgyas/ / 'on kyang lhag bsam 481

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'isgroname'i khrung lam/dag pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur te bstan 'gro'i don khur du bzhes pa'i tshul ni/de nas lo gnyis kyi sa mtshams su kun mkhyen bla ma sgo mang gi chos khrir bzhugs dgos byung zhing / de sngon bla gnyer sbrag mar byed srol yod pa 'jig rten gyi g.yeng ba'i khur che bas 'chad nyan gyi sad du 'gyur ba dang /de 'dra'i steng nas bla slob kyi dam tshig la yang gnod srid pa'i dgag bya dang dgos pa mang du gzigs te kun mkhyen bla ma mchog nas/ nged kyis chos 'jig rten gnyis ga'i khur 'dzin mi nus par 'dug pas/ khyod kyis sgo mang sde ba byed dgos gsungs par/ gcig tu bla ma'i bka' bsgrub pa las lhag pa'i rang gi nyams len med par bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang rnam thar las 'byung la/ gnyis su bstan pa'i gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde 'di lta bur skabs 'di 'dra la zhabs 'degs rnal ma zhig zhu rgyu byung na/bstan 'gro'i don yang de las lhag pa mi 'dug dgongs te/ mngon rlom gyi 'khang ra dang / mdzes lam gyi dgongs khrol sogs gang yang ma zhus par bka' spyi bor blangs/ deng dus 'ga' zhig de skabs spyi gnyer mdzad pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas chos dang mi mthun pa lta bur dogs pa byed pa ni/rang rang dang rigs mthun pa'i skye bo col chung kha drag dpal 'byor cung zad tsamagyis dbyen sbyos te bag med pa'i las la dga' mgur 'jug pa dag gi spyod ngan gyi dpe/ bdag nyid chen po rnams la yang 'os med kyi rigs pas rgyas bkab par snang ste/ sngon dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun gyi zas gos gnas mal la sogs pa'i gnyer mdzad pa dang / klu sgrub kyis dge 'dun gyi gnyer mdzad skabs gser 'gyur la brten nas 'tsho ba sbyar ba'i lo rgyus dang / jo bo chen pos kyang lha rten yo byad dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzad de lde mig sku rked 'khor ba tsam bsnams dgos byung ba'i lo 482

༄za/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyi4bsngags pa'i rol mo/rgyus sogs mang bas/ bsam sbyor rmad du byung ba de lta bus gnyer gyi las khur bzung ba yang theg pa mchog gi lam gyi nyams len zab mor 'gro la/kun slong ngan na/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ rang don kho nar nor dang tshe sgrub/ / dbang sdud drag po mngon spyod la sogs/ / ngan song sgrub pa'i myur lam yin zhes/ / mdo rgyud kun las gsung ba min nam/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgom sgrub dang 'dag sbyar sogs ji tsam byas kyang 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba las ma 'das pas/ chos dang chos ma yin pa rang sems dpang por byas nas 'jog dgos kyi/ ming tsam la snying po ci yang med do/ / gnyer gyi skabs der yang dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas rang don du cung zad tsam yang mi spyod par jo bo'i rnam thar bzhin mdzad de/dang po grwa khang steng du spo skabs phyag g.yog pas gdan gcig dang / na bza' khur nas song ba/ rjes su phyir phebs skabs kyang de ma gtogs ci yang med pa'i lo rgyus da lta yang grags che/ dge 'dun rnams kyang log 'tsho la sbyor mi rung bar dgongs te/ kha bsag gzhog slong / rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba sogs g.yo 'phrul mi mdzad cing / gzhan gyis dad 'bul dang rgyun gyi yong 'bab gang yod til 'bru tsam yang chud zos su ma btang bar dge 'dun gyi cha rkyen du 'gro nges gnang bas nar ma'i mthun rkyen phul du byin pa byung / der ma zad sngar grwa tshang la mchod gzhis sogs de tsam rgya che ba med kyang / skabs der kun mkhyen bla ma mchog gi thugs bskyed bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po rje de'i thabs mkhas mdzad bzang rgyal mtshan gye rtse mor bkod pa la brten nas/ mchod gzhi gsar ba du ma sogs bzhed don lhun gyis grub pas dge 'dun rnams srid kyi ngos nas chos bsgrub pa'i mthun rkyen gyis phongs pa med par byas/ grwa bgres blo kha mtho ba rnams la rang re'i grwa 483

ro༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/tshang 'chad nyan gyi bshad grwa 'gran zla med pa 'di lta bu zhig gzhan gyi yig cha la brten dgos pa dge mtshan chung zhing / phyin chad 'di lta bu'i bla ma 'byung dka' bas mdzod 'dul gnyis kye yig cha bka' rtsom zhus te po ti lnga cha tshang zhig byung na legs tshul gyi 'char bstan pa bzhin/ thams cad mgrin gcig gis gsol ba btab pas/ don smin byung ste chos kyi ngos nas kyang gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa zhig byung ba'i bka' drin 'di shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar gyi dgon ma lag dang bcas pas gzhal bar dka' ba zhig go / de skabs gtong sgo che phra bstan srid kyi las don sogs thugs khur che yang / de la snyad btags nas bag yangs mi mdzad par/ sde par bzhugs ring la yang bka' 'gyur tshar bzhi gsungs shing thugs dam bzlas brjod 'chag med dang / mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang po thugs 'dzin gnang /khyar par dbu ma lung rigs gter mdzod cha tshang bzung ste dpyad pa zhib mo dang bcas skyor sbyangs rgyun ring mdzad pas sngar yig cha mang du bzung ba las da res blo skyed che bar byung gsungs/ thugs shin tu sgam pas gsung zur de tsam las ma byung yang / rtsod dus kyi rig 'gros phra mo tsam ma yin par lta ba'i gnad la nges pa gting phyin pa rnyed par gdon mi za'o/ / rgyal po lha bzang gis sngar nas kun mkhyen bla ma rigs kyi cod paṇa du bkur zhing / rje 'dir yang las don 'ga' che ba'i gros kyi blo phugs gtad de thugs nang nye ba'i dbang gis phyis bod kyi bstan srid mtha' dag khong gi phyag tu 'byor ba'i tshe dod 'bul sogs ma dgos par stod lung gas po zer ba yang grwa tshang gi phog thebs su gnang / sngar gzhi ga'i yong sdud sogs la ngo tshab gtong bzhin pa yin na'ang / rta zhing gas po gnyis la rang nyid phebs 'dun skyes shing / der rta zhang chos rje'i gzim khang 'thor zhig tu song ba gzigs nas 484

༄༅/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chosakyisabasngag4pa'i rol mo/thugs shin tu skyo ba zhig byung / phyir phebs pa'i tshe kun mkhyen mchog nas/khyodakyi khang ba ga 'dra 'dug gsung bar/ nga'i khang ba gang yin zhus pas/rta zhang chos rje'i khang ba ma mthong ngam/ sngon 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i bu chen khong gi sku tshab byas te rgya nag sogs su song nas/ chos srid kyi 'phrin las rlabs po che spel mkhan lung dang las gas mtho ba'i rta zhang chos rje zer ba zhig byung ba de khyod kyi skye ba snga ma yin gsungs/ skabs der gong ma chen po nas rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho smad la phebs dgos kyi bka' babs pas/ grwa sa phan tshun gyi che drag rnams dge skyon sna tshogs pas dogs gzhi bslang bar/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog nas/ gong ma'i bka' dang 'gal na 'phral phugs gnyis gar gnod tshul zhib bkrol gyis gsungs kyang / bstan pa'i gegs chag lta bus/ gzhan phal cher kha 'cham ste zing cha bslang bas/gnas skabs rgyal ba phebs rgyu bshol ma thub pa'i steng du dgon pa rnams chags 'jig la gya ba lta bu'i chos srid gnyis ga'i cha nas shin tu lod pa byung /de'i tshe rje 'di dga' ldan pho brang du che gnyan thams cad tshogs pa'i sar bos nas tsha 'jug gtong rtsis byas kyang / btsan brjid brling ba'i gsung lan skabs su gang bab thogs med du gnang bas/ shes ldan phal cher la go blo skyes shing dmang ma yang 'jigs chum gyis song nas glags ma rnyed/ de ltar rje 'dis kun mkhyen bla ma'i gsung rting mnan pa'i stobs kyis sgo mang pas rang tsho zin pa byung ste/ phyi'i rgyal khams bskal pa zhig pa lta bu'i tshe yang grwa tshang 'di mtsho la dar chags pa bzhin bde 'jags su gnas pa byung ba'i bka' drin gyi phung po bla na med par gyur/ sngon ston pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bkod pa bstan te/ mu stegs ston pa drug la sogs pa'i smra ba ngan pa thams cad pham par mdzad pa'i tshe 485

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i 0me'i ga4 'bum/yang dngos su dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes de dag btul ba bzhin du kun mkhyen bla ma nyid kyi 'phrin las zhi drag gi byed po yang rje 'di la bka' bab par gzigs te/ nyin gcig mdun du 'bod pa gnang nas/da lta mi tsho tshab tshub che bar 'dug khyod la gnas skabs gnyer gyi las khur lce ba'i 'dug rung shin tu bsgrims dgos pa'i dus yin pas/ de'i steng du dge bskos yang byed dgos pa 'dug der ma zad slar nged rnams phyogs gang du 'gro dgos kyi tshod yang mi thang bas nga'i bsam don thams cad khyod kyes sgrub dgos zhes nang sbyar gyi rgyu mtshan zhib lhugs su gsungs pas bka' dang du blang ste/ dge gnyer sbrag ma mdzad/ phyis su rje nyid kyi gsol 'debs bka' rtsom mar/ 'jam dpal zhi khro dgyes bzhad rdo rje yi/ /bzhed don sgrub la myur mdzad mgon po sogs/ / bstan srung du mas lung bstan chos kyi rje/ / zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan tshul je ltar yin zhus pa la/zhib cha ma gnang yang rdzun du ma song tsam yod ces zhal bzhes mdzad pa yang de dus byung ba yin nam zhes dpyod ldan 'ga' zhig gleng / dge bskos kyi skabs su yang thabs mkhas pas sgo mtha' dag nas/ sgrig lam gyi steng gnon tsha ran snyoms shing le shor med pa mdzad pas/ grwa tshang gzhan rnams su re dogs sna tshogs pas sdug smras dang / gyod bdal gyi gtam las/chos kyi sgra mi grag ba lta bu'i tshe/ sde 'dir 'chad nyan me ltar 'bar bar gyur/ nyin gcig kun mkhyen bla ma mchog nas/ de ring jo mjal du 'gro gsungs rje 'di sogs zhabs 'brang 'ga' dang bcas phebs mchod mjal gyi tshe sku zhabs chos rgyal lha khang du phebs skabs rje 'di cung zad rjes su lus nas phyin pas/ nang na gcig gis sngon klu mes dus nas zer ba'i rgyu mtshan mang po zhig bshad kyin 'dug pa su yin dgongs te nang du phebs pas 486

༄/ /sde khri rin po po gsang chen chosakyisabasngagasapa'i rol mo/srong btsan gyi sku de zhal mor mor 'dzum zhing bzhugs pa gzigs/ slar phebs nas ma mkhyen pa ltar mdzad de/ de nas mang po zhig gsung gin 'dug pa ci yin zhus pas/ 'di da res tsam min/ srong btsan gyi sku 'dis nga nam mjal res kyis gsung 'byon gyin yod gsungs/ 'dis mtshon te sangs rgyas byang sems paṇa grub chos srung du ma'i gzigs snang thun mong ba yang mang du yod la/ kun mkhyen mchog nas kyang / de 'dra'i gzigs snang dang sku 'phreng snga phyi sogs gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi rigs rje 'di la cung zad kyang spa gsang mi mdzad pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i chos kyi bdag por nges pa'i gtan tshigs 'khrul ba med pa'o/ /nyin der mdo smad kyi 'byon rgyu'i bskul ma dang bstan 'gro'i don gyi lung bstan du ma stsal pa yin snang ste/ de nas ma 'gyang bar yul mdo smad kyi sa'i tshangs pa chen po dga' ldan er ti ni ju nang gis mi sna gtos che ba mngags pa rnams 'byor/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog mdo smad kyi bstan 'gro'i spyi dpal dam par phebs dgos kyi zhu ba nan can phul bar lo rjes mar phebs rgyu'i zhal bzhes mdzad/ rje 'di la sngar nas gsung zur yang yang gnang ba ltar phyag phyir 'byon dgos kyi bka' phebs shing / de skor gyi nyer bsngogs 'gang che'i rigs rnams khong la gtad de kun mkhyen bla ma nyid nas dgun gyi ring lam gyi gegs sel dang / dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi don la dmigs pa'i thugs dam bcad rgya gnang / 'byon kha'i tshe phyag mdzod rab 'byams pa ngag dbang glo bur du grongs pa'i rkyen gyis rje 'di phyag mdzod du bskos te phyi nang bstan srid kyi bya ba thams cad phyag tu gtad/ nyid kyi dgongs pas gang bcad la kun mkhyen mchog nas kyang bsgyur bkod gtan mi mdzad cing / bkod khyab gang gnang gi mtshams las drag zhan su yang 487

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgronalnga'i khrung 4ma/'da' mi nus pas/ las don che phra thams cad gra 'grig cing bab chags pa mtha' rjes gtsang bas rang skyid gzhan smon gyi gnas kho nar gyur/ phebs khar byang rtse mkhan rin po che dge 'dun phun tshogs nas nyid la ja sral dang phebs rdzongs zur du bstar te/ kun mkhyen bla ma 'di ni nges par sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'am/ rje tsong kha pa slar phebs pa dang khyad par med mod kyang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa gal che/ mdo smad du phebs na yul lugs dang bstun pa'i 'jig rten gyi mthun 'jug sbyin bdag gi ngo 'dzin/ 'jam sar 'jam pa/ tsub sar rtsub pa/ bya ba gang la yang mtha' rjes thon pa zhig byed dgos/ lhag par phebs don gyi gtso bo mchod yon thams cad shugs lang yod pa'i thog 'dir rje bla ma'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bshad sgrub tshang ba'i dgon sde khyad par can zhig gi rmang gzhi myur du zin pa gal che/ zhabs 'brang mang yang gtso cher khyed rang la thug yod pas/sgrims dgos zhes bslab bya rus pa can mang du stsal/ spyir yang mkhan rin po che 'di ni chos phyogs la 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang zhal mi gnyis par ma zad/'jig rten la yang mes po tshangs pa'i blo gros dang 'dra ba'i spyan ltos kyis rje 'di yang thams cad la mkhyen pa ha cang rgyas pa yin zhes ngag rgyun la zer/lam nas bod skyong lha bzang han gyes kun mkhyen bla ma phebs rdzong gi 'bul ba rgya cher btegs shing / rje 'di la sger du dzong cha gya nom pa mdzad/ sog chu khar phebs pa'i tshe chu shin tu brub nas/ rab ma thod par yod pa la/ kun mkhyen mchog nas phyag rdo gnang zhing rje 'di la/ khyod nus pa che bas chu la rdo rgyob gsung ba ltar nyid kyis rdo kha shas chu nang du 'phangs pas/ de ma thag 'dom gang tsam bri nas bde bar brgal thub pa byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar dang dad pa'i sa la bkod/ rim gyis phebs nas rtse gzhung du 'byor 488

༄༅/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyiyobasngags pa'i rol mo/ma thag sa mo glang gi lo 'di rje rin po ches dga' ldan phyag 'debs gnang ba'i lo yin/ rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis lo 'dir dgon pa 'debs rgyu'i skar 'dzin tsam byed dgos/ khyed rang rnams rgya sgar dang tog ti sogs gnas bzang ba zhig tu song la bkra shis gso sbyong dang sa brtag bslang sogs kyes zhes rje 'di sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po kha shas gtong bar mdzad/ de'i tshe so thar gyi mdo 'don pa po yang rje 'di la dmigs kyis bsal nas bka' phebs pa ni bstan pa'i rmang gzhi 'dzin pa'i smon lam gyi mabagrub pa'i dge mtshan du mngon/ der ma zad rgyun du bsgrub bya du mar bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba'i tshe yang zhabs 'brang du dge ba'i bshes gnyen ci tsam yod kyang / rje 'di la las slob byed du bcug pa ni bstan pa'i rtsa ba chos 'dul ba'i nyams len dang / cho ga phyag len bshad pa'i rgyun sogs cha thams cad nas bla ma'i thugs zin pa'i rnam par thar pa shin tu 'gang che ba zhigago / de'i rjes ma so brgyad pa lcags stag la bkra shis 'khyil du dgon gnas gzigs par phebs skabs kyang sngon ma cig yum sras kyi bag chags sad pas/ rang khyim la skeb pa lta bu'i spro nyams dang bag phebs pa byung ste/de'i gnas lugs bshes gnyen chen po rje ngag dbang bkra shis dang skog tu gsung 'phros kyang byung bar snang / de nas kun mkhyen bla ma'i grags snyan lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs kyis sa steng kun tu khyab pa'i dbang gis phyogs ris med nas bla ma dge bshes dpon che chung sogs dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin du 'dus pa thams cad la 'os bstun gye gzhis len/ bla brang 'du khang sogs kyi ar so'i bkod khyab dang gnang cha/ grwa tshang gsar tshugs kyi 'grig lam gong du snyan sgron dang las sne rnams kyi steng gnon zhi drag 'os 'gab sogs mdoran lugs gnyis char dang 'brel ba'i phyi nang gi bya byed thams cad kyi 489

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgronamatha ཿnga 4ma/gzhung bsring ste thabs kyi sgo gang zab nas bsgrubs pas ma 'gyang bar dgon gnas mchod gzhis dang bcas pa'i rkang tshugs pa byung / de ltar zhabs 'degs kyi las don gtso che ba rnams re zhig tshags su tshud cing / sku khams cung zad ma bde ba dang bcas phyag mdzod kyi khur phog ste/ lo mang po'i bar du sku mtshams gnang nas/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa dang rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor la nyin mtshan khor yug tu gzhol bar mdzad cing / lha tshogs du ma'i ljags bsnyen yang phal ba'i blo yul las 'das pa lta bu gnang /de skabs su yang kun mkhyen mchog nas sku don gzhi che ba'i rigs mi ched mngags kyis dri ba gnang ste dgongs pa'i gtad so mdzad pas 'phrin las gdugs dkar gye yu ba lta bur yod/ de nas kun mkhyen bla ma dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad mtshams su grwa slob rnams ci bya gtol med lta bur gyur pa thugs kyis ma bzod pas dgongs rdzogs sgrub tshul sogs kyi bkod khyab dang 'gan khur che bar bzhes/ sku gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i mdun du mchod pa rgya chen po phul te bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbang bzhi'i byen rlabs zhu ba dang / thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs nan tan mdzad/ der zhag lnga'i mtshams su mnal lam la mi mang po zhig gis sku zhabs rin po che phebs kyin 'dug ces 'ur lang bas/ nyid kyang 'byon par brtsams pa na sdig pa ra tsa zhig zhabs la 'tham byung brdog dzis byasanas bsad de gzim chung phug la phebs pa na sku zhabs mi bzhugs par rgyal mtshan gsar ba zhig 'dug pa brtan por byas te snyan shal zhig phul nas 'jog pa rmis/ 'di ni slar dam sri'i bar chad sogs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar mchog sprul gdan sar phebs pa'i khur bzhes dgos pa'i ltas su gsal/de'i rjes su yang dgon pa'i spyi don gal che skabs re gnyis ma gtogs lo 490

༄/ /sde khri rin po lo gsang chen chosakyisabasngag4pa'i rol mo/grangasabacu skor tsam gyi ring dgon pa'i nang dang dben pa'i ri sul du mar bcad rgya 'ba' zhig mdzad/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor phul tu phyin pas yi dam gyi lha du ma zhal gzigs shing dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis 'azin las g.yel med sgrub pa'i g.yar dam phul/ skabs shig mtsho sngon nang zhig gi stabs kyis dpon ju nang rgya nag tu phebs/ bstan 'dzin wang gi dmag 'ongs nas ju nang gi sde ba dgon pa'i mchod gzhis dang bcas pa brgyab pa'i don du/ khri rin po che ngag dbang bkra shis/ rje 'di dang bcas pa phebs te bstan 'dzin wang dang phrad/ wang nas khyed tsho ju nang gi mdzod dang su rug gi bdag po yin 'dug ces ma rangs pa'i gtam dang dgon par dmag 'ong rgyu'i tshig zur btang bas/ rje 'dis 'o na khyod bstan 'dzin ga la yin/bstan pa bshig rgyu red mod/ nged rnams ju nang phebs pa'i rjes la 'gro ma thub kyang de'i shang su dug la bdag byed pa bab 'brel yin/ nged tsho'i mi sde sogs phyir sprod dgos zhes do ma bsrung bar/ gzhung bzang po'i drang gtam thal byung du gsungs pas/ wang gis kyang rje 'di'i sku dang gsung gi zil ma bzod pas/ lan tsha drag zhu ma sbob par slar gros byed ces lhod byin/dgung der wang la shangs khrag rdol zhing / je sang gdug pa can 'ga' zhig gzer thung gis zin pas khong rnams kyang som nyi'i dra bar chud de phyi nyin nas bab phul zhing / ru sde der yod thams cad phyir sprad de mi mthun pa'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i grub pa'i mtshan ma mngon du bstan/ bstan 'dzin wang nas gus 'dud lhur blangs pa na/ 'ga' zhig gis bka' shog cig kyang blang na zhus par kho rang tsho gar 'gro ci shes gsungs nas rtsol ba ma mdzad pa ni 'byung 'gyur rjen par gzigs pa'i gsung du mngon/ de rjes tsam la rgan kya parnyi tas kyang dgra bsdod lag sbrel gyi rnam pas/ dgon pa'i gnas kyi 491

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i ga4 'bum/don du rtsod pa bslang ste rgya'i dpon chen zhig kyang bab par/ rje 'dis zab cing brling pa'i bden gtam yid la 'bab pa gcig gnyis re tsam gyis pha rol po'i spobs pa rmeg med du byas te mi'u thung goms pa gsum gyis stobs ldan 'dzin ma'i 'og tu bcing ba bzhin mdzad/ sku zhabs zhal mi bzhugs shing sprun bdag rnams dus zing gis 'thor te gtad so ci yang med la 'gal rkyen du 'dzing ba byung yang khri rin po che sogs bla slob thams cad kyis 'chad nyan gtsor 'don las phyi nang gi bstan srid gang la'ang thugs g.yeng mi dgos par/ rje 'di la blo phugs gtad chog pas bsrung ba khor yug rdo rje'i ri bo bzhin du bzhugs/ sde gzar 'jag mtshams su ju nang la/ ho nyod chin wang gi thob dang / mi sde mda' tshan du bsgrigs te dngul srang khri/nas rgya bre khri phrag bcas kyi phog yong skabs/ rgya dpon rnams kyis/dgon pas yang blang chog byas pas/ phal cher nor gyi sred pas dngos grub lta bur rtsi yang rje 'dis lam ngan grog mor 'gro nyen gyi dgag bya che bar gzigs nas len du ma bcug lo der nam dus ngan zhing thams cad re ba che bas nas bre lnga brgya tsam blang nas phog gnang ste/ de yang rin sprod len gyi yi ge sogs rjes gtsang mdzad/ de skabs phog blang ba'i dgon pa rnams deng dus phog 'ja' lus su gyur kyang / de la brten pa'i khral 'khri ri dwags rgyar tshud pa lta bu'i sos mi bde ba mthong tshe rjes 'jug rnams kyis bka' drin brjed dka' bar gda'/ skabs snga phyi'i mdzad spyod de dag ni/ lho brag grub chen gyis/ gdong thug drag pos g.yul ngo mi bzlog rang 'dod che bas gnyen mi 'khyong / ser sna che bas nor mi sog pas/ 'dun ma rlabs kyis chod/ thabs dang blo khog skyed/ theg pa sa gzhi ltar che ba gyis/dgongs pa mkha' dang mnyam par gyis/ kun phan nyi zla ltar gyis/ mi 492

༄༅/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/'gyur ri bo ltar gyis/ mi 'khrugs pa rgya mtsho ltar gyis/ zhes nyid kyis gang gsungs phyag don du bkal bar snang ngo / / zla dang bral la mtshon cha mi ldan yang / / rnam dpyod rdzogs pa'i dpung ba chig rkyang de/ / rgyal bstan 'dzin byed mi 'gyur ka ba dang / / bdud sde'i g.yul la mthar byed rta babs yin/ / dgung lo dgu bzhes pa lcags phag gi lo/ rgyud pa dpon slob dge 'dun rgyal mtshan zhi bar gshegs pas bla ma bsko bzhag gi mtshams la/ khri rin po che nas gros btab pa ltar rgyud grwa thams cad mgrin gcig gi sgo nas gsol ba btab par ngas 'gro 'dug gang yang mi nus pa thams cad la rgyus yod bzhin du de ltar zer lugs med gsungs nas zhal bzhes ma mdzad/'o na gsung chos nyan par nged rnams gzim khang ra bar yong chog da res khrir ma bzhugs na grwa tshang thugs kyis dor ba yin zhes u tshugs mthar skyel zhus pas ngo ma bzlog par rgyud grwa'i khri la zhabs sen nye bar bkod/ de yang dgon pa 'di bstan pa nam gnas kyi bar du chos 'byung khungs byed dgos pas/ srol ngan pa 'dzug mi rung gsung ste sku lus kyis lcogs mi lcogs la ma gzigs par 'chad nyan shin tu dmar ba mdzad/ sngar 'grel pa bzhin sbrags ma gsan pas de ma thag khri rin po cher zhus te/ rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi snying po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi dgongs pa bsdus don seng ge'i lta stangs kyis spyi'i khog phub/ dkyus mchan rus sbal 'gros kyis tshig ngo ma zhib par bshad/ zur mchan dang mtha' dpyod kyi mtshams mtshams nas tshig don gyi cha la dogs slong dgag sgrub kyi brdar sha bcad de 'chad pa'i tshul rje bla ma'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i 'chad nyan gnad smin cha tshang ba lo re bzhin rdzogs par mdzad pas/ gdul bya'i yid kye zhing sar rgyud don rim gnyis kyi sa bon grung po thebs nges pa byung / rje 493

ro / /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonama'i gsung 'bum/bdag nyid chen pos 'phros gang yong nas g.yab ste bshad pa don chung bar gsungs pa bzhin/ ma bshad log bshad ha cang bshad pa gsum po skyon yin gsungs nas 'byams bshad thug med kyi spros pa mi mdzad kyang /dka'aganas kyi 'gag sdom gang che sar bshad pa go bde la 'dus che ba re mdzad pas/ bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig gi dpe bzhin gong 'og thams cad la nges pa ster phul che zhing / gang gsung yid la 'jags pas skye bo blo gros kyi nor can rnams lhag par yid 'phrog ste chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mi ldog pa'i dad pa brtan po thob/ sngar ras bris la brten pa'i bdag 'jug tsam las med kyang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams 'thob par rgyud sde las gsungs pas phan yon che ba dang / dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas par 'gyur ba'i gsang sngags nyams len gyi rtsa ba zhig tu dgongs te smad rgyud ltar gyis thig chog dang bcas pa'i phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te mi bskyod rdo rje lha so gnyis dang / 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma gnyis kyi sgrub mchod bdun phrag re re ston chos gnyis pa'i steng 'char can du byed dgos pa'i srol btsugs/sgrub mchod sogs kyi gtong sgo che phra thams cad shin tu spam mtho zhing dngos gtsang ba byas pas chos dang zang zing gnyis ga'i dga' ston gyi yo lang 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ 'on kyang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rje bdag nyid chen por gsungs pa'i tshe na yang / 'bras bu zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa la/ rgyu thabs shes kyi nyams len zung du 'brel ba dang /sgrub pa bar chad kyi dbang du ma song ba dgos pas/ yi dam bde gsang 'jigs gsum ya ma bral ba dgos par gsungs la/ sngar bde mchog gi bshad sgrub gang yang ma tshugs par 'dug pa thugs kyis ma bzod par/494

༄za/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas gling bsre'i bshad pa'i skabs su/ don dam 'od gsal gyi rim pa gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor ma rgyud spyi'i che ba/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug gi nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bu 'khor lo sdom pa yin tshul/ de yang gnas ri rab kyi rtse mor zhal rang re lho gling 'dir phyogs nas bzhugs pas dus mtha' 'dir lha gzhan las byin rlabs 'jug sla ba'i myur khyad/ lhag par gnas nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams dngasgrub pa po'i lus kyi cha nyer bzhi'i rtsa khams rnams ngo bo dbyer med du sgrub tshul/ de'i dbang gis gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams padma'i mtsho la bung ba bzhin du 'du bas dngos grub char ltar 'bebs shing rtsa khams rnams byen gyis rlabs pas bde stong gi ye shes 'char sla ba sogs kyi phan yon dang / rtsa rgyud dngos kyi dgongs don de nyid bcu bzhi dang sbyar te lam gyi rim par bsgrig tshul gyi bshad pa mdor 'dril ba/ lha so so'i cha lugs kyi khyad par/ lag mchod dang rdo rje'i glu sogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad du ma dang bcas legs bshad nor bu'i sgo brgya bye bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus dang rang rang gis kyang chos zab mo 'di lta bu nyams su len rgyu byung na snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba byung / rkyen de nyid kyis mtshams sbyar te rting bskul sogs la cher ma ltos par lo phyi ma'i dbyed chos gnyis pa nas bde mchog tshogs 'don du legs par tshugs/ de nas bde mchog bskyed rim gyi rtsi bzhag gnang zhing / rgyud don mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma gong ma gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i gdams pa mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thol le ba/ rje btsun bla ma rang nyid thugs nyams su bstar ba'i myong grub kyi man ngag du ma lhug par stsal te rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi bstan pa rin po 495

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgonama'i gsung 'bum/che mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar mdzad/ der ma zad bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas zhwa lung dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba sum cu skor gyi chog grwa dang /rje bla mas dga' ldan du sgrub mchod mang po mnyam du btsugs pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ rgyud khang steng du dus 'khor 'jam rdor 'khor chen sogs kyi chog grwa yang khungs btsun 'dzug par mdzad pa ni/ bstan pa yongs su dzogs pa'ikhur bzhes pa'i rnam thar bla na med pa'o/ / kun mkhyen gong ma'i dus nas thugs bskyed lhan gcig pa'i rten 'brel shin tu zab pas khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sprul sku dbus nas gdan 'dren zhu dgo sa zhes dpon tshang la gsud nan stsal te de skor gyi spyor ba thams cad kyang rje 'dis thugs khur mdzad pa yin snang / rgyud khang snga ma dngos zhan cing go yul dogs pas gsar bskrun gyi thugs bzhed byung yang / cha rkyen med pas the tshom gyi ngang du bzhugs skabs/ dag pa'i snang bar bzhed don 'grub pa'i lung bstan byung ba bzhin las mgo brtsams/ thig 'debs pa'i sar ri 'bur zhig yod pas 'ga' zhig 'dis lag ru 'gog ces gleng bar ngas blo rtse gtod sa 'di ka yin gsungs/ slad nas 'du khang gi gyang sa tha na ka rdo tshun chad gter rdol ba bzhin de'i khung nas lhag lus med par 'grigs pas las byed rnams shin tu ngo mtshar sgyes/ shing cha yongs rdzogs dad 'bul gyis 'grigs shing /mi tshang stobs ldan zhig gis gzhis stong ba'i nor rdzas gang yod nyid la phul te mthun pa'i yo byad kyis phongs pa med par gyur/ rmi lam gsal po can la las yul gyi gzhi bdag thams cad bla ma sde bas rgyud khang 'phug pa'i grogs la 'gro dgos zer ba rmis te don la gnas pa'i rtags ya mtshan pa mang du byung 'dug kyang brir ma lang / 'du khang grub par nye ba'i skabs shig spen pad kye 'og nas ser ka byung ba 'phral du je cher song ste shod kyi rked tsam la sleb pas 496

༄༅/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/thams cad blo ma bde bar snyan 'bul zhus pa na/ phebs nas de'i mtshams su phyag gis reg srub 'dam gyis gcod du bcug nas da skyon med gsungs pa bzhin phyis 'du khang yongs rngogs bskyod kyi bar du sor gang tsam yang khyad ma zhugs pa ni bden tshig grub pa'i mtshan mar snang / de ltar thog ma'i dus kye lung bstan bzhin chos srung rnams kyis rgyud bskul te mi dang mi ma yin mtha' dag gis mthun sgrub lhur blang bas/ ma 'gyang bar 'du khang ka pa nyi shu'i steng shod yongs dzogs dang sgo 'byor/ phug gi gtsang khang bzhi thog spen pad dang bcas pa/ nang du 'jigs byed mgon chos rnams kyi ldem sku thog tshad/ thub dbang gi sku de mtshungs la rigs lnga yum bzhis bskor ba rnams phyag tshad dang ldan zhing ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams pa dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ mdo phugs gnyis gar gang dgos kyi mchod rdzas yo byad cha tshang ba tshon rtse sdeb ris dang bcas khyad du 'phags pa nye zho med par grub/ spyan dbye'i cho ga rgyas par byas te dam ye dbyer med du bsgrubs pas byen rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bum phrag du mas 'jig rten kun tu khyab par mdzad/nyin gcig chos rgyal gyi sku rim pas mdun du bsgur nas 'ong bas mgon khang pa rnams stab stab por gyur te 'phral du zhus par/ de ma thag phebs nas 'phrin bcol mdzad cing lcags thag gis bstod de/ ngas 'di la 'bras spungs kyi chos rgyal lcags thag ma 'dra ba zhig 'ong du re bas 'dod don 'grub pa yin gsungs dgyes tshor dpe med mdzad/ mchod mjal zhig gi tshe lha mo'i ldeb ris la snyan shal phul ba phyag gis bzhes/ phyis lo grangs bdun cu skor gyi mtshams nas gtsang khang zhig gsos kyi skabs snyan shal de thog mar shing sogs kyis bsgul bskyod byas kyang ma lon 'dug pa/ rjes sor nged 497

༄/ /gung ca bam pa'ithonama'i ga 4ma/cagarnams kyis arga'i cho ga byas grub pa'i mtshams zhig la rkyen ci yang med par mchod khri'i steng du lhung snang bas thams cad lhag par yid ches pa byung /grwa khang rten brten pa sogs bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rlabs po che'i skabs der yang thugs dam rgyun 'khyer/ chos 'chad nyan/ 'grigs lam gyi rting non/don gnyer can so so'i mos pa bzhin gyi chos bka' du ma sogs bstan pa'i bya ba sgo thams cad nas bsgrubs shing / khyad par skabs shig nas bzung khri rin po che sku bsnyun gyis zin pas lo ngo gnyis tsam smon lam gsung chos gso spyong gtor rgyag sogs tshogs chen bla ma'i gnang sgo phal cher yang nyid nas mdzad dgos byung / spyir kun mkhyen bla ma'i 'phrin las dang gdan sa 'di'i chos srid mtha' dag la bka' drin bsam las 'das shing / lhag par yang gsang chen bstan pa'i bka' bab kyi dbang gis rgyud grwa sngar myu gu thon tsam las med pa sdong por long ba ni rje 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin no/ / gang thugs dkyil 'khor bye ba spro bsdu'i sgo/ / mgrin pa lung rigs sgra snyan chos kyi sgo/ / phyag ni mi zad gtong ba yangs pa'i sgo/ / sgo gsum phye ba bstan pa'i lha khang yin/ / rgyal byed tshal gyi 'dzin mar btab pa'i thig /rgyal tshab mgon gyi mdun sar snang ba bzhin/ / rig 'dzin 'du ba'i dga' tshal bskrun pa yis/ / rigs kun bdag po'i gzhal yas mngon par grub/ /de nas khri rin po che sku 'da' khar yang / rje 'di la khyed kyi sku'i lcog ring rgyas pa'i gtor sgrub dang / lcags mkhar gnyis ma chag pa gyis zhes de rjes khrir bzhugs rgyu gzhir bzhag nas gsungs/ 'ga' zhig gis zhus pa la yang / nged las lhag pa a lag bla ma tshang yin mod/ khong la gsol ba btab na khyed tsho thams cad legs po 'ong gsungs/ 'on kyang bdud kyi gnyen du gyur pa'i skye bo srin bya gos ser can 'ga' zhig gis/498

༄/ /sde khri rin po po gsang chen chosakyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po'i mthu stobs nyi ma 'bar ba'i gdengs ka mngon du 'char ba ma bzod par don med pa'i 'chal gtam than skad 'ug pa'i hud sgra sna tshogs bsgrags pa na/ khri rin po che yang thugs shin tu skyo ste/ngas lugs gnyis kyis de tsam bskyangs pa'i drin gzo med kyang / skabs 'di la thug nas sems rtsa dkrugs pa ang zhes gting nas zhen pa log ste dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ 'on kyang dge 'dun mang gis khri rin po che'i gsung steng bzhin 'dun pa chig dril gyis gsol ba yang yang btab cing / mi'i dbang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma ched gtad kyis phebs nas zhu ba nan cher phul bas zhal bzhes mdzad/ dgung lo re drug pa sa rta'i dbyar chos kyi thog rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i chos grwa chen po 'di nyid kyi chos khrir mnga' gsol te 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i mgon du gyur/ spyi sger mtha' dag gis legs 'bul rgya che ba bstar/ rgyud pa'i bla ma gnang skabs chos grwa'i lam nas yang yang sku ngal gso dgos pa zhig yod kyang / phyis zor yang du song ste tshogs chos grwa gang la yang phebs bzhud thogs pa med pas/ thams cad kyis skyes bu dam pa thugs kyi 'phen pa ma gtogs dgung lo sogs la ltos pa med nges su 'dug ces ya mtshan du gyur/ rje 'di'i lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa gang la yang mgo mjug mtshungs shing bab snyoms pa zhig snang ba ni rang bzhin lta bu yin pas rtsi bzhag 'chag med gnang yang / mang nyung rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa mdzad par 'ga' zhig gis khri rin po che'i rtsi bzhag lta bu mi 'ong 'dug zer ba gsan nas/ chos thog gcig la 'dzin grwa bcu gnyis po re re la shog bu bzhi bcu skor re btang bas phal cher gyis rjes zin dka' bar song / lam rim gyi gsung bshad sogs kyang / blo gros ldan la zab rgya che/ / blo chung go sla bzung bde ba/ / zhes pa ltar 'chad tshul mkhas pa'i dbang gis blo mtho 499

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung ཿma/dman kun gyis go bde zhing / don gyi zab gnad tshang bas go ba ster phul che ba/ tshig gi na yam tsam ma yin par myong steng du bskor te gnang bas thams cad blo sna bsgyur thub pa byung / skabs der grwa tshogs 'phel rgyas che zhing / 'chad nyan yang nyin skyed zhag skyed lta bu byung bas/ sngar cal rgyug gi rjes su 'brang nas mi gus pa phal cher la yang dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes/ mdo sngags gang la dogs pa zhus kyang dka' gnas rnams lhag par gsal cha mdzad pas/ mkhas rlom gyi skye bo su yang rje 'di'i drung du sleb pa'i tshe smra ba'i mgo 'phang stod nus pa 'ga' yang med do/ / rig grwas mtshon pa'i gtong sgo che phra thams cad kyang cha mtshungs shing dge 'dun gyi cha rkyen du 'gro nges mdzad de lugs gnyis char nas bka' drin zla med pa bskyangs/ de ltar sku na shin tu smin yang 'chad nyan gtong sgo sogs chos srid mtha' dag gi khur 'dzin pa la skyo ngal med pa ni thugs rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i rnam par thar pa yin la/ nus pa'i yon tan chos skyong bran du bkol ba'i tshul sogs thor bu gong du song zin cing / gzhan yang 'chi nad kyis zebs te mo sman mtha' dag gis bor nas nyid la skyabs btsal ba 'ga' zhig la khyod da res 'chir mi 'jug ces thog ma nas zhal gyis bzhes te phyag don du bkal ba dang / klu gdon gdug pa can zhig gis gtses nas mi mang du shi ba'i sar phebs te/ rim gro mdzad pas gzugs dngos su bstan cing dam la btags pas shi kha chod/ pha rol nus ldan 'ga' zhig gis rbad pas gza' bdud gzugs dngos su bstan nas 'ongs te gzim khang nye 'khor du zhag gcig bsdad kyang gnod pa ma jeng bar slar log gtor rgyag zhig gi tshe 'tshub ltas kyi rnam pas mdun nas me lce tshur log pas sku rgyab ngos kyi thag ring por yod pa'i dngos po du ma bsreg kyang / sku dngos la me'i dkyil nas 5khu

༄za/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/gnod pa cung zad ma byung / gling bsre'i skabs bzhugs khri mthon po'i steng nasagasol dkar rdo mthil gyi steng du brdab pa thing sgra dang bcas rgyang ring por song yang snad ma zhugs par rdo la rjes gsal bar bab pa sogs grub pa'i mtshan ma ches mang yang zhib tu bri bar ma lang / gtso bor gyur pa nag phyogs bdud rigs kyi g.yul ngo bcom ste bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i tshul ni/ kun mkhyen mchog gi sbrul sku'i skor la/ yid srub kyis rgyud brlam pa mang pos 'then 'khyer sna tshogs kyis zing cha bslang ste/ grwa rigs phyogs gnyis su chad cing / yul dus la ltos pa'i kha drag du ma yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs su 'khor te/ bdud las kyi le'u nas 'byung ba'i sbyor ngan mtha' dag lhag dang bcas lag len du btab pas 'gal rkyen ru 'dzing ba lta bu byung / gzhan zhig yin na mchog sprul gdan 'dren lta zhog dgon gnas chag 'jig gi tshod du song yang / grub pa'i dbang phyug nyid nas cung zad kyang bag tsha ba med par rang tshugs bzung ste/ zhal nas kyang khyod re gnyis smon lam log par btab nas 'ong ba yin 'dug ste/ nga yang khyed cag gi gnyen por smon lam btab nas 'ong ba yin/ dgon sde 'di slar bstan pa'i 'byung khungs byed dgos pas nga lo ji tsam rgas kyang 'di bstan pa'i bdag po zhig gi phyag tu ma sprad par du 'chi rgyu min/ khyod tsho sna tshogs shig pas ma 'dug kyang mi 'gyang bar chos bsrung dam can rnams kyis rtags bstan yong zhes/ btsan brjid brling ba'i tshogs gtam kha shas gnang ste nag phyogs spa bkong zhing gzur gnas rnams la spro ba bskyed/ tshogs gtam re gnang rgyu'i snga dgung pha rol po kha cig la bud med dre'u zhon pas bsdigs pa dang / glang sngon po 'dzigs su rung bas bdas pa sogs nges can du rmi ba 'byung bas re dogs dang som nyi'i dra bar tshud kyang / las kyi 501

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'bum/dug chus myos pas rang gi 'di phyi gnyis ka gtan brlag ma byas bar du sbyor ba ngan pa'i 'phro ma btang bar snang / de mthun sprul sku'i skor dbus su lha dang bla mar lung zhus mngags pa yang phyir 'byor bas lung bstan thams cad dgongs pa mthun zhing / lhag par gnas chung dang / dga' gdong gnyis nasagangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po myur du gdan sar phob cig khyod mi mthun par byed mkhan tsho la chu srin gyi sder mo btab yod ces grub pa'i dbang phyug gi gsung ring dngos su mnan pas thams cad 'jigs chum gyis song / lar deng dus shin tu snyigs mar song ba'i dbang gis yongs grags hang 'gros dang bstun pa'i bsgrigs ma 'ba' zhig gi steng nas 'gro bar 'dug kyang de skabs chos skyong gnyis nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa lta bu'i che brjod mdzad pa ni/ nges pa'i don du bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur bar dgongs pa'i gsung du snang / de nas lung zhus kyi yi ge rdo bcal chen mor khrom bsgrags su byas pa'i zhag gcig po de'i khongs su dkrugs shing byed mkhan gtso bo rnams gnas nas phyung /de'i rjes su phyogs pa rnams la yang bsgyur sbyangs nad thog tu 'phrod pa btang zhing chad las 'os 'gab kyi sgo nas slad kyi bsdam ra rjes gtsang mdzad de rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bas dkar 'jam yug gcig tu btang / yul mdo smad kyi ma gadha bzang mo rnam rgyal sgrol ma sku 'das shing / de nas ma cig gi lung bstan ltar mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen res mos kyi tshul du gyur pas dpon blon phal cher rang 'dod mar gyi bshos bu re bslang ba yang rje 'di'i mthu stobs nus pa'i me 'od kyis gdungs pas dgongs bzhed mar me'i skong bu gcig tu 'khyil dgos pa byung / skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul sku gdan 'dren skabs su phyogs so sor brda' 'grem gyis mdo smad lho rgyud na gnas 502

༄za/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyi4bsngagasapa'i rol mo/pa'i che dgu mtha' dag bsdus te bsu ba'i bkod pa dang / tsha bab zhag bab sogs kyi grwa sgrigs/ phebs lam bcos rgyu sogs phyogs 'dir sngar ma grags pa lta bu'i bkod khyab chen po'i lugs srol dang mthun par mdzad/'khrungs yul gyi skyel ma rnams la zur phog lta bur rta pho lnga bcu sogs gnang cha spam mtho ba dang / gzhi byes kun la dga' ston rgya gang che bstar/skyabs mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i sku nas kyang bka' chos sogs mdzad pa mtha' dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa kun mkhyen gong ma ji lta ba bzhin bstan pas skye bo thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod/ de'i dbang gis rje 'di la lhag par yid ches kyi dad pa dang / bka' drin dran pa'i gus pa lhur byed pa byung ba ni rnam dpyod can rnams kyi spyi srol dang mthun no/ / nyid nas kyang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje de nyid sku'i rnam pa tsam brjes te phebs pa la chos srid mtha' dag grwa ma nyams par 'bul rgyu byung bas 'dod don thams cad grub pa yin zhes dgyes tshor bla na med pa mdzad/ dgung lo don gnyis pa la da ni mchog sprul rin po che'i mdzad 'phrin la mjal kha zhus te lo gnyis gsum zhig sos bder sdod rgyu yin gsung nas khri'i dgongs pa zhus te zur bzhugs mdzad/ de nas shas cher bcad rgya gnang ste zab gsang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gcig tu gzhol bas rim gnyis kyi dga' ston mchog la yongs su gzhol/ mtshams mtshams su skyabs mgon mchog gi drung du phebs nas/ chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad cing bstan 'gro'i don rgya che ba gnang tshul gyi zhal gdams gnad che ba du ma snyan sgon phul/ skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang rje 'di'i gang gsung tshad mar mdzad de/ phyis dus 'khor grwa tshang gsar 'debs dang 'cham chen 'dzugs skabs sogs 'gang che ba du ma sde khri rin po che'i zhal bkod yin zhes do gal che bar gnang / gsung 503

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i sgroname'i g.yo 4ma/'phros gzhan la bsnyad nas shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar gyi sa steng kun tu 'phrin las kyis khyab par lung bstan pa sogs kyang phyi nas rim pa bzhin rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar cung zad yol ba med par don steng du khel bas blo gros can rnams lhag par yid ches pa byung ste bdag nyid chen po 'di ni 'byung 'gyur mtha' dag rjen par gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba zhig tu the tshom mi 'dug ces bsngags pa'i rgyud mangs bsgreng ba la brtson par gyur/ mdor na kun mkhyen bla ma'i sku 'phreng snga phyi gnyis ga'i 'phrin las kyi byed po yin na'ang / lhag par sku 'phreng phyi ma skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi thog mtha' bar gsum ga'i mdzad bzang thams cad kyi rtsa ba gcig pur gyur pa ni/ sngon nas thugs bskyed lhan cig pa'i legs smon gyis lu gu rgyud du 'brel ba'i rten 'brel gye dbang khyad par can zhig yin te/ ma cig gi lung bstan du/ stong sde dag gi dbang phyug dang grol sde rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gnyis ni ra dang khri zhes bya ba'i yul du 'byung bar gsungs pas ra zhes pa snang rar ngos bzung ste skyabs mgonardo rje 'chang nyid stong sde dag gi dbang phyug gi skye bar 'khrungs rabs bka' rtsom du zhal gyis bzhes shing / grol sde rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni rje 'di yin la/ khri zhes pa khri gar ngos 'dzin dgos zhes tshad ldan gyi dam pa'i gsung rgyun las 'byung ngo / / blo chung 'ga' zhig 'o na kun mkhyen gong ma bu mo bsod nams rgyan dang thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs pas/ sku snga phyi'i 'khrungs rabs ma 'brel bar 'gyur snyam na/ skyon med de rigs gsum mgon po thugs rgyud gcig kyang so so'i sprul ba so sor ngos 'dzin rgyu yod pa ltar/ sprul pa po gnyis rgyud gcig cing / sprul pa gnyis ka yang rgyud gcig la/ 'on kyang gtso bor de dang des sprul zhes tha dad du 'byed pa ni 504

༄za/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/gdul bya'i mos pa mi 'dra ba'i 'brel 'jog tshul dang / 'phrin las 'jug tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis yin pas/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa de lta bu ma shes par/ rang cag so so skye bo rten tha dad pa tsam gye rgyud 'brel med du 'grub pa'i rigs 'gros sbyor ba don ma yin no/ / der ma zad rje 'di ni lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul du/rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs skyes mchog tshad mar gyur ba du mas gsungs la/ de ltar na rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i rang gzugs dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ngur smrig 'chang ba'i zol la brten par yang 'grub bo/ / gzhan yang lnga brgya tha ma'i mtshams su bstan pa byang nas byang du dar bar gsung ba'i dus kyi thog ma 'dir mdo khams smad kyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa'i rmang gzhi gsar du 'dzug pa ma bzod pas gnod byed phra mo tsam ma yin par/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi bdag po dga' rab dbang phyug dpung dang bcas pas gnod pa ci tsam brtsams kyang / me lce la bud shing bsnan pa ltar gzi byin lhag par rgyas pa ni snga ma'i lung gi bstan don 'khrul med du nges pa ster ba'i 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs yin no/ / de nas sku tshe de'i ngo skal gyi bstan 'gro'i don dang / / dngos kyi gdul bya'i mtha' rdzogs te dag pa'i zhing du dgongs pa gtad pas cung zad bsnyun tshul bstan/ thugs dam rgyun 'khyer sogs sngar rgyun dang khyad par med kyang /mdzad spyod dang gsung zur sogs thugs sna bstung ba'i rnam pa dang / go rgyu can mang du gsungs pas/ sku 'khor rnams ze tshom du gyur te zhabs brtan rgya gang che zhig sgrub rtsis byas par nged kyi lus la na tsha mngon can ci yang med pas de 'dra mi dgos gsungs nas byed du ma bcug de nas dgung lo don bzhi pa me pho stag gi lo chu stod kyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang 505

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgronama'i khrung dzom/po'i nyin rtag 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dam pos bcings pa'i skye bo rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir gzugs sku rags pa'i bkod pa bsdus te/ yid kyi lus byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang du gshegs so/ / sku 'das ma thag gi tshe dbu cung zad mdun la gug nas yod pa/ khrus gsol sogs byas pa dang rim gyes je drang du song bas lhag par yid ches shing / gdung zhugs 'bul gyi tshe dbu'i rus pa cung zad kyang ma grug par byon pa grwa mang la mjal kha btang / tshems bgrang bas bzhi bcu khri ge byung ste thams cad yid ches dang dad pa'i sa la bkod/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang gdung rtags ya mtshan pa du ma byung / zhabs 'brang rnams kyis gtong ba'i sgo 'phar phye ste dgongs rdzogs rgya cher bsgrubs shing / grwa slob thams cad kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad du byas te dbang bzhi len pa dang / khrus gsol smon lam/ mchog sprul myur du 'byon pa'i gsol 'debs sogs rnam dkar la chig dril du 'bad pa lhur blangs te dgongs pa rdzogs par byas/ma 'gyang bar sprul pa'i sku mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku tshar 'khrungs/skyabs mgon mchog la chos bsrung du mas rnal lam du bskul ma byung zhing /brtagakhrul byas par dang po snga phyi cung zad las ma dod/ yang bskyar byas pas cha mnyam du bsdad pa dang / der dge bshes rin chen chos bzang zhabs phyir yod pa khong gis/ snga mas 'thus pa la zhes smras ma thag / rkyen ciyang med par gcig rgyangs kyis thon pa phye bas rnal lam dang mthun par byung / skyabs mgon mchog dbus su phebs khar sprul sku gdan sar bkod nas rab tu byung ste mtshan 'jigs med lung rigs rgya mtshor btags/ sku tshe der mdo sngags gnyis gar gsan sbyong mthar phyin gnang ste mkhas btsun bzang po'i brtul zhugs rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar rdzogs par bskyangs/506

༄/ /sde khri rin po che'i gsang chen chosakyis bsngags pa'i rol mo/dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs nas gdan sar chos srid kyi 'dzin skyong yang dag pa mdzad/ de'i sku tshe rjes ma sogs yul du 'khrungs pa yang skyabs mgon mchog nas bdag gnang ste ngos 'dzin dang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis snga ma'i skabs ltar skyabs mgon mchog dbus phebs rjes ma'i phebs kha dngos gzhi der gdan sar bkod de rab tu byung nas mtshan 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma zhes gnang ba sogs sku 'phreng du mar 'brel ba'i mtshan ma snga phyi'i rgyu 'bras ma 'chol ba kun gyi mngon sum du gyur/ sbrul pa'i sku nas gnas sbyong sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad bzang gong du 'phel bzhin pa 'di lags so/ / smras pa/ gsang chen chos kyi nor bu'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ / gsang ba'i bdag po mi yi zlos gar mkhan/ / gsang 'dzin grub dbang mchog gi thun mong dang / / gsang ba'i rnam par thar ba mdor bsdus pa/ / 'grig 'grig rdzun gyi phreng bas ma bslad cing / / snyan snyan gcam bu'i zol bstod ma yin par/ / yang yang dpyad de 'khrul bral snying po'i don/ / gsal gsal tshig gi sbyor bas mtshon par byas/ / 'di yi dge bas mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun/ / rtag tu dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes 'dzin cing / / zab gsang rdo je'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas/ / zung 'jug dang po'i mgon po nyid gyur cig / / / ces dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po sde khri rin po che blo bzang don grub pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar ba gsang chen chos kyis bsngags pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba 'di ni rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa skang tsha dka' bcu 'jigs med rgyal mtshan gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon mes chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil du sbyang ba'i yi ge pa ni snyikṣa ratna ā nanta'o/ / / /507

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/༄7/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid sgo mang mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos dar pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'od kyi gdengs ka yis/ / kun rmongs mun pa bcom ste shes bya'i khyon/ / kun la blo gros mchog ster 'jam mgon lhas/ /kun mkhyen ma thob de srid mgon mdzod cig / blo gros dri med mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ / bzang po'i thugs bskyed ri dwags mtshan mas mdzes/ / chos kyi dpal 'byor mi zad chu bo'i gter/ / dar zhing rgyas mdzad kuja'i gnyen khyod rgyal/ / tshul ldan mang thos gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin/ / rgya chen lhag bsam rmad byung sems dpa' che/ / rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gnas rig sngags 'chang / / gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin khyod bsngags par 'os/ / deng dus 'dod yon myos 'gyur dpe dang bcas pas rab spyos te/ / spyod pa'i gom stabs rtsing pos thub bstan pad tshal 'joms byed kyang / / skal dman bung bas bskor slad rigs mthun rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams/ / phan bde'i dga' tshal rgyan du bsngags pa'i mu cor sgrogs byed na/ / rin chen sems kyi rtsa brtan rgyal sras spyod pa'i yal 'dab rdzogs/ /legs bshad me tog rab rgyas bslab gsum 'bras bu'i khur gyis brjid/ /508

ro༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhasapa'i dga' ston/mkhas grub rkang 'thung khrod na cher 'phags bshes gnyen dpag bsam ljon/ / grags pa'i dri ngad ldang la mthun pa'i bser bu cis mi spro/ / mang du gsan pas rmongs pa'i dgra las rgyal/ / tshul bzhin sgrub pas rtogs pa'i btsan sa zin/ / rnam dpyod dpung bas bstan pa'i ru mtshon bsgrengs/ /'didag ngo mtshar gtam gyi sa bon yin/ / ya rabs dam pa'i lugs srol shes 'dod cing / / rgyal sras spyod pa'i rjes su slob 'dod la/ / yi rang goms pas dge tshogs spel 'dod pa/ / de dag dga' dang dad pa'i yid kyis nyon/ / de'ang phun sum tshogs pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i dbang chen gser gyi 'dzin ma la/ rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims kyi chu gter chen po yongs su 'khyil ba'i klong na/ rgya chen sde snod gsum gyi dgongs don thos bsam sgom pa'i bang rim mngon par mtho zhing / gsang chen rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lcog gis nye bar mdzes pa'i bshes gnyen ri yi dbang po sgo mang mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos dar pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar pa rags pa tsam zhig gtam du gleng ba la/ thog mar gang du skye ba bzhes pa'i yul kha ba can gyi ljongs mdo khams smad kyi phyogs 'di nyid 'dzam bu gling gi phyogs cha ji lta zhig tu gtogs tshul zur tsam bsnyad na/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i don du bod ston rnams la 'phrin du springs pa las/ shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam gling gi / bye brag brjid ldan gangs ri'i byang / / kha ba can zhes ming grags pa/ / bod ces bya ba gnas pa'i phyir/ / zhes pa ltar 'dzam gling spyi'i dbyibs ni rgya gar gyi shing rta rta glang sogs la 'gel ba'i phyogs phra zhing / 'khor lo brten pa'i phyogs zheng che ba zhig yod pas de la dpe sbyar ba yin zhing / sog pa'i dbyibs lta bur yang bshad de/ mdzod las/ 'dzam bu'i gling de ngos gsum la/ / stong phrag 509

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgoname'i g.yo 'a4/gnyis so shing rta'i dbyibs/ / gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ / zhes pa bzhin no/ / zheng chung ba'i ngos gang la ston pa'ang da lta bris pa phal cher nang du ri rab ngos la bstan yod kyang / khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo dang /rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ rdo 'phang pa'i mdo sogs las byang ngos che bar gsungs shing / dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po ni/ / gling bzhi kun gyikhyang na'o/ / zhes pa ltar gling gang yin kyang rang gi byang ri rab la ston dgos pa nyi ma'i 'char tshul gyi dbang gis yin no/ / der ma zad lo rgyus sogs la brtags na'arnga gling phran mang po dang khad nye tshul gyis lho ngos rgya mi che ba dang / byang phyogs na sham bha la sogs yul rgya chen po phan tshun gcig gcig gi ming ma thos pa'ang mang po yod pas shes nus so/ / des na yul gye dbusado rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad drug cu tsam nas bod kyi sde zin cing / de la nang gses kyis stod smad bar gsum du phye na/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum ni/ spu rang / mang yul/ zangs dkar gsum skor gcig 'chim/ bru sha sbal ti gsum skor gcig zhang zhung /khri te stod smad gsum skor gcig tu byed/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi ni/sngar dbus la/ dbu ru/ g.yo ru gnyis/ gtsang la g.yas ru/ ru lag gnyis zer yang / chos rgyal kau shi han gyis khri skor bcu gsum dbang du bsdus te rgyal dbang rin po cher phul phyin la/ g.yas ru/ g.yon ru/spus ru/ gung ru bzhir byed do/ / smad mdo khams sgang drug ni/ zal mo sgang / tsha ba sgang / smar khams sgang / spo 'bor sgang / dmar rdza sgang /mi nyag rab sgang dang drug go / de dag la bod chol kha gsum du'ang grags te/mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ de nas rma chu khug pa mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ de nas rgya'i mchod rten dkar po 510

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/yan mdo smad rta'i chol khar byed do/ / 'di thams cad za ma tog bkod pa sogs mdo sde du mar spyan ras gzigs kyi 'dul zhing kha ba can gye rgyal khams zhes gsungs pa de yin pas/ 'ga' zhig dbus gtsang kho na der ngos 'dzin pa ni rmongs zhen gyi gtam yin te/ gangs can nam kha ba can zhes 'dogs pa'i rtsa ba bod skyob pa'i gangs chen brgyad du grags shing / de'ang rjebla mas/ gangs can khrod kyi gangs ri'i dbang po zhes gsungs pa ltar/gangs ri'i rgyal po 'o de gung rgyal/ gangs ri'i dmag dpon sgom ra/gangs ri'i blon po thang lha sogs su bshad pa ltar yin pas/ rma chen gangs kyi gtso bo zhig tu byed na mdo smad gangs can du mi byed pa'i thabs med do/ / 'di dag gnas kyi khyad chos gtso bo yin pas/ rgya bal gyi rgyal po so so'i bsngags pa brjod tshul rgyal po bka' 'bum las/ bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ / sa mtho ri gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /zhes dang / gangs ri rang byung mchod rten ya mtshan can/ / zhes gsungs te/ bka' gdams glegs bam las kyang / gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod/ / ces byung ba de kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas dgon 'di'i lung bstan du 'grel skabs rma chen gyi gangs la ngos bzung ba ltar/skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang nas dgon 'dir rma chen gtso bor bsten pa dang /klong rdol grub dbang rin po ches rma chen 'di la lhag tu 'khor tshul gsungs pa gung bsgrig rgyu mang ngo / / der ma zad mdo khams ni sngon chos rgyal gyi dus rgya bod kyi so mtshams sogs su bzhag pa las mched pa yin pas skad rigs la'ang brda rnying ma 'gyur ba mang zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dbus gtsang la bod dang / mdo khams la bod chen por grags pa tsam las don 'dra ba/dper na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rgya dang rgya ni che nyid na/ / zhes rgya 511

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i ma'i khrung 'bum/nag chen po rgya nag las logs su gsungs kyang / zan shi'i byang phyogs kyi rgyud la rgya nag dang / man jing sogs lho rgyud la rgya nag chen por 'jog pas gnyi ga rgya nag tu 'dra ba bzhin no/ / 'di la dgongs nas lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa dang / sher phyin gyi mdo'i yul dpyad pa'i yon tan gyi skabs sogs su/ bstan pa byang nas byang du dar bar 'gyur ro/ / byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di la nang gses kyis cha gnyis su phye ba'i gcig nasagacig tu dar tshul lung bstan pa yin te/ rgya gar dbus nas byang du dpag tshad brgya brgal ba na sa skya yod cing / de nas byang du dpag tshad brgya lhag brgal tshe mdo smad kyi sne zin pas kyang shes nus so/ / der ma zad khro phu lo tsā bas paṇa chen shākya shrī spyan 'dren skabs phul ba'i zhu yig las/ma ga dha sogs rig 'byung gnas na sdig to yis/ / dmag tshogs kyis bcom o rgyan kha che bal yul yang / / log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ / bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs bskyod zhu/ / zhes pa skabs der rgya bal na paṇḍi ta chen po du ma yod la bstan pa'i 'byung khungs su rtsi dus yin kyang / bstan pa byang du 'pho ba'i rten 'brel gyis ljon shing yar skye bzhin 'phel skyed bod che bar gsungs pa bzhin/ de skabs dbus gtsang du'ang grwa rgyun gyi khrod nas mkhas pa'i thog mdo smad che bar yod 'dug la/ deng sang 'di las kyang chos kyi don gnyer dang rnam grangs la blo rno ba sogs smad phyogs drag par 'dug pa rten 'brel gyi che bar mngon/ de ltar thub bstan dbyar gyi lang tsho dar ba'i dus ston gsar du ngom pa mdo smad sa yi thig le/ de la'ang rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā gnyis pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i klung chen rma chus bgos te lho rgyud dang byang rgyud gnyis su yod pa las lho rgyud/ lung pa'i mda' klung chen de la gtad cing /512

༄/ /togs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/phu shar lhor blta ba'i bod sde mang du yod pa las mar nang tsho lngar grags pa'i ya gyal ka ring zhes pa/ lung pa'i sked na ker langs kyi rdo ka ba lta bu zhig yod pa las btags pa yin zhing / lo rgyus la lar 'di 'dra la dngos grub kyi rtags mtshan du bshad pa'ang yod/ chu shing 'dzom zhing lo tog smin pa/phu na 'brog gi rtswa sa'ang yod pas/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge / 'thung chu zhing chu chu yi dge / gam 'brog rgyang 'brog 'brog gi dge / khang shing bud shing shing gi dge / khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge / zhes pa ltar gyi sa'i dge bcu tshang ba zhig go / yul mi rnams g.yo sgyu med pa ma bcos pa'i rang bzhin drang po can/ rkus jag sogs spyod pa ngan pa'i mig ltos mi byed cing dkon mchog la dad pa/ phal cher gzugs byad bzang zhing smra sgo yangs pa sogs chos sgrub pa'i rten du 'os pa shas che la/ de'i nang nas dpal 'bum bya ba dam pa 'di'i yab yin zhing / yum ni dpal mo mkhar zhes bla ma dkon mchog la gus pa/ dbul sprang sogs la snying brtse ba zhig ste/ mi tshang 'di 'dul ba lung las/ ha cang phyug po'i khyim dang ni/ / dbul po'i khyim du mi skye bar/ / bar ma'i khyim du bye 'gyur zhing / / rtag tu rab byung thob par shog / ces bsngags pa ltar mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba zhig go /yab yum de gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i bgrang bya zhe drug pa/stod 'grel ltar na yongs 'dzin te saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du pa ri dhā ri/ tsi na'i skad du shin ci/ dbang thang bsdun pa chu pho byi ba'i lor dge mtshan gyi ltas dang bcas te bltams/ de'i snga lo sog tsha'i rtsis pa la rtsis byed du bcug par/ sang phod bu zhig skye bas de rab byung byas na dgon sde mang po'i bla ma dang / khyim pa byas na grong sde mang po'i dpon po byed pa'i bsod nams can zhig yin/ de'i sku rim la gser gyi ska rags byas pa'i dngul gyi gzungs 513

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i 0me'i ga4 'bum/'dus shig 'bri dgos zhes bshad 'dug pa ni/ sngon gzhon nu don grub sku bltams pa'i tshe mtshan mkhan sdams khyim na gnas tshe 'khor sgyur dang /rab tu byung tshe sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar lung bstan la/ phyi mas rtsod dus 'khor sgyur mi 'byung bas sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar bshad pa bzhin mdo dbus su dge 'dun gyi sde du ma'i gtsug rgyan du 'gyur rgyu de thig par snang ngo / / der ma zad rim gro 'bab tshul yang / phywa g.yang sel gsum lta bu zhi ba'i dkar bcos/ mnan bsreg 'phang gsum lta bu drag po'i rim gro grong pa la brin pa de 'dra zhig ma babs par/ rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa sgrub tshul babs pa ni sku tshe 'di'i bzhed don mtha' dag chos dang mthun par 'grub pa'i rten 'brel gyi mgo tshugs par snang / de rjes yab cher ma 'gyang bar 'das te yum gyis bskyangs/ khams mi bde ba sogs ci yang med cing mtsho nang gi padma bzhin skyed che bas shin tu gso sla ba byung / cung zad nar son te byis pa rnams dang lhan cig rtse ba'i dus na'ang zla bo rnams 'phyong rgyug 'ar 'ur ci tsam byas kyang rtog dpyod mi gtong bar de'i rjes su mi 'gro ba dang / rtsed mo'ang ngan spyod kye rigs mi byed pa rgan po'i spyod pa lta bu kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig yod par snang ngo / / kai la shas mtshan bsil ljongs mdo khams smad/ / ka ring zhes grags sa yi thig le ru/ / ku mud tshal du zla zer 'phos pa bzhin/ / kun bzang dge ba'i ltas dang bcas te bltams/ / na tshod padma'i myu gu ches phra yang / / ne'u ldang bag med byis pa'i tshogs kyi nang / / nor 'khrul nyes spyod dri ma'i 'dab rdzab kyis/ / nam yang ma sbags sngon goms mthu de rmad/ / skabs shig nas a khu bla ma ngag dbang don grub kyi drung du klog bslab par thod rgal byas nas mi 'gro bar phral klog sbyar klog sogs rim pa bzhin nan tan gyis dal bus zhib mor slob cing /514

༄༅/ /rtog4bajod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/gang shes pa de nam yang mi brjed par byas te yid la 'jag pas slob mkhan la'ang dka' tshegs med cing shin tu mgu ba byung ste/ grog mkhar dang sprang rtsi ltar/ yon tan gsog tshul ma nor ba'i nyer bsdogs dang por brtsam mo/ / de nas blo bzang dar rgyas zhes pa mang thos tshul ldan mkhan por 'os pa zhig gi drung nas rab tu byung ba'i tshul khrims yang dag blangs te ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang zhing mtshan blo bzang chos dar zhes btags/ ka ring sgar du zhugs te de na 'don rgyun la yod pa'i cho ga chos spyod rnams dzogs par bslabs/ de skabs thugs la rab tu byung ba'i ming tsam des go mi chod par 'dug chos rnam par dag pas gtan gyi mdun ma 'grub nges shig mi byed pa'i thabs mi 'dug de byed pa la thog mar grwa sa chen po zhig tu zhugs nas slob gnyer tshul bzhin byas la chos kyi gnad go ba zhig byed dgos par 'dug snyam ste/ dbyar thog cig bkra shis 'khyil du bros nas phebs/ yul mi rnams kyis rjes bsnyegs nas 'ongs te bzhugs thub pa ma byung yang /dang por phebs pa de sngon gyi thugs smon gyis bskul ba yin zhing phyis 'byung rten 'brel bsgrigs pa lta bur yang mngon/ de lo dbyar chos kyi gling bsre bka' bcu a bar bzod pa dang / skyor dpon no 'bug gnyis yin zer gyin 'dug ces phyis dgung lo bdun cu skor la phebs dus bka' chos 'ga' zhig gi skabs su gsungs snang / des mtshon sku na phra mo'i dus nas gsan gzigs byung tshad nam yang bsnyel ba med pa'i dran pa brtan po zhig mnga' ba ni skye ba'i 'phreng bar sems kyi rta mchog dran shes srab kyis kha lo bsgyur te bag med pa'i lam du nam yang mi gtong bar/ thub pa'i gzhung lam drang por bgrod pa'i 'bras rtags su mngon/ de nas yul mi rnams kyis kyang 'di grwa sa zhig tu ma btang bar mi sdod 'dug snyam ste ji ltar 'os pa'i mthun 515

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i ga4 'bum/pa'i 'tshog chas bsgrubs pa bzhin dgung lo bcu bdun pa bidha ba ste rnam 'byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug gi lo dbus su phebs pas lam skabs sogs nas nye zho ci yang med pas bde bar son to/ / nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs te/ / nyes ltung rnyog pa'i dri ma ring du spangs/ / nyon mongs gdung sel tshul khrims bdud rtsi'i bcud/ / nyams su myong bas dga' ba ci yang brtas/ / thar pa'i go 'phang mchog de sgrub pa yang / / thog ma kho nar rgyal ba'i gsung rab la/ / thos bsam tshul bzhin bgyid la rag las par/ /thugs kyis dgongs te sbyor ba 'di brtsams so/ / de nas sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer ma mchis ba jo shāka sogs kyi zhal bzang mig gi bdud rtsid gyur pas dga' dad dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin rgyas shing chos kyi bzhed don smon pa bzhin 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs nan tan zhus/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi padmor mjal zhing mos gus tshad med pa skyes/ de nas mkhas grub klu dbang bye ba'i bste gnas/ lung dang rigs pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i dga' tshal/ dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i gling gi grwa tshang bzhi'i nang nas gur dkar po'i tog lta bu bkra shis sgo mang gi chos grar zhugs/ tshul khrims rnam par dag cing byang chub kyi sems la mnga' 'byor pa mkhan po sangs rgyas rdo rje'i drung nas bsdus grwa'i brtsi bzhag thog mar gsan/ rang gi khang tshan bsam blo yin kyang sngon gyi 'brel bas mtshams sbyar te yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bra nye ngag dbang dge legs dge rgan du bsten/ tshogs chos 'grim/ dpe 'dzin dang gshar sbyang mdzub khrid sogs la brtson ba chu bo'i rgyun lta bu nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu mdzad/ zhar la dmigs brtse ma dang a ra pa tsa sogs la 'bad nas lha dang bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa bshags sbyang sogs rgyu dang spun gyi tshul du 516
