༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnayomakhas pa'i dga' ston/'bad pas cher ma 'gyang bar bsdus tshod kyi rigs pa'i sgo phye ste bgro gleng legs par byed thub pa byung / sa sbrul lo paṇa chen rin po ches rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdun nas bka' chos gsan ched sa ga zla ba'i nang du phebs pa la dan 'bag gling khar sen 'phreng gi tshe zhal mthong ba tsam nas dad pas ba spu g.yo ba byung / slob gnyer byed sa'i gtso bo zab rgyas kyi gzhung gnyis yin pas/ bsdus grwa'i skabs der rgyan 'jug gnyis la blo 'dzin shin tu byang ba mdzad/ bsdus grwa blo rtags sogs kyi rtsod pa rdzogs nas gzhung tshugs te phar phyin dbu mdzod 'dul ba rnams la rim bzhin sbyangs pa na blo gros je rgyas su song ba bzhin brtson pa je cher 'gro bas klog pa thos bsam gyi bya ba dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin du 'phel/ nyid rang bzhin gyis thugs sgam zhing brtan pa'i thog dge rgan nas kyang rje yab sras kyi gsung rab rnams rtsa ba yin pa smos ci dgos/ gzhan grwa sa so so'i yig cha spyi don thal phreng mi 'dra ba mang po 'dug mod kyang gsung rab kyi dgongs don zhig go 'dod na kun mkhyen bla ma'i yig cha 'di'i steng nas ma go bar gzhan nas lhag pa blang gtong rgyu e yod mi shes zhes yang yang gsungs stabs/ rnam bshad gser phreng sogs la skabs skabs su gzigs pa ma gtogs yig cha kho na gtsor 'don gyi 'dzin skyor chos thog chos mtshams kun la gshar sbyang dang yig cha'i steng nas dpyad pa phu thag chod pa mdzad/ khyad par gzhung tshan so so'i rang lugs skabs kyi/ mtshan nyid/ dbye bsdu/ grangs nges/ go rim/ byed las/ sa mtshams/ sgra don/ mu rtsi tshul sogs gang yod kyi tshig don gnyi ga blo la shin tu byang nas gcig car 'char ba lta bu sha zhag rus zhag tu 'gro ba byas/ deng sang slob gnyer la 'bad pa'i khul byed pa phal cher yang dpe cha lta tshul rang gi yig cha 'dzin skyor byed rgyu bskyur nas dpe sna 517

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i sgroname'i g.yo 'a4/mang po zhig gis ma long ba bzhin byas te dpe klog chab chob ra rtsi thog la yan pa bzhin thams cad kyi sne btog re byas rung gnad la 'bab rgyu gcig kyang med/ gzhung tshan de'i'ang rang lugs bskyur te gzhan lugs dgag pa'i thad nas phar 'phen rgyu re e yod gtso bor byas pas skabs der 'gro thabs tsam 'ong yang / rang la tshur 'phang ba na 'bab sa 'di 'dra zhig dgos snyam du blor 'dzin rgyu'i gtad so zhig med stabs ri dwags thang la brdas pa bzhin gar 'gro 'dir 'gro med cing / lo zla kha shas song dus sems ngo na ci yang med pa ni dang por slob gnyer rgyag dus rgyag ma shes pa'i skyon du snang ste/kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ gzhung tshig blo 'dzin mi byed gzhung gi don/ / dpe klog tsam gyis shes 'dod bzhad gad gnas/ /zhes dang / thad ga'i gzhung la lta ba yal bor nas/ / dpe mang blta ba shes rab 'chal ba'i rgyu/ / gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ blo gsar rnams yeng ma yeng gis nyi ma 'phul thabs de 'drar ma song ba dam pa 'di dag gi rnam thar la kha mig yar blta ba zhig dgos so/ / rgyun par bgro gleng gnang tshul gzhung gi go don tshol ba gtsor 'don byas pas bam me ba zhig yin kyang /pha rol pos tshig 'khri sogs ha cang gi rigs pa zhib mdog dang dar dar byas na de'i tshod kyis rigs pa je rnor btang ste phyi rgol gyi spob pa gzhom nus pa rtsod pa'i khyu mchog lta bur yod ces rgyus yod rnams gleng / nyi shu rtsa grangs shig la mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i chos kyi rgyal tshab mkhas grub bye ba'i gtsug rgyan dam pa rje ngag dbang byams pa'i zhabs drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ de nyid kyi lam rim bka' chos sogs la'ang lan kha yar byon te gsung gi bdud rtsi nyams su myong / chu sprel lor kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po dbus su phebs par dge rgan gyi stabs thusas 'dris che ba byung /518

༄/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/skabs shig thos bsam gyi bar chad lta bus sku khams mi bde ba zhig byung ste thabs ci byas kyang ma phan/ nyin gcig kun mkhyen de nyid kyi mdun du song bar thugs khros pa'i rnam pas khyod mi bde ba e red gsungs par/ gnod tshab chen po mi 'dug kyang skyed gtan mi 'ong ba zhig 'dug zhus pas/ de skyon can zhig yin pa 'dra/ sang ngas rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang zhig byed gsung / phyi nyin yang thugs khros pa'i rnam pa de ga'i ngang nas rjes gnang stsal te grub zin pa na dgyes nyams dang bcas da skyon med mod/ rta mgrin ci thub re thon gsungs pa de nas bzung ste sangs dwangs su song / de rjes thu'u bkwan rin po che'ang phebs pas thugs nang shin tu nye ba byung 'dug pa ni/rtsab sngon nas thugs smon gyi 'brel ba zhig yin 'dug la/ thun mong ltar yang / bzod pas mdzes shing skye bo dam pa la/ / phangs dang lugs dang lugs min shes/ zhes gsungs pa der mngon/ me glang gi lo mjug lcang skya thams cad mkhyen pa'ang dbus su phebs te lo snga phyir chos bka' mang du gnang bar gsan zhed che'ang / de skabs chos 'grim gyi sgang du song bas lha sar gnang ba rnams la cher phebs mthug chos mtshams dang 'grig dus kha shas dang bras srungs tshogs chen nas lam rim thun gcig sgo mang chos grwar lam gtso'i gzab bshad gnang ba rnams thugs la 'jag nges su byas te gsan/ rtsod bzhin pa'i skabs gnas skor chos nyan sogs la 'gro mi rung bar bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bca' yig tu dgag pa mdzad pa'ang gnas skabs tshogs chos grwa mi 'chag pa'i thabs tsam min gyi dgos pa las dgag bya che ba zhig yod pa yin te/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ gang zhig bsams te byar brtsams pa/ / de las gzhan du mi bsam ste/ / der gtad pa yi bsam pa yis/ / de nyid re zhig bsgrub par bya/ / de lta na ni kun legs byas/ /519

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung ཿma/gzhan du gnyi gar mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes gang brtsams rim pa ltar 'grub pa dgos kyi/ chos grwar rdzas bzhag tsam nas dril bu dkrol tshad kyi rtsar rgyug pa'i blo sna mang po rtsi skud mgo breg pa lta bu der snga phyi gnyis po gang yang mi yong bar gsungs so/ / brtson 'grus byed lugs kyang nyi ma kha shas lto'ang mi dran pa lta bu'i tsha drag byas/ skabs skabs su brjed song ba bzhin bskyur nas 'gro ba'i 'phar ldang des gar yang mi phyin par gzigs nas rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus rgyun chags chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba sogs rkyen gzhan gyes bzlog tu med pa ri gzar gyi rbab lta bu/ tsha thub grang thub kyi dka'aspyad dam ba gong ma'i rnam thar dang rjes su mthun pa zhig mdzad pas slob gnyer lo re las lo re skyed thon tshab che bar byung ba ni rgyu 'bras go ma log pa'i 'bras rtags yin te/ skye bo gso thigs las/ gzhon pa'i dus su rig pa bslab/ / zho 'dod pa ni dgun nas gso/ / drod gsher ldan dus sa bon gdab/ / de gsum 'phral du smin pa'i rgyu/ / zhes dang / 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug / bde bar 'dod la mkhas mi srid/ / gsungs pa bzhin te/ la la zhig rang gis brtson 'grus mibyed par nga la slob gnyer yong thabs zhes thabs shig thang nas tshol bar snang yang / tsan ga'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ yon tan 'bad pas 'grub pa yin/ / 'bad pa bdag nyid la gnas pas/ / 'bad nas yon tan mi slob par/ / gzhan dag yon tan ldan zhes sgrogs/ / gsungs pa'i dpe ltar dgos pa med do/ / de ltar thugs gnyer gnang tshul mkhas shing mgo mjug mtshungs pas ring por ma thogs par bka' po ti chen po lnga'i dgongs don thugs su chud de mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob bo/ / tshogs mchog dge 'dun rigs pa smra ba'i grwar/ / tshad ma sde bdun rigs lam bsdus grwa 520

༄/ /rtogasabarjod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/dang / / tshul gsum gtan tshigs rigs par sbyangs pa yis/ / tshegs med lung dang rigs pa'i dga' ston myong / / shes rab gru gzings brtson pa'i ba dan can/ / shugs drag brtson pa'i rlung gis bskul ba na/ / shāka gsung dgongs don zab cing rgya che'i mtsho/ / shin tu brgal dka'i pha rol yud kyis son/ / so bzhi pas bya'i lo nas mkhan po ngag dbang dge legs sgo mang gi chos khrir phebs pas/ khong gi zhal nas mkhan thog snga ma gnyi ga de tsam mthar phyin po ma byung ba sogs kyi stabs deng sang grwa tshang gi 'grigs lam sogs ha cang blor 'bab po zhig yong gi mi 'dug khyed rang smon lam ming btags kyi tshad la slebs yod pa cung 'gyang 'gro bar 'dug kyang 'di gal che bas khyod kyis grwa tshang dge bskos byed dgos gsung bar dgongs pa zhus kyang nga la grogs shig dgos par 'dug ces gsung nan che bas bka' bzhin zhus/de ni spyod 'jug las/ ma brtsams pa ni mchog yin gyi/ / brtsams nas ldog par mi bya'o/ / gsungs pa bzhin bya ba 'di byed dgos pa la yal yol gyis 'gro thabs tsam ma yin par sems la 'dzin rgyu yod pa zhig byed dgos par 'dug bla ma'i bka' yin par ma zad/ spyir na'ang be'u bum sngon mo las/ ci nas byed 'dod sangs rgyas bstan pa/ / 'jig rten yun ring cig nas bya ste/ / de yang dge 'dun sde la rag las/ / nus pa yod na de gnas thabs bya/ / zhes 'gro ba'i bde skyid bstan pa dang / de dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las par gsungs pa de 'gyed phog gi skal ba len mkhan mang bas go mi chod/ 'chad nyan 'grig lam rnam dag cig yod dgos par 'dug 'di la phan zhig thogs na chos kyi bya ba'ang de las lhag mi 'dug dgongs te drag zhan su la'ang ngo dga' zol 'jog tu ma song bas 'grig gi rtingaganon 'chun che zhing tsha ran snyoms pa gang la gang 'os bab mtshungs le 521

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'isgroname'i gsung 'a4/shor med pa gnang / dge bshes chen po zhi zhing dul ba zer ba'i ming bzang la ma ltos par 'grig 'gal lang shor du song ba rnams la brdung btags kyang tsha nan mdzad pa ni don go na de dag la'ang phan btags pa kho na yin te/shes rab sdong bu las/ mi bsrun skye bo zhig bas min/ / de dang 'tsham pa'i tsub pa bsten/ / bu ni mi bsgrub ba dag la/ / phan 'dod pa yis mi bsdigs sam/ / mkhas rnams rna bar mi snyan yang / / phan tshig sman bzhin bsten par gyis/ / skye bo ngan dang gser dang rdo/ / mi bsrun rta dang bud med dregs/ / brdungs na dul ba nyid 'gyur gyi/ / de dag legs byas snod ma yin/ / zhes gang gsungs pa bzhin no/ / de ltar zhi drag gang dgos kyis bab bstun mdzad pas dmu rgod dag 'jigs shing dge 'dun rnams spro ba 'phel pas 'grig lam la shin tu phan thogs pa dang mkhan rin po che'ang dgyes pa'i rtser son pa byung / de nas smon lam grwa skor gnang dgos pas gzhung gong 'og thams cad la khol 'don tsam ma yin par cha mnyam pa'i zhib dpyod bskyar ma dang / mtsho ṭīka mchims mdzod sogs la'ang zhib gzigs/sdoms tshig gal che ba'i rigs blo 'dzin byang bar mdzad/ dgung lo so brgyad pa sa mo glang gi dgun chos thog grwa tshang gi dam bca' dang / lcags stag lo'i smon lam thog lha sa'i dam bca' bzhag par gzhung 'bab tshan che'ang khas len shor tshab che ba ma byung la/ lan myur zhing gsal la dpangs mtho ba sku'i rnam 'gyur sogs gang thad nas khyad du thon pas mkhas blun mtha' dag gi yid mgu zhing bsngags pa'i rol mo 'khrol ba byung ngo / / chos kyi sde chen bkra shis sgo mang gi / chos khrims 'dzin pa'i res su son pa na/ / chos min brlang por sbyong rnams spa bkong zhing / / chos mthun tshogs kyi dbu 'phang ci yang bstod/ / rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son 522

༄༅/ /togasabarjod gzur gnayomakhasapa'i dga' ston/te/ / ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang chen du/ / rab 'byams smra ba'i grwa skor mdzad pa na/ / rigs lam dri med dga' ston mchog tu 'phel/ / nyid kyi dgongs par smon lam gyi dam bca' grub phral nas rgyud grwar phebs te sngags la slob gnyer tshad dang ldan pa byas/ de rjes mdo sngags kyi lam rdzogs pa'i nyams len rdo rus thug pa zhig gnang bzhed shugs drag po yod pas/ snga lo dgun thog rgyud pa 'bras srungs su phebs skabs dge rgan la snyan gsan phab nas gsol ja sogs drangs te thugs thag bcad yod kyang /tshogs mchod grol mtshams 'dul ba mkhan po gnang dgos tshul rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' babs/ ma 'gyang bar 'dul ba bla brang du spos te khri 'don rmedzad par rtse shod kyi sku tshab/ 'bras srung bla spyi so so/mkhan po dge 'dun bde chen dang / mgron gnyer mkhan po sogs mi drag mang po'i ngo tshab/ bsam blo khang tshan/ bis mdo mi tshan sogs spyi sger kun nas khri 'bul gye bdog pa gya nom pa bstar/ stod lung lding kha'i dgon pa 'dul ba mkhan po snga phyi'i 'dzin thebs su sprod len byed dgos pas der yang khri 'don mdzad/ bla ma gzhan gyi skabs sna tshogs byung yang khong la gus zhen che zhing rigs grwa'i zhabs 'gyur du phan thogs pa byung bas/ nyid nas kyang rjes sor 'gyed 'jog pa sogs spyan bskyangs che bar gnang / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub ngag mtshams dam po zla ba gsum tsam gnang ste rdo rje'i rnal 'byor brtan po la gzhol bar mdzad cing mjug tu kha skong gi sbyin sreg rgyas par gnang / 'di skabs las don sogs kyi thugs g.yeng chung bas byams mgon bla ma rin po che sogs kyi drung nas lam rim blo sbyong rim gnyis kyi khrid sogs yang yang gsan pa'i don bzhin thun mong ba lam gyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags zab mo'i 523

༄/ /gung thang jam pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/nyams bzhes zung du 'brel bar brtson pa rgyun chags su gnang bas nyams rtogs yar zla bzhin 'phel/ yi dam chos srung gi bsnyen pa'ang lo ltar gyis ma chag pa gnang / lan gcig rtse'i bzhugs gral du se ra byes pa'i bla ma mkhas grags shin tu che ba de dang lhan cig tshogs gleng mdzad de/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la zhes sogs kyis bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya bstan pa yin tshul gyi bgro gleng btang bas/ skabs shig pha rol pos bye brag smra bar gyur pa'i byang sems de nyan thos kyi rigs can yin zer dgos pa lta bu khas len 'dzin rgyu med pa byung bas kun ya mtshan du gyur/ rgyun par thugs dam gtsor 'don dang don gnyer can kha shas la chos bka' thor bu dpe khrid sogs gnang bzhin pa'i mu nas lo drug song ba shing lug lor rigs grwa btang ste dge 'dun stong phrag bdun du nye ba la nyin bco lnga'i ring mang ja'i bsnyen bkur dang tsha ra/ nyin ltar gyi 'gyed sna re dang 'gyed chen dngul ṭaṃ ga gnyis re/ lhag mchod du sgo mang la grwa ja bzhi dang dngul zho re/ khang tshan la skar lnga/ mi tshan la kha dar re bcas btang / 'dul ba bla brang 'di 'tshub che bas bla rabs snga phyi mang pos mthar phyin dka' ba byung yang / nyid bzhugs skabs 'tshub ci yang med pas shin tu bde bar byung ba thugs skyed dang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes ma g.yel ba'i stobs yin par mngon/ de skabs kyang 'ga' zhig gis rigs grwa gcig po 'di gegs ci yang med par mthar phyin pa legs byung bas mtshams 'dir dgongs pa zhus na zhes gros 'debs pa byung yang / dam pa nyid bya ba gang brtsams mthar thon nges shig byed pa rang gi gnas lugs lta bu yin pa dang / zar zir gyi g.yeng ba chung bas thugs dam 'phel ba sogs kyis thugs spro bar gyur te slar yang bzhugs pas nye zho med cing rigs grwa phyi 524

༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnayomakhas pa'i dga' ston/masngon las bldab 'gyur lta bur gtong rgyu byung ba 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ / 'dus pa'i dge 'dun mchog gi grwar phebs pa'i/ / 'dun pa shugs drag thugs la brnag na yang / / 'dul ba mkhan po'i go sar bka' babs pa/ / 'da' bar ma nus de yi khri la 'khod/ / thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam bzang gi / thugs dam zab mos nyin mtshan dus 'da' zhing / / zeg gsum dge 'dun sde la bsnyen bkur sogs/ / thams cad gegs med smon bzhin lhun gyis grub/ / har chen wang ratna yidhi'i sras tho yon mthu stobs nyi ma/ har chin zhabs drung / har chin zla ba tho yon sogs du mas dge rgan du bsten/ dge phrug sogs la bka' bskyon cher mi gnang yang / stobs kyis bsdigs pa med par 'gro kun 'dud/ / ces pa ltar nang gi rtogs pa'i stobs kyis rigs mthon po nga rgyal can sogs ci 'dra zhig yin kyang gsung las 'da' mi nus par skrag pa dang / de'i tshod kyis gus zhen che ru 'gro ba zhig yod la/ dpe khrid gnang tshul yang la la shes rab che mdog gis yin byas na'ang 'di bzhin byas chog/ min byas na'ang 'di bzhin byas chog ces rnam grangs mang ba la/ nang na rang lugs thag chod pa'i mdzub mo 'dzug sa med pa de 'dra mang po 'ong bar snang yang / de 'dra gtan mi mdzad par rtsa ba yig cha'i dgongs pa gzhir bzhag grwa tshang gi khas len gyi rgyun 'di yin zhes go bde la mdor 'dril ba'i gtsang sang nge ba re gsungs pa de sems la 'jags nas shin tu phan thogs pa/ sngon 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar gyi zhal nas/ chos gcig la dge bshes rwa pa'i chos las kha zhe gshin pa med/ rgya gar gyi paṇa grub 'di 'di skad gsung bya ba las rang bzo dang bod kyis se gtan nas mi byed gsung ba'i dpe lta bu zhig yod pas phan thogs shin tu che/ de'i gnad kyis rgyus yod rnams de 'dra'i rigs la khong dge 525

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i me'i khrung ཿma/rgan du bsten 'jug pas phyis nas bā rin wang gi tho yon dang / a lag shā wang gi tho yon sogs mang du byung / me bya'i lo gnyis pa'i nyi shur paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal dbang rin po cher thugs rdzogs gnang rgyu'i don du phebs par chibs bsu dang 'bras spung spyi so'i ja thab steng nas mjal kha zhus/gsum pa'i nang du paṇa chen mchog nas bde lam gyi gzab khrid sogs chos bka' mang po gnang ba phal cher gsan/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar jo bo shākya mu ni'i drung du paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas kun gzigs rgyal ba'i dbang por thugs rdzogs kyi sdom pa phog pa'i las gral du bzhugs te thub bstan rin po che'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa la legs smon grub pa'i skal bzang mngon du gyur/ de'i rjes thogs su rgyal dbang yab sras dge 'dun stong phrag mang po dang bcas gso sbyong lhan du mdzad de so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa nyams su myong bas bslab gzhi yongs su dag par mdzad/ lo hril por paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas gsung gi bdud rtsi mang du mnos/ de'i lo rjes ma'i gnyis pa'i zla mjug tu paṇa chen rin po che gtsang du phyir phebs par chibs skyel zhus/ lo der klong rdol grub dbang rin po che'i drung nas rje yab sras kyi gsung sogs chos bka' yang mang du gsan no/ / tshul khrims phung po yongs su rdzogs zin kyang / / tshangs spyod mchog gi brtul zhugs gsar nod kyi/ / tshul bzhes las kyi kha skong mdzad pa yis/ / tshe rabs 'phreng bar 'brel ba'i legs smon grub/ / yam bshad spun pa'i phung bo 'phyar min par/ / yang dag don gyi snying po sil ma yis/ / ya rab thar 'dod zhing pa'i re skong gi / yongs 'dzin gang de gtsug gis bsten bya yin/ / dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sa phag gi lo bdun pa'i tshes la rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang no min han nas lo rjes mar 526

༄za/ /togs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po dgung lo bdun cur phebs rgyu'i ba yar mkhan po la 'gro dgos pa'i bka' babs/ de nas phebs chas sogs gang dgos gzhung nas gra bsgrigs pa'i thog nas bcu gcig pa'i tshes la lam du chas/lhokha brgyud de phebs par rgya bod kyi sa tshigs so sor rta 'ul gyi gra sgrig le thogs med pas lam bgrod shin tu bde ba byung / lcags byi zla ba bdun pa'i nyi shu skor la yi hor du 'byor/ phyi nyin 7gong ma chen por tshe dpag med kyi sku/ bye ru'i rgyan 'phreng sogs thog ma'i mtshams zhu phul/ de nas bzung dpon g.yog thams cad la mdzod nas gsol chas kyi phog sogs rgya che ba gnang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par mjal bas bod phyogs kyi gsung gleng mang du gnang zhing dgyes gzigs che bar mdzad/ nyer bzhi'i nyin ston chen gnang yul gyi bzhugs gur shin tu che ba dbus su ka ring drugamathar ka thung mang po/ phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi yod pa'i dbus su dpangs la mi tshad tsam yod pa'i khri rgya chen po mdun dang g.yas g.yon nas skas btsugs pa/ de'i steng du rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i khri chen po nyis bsgrigs la 7gong ma bdag po chen po dang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs/g.yon ngos su lcang skya rdo rje 'chang / smin grol no mon han/ rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ nang gi ja sag bla ma rnams dang wang che khag mang po/ g.yas ngos su gsol dpon gangs can mkhan po dang / ba yar mkhan po nyid sogs bzhugs pa'i gsham tsam la'ang dpon chen mang po 'khod pas/mchod yon gnyis la gser rkyang las grub pa'i lder brgya phrag dang / gzhan rnams la dngul lder sha stag tu ston mo bstar zhing / 7gong ma'i gsol ston nas nang gi bla ma rnams dang mkhan po nyid la'ang gsol ras stsal/ nyi shu lnga nas bzung nyin bcu'i ring khrang zhi'i gzigs mo bstar ba la paṇa chen gyi 527

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/zhabs phyi zhus te lan kha yar phebs/ brgyad pa'i tshes gsum la 7gong nas paṇa chen rin po cher sbo sbas zhes pa rin po che'i tham ga dang 'ja' sa stsal par ba yar gyi kha btags phul/ tshes bdun la paṇa chen rin po che nas 7gong mar bdun cu'i ba yar gyi ston chen zhu skabs sogs gsol ston rim pa du mar phebs te 7gong ma'i gser zhal mjal/ tshes bcu gsum rgyal po'i 'khrungs skar gyi ba yar dngos gzhi'i rten 'byung gi thog ma rgyal dbang rin po che'i legs 'bul gyis byed dgos pas 7rgyal po dang paṇa chen mchod yon gong du bzhugs/ lcang skya rdo rje 'chang / btsan po no mon han/ rta tshag rje drung rin po che/ nang gi ja sag bla ma bzhi sogs bla ma sum cu tsam gral byas nas 'don pa gsung ba'i 'phror mkhan po nyid nas brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa gnang / 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po mi yi rjer/ / rol pa'i gnam gyi lha mchog zhabs padmor/ / gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla la sogs pa/ / snod bcu dge mtshan mtha' dag dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes sogs tshigs bcad re dang sbrags te rim pa bzhin 7gong ma'i phyag tu phul ba bzhes te shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ rten chas kyang nang mdzod sna lnga'i 'dog bcas kyi maṇḍal/ 'jigs byed mgon chos lha mo sku lnga so so dang bcas pa'i thang chen dpangs thog so gnyis zheng 'dom phyed do re yod pa gos chen rgyu rnying khyad 'phags kyi gong gsham can tog zhal kheb sogs 'gang che ba grangs mtshungs dgu/ dngul dkar blug gi bde mchog lha lnga/ ku ru kulle sogs dpangs kha brgyad re can/ dngul dkar gyi rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad sogs khru gang lhag tsam re yod pa/ kha che sha kha ma/ kha sar ba ṇi/ 'ba' sha rgun 'brum/ bye ris/ shel dkar so so nas rgam bco lnga re/ spos dmar do bo lnga bcu/ phrug do po bdun cu sogs rten chas 528

༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/mtha' dag rgyal ba'i phyag tham dang bcas ma nyams par phul/ de'i mjug tu mthud de bkra shis lhun po'i sku chas gsar 'byor gyi phud lta bur 7gong du bdog pa spel bar gnang / de nas ston mo'i skabs mkhan po nyid dang yi hor po ta la'i mkhan po mdung nag zhabs drung gnyis kyis tshogs gleng byas par brjod don phun sum tshogs shing rjod byed tshig bkra legs pa dang rnam 'gyur sogs sgo thams cad nas lhun chags pas mig dang rna ba'i bdud rtsi spro bar mdzad/ de skabs 'dzam gling gi che dgu phyogs gcig tu 'dzoms pa bzhin mchod yon nyi zla zung du 'brel/ gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i bla ma che khaga'ajig rten mes po lta bu'i blo chen rnams dang / gzhan yang lus kyi cha lugs mi 'dra ba/ ngag gi skad rigs mi gcig pa/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so mi mtshungs pa'i dpon rigs dang blon po che chung grangs med pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i dbus der brtan bzhugs kyi bshad pa dang tshogs gleng sogs gang gi skabs su'ang dpa' zhum pa med par sku'i gzi byin rgyas shing gsung gi gdangs mtho bas khrom zil gyis gnon pa byung bar/ 7gong ma chen po shin tu thugs mgu bas spyir bla ma ser mo pa dang / sgos su nyi ma nub phyogs kyi bstan pa'i la rgya/ rgyal ba'i dbang bo mchog gi 'phrin las kyi zhabs 'degs bla na med par gyur/ de nas gral du bzhugs skabs 7gong ma chen po nas tā la'i bla ma'i sku tshab kyi gdan dma' song 'dug gsungs nas 'bol sum rtseg byed du bcug cing / ho thog thu der sdod ces ho thog thu'i thob dang / mang myug gi lwa ba/ byu ru'i rgyan phreng sogs gnang / gsol ston grol nas bla dpon che khag mang pos nyid la legs so'i kha dar phul/ 7gong nas rjes sor yang gos chen dang gos khug sogs kyi gnang sbyin lan 'ga' zhig stsal/ gtso cher paṇa chen mchog nas 7gong mar zhu mkhas mdzad pa 529

༄/ /gung ca bstan losgroname'i ga4 'bum/dang / de'i yan lag tu dam pa nyid kyis zhabs brtan 'bul tshul sogs gang ci nas 7gong ma chen po shin tu dgyes te rgyal dbang rin po cher yu'u shis kyi tham ga 'ja' sa sogs gzengs bstod tshad med gnang rgyu'i sgo dod pas 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs te phebs pa'i dgosadon gtso bo lhun gyis grub/ dgu ba'i nang la pho brang du phebs nas shar su mer bzhugs/ sku chas rnams dang po nas 'dir phab yod pas paṇa chen rin po cher maṇḍal sku gsung thugs rten/ phrug bco lnga/ zer ril sum cu/ spos ngo bo gcig mnga' ris mgo stabs pa ko khra gcig bcas phul/ zhabs phyi nyer gsum yod pa so sos kyang sprug re mjal dar du phul/paṇa chen rin po che nas da lan khyed kyis rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku don lar rgya la 'di las lhag pa'i go gcod tshul med/ legs so rgya chen po zhig gi bab 'os yod kyang slar bod du song nas byed rtsis yin pas/ da lan mtshon byed tsam yin gsung ste/ mdzod gos khyad 'phags yug bcu nang mdzod bcas gnang / zhabs phyi rnams la srang bcu re dang gos yug re bdag rkyen stsal/ nyid skabs skabs su lcang skya rin po che'i mdun du phebs te chos kyi 'phros pa/ sngon gyi grwa sa so so dang a mdo'i phyogs kyi lo rgyus/rgya nag gi gnas tshul sogs lugs gnyis kyi gsung 'phros shin tu 'phel zhing thugs mnyes mnyes kho na gnang / nyin gcig lam shes yan lag las brtsams pa'i dri ba zhig gnang bar don bdun cu dang skabs gnyis pa'i mtha' dpyod kyi tshig zin cung mi 'dra tshul dang bcas zhib tu zhus par/khyod kyis da dung yig cha ma brjed 'dug pa shin tu legs/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yig cha 'di gcig go na ri mthon po'i rtse nas bltas dus ri chung thams cad kha 'og tu chud yod pa lta bu zhig yin/ nga'ang las don gyi g.yeng 530

༄༅/ /togs brjod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/ba che song bas slob gnyer bsam pa ltar zhig byed rgyu ma byung yang / yig cha 'di la 'dzin skyor dga' bo byas ba'i khul yin pas da lta po ti lnga la go ba zhig chags pa 'di'i drin yin/ snga mo co nee no mon han gyis nga la nyin gcig grub mtha' thams cad kyi 'dod tshul gsal bar ston pa khyod kyi grub mtha' 'di lta bu'i rgyas po sngar ma byung 'dug pas bka' drin che zer bar/ ngas khyed kyis 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i grub mtha' chen mo gzigs yod mod byas par lta ma myong zer/ 'o na nga'i 'di de'i nang nas nyer mkho nyung nyung zhig btus pa yin/ grub mtha'i 'gro phyogs shig shes 'dod tshe blta na lta rgyu der yod byas pa yin gsung / de las 'phros te bka' mchid mang po gnang ba'i lhongs shig la khyed tsho sgo mang gi dge bshes tshos rdo rje'i gzeg ma'i gtan tshigs zhes pa'i rdo rje de gser gyi rdo rje yin zer gyin yod dam/ zang gi rdo rjeyin zer gyin yod gsungs par/ de 'dra min/ rdo rje pha lam des rdo dang lcags la sogs pa thams cad gcod nus pa ltar/ gtan tshigs 'dis mtha' bzhi las bye bar 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dog gi mtha' thams cad gcod nus pa'i don yin zhus par/ ngas rtsed mo byas pa yin/ snga mo khong gis de 'dra byas dris byung gsungs nas bzhad mo gnang / dge bshes gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang deng sang shes rab che mdog kha bo yod kyang / rtsod gra bzhag nas lo gnyis gsum zhig song dus brtsad pa'i rjes med par 'gro gi 'dug sngon gyi dge bshes 'di tshos gang shes pa de brjed rgyu med pa rdo thog tu phur ba btab pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa de sngon dang deng sang gi mi'i rang bzhin brtan mi brtan dang dang po nas slob gnyer rgyag lugs ma 'dra ba red ces bsngags brjod mdzad 'dug nyin gcig lcang skya rin po che'i mdun du pheb skabs/ a mye tshang khyed rang la thugs shin tu dgyes 'dug pas/ ja 531

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'bum/sag bla ma'i thob lta bu re zhu 'dod na zur tsam zhig btang bas chog tshod red gsungabyung bar/ spyir bod lung pa na de 'dra zhig byung phyin don yod med thams cad 'jar nas yong zhing / che chung thams cad ming dang go sa zhig ma gtogs bsam rgyu med pa'i mig ltos la dpag na rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed pa yin mod kyang / dam pa 'di ni rang gi gshis lugs kyis 'dod chung chog shes la gnas pa dang bya ba gang la'ang tshod zin cing / phugs su dgos pa ci yod dang gnod pa ci yod kyi phyi rjes su gzigs pa sogs lugs gnyis char nas lhus zangs pa'i mthar thug pa zhig yod pas/ de rigs gtan mi dgos zhes zhus nas dang du ma bzhes/ tshul 'di ni spyod 'jug las/grags pa'i don du nor gtong zhing / / bdag nyid kyang ni gsod byed na/ /tshig 'bru rnams kyis ci zhig bya/ / shi na des ko su la bde/ / bstod dang grags pa'i rim gro ni/ / bsod nams mi 'gyur tsher mi 'gyur/ / bdag stobs mi 'gyur nad med min/ / lus bde bar yang mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes ming dang grags skam des ci la'ang phan rgyu med par gsung ba'i don kha bshad lag len du yod pa chos dang rgyud 'dres pa'i rnam thar rmad du byung ba'o/ /dgu pa'i bcu gsum la so'u he'i rten bya ba rgyal po na rim khri 'don gnang sa'i pho brang / rgyun par rgyal po'i bka' med par nang du song yang mi chog pa der mchod yon zhal 'dzom gyi ston mo gnang ba'i bzhugs gral du'ang phebs/ rgyun par mkhan nang rnams zhag grangs 'char can gye phog yod pa grub nas mi sdod kyang 'di lo 7gong ma chen po nas da lo dgun grang mo red/tā la'i bla ma'i elce mkhan po la phog 'phar ma gnang rgyu yin pas sems bde mo byas nas sdod ces bka' bsgyur zhing / bu la han gyi tā hu/ dngul gyi khrus bum khrus gzhong / sga srab sdom bcas cha 'grig rnams gnang / 'on 532

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkha4pa'i dga' ston/kyang nyid lo rjes mar rigs grwa gtong dgos pa'i thugs khur gyi stabs lcang skya rin po che langs rigs grwa mi non 'dug stabs dgongs pa zhu thabs shig bka' drin bskyang dgos zhus par ngas khyod shes rgya che bsam re ma che ba red/7gong ma rgyal pos dgun grang gi gsung ba de sa dang rdo grang gi byas pa ma red/khyod la thugs rtsis che bas sha tsha gnang ba red/ gtong sgo ci 'dra byed rgyu yin yi ge zhib mo bris na rta zam thog nas gri tsi btang chog gsungs/ de bzhin byas te gre tsi btang ba srid skyong no mon han gye phyag tu 'byor pas/khong gis kyang ser 'bras kyi bla ma rnams la da lo mkhan po chos dar gyis go bcad yod pa snang / gzhan gyi don dag la 7gong ma tshang gis 'di 'dra byas nas gre tsi btang mi yong / kho la 7gong ma ha cang mnyes nas bdag rkyen chen po byung ba red gsungs te de ga rang yin par snang ngo / / 7gong zhabs mchod yon gdan 'dzom mdun sa cher/ / gong sa mchog gi bka' 'phrin spel ba la/ / gong na med pa'i rnam dpyod gar bsgyur tshe/ / 7gong ma chen pos dgyes zhal lhug par bstan/ / rgyal blon nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bu'i dbus/ / rgyal dbang mchog gi mdzad pa 'phrin las kyi/ / rgyal mtshan srid pa'i rtse mor bsgrengs pa 'di/ / rgyal ba'i bstan la'ang bya ba chung ngu min/ /rigs grwa'i gtong sgo'i skor nyid nas gsung bkod gnang ba bzhin sde pa skal bzang sogs kyis khur len byas te/ 'gyed chen la zho lnga re/ nyin ltar gyi mang 'gyed/ sgo mang la lhag mchod grwa ja bzhi'i thog 'gyed dngul zho gsum re/ khang tshan la kha btags bcas btang ste/ rgyun par 'dul shāka rgyal gsum rigs chung yin kyang rigs 'bring gi gtong sgo las kyang lhag pa byung /snga lo bskul ma gnang yod pa bzhin nged kyis kyang mang ja gcig dang rdo tshad bdun gyis skar lnga'i 'gyed bcas rigs grwa'i zhal 'debs su phul/ de 533

༄/ /gung thang bstan losgroname'i g.yo 'bum/nas pho brang du tsardon jo bo sogs la mchod 'bul dang phyag skor/ dad ldan du mar chos sbyin yang mang du gnang / paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dgongs pa gzhan du gtad rjes ho thug thu rnams dang lhan du zla ba gcig gi ring dgongs dzogs kyi rim pa bsgrubs te gsol 'debs zhus/ nyid nas sger du'ang mchod 'bul sogs rgya gang che zhus/ de skabs phyogs so so nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen par bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhu ba'i phyir 'ongs pa mang bo lus song ba rnams/ lcang skya rin po che nas paṇa chen gyi yongs 'dzin la bsgrub tu bcug na zhus par/ 7gong mas tā la'i bla ma'i elci mkhan po 'dug pa de la bsgrub tu chug gsung ste/ bsgrub bya sum brgya lhag tsam la bsnyenadzogs kyi sdom pa phog ste bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhi la bkod cing thar pa'i sa bon grung po 'debs par mdzad/ 'di ni paṇa chen mchog gi'ang mdzad pa'i 'phro bskangs te zad med kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub pa'i mchod pa bla na med pa yin la/ bsgrub bya de dag kyang mgon med skyabs med du lus pa'i tshe yid la brnag pa'i don las kyi cho gar/ khyod sngon bdag legs par gsung ba'i chos 'dul ba las rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob na ci ma rung snyam du smon pa de/deng khyod mkhan por 'os pa dang slob dpon du 'os pa dang / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las mi g.yo ba bzhag par mi 'os pas rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs so/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin mdzad pas bka' drin bla na med par gyur to/ / tshul de dag la brten nas tsho chen zhe dgu sogs kyi mjal ba dang chos 'brel zhu mkhan yang zam ma chad par byung / de'i zhar la bdog pa'i mchod sprin rgya che zhing dngos gtsang ba dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin 'dus pas rigs grwa'i gtong sgo sogs kyi zebs gang dgos dka' tshegs ci yang med 534

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/par lhun grub tu byung ste/ phar phyin bsdus pa las/ tshig tu ma brjod tshegs su ma gyur kyang / / nyams su mkho ba'i longs spyod rim gro 'du/ /zhes tshul khrims kyi phan yon du gsungs pa dang / dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ bsod nams ldan pa'i nyer mkho rnams/ / 'bad pa med par phun sum tshogs/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ 'di ni mtshon byed tsam yin gyi/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun/ / rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin/ / 'bras bu mchog gis spa ba yi/ / sems dpa' chen po de la ni/ / rnam pa kun tu rten par byed/ / ces gsungs pa ltar sems dpa' chen po rnams la bde dge legs tshogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgya mtsho la chu bo bzhin du 'du ba ni chos nyid yin no/ / de rjes 7gong ma chen po nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par 'tshams zhus kyi lan gser dngul gos chen rin po che'i spyad pa sna tshogs pas mtshon khyad nor dpag tu med pa'i rten chas dang / nyid la'ang gnang sbyin rgya chen po bcas stsal te gser gyi rgyal khab nas btegs sa tshigs so so'i rgya'i dpon po rnams kyis bsu skyel dang tsho zhag gi gra sgrig rnams bkur gzos phul du che ba'i steng nas rim gyis phebs te rgya grong zad mtshams su dar rtse mdo sa dkar mgo'i nang nas bzhugs/lcags la rgyal pos yā mun la gdan 'dren byas te 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur zhus/ lnga mchod dgon dang lha mo rtse'i dgon pa gnyis kyis gdan drangs te bsnyen bkur bstabs/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang chos spyod kha shas kyi lung zhus/ dngos 'bul gyi gya nom pa phul/ khams li thang la phebs nas sde pa a sang nor bu'i nang du bzhugs/ li thang mkhan po chos grags kyis li thang dgon par gdan 'dren zhus par phebs shing mang 'gyed gnang / de nas rim gyis phebs te 'ba' sde pa rnam nges tshang nas bzhugs/ 'ba' sde chen 535

༄/ /gung thang bam pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/khang sar du gdan 'dren zhus/ 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur gzabs/ ma 'gam la phebs te 'od zer sprul sku'i nang du bzhugs/ ma 'gam ze jis gdan drangs/ dngos 'bul dang bsnyen bkur gang legs byas/ de nas khams brag yab byams mdun du phebs/ brag g.yab che tshang dang chung tshang gnyis kyis 'tshams zhu phul/ zla gam chab mdor rgyal ba 'phags pa lha dang zhi ba lha rnam gnyis dang mjal 'phrad gnang / dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ tshur la'ang gnang sbyin gtos che ba stsal/ khams ri bo cher phebs/ nags shod dgon pa'i ja sag bla mas 'tshams zhu dang dngos 'bul bgyis/ khams sho ba mdo'i dgon par phebs skabs grwa mang nas rten 'brel bstod pa'i lung sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig zhus te dngos 'bul dang bsnyen bkur shin tu gzabs/ de nas rim gyis phebs te nub gangs la'i mdo rdo thig nas bzhugs pa'i dgung mo phyag mdzod la nub gangs la 'dir bstan ma gnas pa 'dra gsungs/ de ci red zhus par/ de nas bstan ma phebs te khyod la sgo mang mkhan po yong gsungs pa zhig rmis byung /bon kyang nga la de yong don ga la yod gsungs/ de ltar lam skabs su nye zho ci yang med cing bstan 'gro'i don mdzad bzhin pa'i mu nas lha sar phebs/de'i tshe am ban gnyis dang bka' blon bzhi/ 7gong ma'i cho lo yod pa rnams kyis gser yig la phebs bsu dang / mkhan po nyid la ja thab byas/de rjes gser yig po ta lar gdan 'dren zhus skabs no mon han gzim chung phyi ma'i sgor phebs nas pus btsugs/ rgyal ba rin po che bzhugs khri'i rtsar phebs/ de nas nyid kyes 7gong ma'i bka' bsgyur ba ni gnam gyi lha'i bka'/ khyod tā la'i bla ma'i sprul sku bde mo e yin zhes zhus te rgyal ba'i phyag tu gser yig phul/ rten chas bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams rim bzhin 536

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkha4pa'i dga' ston/spyan lam du bstar/ no mon han dang am paṇa gnyis bka' blon bzhi/bod kyi cho lo yod pa rnams la so so'i go bab kyi 7gong ma'i rten chas rim par sprad/ de nas gzhung gis ston chen gnang / de'i steng du skyabs mgon rgyal ba rin po che dang no min han sogs thugs shin tu dgyes nyams kyi gsung gleng mang po mdzad/ zhag kha shas song nas 'bras spung du phebs/ tshogs chen la mang ja bzhi dang 'gyed kha re/ sgo mang grwa tshang la grwa ja bzhi dang dngul zho gsum re/ bsam blo khang chen la dngul zho do re dang tshom ja bzhi/bis mdo mi tshan la dngul ṭaṃ kha re dang tshom ja bzhi btang / rgyal ba rin po cher gzim chung nang du 'bul ba dngul gyi maṇḍal 'dogs bcas/ nang mdzod kha btags/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul srang nyis brgya/ gos yug bco lnga/ shing thog sna tshogs ko khra lnga/ shing thog a mra sgam gsum/tha ma ka ko khra lnga bcas rnam grangs nyis brgya dang sum cu rtsa gsum/ ne min han la'ang maṇḍal/ mdzod btags/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul srang brgya/ gos yug bdun/ shing thog ko khra bzhi/ tha ma ka ko khra gsum bcas rnam grangs brgya dang dgu bcu phul/ 'dul ba bla brang rtsis sprad nas lha dbang gling du zur bzhugs mdzad/ rgyal dbang rin po che nas khyod rang gong ma bdag po chen po dgung lo bdun cur phebs pa'i bkra shis khri phrag gi ba yar 'bul bar phyin skabs 'di ga'i bstan srid la rgyar shin tu phan pa byung bas dmigs bsal gyi bsko bzhag bgyis pa yin gsungs te lho brag chung tshang dgon ma lag dang bcas pa'i mkhan sa bdag rkyen la gnang / der byon nas khri 'don gnang skabs dngos 'bul rgya chen po dang / khyad par sku gsung thugs rten gyi gtso bor dzhai kṣim las grub pa'i jo'i sku khru tshad ma gan chag brag ra'i nang rten gyi gtso bo de nyid phul bas thugs shin tu dgyes/537

༄khya/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgronama'i gsung 'bum/phar yang mang 'gyed sogs kyis tshim par mdzad/ lo bdun gyi ring la 'dzin bdag byas/ bis mdo mi tshan la sngar tshom med pas/ tshom ja yod tshe rgyud khang steng gi g.yab skor du 'tshogs dgos pa sogs 'o brgyal bar yong ba dang / rgyal khang rtse'i khang mig rnams sngar grwa pa nang phan tshun nyo tshong byas te 'gro ba zhig yod pa de skabs nyo mkhan sogs 'grig pa zhig ma byung bas tshur bsnyegs nas 'ongs pa lta bus dka' tshegs med par byung ba nyos te mi tshan gyi tshoms su sbyor 'jag gnang / sngar grwa rkyang skabs der yang yang bzhugs rgyur song zhing / 'di dus rten 'brel rang 'grig gis phyag tu 'ong lugs dang / sngon chos grwa 'grim skabs mnga' ris sprul sku rin po che nas khyed rgyud grwar 'gro rgyu byung na dga' ldan khri pa byed rgyu'i sngon gyi las smon gyi 'phro zhig 'dug gsungs pa rnams gung bsgrigs te/ dpyod ldan 'ga' zhig khri rgyal khang rtse ba'i skye mthar gleng ba'ang byung / de ni khri thog nyer lnga pa/mtshan dngos dpal 'byor rgya mtsho rgyal khang rtser yun ring bzhugs pas rgyal khang rtse bar grags/ rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtshos khu ston gyi skye bar lung bstan/ phyag mdzod seng ge sogs rgyal ba'i sprul sku gdan 'dren la sog yul du 'gro skabs/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho zhes mtshan 'dogs mkhan yang khong yin la/dus thog der bstan 'gro la phan pa'i 'phrin las che shos shig byung bar snang ngo / / de ltar lha dbang gling du zur bzhugs kyi skabs phal cher bcad rgya lta bu'i ngos nas thugs dam mdzad cing / gzhung nas bka' phebs te rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan la tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar/ mgon po tshe bdag sogs kyi tshe sgrub kyang lo ltar bdun phrag gnyis gsum re gnang / chu stag lo nyid kyi dge phrug har chin tho yon mthu stobs nyi ma la zhur bcug ste/ snyigs 538

༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnayomakhayopa'i dga' ston/ma'i dus 'dir rje btsun mi la dang mtshungs par chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba grol ba'i rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i drung nas thar 'dod yongasakyi 'jug ngogs gcig pu byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen mo mchan sum sbrags kyi bshad lung rgyas pa man ngag gi gnad du mas brgyan pa dang / rgyud sde kun gyi rgyal po dang mdo sde kun gyi za ma tog dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dgongs don rjen par ston pa 'grel pa bzhi sbrags kyi bshad lung smin rgyas/ gzhan yang brgyad stong pa/ bka' gdams gzhung drug 'grel chen dri med 'od/ byams chos sde lnga/ tshad ma sde bdun/ mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba/ me tog phreng rgyud/ mdo kun las btus pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ nag po gzhung drugaphreng ba skor gsum/ dril bu'i gzhung chung gsum/ khru i pa'i rgya gzhung /mdo bsre/ mdor byas/ dkyil chog nyi shu ba/ rnam bzhag rim pa/gsang 'dus rim lnga/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang ba ri brgya rtsa'i rgya gzhung /snar thang brgya rtsa'i rang gzhung sogs rgya gzhung dang / bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ rgyal po bka' 'bum/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud 'grel sbas don kun gsal/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ bskyed rim dngos grub rgya mtsho/'jigs byed bskyed rim chen mo/ 'khrul 'khor khams gsum nim rgyal/yig chung yang chung sogs dang / mgon po'i be bum/ rnam sras bee bum/beg rtse'i be bum/ lha mo'i las gsum rnam gzhag thar rtse pa'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang / chos spyod rab gsal gsar rnying gnyis kyi lung sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos rgyun dpag tu med pa zla ba mang por sbrel te rgya mtsho las chu bcu ba bzhin du bzhes nas thugs kyi yol go 'gengs par mdzad/ phyi nas dga' ldan khrir phebs pa gzim khang chos mdzad ngag dbang snyan grags 539

༄/ /gung thang b.lo pa'i sgoname'i ga4 4ma/sogs dge bshes mang pos kyang de'i zhar la thob pas rgya bod kyi gzhung 'gang che zhing rgyun nyag phra ba mang po'i chad mthud du gyur pa'i rtsa ba dam pa 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin/ der ma zad yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas lo ltar ston dpyid la bka' chos chen mo gnyis re gnang gi yod pas/ shing 'brug lo'i dpyid chos skabs bdag gis 'di lo ston ga'i bka' chos la 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i bshad lung zhig thugs rjes gzigs dgos zhes gsol ba btab par dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes/dbyar ka yang bskyar gyis nyer len zhus pa'i tshe no min han la gcig zhu dgos gsungs/ der phyin nas zhus pas/ ston dpyid kyi bka' chos 'char can 'di sde pa gzhung nas zhus pa yin/ so sos gang 'dod re gnang rgyu yin na rang rang gis gdan 'dren zhus/ me ru nas 'dul ba 'dra gnang ste mi tshe'i 'du khang bshig btang mi chog gsungs nas dgongs pa ma khrol/ da byed thabs mi yong bar 'dug snyam phyir song ste rgyu mtshan bla ma la zhus pas/ khyod rang sems pham mi dgos/ 'bras spung gdan sa khyad par can yin pas nga rang la mjal 'dun zhig kyang yod/ nga rang tsho'i 'di ci las kyang yag po zhig yong gsungs/ gsung zur de la brten nas bdag gis dge rgan rin po che mkhan po skal bzang dngos grub par da cha gzhan stabs mi 'dug pas 'bras spung spyi zhus kyi ming zhig 'jog dgos par 'dug zhus pas thugs shin tu 'thad kyang no min han gyi stabs dogs pa gnang gi 'dug 'on kyang bla ma tshogs 'du'i steng nas gleng bslang bar/ dam pa 'di nyid nas/ bla ma gzhan dang mi 'dra ba/ gdan sa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba/ chos gzhan dang mi 'dra ba yin pas dogs pa byed rgyu yod dogs med/ zhus thong zhes gros mgo bton te gdan 'dren zhus/ gdan sa phan tshun nas blo gsal don 540

༄/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnas mkha4pa'i dga' ston/gnyer 'dus pa lnga stong tsam la bdun pa'i tshes brgyad nas bzung nyin nyi shu'i ring bstan pa'i nang mdzod 'dul pa mdo rtsa ba'i bshad lung / de nas sgo mang la mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bshad lung / blo gsal gling du 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snyeng po'i bshad lung / bde yangs par sman bla mtho brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / sngags par bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bshad lung bcas gnang / 'bras spung spyi so'i gtong sgo rnams rang rang ngos thad kyi gzhi ga'i thog nas yong bas spyi na sprod len byed rgyu cher med stabs spyi so nas 'bul ba'i rnam bzhag cher mi 'dug la/ rang nyid rtsa ba'i zhu bar song stabs gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul rta rmig ma gnyis/ gos yug kha shas bcas phul bas/ bka' chos grol nas phyir yong skabs dam pa 'di nyid nas/ khyed kyis nged 'bras spung bla ma tsho'i ngo'i 'bag bshus song zhes rtsed mo gnang gi 'dug la/ bka' chos 'di skor la'ang khong bka' drin che bar byung / ci mdzad bstan pa la phan rlabs bka' drin che ba kho nar 'byung ba ni rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam grub pa'i 'bras rtags su mngon/des mtshon te yongs 'dzin rin po che'i mdun nas chos bka' mang po snga phyir gsan zhing / skabs shig rgyal sras rin po che skal bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas kyis rnam rgyal grwa khang du rdo rje phreng ba dang mi tra ba rgya rtsa sogs gnang ba'ang legs par gsan te gsang chen gdams pa'i nor bus thugs kyi bang mdzod phyur bur gtams/ don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis nan gyis zhus te chos bka' 'ga' zhig gnang yang de gtso bor mi mdzad par rang gis gsan rgyu dang / de ma yin pa'i skabs thams cad du dben pa las skyes pa'i bde bas thugs phrogs te nyams bzhes la shin tu 'grus par mdzad pas thugs dam yar zla bzhin 'phel/ mdzad pa 541

༄/ /yo ca bstan pa'i me'i gsung 'bum/'di'ang don chen po kun gyis go dgos pa zhig yin te/ deng dus phal mo che rang gis ma thosakong nas gzhan la bshad par rings pa/ slob gnyer mgo tshugs tsam nas mkhas pa'i grags pa 'dod pa/ sgom sgrub kyi sne ma zin par grub thob re ba sogs 'bras bu 'dod kyang rgyu la g.yel ba ni gang yang mi 'grub pa'i snga ltas yin pas/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa 'dod na dam pa'i mdzad srol 'di bzhin byed dgos te/ bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/khyod ni yon tan rgyu rnams la/ / mngon dgyes 'bras bu rnams la min/ /yang dag sgrub pa de nyid kyis/ / khyod kyi yon tan pha mthar phyin/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / shing 'brug gi lo mjug tu kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dbus su chibs bskyod par phebs bsu zhu zhing sngar nas thugs 'dris che bas yang yang mdun du phebs te lugs gnyis kyi gsung gleng 'phel/ kun mkhyen mchog nas khyed bkra shis 'khyil du phebs dgos gsungs bar khas len zhus/ phyi lo kun mkhyen mchog gtsang du phebs te chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba dang paṇa chen rnam thar bka' rtsom mdzad pa sogs kyis lo ngo lhag tsam 'gyang bas/ de'i shul du gzhung sa rin po che nas dam pa 'dir rgya nag mkhan por phebs dgos kyi bka' babs/gnang ba zhu rtsis mdzad kyang gnang ba zhus mi chog ces dgongs pa ma khrol/denas byang kha brgyud de phebs par lam skabs kun tu dpon g.yog rta khal dang bcas par nyes skyon ci yang med pas bde skyid dang / 7gong du mjal te rta lo'i lo gsar la zhabs brtan dang rten chas 'bul rgyu sogs gra gang 'grig 7gong ma chen pos kyang dgyes gzigs kyi bka' sogs gang legs/'char can gyi rten chas rgya chen po gnang ba sogs snga ma'i skabs bzhin bkra shis lugs legs kyi mu nas yar phebs pa dang / kun mkhyen 'jam 542

༄/ /rtogasabarjodagazur gnasamakhalopa'i dga' ston/dbyangs bzhad pa phyir chibs kha bsgyur ba nag chu'i mtsho mo rang mjal 'dzoms byung / phan tshun legs skyes spel zhing gsung 'phros mdzad/ kun mkhyen mchog nas khyed yar phebs na rgyal dbang rin po che'i thugs la sgo mang blamar sko rgyu'i thugs 'dun 'dug pas/ de byas te grwa tshang la 'chad nyan yag po zhig gnang na de gal che/ khyed kyis sngar 'dul ba bla ma byas te rigs grwa gnyis btang 'dug pas da lan gcig las gtong mi dgos/de'i mtshams su nged kyis bsu ma gtong rgyu yin pas phebs dgos zhes gsung yang bskyar phebs par/ snga ma'i khas len 'gyur med kyi lan zhus/ yar 'byor nas rgyal bar gser yig dang rten chas 'bul rgyu/ gzhung gis ston chen sogs sngar rgyun bzhin byas/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par gzim chung gi 'bul bar/ dngul gyi maṇḍal/ mdzod btags gcig sku gsung thugs rten/ dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ gos yug bco lnga/shel ka ra sgam gsum/ tha ma ka ko ṭa lnga/ sis thog a mra sgam gnyis bcas rnam grangs brgya dang brgyad cu gya gcig phul/ de nas 'bras spung la phebs/'bras spung tshogs chen la mang ja bzhi dang 'gyed zho re/ sgo mang grwa tshang la grwa ja bzhi 'gyed skar ma phyed brgyad de/ khang tshan mi tshan la'ang tshom ja 'gyed bcas btang ste de skor gyi bya bzhag thams cad kyang bde blag tu 'grub bo/ / che dgu'i thugs kyi ri rtser mi 'gro ba/ / chos tshul zab rgyas yan lag brgyad ldan gyi/ / chu rgyun dad pa'i gshong bur 'khyil ba yi/ / cha tsam gyis kyang srid zhi'i gdung ba sel/ / 'jam dbyangs mi yi rje bor yang bskyar gyis/ / mjal bas bzhed dgu grub nas slar log tshe/ / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes slad kyi dus/ / mjal 'dzoms dgos pa'i bka' phebs dang du bzhes/ de nas ma 'byang bar sgo mang mkhan por bsko bzhag gi 543

༄7/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonas gsung 'bum/bka' bsgyur/ dgung lo nga lngar phebs pas sa ra bha bā ste zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i gral tshes bzang por mkhas grub klu dbang stong gi rol mtsho/ lung rigs dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i dga' tshal/'khrul bral bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung khungs/ 'dzam bu'i ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling 'dir bshad grwa ji snyed cig yod pa las rab dang phul dang rtse mo'i tog tu son pa dpal ldan bkra shis sgo mang gi chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por mnga' gsol/ rgyal dbang rin po che nas a khu lags kyi sku tshab mngags te sku gsung thugs rten dang na bza' cha tshang bcas phul/ gzhan yang yongs 'dzin rin po che/ byams pa rin po che'i sprul sku/ rgyal ba'i sku mched rje drung rnam gnyis/ bka' blon chu mig g.yu thog mda' dpon/dga' ldan khang gsar gye ja sag bla ma/ sku ca ra dge 'dun/ mgron gnyer lha ri chos mdzad sogs gzhung gi mi drag du ma'i ngo tshab/ bka' blon bzhi'i tshong dpon sogs phyogs nas 'ongs pa che kha bzhi bcu skor dang /didīX tt+waṃ bhe sdi so bla ṭwāṃ dīdīdī swā gyig dīXs ba/ pho bhe ༵ hūṃm pa gye/ dardo di ṭwāṃ ༵ /༵ phal cher gyis kha dar phul zhing bdog pa'i tshan grangs rgya gang che btegs/gzhi byes kyi mgron rnams la dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa bstabs/gzhung nas rigs chen kyi gtong zebs shel dkar dgon pa'i mkhan sa gnang bar sa thag ring bas dngos su phebs ma thub kyang mā zhabs drung sku tshab tu mngags te 'dzin bdag mdzad/ dgun chos chen mo'i 'dzin grwa phye ba dang dus 'grig bas po ti thams cad kyi mgo nas rtsi bzhag btang / de'ang nyug ring la mchad ba sgra dag cing gsang bstod de gnang bas rang rang gis skyor dus dang mi 'dra ba'i go ba ster ba lta bu dang / phar phyin ston mo'i dam 5yo

go༅/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/bca' skor la 'phros pa yang yang mdzad cing / de'ang rigs 'gros ded tsam ma yin par yig cha'i stod smad kun lhu bsgrigs te 'di e 'phang 'di la ci zer zhes gsungs pa na rtsod bzhin ba tshor yang de tsam mi nges pas blo skyed che ba dang / de'i rkyen gyis rgyun par kha brgyad kyi bgro gleng kho nas nyi ma 'phul thabs byed pa tsho'ang tshur yig cha 'ba' zhig gi steng du 'khor ba byung /skabs shig bca' yig gi steng nas tshogs gtam zhib rgyas gnang bas bshad bzhin pa dang nyan bzhin pa'i yam yam de ma yin par/ thams cad la 'di bzhin ma byas pa'i thabs yod rgyu ma red snyam sems thog tu lci yor gyis 'bab pa dang / 'grig 'gal log sgrub can rnams rang gnong la me btsa' sha thog tu bab pas tsha 'ub kyis 'gro ba/ tshul mthun gyi slob gnyer pa rnams dga' lhangagis 'gro ba ste/ mdor na bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa las/ bag med rnams ni skrag par mdzad/ / mkhas pa rnams kyi dga' ba skyed/ / bar ma rnams kyi blo yang spel/ / gsung 'di skye bo kun la sman/ / zhes pa ji lta ba bzhin byung / de'ang bshad mkhas pa dang / dbang che ba'i stobs min gyi/gsung ba po rang nyid la de dang don mthun pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba/bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan cing dul la blo gros che/ / bzod ldan drang la g.yosgyu med/ / ces sogs kyi khyad par mig mthong lag bzung lta bur grub pa'i dbang gis yin no/ / de nas 'grig lam bya spu non gyi tshul du gnon lugs las sne so so la bkod pas khyab par mdzad de tshogs chos grwa'i rting skul/rgyug rtsi bzhag yod med kyi blta rtog / dbyar dgun dus tshod la dpag pa'i 'tshog tshad grol tshad/ 'don pa'i dal brel tshun chad nyi ma gcig la'ang yo bzur med pa byung bas/ grwa rgan mthar thug rnams sgo mang grwa tshang gi 'grig lam zer ba de 'di 'dra zhig yin dgos zhes gleng ba byung / bstan pa'i 545

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgonayo gsung 'a4/'byung khungs dge 'dun gyi sde dang / de'i bya ba'i gtso bo chos 'chad nyan yin kyang / chos 'chad nyan gyi rmang gzhi la 'dul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig med mi rung yin pas/ de'i rten 'brel du dgongs te klong rdol grub dbang rin po che nas sgo mang grwa khang gi phu'i mi 'khrugs pa'i lha khang zhig gsos byed dgos gsung ba bzhin/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bzhugs khri gsar bzo dang / gzungs gzhug skyon zhugs pa rnams la chad bsab/ gsar du gzungs sgril du ma dang / klong rdol rin po che tsa rir phebs skabs kyi thugs dam rten gtso'i glegs bam dam sbyar ma/ rgyal ba yab sras kyi na bza' sogs byen rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzungs 'jug tu phul/ grang gser srang du mas ljib thum gyis gsar bzhengs lta bu dang / gtsang khang gi ngos kun la ldeb ris phul du phyin pa bcas bsgrubs/ bla brang nyid kyi nang rten du'ang btsong kha brgyad cu'i thang ga gser tshon ri mo gong gsham sogs khyad du 'phags pas mtshon sku gsung thugs rten mang du bzhugs/ chos thog la chos grwa 'chag med/ dbyar ston lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung sogs rgyas par gnang / dus dbang gis nye 'khor nas chos lugs sna tshogs byed mkhan byung bar la las dgag pa byas kyang / 'ga' zhig dag snang spyong khul byas te de 'dra zer mi nyan byas pa gsan nas thugs la ma bab par gsung chos skabs su/ khyed tshos dag snang che mdog dang / rgyu dag bzang mdog byed pa de ha ma go ba yin/ chos rnam dag cig yin na rje bla ma'i dgongs pa 'di dang mthun dgos/ 'di dang mi mthun pa'i chos rnam dag cig med ces thag bcad nas bshad chog nam me nem me byed mi dgos/ de 'dra la chos spong du 'gro dogs med/ dpal ldan zla bas/ 'di las gzhan na chos 'di ni/ / ji ltar med pa de bzhin du/ / 'dir 'byung lugs kyang 546

༄za/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/gzhan na ni/ / med ces mkhas rnams nges par mdzod/ / gsungs ba de gsung rgyu mi gsung rgyu'i mtshams ma zin pa e red gsungs tshul sogs rgyus yod rnams kyi ngag nas mang du thos kyang brir ma lang / mdor na gang gsungs thams cad rus pa can/ lo mang po song yang mi brjed par blor zhag 'dug pa'i shugs can zhig yin par 'dug chos 'tshams rnams su shas cher thugs dam dang / don gnyer can du mas yang yang gsol ba btab ste bka' chos kyi rim pa'ang / thor god dge rgan chos 'phel sogs mang tsam la gser phreng dang grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba sogs kyi lung /hal ha er ti ni chos rje dang no mon han gnyis kyis gtsos par skyid shod gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po dang rjes gnang 'ga' zhig har chin wang gi tho yon sogs du mar tho'u bkwan rin po che'i gsung 'bum gyi lung gzhan yang lung rjes gnang sogs mang du gnang yod 'dug kyang sa bon ma 'khod stabs brir ma nus so/ / 'grig lam dang 'gal tshab che ba 'ga' zhig dang por tshogs gtam tsam gnang nas 'jog rtsis kyis tshogs gtam gnang zhor la ha cang nyes pa che bas mi 'tsham par dgongs te/ de ring rang 'gro dgos zhes mar nang gi sru bzhin bton pa'ang 'ga' zhig byung bas/ tshogs gtam re gnang ba'i tshe 'grig 'gal can rnams kyi sems la mgo thog gnam rdo lhung ba lta bu ci 'dra zhig bab yong snyam nas grol ring la 'dar chum me sdod dgos pa byung / 'di dag kyang gnad go na gzhan phan rgyal sras kyi spyod pa yin te/'dul ba las gnas kyi bla mas gnas pa ma dul ba la nan tur lnga byed tshul dang / byang sa'i tshul khrims le'ur yang sems can gyi don bya tshul 'jam zub sna tshogs shig dgos par gsungs/ gsang sngags kyi drag las bshad pa rnams kyang sems snying rje'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa rnams kyi dbang du byas 547

༄7/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgoname'i gsung 'thugapa ma gtogs rang don gtso bor byed mkhan rnams la rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa min/ chos min spyod pa de 'dra tshar bcad chog pa tsam min gyi med mi rung du tshar gcod dgos pa yin te/ dkon mchog sprin gye mdo las/tshul khrims 'chal pa rnams dang / dam pa'i chos sun 'byin pa rnams bran bzhin du tshar bcad par ngas gnang ngo / / gang dag de rnams tshar gcod par mi byed pa de dag ni nga'i bstan pa la shin tu ring ba yin/ gang dag de rnams tshar gcod par byed pa de dag ni nga'i slob ma dang nyan thos yin no/ / zhes gsungs shing / de'i 'phror/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sems can thams cad la sgra gcan 'dzin lta bur dgongs pa/ tsardon dang ste'ur mtshungs pa yin na de 'dra gsung tshul yod dam zhus pa la/ de rang rang la phan thabs yin pas skyon med tshul sogs gsungs pa dang / de 'dra tshor lus ngag gis byams po byas pa la rgyud sde rnams su gdug pa'i byams pa zhes gsungs/ sdom gsum rab dbye las kyang / smod cing bstan pa 'jig pa la/ / khro bas bzlog par nus bzhin du/ / bzod pa bsgom na ma dag pa'o/ / zhes gsungs so/ / de ltar 'grig lam dam zhing 'chad nyan dmar ba'i ngang nas lo ngo lnga tsam 'das pa lcags mo phag gi lo bstan pa'i gegs chag dang skye dgu'i bsod nams ma yin pa'i dbang gis bal bod kyi 'khrugs pa lang / de'i rkyen ni sngar lha sa'i 'khyam ra zhig gsos skabs mtha' dmag dang mtha' 'dre'i kha gnon gye ldeb ris byin can mang po gshegs gsol byas pa'i rkyen du dgongs te rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa yongs 'dzin rin po che dang bcas pas rab gnas bskyar ma yang yang gnang tshul yongs 'dzin rnam thar bzhin yin la/ rtsa ba de 'dra yin shas che'ang 'phral rkyen ni bal bod mtshams kye sde 'ga' zhig gi steng na kor ṣa la dpya cung zad cig sdud rgyu 548

sa༅/ /rtogasabarjod gzur gan4mkhasapa'i dga' ston/yod pa de/ gzhung lar phan res bsam pa'i rkyen dang / kho rang gis sngar bal po'i rgyal khag yam zhu/ ye rang / khom khom gsum ga mnga' 'og tu bsdus te khengs dregs 'bar yod pa thug pa'i rkyen yin no/ / de nas bal po'i dmag gi mgo brtsams pa na am ban gnyis kyis paṇa chen rin po che bde chen rab rgyas dgon nas lha sar gdan drangs/ bal dmag bkra shis lhun por 'byor pa na rgyal ba yab sras gnyi ga khams mgar thang du gdan 'dren rtsis byas/ bod pa'i dmag rnams 'thab ya 'dzin rgyu lta zhog bal po steng du sleb pa na gzhung gi me lcog chen mo'ang rgyag ya min 'bul ya yin zhes dgra la sprad/ mi ser byings nas/ nga tsho ji ltar byas kyang g.yog po zhig ma gtogs dpon po ni mi nyan/ sdug las 'di 'dra byed pa las bal pos thob song na des dga' shas che zhes 'di phyi gang yang bsam rgyu med pa'i nang cha phyir bton/ gzhung gi mi chen 'jig rten gye mes po lta bu'i khengs dregs can/ sos bder yod skabs se 'bras dge gsum dang rgyal ba yab sras bsnyegs nas rgya bod hor gsum 'dus pa'i tshe rang rang 'gang che bar 'khrul te su la'ang brnyas thabs kho na byed pa tsho'ang ci bya gtol med du gyur te khyim gyi dbye 'byed dang 'gro chas sogs la g.yeng nas rtser 'khor mi'ang cher med par gra rkyang tsho'ang rgyal ba'i mdun la gang 'dod du song nas gsung 'phros byas chog pas phyi sdoms nang sdoms thams cad zhig ste/ gzhung dga' ldan pho brang zer ba'i sgra po che de sog ma'i khres po phon thag chad pa bzhin dngos med du 'gro grab byung ba'i tshe/ dam pa 'di nyid nas 'phral yun gye bya byed kun la blo gros bkram/ zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi go cha bgos te se 'bras kyi bla ma rnams bsdus nas gros mgo bzung ste/ am 'ban gyis byed lugs 'di red/ gzhung gi mi tshos ni khos gang zer blta ba las cang lab 549

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'i sgoname'i khrung 4ma/thub ki mi 'dug rgyal ba yab sras ma bzhugs na jo shāka rnam gnyis/ se 'bras dge gsum sogs thams cad chags thabs med mod da ji 'dra byed rgyu yin gsungs par/ thams cad kyis khyed kyi gang gsungs na'ang de ka yin/nga tsho thams cad de'i rting bar 'ju rgyu las med zhus pas/ 'o na rgyal ba rin po che la zhu dgos par 'dug gsungs nas thams cad rgyal ba'i mdun du song ste/ mkhan po nyid nas/ rgyal ba thugs rje can/ khyed kyis gra sa se 'bras dge gsum nas bzung 'di thams cad thugs kyis dor te gzhan la phebs lugs yod dam zhus pas/ rgyal dbang mchog nas/ de med mod kyang am 'ban dbang che bas mi nyan par 'dug gsungs/ 'o na am 'ban la nged tshos bshad chog ces bla ma thams cad am 'ban gyi rtsar phebs/mkhan po nyid nas/ rgyal ba yab sras ma bzhugs na bod lung par sangs rgyas kye bstan pa 'di gnas tshul med pas/ nged se 'bras dge gsum gas rgyal ba gzhan la phebs ki 'jug rgyu min byas par/ ma phebs na skyon mi yong ba'i khag e thag khyed tsho la blo rtse ci yod pa yin zer/ lan du/ nged se 'bras dge gsum la gra pa khri phrag 'ga' yod pas rgyal ba yab sras bsrung thub blo rtse de yin byas pas am 'ban khros te/ de 'dra byas pas mi choga'adi'i khag nga la yong bas gdan 'dren ma byas par thabs med zer/ de nas mkhan po rang gis kyang je dar la btang ste 'o na gdan 'dren zhur mi 'jug thag chod yin/ sku 'bum thang du gcig bud dang / sngon la nga rang tshos thag gcod dgos/ zhes tsham tshom med par gsung bas/ am 'ban u thug ste/ gong mar zhu rgyu yin byas na skrag nas lhod e yong snyam ste/ 'o na ngas se 'bras tsho'i bla ma rnams kyis rgyal ba phebs ki mi 'jug gi zhes 7gong mar spe tsi 'dzin rgyu yin zer bar/ ci nas kyang de ltar gre tsi bzung 550

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnasamakhayopa'i dga' ston/chog pa zhig bka' drin che dgos byas pas/ thabs ma rnyed par gre tsi btang ste rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs rgyu byas/ mkhan po nyid nas grwa sa so so'i grwa pa gzhon shar rnams kyis po ta la sogs srung tshul/ rgyab mdun gyi lam 'gog lugs sogs kyi bkod khyab btang bar thams cad kyis ci gsung dang du blangs te ma bskos rgyal po rang byon du song / tshul 'di ni shes rab sdong bu las/ ji sred 'jigs pa ma byung ba/ / de srid de la 'jigs par bya/ /'jigs pa mngon du byung ba'i tshe/ / 'jigs med lta bur gzhom par bya/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa lugs gnyis gang gi dbang du btang yang dgos nges pa zhig yin no/ / de nas cher ma 'gyang bar bal po'i dmag nang du/ se 'brasadage gsum gyi dmag sngon ma skam pa la'i tshur nang du slebs tshar zhing mjug da dung lha sa nas ma rdzogs pas khri phrag mang po zhig 'ong gin yod pa red ces pa'i gtam zhig 'byor te 'ur zhogs kyis rang yul du chas/'di'ang rtsa ba dge ldan pa'i bstan srung rnams kyi thugs rje yin kyang /'phral gye lhan cig byed rkyen ni/ snga sor nged tshogs pa khri phrag mang po yod pa 'dis byed dgos byung na bal po'i do ya thub thag chod yin zhes dpa' skad cigabaton pa de gcig las gnyis 'khyar du song ste/ pho kha thang can gyis/sdar ma yul 'phud pa'i dper song ba yin par snang / de rjes dmag dpon chen po hi gung gis so lon gyi dmag khrid de byang kha nas 'ongs/ gser gyi ka ba lta bu'i nang gi blon chen bzhi'i ya gyal phu zi grung thang gis rgya dang rgyal rongagi dmag khyed de lho lam nas 'ongs/ de nas rgya mtsho 'phyur ba bzhin dmag gi dpung chen po rim pa rim pa 'byor pas sdig can gor ṣa pham par byas te mnga' 'og tu bcug des skabs shig la 7gong nas sngar gyi gre tsi'i lan bab pas/ ser 'bras kyi bla ma thams cad sang nyi ma rtse shar la 551

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i gsang 'bum/nor 'dzin dga' tshal du 'byor dgos zhes brda brgyab/ phyi nyin 'dzoms thog tu grung thang chen mos rgyal po'i bka' bsgrag pa ni/ khyod ser 'bras dgegasum gyi bla ma rnams kyis rgyal ba yab sras gdan 'dren zhur ma bcug pas ser 'bras dge gsum dang lha sa sogs bde bar gnas pa ni khyed rnams kyi drin yin/ khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi dus kyi nyan thos lta bu red bo am 'ban glen pa lug 'dra ba 'dis paṇa chen rin po che lha sar gdan 'dren zhus pas bkra shis lhun po la chag 'jig byung ba red/ khrims la brgyab na 'di la srog gi chad pa min pa med/ 'on kyang 'dis am ste rje rin po che'i bstan pa la she mong phul mkhan zhig yin pa'i ngor 'di la srog gi chad pa ni med/zla ba gsum la an bskon nas lha sa'i khrom nas zhog gsungs/ bla ma thams cad la bdag rkyen dang / khyad par du nyid la nor bu mkhan po zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / lan gyi 'bab lugs la brtag na/ dang por gre tsi 'dzin pa'i tshe mkhan po 'di nyid dmigs kyis bkar te/ 'dis gtso byas pa'i bla ma rnamasakyis 'di 'dra bshad nas pheb ki mi 'jug par 'dug ces zhus pa na bshad tshul dang byed lugs la 7gong ma shin tu mnyes te er ti ni mkhan po ste/ mkhan rin po che zhes gzengs bstod pa yin 'dug pas/ bod skad du ma bsgyur na cho lo'i nyams dod pa zhig 'ong yang / lo tsā bas nor bu mkhan por bsgyur ba yin 'dug la/ rnam pa gcig tu rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin nam snyam/ bla ma gzhan thams cad kyis kyang mkhan po nyid rang gi bka' drin yin zhes legs so 'bul zhing mngon skog med par de kho na gleng ngo / / de ltar 'khrug zing zhi nas bsil ldan gyi ljongs kun bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod rgyu byung ba ni 7'jam dbyangs mi rje'i rnam rol kho na'i bka' drin yin la/ 'on kyang de'i bka' drin thugs rje'i nyi ma 'char ba'i 552

༄༅/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/bar la rang gis rang dngos med du gtong grab byung ba/ thabs mkhas skya rangs kyi snang bas de dang mtshams sbyor ba po ni dam pa 'di nyid yin pas bka' drin bla na med pa shes par byos shig bal po'i dmag tshogs 'ong ba'i sgra tsam gyis/ / bod yul che dgus rang mdangs bstan pa na/ / bar gcod dbang du mi gtong snying stobs kyi/ / ba dan bsgreng bar nus pa khyod min su/ / sos bder gnas tshe mchog dman skye bo'i tshogs/ / su la brnyas thabs khyad gsod mi mdzad kyang / / seng ge'i ngar skad sgrogs pa'i dus babs na/ / sud kyis mi 'gro dpa' po'i brtul zhugs yin/ / de nas yang 'grig lam dang 'chad nyan dmar ba sngar rgyun bzhin mdzad cing / dge 'dun rnams kyang thugs dga' spro dang bcas pas tshogs chos shin tu 'phel/grwa 'tshogs kyang nyis stong lnga brgyar nye ba byung / dgung lo re gcig pa chu bya'i lo 'dir rigs grwa'ang 'khor te/ rgyal dbang lnga pa bzhin rang lo'i thad thad du don che ba mang po 'grub pa 'dri 'dra la gegs yar 'gro'i tha snyad kyang byed par snang / rigs grwa'i 'gyed chen du dngul srang khri phrag la nye bas tshogs pa bdun stong skor la dngul srang gang dang zho gsum re btang / nyin bco lnga'i ring la bsnyen bkur dang nyin ltar gyi 'gyed sna re/ sgo mang gra tshang gi lhag mchod la dngul zho lnga re/ khang tshan la zho gsum re/ mi tshan la zho re bcas btang / de'i rjes su sgo mang mkhan po'i gnang ba zhus te/ nyid kyi dge phrug lha btsun mthu stobs nyi ma sgo mang mkhan por bsko bzhag gi mgo mtha' gnang / mkhan po rjes ma la nas khal lnga bcu dang thab cha'i skor gdan cha bcas gsar 'jog dang / khri 'don skabs sku gsung thugs rten/na bza' cha tshang chibs pa bzang po gcig bcas bdog pa bstar/ de nas sngar bzhin lha dbang gling nas zur bzhugs mdzad/ snga phyi ci rigs 553

༄/ /gung bang bstan pa'i sgronas gsung la /shig tu klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i mdun nas lam rim chung ngu'i bshad lung /sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung / 'jigs byed bskyed rim chen mo'i bshad lus sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du gsan 'dug kyang dus tshod gang yin ma nges/ nyid nas gra tshang la mchod rdzas cha tshang zhig 'jog rtsis gnang ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan klong rdol rin po cher zhus pas/ 'o na rgya mthongs kyi chu dar nges bzhag ste smon lam lhan cig tu byas na rten 'brel khyad par can zhig yod gsungs nas de bzhin gnang / mkhan po nyid nas gos chen khyad 'phags sha stag las bsgrubs pa'i ka 'phan bye 'phur bla bre sogs mchod rdzas yongs su rdzogs pa dngul srang sum stong gi rgyu song dang / de mtshungs bsam blo rgyud khang du'ang srang nyis stong la nye ba'i zong gi mchod rdzas bzhag glang gi lo lha sa'i smon lam la mang ja dang rdo tshad sum cu skor gyis 'gyed skar phyed brgyad re btang ste chos dang zang zing gnyi ga'i sgo nas gra tshang gi 'dzin skyong 'gran zla med pa gnang ba'i bzhed pa mtha' dag bar chad phra mo tsam yang med par mthar phyin to/ / bcom ldan thugs rje mnga' ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / bca' khrims dam pos bag med gnas las bzlog / bcu phyed bka' pod dgongs don a mṛ ta'i/ / bcud kyis skal bzang lha rnams tshim par mdzad/ / mkha' las gru char 'jo ba'i sprin sngon bzhin/ / mkhas rnams legs bshad gtam gyes tshim mdzad cing / / mkho dgu'i 'byor pas dmangs kyi re bskangs te/ / mkhan por grags pa phal gyi do zla min/ / de nas gzhan la chos bka' ci rigs dang / lhag par rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu mkhan brgya phrag brgal ba dang / bslab skyor zhu mi'ang mang du byung ba'i re ba bskangs te lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi dga' ston mchog la sbyar/ skabs shig rgya nag tu bla ma bzang po zhig gtong dgos kyi bka' bab 554

༄/ /rtogasabarjod gzur gnasamakhayopa'i dga' ston/pas/ am 'ban gnyis nas gra sa'i bla ma rnams bos te bltas nas/mkhan po 'di pa 'os tshul gleng ba na/ thugs ma bde bar klong rdol rin po cher zhus pas/ rim gro 'ga' zhig dang / de nas am 'ban la gser srang bco lnga byin na zlog thub yong gsung ba ltar byas pas de kho na bzhin byung /de skabs kyi rgyu mtshan nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / thams cad las de la dga' mdog kha bo/ snye snye zer ra 'dra mo/ sin sin zer ra 'dra mo mang po zhig lab ki 'dug/ yag po ma byung / las ci 'dra zhig bsags yod mi shes/rus pa 'di gang nas 'jog dgos rgyu yin snyam blo ma bde gsungs pa dngos su thos/ gzhan zhig yin na thams cad las kho lhag pa byung snyam rloms sems skye'ang / nyid nas de dag gis bstod bkur bsngags pa byas tshad gshin rje'i 'dzum dang 'ug pa'i than skad lta bur dgongs pa ni bstod smad dang snyan mi snyan sogs chos brgyad ro sgoms su song ba'i rnam thar ro/ / snga sor kun mkhyen mchog nas dus las 'dzol pa med pa'i mngon mkhyen gyis gzigs te gsungs pa'i don bzhin sgo mang gi khri mthar phyin/ rgya mi'i gleng brjod de dag kyang skul ma lta bur song yod pa'i thog shing stag lo ngag dbang wang gi dpon mo dbus la yong ba de'i skyel mar bla brang gi drung yig dge legs btang yong bas mtshams sbyar/ kun mkhyen gong ma'i sku tsha dbon po dkon mchog seng ge gra sar yod pas gzhung bzung ste mdo smad du phebs rgyu'i zhu ba phul/nyid nas da skabs sku zhabs rin po che mi bzhugs pas nged song ste phan thog yod med mi shes/ chos skyong rnams la lung bstan zhu dgos gsungs te gnas chung la zhus par/ dgon gnas slob dpon dam ldan gyis gzugs med la dris pa legs/ slar yang chos 'chad nyan 'phel rgyas su rim gro/skal bzang / brgya stong / rtag brtan gzungs 'dus/ sku lnga dpon blon 555

sa / /gung thang bstan pa'isgronama'i gsung 'bum/gyi bskang ba/ phrin bcol/ ri bsang brgya/ klung rta brgya bcas sgrubs na/gzugs med yid kyis ma dor na/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'phrin las bgyed/ ces mdo smad du'ang 'chad nyan yar rgyas su gnang rgyu sogs shin tu gsal ba dang / dga' gdong bstan ma gnyis kyis kyang rim gro dang 'phrin las sgrub pa'i zhal bzhes sogs gang legs gnang / lo mjug tu dbon po dang drung yig sogs kyis de don rgyal dbang rin po cher dgongs pa zhus pas/ rgyal dbang rin po che nas nyid la nang sbyar gyi bka' phebs te/khyed rang sngar phebs chad yin zer ba bden zhing / bla ma'i bka' dang yul ma'i 'dun pa bzhin phebs 'dod yod na gnang ba ster/ min na mi ster/khyed rang gi thugs bzhed dang bstun chogs gsungs par/ snga sor de 'dra zhus yod pa bden/ da cha sku zhabs de nyid sku dngos mi bzhugs kyang / nga bla ma chos gos gyon pa zhig gis khrel med byed lugs med pas 'gro 'dun yod zhus pas/ 'o na de bzhin byas chog ces dgongs pa dgyes bzhin du khrol/yos lo gsar nas smon lam thog la dga' ldan se ra gnyis kyi bla ma rnams kyis 'bras spung bla ma rnams la sgo mang mkhan po rgan pa 'di pa grwa sa ser 'bras dge gsum gyi bla ma rnams kyi blo rtse gtad sa yin/ 'bras spung tshugs nas rigs gra gsum btang ba bla ma 'di min pa ma byung / khyed rnam pas dang po ma zhus stabs da gzod zhu lugs med rung / nga tshos gzhung la zhus te khong mi phebs pa zhig byed dgos zer nas de bzhin byas kyang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa mdo smad kyi bstan pa'i bdag po yin pa dang /ching wang sngar nas zhwa ser gyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po'i rgyud yin stabs dmigs bsal gal po che gnang ste rgyal ba'i bka' babs tshar ba yin pas/da cha/ ri chen po'i rbab la phyir log med/ dpon chen po'i bka' la 556

༄za/ /rtog4bajod gzur gnasamakha4pa'i dga' ston/bka' log med/ zer ba yin zhes 'gog thub pa ma byung / rgyun par gra sa rgya che bas phan tshun cher ma ltos pa lta bu zhig yod kyang / snga sor nyen che ba'i skabs mchod rten gyi srog shing bzhin tshang ma'i rten sar song ba'i stabs kyis da dung yang thag ring du phebs rgyu blos ma bzod pa lta bu byung ba yin 'dug pas/ rang rtsa las kyang rgyang na gnas pa tsho'i ngor phan pa'i zil che ba zhig yong ba ni/ dpe chos 'grel par/ skyes bu dam pa tshad ldan de/ bkyed kyin gsal ba has po'i gangs lta bu/ btud kyin gsal ba rma bya'i mdongs lta bu zhig 'ong bar gsungs pa'i don yin no/ / de nas mdo smad du 'byon rgyur thag chod de/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par skyabs 'jug zhu rten la maṇḍal/ sku gsung thugs rten/ na bza' cha tshang / dngul srang bdun brgya/ gos yug bco brgyad/ stag tsha rin po cher/ sku gsung thugs rten/maṇḍal/ dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ gos yug lnga bcas phul/ 'bras spung tshogs chen dang gra tshang la skyabs zhus kyi mang ja'i thog 'gyed ḍi kha re/gra tshang spyi 'jog tu 'bri bdun cu don bdun dang khyim kha gsum bcas bzhagabla ma rigs gra pa la'ang 'bri bdun cu don bdun/ bla ma phyag mdzod phu la 'bri sum cu tham pa/ khang tshan la tshom ja dang 'gyed dngul phyed brgyad re/mi tshan la mchod khri dang rje'i sku/ gnam yol/ nyid kyi na bza' cha tshang bzhugs khri dang bcas pa bzhag gzhan yang phur bu lcog tshe chog gling /stod lung lding kha'i dgon sogs la mang ja dang 'gyed ḍi kha re bcas btang /jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs lha sa'i rten rnams dang / po ta la'i jo bo lo ke shā ra dang / de skabs 'phags pa wa ti'ang der bzhugs yod pas/ de gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rten phal cher/ 'bras spung gi byams pa mthong grol ma dang thub pa tshul khrims ma sogs rten rnams la gser gsol dang mchod pa 557

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'izlanama'i khrung ཿma/rgya chen po phul te tshe rabs kun tu blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel ba'i smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor nan tan du mdzad/ de skabs phyag mdzod kyis mdo smad du phebs na gzhan ngo mi shes shing / gzhi che tsam zhig 'dzin dgos pa yong bas 'bri 'di'i nang nas gzhon pa skor gcig 'dzin dgos pa 'dra zhus par mi dgos gsungs u tshugs byas pas/ ngas 'di thams cad sngar nas dge 'dun pa la bsngos yod pa yin/ de ma byas na khyod rang la chos skyong gis yag po mi yong zhes gsungs btsan po gnang bas bka' bzhin bsgrubs 'dug rgyun bar nor dngos po kun la zhen pa log pa'i tshul gyis mig btsum skad gdangs tshun chad smad de zhi zhing dul ba'i nyams kho na mi ston yang / nyams len skabs bslab spyod kyi btang bsrung dag spel bzhi'i don bzhin bdog pa thams cad gzhan la bsngos te 'dzin chags ci yang mi mdzad pa ni tshe blos btang gi spyod tshul lhad med pa yin gyi/ chos pa'i nyams phyi rol tu thon che ba'i rigs la dge slong gser len spu skyel lta bu rdzun ma mang po 'byung ste/ gzi bajid can gyi mdo las/ gcom bskyung ba'i tshul 'chos pa can ni/ gang gi tshe rgyu mtshan du byas nas tshig zhan pa zhan par byed pa'o/ / 'dod pa chung bar smra ba'i tshul 'chos pa can ni/ gang gi tshe 'dod pa chung bar smra zhing sems kyis rnyed pa 'dod pa ste/ yo byad bsnyung bar ston pa'o/ / zhes sogs tshul 'chos pa bcu gsung la/ 'od srung gis zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / dal gyis 'gro ba'i tshul 'chos par 'gyur ba dang / mgo smad pa'i tshul 'chos par 'gyur ba dang / zhes pa nas/ nga la cung zad kyang cung zad kyang mi dgos so zhes smra ba sems kyis rnyed pa 'dod cing tshig gis 'dod pa chung bar smra ba 'di ni sems kyi tshul 'chos pa zhes brjod do/ / zhes gsungs pas/ dam pa'i 558

༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/rnam thar 'di dag dang bstun te rang sems dpang por bzhag nas zhib dpyod ma byas na phub ma'i chu dong 'byung nyen che'o/ / bshes spring las kyang /mi ni a mra'i 'bras bzhin ma smin la/ / smin pa dang 'dra smin la ma smin 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyis phyi nang smin ma smin mu bzhir gsungs pa'i gtso bo nang smin dgos pa yin pas/ kham lung pa phyi nang gnyi ga smin pa dang / po to pa phyi ma smin la nang smin par spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs te/po to pa'i rnam thar mdzes pa'i padmo las/ snying rje can du mngon mngon mi mdzad kyang / zhes gsungs don yang de yin no/ / de nas phebs rgyu'i dus dang nye ba na rgyal dbang rin po che nas thon phyag gi gnang char/ thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i zhal thang rgyal ba nyid kyi phyag dam can/ tshe sku li ma gcig thub pa'i li sku gcig dbu zhwa/ sku 'gag sku chos/ sku gzan/ sku sham/ zhabs chag bas pa chibs 'grogs gnyis/chibs sga legs pa tog bse khebs lung khebs bcas cha tshang / dung dkar cha/ kha che dri bzang srang lnga bcu/ spos dmar to bo gcig zhwa snam lnga bcu/ sprug bco lnga/ has ga gcig la ta dang ke tsa yug du ma sogs dpangs mtho ba stsal cing mdo smad du bstan 'gror gang phan gnang dgos tshul dang rjes 'dzin gyi zhal bzhes sogs brtse gzigs gang che gnang /stag tsha rin po che nas sku brnyan li ma gsum/ grags rgyal ma'i zhal thang gcig dung dkar gcig na bza' cha tshang / ther dril bco lnga/ zhwa snam sum cu/ sprug brgyad/ so so nas zhabs phyi rnams la'ang go bab dang bstun pa'i gnang cha bstsal/ de'i sngon tsam la rtse drung nang ma 'ga' zhig gis/ rgyal ba'i sku'i che ba yin pas zhu rten cung zad phul te ma zhus par gnang ba'i dpe la ma med/ de byas na no mon han gyi cho lo dang gdugs rta 559

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'ithonas gsung 'bum/dar sogs nyid la cis kyang gnang yong zhes gros 'debs byung bar/ nga rang gi chas ka gang yod dge 'dun la btang ste da ci yang med pas zhu mi dgos gsung ste gsan dgongs ma mdzad/ dam pa nyid kyi ngos nas gzhung gi cho lo ma zad/ 7'jam dbyangs gong ma'i cho lo la'ang thugs bzhed med pa sngar smos pa ltar yin pas mi dgos mod/ gzhung gi sku don la dngul srang khri phrag mang po phul ba las kyang lhag pa'i zhabs 'degs bsgrubs pa des go ma chod par zhu rten zhig dgos pa dang / dngul phran tshogs re phul na su la yin kyang gnang sho bzhag pa de ni dpe lam gyi nang nas gnas lugs med pa'i dpe lam zhig tu snang / dga' ldan khri rin po che blo bzang smon lam nas sku brnyan paṇa zhwa sne ring sogs na bza' 'ga' zhig bcas gnang zhing thugs 'phrang ba'i nyams kyi gsung gleng mdzad/ sgo mang gra tshang nas gnas bcu'i zhal thang gsum/ dngul srang lnga bcu/ sgo mang mkhan pos tshe sku li ma/spos khros bzhi/ snam sprug sogs dang / gzhan yang blo gsal gling /rgyal ba/ 'dul ba sogs kye mkhan po/ 'bras bla sbyi/ khang tshan mi tshan/mi drag mang po sogs kyi phebs rdzongs dang / grwa pa rgan gzhon skyabs 'jug zhu mi sogs nyin mang por bar ma chad lta bur byung / sgra dbyangs gling du mang ja nyin 'khyong thog chos skyong spyan 'dren gyi gzab gsol zhus/ chos skyong chen po nas kyang / hrī snyigs ma'i rang rtags na bun 'khrigs pa'i klong / / blang dor bya byed gzugs brnyan 'char dka'i ngo / / 'on kyang mchog gsum chos srung mthu bskul la/ / las 'bras drang po'i gzhung lam 'grim pa gnad/ / bgrang bya me tog mda' lhag bdun phrag stobs/ / zhes sogs kyis sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i lung bstan dang g.yel med 'phrin las sgrub pa'i zhal bzhes gang legs gnang / tshes bzang por lha dbang gling nas 560

༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/chibs bsgyur pa'i skabs su'ang / lha dbang gling gi steng nas 'ja' tshon zhig shar ba gnas chung spyog gi steng du zug de nas gcig shar ba gling khar 'bras spung bla spyis ja thab bzung yod pa'i steng du zug pas/ dgon pa'i grwa dpon slob thams cad lhag par yang mos gus dang skyo shas kyis yid 'khul ba byung / chos skyong 'di la nyid nas thugs rtse gtod cing / chos skyong gis kyang chos 'chad nyan sogs bstan pa'i bya ba gang gi tshe na'ang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i sdongs grogs mdzad pa zhig yod par snang / 'di kha cig 'jig rten pa'i srung ma yin gyi/ bstan srung ye shes pa min zer yang / sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mi'i sha tshugs 'dzin pa na chos kho na ston pa'i bla ma'i rnam pa 'ba' zhig 'dzin mi dgos par/ dge sdig sna tshogs spyod pa'i rgyal po sogs gdul bya de'i snang tshod kyi skal ba de dang 'tsham par ston pa bzhin/srung ma'i rnam par ston pa'i tshe'ang / 'jig rten 'di tsam gtso bor byed pa rnams kyis bsten na 'phrin las kyang de dang mtshungs pa zhig bsgrub nas 'brel 'jog thabs byed cing / chos rnam dag kho na sgrub mkhan zhig gis bsten na sa lam gyi grogs tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i srung ma khyad par can du 'gro ba yin te/ 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas/ nged jo bo mjal bar mnga' ris su 'gro skabs mi ngo mi shes pa gcig gis lam mkhan byas song ba de pe har du snang bas/ chos gsha' ma byed na khong yang chos skyong bzang por 'dug ces gsungs tshul deb sngon du 'byung ba bzhin no/ / des na chos skyong ye shes bar nges pa rnyed nas skyabs su bzung na legs la/ tshe 'di'i phan pa kho na sgrub pa'i dgra lha tsam zhig yin pa zhe phugs su bzhag nas skyabs su bzung na skyabs 'gro la gnod pas/ spang blang gi mtshams 'di 'dra rang sems la zhu dag btang ste byed dgos pa zhig yin no/ / de nas rim gyis phebs pa'i lam nas 561
