༄/ /gung ca b.lo pa'i sgroname'i gsung 'a4/'dam snying grong gi chu tshan khar zhag bdun bzhugs te sku'i 'phrod brten mdzad/ 'jog pa'i 'bri rnams kyang nyid kyi spyan lam bstar te gang bzang 'dem sprug byas nas sprad/ lam grogs tshong dpon 'ga' zhig dang bcas dgra jag chu sogs kyi 'tshe ba phra mo tsam yang med par glang chen dal 'gros kyis byon pa brgyad pa'i tshes la stong 'khor du babs/ der bla brang gi gsol dpon dpal ldan ngo g.yog dang / nyid kyi sku tsha klu 'bum lha dang yum skyabs gnyis bcas 'byor/ de nas sku 'bum du phebs par shangs len gzos sgo gang drag zhus shing / rten la mchod mjal dang tshogs su mang ja kha dar gyi 'gyed bcas btang / de tshun chad kyi zhag bab so so'i sar bla brang gzhis ka yong pa rnams nas bsnyen bkur gang legs kyi gra sgrig zhus/ ka mdo'i dgon dang gcu 'khor dgon par yang mang ja 'gyed bcas gnang / bla brang nas chibs pa kha shas dang bcas bstan 'dzin bsu bar btang ba gcu 'khor gyi lung pa'i phur 'byor te chibs pa rnams phul/ nang chen rnams kyi bsu ba dang bcas nyi ma lung du spyi chen gyi gra sgrig thug tu zhag sa 'debs steng thos bsam gling dang rgyud pa'i gnyer bas ja thab zhus/ rgyud pa dpon slob kyis gtsos pas rta bsu dang / ngur sprig 'chang ba'i dge 'dun mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pas ser sbrengs dang bcas bla brang chen mor phyag bas/bla brang nas gsol ston dang dgon pa'i las sne/ bla brang zhabs sdod rnams kyis mjal dar phul/ nged dang hor tshang gser khri rin po che'i bla brang nas kyang ja zhus thog gsol ston legs 'bul dga' dar bcas phul/ dge 'dun nyis stong brgal bar mang ja bzhi'i thog skyes kyi tshul du ja bag phyed re'i 'gyed bstar/ sku zhabs rin po che'i sku skal lta bur khal ma nyi shu phul/nged can dang bla brang zhabs gras sogs la gang 'os kyi dbus rang 'tshem med 562

༄7/ /rtogasabarjod gzur gnas mkha4pa'i dga' ston/du gnang / zhag bco lnga tsam nas zur du spo skabs bla brang nas thab 'dzin gyi zur gsos sogs gang legs phul/ 'dzol med mngon par mkhyen pa'i bka' lung bzhin/ / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i byang phyogs mdo smad kyi/ /'dzin mar zhabs sen 'god pa'i rten 'brel kun/ / 'dzom pas dge legs lam bzang yangs por phye/ / bla na med pa'i thugs bskyed 'brel zab mthus/ / bla brang bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i sder/ / bla ma mchog gi bka' bzhin phebs pa na/ / bla slob zhal 'dzoms dge mtshan mchog tu 'phel/ / yos lo'i dgun smad nas 'brug lo'i sos ga'i bar sku ngal gso ba dang sbrags bcad rgya'i tshul du bzhugs te thugs dam gtso bor mdzad/phyogs nas ched gtad kyis 'ongs pa rnams la thun mtshams su mjal kha gnang / dbyar thog nas gzim khang gsar 'bub kyi spyor ba brtsams/ston ka ring gi dgon grong spyi nas gdan 'dren zhus pa bzhin der phebs/bis kya thang du ser skya tshang mas chibs bsu dang thab bsu gang rgyas zhus/thar pa gling ri khrod rnams kyis bsu ba ja thab zhus/ de nas ser sbreng dang bcas ka ring dgon par babs te 'du khang steng du bzhugs/ yul lugs dang bstun pa'i ston mo gzab rgyas zhus/ tshogs bar mang ja dang zhwa snam re'i 'gyed/ sde pa spyi la'ang bdag rkyen bcas yid mgu bar mdzad/ grong ba rnams kyis 'bru kon to'u sum brgya sogs gang 'byor gyi 'bul ba btegs/de sngon ka ring bis mdo gnyis gyod la thug ste phan tshun gnyi ga'i mi drug cu rtsa bdun bsad/ lo dgu tsam 'gyang yang bla dpon sus bshad de ma 'grig par yod stabs/ nyid nas gsung dgos zhus kyang 'phral du zhal bzhes ma mdzad/ dgun thog thar pa gling nas zla ba gnyis tsam la 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen mtshams gnang skabs kha mchu de nyid zhi ba'i phyir spyan dmigs yang 563

༄/ /gung ca bayo pa'i sgoname'i g.yo 'bum/yang gnang bas/ nub cig mnal lam du rgya mo zhig gis bong bu rkang pa drug can zhig zhon te mdun du 'ongs nas nyam thag pa'i tshul gyis yun ring ngus/mthar rlung 'tshub lta bu zhig tu gyur te lung pa de nas bud song ba zhig rmis/de ni phan tshun gnyi ga'i rgyud dkrugs pa'i gyod 'dre gdug pa can zhig yod pa de rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi mthus gzir nas gzhan du bskrad pa yin par snang /bcad rgya grol te lo gsar gyi dga' ston mdzad/ sbrul lo'i zla ba dang po nas sde pa gnyi ga'i bar gye gzu gsungs te phan tshun du 'byon bzhud lan 'ga' dgos pa byung yang skyo ngal med par phan thabs kyi dgongs pa kho na mdzad pas gyong legs par 'grig ste skye bo du ma tshe 'dir 'chi bdag gi mche ba'i phrag nas blangs shing / phyi ma ngan 'gro mi bzad par 'gro ba'i sgo lam bcad de phan pa dang bde ba'i dpal la bkod/ 'di skor rdzong dkar ma ṇi pa chung pa tshang dang 'phros byung bar/ sgo mang mkhan rin po che nas/ a kha kha/ mi 'di tsam bsad de yag po ma red/ da de 'dra ma byed gyod 'grig gi chugs/'grig gi chugs gsungs pa ma gtogs/ sa cha'i gyod ngan de 'dra la thugs rgyus med stabs gyod kyi gnas lugs brda ded byas nas gsung rgyu mi 'dug kyang / skyes bu dam pa'i thugs smon dang byin rlabs de ya mtshan po red/sngar ci byas kyang mi 'phrod pa zhig yod pa de lan dka' tshegayomed par 'grig byung / zhes gsung gi 'dug pa dngos su thos te/ dbu ma rin chen phreng bar/ 'jig rten kun na skye bo gang / / sdig pa byed par 'dod gyur pa/ / de dag thams cad gnod med par/ / rtag tu gcig car bzlog gyur cig / ces dang spyod 'jug las gsungs pa lta bu'i smon lam thams cad grub cing bden tshig gi nus pa smin pa'i mthu yin no/ / sngar 'thab rtsod 'khrug long gis srin po'i grong khyer lta bur yod pa/ nyid phebs te zla shas 5yo

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/bzhugs pa nas dus bde zhod 'jag gis nyams spro zhing yid pheb pa ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ gang na dam pa bzhugs pa yi/ / sa de yid du 'ong ba yin/ / zhes pa ltar gyur to/ / gtum drag khong khro'i gdon gyis brlams pa'i gar/ / gtol med spyon pa'i stang stabs bzhin bsgyur tshe/ / gtugs pa med pa'i snying rjes yongs bzung ste/ / gting zab ngan 'gro'i g.yang las skyob par mdzad/ / wa ra ṇa si'i 'khrul 'khor rtsom pa'i bdud/ / wa skyes ngan pa seng ge'i nga ros bskrad/ / waze mchog tu bgos pa'i snying stobs kyis/ / wa ler 'jig rten bde ba'i gnas la bkod/ / bdun pa'i nang la bkra shis 'khyil du phebs te nyid kyi gzim khang gsar bskrun gyi nang du bzhugs/ nyid kyi dge phrug a lags sha tho yon mkhan pos gser zangs lasabasgrub pa'i jo bo'i sku khyad 'phags mi tshad lhag pa zhig phul ba gzungs gzhug dang rab gnas sogs ji bzhin bgyis te gzim khang gi rten gtsor bzhugs su gsol/ bla brang chen mo'i gzim khang thub bstan pho brang yang gsar du grub pas tshom chen 'dod dgu 'khyil rten brten pa kun la rab gnas mdzad/ de nas zla ba lnga drug tsam las ma 'gyang bar mchog sprul rin po che gdan sar bkod de/ de nyid du dpon slob thams cad dga' ston la longs spyod chog pa byung bas/ rab gnas kyi dus/ zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes te/ / nyi ltar zhal dro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing / /gsungs pa de kho na bzhin du gyur/ bdag gis kyang rta lo'i smon lam gyi steng der skyabs mgon mchog gdan sar bkod nas rang gi khri khar bzhag pas/dam pa nyid tshogs chen gyi khrir bsko bzhag mdzad/ kun mkhyen bla ma sku snga phyis bstan 'gro'i don sgrub pa'i rtsa ba lta bu dgon sde 'di nyid yin pas/mchog sprul rin po che'i 'ang mdzad pa'i thog ma bstan pa'i 'byung gnas 565

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgoname'i gsung 'bum/'dir bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i don sgrub mkhan gtso la/ mdo dbus kun tu bstan pa'i bya ba gang brtsam lhun gyes grub pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po 'di lta bu zhig sgo rgyu'i rten 'brel rang 'grig tu byung ba ni bstan pa phyogs mthar spel ba'i thugs skyed lhan cig pa'i 'bras bzang dus su smin pa'i dge mtshan rmad du byung ba'o/ / sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bzang por khri 'don mdzad par spyi bla brang nang chen khag nas khri 'bul bstar/ bdag gis kyang bla ma snga phyi'i rtsis sprod dkyus ma'i thog nyid kyi bla brang gsar 'dzin sogs 'gro sgo che ba dang / rigs gra'i dus kyang nye bar gtugs pa'i stabs ja mar dngos po sna tshog4bcas dngul srang phyed dang sum brgya'i rtsis rigs gra'i zhal 'debs lazur du phul/ chos grar rtsi bzhag 'chag med lta bu dang gson gshin gyi don la thag nye ring gi gdan 'dren byung bar yang 'dun pa bzhin phebs/ 'grig gi rting gnon tshang drag sgo mang mkhan po'i skabs lta bu ma mdzad kyang /tshogs gtam sogs ci gsungs thams cad rgan gzhon kun gyis spyi bos nod pas shin tu legs pa byung / zhal nas gsung dus 'di'i bla ma byed rgyu 'di sgo mang las dka' las tsha bar 'dug sgo mang gra tshang ltar gyi rtsi bzhag cha tshang bar 'gro dgos pa'i thog tu/ ya ki tsho dang 'dra ba'i zebs ci yang med par grong chog kho na'i steng nas rigs gra gtong dgos pa dang / rigs gra'ang ya kir lo drug rer bsags nas btang chog la/ 'dir lo re bzhin gtong dgos shing mang ja ma brtsis pa'i phog rkyang pa la'ang dngul srang stong dang lnga brgya re'i tshod ma mtha' 'gro kin 'dug pas bsdoms song na gtong sgo 'di lce bar 'dug de'i thog tu gtor sgrub/ gtor chen gtor rgyag zer ba lta bu sngags gra zhig gis byed rgyu'ang mang po byed dgos pas dka' las chen po red gsungs na'ang / phyag len du 'debs pa'i tshe mi'i mig ltos bslad 566

༄/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/mi nyan gsungs nas dgon 'di'i lu gu lag skyes kyi rgyus yod/ sku na gzhon pa tshos gang mdzad rgyu mthas cad lhag dang bcas te gnang yang sku dang thugs la skyo ngal gyi rnam pa dang mi lcogs pa ci med pas/ thams cad kyang skyes bu dam pa'i thugs smon dang thugs stobs kyi mthu ma gtogs dgung lo la ltos pa mi 'dug ces ya mtshan dang dad gus lhag par 'phel/ rigs gra dang po'i skabs dge 'dun nyis stong sum brgya tsam la phog chen bag phyed re dang ja bag phyed re'i rtsis kyi sprug sogs dngos po sna tshogs/ nyi ma gnang chags kyi 'gyed sna bdun/ thos bsam gling pa stong dang nyis brgya skor la zam ya re bcas lo ltar nges can dang / rigs gra phyi ma gnyis kyi phog chen la ja bag re btang / 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ drang po zang thal byas na 'khon pa'i rgyu/ / sna tshogs thabs mkhas byas na g.yo sgyur go / sems la gtad med byas kyang mi mi mgu/ / 'du 'dzis skyo ba med dam lo tsā ba/ / drang por smras na phal cher dgra ru sdang / / yon bor spyad na sems la rnam smin lce/ /sna tshogs spyad na gtad so med par blta/ / byas pa'i 'bras bu soms dang lo tsā ba/ / zhes gsungs bzhin spyir sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa yin pas thams cad mgu tshul med la/ lhag par bya ba zhi drag gi sner sleb pa 'dir 'ga' zhig dga' yang 'ga' zhig mi dga' ba zhig las 'ong mi srid pa lta bur 'dug kyang / dam pa nyid la bgres gzhon bar ma su'i thad nas kyang dad gus byed pa ma gtogs mi dga' pa'i skyon 'dogs tshig gcig brjod pa'ang thos ma myong ba ni tshul khrims dang lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i che ba'o/ /khrir bzhugs kyi rang la chos 'chad nyan 'phel zhing gra tshogs rgyas pa dang /yul khams su nad 'khrug med cing lo tog smin pa sogs bkra shis kyi dge mtshan mchog tu 'phel/ lcags sprel lor kho bo cag la tshogs chen du bde 567

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgoname'i gsung 'byam/lam gye khrid cig byed dgos kyi skul ma mdzad pa bzhin/ dam pa nyid kyis dbu mdzad pa'i dge 'dun stong phrag gnyis lhag la nyin bco lnga'i ring khrid dmigs rgyas pa sems byed mchod pa dang bcas phyag len bzhin phul/ lo ltar 'di bzhin bka' chos che ba re dgos tshul gsungs pa la'ang rten 'brel gyisakhas len zhus/ lcags bya'i lo cho 'phrul smon lam gyi dus mchod kho bo cag nas btang bar da dung rdo tshad gcig zhal 'debs su gnang zhing sgon lam gsung chos sogs chag med bka' drin bskyangs te smon pa'i mtshams spyor mdzad par ci 'byor gyi legs 'bul btegs/ smon lam grol rjes khri'i gnang ba zhus te zur bzhugs mdzad/ sku zhabs rin po cher gos yug bcu ras lnga bcu lha dar bcas phul bar dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong gang legs mthar phyin pa'i dga' dar gsol ston rgyas pa bcas gnang / tshogs chen dang gra tshang la mang ja 'gyed bcas kyi thog 'du khang chen mor mang nug dang bcad ldan sogs gos chen gang bzang gi bla bre gyan dgu ma long tsam gsar 'jog mdzad/ dus ji tsam snyigs mar song ba bzhin gyi snying stobs dang spro ba lhag par 'phel bas sku la'ang mi lcogs pa med pa/ byams pa'i rlung shugs kyis bskyod pas/ / shing bal bzhin du srid pa 'dir/ / 'gro ba'i don du g.yo ba lags/ / zhes pa'am/ spyod 'jug las/ je ltar rlung gis 'gro ba'am/ / 'ong bas shing bal dbang bsgyur ba/ / de bzhin spro bas dbang bsgyur zhing / / de lta na ni 'grub par 'gyur/ / zhes pa bzhin no/ / dus dang yul gyi mthar yang bshad sgrub kyi/ / dar chen bsgreng la snying stobs ma zhum pa/ / dam pa rnams kyi thugs skyed gru gzings kyis/ / don gnyis nor bu'i dga' ston ci yang drangs/ / hā ri dra yi cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan/ / ha ri bha dra'i dgongs don sher phyin sogs/ / ha ri tsardon dri 568

༄༅/ /togs bajod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/bsung 'thul ba yis/ / ha sa badzra bzhed pa yongs su bskangs/ / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin ba chen po mdzo dge ri khrod pa mkhas grub bstan 'dzin gyis zhus te bla ma dge bshes rags bsdus bzhi bcu skor la skyid shod gsung 'bum gyi lung dang / gzhan yang don gnyer can mang por 'dod chos ci rigs gnang / dam pa nyid dbang lung khrid man ngag sogs kyi gdams pa'i mdzod lta bu yin mod kyang da dung chos tshol ba la dgyes pas sku zhabs tho'u bkwan rin po che dgon par snga phyir phebs skabs 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongasardzogs kyi rjes gnang / mgon po'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel/snying zhugs kye thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs tshar chen gyis mdzad pa le tshan gnyis/ des mdzad pa'i tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rgyal dbang dang nyid kyis mdzad pa/ klu sgrub smon lam sogs lung thor bu mang tsam dang / blo sbyong chig brgyad ma'i nyams khrid bcas gsan/ kho bo cag gi rtsa nas kyang / dril bu lha lnga dang lusadakyil gyi dbang / mgon po bka' bcu gsum/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum/ tshe dpag sgrol ma dkar ljang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po/lo gyon ma gtso 'khor gsum sogs rjes gnang thor bu mang po dang lung yang 'ga' zhig gsan/ tshogs chen la rdor phreng dang mi tra'i dbang byed skabs/nyid sku na shin tu smin yod kyang da'i nang gi 'ga' zhig la'ang phebs nas gsan song ba ni chos kyis ngoms pa med pa'i rnam thar du snang / skabs shig ka ring sgar du phebs nas der gos sku thog tshad gsum can/ gtso bo byams mgon la/ lha mgron du rje yab sras/ yi dam chos srung sogs mang po bzhugs pa zhig sbyor 'jag mdzad/ nyid kyis gtso mdzad pa'i gra slob mang bos nyin gnyis kyi ring spyan dbye'i chog rgyas par bsgrubs te bkra shis kyi me 569

༄༅/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgra me'i gsung 'bum/tog char du bsnyil/ zam cha re'i 'gyed bstabs/ sde ba sbyi nas gsol ston gzab rgyas zhus shing thams cad gros mthun gyi sgo'i dgon der gzim khang zhig dgos tshul zhus pa zhal gyis bzhes te/ de'i phyi lor gzim khang rgyan lnga pa zhig phub/ 'od dpag med kyi sku mi tshad lhag tsam zhig dang li ma kha shas/ zhal thang byin can mang po bcas der bzhugs su gsol nas yul de'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bsgrubs/ mtshams mtshams su der chu spos nas bzhugs te sku'i 'phrod brten mdzad cing / rgyun bar bkra shis 'khyil du gzim khang che ba'i g.yas phyogs sur skor zur du bcad de bsro khang / nyi ra/ gsol thab sogs thams cad tshang ba khod yangs shing / ra bar me tog gi tshal yod pa shin tu 'gol zhing stabs bde ba zhig byas nas der 'jig rten gyi g.yeng ba ci yang med par thugs shin tu bag phebs shing zab mo'i nyams bzhes kyi rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba'i dga' bde'i ngang du bzhugs/ston mjug cig la sgol ma phu'i zhabs drung gis 'du khang gsar bskrun bgyis pa rab gnas kyi don du gdan 'dren zhus nas der phebs pa'i zhar la byams pa 'bum gling du mjal/ 'di kha cig kong tshes bzhengs zer yang / chos 'byung mang por rgya bza' kung jo bod du phebs pa'i lam nas brag la byams pa khru brgyad cu pa brkos zhes 'byung la/ de dus kyi pho brang zhing nga phu yin pas lam 'di dang 'grig cing gzhan na de 'dra ston rgyu med pa dang / 'di'i nye skor du sgol ma rang byon 'ong lugs kyis kyang shes pas/ kong tshes bzhengs zer ba de kong cos bzhengs zhes pa rim gyis sgra log pa yin par snang ngo / /de nas rgya bod kyi khrom chen pos bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas sgrol ma phur phebs/ dge legs char 'bebs kyi steng nas rab gnas rgyas pa sbyin sreg dang bcas gnad smin mdzad de rten dang brten pa mtha' dag byin rlabs mi 570

༄༅/ /tog4brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/zad pa'i gter du bsgrubs/ bka' drin gtang rag tu rje'i gser sku khru tshad ma gcig gis gtsos sku gsung thugs rten/ mchod cha'i rigs mang po/gos dar/ ras/ dung tse sogs dngos 'bul gya nom pa btegs/ de nas sgol ma'i sgang lam brgyud de phebs byams la bzhugs nas bde mchog rang byon gyi lha khang lo kyu tun tu grags par phebs/ tshogs 'khor gnang tshe 'ja' tshon sna lnga pa zhig shar bas rgya mi rnams kyang ngo mtshar du gyur te gus 'dud lhur blangs/ yar lam a 'gang rta mgrin rang byon gye lha khang du mjal/ de'i dge 'dun rnams kyis chos 'brel zhus pa'i re ba bskangs/de nas stag lung sprul pa'i skus gdan 'dren zhus te bsu ba ser sbreng dang bcas stag lung dgon du phebs/ der mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa zhig gsar 'dzug byed rtsis kyi skabs su yod pas brtsi bzhag gi thog ma gnang ste sa mthar bstan pa'i sgron me spar/ thugs smon gyi mthus gra tshang yang de nas bzung yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin 'phel/ khong dpon slob kun nas dngos 'bul yang rgya che ba phul/ de nas byon par hor tshang bla ma rgyal mtshan sogs kyis ja zhus 'bul ba bsu skyel sogs bkur ste phul du phyin pa bsgrubs te rim gyis dgon par babs/ kho bo cag nas mchod rten mthong grol chen mo bzhengs par srang sum cu'i zhal 'debs dang / sku zhabs rin po che nas rab gnas gnang skabs spyan dbye'i cho ga'ang lhan du gnang / phyis su de'i skor tshad kyi zhabs skor stong phrag bzhi'ang grangs gsog mdzad/ bla brang phyag mdzod blo bzang dar rgyas dus las 'das pa'i don du spyan drangs par 'pho ba'i spyan dmigs rjes 'dzin gyi bka' drin stsal/ a mchog dgon gyi lam rim gra tshang gi bla ma dang / rgyal mo dgon gyi reb tsha sprul pa'i skus dbon rgan 'das pa sogs kyi sar gdan 'dren nan cher zhus pa bzhin phebs nas so 571

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'itshonama'i gsung 'bum/sor bsngo smon sogs ched dmigs dang / dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams la'ang chos lung ci rigs stsal/ so so nas dngul rdo tshad/ gos spruganyer spyad/ rta nor sogs 'bul ba gang rgyas bstar/ de 'dra'i phebs bzhud thabs med dgos pa re gnyis ma gtogs rgyun par nang du ting nge 'dzin la yang dag par gzhol pas zag med kyi dga' bdes nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu 'da' bar mdzad/ de'i stobs kyis snga sor chos skyong chen pos sku tshe'i tshad dgung lo don lngar gsungs pa ji bzhin thog tu khel ba'i steng du thugs dam gyi mthus sku tshe bsrings te brgyad cu rtsa bgrang zhing / tshe rabs du maragazhan la 'tshe ba spangs pa'i myong ba dang byed pa rgyu mthun gyis/ de'i ring la 'phel zad 'khrugs pas snyun sogs kyis thugs dam nyi ma gcig 'chag dgos pa'ang ma byung bar zo mdog bde la/ tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang gis sku'i gzi mdangs rgyas bzhin par bzhugs/rgyun gyi thugs dam mdzad lugs kyang nad pa'i rim gro bzhin du grangs gang 'gro gtso bor mi mdzad par/ thog mar kun slong 'chos tshul dal bus gnad du 'gro ba zhig mdzad de/ de'i ngang nas zhal 'don so so'i skabs kyi dmigs rnam 'char nges gnang / gtso bor thun mong ba skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i gzhung shing nges 'byung byang sems yang dag pa'i lta ba gsum la rtsal 'don mdzad/ cho ga gang gsungs na'ang de gsum rmang gzhir byas te rang rang gi 'gros kyi rim pa gnyi ga'i rnal 'byor dang sbrags nas gsungs pa las gang tshar mi mdzad/ nyams len snying po mthar thug pa rang gis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gtso che bar gzigs te nyin mtshan dus kun tu dran shes bzhin gyis bya ra byas nas rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa bag med pa'i phyogs su cung zad kyang mi 'chor bas bslab khrims rnam par 572

༄/ /rtogasabarjod gzur gnasamakhas pa'i dga' ston/dag pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrung bar mdzad/ yul dus kyi dbang gis bla mar 'jog byed mo lung bstan zhig la gtso bor byed stabs/ la las lung bstan sogs zhus par ngas de 'dra mi shes gsungs/ cis kyang phyag mo zhig yin rung gnang dgos zhes u tshugs zhus par a kha kha da rdzun yang bshad dgos rgyu red ces thugs shin tu 'tsher ba gnang / phal mo cher bshad sa zhig ma rnyed pa'i zhe 'tsher las bshad dgos pa'i zhe 'tsher mi snang mod/dam pa nyid kyi dgongs par blo spyong mtshon cha 'khor lo las/ dam chos gtsug lag zhus nas mo bon skyong / / phung byed rtog pa'i mgo la chems se chem/ / gsungs pa dang / bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgos las/rang tshos sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa la mo ma no shos tsam mi rtsi zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bka' gtsug lag gi mdo rgyud rnams su blang dor rgyu 'bras thams cad gsungs pa la yid mi ches par/ mo lung rtsis gsum gtso bor byed pa la thugs shin tu ma mnyes pa'i gsung du snang / zhabs brtan rim gro re sgrub na'ang gto mdos sogs gsar rnying mang po mi mdzad par/ rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa klog 'don sogs 'phral phugs gnyi gar phan nges re mdzad de gnad shin tu che/ la la zhig dpal mgon klu sgrub kyis/ mkha' la skar mkhan dag gis rtsis byas nas/ / zla ba dang ni skar ma'i lam rnams shes/ / khyim na mi dang khyim thab log pa dag / sna tshogs spyod pa de ni mthong ma gyur/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ gzhan gye legs nyes thams cad lung ston yang rang gi 'phral yun gye mdun ma kun 'chol 'gro ba mang bar snang na'ang / nyid kyi mdzad pa gang la'ang dang po nas dgongs pa gtad tshul de'i thog tu mi khel mi srid pa ni 'byung 'gyur gzigs pa'i mtshan mar snang /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig 'ong ba'i rtsa ba 'dod chung chog shes kyi 573

༄/ /gung thang ཿna pa'isoyo khrung ཿma/'phags pa'i rigs bzhi dang / sangs rgyas thugs rje can des rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par dzogs pa'i dge slong gi gnas bzhi gsungs pa thugs la bzhag ste nor dngos po gang la'ang 'dzin chags spong zhing / rtsol sgrub la ma ltos par rang shugs kyis 'ongs pa tsam las/ rgya che grangs mang gi rtsol ba mi mdzad de/ 'phreng ba rgyan ldan legs pa re 'bul mkhan byung tshe phyag tu bsnams na zhus kyang / bod pa tsa le ba byed rgyu min rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa 'dis chog gsungs nas sku tshe gang por 'phreng ser re las mi bsnams/ des mtshon pa'i nyer spyad gang yin kyang rnying pa des spyad rung tsam yod na des chog par byed pa ma gtogs/ bkrag gang che'i gsar ba'i rigs spyan lam du'ang cher mi 'jog zhal nas rung mi rung gi zur mang po mi gsung yang / 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag gsung gleng zas spyod sogs gang gi tshe'ang ston pa'i bcas pa la zon byed bzhin kho nar bzhugs/'bad med du byung ba'i phyag rdzas rnams ni cung zad kyang chud zos su mi gtong bar dkon mchog gi zhing kho nar 'gro ba mdzad de/ rigs gra snga phyir 'bras srungs la phog chen gsum dang bcas 'gyed bzhi bcu zhe lnga/ zur du'ang lha sa smon lam/ 'bras spung tshogs chen/ sgo mang bcas 'gyed lan dgu tsam gnang zhing srang lnga stong skor gyi mchod rdzas/ 'bri nyis brgyar nye ba'i 'jog pa sogs bsdoms te mang ja gra ja'i rigs ma brtsis pa la'ang ma mtha' srang khri phrag bzhi tsam gyis dge 'dun mchog snang ba ni po to ba'i zhal nas/ ngas gang rnyed dge 'dun so can gyi kha na gsungs pa'i rnam thar du snang / des na bden pa'i rnam pa'i mdo las/ rab tu byung ba la ni zang zing gi sbyin pa ma gnang ngo / / zhes gsungs pa dang / bka' gdams gong ma rnams/kho bo cag gis gtong ba'i phan yon rnams mi brjod kyi/ 'dzin pa'i nyes 574

༄za/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/dmigs brjod pa yin/ gsung ba rnams rang gi sdom khrims sogs yal bar dor te thabs sna tshogs kyis longs spyod bsgrubs nas sbyin gtong byed pa bkag pa yin pa ni/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa las 'das nas ji ltar yang sbyin pa mi gtong /zhes pa ltar yin pas/ rtsol med du byung ba'i steng nas 'di ltar gtong ba rgyalasras kyi lag len ched du bsngags pa'i gnas su gyur pa yin no/ / mdo smad du'ang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur la srang lnga stong lhag par song ba'i tshod du snang yang zhib cha ma nges so/ / de'ang dam pa'i skyes bu nang phan tshun dgongs pa mthun pa chos nyid yin stabs/ khri rin po che blo bzang smon lam dang dam pa nyid thugs nang shin tu nye bas nyin gcig rnam pa gnyi gas gsol tshigs lhan du mdzad de gsung 'phros mang po gnang ba'i lhongs shig la bde 'gror skye thub mi thub cig gsungs bar/ dam pa 'dis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas las ci 'dra bsags yod mi shes pas dka' mo red zhus par/nga rang gnyis bde 'gror skye thub drag nga rang gnyis sgye mi thub na mi tshos gang 'dra byed rgyu yin gsungs ba'ang / dpang po gnyis kyi gtso bo bzung /zhes pa ltar rang sems dpang por bzhag ste tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gdeng tshad dang ldan pa'i gsung yin te/ sngon po to pa'i slob ma sgom pa sher yonabya ba sku gshegs khar/ po to pas khyed dga' ldan du skyes na der jo 'brom gnyis bzhugs pas nga'i rgyu mtshan dris tshe 'di 'dra zhus zhes 'phrin bskur bar khong gis dbu gug gug byas pas/ 'ga' zhig bzhad gad byed kyang / gcig gis 'di nges par dga' ldan du skye'am zhus pa la/ po to bas/ 'di dga' ldan du skyes te yong 'di 'dra mi skye na dga' ldan stongs te yongagasungs pa bla ma thugs zin pa'i tshad bzhag tu gsungs pa ltar ro/ /575

༄/ /yo thang bstan pa'i sgroname'i khrung 'bum/der ma zad khri chen de ni deng sang gi mi zhig dang mi 'dra bar bcos ma cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing thugs la shar ba drang thal du gsung ba zhig yod pas/'ga' zhig la mkhan po chos dar gra pa yag po yin kho nga las kyang yag bsam pa yod gsungs te/ gra pa yag po zhes pa de bstan pa'i gnad shes pa zhig gis bltas na rnam thar chen po yin no/ / yang phyag mdzod 'dis lan cig rgya nag mkhan po zhig gi rjes la phyin nas rnyed 'tshol zhig byas te gra tshang bsnyen bkur zhig e thub snyam/ klong rdol rin po cher zhus pa'i lan du/ sgo mang mkhan po gang zag rang bzhin pa min pas de'i dgongs par ma mthun na grwa ja mang ja btang yang chos min/ de'i gsung bzhin byas na gang byas chos yin rdo rje grags ldan gyis kyang grogs byas yong gsungs pa dang / yang klong rdol rin po che'i mdun du bla ma 'ga' zhig 'ongs pa'i tshe bkur gzos che ba mdzad cing / 'di par ci yang mi mdzad pas nye gnas kyis de mi mdzes par 'dug zhus pa la/ khyod kyis mi shes/ so so sgye bo las dang po pa la de 'dra ma byas na khong khro lang yong / mkhan po chos dar de 'dra min gsungs ba sogs tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes chen du mas bsngags pa brjod tshul gyi lo rgyus mang yang zur tsam bkod pa yin/ mdor na sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa'i bab mtha' dag lha rtse pa'i rnam thar 'brug zla grags kyis mdzad pa las/ sku bslab pa gsum po'i khrims kyis btsun pa/ phyar g.yang gi 'chor sgeg mi ston pa/snang shas kyi dri mi bro ba/ bcos ma'i tshul mi 'chos pa/ snyoms las kyi ro mi myang ba/ gsung lhad ma zhugs shing zur ma nyams pa/ gsong por smra zhing chad don btsan pa/ gnad zab la go sla ba/ rgyas bshad don du 'dril ba/snga phyi 'brel chags pa/ sgra mi gsal ba'i ldab ldib can ma yin pa/ thugs zab cing dkyil che ba/ ma brtag pa'i bya ba dang bral ba/ g.yo dang sgyu med 576

༄za/ /rtog4brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/pa/ drang zhing gzu bor gnas pa/ khengs dregs kyi che khyad spangs pa/bab col thub chod can du ma gyur pa zhes pa'i khyad par rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshang ba ni/ dngos su mjal zhing rgyus yod pa mtha' dag gi mngon sum tshad mas bston med du 'grub pa bzhin no/ / zhi dul bag yod sru sdug gos kyis klubs/ / zhi lhag zung 'jug thabs shes 'dab zung— g.yo/ / zhi ba'i mkha' la mi gnas srid pa'i skyon/ / zhi phyir 'dzin mar mi ltung e ma mtshar/ / gzhung mang thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnad kun thugs su chud/ / gzhar yang mi nyams rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad brnyes/ / gzhan dang mi mnyam rnam thar bsam mi khyab/ / de nas dgung lo brgyad cu'i skabs su jo shāka sogs la mchod thebs dang / sgo mang gra tshang la mang 'gyed kyi thebs dngul srang bzhi brgya bskur/ 'di kha'i tshogs chen la mang ja bzhi'i thog dung tse sum brgya re'i 'gyed btang / gya gcig bzhes pa'i dbyar jog nyin gcig nged kyi rtsar phebs te zhal chem gyi rnam pa lta bu 'ga' zhig gsungs/ sku'i bab sngar dang phal cher 'dra bas da dung lo shas skyon med mod snyam nas de lugs dang gang gsungs yid la 'dzin rgyu'i khas len zhus/ bcu pa'i nang sku khams cung zad ltems pas phyag mdzod la/da nga'i phung po cho mi 'dug pas khyod kyis gra sgrig gyis gsungs bar/ sku gzugs nga tshos bltas na skyon mi 'dug sku zhabs rin po che phebs ring la bzhugs mod zhus pas/ de nga'i gzugs pos mi lcogs shing / mi lam la bltas na'ang mi 'dug pa 'dra gsungs/ mnal lam ci byung zhus par/smad sog 'dra ba phu thung can zhig 'ongs nas/ khyod dbus rtsang la 'gro dgos zer bas/ nga'i sku gsung thugs rten dang dpe cha rnams la bdag po med pas nga mi 'gro byas par/ de mi chog 'gro dgos kyang phyir myur du 'ong 577

༄/ /gung thang bayo pa'isgoname'i khrung 4ma/chog pas/ de'i ring la sku gsung thugs rten rnams ngas bsrung 'dug zer/khyod su yin byas par/ rdo rje grags ldan gyi sprul pa smad sog gi cha lugs byas nas 'ongs pa yin zer/ de nga'i chos skyong yin gsungs/ yang zla ba bcugacig pa'i nang la lan cig khong dga' ldan shar rtse nas khri 'don byas/gos thams cad gsar ba spyon pa rmis/ de rtags gcig yin gsungs/skabs shig nged rgya nang zhig tu skyes gtong ba 'dra gsungs te/ smra brjod sogs ji bzhin mi 'ong dgongs pa yin nam thugs khral lta bu mdzad/ de'i ched du rim gro'ang 'ga' zhig bsgrubs nas da der mi skye bar 'dug gsungs thugs lhod pa'i rnam pa mdzad/ gsung 'phros kyi zhar la sprul sku'i don sku 'bum chos skyong la zhus na 'bras spung gnas chung dang gcig yin pas des chog gsungs te/ nyid dang chos skyong rnam gnyis phan tshun thugs yid ches pa'i nang nyams shig yod par snang / yang bcu gcig pa'i mas bcu gnyis kyi zhog ka yar bzhengs ma thag shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam pas zho khyer shog gsungs te thur ma gang bzhes/ mdang nga'i rmi lam la rnal 'byor pa zhig phebs byung bar/ ngas khyed su yin dris pas/ nga bde mchog gi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin gsungs nas ngas khyod la bdud rtsi khyer yong yod gsungs/bdud rtsi ka re zhus pas/ ka pā la'i nang nas bdud rtsi nga la byin nas nga khyod kyi gdan thog 'di nas zhing la phebs rgyu yin gsungs byung / de'ang rtags gcig yin gsungs ba la/ phyag mdzod kyis rnal 'byor pa de su yin zhus pas/ de nga'i bla ma khri dge 'dun phun tshogs pa tshang bde mchog gi rnal 'byor pa yin gsungs te/ nga'i bla ma gsungs lugs la dpag na sku tshe snga marakhri chen de dang 'brel che ba thugs kyis dran pa yin nam snyam/ 'khon ston gye 'khrungs rabs khong rang gis mdzad pa las/ de dag kun dang las 578

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkha4pa'i dga' ston/'brel stobs che bas/ / thar pa sgrub pa'i rten bzang 'di thob par/ / skye ba rim par brgyud pa khyod yin zhes/ / 'ga' yis rab btags mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ / gsungs pa'i dpe ltar/ rang lta bu khri chen de 'dra'i skye mtha' min pa rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur pas thag chod kyang / sngon las kyi 'brel ba zhig la dgongs nas lha dang bla mas de'i skye bar lung bstan te mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa la dag snang sbyangs te 'di skabs kyang dam tshig gso ba'i phyir dbang dgos tshul gsungs ba bzhin/ bcu gcig pa'i gnam gang la gzim chung du byin te dril bu lha lnga'i dbang gzhi dzogs par phul/sa sbrul lo nged rang gnas mjal du 'gro skabs lo kyā tun du zhag gsum bsdad pa'i gnyis pa'i dgung mo rmi lam du lha khang de rgya che tsam 'dug pa'i phun gdung gi nyams med par gser zangs kyi sku 'ga' zhig bsgrig 'dug de sngon mdzo mo mkhar gyi lha khang sogs mjal skabs nang rten rnams kyi sne nas rten skal re bslang ba de'i bag chags lta bus nga la rten skal zhig dgos byas par/ gcig gis yum gyi phyag gi thod pa de khyod kyi rten skal gyes/ stabs 'grig na de gnyis la'ang byin zer/ phyir bltas pas gzhan mi 'dug cing /su yin ma shes/ de'i mtshams nas gnyid sad/ phyi nyin gser chab 'bul skabs pir gyis gsol yang ji bzhin zhig mi 'ong 'dug pas sku la byugs btang yang khyad mi 'dug snyam/ rang lag pas yab yum gnyis kyi zhal dang phyag sogs la byugs skabs byin rlabs kyi rdzas shig lag tu byung bas rmi lam de de la blta'am snyam/ de'i lo rjes ma'i rjes ma zhig la rmi lam du sngar gnas mjal la song tshul/ rmi lam rmis tshul sogs bshad kyin 'dug pas/ rmi lam gyi ngo de na de gnyis zer rgyu'i gcig sgo mang mkhan po tshang yin pa lta bu zhig shar 'dug pas rkyen byas te dogs pa bslang yod pa'i thog da res 579

༄/ /yo ca bayo pa'i mame'i g.yo 'bum/stabs 'grig lugs kyis rten de'ang phul ba yin/ rang gis 'phrin pa tsam zhigacos kyang rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug pham mthing pa yin pas/ nyid kyi mnal lam du byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa de'ang de la blta bar mngon/ yang zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nub gcig gsol dpon la khyod yar long / shar rtse mkhan po phebs ki yod/ bde mchog gi lha grangs thams cad kyang phebs ki yod pas khyod kyis e mthong gi bde mchog gsung gin yod pa khyod kyis e thos gsungs/ lan cig na bza' gsar ba bzhes te jo bo rin po che/ rwa mo che gnyis la mjal bar 'gro rgyu yin gsungs ba sogs la dpag na nyams dang rmi lam 'dres pa'i dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs shig byung ba'i tshod du snang / nyin gcig gsol dpon la gdung 'khru byed kyi dri bzang tshags kyis gsungs bar/ khos khyed thugs dam la bzhugs tshe gdung bkrus na thugs dam la e gnod zhus pa la/thugs dam gyi skabs dri bzang gis 'khru ba dang spos sbar ba sogs kyis mi gnod pa nga tsho ri bo dge lugs pa'i thugs dam gyi khyad chos yin gsungs te/dge lugs pa tsam la rtogs pa mtho dman gyi rim pa sna tshogs shig yod kyang /nyid bstan pa'i snying po 'khrul ba dang bral ba 'di'i nyams len gyis rtogs pa brtan po'i gdeng thob pa'i gsung du snang / de ltar sku tshe gcig gi bstan 'gro'i don dang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi mdzad pa thams cad dgongs pa bzhin mthar 'khyol te/ ded dpon chen po dgos 'dod grub nas rang yul du ldog pa'am/ bu pha khyim du 'gro ba ltar dga' spro'i ngang nas gya gcig pa chu sprel lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i tho rengs mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te chos dbyings su gshegs/bdun phrag gcig gi ring thugs dam la bzhugs shing / de rjes grol ba'i 580

༄༅/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnayomakhas pa'i dga' ston/rtags kyang bshad tshod ji lta ba bzhin byung / zhing du phebs pa nas nyin ltar bla gra mang pos dkyil 'khor gye 'khor lo du ma zhal phye ste bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad du byas nas mchog khrus 'bul ba/ gra tshang so so'i dge 'dun mang nas rgyan 'jug rgyud gzhung sogs gsungs ba/ phyi nang kun tu mchod pa rgya chen po gsol 'debs dang smon lam gyi rim pa sogs thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i thabs la 'dun pa chig dril du 'bad/ nyer bdun la sku gdung zhugs 'bul byas/ nang nas kyang thams cad la bsnyen bkur dang yon gang rgyas dbul/ gtsug lag khang so sor mchod pa/ nyer brgyad kyi nyin tshogs chen la bsnyen bkur gzabs thog ja bag re'i 'gyed btang / sku zhabs rin po cher slar ljags bsngo zhu rten chibs chibs 'gros/ dngul rdo tshad/ gos yug nyer spyad sogs 'bul pa gya nom pa/ bla ma gdan zur/ sprul sku che chung sogs thams cad la'ang 'bul tshan dngos dag ka ring dgon du nyin 'khyong gi bsnyen bkur thog ja bag phyed re'i 'gyed dang tsha ra/ tshan grangs rol cha sogs spyi 'jog thar pa gling la'ang de mtshungs/ grong sde rnams la'ang sgo 'gyed yid tshim pa/ gzhan yang phan tshun gyi dgon sgrub sde du mar zhal 'debs/ ngan slong la sbyin pa sogs rnam dkar gyi phung po rlabs che ba bsgrubs/ gdung rus la kho bo cag nas rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas rus chog bgyes te sku dang satstsha mang du btab pa rnams gser zangs kyi mchod rten dkyug mtho gsum lhag pa zhig tu bzhugs su gsol te gzim chung nang rten du bzhugs pa sogs zhabs sdod rnams nas lhag bsam dag pas khur du blangs pas dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rnams kyang legs par mthar phyin te thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i dngos po kho nar gyur to/ / rtsang dbus mdo smad rgya nag yul kun tu/ / rtsol med bstan 'gro'i don chen 581

༄/ /gung ca bstan pa'isgroname'i khrung 'am/mthar phyin te/ / rtsa mchog grong du thub pa'i mdzad pa bzhin/ / rtse gcig zhi ba'i dbyengs su gzhol bar gyur/ / e waṃ thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i gar/ /a ho dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa ni/ / e ma mthong thos dran reg thams cad la/ / a mṛ ta bzhin thog mtha' bar du dge / de nas yang srid 'khrul bral myur gsal gyi don la nang nas lha bla ma'i lung phebs kyi rim gro nar mar bsgrubs shing / dad ldan bu slob rnams kyis gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa dang / kun mkhyen bla ma'i bstan pa spel ba'i thugs bskyed lhan cig pa sogs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang gis yang srid gzhon nu'i 'dzum zhal mngon du gyur pa'i dga' ston la nye bar phyogs pa 'di bzhin lags so/ / smras pa/ rmad byung thugs skyed rta mchog kha sgo las/ / bab pa'igaser gyi bye ma rgyal sras spyod/ / sdeb legs gtam du 'dren pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ / sa gsum lus can dag byed mchog tu spel/ / rlan gsher gcig la 'gro gsum snang tshul bzhin/ / rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i gdams pa dang / / tshul ldan gzur gnas mkhas 'dod bslab bya'am/ / sgra don nyams ldan snyan ngag gzhung du mdzod/ / ma smad grags pa'i shugs 'chang chos kyi rnga/ / bskul ba tsam las snyan pa'i gdangs 'byung gi / sgra med rtsig pa'i ngos la rnam pa brgyar/ / bsnun yang don mthun sgra snyan ci las 'byung / / dam pa'i yon tan gsong por smra ba'i dges/ / don min stong du 'gyu ba'i ro 'dzin 'dis/ / ngag gi nyes pa ci bgyis kun byang ste/ / 'jam dpal gsung gi dbang phyug 'grub gyur cig / 'brel thogs dad ldan kun kyang legs smon gyi/ / srad pu ma chad dal 'byor 'phreng brgyud pa/ / dpal ldan bla ma'i mdud 'dzin gyis bzung ste/ / bde chen gsang sngags rgyal po 'dren gyur cig / sngon goms lugs bskyed 'bras bzang sa bon du/ /582

༄/ /rtogs brjod gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston/slar yang smin pa'i yang srid myu gu gsar/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i snye ma yongs gang ste/ / bstan 'gro'i bsod nams zhing sa mdzes gyur cig /phyag drug myur mdzad mgon dang chos kyi rgyal/ / sprul pa'i chos rgyal rdo rje grags ldan sogs/ / bstan srung rgya mtshos rdo rje'i g.yar dam bzhin/ /'dod dgu lhun grub 'phrin las kāryachu zhes dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid sgo mang mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos dar pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa gzur gnas mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni/ nyid kyi zhabs 'degs tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa phyag mdzod blo bzang don grub/ dpon po dkon mchog chos bzang / gsol dpon blo bzang dge 'dun sogs kyis snga phyir yang yang bskul zhing / stag lung sprul pa'i sku sogs gsung las skyes pa'i zhal slob 'ga' zhig gis nye bar bskul bas mtshams sbyar te/ 7btsun pa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes me byi'i lo dgun mtshams kyi skabs nyin gung gi thun gseng du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ram pa dkon mchog kun dga' 'o/ / / /583

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'isgroname'i khrung lam/gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/dpar sgrig dpe skrun mi sna/blo 'dri sa/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/gling rgya bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/gung thang thub bstan/bsod nams rgya mtsho/gtso sgrig pa/ don 'grub rdo rje/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ 'jam dga'/sbyi khubajus 'doms pa/ tsha lag tshe ring rgyal/rtsom sgrig khongs mi/ mgon po dar rgyas/ phur kho/ rta mgrin rdo rje/'phrin las rgyal mtshan/ pan de mkhar/ting 'dzin bkra shis/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ ting 'dzin bkra shis/

༄/ /gung thang bstan pa'i 0sa khrung 4ma/dkon mchogakun dngos 'jigs med dbang bo'i sdes/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur bzhin/ /lungahogs nyizla zung gi sgon me yis/ /skye dgu'i rmongs mun sel ba 'di rmad byung / /zhes dbal mang pani tas mdzad pa'i chigs bcad kyis mdun bsus te mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum dpe skrun byed par mthun rkyen sbyar mkhan a ri'i zam pa'i thebs rtsa tshogs par thugasarje che zhu/ zla rgya༅ po

ṭwāṃ bheṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ/ rte /shaṃ// ༷/ // bhebhe snye rdo sdi ༷dre/ na/༄khya/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgon me'i gsung 'bum/ /(ca):gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas/(pe cin ho phing li byang lam yang 14pa/ sbrag ang 100013kha par ang grang4yo23la11—6509)mi rigs dpe spun khang gi skul 'od par sgrig khang nas par bsgrigs/ti zhin par khang na4par btab/2khru4lo'i ma5par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2ཿ4lo'i zla 5par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/deb tshad 850par ma116877 172 dpar shog 18 5dpar grangasasgom1—1mi deb rer sgor 35 khru
